149		err    error
150	
151		width, height int
152		quitting      bool
153		chosen        string
154	}
155	
156	// New builds the dashboard.
157	func New(actions Actions, rows []inventory.Row, repos []RepoRow) Model {
158		in := textinput.New()
159		in.CharLimit = 200
160	
161		return Model{
162			actions: actions,
163			rows:    rows,
164			repos:   repos,
165			input:   in,
166			width:   100,
167			height:  30,
168		}
169	}
170	
171	// WithRemotes seeds the lazy forge view from a fresh on-disk cache. The first
172	// switch is then instant; r still refreshes explicitly.
173	func (m Model) WithRemotes(rows []RemoteRow) Model {
174		m.remotes, m.remotesLoaded = rows, true
175		return m
176	}
177	
178	// Chosen reports a directory the caller should cd into after the program
179	// exits, or "" when there is none.
180	func (m Model) Chosen() string { return m.chosen }
181	
182	// CurrentView reports which list is showing.
183	func (m Model) CurrentView() View { return m.view }
184	
185	// Init implements tea.Model.
186	func (m Model) Init() tea.Cmd { return textinput.Blink }
187	
188	type reloadMsg struct {
189		rows      []inventory.Row
190		repos     []RepoRow
191		remotes   []RemoteRow
192		remoteSet bool
193		err       error
194	}
195	
196	type remoteMsg struct {
197		rows []RemoteRow
198		err  error
199	}
200	
201	type statsMsg struct {
202		panel StatsPanel
203		err   error
204	}
205	
206	type configEditedMsg struct{ err error }
207	
208	type configMsg struct {
209		tools         []Tool
210		status        string
211		refreshRemote bool
212		err           error
213	}
214	
215	type actionMsg struct {
216		status     string
217		cd         string
218		remoteName string
219		localPath  string
220		err        error
221	}
222	
223	func (m Model) reload() tea.Cmd {
224		return func() tea.Msg {
225			ctx := context.Background()
226			out := reloadMsg{}
227			if m.actions.Reload != nil {
228				rows, err := m.actions.Reload(ctx)
229				out.rows, out.err = rows, err
230			}
231			if m.actions.ReloadRepos != nil {
232				repos, err := m.actions.ReloadRepos(ctx)
233				out.repos = repos
234				if out.err == nil {
235					out.err = err
236				}
237			}
238			return out
239		}
240	}
241	
242	func (m Model) reloadRemote() tea.Cmd {
243		return func() tea.Msg {
244			if m.actions.ReloadRemote == nil {
245				return remoteMsg{}
246			}
247			rows, err := m.actions.ReloadRemote(context.Background())
248			return remoteMsg{rows: rows, err: err}
249		}
250	}
251	
252	func (m Model) reloadConfig(refreshRemote bool) tea.Cmd {
253		return func() tea.Msg {
254			if m.actions.ReloadConfig == nil {
255				return configMsg{refreshRemote: refreshRemote}
256			}
257			tools, status, err := m.actions.ReloadConfig(context.Background())
258			return configMsg{tools: tools, status: status, refreshRemote: refreshRemote, err: err}
259		}
260	}
261	
262	func (m Model) reloadAfterConfig(refreshRemote bool) tea.Cmd {
263		return func() tea.Msg {
264			ctx := context.Background()
265			out := reloadMsg{}
266			if m.actions.Reload != nil {
267				out.rows, out.err = m.actions.Reload(ctx)
268			}
269			if m.actions.ReloadRepos != nil {
270				var err error
271				out.repos, err = m.actions.ReloadRepos(ctx)
272				if out.err == nil {
273					out.err = err
274				}
275			}
276			if refreshRemote && m.actions.ReloadRemote != nil {
277				var err error
278				out.remotes, err = m.actions.ReloadRemote(ctx)
279				out.remoteSet = true
280				if out.err == nil {
281					out.err = err
282				}
283			}
284			return out
285		}
286	}
287	
288	// visibleTasks applies the state filter and the text query.
289	func (m Model) visibleTasks() []inventory.Row {
290		var out []inventory.Row
291		for _, r := range m.rows {
292			if len(m.states) > 0 {
293				if !containsState(m.states, r.Task.State) {
294					continue
295				}
296			} else if r.Task.State == task.Done && !m.showDone {
297				continue
298			}
299			if !matches(taskSearchText(r), m.filter) {
300				continue
301			}
302			out = append(out, r)
303		}
304		return out
305	}
306	
307	// visibleRepos applies the text query, and sorts repositories with work in
308	// flight to the top — that is what someone opening the dashboard is looking
309	// for, not alphabetical order.
310	func (m Model) visibleRepos() []RepoRow {
311		var out []RepoRow
312		for _, r := range m.repos {
313			if !matches(r.searchText(), m.filter) {
314				continue
315			}
316			out = append(out, r)
317		}
318		sort.SliceStable(out, func(i, j int) bool {
319			a, b := out[i], out[j]
320			if a.HotTasks() != b.HotTasks() {
321				return a.HotTasks() > b.HotTasks()
322			}
323			if a.Live != b.Live {
324				return a.Live
325			}
326			if len(a.Tasks) != len(b.Tasks) {
327				return len(a.Tasks) > len(b.Tasks)
328			}
329			if a.Status.Dirty() != b.Status.Dirty() {
330				return a.Status.Dirty()
331			}
332			return strings.ToLower(a.Repo.Display()) < strings.ToLower(b.Repo.Display())
333		})
334		return out
335	}
336	
337	// visibleRemotes filters the combined gh/glab inventory. Local clones sort
338	// first, then recently updated repositories.
339	func (m Model) visibleRemotes() []RemoteRow {
340		var out []RemoteRow
341		for _, r := range m.remotes {
342			if matches(r.searchText(), m.filter) {
343				out = append(out, r)
344			}
345		}
346		sort.SliceStable(out, func(i, j int) bool {
347			if out[i].Cloned() != out[j].Cloned() {
348				return out[i].Cloned()
349			}
350			if !out[i].Repo.UpdatedAt.Equal(out[j].Repo.UpdatedAt) {
351				return out[i].Repo.UpdatedAt.After(out[j].Repo.UpdatedAt)
352			}
353			return out[i].Repo.Label() < out[j].Repo.Label()
354		})
355		return out
356	}
357	
358	func containsState(list []task.State, s task.State) bool {
359		for _, v := range list {
360			if v == s {
361				return true
362			}
363		}
364		return false
365	}
366	
367	// count is how many rows the current view has.
368	func (m Model) count() int {
369		switch m.view {
370		case ViewRepos:
371			return len(m.visibleRepos())
372		case ViewRemote:
373			return len(m.visibleRemotes())
374		default:
375			return len(m.visibleTasks())
376		}
377	}
378	
379	// at is the cursor position in the current view.
380	func (m Model) at() int {
381		switch m.view {
382		case ViewRepos:
383			return m.repoCursor
384		case ViewRemote:
385			return m.remoteCursor
386		default:
387			return m.taskCursor
388		}
389	}
390	
391	// setAt moves the cursor, clamped to the current view's length.
392	func (m *Model) setAt(i int) {
393		n := m.count()
394		switch {
395		case n == 0:
396			i = 0
397		case i >= n:
398			i = n - 1
399		case i < 0:
400			i = 0
401		}
402		switch m.view {
403		case ViewRepos:
404			m.repoCursor = i
405		case ViewRemote:
406			m.remoteCursor = i
407		default:
408			m.taskCursor = i
409		}
410	}
411	
412	// currentTask returns the selected task, if the task view is showing one.
413	func (m Model) currentTask() (inventory.Row, bool) {
414		if m.view != ViewTasks {
415			return inventory.Row{}, false
416		}
417		rows := m.visibleTasks()
418		if m.at() >= len(rows) {
419			return inventory.Row{}, false
420		}
421		return rows[m.at()], true
422	}
423	
424	// currentRepo returns the selected repository, if the repo view is showing one.
425	func (m Model) currentRepo() (RepoRow, bool) {
426		if m.view != ViewRepos {
427			return RepoRow{}, false
428		}
429		repos := m.visibleRepos()
430		if m.at() >= len(repos) {
431			return RepoRow{}, false
432		}
433		return repos[m.at()], true
434	}
435	
436	// currentRemote returns the selected forge repository.
437	func (m Model) currentRemote() (RemoteRow, bool) {
438		if m.view != ViewRemote {
439			return RemoteRow{}, false
440		}
441		rows := m.visibleRemotes()
442		if m.at() >= len(rows) {
443			return RemoteRow{}, false
444		}
445		return rows[m.at()], true
446	}
447	
448	// currentDir is the checkout the selected row points at, for the external
449	// tools and for the cd directive.
450	func (m Model) currentDir() string {
451		if r, ok := m.currentTask(); ok {
452			if r.CheckoutExists {
453				return r.Checkout
454			}
455			return ""
456		}
457		if r, ok := m.currentRepo(); ok {
458			return r.Repo.Path
459		}
460		if r, ok := m.currentRemote(); ok {
461			return r.LocalPath
462		}
463		return ""
464	}
465	
466	// Update implements tea.Model.
467	func (m Model) Update(msg tea.Msg) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
468		switch msg := msg.(type) {
469		case tea.WindowSizeMsg:
470			m.width, m.height = msg.Width, msg.Height
471			return m, nil
472	
473		case reloadMsg:
474			if msg.err != nil {
475				m.err = msg.err
476				return m, nil
477			}
478			m.err = nil
479			if msg.rows != nil {
480				m.rows = msg.rows
481			}
482			if msg.repos != nil {
483				m.repos = msg.repos
484			}
485			if msg.remoteSet {
486				m.remotes, m.remotesLoaded, m.remotesLoading = msg.remotes, true, false
487			}
488			m.setAt(m.at())
489			return m, nil
490	
491		case remoteMsg:
492			m.remotes, m.remotesLoaded, m.remotesLoading = msg.rows, true, false
493			m.err = msg.err
494			m.status = ""
495			m.setAt(m.at())
496			return m, nil
497	
498		case configEditedMsg:
499			if msg.err != nil {
500				m.err, m.status = msg.err, ""
501				return m, nil
502			}
503			m.status = "reloading config…"
504			return m, m.reloadConfig(m.view == ViewRemote)
505	
506		case configMsg:
507			if msg.err != nil {
508				m.err, m.status = msg.err, ""
509				return m, nil
510			}
511			m.actions.Tools = msg.tools
512			m.err, m.status = nil, msg.status
513			return m, m.reloadAfterConfig(msg.refreshRemote)
514	
515		case statsMsg:
516			if msg.err != nil {
517				m.err = msg.err
518				m.stats = nil
519			} else {
520				m.err = nil
521				m.stats = &msg.panel
522			}
523			m.status = ""
524			return m, nil
525	
526		case actionMsg:
527			if msg.err != nil {
528				m.err = msg.err
529				return m, nil
530			}
531			m.err, m.status = nil, msg.status
532			if msg.remoteName != "" && msg.localPath != "" {
533				for i := range m.remotes {
534					if m.remotes[i].Repo.FullName == msg.remoteName {
535						m.remotes[i].LocalPath = msg.localPath
536						break
537					}
538				}
539			}
540			if msg.cd != "" {
541				// Under a runtime with no sessions the only useful outcome is
542				// putting the user in the directory, which needs the alternate
543				// screen torn down first.
544				m.chosen, m.quitting = msg.cd, true
545				return m, tea.Quit
546			}
547			if m.view == ViewRemote {
548				// Clone already updated the selected row; only local repo/task
549				// state needs a refresh. A network round-trip here would make a
550				// successful clone feel hung for several seconds.
551				return m, m.reload()
552			}
553			return m, m.reload()
554	
555		case tea.KeyMsg:
556			if m.mode == modeStats {
557				return m.updateStats(msg)
558			}
559			switch m.mode {
560			case modeFilter:
561				return m.updateFilter(msg)
562			case modeEditNext, modeConfirmPark, modeStartTask, modeStartDirect, modeConfirmClone:
563				return m.updatePrompt(msg)
564			}
565			return m.updateList(msg)
566		}
567		return m, nil
568	}
569	
570	func (m Model) updateList(msg tea.KeyMsg) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
571		n := m.count()
572		page := m.listHeight() / 2
573		if page < 1 {
574			page = 1
575		}
576	
577		switch msg.String() {
578		case "q", "ctrl+c":
579			m.quitting = true
580			return m, tea.Quit
581		case "esc":
582			// One escape clears whatever narrowing is in effect before quitting
583			// becomes the meaning of the key.
584			if m.filter != "" || len(m.states) > 0 {
585				m.filter, m.states = "", nil
586				m.setAt(0)
587				return m, nil
588			}
589			m.quitting = true
590			return m, tea.Quit
591	
592		// Vim-style movement, with the arrow equivalents alongside.
593		case "j", "down", "ctrl+n":
594			m.setAt(m.at() + 1)
595		case "k", "up", "ctrl+p":
596			m.setAt(m.at() - 1)
597		case "ctrl+d", "pgdown":
598			m.setAt(m.at() + page)
599		case "ctrl+u", "pgup":
600			m.setAt(m.at() - page)
601		case "g", "home":
602			m.setAt(0)
603		case "G", "end":
604			m.setAt(n - 1)
605	
606		// View switching. h/l double as left/right between views, since a list has
607		// no horizontal axis of its own.
608		case "tab", "l", "right":
609			m.view = Views[(int(m.view)+1)%len(Views)]
610			return m.afterViewSwitch()
611		case "shift+tab", "h", "left":
612			m.view = Views[(int(m.view)+len(Views)-1)%len(Views)]
613			return m.afterViewSwitch()
614	
615		case "/":
616			m.mode = modeFilter
617			m.input.SetValue(m.filter)
618			m.input.Placeholder = "filter"
619			m.input.CursorEnd()
620			m.input.Focus()
621			return m, textinput.Blink
622	
623		case "r":
624			m.status = "reloading config + data…"
625			if m.view == ViewRemote {
626				m.remotesLoading = true
627			}
628			return m, m.reloadConfig(m.view == ViewRemote)
629	
630		case "1":
631			m.states, m.showDone = []task.State{task.Hot}, false
632			m.view = ViewTasks
633			m.setAt(0)
634		case "2":
635			m.states, m.showDone = []task.State{task.Warm}, false
636			m.view = ViewTasks
637			m.setAt(0)
638		case "3":
639			m.states, m.showDone = []task.State{task.Cold}, false
640			m.view = ViewTasks
641			m.setAt(0)
642		case "0":
643			m.states, m.filter = nil, ""
644			m.setAt(0)
645		case "a":
646			m.showDone, m.states = !m.showDone, nil
647			m.setAt(0)
648	
649		case "enter", "o":
650			return m, m.openSelected()
651	
652		case "p":
653			if _, ok := m.currentTask(); !ok {
654				return m, nil
655			}
656			return m.prompt(modeConfirmPark, "", "what to do when you come back")
657	
658		case "c":
659			if row, ok := m.currentTask(); ok {
660				return m.prompt(modeEditNext, row.Task.Next, "next action")
661			}
662			if row, ok := m.currentRemote(); ok && !row.Cloned() {
663				return m.prompt(modeConfirmClone, row.Repo.FullName,
664					"enter to clone; esc to cancel")
665			}
666			return m, nil
667	
668		case "s":
669			if _, ok := m.currentRepo(); !ok {
670				return m, nil
671			}
672			return m.prompt(modeStartTask, "", "name for the new worktree task")
673	
674		case "d":
675			if _, ok := m.currentRepo(); !ok {
676				return m, nil
677			}
678			return m.prompt(modeStartDirect, "", "name for direct work on current branch")
679	
680		case "e":
681			if m.actions.EditConfig == nil {
682				return m, nil
683			}
684			proc, err := m.actions.EditConfig()
685			if err != nil {
686				m.err = err
687				return m, nil
688			}
689			m.status = "editing config…"
690			return m, tea.ExecProcess(proc, func(err error) tea.Msg {
691				return configEditedMsg{err: err}
692			})
693	
694		case "H":
695			repo := m.selectedRepoName()
696			if repo == "" || m.actions.LoadStats == nil {
697				return m, nil
698			}
699			m.mode, m.stats, m.status = modeStats, nil, "loading activity…"
700			return m, m.loadStats(repo)
701	
702		default:
703			if cmd := m.launchTool(msg.String()); cmd != nil {
704				return m, cmd
705			}
706		}
707		m.setAt(m.at())
708		return m, nil
709	}
710	
711	func (m Model) selectedRepoName() string {
712		if r, ok := m.currentTask(); ok {
713			return r.Task.Repo
714		}
715		if r, ok := m.currentRepo(); ok {
716			return r.Repo.Name
717		}
718		if r, ok := m.currentRemote(); ok && r.Cloned() {
719			if r.LocalName != "" {
720				return filepath.Base(r.LocalName)
721			}
722			return r.Repo.Name
723		}
724		return ""
725	}
726	
727	func (m Model) loadStats(repo string) tea.Cmd {
728		return func() tea.Msg {
729			panel, err := m.actions.LoadStats(context.Background(), repo)
730			return statsMsg{panel: panel, err: err}
731		}
732	}
733	
734	func (m Model) updateStats(msg tea.KeyMsg) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
735		switch msg.String() {
736		case "q", "ctrl+c":
737			m.quitting = true
738			return m, tea.Quit
739		case "esc", "H":
740			m.mode, m.stats, m.err, m.status = modeList, nil, nil, ""
741			return m, nil
742		case "r":
743			repo := ""
744			if m.stats != nil {
745				repo = m.stats.Repo
746			}
747			if repo == "" {
748				repo = m.selectedRepoName()
749			}
750			m.stats, m.status = nil, "loading activity…"
751			return m, m.loadStats(repo)
752		}
753		return m, nil
754	}
755	
756	// afterViewSwitch lazily loads forge data only when REMOTE is first opened,
757	// so starting the dashboard never waits on a network request.
758	func (m Model) afterViewSwitch() (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
759		m.setAt(m.at())
760		if m.view == ViewRemote && !m.remotesLoaded && !m.remotesLoading {
761			m.remotesLoading = true
762			m.status = "loading GitHub and GitLab repositories…"
763			return m, m.reloadRemote()
764		}
765		return m, nil
766	}
767	
768	func (m Model) prompt(md mode, value, placeholder string) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
769		m.mode = md
770		m.input.SetValue(value)
771		m.input.Placeholder = placeholder
772		m.input.CursorEnd()
773		m.input.Focus()
774		return m, textinput.Blink
775	}
776	
777	func (m Model) updateFilter(msg tea.KeyMsg) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
778		switch msg.String() {
779		case "esc":
780			m.mode = modeList
781			m.input.Blur()
782			m.filter = ""
783			m.setAt(0)
784			return m, nil
785		case "enter":
786			m.mode = modeList
787			m.input.Blur()
788			return m, nil
789		}
790		var cmd tea.Cmd
791		m.input, cmd = m.input.Update(msg)
792		// Filtering live is the point: seeing the list narrow as you type is what
793		// makes it faster than remembering an exact name.
794		m.filter = m.input.Value()
795		m.setAt(0)
796		return m, cmd
797	}
798	
799	func (m Model) updatePrompt(msg tea.KeyMsg) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
800		switch msg.String() {
801		case "esc":
802			m.mode = modeList
803			m.input.Blur()
804			return m, nil
805		case "enter":
806			md := m.mode
807			value := strings.TrimSpace(m.input.Value())
808			m.mode = modeList
809			m.input.Blur()
810			return m, m.submit(md, value)
811		}
812		var cmd tea.Cmd
813		m.input, cmd = m.input.Update(msg)
814		return m, cmd
815	}
816	
817	func (m Model) submit(md mode, value string) tea.Cmd {
818		switch md {
819		case modeEditNext:
820			row, ok := m.currentTask()
821			if !ok {
822				return nil
823			}
824			t := row.Task
825			return func() tea.Msg {
826				if err := m.actions.SetNext(context.Background(), t, value); err != nil {
827					return actionMsg{err: err}
828				}
829				return actionMsg{status: "next action recorded for " + t.Title()}
830			}
831	
832		case modeConfirmPark:
833			row, ok := m.currentTask()
834			if !ok {
835				return nil
836			}
837			t := row.Task
838			return func() tea.Msg {
839				status, err := m.actions.Park(context.Background(), t, value)
840				return actionMsg{status: status, err: err}
841			}
842	
843		case modeStartTask:
844			r, ok := m.currentRepo()
845			if !ok {
846				return nil
847			}
848			if value == "" {
849				return func() tea.Msg { return actionMsg{err: fmt.Errorf("a task needs a name")} }
850			}
851			return func() tea.Msg {
852				status, err := m.actions.Start(context.Background(), r, value)
853				return actionMsg{status: status, err: err}
854			}
855

927	// launchTool hands the terminal to an external program running in the selected
928	// row's checkout, then reloads — the tool may well have changed the git state
929	// the dashboard is displaying.
930	func (m Model) launchTool(key string) tea.Cmd {
931		for _, t := range m.actions.Tools {
932			if t.Key != key {
933				continue
934			}
935			if t.Available != nil && !t.Available() {
936				return func() tea.Msg {
937					return actionMsg{err: fmt.Errorf("%s is not installed", t.Command[0])}
938				}
939			}
940			dir := m.currentDir()
941			if dir == "" {
942				return func() tea.Msg {
943					return actionMsg{err: fmt.Errorf("nothing selected with a checkout on disk")}
944				}
945			}
946			c := exec.Command(t.Command[0], t.Command[1:]...)
947			c.Dir = dir
948			return tea.ExecProcess(c, func(err error) tea.Msg {
949				if err != nil {
950					return actionMsg{err: fmt.Errorf("%s: %w", t.Name, err)}
951				}
952				return actionMsg{status: "back from " + t.Name}
953			})
954		}
955		return nil
956	}
957	
958	// Tools lists the external programs available on this machine, so the footer
959	// only advertises bindings that will actually work.
960	func (m Model) Tools() []Tool {
961		var out []Tool
962		for _, t := range m.actions.Tools {
963			if t.Available == nil || t.Available() {
964				out = append(out, t)
965			}
966		}
967		return out
968	}
969	
970	// Summary counts the task states, for the header line.
971	func (m Model) Summary() string {
972		counts := map[task.State]int{}
973		for _, r := range m.rows {
974			counts[r.Task.State]++
975		}
976		var parts []string
977		for _, s := range task.States {
978			if counts[s] > 0 {
979				parts = append(parts, fmt.Sprintf("%s %d %s", s.Icon(), counts[s], s))
980			}
981		}
982		if len(m.repos) > 0 {
983			parts = append(parts, fmt.Sprintf("%d repos", len(m.repos)))
984		}
985		if m.remotesLoaded {
986			parts = append(parts, fmt.Sprintf("%d remote", len(m.remotes)))
987		}
988		if len(parts) == 0 {
989			return "no tasks"
990		}
991		return strings.Join(parts, "   ")
992	}

251	func remoteAge(r RemoteRow) string {
252		if r.Repo.UpdatedAt.IsZero() {
253			return "—"
254		}
255		d := time.Since(r.Repo.UpdatedAt)
256		switch {
257		case d < 24*time.Hour:
258			return fmt.Sprintf("%dh ago", int(d.Hours()))
259		case d < 14*24*time.Hour:
260			return fmt.Sprintf("%dd ago", int(d.Hours()/24))
261		case d < 60*24*time.Hour:
262			return fmt.Sprintf("%dw ago", int(d.Hours()/24/7))
263		default:
264			return fmt.Sprintf("%dmo ago", int(d.Hours()/24/30))
265		}
266	}

439			if r, ok := m.currentRemote(); ok && r.Cloned() {
440				bindings = append(bindings, "enter open local")
441			} else {
442				bindings = append(bindings, "c clone")
443			}
444		default:
445			bindings = append(bindings, "enter open", "p park", "c next")
446		}
447		bindings = append(bindings, "tab view", "/ filter", "H stats", "e config")
448		for _, t := range m.Tools() {
449			bindings = append(bindings, t.Key+" "+t.Name)
450		}
451		bindings = append(bindings, "1/2/3 state", "0 clear", "r reload", "q quit")
452	
453		var b strings.Builder
454		if status != "" {
455			b.WriteString("  " + status + "\n")
456		}
457		b.WriteString("  " + styleHelp.Render(wrapBindings(bindings, m.width-4)))
458		return b.String()
459	}
460	
461	// wrapBindings lays the key hints out over as many lines as the width needs,
462	// rather than truncating them — a hint you cannot read is not a hint.
463	func wrapBindings(items []string, width int) string {
464		if width < 20 {
465			width = 20
466		}
467		var lines []string
468		cur := ""
469		for _, it := range items {
470			candidate := it
471			if cur != "" {
472				candidate = cur + " · " + it
473			}
474			if lipgloss.Width(candidate) > width && cur != "" {
475				lines = append(lines, cur)
476				cur = it
477				continue
478			}
479			cur = candidate
480		}
481		if cur != "" {
482			lines = append(lines, cur)
483		}
484		return strings.Join(lines, "\n  ")
485	}
486	
487	func gitColumn(r inventory.Row) string {
488		switch {
489		case r.StatusErr != nil:
490			return "?"
491		case !r.CheckoutExists:
492			return "no dir"
493		}
494		return r.Status.Summary()
495	}
496	
497	func nextColumn(r inventory.Row) string {
498		if r.Task.Next == "" {
499			return styleDim.Render("—")
500		}
501		return r.Task.Next
502	}
503	
504	func shortAge(r inventory.Row) string {
505		d := r.Age()
506		switch {
507		case d <= 0:
508			return "—"
509		case d.Hours() < 24:
510			return fmt.Sprintf("%dh", int(d.Hours()))
511		case d.Hours() < 24*14:
512			return fmt.Sprintf("%dd", int(d.Hours()/24))
513		case d.Hours() < 24*60:
514			return fmt.Sprintf("%dw", int(d.Hours()/24/7))
515		default:
516			return fmt.Sprintf("%dmo", int(d.Hours()/24/30))
517		}
518	}
519	
520	func colourState(s task.State, line string) string {
521		switch s {
522		case task.Hot:
523			return styleHot.Render(line)
524		case task.Warm:
525			return styleWarm.Render(line)
526		case task.Cold:
527			return styleCold.Render(line)
528		case task.Done:
529			return styleDone.Render(line)
530		}
531		return line
532	}
533	
534	// pad truncates to n display columns, measuring the way lipgloss renders so
535	// CJK repo and task names do not shift the table.
536	func pad(s string, n int) string {
537		if lipgloss.Width(s) <= n {
538			return s
539		}
540		var b strings.Builder
541		used := 0
542		for _, r := range s {
543			w := lipgloss.Width(string(r))
544			if used+w > n-1 {
545				break
546			}
547			b.WriteRune(r)
548			used += w
549		}
550		return b.String() + "…"
551	}
552	
553	func clamp(v, lo, hi int) int {
554		if v < lo {
555			return lo
556		}
557		if v > hi {
558			return hi
559		}
560		return v
561	}

15	// RepoRow is one repository as the dashboard shows it: what it is, plus how
16	// much of it is currently in flight.
17	//
18	// The repository view exists because the task list alone answers only half the
19	// question. On a machine with forty repositories and no tasks recorded yet,
20	// a task-only dashboard is empty — and the honest answer to "what do I have
21	// here?" has to come before "what am I working on?"
22	type RepoRow struct {
23		Repo   repo.Repo
24		Status gitx.Status
25		// Worktrees is the number of linked worktrees, excluding the main checkout.
26		Worktrees int
27		// Tasks are the recorded tasks belonging to this repository.
28		Tasks []*task.Task
29		// Live reports a runtime session sitting in this repository.
30		Live          bool
31		Runtime       string
32		RuntimeHandle string
33		RuntimeStatus string
34		// RemoteForge / RemoteName identify origin for matching the REMOTE view to
35		// this local checkout without rescanning every repo when a cache opens.
36		RemoteForge forge.Kind
37		RemoteName  string
38	}
39	
40	// HotTasks counts the repository's tasks that are currently hot.
41	func (r RepoRow) HotTasks() int {
42		n := 0
43		for _, t := range r.Tasks {
44			if t.State == task.Hot {
45				n++
46			}
47		}
48		return n
49	}
50	
51	// StateSummary renders the repository's tasks as a compact per-state tally,
52	// which is what makes the list scannable at forty repositories.
53	func (r RepoRow) StateSummary() string {
54		if len(r.Tasks) == 0 {
55			return ""
56		}
57		counts := map[task.State]int{}
58		for _, t := range r.Tasks {
59			counts[t.State]++
60		}
61		var parts []string
62		for _, s := range task.States {
63			if counts[s] > 0 {
64				parts = append(parts, s.Icon()+strconv.Itoa(counts[s]))
65			}
66		}
67		return strings.Join(parts, " ")
68	}

70	// searchText is what a filter query matches against.
71	func (r RepoRow) searchText() string {
72		var b strings.Builder
73		b.WriteString(r.Repo.Display())
74		b.WriteString(" ")
75		b.WriteString(r.Status.Branch)
76		for _, t := range r.Tasks {
77			b.WriteString(" ")
78			b.WriteString(t.Title())
79			b.WriteString(" ")
80			b.WriteString(t.Branch)
81		}
82		return strings.ToLower(b.String())

86	func taskSearchText(r inventory.Row) string {

88		return strings.ToLower(strings.Join([]string{
89			t.Title(), t.Repo, t.Branch, t.Next, t.Note, string(t.State),
90		}, " "))

92	
93	// matches reports whether every whitespace-separated term of the query appears
94	// in the haystack.
95	//
96	// Term-wise rather than substring so "auth api" finds a task named "api token
97	// auth" — the order words come to mind in is rarely the order they appear in.
98	func matches(haystack, query string) bool {
99		query = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(query))
100		if query == "" {
101			return true
102		}
103		for _, term := range strings.Fields(query) {
104			if !strings.Contains(haystack, term) {
105				return false
106			}
107		}
108		return true
109	}

28	func newTUICmd(app *App) *cobra.Command {
29		cmd := &cobra.Command{
30			Use:   "tui",
31			Short: "Interactive dashboard over the inventory",
32			Long: `Browse and act on your work in progress.
33	
34	Shows exactly what "dev ls" shows, from the same code path, plus the ability
35	to open, park and annotate a task without retyping its name.
36	
37	Three lists, switched with tab:
38	
39	  TASKS   change streams dev is tracking — what am I working on
40	  REPOS   every repository under the scan roots — what do I have here
41	  REMOTE  repositories visible through gh and glab — what can I clone/open
42	
43	Navigation is vim-style, with arrows alongside:
44	
45	  j k        move                 ctrl+d ctrl+u   half a page
46	  g G        top / bottom         h l / tab       previous / next view
47	  /          filter as you type   esc             clear, then quit
48	
49	Actions depend on the list:
50	
51	  enter      open in the runtime
52	  p          park a task          c    edit its next action
53	  s          start a task in the selected repository
54	  c          clone the selected remote repository (after confirmation)
55	  1 2 3      hot / warm / cold    0    clear filters    a  include done
56	  H          selected repo heatmap
57	  e          edit config, then live-reload data/tools
58	  r          reload config + data  q    quit
59	
60	External tools are configured, not fixed — see [[tui.tools]] in the config,
61	and "dev tui tools" for what is bound here. They run in the selected row's checkout;
62	the dashboard suspends while they do and redraws afterwards, and bindings for
63	programs that are not installed are not offered.`,
64			Args: cobra.NoArgs,
65			RunE: func(cmd *cobra.Command, args []string) error {
66				return runTUI(app)
67			},
68		}
69		cmd.AddCommand(newTUIToolsCmd(app))
70		return cmd
71	}
72	
73	func newTUIToolsCmd(app *App) *cobra.Command {
74		return &cobra.Command{
75			Use:   "tools",
76			Short: "List the external tool bindings and whether each one works here",
77			Long: `Show which programs the dashboard will hand the terminal to.
78	
79	Bindings come from [[tui.tools]] in the config; with none configured, the
80	built-in set applies. A configured list replaces the defaults entirely, so
81	what is bound is always exactly what is written down.
82	
83	Add your own — an editor, a script, anything you already reach for:
84	
85	    [[tui.tools]]
86	    key  = "V"
87	    name = "nvim"
88	    run  = "nvim ."
89	
90	    [[tui.tools]]
91	    key  = "B"
92	    name = "vibe"
93	    run  = "vibe"
94	
95	The command runs through your shell in the selected row's checkout, so
96	arguments, environment variables and your own scripts all behave as typed.
97	Set interactive = true only for aliases/functions from your shell rc; that
98	binding runs through $SHELL -lic and the mode is shown in this listing.`,
99			Args: cobra.NoArgs,
100			RunE: func(cmd *cobra.Command, args []string) error {
101				configured := len(app.Cfg.TUI.Tools) > 0
102				source := "built-in defaults"

104					source = config.Contract(app.Cfg.Source)
105				}

107	
108				t := NewTable("KEY", "NAME", "MODE", "RUNS", "AVAILABLE")
109				configuredTools := app.Cfg.EffectiveTools()
110				for i, tool := range externalTools(app) {
111					status := "yes"
112					if tool.Available != nil && !tool.Available() {
113						status = "no — not on PATH"
114					}
115					// Command is [shell, -c/-lic, run]; show the run itself.

117					mode := "shell"

119						mode = "interactive"

134	// interactive reports whether a real terminal is attached. Piping `dev` into

409	// collectRepos builds the repository view: what exists, plus how much of it is
410	// in flight.
411	func collectRepos(ctx context.Context, app *App, rt runtime.Runtime) ([]tui.RepoRow, error) {
412		repos, err := repo.Discover(ctx, app.Cfg.ScanRoots(), repo.DefaultOptions())
413		if err != nil {
414			return nil, err
415		}
416		tasks, err := app.Tasks.List()
417		if err != nil {
418			return nil, err
419		}
420		byRepo := map[string][]*task.Task{}
421		for _, t := range tasks {
422			byRepo[t.RepoPath] = append(byRepo[t.RepoPath], t)
423		}
424		sessions, _ := rt.List(ctx)
425	
426		out := make([]tui.RepoRow, 0, len(repos))
427		for _, r := range repos {
428			row := tui.RepoRow{Repo: r, Tasks: byRepo[r.Path]}
429			if !r.Bare {
430				if st, err := gitx.StatusOf(ctx, r.Path); err == nil {
431					row.Status = st
432				}
433				if list, err := gitx.Worktrees(ctx, r.Path); err == nil && len(list) > 0 {
434					row.Worktrees = len(list) - 1
435				}
436				row.RemoteForge, row.RemoteName = forge.IdentityFromURL(gitx.Remote(ctx, r.Path, "origin"))
437			}
438			for _, s := range sessions {
439				if s.Covers(r.Path) || (r.RealPath != "" && s.Covers(r.RealPath)) {
440					row.Live = true
441					row.Runtime, row.RuntimeHandle, row.RuntimeStatus = rt.Name(), s.Handle, s.AgentStatus
442					break
443				}
444			}
445			out = append(out, row)
446		}
447		return out, nil
448	}
449	
450	// externalTools resolves the configured tool bindings.
451	//
452	// Configurable rather than fixed because which program you reach for is
453	// personal, and because the useful ones are often your own scripts and
454	// aliases, not just the well-known tools.
455	func externalTools(app *App) []tui.Tool {
456		var out []tui.Tool
457		for _, t := range app.Cfg.EffectiveTools() {
458			run := t.Run
459			name := t.Name
460			if name == "" {
461				name = firstWord(run)
462			}
463			command := []string{shellPath(), "-c", run}
464			if t.Interactive {
465				// The command string passed to shell -lic is parsed before some
466				// shells finish loading aliases. Parse only eval "$1" up front,
467				// then evaluate the configured command after rc loading, so both
468				// aliases (vibe) and functions (claude-plans-here) work.
469				command = []string{shellPath(), "-lic", `eval "$1"`, "dev-tui-tool", run}
470			}
471			out = append(out, tui.Tool{
472				Key: t.Key, Name: name, Command: command,
473				Available: commandRunnable(run, t.Interactive),
474			})
475		}
476		return out
477	}
478	
479	// commandRunnable resolves the command's first word on PATH, expanding a
480	// leading environment variable so "$EDITOR ." checks the editor itself.
481	func commandRunnable(run string, interactive bool) func() bool {
482		// Availability is stable for the lifetime of one dashboard. In particular,
483		// probing an interactive alias starts a login shell; doing that on every
484		// render would turn a 60fps UI into a shell-launch benchmark.
485		var once sync.Once
486		available := false
487		return func() bool {
488			once.Do(func() { available = checkCommandRunnable(run, interactive) })
489			return available
490		}
491	}
492	
493	func checkCommandRunnable(run string, interactive bool) bool {
494		word := firstWord(run)
495		if strings.HasPrefix(word, "$") {
496			word = os.Getenv(strings.TrimPrefix(word, "$"))
497			if word == "" {
498				return false
499			}
500			word = firstWord(word)
501		}
502		if word == "" {
503			return false
504		}
505		if interactive {
506			// Ask the configured shell after it loads its rc files; LookPath
507			// cannot see aliases or functions.
508			ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 3*time.Second)
509			defer cancel()
510			probe := exec.CommandContext(ctx, shellPath(), "-lic",
511				`command -v "$1" >/dev/null 2>&1`, "dev-tool-probe", word)
512			return probe.Run() == nil
513		}
514		if filepath.IsAbs(word) {
515			_, err := os.Stat(word)
516			return err == nil
517		}
518		_, err := exec.LookPath(word)
519		return err == nil
520	}
521	
522	func firstWord(s string) string {
523		f := strings.Fields(s)
524		if len(f) == 0 {
525			return ""
526		}
527		return f[0]
528	}
529	
530	func shellPath() string {
531		if s := os.Getenv("SHELL"); s != "" {
532			return s
533		}
534		return "/bin/sh"
535	}
536	
537	// remoteCachePath is private because the inventory can contain names and URLs
538	// of private repositories.
539	func remoteCachePath() string {
540		return filepath.Join(config.CacheHome(), "dev", "remotes.json")
541	}
542	
543	// cachedRemotesForRepoRows uses the local repo data the dashboard already
544	// collected, avoiding another process-spawning scan on startup.
545	func cachedRemotesForRepoRows(app *App, locals []tui.RepoRow) ([]tui.RemoteRow, bool) {
546		cache, ok := forge.LoadCache(remoteCachePath(), app.Cfg.Forge.CacheTTL.Duration)
547		if !ok {
548			return nil, false
549		}
550		byRemote := map[string]tui.RepoRow{}
551		for _, r := range locals {
552			if r.RemoteForge != forge.Unknown && r.RemoteName != "" {
553				byRemote[string(r.RemoteForge)+"/"+strings.ToLower(r.RemoteName)] = r
554			}
555		}
556		out := make([]tui.RemoteRow, 0, len(cache.Repos))
557		for _, rr := range cache.Repos {
558			row := tui.RemoteRow{Repo: rr}
559			if local, ok := byRemote[string(rr.Forge)+"/"+strings.ToLower(rr.FullName)]; ok {
560				row.LocalPath, row.LocalName = local.Repo.Path, local.Repo.Display()
561			}
562			out = append(out, row)
563		}
564		return out, true
565	}
566	
567	// cachedRemotes returns a fresh, already-local-matched cache for instant TUI
568	// navigation. Local paths are recomputed rather than cached because clones can
569	// move independently of the forge inventory.
570	func cachedRemotes(ctx context.Context, app *App) ([]tui.RemoteRow, bool) {
571		cache, ok := forge.LoadCache(remoteCachePath(), app.Cfg.Forge.CacheTTL.Duration)
572		if !ok {
573			return nil, false
574		}
575		return matchRemoteLocals(ctx, app, cache.Repos), true
576	}
577	
578	// collectRemotes aggregates gh and glab, caches the normalised response, then
579	// marks remotes that already have a checkout under the configured scan roots.
580	// Calls run concurrently so one slow forge does not serialise the other.
581	func collectRemotes(ctx context.Context, app *App, limit int) ([]tui.RemoteRow, error) {
582		if limit <= 0 {
583			limit = app.Cfg.Forge.RemoteLimit
584		}
585		type result struct {
586			repos []forge.RemoteRepo
587			err   error
588		}
589		ch := make(chan result, len(forge.All()))
590		var wg sync.WaitGroup
591		available := 0
592		for _, f := range forge.All() {
593			if !f.Available() {
594				continue
595			}
596			available++
597			wg.Add(1)
598			go func(f forge.Forge) {
599				defer wg.Done()
600				r, err := f.ListRepos(ctx, limit)
601				ch <- result{repos: r, err: err}
602			}(f)
603		}
604		wg.Wait()
605		close(ch)
606		if available == 0 {
607			return nil, fmt.Errorf("neither gh nor glab is installed")
608		}
609	
610		var (
611			remoteRepos []forge.RemoteRepo
612			errs        []error
613		)
614		for res := range ch {
615			if res.err != nil {
616				errs = append(errs, res.err)
617			}
618			remoteRepos = append(remoteRepos, res.repos...)
619		}
620		// Cache partial results too. They are exactly what was observed, and a
621		// partial list is more useful on the next switch than another six-second
622		// wait merely to rediscover the same provider failure.
623		if len(remoteRepos) > 0 && limit >= app.Cfg.Forge.RemoteLimit {
624			_ = forge.SaveCache(remoteCachePath(), remoteRepos)
625		}
626		return matchRemoteLocals(ctx, app, remoteRepos), errors.Join(errs...)
627	}
628	
629	func matchRemoteLocals(ctx context.Context, app *App, remoteRepos []forge.RemoteRepo) []tui.RemoteRow {
630		locals, _ := repo.Discover(ctx, app.Cfg.ScanRoots(), repo.DefaultOptions())
631		localByRemote := map[string]repo.Repo{}
632		for _, r := range locals {
633			if r.Bare {
634				continue
635			}
636			kind, name := forge.IdentityFromURL(gitx.Remote(ctx, r.Path, "origin"))
637			if kind != forge.Unknown && name != "" {
638				localByRemote[string(kind)+"/"+strings.ToLower(name)] = r
639			}
640		}
641		out := make([]tui.RemoteRow, 0, len(remoteRepos))
642		for _, rr := range remoteRepos {
643			row := tui.RemoteRow{Repo: rr}
644			if local, ok := localByRemote[string(rr.Forge)+"/"+strings.ToLower(rr.FullName)]; ok {
645				row.LocalPath, row.LocalName = local.Path, local.Display()
646			}
647			out = append(out, row)
648		}
649		return out
650	}

28	func TestCommandRunnableCachesProbe(t *testing.T) {

30		// the closure is what prevents interactive probes from launching a login

+func TestRepoViewShowsLiveRuntimeExplicitly(t *testing.T) {
+	r := repoRow("api")
+	r.Live = true
+	r.Runtime, r.RuntimeHandle, r.RuntimeStatus = "herdr", "w7", "working"
+	m := tui.New(newActions(&recorder{}, nil), nil, []tui.RepoRow{r})
+	m = send(m, key("tab"))
+
+	out := m.View()
+	if !strings.Contains(out, "LIVE") || !strings.Contains(out, "herdr:working") {
+		t.Errorf("repo row should make active workspace status explicit:\n%s", out)
+	}
+	if !strings.Contains(out, "herdr w7 · working") {
+		t.Errorf("detail should show the workspace handle:\n%s", out)
+	}
+}
+
+func TestHeatmapShortcutAndRefresh(t *testing.T) {
+	rows := []inventory.Row{row("a", "token refresh", task.Hot, "")}
+	loads := 0
+	actions := newActions(&recorder{}, rows)
+	actions.LoadStats = func(context.Context, string) (tui.StatsPanel, error) {
+		loads++
+		return tui.StatsPanel{
+			Repo: "demo", Heatmap: "HEATMAP-GRID\n", Seconds: 5400,
+			ActiveDays: 3, Since: time.Now().AddDate(-1, 0, 0), Until: time.Now(),
+		}, nil
+	}
+	m := tui.New(actions, rows, nil)
+	if !strings.Contains(m.View(), "H stats") {
+		t.Errorf("footer should expose the shortcut:\n%s", m.View())
+	}
+	m = send(m, key("H"))
+	out := m.View()
+	if !strings.Contains(out, "HEATMAP") || !strings.Contains(out, "HEATMAP-GRID") ||
+		!strings.Contains(out, "1h 30m") {
+		t.Errorf("stats overlay not rendered:\n%s", out)
+	}
+	m = send(m, key("r"))
+	if loads != 2 {
+		t.Errorf("H load + r refresh = 2, got %d", loads)
+	}
+	m = send(m, key("esc"))
+	if strings.Contains(m.View(), "HEATMAP-GRID") {
+		t.Error("esc should return to the list")
+	}
+}
+
+func TestConfigEditReturnsSuspendingProcess(t *testing.T) {
+	rows := []inventory.Row{row("a", "one", task.Hot, "")}
+	edits := 0
+	actions := newActions(&recorder{}, rows)
+	actions.EditConfig = func() (*exec.Cmd, error) {
+		edits++
+		return exec.Command("true"), nil
+	}
+	m := tui.New(actions, rows, nil)
+	_, cmd := m.Update(key("e"))
+	if edits != 1 || cmd == nil {
+		t.Errorf("e should resolve one editor process for tea.ExecProcess: edits=%d cmd=%v", edits, cmd)
+	}
+	// tea.ExecProcess invokes its callback through Program's exec machinery,
+	// not by returning a normal message from cmd(), so r covers the reload
+	// path independently below.
+}
+
+func TestRReloadsConfigAsWellAsData(t *testing.T) {
+	rows := []inventory.Row{row("a", "one", task.Hot, "")}
+	configReloads, dataReloads := 0, 0
+	actions := newActions(&recorder{}, rows)
+	actions.ReloadConfig = func(context.Context) ([]tui.Tool, string, error) {
+		configReloads++
+		return nil, "reloaded", nil
+	}
+	actions.Reload = func(context.Context) ([]inventory.Row, error) {
+		dataReloads++
+		return rows, nil
+	}
+	m := tui.New(actions, rows, nil)
+	send(m, key("r"))
+	if configReloads != 1 || dataReloads != 1 {
+		t.Errorf("r should reload both: config=%d data=%d", configReloads, dataReloads)
+	}
+}

+func humanSeconds(seconds int) string {

+		return fmt.Sprintf("%dm", int(d.Minutes()))
+	}
+	return fmt.Sprintf("%dh %dm", int(d.Hours()), int(d.Minutes())%60)

13	type listOptions struct {
14		states    []string
15		repo      string
16		jsonOut   bool
17		live      bool
18		dirty     bool
19		showAll   bool
20		noRuntime bool
21	}

23	func newListCmd(app *App) *cobra.Command {
24		var o listOptions
25		cmd := &cobra.Command{
26			Use:     "ls",
27			Aliases: []string{"list"},
28			Short:   "List work in progress across every repo",
29			Long: `Show every change stream dev knows about, enriched with live git and
30	runtime state.
31	
32	This is the answer to "what am I working on?" — the question a terminal
33	multiplexer's sidebar gets abused for. Only the state, owner and next action
34	come from dev's registry; branch, dirty, ahead/behind and the live session are
35	derived on every run, so the listing cannot go stale.
36	
37	By default finished tasks are hidden; pass --all to include them.`,
38			Args: cobra.NoArgs,
39			RunE: func(cmd *cobra.Command, args []string) error {
40				return runList(app, o)
41			},
42		}
43		f := cmd.Flags()
44		f.StringSliceVarP(&o.states, "state", "s", nil, "only these states ("+task.JoinStates(", ")+")")
45		f.StringVarP(&o.repo, "repo", "r", "", "only tasks whose repo name contains this")
46		f.BoolVar(&o.jsonOut, "json", false, "emit JSON for scripting")
47		f.BoolVar(&o.live, "live", false, "only tasks with a running runtime session")
48		f.BoolVar(&o.dirty, "dirty", false, "only tasks with uncommitted changes")
49		f.BoolVarP(&o.showAll, "all", "a", false, "include done tasks")
50		f.BoolVar(&o.noRuntime, "no-session", false, "skip the runtime query (faster)")
51		return cmd
52	}
53	
54	func runList(app *App, o listOptions) error {
55		ctx := ctxOf()
56		tasks, err := app.Tasks.List()
57		if err != nil {
58			return err
59		}
60	
61		filter := inventory.Filter{Repo: o.repo, LiveOnly: o.live, DirtyOnly: o.dirty}
62		for _, s := range o.states {
63			st, err := task.ParseState(s)
64			if err != nil {
65				return err
66			}
67			filter.States = append(filter.States, st)
68		}
69		if len(filter.States) == 0 && !o.showAll {
70			filter.States = []task.State{task.Hot, task.Warm, task.Cold}
71		}
72	
73		rt := app.Runtime()
74		rows := inventory.Collect(ctx, tasks, rt, inventory.Options{SkipRuntime: o.noRuntime})
75		rows = filter.Apply(rows)
76	
77		if o.jsonOut {
78			return emitJSON(app, rows)
79		}
80	
81		if len(rows) == 0 {
82			if len(tasks) == 0 {
83				fmt.Fprintln(app.Out, "No tasks yet. Start one with:  dev start <repo> --task <name>")
84			} else {
85				fmt.Fprintln(app.Out, "No tasks match that filter. Try `dev ls --all`.")
86			}
87			return nil
88		}
89	
90		t := NewTable("", "TASK", "STATE", "REPO", "BRANCH", "GIT", "AGE", "SESSION", "NEXT")
91		for _, r := range rows {
92			session := "—"
93			if r.Live() {
94				session = rt.Name()
95				if r.Session.AgentStatus != "" {
96					session += ":" + r.Session.AgentStatus
97				}
98			}
99			gitCol := r.Status.Summary()
100			switch {
101			case r.StatusErr != nil:
102				gitCol = "?"
103			case !r.CheckoutExists:
104				gitCol = "no checkout"
105			}
106			t.Add(
107				r.Task.State.Icon(),
108				truncate(r.Task.Title(), 28),
109				r.Task.State.Label(),
110				truncate(r.Task.Repo, 20),
111				truncate(r.Task.Branch, 28),
112				gitCol,
113				humanAge(r.Age()),
114				session,
115				truncate(dash(r.Task.Next), 40),
116			)
117		}
118		t.Render(app.Out)
119	
120		// Surface drift as a hint rather than rewriting state behind the user's
121		// back: dev reports, the user decides.
122		var drifted int
123		for _, r := range rows {
124			if r.StateDrift() != "" {
125				drifted++
126			}
127		}
128		if drifted > 0 {
129			fmt.Fprintf(app.Err, "\n%d task(s) drifted from their recorded state — run `dev sweep` to review.\n", drifted)
130		}
131		return nil
132	}
133	
134	// jsonRow is the stable shape of `dev ls --json`. It is a contract for other
135	// tools (and for the multi-host aggregation `ssh host dev ls --json` enables),
136	// so fields are added but never renamed.
137	type jsonRow struct {
138		ID           string   `json:"id"`
139		Name         string   `json:"name"`
140		Repo         string   `json:"repo"`
141		RepoPath     string   `json:"repo_path"`
142		Branch       string   `json:"branch"`
143		Base         string   `json:"base,omitempty"`
144		WorktreePath string   `json:"worktree_path,omitempty"`
145		Checkout     string   `json:"checkout,omitempty"`
146		State        string   `json:"state"`
147		Mode         string   `json:"mode"`
148		Owner        string   `json:"owner,omitempty"`
149		Next         string   `json:"next,omitempty"`
150		Note         string   `json:"note,omitempty"`
151		Tags         []string `json:"tags,omitempty"`
152	
153		CheckoutExists bool   `json:"checkout_exists"`
154		Dirty          bool   `json:"dirty"`
155		Changed        int    `json:"changed"`
156		Staged         int    `json:"staged"`
157		Unstaged       int    `json:"unstaged"`
158		Untracked      int    `json:"untracked"`
159		Conflicted     int    `json:"conflicted"`
160		Added          int    `json:"added"`
161		Modified       int    `json:"modified"`
162		Deleted        int    `json:"deleted"`
163		Renamed        int    `json:"renamed"`
164		Ahead          int    `json:"ahead"`
165		Behind         int    `json:"behind"`
166		Upstream       string `json:"upstream,omitempty"`
167		GitSummary     string `json:"git_summary"`
168	
169		Live          bool     `json:"live"`
170		Runtime       string   `json:"runtime,omitempty"`
171		RuntimeHandle string   `json:"runtime_handle,omitempty"`
172		AgentStatus   string   `json:"agent_status,omitempty"`
173		AgentSessions []string `json:"agent_sessions,omitempty"`
174	
175		Drift      string `json:"drift,omitempty"`
176		AgeSeconds int64  `json:"age_seconds"`
177		Updated    string `json:"updated,omitempty"`
178	}
179	
180	func emitJSON(app *App, rows []inventory.Row) error {
181		out := make([]jsonRow, 0, len(rows))
182		for _, r := range rows {
183			j := jsonRow{
184				ID:             r.Task.ID,
185				Name:           r.Task.Title(),
186				Repo:           r.Task.Repo,
187				RepoPath:       config.Contract(r.Task.RepoPath),
188				Branch:         r.Task.Branch,
189				Base:           r.Task.Base,
190				WorktreePath:   config.Contract(r.Task.WorktreePath),
191				Checkout:       config.Contract(r.Checkout),
192				State:          string(r.Task.State),
193				Mode:           string(r.Task.EffectiveMode()),
194				Owner:          r.Task.Owner,
195				Next:           r.Task.Next,
196				Note:           r.Task.Note,
197				Tags:           r.Task.Tags,
198				CheckoutExists: r.CheckoutExists,
199				Dirty:          r.Status.Dirty(),
200				Changed:        r.Status.Changed,
201				Staged:         r.Status.Staged,
202				Unstaged:       r.Status.Unstaged,
203				Untracked:      r.Status.Untracked,
204				Conflicted:     r.Status.Conflicted,
205				Added:          r.Status.Added,
206				Modified:       r.Status.Modified,
207				Deleted:        r.Status.Deleted,
208				Renamed:        r.Status.Renamed,
209				Ahead:          r.Status.Ahead,
210				Behind:         r.Status.Behind,
211				Upstream:       r.Status.Upstream,
212				GitSummary:     r.Status.Summary(),
213				Live:           r.Live(),
214				Drift:          r.StateDrift(),
215				AgeSeconds:     int64(r.Age().Seconds()),
216			}
217			if !r.Task.Updated.IsZero() {
218				j.Updated = r.Task.Updated.Format("2006-01-02T15:04:05Z")
219			}
220			if r.Session != nil {
221				j.RuntimeHandle = r.Session.Handle
222				j.AgentStatus = r.Session.AgentStatus
223				j.AgentSessions = r.Session.AgentSessions
224			}
225			if r.Task.WorktreePath == "" {
226				j.WorktreePath = ""
227			}
228			out = append(out, j)
229		}
230		enc := json.NewEncoder(app.Out)
231		enc.SetIndent("", "  ")
232		return enc.Encode(out)
233	}

329	// repoNameFromRef derives a directory name from a clone reference.
330	func repoNameFromRef(ref string) string {
331		ref = strings.TrimSuffix(strings.TrimSuffix(ref, "/"), ".git")
332		if i := strings.LastIndexAny(ref, "/:"); i >= 0 {
333			return ref[i+1:]
334		}
335		return ref
336	}
337	
338	func contractAll(paths []string) []string {
339		out := make([]string, len(paths))
340		for i, p := range paths {
341			out[i] = config.Contract(p)
342		}
343		return out
344	}

366					rows []tui.RemoteRow
367					err  error
368				)
369				if cachedOnly {
370					var ok bool
371					rows, ok = cachedRemotes(ctxOf(), app)
372					if !ok {
373						return fmt.Errorf("no fresh remote cache; run `dev repo remote` once online")
374					}
375				} else {
376					rows, err = collectRemotes(ctxOf(), app, limit)
377				}
378				// Partial results are useful when one forge is authenticated and
379				// the other is not. Render them, then report the partial failure.
380				if len(rows) == 0 && err != nil {
381					return err
382				}
383				query := ""
384				if len(args) == 1 {
385					query = strings.ToLower(args[0])
386				}
387				var filtered []tui.RemoteRow
388				for _, r := range rows {
389					hay := strings.ToLower(strings.Join([]string{
390						string(r.Repo.Forge), r.Repo.FullName, r.Repo.Description,
391						r.Repo.Visibility, r.LocalName,
392					}, " "))
393					matched := true
394					for _, term := range strings.Fields(query) {
395						if !strings.Contains(hay, term) {
396							matched = false
397							break
398						}
399					}
400					if matched {
401						filtered = append(filtered, r)
402					}
403				}
404	
405				if jsonOut {
406					enc := json.NewEncoder(app.Out)
407					enc.SetIndent("", "  ")
408					if encodeErr := enc.Encode(filtered); encodeErr != nil {
409						return encodeErr
410					}
411				} else {
412					t := NewTable("FORGE", "REPOSITORY", "VIS", "LOCAL", "UPDATED", "DESCRIPTION")
413					for _, r := range filtered {
414						local := "—"
415						if r.LocalPath != "" {
416							local = config.Contract(r.LocalPath)
417						}
418						updated := "—"
419						if !r.Repo.UpdatedAt.IsZero() {
420							updated = r.Repo.UpdatedAt.Format("2006-01-02")
421						}
422						t.Add(string(r.Repo.Forge), truncate(r.Repo.FullName, 36),
423							strings.ToLower(r.Repo.Visibility), truncate(local, 30), updated,
424							truncate(r.Repo.Description, 50))
425					}
426					if t.Len() == 0 {
427						fmt.Fprintln(app.Out, "No remote repositories match that query.")
428					} else {
429						t.Render(app.Out)
430					}
431				}
432				if err != nil {
433					app.warnf("partial remote results: %v", err)
434				}
435				return nil
436			},
437		}
438		f := cmd.Flags()
439		f.BoolVar(&jsonOut, "json", false, "emit JSON")
440		f.BoolVar(&cachedOnly, "cached", false, "use the fresh XDG cache without querying either forge")
441		f.IntVar(&limit, "limit", 0, "maximum repositories requested from each forge (default: config forge.remote_limit)")
442		return cmd
443	}

27	}

29	// Len reports the number of data rows.

33	func (t *Table) Render(w io.Writer) {

36		}

45				}
46			}

51		}
52	}

54	func writeRow(w io.Writer, cells []string, widths []int) {

59				break
60			}
61			b.WriteString(c)
62			b.WriteString(strings.Repeat(" ", widths[i]-width(c)+2))
63		}

65	}

67	// width counts display columns, treating wide CJK runes as two.
68	func width(s string) int {

83			r >= 0x2E80 && r <= 0xA4CF, // CJK radicals through Yi
84			r >= 0xAC00 && r <= 0xD7A3, // Hangul syllables

88			r >= 0xFFE0 && r <= 0xFFE6,

132		case d < 24*time.Hour:

I'm prioritizing maintaining the exact previous state during operations. If a path is occupied, I need to fail explicitly and prompt for a new name instead of renaming silently. For evicted linked worktrees, I can add a worktree for the previous path using the specified branch or commit. If I need to restore a normal state, I’ll clone from the verified remote into the default destination and fetch all branches or tags. However, ignored or disposable branches won’t recover by design.
</details></think>

+// configEditorProcess resolves the effective config and editor without running
+// it. The CLI runs the process directly; the TUI passes it to tea.ExecProcess,
+// which suspends the alternate screen and redraws after the editor exits.
+func configEditorProcess(app *App, editor string) (*exec.Cmd, string, bool, error) {
+	path := app.configPath
+	if path == "" {
+		path = config.ConfigFile()
+	}
+	path = config.Expand(path)
+	created, err := ensureConfigForEdit(path)
+	if err != nil {
+		return nil, "", false, err
+	}
+	chosen, err := resolveEditor(editor)
+	if err != nil {
+		return nil, "", false, err
+	}
+	command := chosen + " " + shellQuote(path)
+	return exec.Command(shellPath(), "-c", command), chosen, created, nil

1	package config
2	
3	import (
4		"fmt"
5		"regexp"
6		"strings"
7	)
8	
9	// Path templates are deliberately *not* text/template: the syntax users write
10	// in config.toml ("{{worktree_root}}/{{repo}}/{{branch|slug}}") needs to stay
11	// readable and to fail loudly on an unknown variable rather than silently
12	// rendering "<no value>".
13	
14	var tmplVar = regexp.MustCompile(`\{\{\s*([a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_]*)\s*(?:\|\s*([a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_]*)\s*)?\}\}`)
15	
16	// Vars is the substitution environment for a path template.
17	type Vars map[string]string
18	
19	// Render substitutes every {{var}} / {{var|filter}} occurrence in tmpl.
20	// An unknown variable or filter is an error — a typo in worktree_path should
21	// surface at create time, not as a directory literally named "{{rep}}".
22	func Render(tmpl string, vars Vars) (string, error) {
23		var firstErr error
24		out := tmplVar.ReplaceAllStringFunc(tmpl, func(m string) string {
25			g := tmplVar.FindStringSubmatch(m)
26			name, filter := g[1], g[2]
27			val, ok := vars[name]
28			if !ok {
29				if firstErr == nil {
30					firstErr = fmt.Errorf("unknown template variable %q in %q (known: %s)", name, tmpl, strings.Join(sortedKeys(vars), ", "))
31				}
32				return m
33			}
34			switch filter {
35			case "":
36				return val
37			case "slug":
38				return Slug(val)
39			case "lower":
40				return strings.ToLower(val)
41			case "base":
42				if i := strings.LastIndexByte(val, '/'); i >= 0 {
43					return val[i+1:]
44				}
45				return val
46			default:
47				if firstErr == nil {
48					firstErr = fmt.Errorf("unknown template filter %q in %q (known: slug, lower, base)", filter, tmpl)
49				}
50				return m
51			}
52		})
53		if firstErr != nil {
54			return "", firstErr
55		}
56		return out, nil
57	}
58	
59	var slugStrip = regexp.MustCompile(`[^a-zA-Z0-9._-]+`)
60	
61	// Slug makes a branch name safe to use as a single filesystem component:
62	// "feat/auth/oauth-refresh" becomes "feat-auth-oauth-refresh". Leading dots
63	// and dashes are trimmed so the result can never be a hidden directory or be
64	// mistaken for a flag.
65	func Slug(s string) string {
66		s = slugStrip.ReplaceAllString(s, "-")
67		for strings.Contains(s, "--") {
68			s = strings.ReplaceAll(s, "--", "-")
69		}
70		s = strings.Trim(s, "-._")
71		if s == "" {
72			return "unnamed"
73		}
74		return s
75	}
76	
77	func sortedKeys(v Vars) []string {
78		out := make([]string, 0, len(v))
79		for k := range v {
80			out = append(out, k)
81		}
82		// small map; insertion sort keeps this dependency-free
83		for i := 1; i < len(out); i++ {
84			for j := i; j > 0 && out[j] < out[j-1]; j-- {
85				out[j], out[j-1] = out[j-1], out[j]
86			}
87		}
88		return out
89	}
90

1	// Package forge wraps the GitHub and GitLab CLIs. Both are optional: every
2	// entry point degrades to plain git, because a workflow that hard-depends on a
3	// forge CLI being installed and authenticated stops working on exactly the
4	// machines where you most need it.
5	package forge
6	
7	import (
8		"bytes"
9		"context"
10		"errors"
11		"fmt"
12		"net/url"
13		"os"
14		"os/exec"
15		"strings"
16		"time"
17	
18		"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/gitx"
19	)
20	
21	// Kind identifies a forge.
22	type Kind string
23	
24	const (
25		// GitHub is served by the gh CLI.
26		GitHub Kind = "github"
27		// GitLab is served by the glab CLI.
28		GitLab Kind = "gitlab"
29		// Unknown is any other host, or none.
30		Unknown Kind = "unknown"
31	)
32	
33	// ErrNoCLI reports that the forge's CLI is not installed.
34	type ErrNoCLI struct {
35		Kind Kind
36		Bin  string
37	}
38	
39	func (e *ErrNoCLI) Error() string {
40		return fmt.Sprintf("%s support needs the %q CLI, which is not installed", e.Kind, e.Bin)
41	}
42	
43	// Forge is the subset of forge behaviour dev uses.
44	type Forge interface {
45		Kind() Kind
46		// Bin is the CLI binary name.
47		Bin() string
48		Available() bool
49		// CreatePR opens a pull/merge request from head into base.
50		CreatePR(ctx context.Context, dir string, req PRRequest) (string, error)
51		// CreateRepo creates a remote repository from an existing local one.
52		CreateRepo(ctx context.Context, dir string, req RepoRequest) (string, error)
53		// CloneURL renders the clone target for an owner/name reference.
54		CloneURL(ref string) string
55		// ListRepos lists repositories visible to the authenticated user.
56		ListRepos(ctx context.Context, limit int) ([]RemoteRepo, error)
57	}
58	
59	// RemoteRepo is one repository visible through a forge CLI.
60	type RemoteRepo struct {
61		Forge         Kind      `json:"forge"`
62		Name          string    `json:"name"`
63		FullName      string    `json:"full_name"`
64		Description   string    `json:"description,omitempty"`
65		URL           string    `json:"url"`
66		CloneURL      string    `json:"clone_url"`
67		SSHURL        string    `json:"ssh_url,omitempty"`
68		Visibility    string    `json:"visibility,omitempty"`
69		DefaultBranch string    `json:"default_branch,omitempty"`
70		Archived      bool      `json:"archived"`
71		Fork          bool      `json:"fork"`
72		UpdatedAt     time.Time `json:"updated_at,omitempty"`
73	}
74	
75	// Label is the provider-qualified identity shown in a combined list.
76	func (r RemoteRepo) Label() string { return string(r.Forge) + ":" + r.FullName }
77	
78	// All returns both forge adapters, for an aggregate remote inventory.
79	func All() []Forge { return []Forge{&gh{}, &glab{}} }
80	
81	// PRRequest describes a pull/merge request to open.
82	type PRRequest struct {
83		Base  string
84		Head  string
85		Title string
86		Body  string
87		Draft bool
88		// Fill asks the CLI to derive title and body from the commits.
89		Fill bool
90		// Web opens the created request in a browser.
91		Web bool
92	}
93	
94	// RepoRequest describes a remote repository to create.
95	type RepoRequest struct {
96		Name        string
97		Description string
98		Private     bool
99		// Push pushes the current branch after creating the remote.
100		Push bool
101		// RemoteName is the git remote to add, defaulting to origin.
102		RemoteName string
103	}
104	
105	// Detect infers the forge for a checkout from its origin remote. A repo with
106	// no remote, or one on a self-hosted host neither CLI knows, resolves to
107	// Unknown — which callers must treat as "use plain git".
108	func Detect(ctx context.Context, dir string) Kind {
109		return FromURL(gitx.Remote(ctx, dir, "origin"))
110	}
111	
112	// FromURL classifies a remote URL.
113	func FromURL(url string) Kind {
114		u := strings.ToLower(url)
115		switch {
116		case u == "":
117			return Unknown
118		case strings.Contains(u, "github.com"), strings.Contains(u, "github."):
119			return GitHub
120		case strings.Contains(u, "gitlab.com"), strings.Contains(u, "gitlab."):
121			return GitLab
122		}
123		return Unknown
124	}
125	
126	// For returns the adapter for a kind.
127	func For(k Kind) (Forge, error) {
128		switch k {
129		case GitHub:
130			return &gh{}, nil
131		case GitLab:
132			return &glab{}, nil
133		}
134		return nil, errors.New("no forge CLI for this remote; falling back to plain git")
135	}
136	
137	// Preferred returns the first available forge, for commands like `repo new`
138	// that have no existing remote to infer from.
139	func Preferred() (Forge, error) {
140		for _, f := range []Forge{&gh{}, &glab{}} {
141			if f.Available() {
142				return f, nil
143			}
144		}
145		return nil, errors.New("neither gh nor glab is installed")
146	}
147	
148	// run executes a forge CLI, streaming stderr through so the user sees the
149	// CLI's own authentication prompts and error messages verbatim.
150	func run(ctx context.Context, bin, dir string, args ...string) (string, error) {
151		cmd := exec.CommandContext(ctx, bin, args...)
152		cmd.Dir = dir
153		var stdout, stderr bytes.Buffer
154		cmd.Stdout = &stdout
155		cmd.Stderr = &stderr
156		cmd.Stdin = os.Stdin
157		if err := cmd.Run(); err != nil {
158			detail := strings.TrimSpace(stderr.String())
159			if detail != "" {
160				return strings.TrimSpace(stdout.String()), fmt.Errorf("%s %s: %s: %w",
161					bin, strings.Join(args, " "), detail, err)
162			}
163			return strings.TrimSpace(stdout.String()), fmt.Errorf("%s %s: %w", bin, strings.Join(args, " "), err)
164		}
165		return strings.TrimSpace(stdout.String()), nil
166	}
167	
168	func have(bin string) bool {
169		_, err := exec.LookPath(bin)
170		return err == nil
171	}
172	
173	// IdentityFromURL returns a forge and owner/name identity for an HTTPS or SSH
174	// Git remote. It is used to match remote inventories to local clones without
175	// assuming the checkout directory has the same name.
176	func IdentityFromURL(raw string) (Kind, string) {
177		kind := FromURL(raw)
178		if kind == Unknown {
179			return Unknown, ""
180		}
181		s := strings.TrimSpace(raw)
182		if strings.Contains(s, "://") {
183			if parsed, err := url.Parse(s); err == nil {
184				s = strings.TrimPrefix(parsed.Path, "/")
185			}
186		} else if at := strings.IndexByte(s, '@'); at >= 0 {
187			// SCP-style SSH: git@github.com:owner/repo.git
188			s = s[at+1:]
189			if colon := strings.IndexByte(s, ':'); colon >= 0 {
190				s = s[colon+1:]
191			}
192		}
193		s = strings.Trim(strings.TrimSuffix(s, ".git"), "/")
194		return kind, s
195	}

84	// send feeds a sequence of key presses through Update, running any command the
85	// model returns so the action callbacks actually fire — that is what makes
86	// these tests exercise the real key bindings rather than the model's fields.
87	func send(m tui.Model, msgs ...tea.Msg) tui.Model {
88		var cur tea.Model = m
89		for _, msg := range msgs {
90			var cmd tea.Cmd
91			cur, cmd = cur.Update(msg)
92			// Follow the command chain, so an action's resulting message (and the
93			// reload it triggers) is applied too. Commands that do not return
94			// promptly are the cursor's blink timers; running those would make the
95			// suite sleep for half a second per keystroke.
96			for i := 0; cmd != nil && i < 8; i++ {
97				out, ok := runQuickly(cmd)
98				if !ok || out == nil {
99					break
100				}
101				if _, isBatch := out.(tea.BatchMsg); isBatch {
102					break
103				}
104				cur, cmd = cur.Update(out)
105			}
106		}
107		return cur.(tui.Model)
108	}
109	
110	// runQuickly executes a command, giving up on anything that blocks — which in
111	// practice means the cursor blink timers.
112	func runQuickly(cmd tea.Cmd) (tea.Msg, bool) {
113		done := make(chan tea.Msg, 1)
114		go func() { done <- cmd() }()
115		select {
116		case msg := <-done:
117			return msg, true
118		case <-time.After(100 * time.Millisecond):
119			return nil, false
120		}
121	}
122	
123	func key(s string) tea.KeyMsg {
124		switch s {
125		case "enter":
126			return tea.KeyMsg{Type: tea.KeyEnter}
127		case "esc":
128			return tea.KeyMsg{Type: tea.KeyEsc}
129		case "down":
130			return tea.KeyMsg{Type: tea.KeyDown}
131		case "up":
132			return tea.KeyMsg{Type: tea.KeyUp}
133		}
134		return tea.KeyMsg{Type: tea.KeyRunes, Runes: []rune(s)}
135	}
136	
137	func typeText(s string) []tea.KeyMsg {
138		out := make([]tea.KeyMsg, 0, len(s))
139		for _, r := range s {
140			out = append(out, tea.KeyMsg{Type: tea.KeyRunes, Runes: []rune{r}})
141		}
142		return out
143	}

21	// harness runs dev commands against an isolated HOME, config and scan root.
22	type harness struct {
23		t          *testing.T
24		home       string
25		configPath string
26		scanRoot   string
27		wtRoot     string
28		repo       *gittest.Repo
29	}
30	
31	func newHarness(t *testing.T) *harness {
32		t.Helper()
33		home := t.TempDir()
34		scanRoot := filepath.Join(home, "Program")
35		wtRoot := filepath.Join(home, "Worktrees")
36		if err := os.MkdirAll(scanRoot, 0o755); err != nil {
37			t.Fatal(err)
38		}
39	
40		// A repo inside the scan root, so `dev` discovers it the way it would in
41		// real use rather than via an absolute path.
42		r := gittest.New(t)
43		dest := filepath.Join(scanRoot, "demo")
44		if err := os.Rename(r.Root, dest); err != nil {
45			t.Fatal(err)
46		}
47		r.Root = dest
48	
49		// Isolate every path dev touches from the developer's real machine.
50		t.Setenv("HOME", home)
51		t.Setenv("XDG_DATA_HOME", filepath.Join(home, ".local", "share"))
52		t.Setenv("XDG_CONFIG_HOME", filepath.Join(home, ".config"))
53		t.Setenv("XDG_CACHE_HOME", filepath.Join(home, ".cache"))
54	
55		configPath := filepath.Join(home, "config.toml")
56		cfg := "" +
57			"[paths]\n" +
58			"scan_roots = [\"" + scanRoot + "\"]\n" +
59			"project_root = \"" + scanRoot + "\"\n" +
60			"tries_root = \"" + filepath.Join(home, "tries") + "\"\n" +
61			"worktree_root = \"" + wtRoot + "\"\n" +
62			"state_dir = \"" + filepath.Join(home, "state") + "\"\n" +
63			"\n[runtime]\nbackend = \"none\"\n" +
64			"\n[worktree]\ninclude = [\".env\"]\npost_create = []\n"
65		if err := os.WriteFile(configPath, []byte(cfg), 0o644); err != nil {
66			t.Fatal(err)
67		}
68		return &harness{t: t, home: home, configPath: configPath, scanRoot: scanRoot, wtRoot: wtRoot, repo: r}
69	}
70	
71	// run executes one dev invocation, capturing its output. Commands write
72	// through App, so the writers passed to NewRootCommandWithIO are all that is
73	// needed — no file-descriptor juggling.
74	func (h *harness) run(args ...string) (string, string, error) {
75		h.t.Helper()
76		var out, errBuf bytes.Buffer
77		root := cli.NewRootCommandWithIO(&out, &errBuf)
78		root.SetArgs(append([]string{"--config", h.configPath}, args...))
79		err := root.Execute()
80		return out.String(), errBuf.String(), err
81	}
82	
83	func (h *harness) mustRun(args ...string) string {
84		h.t.Helper()
85		out, errOut, err := h.run(args...)
86		if err != nil {
87			h.t.Fatalf("dev %s: %v\nstderr: %s", strings.Join(args, " "), err, errOut)
88		}
89		return out
90	}
