534	// pad truncates to n display columns, measuring the way lipgloss renders so
535	// CJK repo and task names do not shift the table.
536	func pad(s string, n int) string {
537		if lipgloss.Width(s) <= n {
538			return s
539		}
540		var b strings.Builder
541		used := 0
542		for _, r := range s {
543			w := lipgloss.Width(string(r))
544			if used+w > n-1 {
545				break
546			}
547			b.WriteRune(r)
548			used += w
549		}
550		return b.String() + "…"
551	}
552	
553	func clamp(v, lo, hi int) int {
554		if v < lo {
555			return lo
556		}
557		if v > hi {
558			return hi
559		}
560		return v

15	// RepoRow is one repository as the dashboard shows it: what it is, plus how
16	// much of it is currently in flight.
17	//
18	// The repository view exists because the task list alone answers only half the
19	// question. On a machine with forty repositories and no tasks recorded yet,
20	// a task-only dashboard is empty — and the honest answer to "what do I have
21	// here?" has to come before "what am I working on?"
22	type RepoRow struct {
23		Repo   repo.Repo
24		Status gitx.Status
25		// Worktrees is the number of linked worktrees, excluding the main checkout.
26		Worktrees int
27		// Tasks are the recorded tasks belonging to this repository.
28		Tasks []*task.Task
29		// Live reports a runtime session sitting in this repository.
30		Live          bool
31		Runtime       string
32		RuntimeHandle string
33		RuntimeStatus string
34		// RemoteForge / RemoteName identify origin for matching the REMOTE view to
35		// this local checkout without rescanning every repo when a cache opens.
36		RemoteForge forge.Kind
37		RemoteName  string
38	}

40	// HotTasks counts the repository's tasks that are currently hot.
41	func (r RepoRow) HotTasks() int {
42		n := 0
43		for _, t := range r.Tasks {
44			if t.State == task.Hot {
45				n++
46			}
47		}
48		return n
49	}
50	
51	// StateSummary renders the repository's tasks as a compact per-state tally,
52	// which is what makes the list scannable at forty repositories.
53	func (r RepoRow) StateSummary() string {
54		if len(r.Tasks) == 0 {
55			return ""
56		}
57		counts := map[task.State]int{}
58		for _, t := range r.Tasks {
59			counts[t.State]++
60		}
61		var parts []string
62		for _, s := range task.States {
63			if counts[s] > 0 {
64				parts = append(parts, s.Icon()+strconv.Itoa(counts[s]))
65			}
66		}
67		return strings.Join(parts, " ")
68	}

74		b.WriteString(" ")
75		b.WriteString(r.Status.Branch)
76		for _, t := range r.Tasks {
77			b.WriteString(" ")

93	// matches reports whether every whitespace-separated term of the query appears
94	// in the haystack.
95	//
96	// Term-wise rather than substring so "auth api" finds a task named "api token
97	// auth" — the order words come to mind in is rarely the order they appear in.
98	func matches(haystack, query string) bool {
99		query = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(query))
100		if query == "" {
101			return true
102		}
103		for _, term := range strings.Fields(query) {
104			if !strings.Contains(haystack, term) {
105				return false
106			}
107		}
108		return true
109	}

1	package gitx
2	
3	import (
4		"context"
5		"strconv"
6		"strings"
7	)
8	
9	// Status is the live git state of one checkout — everything dev's inventory
10	// shows about a task without persisting any of it.
11	type Status struct {
12		Branch   string `json:"branch,omitempty"`
13		Detached bool   `json:"detached"`
14		// Upstream is the tracking ref (e.g. "origin/feat/auth"), empty when the
15		// branch has never been published.
16		Upstream string `json:"upstream,omitempty"`
17		Ahead    int    `json:"ahead"`
18		Behind   int    `json:"behind"`
19		// Changed counts unique changed paths. Staged and Unstaged are index /
20		// working-tree views and can overlap when one path has both kinds of
21		// changes; Changed does not double-count it.
22		Changed   int `json:"changed"`
23		Staged    int `json:"staged"`
24		Unstaged  int `json:"unstaged"`
25		Untracked int `json:"untracked"`
26		// Added, Modified, Deleted and Renamed classify status letters. One path
27		// can contribute to two when its staged and unstaged states differ.
28		Added    int `json:"added"`
29		Modified int `json:"modified"`
30		Deleted  int `json:"deleted"`
31		Renamed  int `json:"renamed"`
32		// Conflicted counts unmerged paths; a non-zero value means the checkout is
33		// mid-merge or mid-rebase and must not be touched automatically.
34		Conflicted int `json:"conflicted"`
35	}
36	
37	// Dirty reports uncommitted work of any kind.
38	func (s Status) Dirty() bool { return s.Changed > 0 }
39	
40	// Published reports whether the branch has an upstream at all.
41	func (s Status) Published() bool { return s.Upstream != "" }
42	
43	// Synced reports a branch that is published and exactly level with upstream.
44	func (s Status) Synced() bool { return s.Published() && s.Ahead == 0 && s.Behind == 0 }
45	
46	// Summary renders the compact, starship-like column used throughout dev:
47	//
48	//	⇕⇡2⇣1 =1 +3 !2 ?4
49	//
50	// Divergence, conflicts, staged, unstaged and untracked paths remain separate
51	// so "dirty" says how and by how much, rather than collapsing to one ●.
52	func (s Status) Summary() string {
53		var parts []string
54		switch {
55		case s.Ahead > 0 && s.Behind > 0:
56			parts = append(parts, "⇕⇡"+strconv.Itoa(s.Ahead)+"⇣"+strconv.Itoa(s.Behind))
57		case s.Ahead > 0:
58			parts = append(parts, "⇡"+strconv.Itoa(s.Ahead))
59		case s.Behind > 0:
60			parts = append(parts, "⇣"+strconv.Itoa(s.Behind))
61		}
62		if s.Conflicted > 0 {
63			parts = append(parts, "="+strconv.Itoa(s.Conflicted))
64		}
65		if s.Staged > 0 {
66			parts = append(parts, "+"+strconv.Itoa(s.Staged))
67		}
68		if s.Unstaged > 0 {
69			parts = append(parts, "!"+strconv.Itoa(s.Unstaged))
70		}
71		if s.Untracked > 0 {
72			parts = append(parts, "?"+strconv.Itoa(s.Untracked))
73		}
74		if len(parts) == 0 {
75			if !s.Published() {
76				return "local"
77			}
78			return "clean"
79		}
80		return strings.Join(parts, " ")
81	}
82	
83	// Breakdown renders the detailed change count shown by `dev status` and the
84	// TUI detail pane. Changed is the unique-path total; staged and unstaged may
85	// overlap, which is stated by presenting them as categories rather than a sum.
86	func (s Status) Breakdown() string {
87		if s.Changed == 0 {
88			return "0 changed paths"
89		}
90		var parts []string
91		if s.Staged > 0 {
92			parts = append(parts, "+"+strconv.Itoa(s.Staged)+" staged")
93		}
94		if s.Unstaged > 0 {
95			parts = append(parts, "!"+strconv.Itoa(s.Unstaged)+" unstaged")
96		}
97		if s.Untracked > 0 {
98			parts = append(parts, "?"+strconv.Itoa(s.Untracked)+" untracked")
99		}
100		if s.Conflicted > 0 {
101			parts = append(parts, "="+strconv.Itoa(s.Conflicted)+" conflicted")
102		}
103		return strconv.Itoa(s.Changed) + " changed paths (" + strings.Join(parts, ", ") + ")"
104	}
105	
106	// TypeBreakdown classifies the status letters when that detail is available.
107	func (s Status) TypeBreakdown() string {
108		var parts []string
109		for _, item := range []struct {
110			n    int
111			name string
112		}{
113			{s.Added, "added"}, {s.Modified, "modified"}, {s.Deleted, "deleted"},
114			{s.Renamed, "renamed/copied"},
115		} {
116			if item.n > 0 {
117				parts = append(parts, strconv.Itoa(item.n)+" "+item.name)
118			}
119		}
120		return strings.Join(parts, ", ")
121	}
122	
123	// StatusOf reads the porcelain v2 status of the checkout at dir. Porcelain v2
124	// is the documented machine-readable format: it reports branch, upstream and
125	// ahead/behind in the same pass as the file states, so one process gives dev
126	// everything it needs.
127	func StatusOf(ctx context.Context, dir string) (Status, error) {
128		out, err := run(ctx, dir, "status", "--porcelain=v2", "--branch", "--untracked-files=normal", "-z")
129		if err != nil {
130			return Status{}, err
131		}
132		var s Status
133		for _, rec := range nulLines(out) {
134			if rec == "" {
135				continue
136			}
137			switch rec[0] {
138			case '#':
139				parseBranchHeader(rec, &s)
140			case '1', '2':
141				// "1 XY ..." ordinary change, "2 XY ..." rename/copy. X is
142				// staged, Y unstaged. This record is one unique changed path even
143				// when both sides are non-dot.
144				f := strings.Fields(rec)
145				if len(f) < 2 || len(f[1]) < 2 {
146					continue
147				}
148				s.Changed++
149				x, y := f[1][0], f[1][1]
150				if x != '.' {
151					s.Staged++
152				}
153				if y != '.' {
154					s.Unstaged++
155				}
156				classifyChange(x, &s)
157				classifyChange(y, &s)
158			case 'u':
159				s.Changed++
160				s.Conflicted++
161			case '?':
162				s.Changed++
163				s.Untracked++
164			}
165		}
166		return s, nil
167	}
168	
169	func classifyChange(code byte, s *Status) {
170		switch code {
171		case 'A':
172			s.Added++
173		case 'M', 'T':
174			s.Modified++
175		case 'D':
176			s.Deleted++
177		case 'R', 'C':
178			s.Renamed++
179		}
180	}
181	
182	func parseBranchHeader(rec string, s *Status) {
183		f := strings.Fields(rec)
184		if len(f) < 3 {
185			return
186		}
187		switch f[1] {
188		case "branch.head":
189			if f[2] == "(detached)" {
190				s.Detached = true
191			} else {
192				s.Branch = f[2]
193			}
194		case "branch.upstream":
195			s.Upstream = f[2]
196		case "branch.ab":
197			// "# branch.ab +2 -1"
198			if len(f) < 4 {
199				return
200			}
201			s.Ahead, _ = strconv.Atoi(strings.TrimPrefix(f[2], "+"))
202			s.Behind, _ = strconv.Atoi(strings.TrimPrefix(f[3], "-"))
203		}
204	}
205	
206	// LastCommit reports the author timestamp of HEAD as a Unix epoch, and the
207	// subject line. Used to age a task in `dev sweep`.
208	func LastCommit(ctx context.Context, dir string) (unix int64, subject string, err error) {
209		out, err := run(ctx, dir, "log", "-1", "--format=%at%x00%s")
210		if err != nil || out == "" {
211			return 0, "", err
212		}
213		ts, subj, _ := strings.Cut(out, "\x00")
214		unix, _ = strconv.ParseInt(ts, 10, 64)
215		return unix, subj, nil
216	}
217	
218	// WipCommit stages everything and records a checkpoint commit.
219	//
220	// A checkpoint commit is deliberately preferred over `git stash`: a stash is
221	// invisible in the log, easy to forget, and cannot be pushed — so it can never
222	// travel to another machine, which is exactly what parking a task needs.
223	func WipCommit(ctx context.Context, dir, message string) (bool, error) {
224		st, err := StatusOf(ctx, dir)
225		if err != nil {
226			return false, err
227		}
228		if !st.Dirty() {
229			return false, nil
230		}
231		if st.Conflicted > 0 {
232			return false, &Error{Args: []string{"commit"}, Dir: dir,
233				Stderr: "checkout has unmerged paths; resolve the conflict before parking"}
234		}
235		if _, err := run(ctx, dir, "add", "--all"); err != nil {
236			return false, err
237		}
238		if message == "" {
239			message = "wip: checkpoint"
240		}
241		if _, err := run(ctx, dir, "commit", "--no-verify", "-m", message); err != nil {
242			return false, err
243		}
244		return true, nil
245	}
246

1	package gitx
2	
3	import (
4		"context"
5		"strings"
6	)
7	
8	// Worktree is one entry of `git worktree list --porcelain`.
9	type Worktree struct {
10		Path string
11		// Head is the commit the worktree is checked out at.
12		Head string
13		// Branch is the short branch name, empty when detached.
14		Branch   string
15		Detached bool
16		Bare     bool
17		// Locked reports a `git worktree lock`; Prunable reports a checkout whose
18		// directory has gone missing. Both block a plain remove.
19		Locked         bool
20		LockedReason   string
21		Prunable       bool
22		PrunableReason string
23		// Main reports the primary (non-linked) checkout.
24		Main bool
25	}
26	
27	// Worktrees lists every worktree of the repository containing dir, in git's
28	// own order: the main checkout first, then linked worktrees.
29	func Worktrees(ctx context.Context, dir string) ([]Worktree, error) {
30		out, err := run(ctx, dir, "worktree", "list", "--porcelain")
31		if err != nil {
32			return nil, err
33		}
34		var (
35			list []Worktree
36			cur  *Worktree
37		)
38		flush := func() {
39			if cur != nil {
40				list = append(list, *cur)
41				cur = nil
42			}
43		}
44		for _, line := range strings.Split(out, "\n") {
45			if line == "" { // records are blank-line separated
46				flush()
47				continue
48			}
49			key, val, _ := strings.Cut(line, " ")
50			switch key {
51			case "worktree":
52				flush()
53				cur = &Worktree{Path: val, Main: len(list) == 0}
54			case "HEAD":
55				if cur != nil {
56					cur.Head = val
57				}
58			case "branch":
59				if cur != nil {
60					cur.Branch = strings.TrimPrefix(val, "refs/heads/")
61				}
62			case "detached":
63				if cur != nil {
64					cur.Detached = true
65				}
66			case "bare":
67				if cur != nil {
68					cur.Bare = true
69				}
70			case "locked":
71				if cur != nil {
72					cur.Locked, cur.LockedReason = true, val
73				}
74			case "prunable":
75				if cur != nil {
76					cur.Prunable, cur.PrunableReason = true, val
77				}
78			}
79		}
80		flush()
81		return list, nil
82	}
83	
84	// WorktreeFor finds the worktree checked out on branch, if any. Git refuses to
85	// check the same branch out twice, so at most one can match.
86	func WorktreeFor(ctx context.Context, dir, branch string) (Worktree, bool, error) {
87		list, err := Worktrees(ctx, dir)
88		if err != nil {
89			return Worktree{}, false, err
90		}
91		for _, w := range list {
92			if w.Branch == branch {
93				return w, true, nil
94			}
95		}
96		return Worktree{}, false, nil
97	}
98	
99	// AddWorktree creates a linked worktree at path.
100	//
101	// When branch already exists it is checked out; otherwise it is created from
102	// base. Passing an explicit base matters: without one git branches from the
103	// *current* HEAD, so a worktree created while standing on feature/A would
104	// silently inherit feature/A's commits.
105	func AddWorktree(ctx context.Context, dir, path, branch, base string) error {
106		exists := BranchExists(ctx, dir, branch)
107		args := []string{"worktree", "add"}
108		if exists {
109			args = append(args, path, branch)
110		} else {
111			args = append(args, "-b", branch, path)
112			if base != "" {
113				args = append(args, base)
114			}
115		}
116		_, err := run(ctx, dir, args...)
117		return err
118	}
119	
120	// RemoveWorktree removes a linked worktree checkout. It never deletes the
121	// branch — that is a separate, explicit decision.
122	func RemoveWorktree(ctx context.Context, dir, path string, force bool) error {
123		args := []string{"worktree", "remove"}
124		if force {
125			args = append(args, "--force")
126		}
127		args = append(args, path)
128		_, err := run(ctx, dir, args...)
129		return err
130	}
131	
132	// PruneWorktrees clears administrative entries for checkouts whose directories
133	// were deleted behind git's back.
134	func PruneWorktrees(ctx context.Context, dir string) error {
135		_, err := run(ctx, dir, "worktree", "prune")
136		return err
137	}
138	
139	// BranchExists reports whether a local branch of that name exists.
140	func BranchExists(ctx context.Context, dir, branch string) bool {
141		if branch == "" {
142			return false
143		}
144		_, err := run(ctx, dir, "show-ref", "--verify", "--quiet", "refs/heads/"+branch)
145		return err == nil
146	}
147	
148	// RefExists reports whether any ref or commit-ish resolves.
149	func RefExists(ctx context.Context, dir, ref string) bool {
150		if ref == "" {
151			return false
152		}
153		_, err := run(ctx, dir, "rev-parse", "--verify", "--quiet", ref+"^{commit}")
154		return err == nil
155	}
156

20	// suggestion is one proposed change, with the reason and the exact effect.
21	type suggestion struct {
22		row    inventory.Row
23		action string
24		reason string
25		// apply performs the change. nil means "report only".
26		apply func() error
27	}
28	
29	func newSweepCmd(app *App) *cobra.Command {
30		var (
31			apply     bool
32			staleDays int
33			yes       bool
34		)
35		cmd := &cobra.Command{
36			Use:   "sweep",
37			Short: "Review stale tasks and drifted state, and act on them",
38			Long: `Show which tasks have gone stale or drifted, and what dev would do about it.
39	
40	Cleanup usually fails not because people are unwilling but because there is no
41	trustworthy way to be sure the work is recoverable. So sweep reports first and
42	only changes things with --apply, confirming each one unless you pass --yes.
43	Nothing here ever deletes uncommitted work.`,
44			Args: cobra.NoArgs,
45			RunE: func(cmd *cobra.Command, args []string) error {
46				ctx := ctxOf()
47				tasks, err := app.Tasks.List()
48				if err != nil {
49					return err
50				}
51				rt := app.Runtime()
52				rows := inventory.Collect(ctx, tasks, rt, inventory.Options{})
53				stale := time.Duration(staleDays) * 24 * time.Hour
54	
55				var sugg []suggestion
56				for _, r := range rows {
57					sugg = append(sugg, suggestFor(app, ctx, rt, r, stale)...)
58				}
59	
60				// Live sessions no task claims: the other half of a crowded sidebar.
61				if sessions, err := rt.List(ctx); err == nil {
62					if orphans := inventory.Orphans(sessions, rows); len(orphans) > 0 {
63						fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "\n%d live session(s) with no task recorded:\n", len(orphans))
64						for _, s := range orphans {
65							dir := "—"
66							if len(s.Dirs) > 0 {
67								dir = config.Contract(s.Dirs[0])
68							}
69							fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "  %-24s %s\n", truncate(s.Label, 24), dir)
70						}
71						fmt.Fprintln(app.Out, "  → `dev start` in one of those directories to track it, or just close it.")
72					}
73				}
74	
75				if len(sugg) == 0 {
76					fmt.Fprintln(app.Out, "\nNothing to sweep — every task matches its recorded state.")
77					return nil
78				}
79	
80				fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "\n%d suggestion(s):\n\n", len(sugg))
81				for _, s := range sugg {
82					fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "  %s %-28s %s\n", s.row.Task.State.Icon(),
83						truncate(s.row.Task.Title(), 28), s.reason)
84					fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "     → %s\n", s.action)
85				}
86	
87				if !apply {
88					fmt.Fprintln(app.Out, "\nRe-run with --apply to act on these (each is confirmed individually).")
89					return nil
90				}
91	
92				in := bufio.NewReader(os.Stdin)
93				for _, s := range sugg {
94					if s.apply == nil {
95						continue
96					}
97					if !yes && !confirm(app, in, s.action) {
98						continue
99					}
100					if err := s.apply(); err != nil {
101						app.warnf("%s: %v", s.row.Task.ID, err)
102						continue
103					}
104					fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "  done: %s\n", s.action)
105				}
106				return nil
107			},
108		}
109		f := cmd.Flags()
110		f.BoolVar(&apply, "apply", false, "act on the suggestions instead of only reporting")
111		f.IntVar(&staleDays, "stale-days", 14, "days without a commit before a task counts as stale")
112		f.BoolVar(&yes, "yes", false, "with --apply, do not confirm each change")
113		return cmd
114	}
115	
116	func suggestFor(app *App, ctx context.Context, rt runtime.Runtime, r inventory.Row, stale time.Duration) []suggestion {
117		t := r.Task
118		var out []suggestion
119	
120		switch {
121		// A hot task with no live session is the commonest drift: the session was
122		// closed (or the machine rebooted) without parking.
123		case t.State == task.Hot && !r.Live():
124			out = append(out, suggestion{
125				row:    r,
126				reason: fmt.Sprintf("hot but no live session, idle %s", humanAge(r.Age())),
127				action: fmt.Sprintf("mark %s warm", t.ID),
128				apply: func() error {
129					t.State = task.Warm
130					return app.Tasks.Save(t)
131				},
132			})
133	
134		// A warm task nobody has touched in weeks is a candidate for cold: keeping
135		// the worktree costs disk and clutters every listing.
136		case t.State == task.Warm && r.Age() > stale:
137			reason := fmt.Sprintf("warm and untouched for %s", humanAge(r.Age()))
138			if r.Status.Dirty() {
139				out = append(out, suggestion{row: r, reason: reason + ", but has uncommitted work",
140					action: "commit or `dev park --wip` before going cold — not changed automatically"})
141				break
142			}
143			if !r.Status.Synced() {
144				out = append(out, suggestion{row: r, reason: reason + fmt.Sprintf(", not pushed (%s)", r.Status.Summary()),
145					action: fmt.Sprintf("push %s so it can go cold: dev park %s --cold --push", t.Branch, t.ID)})
146				break
147			}
148			out = append(out, suggestion{
149				row:    r,
150				reason: reason + ", clean and pushed",
151				action: fmt.Sprintf("go cold: remove %s (branch and remote keep the work)", config.Contract(r.Checkout)),
152				apply: func() error {
153					m := &wt.Manager{Cfg: app.Cfg, Runtime: rt, Log: app.Err}
154					if t.WorktreePath != "" {
155						if err := m.Remove(ctx, wt.RemoveRequest{
156							RepoPath: t.RepoPath, Path: t.WorktreePath, RuntimeHandle: t.RuntimeHandle,
157						}); err != nil {
158							return err
159						}
160						t.WorktreePath = ""
161					}
162					t.State, t.RuntimeHandle = task.Cold, ""
163					return app.Tasks.Save(t)
164				},
165			})
166	
167		// A done task's entry has served its purpose once the branch is gone.
168		case t.State == task.Done:
169			out = append(out, suggestion{
170				row:    r,
171				reason: "merged",
172				action: fmt.Sprintf("reap the task entry %s", t.ID),
173				apply:  func() error { return app.Tasks.Delete(t.ID) },
174			})
175		}
176	
177		// Drift that is independent of the lifecycle stage.
178		if r.WorktreeMissing && t.WorktreePath != "" {
179			wtPath := t.WorktreePath
180			out = append(out, suggestion{
181				row:    r,
182				reason: "records a worktree that git no longer knows about",
183				action: fmt.Sprintf("clear the stale worktree path %s", config.Contract(wtPath)),
184				apply: func() error {
185					if err := gitx.PruneWorktrees(ctx, t.RepoPath); err != nil {
186						return err
187					}
188					t.WorktreePath = ""
189					if t.State == task.Hot || t.State == task.Warm {
190						t.State = task.Cold
191					}
192					return app.Tasks.Save(t)
193				},
194			})
195		}
196		return out
197	}
198	
199	func confirm(app *App, in *bufio.Reader, action string) bool {
200		fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "  %s? [y/N] ", action)
201		line, err := in.ReadString('\n')
202		if err != nil {
203			return false
204		}
205		answer := strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(line))
206		return answer == "y" || answer == "yes"
207	}

1	// Package cli assembles dev's command tree. Commands stay thin: they parse
2	// flags, call into the domain packages, and render. All policy lives in
3	// config, gitx, wt, task and runtime so it can be tested without a terminal.
4	package cli
5	
6	import (
7		"context"
8		"fmt"
9		"io"
10		"os"
11	
12		"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/config"
13		"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/runtime"
14		"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/task"
15	)
16	
17	// App is the state shared by every command.
18	type App struct {
19		Cfg   config.Config
20		Tasks *task.Store
21	
22		Out io.Writer
23		Err io.Writer
24	
25		// configPath is the --config override; empty means the XDG default.
26		configPath string
27		// runtimeOverride is the --runtime flag; empty means use the config.
28		runtimeOverride string
29		// noRuntime disables all multiplexer interaction for one invocation.
30		noRuntime bool
31	}
32	
33	// Load reads configuration and prepares the shared stores.
34	func (a *App) Load() error {
35		cfg, err := config.Load(a.configPath)
36		if err != nil {
37			return err
38		}
39		a.Cfg = cfg
40		a.Tasks = task.NewStore(cfg.TasksDir())
41		if a.Out == nil {
42			a.Out = os.Stdout
43		}
44		if a.Err == nil {
45			a.Err = os.Stderr
46		}
47		return nil
48	}
49	
50	// Runtime resolves the multiplexer backend for this invocation, honouring
51	// --runtime and --no-runtime.
52	func (a *App) Runtime() runtime.Runtime {
53		if a.noRuntime {
54			return runtime.None{}
55		}
56		backend := a.Cfg.Runtime.Backend
57		if a.runtimeOverride != "" {
58			backend = a.runtimeOverride
59		}
60		rt := runtime.Select(backend)
61		if h, ok := rt.(*runtime.Herdr); ok {
62			return h.WithMetadataSource(a.Cfg.Runtime.MetadataSource)
63		}
64		return rt
65	}
66	
67	// printf writes to the command's stdout.
68	func (a *App) printf(format string, args ...any) {
69		fmt.Fprintf(a.Out, format, args...)
70	}
71	
72	// warnf writes a non-fatal notice to stderr, so it never pollutes piped output.
73	func (a *App) warnf(format string, args ...any) {
74		fmt.Fprintf(a.Err, "dev: "+format+"\n", args...)
75	}
76	
77	// cdDirective emits the marker the shell wrapper installed by
78	// `dev shell-init` looks for. A child process cannot change its parent's
79	// working directory, so the only way `dev resume` can leave the user *in* the
80	// checkout is to ask the shell to do it.
81	func (a *App) cdDirective(dir string) {
82		fmt.Fprintf(a.Out, "cd %s\n", shellQuote(dir))
83	}
84	
85	// ctx is the cancellable context commands run under.
86	func ctxOf() context.Context { return context.Background() }

18	It exists to keep three things separate that otherwise collapse into one:
19	
20	  git remote      durable code state, the source of truth
21	  git worktree    a disposable local checkout

23	  dev             human intent: what am I working on, and what is next

25	Everything derivable from git or the runtime is derived live. dev persists only
26	what git cannot answer — a task's state, its owner and its next action — so
27	closing a runtime session never means losing the thread.`

29	// NewRootCommand builds the whole command tree writing to the process streams.
30	func NewRootCommand() *cobra.Command {
31		return NewRootCommandWithIO(os.Stdout, os.Stderr)
32	}
33	
34	// NewRootCommandWithIO builds the command tree writing to the given streams.
35	// Commands write through App rather than through cobra, so this is the seam
36	// tests use to capture output without redirecting the process's file
37	// descriptors.
38	func NewRootCommandWithIO(out, errOut io.Writer) *cobra.Command {
39		app := &App{Out: out, Err: errOut}
40	
41		root := &cobra.Command{
42			Use:           "dev",
43			Short:         "Manage repos, worktrees and work-in-progress across agent runtimes",
44			Long:          rootLong,
45			Version:       Version,
46			SilenceUsage:  true,
47			SilenceErrors: true,
48			// Bare `dev` shows the inventory, which is the question the tool
49			// exists to answer.
50			RunE: func(cmd *cobra.Command, args []string) error {
51				if printSkill, _ := cmd.Flags().GetBool("skill"); printSkill {
52					out, err := skill.Render()
53					if err != nil {
54						return err
55					}
56					fmt.Fprint(app.Out, out)
57					return nil
58				}
59				// A terminal gets the dashboard; a pipe gets the listing, so
60				// `dev | grep` and `dev > file` behave as expected.
61				if interactive() {
62					return runTUI(app)
63				}
64				return runList(app, listOptions{})
65			},
66			PersistentPreRunE: func(cmd *cobra.Command, args []string) error {
67				return app.Load()
68			},
69		}
70	
71		pf := root.PersistentFlags()
72		pf.StringVar(&app.configPath, "config", "", "path to config.toml (default: $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/dev/config.toml)")
73		pf.StringVar(&app.runtimeOverride, "runtime", "", "override runtime backend: herdr, tmux or none")

110	// Execute runs the CLI and maps errors to exit codes.
111	func Execute() int {
112		root := NewRootCommand()
113		if err := root.Execute(); err != nil {
114			msg := err.Error()
115			// cobra already printed usage errors in a readable form.
116			if !strings.HasPrefix(msg, "unknown command") {
117				fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "dev: "+msg)
118			}
119			return 1
120		}
121		return 0
122	}

329	// repoNameFromRef derives a directory name from a clone reference.
330	func repoNameFromRef(ref string) string {
331		ref = strings.TrimSuffix(strings.TrimSuffix(ref, "/"), ".git")

333			return ref[i+1:]
334		}
335		return ref
336	}

439		f.BoolVar(&jsonOut, "json", false, "emit JSON")

54	func runList(app *App, o listOptions) error {
55		ctx := ctxOf()
56		tasks, err := app.Tasks.List()
57		if err != nil {
58			return err
59		}
60	
61		filter := inventory.Filter{Repo: o.repo, LiveOnly: o.live, DirtyOnly: o.dirty}
62		for _, s := range o.states {
63			st, err := task.ParseState(s)
64			if err != nil {
65				return err
66			}
67			filter.States = append(filter.States, st)
68		}
69		if len(filter.States) == 0 && !o.showAll {
70			filter.States = []task.State{task.Hot, task.Warm, task.Cold}
71		}
72	
73		rt := app.Runtime()
74		rows := inventory.Collect(ctx, tasks, rt, inventory.Options{SkipRuntime: o.noRuntime})
75		rows = filter.Apply(rows)
76	
77		if o.jsonOut {
78			return emitJSON(app, rows)
79		}
80	
81		if len(rows) == 0 {
82			if len(tasks) == 0 {
83				fmt.Fprintln(app.Out, "No tasks yet. Start one with:  dev start <repo> --task <name>")
84			} else {
85				fmt.Fprintln(app.Out, "No tasks match that filter. Try `dev ls --all`.")
86			}
87			return nil
88		}
89	
90		t := NewTable("", "TASK", "STATE", "REPO", "BRANCH", "GIT", "AGE", "SESSION", "NEXT")
91		for _, r := range rows {
92			session := "—"
93			if r.Live() {
94				session = rt.Name()
95				if r.Session.AgentStatus != "" {
96					session += ":" + r.Session.AgentStatus
97				}
98			}
99			gitCol := r.Status.Summary()
100			switch {
101			case r.StatusErr != nil:
102				gitCol = "?"
103			case !r.CheckoutExists:
104				gitCol = "no checkout"
105			}
106			t.Add(
107				r.Task.State.Icon(),
108				truncate(r.Task.Title(), 28),
109				r.Task.State.Label(),
110				truncate(r.Task.Repo, 20),
111				truncate(r.Task.Branch, 28),
112				gitCol,
113				humanAge(r.Age()),
114				session,
115				truncate(dash(r.Task.Next), 40),
116			)
117		}
118		t.Render(app.Out)
119	
120		// Surface drift as a hint rather than rewriting state behind the user's
121		// back: dev reports, the user decides.
122		var drifted int
123		for _, r := range rows {
124			if r.StateDrift() != "" {
125				drifted++
126			}
127		}
128		if drifted > 0 {
129			fmt.Fprintf(app.Err, "\n%d task(s) drifted from their recorded state — run `dev sweep` to review.\n", drifted)
130		}
131		return nil
132	}

180	func emitJSON(app *App, rows []inventory.Row) error {
181		out := make([]jsonRow, 0, len(rows))
182		for _, r := range rows {
183			j := jsonRow{
184				ID:             r.Task.ID,
185				Name:           r.Task.Title(),
186				Repo:           r.Task.Repo,
187				RepoPath:       config.Contract(r.Task.RepoPath),
188				Branch:         r.Task.Branch,
189				Base:           r.Task.Base,
190				WorktreePath:   config.Contract(r.Task.WorktreePath),
191				Checkout:       config.Contract(r.Checkout),
192				State:          string(r.Task.State),
193				Mode:           string(r.Task.EffectiveMode()),
194				Owner:          r.Task.Owner,
195				Next:           r.Task.Next,
196				Note:           r.Task.Note,
197				Tags:           r.Task.Tags,
198				CheckoutExists: r.CheckoutExists,
199				Dirty:          r.Status.Dirty(),
200				Changed:        r.Status.Changed,
201				Staged:         r.Status.Staged,
202				Unstaged:       r.Status.Unstaged,
203				Untracked:      r.Status.Untracked,
204				Conflicted:     r.Status.Conflicted,
205				Added:          r.Status.Added,
206				Modified:       r.Status.Modified,
207				Deleted:        r.Status.Deleted,
208				Renamed:        r.Status.Renamed,
209				Ahead:          r.Status.Ahead,
210				Behind:         r.Status.Behind,
211				Upstream:       r.Status.Upstream,
212				GitSummary:     r.Status.Summary(),
213				Live:           r.Live(),
214				Drift:          r.StateDrift(),
215				AgeSeconds:     int64(r.Age().Seconds()),
216			}
217			if !r.Task.Updated.IsZero() {
218				j.Updated = r.Task.Updated.Format("2006-01-02T15:04:05Z")
219			}
220			if r.Session != nil {
221				j.RuntimeHandle = r.Session.Handle
222				j.AgentStatus = r.Session.AgentStatus
223				j.AgentSessions = r.Session.AgentSessions
224			}
225			if r.Task.WorktreePath == "" {
226				j.WorktreePath = ""
227			}
228			out = append(out, j)
229		}
230		enc := json.NewEncoder(app.Out)
231		enc.SetIndent("", "  ")
232		return enc.Encode(out)
233	}

1	package forge
2	
3	import (
4		"encoding/json"
5		"errors"
6		"io/fs"
7		"os"
8		"path/filepath"
9		"time"
10	)
11	
12	// Cache is the on-disk forge inventory. It exists for UI latency, not as a
13	// source of truth: the REMOTE tab should open instantly, and r refreshes it.
14	type Cache struct {
15		FetchedAt time.Time    `json:"fetched_at"`
16		Repos     []RemoteRepo `json:"repos"`
17	}
18	
19	// LoadCache returns a fresh cache, or false when it is missing, malformed or
20	// older than maxAge. A stale cache is deliberately not returned: showing a
21	// deleted private repo as current is more confusing than a brief reload.
22	func LoadCache(path string, maxAge time.Duration) (Cache, bool) {
23		b, err := os.ReadFile(path)
24		if err != nil {
25			return Cache{}, false
26		}
27		var c Cache
28		if json.Unmarshal(b, &c) != nil || c.FetchedAt.IsZero() {
29			return Cache{}, false
30		}
31		if maxAge > 0 && time.Since(c.FetchedAt) > maxAge {
32			return Cache{}, false
33		}
34		return c, true
35	}
36	
37	// SaveCache atomically replaces the cache. A partial forge response may be
38	// cached — its FetchedAt still says exactly when it was observed.
39	func SaveCache(path string, repos []RemoteRepo) error {
40		if path == "" {
41			return errors.New("empty cache path")
42		}
43		if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(path), 0o755); err != nil {
44			return err
45		}
46		b, err := json.MarshalIndent(Cache{FetchedAt: time.Now().UTC(), Repos: repos}, "", "  ")
47		if err != nil {
48			return err
49		}
50		b = append(b, '\n')
51		tmp, err := os.CreateTemp(filepath.Dir(path), ".remotes-*.tmp")
52		if err != nil {
53			return err
54		}
55		name := tmp.Name()
56		defer os.Remove(name)
57		if _, err := tmp.Write(b); err != nil {
58			tmp.Close()
59			return err
60		}
61		if err := tmp.Close(); err != nil {
62			return err
63		}
64		if err := os.Chmod(name, 0o600); err != nil {
65			return err
66		}
67		return os.Rename(name, path)
68	}
69	
70	// CacheExists reports whether any cache file exists, even stale. Used only for
71	// diagnostics.
72	func CacheExists(path string) bool {
73		_, err := os.Stat(path)
74		return err == nil || !errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist)
75	}
76

39	func newActions(r *recorder, rows []inventory.Row) tui.Actions {

49				r.opened = append(r.opened, "repo:"+rr.Repo.Name)
50				return "opened", nil

57				r.cloned = append(r.cloned, rr.Repo.FullName)
58				return "cloned", "/src/" + rr.Repo.Name, nil
59			},
60			Start: func(_ context.Context, rr tui.RepoRow, name string) (string, error) {
61				r.started = append(r.started, "worktree:"+rr.Repo.Name+"/"+name)
62				return "started", nil
63			},
64			StartDirect: func(_ context.Context, rr tui.RepoRow, name string) (string, error) {
65				r.started = append(r.started, "direct:"+rr.Repo.Name+"/"+name)
66				return "started direct", nil
67			},

69				r.opened = append(r.opened, t.ID)
70				return "opened " + t.ID, nil
71			},
72			Park: func(_ context.Context, t *task.Task, next string) (string, error) {
73				r.parked = append(r.parked, t.ID)
74				r.nexts[t.ID] = next
75				return "parked " + t.ID, nil
76			},
77			SetNext: func(_ context.Context, t *task.Task, next string) error {

79				return nil

83	
84	// send feeds a sequence of key presses through Update, running any command the
85	// model returns so the action callbacks actually fire — that is what makes
86	// these tests exercise the real key bindings rather than the model's fields.
87	func send(m tui.Model, msgs ...tea.Msg) tui.Model {
88		var cur tea.Model = m
89		for _, msg := range msgs {
90			var cmd tea.Cmd
91			cur, cmd = cur.Update(msg)
92			// Follow the command chain, so an action's resulting message (and the
93			// reload it triggers) is applied too. Commands that do not return
94			// promptly are the cursor's blink timers; running those would make the
95			// suite sleep for half a second per keystroke.
96			for i := 0; cmd != nil && i < 8; i++ {
97				out, ok := runQuickly(cmd)
98				if !ok || out == nil {
99					break
100				}
101				if _, isBatch := out.(tea.BatchMsg); isBatch {
102					break
103				}
104				cur, cmd = cur.Update(out)
105			}
106		}
107		return cur.(tui.Model)
108	}
109	
110	// runQuickly executes a command, giving up on anything that blocks — which in
111	// practice means the cursor blink timers.
112	func runQuickly(cmd tea.Cmd) (tea.Msg, bool) {
113		done := make(chan tea.Msg, 1)
114		go func() { done <- cmd() }()
115		select {
116		case msg := <-done:
117			return msg, true
118		case <-time.After(100 * time.Millisecond):
119			return nil, false
120		}
121	}
122	
123	func key(s string) tea.KeyMsg {
124		switch s {
125		case "enter":
126			return tea.KeyMsg{Type: tea.KeyEnter}
127		case "esc":
128			return tea.KeyMsg{Type: tea.KeyEsc}
129		case "down":
130			return tea.KeyMsg{Type: tea.KeyDown}
131		case "up":
132			return tea.KeyMsg{Type: tea.KeyUp}
133		}
134		return tea.KeyMsg{Type: tea.KeyRunes, Runes: []rune(s)}
135	}
136	
137	func typeText(s string) []tea.KeyMsg {
138		out := make([]tea.KeyMsg, 0, len(s))
139		for _, r := range s {
140			out = append(out, tea.KeyMsg{Type: tea.KeyRunes, Runes: []rune{r}})
141		}
142		return out
143	}

```text
200	- `+` — staged paths
201	- `!` — unstaged paths
202	- `?` — untracked paths
203	
204	`dev status` and the TUI detail pane also show the unique changed-path total
205	and type breakdown (added / modified / deleted / renamed). A path staged and
206	then modified again is one changed path, while correctly appearing in both the
207	staged and unstaged categories. JSON output exposes all counts separately.
208	
209	## Worktree ownership
210	
211	Three mechanisms create git worktrees. `dev` takes one position so nobody has
212	to improvise:
213	
214	| Kind | Owner | Where | Lifetime |
215	|---|---|---|---|
216	| Feature, fix, experiment, cross-machine handoff | **`dev`** | `~/Worktrees/<repo>/<slug>` | until `dev done` / `dev sweep` |
217	| Turn-scoped subagent isolation | **Claude Code** | `.claude/worktrees/` (gitignored) | dies with the turn |
218	| `herdr worktree create` | **not used** — `dev` runs `git worktree add`, then `herdr worktree open --path …` | — | — |
219	
220	**Might you come back tomorrow → `dev`. Dies with this agent turn → Claude
221	Code native.**
222	
223	`dev` does not delegate placement to herdr because the path policy has to hold
224	on machines without herdr. It creates the checkout with plain git and asks
225	herdr only to *open* it — which still surfaces it in the sidebar grouped under
226	its parent repo with its own branch and ahead/behind row.
227	
228	`dev` refuses to create a worktree inside a repository: a checkout nested in
229	another checkout makes every indexer, file watcher and `rg` run see a second
230	copy of the tree.
231	
232	### Provisioning
233	
234	A worktree is a clean checkout — no `node_modules`, no `.venv`, no `.env`.
235	Without provisioning, every new one starts broken. `dev` copies the gitignored
236	files you list, optionally symlinks heavy directories, and runs a setup
237	command detected from the lockfiles:
238	
239	```toml
240	[worktree]
241	include     = [".env", ".env.local"]   # only files that are ALSO gitignored
242	link        = []                       # opt-in; sharing node_modules is risky
243	post_create = "auto"                   # uv.lock → uv sync, package-lock.json → npm ci, …
244	```
245	
246	**Copy or reinstall?** Reinstalling is always correct but can take minutes;
247	copying is fast but only sound for dependency trees carrying no absolute paths.
248	That is a per-ecosystem fact, not a preference, so dev knows it:
249	
250	```toml
251	[worktree]
252	strategy = "reinstall"      # reinstall | copy | link | skip
253	
254	[worktree.strategies]
255	node = "copy"               # node_modules copies soundly
256	```
257	
258	Asking to copy a virtualenv is refused with the reason — it bakes its own
259	absolute path into `pyvenv.cfg` and `bin/activate` — and narrowed back to
260	reinstalling rather than silently producing a broken checkout.
261	
262	`dev wt plan` shows exactly what a new worktree of a repository would get:
263	which project types were detected, which tools are missing, and every file and
264	command involved. `dev wt plan --write` seeds a `<repo>/.dev.toml` from it, so
265	a project can commit its own setup and every machine provisions the same way.
266	
267	```
268	$ dev wt plan
269	PROJECT  MANAGER  FROM               DEPENDENCIES  TOOL
270	node     npm      package-lock.json  node_modules  installed
271	python   uv       uv.lock            .venv         installed
272	
273	   ACTION    WHAT          WHY
274	✓  copy      .env          gitignored, so the checkout would not have it
275	✓  copy-dir  node_modules  npm dependencies, copied instead of reinstalling
276	✓  run       uv sync       uv.lock detected
277	```
278	
279	## Other things it does
280	
281	```bash
282	dev repo list                  # every repo under the scan roots, with status
283	dev repo clone owner/name -c Web   # clone into the right place, via gh or glab
284	dev repo sync --all            # fetch + prune, and report what moved
285	
286	dev try redis-streams          # dated scratch directory for an experiment
287	dev graduate redis-streams -c Infra --remote   # promote it into a real project
288	
289	dev gitignore                  # .gitignore from GitHub's templates + the rest
```

```markdown
# `dev try` TUI、asset metadata 與安全回收

## Context

目前 `dev try`（`internal/cli/try.go`）只掃描 `paths.tries_root` 的第一層目錄，以 directory mtime 排序，並把 create/clone/open/render 全放在 Cobra handler；`dev graduate`（`internal/cli/graduate.go`）也自行處理 resolve、move、Git 初始化與 remote。這足以快速開實驗，卻無法可靠回答「最近用過什麼、哪些值得保留、哪些可安全釋放空間」，也沒有能在 local directory 被移除後繼續存在的索引。

目標是把 TRY 作為主 TUI 的第四個 view，同時保留 `dev try <name>` 的低摩擦與可腳本化 CLI。資料與安全規則放在共用 domain service，不放進 Bubble Tea；普通 repository 與 Try 共用 tags／notes／穩定 ID，但只有真正的 Try entry 具有 Try lifecycle。容量預設代表刪除該 local checkout 真正擁有、可回收的 logical bytes，而不是含糊地選擇是否「扣掉 `.git`」。

採用以下產品語意：

- `active`／`deprecated`／`graduated` 是人為 lifecycle phase。
- `present`／`archived`／`evicted` 是每台機器的 local disposition；archive 不等於刪除，evict 不等於 deprecated。
- `important`、`keep`、`experiment` 等 tags 可組合；普通 repo 的 `experiment` tag 只分類，不會建立 Try lifecycle。
- Git tries 預設只顯示於 TRY，避免與 REPOS 重複；可用 `--include-tries`／TUI「顯示全部」查看。Graduated entry 保留歷史與 ID，並改在 REPOS 顯示。
- Archive 是 `TriesRoot` 內同 filesystem 的可逆隱藏搬移；evict 才釋放空間。Remote create/push 永遠需要明示，且「有 remote」不等於「資料可恢復」。

## 1. 建立共享 asset catalog 與安全 path primitives

新增 `internal/catalog`，不要擴充 `task.Task`：Try 可以是 non-Git，也沒有 branch/task/runtime，而 `task.State` 的 hot/warm/cold/done 是另一種生命週期。

- `Entry` 以隨機穩定 ID（檔名）保存 `schema_version`、kind (`try|repository`)、name/note/tags、可選的 `Experiment` metadata、timestamps、per-host `Location`、已驗證的 `RecoveryReceipt` 與短暫 `MoveIntent`。
- `Experiment` 保存 phase、slug/origin、deprecated/graduated timestamps 與 from/to；`Location` 保存 host、disposition、目前/還原 path 與 changed time。
- Store 位於 `Config.AssetsDir()`（`<state_dir>/assets/<id>.toml`），沿用 `task.Store` 的一筆一檔、temp+close+chmod+rename 原子更新與壞檔隔離模式；diagnostics 由 API 回傳或注入 logger，不直接寫 `os.Stderr`。
- Registry 提供 `List/Get/Update/FindByPath/EnsureRepository/Attach/Patch`。普通 repo 只在第一次 mark/note/track 時建立 entry，不為所有 scan roots 預先落盤。
- Match 先用 host + canonical path／Git common-dir；remote identity 只作 relocate 提示，遇到同 remote 多 clone 時不得自動合併。
- Locations 按 `config.Hostname()` 分開，讓 syncable state 不會把「A 機已 evict」誤當成所有機器都沒有 checkout。
- Live Git status、runtime、size 不寫入 catalog；recovery receipt 只記錄某次 backup 驗證的 remote、HEAD/ref digest 與時間，apply 前仍須重驗。

新增 `internal/pathx` 給 graduate/archive/reclaim 共用：以 `filepath.Abs/Clean/Rel` 與可解析部分的 `EvalSymlinks` 做 separator-aware containment，拒絕 root 本身、`..`、symlink escape 與 `/tries/foo` 對 `/tries/foobar` 的 prefix 誤判；category/name 僅允許單一 path component。

## 2. 抽出 `internal/experiment`，讓舊 CLI 與 TUI 共用

把 `internal/cli/try.go`、`internal/cli/graduate.go` 的 policy 移入 `experiment.Service`；Cobra 只解析 flags、呼叫 service、render 結果。核心 API 包含：

- `Reconcile/List/Resolve/ResolveOrCreate/Touch`
- `Deprecate/Reactivate/Archive/Restore/Graduate`
- request/result types 明確描述 dry-run plan、move、catalog transition 與需要重新載入的 inventory。

Reconcile/backfill 規則：

1. 掃描 `TriesRoot` 第一層並跳過隱藏目錄（含 `.dev`）；首次看到既有目錄時配置 ID，不搬、不改名、不寫 repo sidecar。
2. 日期前綴只用來回填 `CreatedAt`；不再把 directory mtime 當 last-used。Open 成功後 `Touch`，列表 activity 取 `max(LastOpenedAt, last Git commit)`，都未知就顯示 unknown。
3. Resolve 順序為 exact ID、完整 basename、去日期後完整名稱、唯一 substring；多個 substring 必須回 ambiguity，不再靜默挑最新。
4. Clone 預設採 `owner-repo` slug；同日碰撞以 `-2/-3` versioning，不覆寫也不誤開另一個 Try。
5. 外部手動搬移且無唯一身份時，以 `dev tries attach <id> <path>` 明確重新連結。

Lifecycle filesystem 行為：

- `deprecate/reactivate` 只改 phase，不搬檔。
- `archive` 搬到 `<tries_root>/.dev/archive/<id>/<basename>`，記住 restore path；`restore` 拒絕覆蓋已存在目的地。
- `graduate` 保留 ID/tags/note/Experiment history，將 kind 改為 repository、更新 location；normal directory 用 `os.Rename`，linked worktree 新增並使用 `gitx.MoveWorktree`（`git worktree move`）。MVP 對跨 filesystem move 明確拒絕。
- Non-Git Try 的 Git init/initial commit 在搬移前完成，失敗時仍留在原處；remote create/push 在本機 graduation 成功後才做，失敗不謊稱 remote 成功，也不回滾已完成的本機 graduation。
- Archive/graduate 先寫 `MoveIntent`、執行 move、再 finalize；`Reconcile` 根據 from/to 實際存在性修復中斷狀態。Catalog finalize 失敗時嘗試搬回並回報。
- Evicted tombstone 保留最後 path、phase、tags、remote/recovery receipt 與時間；首版不自動 GC/forget catalog history。

## 3. 保持 CLI 相容並加入管理入口

保留既有語法與行為：

- `dev try [name] [--clone URL] [--no-git]`、`dev try --list`
- `dev graduate [try]` 與現有 flags

新增 sibling `dev tries` group，避免把今天合法的 `dev try archive` 從「開啟名為 archive 的 Try」變成 subcommand：

- `list [query] [--all] [--json] [--sizes]`
- `open/touch/attach/mark`
- `deprecate/reactivate/archive/restore`
- `graduate`（與 top-level `dev graduate` 共用同一 service）
- `backup --remote <name> [--push] [--create --private]`
- `evict <ref...> [--apply]` 與明確 data-loss acknowledgements

Repository 共用 metadata：

- 在現有 `dev repo` group 加 `mark <repo> --add/--remove/--note`。
- `repo list` 加 `--include-tries`、`--json`、`--sizes`，透過 catalog join 顯示 tags/mark；不改 `repo.Discover` 的通用掃描與 common-dir 去重。
- 新增 `dev reclaim` 作跨 Try/repo 的 read-only 候選報告（age/tag/size/kind filters）；只有 `--apply` 才執行，且共用 `reclaim.Service`。
- `important` 置頂並加強 destructive warning；`keep` 排除預設 reclaim 候選且需 `--override-keep`；`task.Task.Tags` 維持 task/change-stream metadata，不自動同步。
- JSON 使用可向後擴充的 nested `asset`、`size`、`reclaim` objects；未知 size 用 `null`，不以 `0` 冒充。

## 4. 實作一致的容量模型

新增 `internal/diskusage`；在 `gitx.Repo` 的同一次 `rev-parse` 補取 checkout-specific `GitDir`，搭配既有 `GitCommonDir/Key/MainRoot/IsLinkedWorktree` 判斷 ownership。

`Usage` 至少包含：

- `checkout_bytes`：checkout root 內 logical `Lstat.Size()`，跳過 root `.git` entry；不 follow symlink，symlink 只算自身，sparse file 以 logical length 計。
- `private_git_bytes`：只屬於此 checkout、刪除此 checkout 可回收的 Git admin data。
- `shared_git_bytes`：shared common-dir 的非重疊 logical bytes，只供 detail/context，不歸到每個 worktree。
- `owned_bytes = checkout + private_git`：TRY/REPOS `SIZE` 欄的預設值。
- `total_bytes`：僅在 standalone ownership 完整、沒有 shared ambiguity 時提供。
- `complete/unreadable_entries/measured_at/cached`；partial 顯示為 `≥N`，不可包裝成精確值。

Ownership 規則：standalone clone 且 common-dir 位於目標內時，`.git` 算 private；linked worktree 只算自己的 checkout 與可唯一歸屬的 gitdir，common objects/refs 算 shared；main checkout 仍有 linked worktrees或 external git-dir 時，common-dir 不算其 reclaimable bytes。各欄位不得重複計數。

效能與快取：

- Portable Go walker、context cancellation、最多 2 個背景 scanner；列表/TUI startup 不同步遞迴所有 repo。
- `$XDG_CACHE_HOME/dev/sizes-v1.json` 使用 versioned key（canonical checkout/git/common dirs）與原子 `0600` 寫入，TTL 10 分鐘；nested 變更主要依 TTL，不假裝 root mtime 能完整 invalidation。
- Create/clone/archive/restore/graduate/evict、外部 TUI tool 返回後精準 invalidate；`r` 強制重測當前 local view。
- TUI 先套 fresh cache，再以 `loadID + sizeMsg` 流式逐列更新；切 view/reload 時 cancel 舊 batch，晚到訊息因 load ID 不符而忽略。每個 `sizeMsg` 後排下一個 channel receive command，避免阻塞 Tea loop。

## 5. 安全 backup／reclaim／evict

新增 `internal/reclaim`，將 inspect/plan、backup、evict、restore 與 finding codes 放在 domain；CLI/TUI 只呈現 plan 並收集明確意圖。`Apply` 必須在真正 move/remove 前重新 inspect，不能信任幾秒前的畫面。

Git preflight 除了重用 `gitx.StatusOf/Discover/Worktrees`，新增 `gitx.RecoverySnapshot` 檢查：

- staged/unstaged/untracked/conflicted 與 merge/rebase/cherry-pick/bisect 等進行中狀態；
- ignored files（尤其 `.env`、dependencies/build artifacts）及 unreadable content；
- local heads/tags/notes、stash，以及指定 remote 的實際 refs/OIDs；
- linked/locked/prunable worktrees、shared common-dir ownership；
- submodule、nested Git repo、Git LFS；首版無法完整證明時直接阻擋 safe eviction；
- catalog `keep`、未完成 task、live runtime、目前 cwd 位於 target、alias/symlink containment。

操作語意：

- `backup --push` 明確推送選定 heads/tags/notes，再以 `ls-remote` 驗證並寫 receipt；stash 不自動藏到特殊 ref。`forge.CreateRepo(...Push:true)` 不能單獨當完整 backup proof。
- Standalone Git 只有在 worktree clean、ignored 已處理、所有受保護 refs 已由指定 remote 驗證且無 blocker 時可 safe-evict。
- Linked worktree 若 clean 且 branch/commit 仍由可用 shared common-dir 保留，使用 `git worktree remove`；永不刪 branch/common-dir。Main clone 仍有 linked worktree 時阻擋整個 clone eviction。
- Non-Git 預設只能 archive；要永久丟棄須明示 `--discard-without-backup`。Dirty/untracked/ignored/keep 各自使用名稱精確的 `--discard-dirty`、`--discard-ignored`、`--override-keep`，不提供含糊 `--force`，`--yes` 也不能代替 data-loss flags。
- 普通 directory eviction 先寫 intent、rename 至同 parent staging name、再 remove；這提供可 reconcile 的 metadata，不宣稱未備份資料在中途刪除後可復原。Safe eviction 已有 remote receipt；unsafe discard 明確顯示不可恢復。
- 批次操作預設 report-only；apply 前顯示每筆 canonical path、owned bytes、recovery source、blockers/warnings，要求完全大寫 `YES`。只有命令列明確列出 refs 時 `--yes` 可略過互動，廣泛 filter 不可靜默批次刪除。

首版刻意不做：跨 filesystem copy-verify-delete、non-Git/dirty 自動 tar/object-store backup、LFS/submodule/nested-repo 完整備份、allocated blocks/APFS clone/hardlink dedup、daemon/watch/automatic GC、remote repo deletion或 forge archive。

## 6. 整合主 TUI，而不是建立第二套 TUI

在既有 `internal/tui` model 增加 `ViewTries`，順序為 `TASKS | REPOS | TRY | REMOTE`；保留 header/filter/window/footer、runtime handoff、external tools 與 lazy REMOTE。Try-specific row/render/update 拆到獨立檔案，避免繼續膨脹 `model.go`/`view.go`。

- `TryRow` 帶 catalog summary + live experiment/Git/runtime/size facts；Model 增加 `tries`, `tryCursor`, per-view visibility/sort state，並讓 `currentDir()` 只對 present Try 回傳路徑。
- 將新增 callbacks 分組為 `TryActions`、`SizeActions`、`ReclaimActions` 嵌入 `Actions`，不要再加一長串平坦欄位；`internal/cli/tui.go` 注入同一批 experiment/catalog/reclaim services。
- 使用 `triesMsg/reposMsg/sizeMsg/tryActionMsg` 做 targeted refresh。Graduate/archive/restore/evict 更新 TRY + REPOS + local remote matching，但絕不因此重新查 gh/glab。
- TRY table 顯示 mark/name、phase·where、Git、last activity、`SIZE=owned_bytes`；detail 分列 checkout/private/shared Git、tags/note、origin/recovery 與 reclaim findings。REPOS 加 mark/size，窄畫面優先隱藏較次要 WT/task tally，不隱藏名稱/Git/size。
- 預設排序：important/keep、activity、name；提供 activity/size/name 切換。Reclaim overlay 固定按 eligible owned bytes 由大到小。
- 擴充 filter 為一般 AND terms 加 `tag:`、`phase:`、`where:`、`reclaimable:`、`size:>…`；`a` 採 view-specific「顯示全部」（TASKS=done、REPOS=tries、TRY=archived/deprecated/graduated/evicted）。
- 新增可重用 full-screen overlay/form state，沿用 stats overlay 的模式；create/graduate/backup/action palette 與 reclaim multi-select/review/exact-YES 不再塞進現有單一 `textinput` mode switch。
- 實作已被 reserved/docs 宣告但目前缺少的 `?` help overlay，集中顯示 context keys；這是新 view 可發現性的一部分。現有 cold-task Enter 文案落差與 taskflow callback 重構留在獨立工作，不混入本功能。
- REMOTE local matching 同時考慮 repository 與 Try，標示 `LocalKind`；即使 Git Try 預設不在 REPOS，也不能被 REMOTE 誤顯示成未 clone。

## 7. 實作順序

1. **Catalog/path 基礎**：`Config.AssetsDir`、schema/store/registry、canonical containment、multihost locations、tests；`App.Load` 初始化 catalog。
2. **Experiment vertical slice**：backfill/resolve/create/open/touch，讓既有 `dev try` 成為薄 adapter，所有舊語法與測試先保持通過。
3. **Lifecycle + graduate**：deprecate/archive/restore、move journal、`gitx.MoveWorktree`、graduate service；top-level `dev graduate` 與新 `dev tries graduate` 共用。
4. **Management/annotations**：`dev tries` group、`repo mark`、catalog inventory join、REPOS suppression/REMOTE LocalKind、JSON contracts。
5. **基本 TRY TUI**：第四 view、open/create/mark/deprecate/archive/graduate、help/form overlays與 targeted reload，先交付可用的互動流程。
6. **Disk usage**：Git ownership、scanner/cache/CLI flags，再接入 TRY/REPOS streaming size、filter/sort/detail。
7. **Reclaim**：RecoverySnapshot、backup receipts、report-first CLI、safe evict/restore與 explicit discard；最後接入 TUI multi-select review/apply。
8. **文件/e2e**：README、`internal/help/topics/tui.md`、bundled skill/command reference、reserved keys、`scripts/e2e.sh`。

目前 Go 基線已包含 direct tasks、rich Git status、heatmap與 config reload（HEAD `90276d5`）；直接建立其上，不重做已解決的 config wiring，也不回退那些型別。現有 `.specstory` 修改/未追蹤檔不屬於本功能，實作時不得覆寫或混入功能變更。

## Verification

逐 slice 驗證，最後做完整 end-to-end：

- `go test -race ./internal/diskusage ./internal/tui`，再執行 `go test ./...` 與 `go vet ./...`。
- 擴充 `scripts/e2e.sh`，只用隔離 HOME + local bare remote：建立 Git/non-Git tries、touch/list、archive/restore、graduate、push+verify+evict+clone restore，並確認 dirty/ignored/unpushed/default non-Git deletion 都被拒絕；不碰真實 forge。

## Approved Plan:
# `dev try` TUI、asset metadata 與安全回收

## Context

目前 `dev try`（`internal/cli/try.go`）只掃描 `paths.tries_root` 的第一層目錄，以 directory mtime 排序，並把 create/clone/open/render 全放在 Cobra handler；`dev graduate`（`internal/cli/graduate.go`）也自行處理 resolve、move、Git 初始化與 remote。這足以快速開實驗，卻無法可靠回答「最近用過什麼、哪些值得保留、哪些可安全釋放空間」，也沒有能在 local directory 被移除後繼續存在的索引。

目標是把 TRY 作為主 TUI 的第四個 view，同時保留 `dev try <name>` 的低摩擦與可腳本化 CLI。資料與安全規則放在共用 domain service，不放進 Bubble Tea；普通 repository 與 Try 共用 tags／notes／穩定 ID，但只有真正的 Try entry 具有 Try lifecycle。容量預設代表刪除該 local checkout 真正擁有、可回收的 logical bytes，而不是含糊地選擇是否「扣掉 `.git`」。

採用以下產品語意：

- `active`／`deprecated`／`graduated` 是人為 lifecycle phase。
- `present`／`archived`／`evicted` 是每台機器的 local disposition；archive 不等於刪除，evict 不等於 deprecated。
- `important`、`keep`、`experiment` 等 tags 可組合；普通 repo 的 `experiment` tag 只分類，不會建立 Try lifecycle。
- Git tries 預設只顯示於 TRY，避免與 REPOS 重複；可用 `--include-tries`／TUI「顯示全部」查看。Graduated entry 保留歷史與 ID，並改在 REPOS 顯示。
- Archive 是 `TriesRoot` 內同 filesystem 的可逆隱藏搬移；evict 才釋放空間。Remote create/push 永遠需要明示，且「有 remote」不等於「資料可恢復」。

## 1. 建立共享 asset catalog 與安全 path primitives

新增 `internal/catalog`，不要擴充 `task.Task`：Try 可以是 non-Git，也沒有 branch/task/runtime，而 `task.State` 的 hot/warm/cold/done 是另一種生命週期。

- `Entry` 以隨機穩定 ID（檔名）保存 `schema_version`、kind (`try|repository`)、name/note/tags、可選的 `Experiment` metadata、timestamps、per-host `Location`、已驗證的 `RecoveryReceipt` 與短暫 `MoveIntent`。
- `Experiment` 保存 phase、slug/origin、deprecated/graduated timestamps 與 from/to；`Location` 保存 host、disposition、目前/還原 path 與 changed time。
- Store 位於 `Config.AssetsDir()`（`<state_dir>/assets/<id>.toml`），沿用 `task.Store` 的一筆一檔、temp+close+chmod+rename 原子更新與壞檔隔離模式；diagnostics 由 API 回傳或注入 logger，不直接寫 `os.Stderr`。
- Registry 提供 `List/Get/Update/FindByPath/EnsureRepository/Attach/Patch`。普通 repo 只在第一次 mark/note/track 時建立 entry，不為所有 scan roots 預先落盤。
- Match 先用 host + canonical path／Git common-dir；remote identity 只作 relocate 提示，遇到同 remote 多 clone 時不得自動合併。
- Locations 按 `config.Hostname()` 分開，讓 syncable state 不會把「A 機已 evict」誤當成所有機器都沒有 checkout。
- Live Git status、runtime、size 不寫入 catalog；recovery receipt 只記錄某次 backup 驗證的 remote、HEAD/ref digest 與時間，apply 前仍須重驗。

新增 `internal/pathx` 給 graduate/archive/reclaim 共用：以 `filepath.Abs/Clean/Rel` 與可解析部分的 `EvalSymlinks` 做 separator-aware containment，拒絕 root 本身、`..`、symlink escape 與 `/tries/foo` 對 `/tries/foobar` 的 prefix 誤判；category/name 僅允許單一 path component。

## 2. 抽出 `internal/experiment`，讓舊 CLI 與 TUI 共用

把 `internal/cli/try.go`、`internal/cli/graduate.go` 的 policy 移入 `experiment.Service`；Cobra 只解析 flags、呼叫 service、render 結果。核心 API 包含：

- `Reconcile/List/Resolve/ResolveOrCreate/Touch`
- `Deprecate/Reactivate/Archive/Restore/Graduate`
- request/result types 明確描述 dry-run plan、move、catalog transition 與需要重新載入的 inventory。

Reconcile/backfill 規則：

1. 掃描 `TriesRoot` 第一層並跳過隱藏目錄（含 `.dev`）；首次看到既有目錄時配置 ID，不搬、不改名、不寫 repo sidecar。
2. 日期前綴只用來回填 `CreatedAt`；不再把 directory mtime 當 last-used。Open 成功後 `Touch`，列表 activity 取 `max(LastOpenedAt, last Git commit)`，都未知就顯示 unknown。
3. Resolve 順序為 exact ID、完整 basename、去日期後完整名稱、唯一 substring；多個 substring 必須回 ambiguity，不再靜默挑最新。
4. Clone 預設採 `owner-repo` slug；同日碰撞以 `-2/-3` versioning，不覆寫也不誤開另一個 Try。
5. 外部手動搬移且無唯一身份時，以 `dev tries attach <id> <path>` 明確重新連結。

Lifecycle filesystem 行為：

- `deprecate/reactivate` 只改 phase，不搬檔。
- `archive` 搬到 `<tries_root>/.dev/archive/<id>/<basename>`，記住 restore path；`restore` 拒絕覆蓋已存在目的地。
- `graduate` 保留 ID/tags/note/Experiment history，將 kind 改為 repository、更新 location；normal directory 用 `os.Rename`，linked worktree 新增並使用 `gitx.MoveWorktree`（`git worktree move`）。MVP 對跨 filesystem move 明確拒絕。
- Non-Git Try 的 Git init/initial commit 在搬移前完成，失敗時仍留在原處；remote create/push 在本機 graduation 成功後才做，失敗不謊稱 remote 成功，也不回滾已完成的本機 graduation。
- Archive/graduate 先寫 `MoveIntent`、執行 move、再 finalize；`Reconcile` 根據 from/to 實際存在性修復中斷狀態。Catalog finalize 失敗時嘗試搬回並回報。
- Evicted tombstone 保留最後 path、phase、tags、remote/recovery receipt 與時間；首版不自動 GC/forget catalog history。

## 3. 保持 CLI 相容並加入管理入口

保留既有語法與行為：

- `dev try [name] [--clone URL] [--no-git]`、`dev try --list`
- `dev graduate [try]` 與現有 flags

新增 sibling `dev tries` group，避免把今天合法的 `dev try archive` 從「開啟名為 archive 的 Try」變成 subcommand：

- `list [query] [--all] [--json] [--sizes]`
- `open/touch/attach/mark`
- `deprecate/reactivate/archive/restore`
- `graduate`（與 top-level `dev graduate` 共用同一 service）
- `backup --remote <name> [--push] [--create --private]`
- `evict <ref...> [--apply]` 與明確 data-loss acknowledgements

Repository 共用 metadata：

- 在現有 `dev repo` group 加 `mark <repo> --add/--remove/--note`。
- `repo list` 加 `--include-tries`、`--json`、`--sizes`，透過 catalog join 顯示 tags/mark；不改 `repo.Discover` 的通用掃描與 common-dir 去重。
- 新增 `dev reclaim` 作跨 Try/repo 的 read-only 候選報告（age/tag/size/kind filters）；只有 `--apply` 才執行，且共用 `reclaim.Service`。
- `important` 置頂並加強 destructive warning；`keep` 排除預設 reclaim 候選且需 `--override-keep`；`task.Task.Tags` 維持 task/change-stream metadata，不自動同步。
- JSON 使用可向後擴充的 nested `asset`、`size`、`reclaim` objects；未知 size 用 `null`，不以 `0` 冒充。

## 4. 實作一致的容量模型

新增 `internal/diskusage`；在 `gitx.Repo` 的同一次 `rev-parse` 補取 checkout-specific `GitDir`，搭配既有 `GitCommonDir/Key/MainRoot/IsLinkedWorktree` 判斷 ownership。

`Usage` 至少包含：

- `checkout_bytes`：checkout root 內 logical `Lstat.Size()`，跳過 root `.git` entry；不 follow symlink，symlink 只算自身，sparse file 以 logical length 計。
- `private_git_bytes`：只屬於此 checkout、刪除此 checkout 可回收的 Git admin data。
- `shared_git_bytes`：shared common-dir 的非重疊 logical bytes，只供 detail/context，不歸到每個 worktree。
- `owned_bytes = checkout + private_git`：TRY/REPOS `SIZE` 欄的預設值。
- `total_bytes`：僅在 standalone ownership 完整、沒有 shared ambiguity 時提供。
- `complete/unreadable_entries/measured_at/cached`；partial 顯示為 `≥N`，不可包裝成精確值。

Ownership 規則：standalone clone 且 common-dir 位於目標內時，`.git` 算 private；linked worktree 只算自己的 checkout 與可唯一歸屬的 gitdir，common objects/refs 算 shared；main checkout 仍有 linked worktrees或 external git-dir 時，common-dir 不算其 reclaimable bytes。各欄位不得重複計數。

效能與快取：

- Portable Go walker、context cancellation、最多 2 個背景 scanner；列表/TUI startup 不同步遞迴所有 repo。
- `$XDG_CACHE_HOME/dev/sizes-v1.json` 使用 versioned key（canonical checkout/git/common dirs）與原子 `0600` 寫入，TTL 10 分鐘；nested 變更主要依 TTL，不假裝 root mtime 能完整 invalidation。
- Create/clone/archive/restore/graduate/evict、外部 TUI tool 返回後精準 invalidate；`r` 強制重測當前 local view。
- TUI 先套 fresh cache，再以 `loadID + sizeMsg` 流式逐列更新；切 view/reload 時 cancel 舊 batch，晚到訊息因 load ID 不符而忽略。每個 `sizeMsg` 後排下一個 channel receive command，避免阻塞 Tea loop。

## 5. 安全 backup／reclaim／evict

新增 `internal/reclaim`，將 inspect/plan、backup、evict、restore 與 finding codes 放在 domain；CLI/TUI 只呈現 plan 並收集明確意圖。`Apply` 必須在真正 move/remove 前重新 inspect，不能信任幾秒前的畫面。

Git preflight 除了重用 `gitx.StatusOf/Discover/Worktrees`，新增 `gitx.RecoverySnapshot` 檢查：

- staged/unstaged/untracked/conflicted 與 merge/rebase/cherry-pick/bisect 等進行中狀態；
- ignored files（尤其 `.env`、dependencies/build artifacts）及 unreadable content；
- local heads/tags/notes、stash，以及指定 remote 的實際 refs/OIDs；
- linked/locked/prunable worktrees、shared common-dir ownership；
- submodule、nested Git repo、Git LFS；首版無法完整證明時直接阻擋 safe eviction；
- catalog `keep`、未完成 task、live runtime、目前 cwd 位於 target、alias/symlink containment。

操作語意：

- `backup --push` 明確推送選定 heads/tags/notes，再以 `ls-remote` 驗證並寫 receipt；stash 不自動藏到特殊 ref。`forge.CreateRepo(...Push:true)` 不能單獨當完整 backup proof。
- Standalone Git 只有在 worktree clean、ignored 已處理、所有受保護 refs 已由指定 remote 驗證且無 blocker 時可 safe-evict。
- Linked worktree 若 clean 且 branch/commit 仍由可用 shared common-dir 保留，使用 `git worktree remove`；永不刪 branch/common-dir。Main clone 仍有 linked worktree 時阻擋整個 clone eviction。
- Non-Git 預設只能 archive；要永久丟棄須明示 `--discard-without-backup`。Dirty/untracked/ignored/keep 各自使用名稱精確的 `--discard-dirty`、`--discard-ignored`、`--override-keep`，不提供含糊 `--force`，`--yes` 也不能代替 data-loss flags。
- 普通 directory eviction 先寫 intent、rename 至同 parent staging name、再 remove；這提供可 reconcile 的 metadata，不宣稱未備份資料在中途刪除後可復原。Safe eviction 已有 remote receipt；unsafe discard 明確顯示不可恢復。
- 批次操作預設 report-only；apply 前顯示每筆 canonical path、owned bytes、recovery source、blockers/warnings，要求完全大寫 `YES`。只有命令列明確列出 refs 時 `--yes` 可略過互動，廣泛 filter 不可靜默批次刪除。

首版刻意不做：跨 filesystem copy-verify-delete、non-Git/dirty 自動 tar/object-store backup、LFS/submodule/nested-repo 完整備份、allocated blocks/APFS clone/hardlink dedup、daemon/watch/automatic GC、remote repo deletion或 forge archive。

在既有 `internal/tui` model 增加 `ViewTries`，順序為 `TASKS | REPOS | TRY | REMOTE`；保留 header/filter/window/footer、runtime handoff、external tools 與 lazy REMOTE。Try-specific row/render/update 拆到獨立檔案，避免繼續膨脹 `model.go`/`view.go`。

- `TryRow` 帶 catalog summary + live experiment/Git/runtime/size facts；Model 增加 `tries`, `tryCursor`, per-view visibility/sort state，並讓 `currentDir()` 只對 present Try 回傳路徑。

- 使用 `triesMsg/reposMsg/sizeMsg/tryActionMsg` 做 targeted refresh。Graduate/archive/restore/evict 更新 TRY + REPOS + local remote matching，但絕不因此重新查 gh/glab。
- TRY table 顯示 mark/name、phase·where、Git、last activity、`SIZE=owned_bytes`；detail 分列 checkout/private/shared Git、tags/note、origin/recovery 與 reclaim findings。REPOS 加 mark/size，窄畫面優先隱藏較次要 WT/task tally，不隱藏名稱/Git/size。

1	package task

3	import (
4		"errors"

8		"path/filepath"

16	
17	// ErrNotFound is returned when no task matches an identifier.
18	var ErrNotFound = errors.New("no such task")
19	
20	// Store is a directory of one-TOML-file-per-task.
21	//
22	// One file per task, rather than a single registry document, is a deliberate
23	// choice: the state directory is meant to be syncable across machines (it can
24	// simply be a git repo), and a shared central file would conflict on every
25	// parallel edit while separate files merge cleanly.
26	type Store struct{ Dir string }
27	
28	// NewStore returns a store rooted at dir.
29	func NewStore(dir string) *Store { return &Store{Dir: dir} }
30	
31	var idUnsafe = regexp.MustCompile(`[^a-zA-Z0-9._-]+`)
32	
33	// MakeID derives the stable filename stem for a repo+branch pair.
34	func MakeID(repo, branch string) string {
35		clean := func(s string) string {
36			s = idUnsafe.ReplaceAllString(s, "-")
37			for strings.Contains(s, "--") {
38				s = strings.ReplaceAll(s, "--", "-")
39			}
40			return strings.Trim(s, "-._")
41		}
42		r, b := clean(repo), clean(branch)
43		if r == "" {
44			r = "repo"
45		}
46		if b == "" {
47			b = "branch"
48		}
49		return r + "__" + b
50	}
51	
52	func (s *Store) path(id string) string { return filepath.Join(s.Dir, id+".toml") }
53	
54	// Save writes a task, stamping Updated (and Created on first write).
55	func (s *Store) Save(t *Task) error {
56		if t.ID == "" {
57			t.ID = MakeID(t.Repo, t.Branch)
58		}
59		if err := t.Validate(); err != nil {
60			return err
61		}
62		now := time.Now().UTC().Truncate(time.Second)
63		if t.Created.IsZero() {
64			t.Created = now
65		}
66		t.Updated = now
67	
68		if err := os.MkdirAll(s.Dir, 0o755); err != nil {
69			return fmt.Errorf("create state dir: %w", err)
70		}
71		// Write to a temp file and rename, so an interrupted write can never leave
72		// a half-parsed task behind.
73		tmp, err := os.CreateTemp(s.Dir, "."+t.ID+".*.tmp")
74		if err != nil {
75			return err
76		}
77		defer os.Remove(tmp.Name())
78		enc := toml.NewEncoder(tmp)
79		if err := enc.Encode(t); err != nil {
80			tmp.Close()
81			return fmt.Errorf("encode task %s: %w", t.ID, err)
82		}
83		if err := tmp.Close(); err != nil {
84			return err
85		}
86		if err := os.Chmod(tmp.Name(), 0o644); err != nil {
87			return err
88		}
89		return os.Rename(tmp.Name(), s.path(t.ID))
90	}
91	
92	// Get loads one task by its exact id.
93	func (s *Store) Get(id string) (*Task, error) {
94		var t Task
95		if _, err := toml.DecodeFile(s.path(id), &t); err != nil {
96			if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
97				return nil, fmt.Errorf("%q: %w", id, ErrNotFound)
98			}
99			return nil, fmt.Errorf("read task %s: %w", id, err)
100		}
101		t.ID = id
102		return &t, nil
103	}
104	
105	// List loads every task, sorted by state (hot first) then most recent.
106	func (s *Store) List() ([]*Task, error) {
107		entries, err := os.ReadDir(s.Dir)
108		if err != nil {
109			if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
110				return nil, nil // no state yet is a normal, empty inventory
111			}
112			return nil, err
113		}
114		var out []*Task
115		for _, e := range entries {
116			name := e.Name()
117			if e.IsDir() || !strings.HasSuffix(name, ".toml") || strings.HasPrefix(name, ".") {
118				continue
119			}
120			id := strings.TrimSuffix(name, ".toml")
121			t, err := s.Get(id)
122			if err != nil {
123				// One corrupt file must not hide the rest of the inventory.
124				fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "dev: warning: skipping %s: %v\n", name, err)
125				continue
126			}
127			out = append(out, t)
128		}
129		Sort(out)
130		return out, nil
131	}
132	
133	// Delete removes a task entry. It never touches git state.
134	func (s *Store) Delete(id string) error {
135		err := os.Remove(s.path(id))
136		if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
137			return fmt.Errorf("%q: %w", id, ErrNotFound)
138		}
139		return err
140	}
141	
142	// Resolve finds a task from a loose user-supplied reference: an exact id, an
143	// exact branch, or a unique case-insensitive substring of the id, name or
144	// branch. An ambiguous reference is an error listing the candidates rather
145	// than a silent pick.
146	func (s *Store) Resolve(ref string) (*Task, error) {
147		if ref == "" {
148			return nil, fmt.Errorf("empty task reference: %w", ErrNotFound)
149		}
150		all, err := s.List()
151		if err != nil {
152			return nil, err
153		}
154		for _, t := range all {
155			if t.ID == ref || t.Branch == ref {
156				return t, nil
157			}
158		}
159		needle := strings.ToLower(ref)
160		var hits []*Task
161		for _, t := range all {
162			hay := strings.ToLower(t.ID + " " + t.Name + " " + t.Branch + " " + t.Repo)
163			if strings.Contains(hay, needle) {
164				hits = append(hits, t)
165			}
166		}
167		switch len(hits) {
168		case 1:
169			return hits[0], nil
170		case 0:
171			return nil, fmt.Errorf("%q: %w", ref, ErrNotFound)
172		default:
173			names := make([]string, len(hits))
174			for i, t := range hits {
175				names[i] = t.ID
176			}
177			return nil, fmt.Errorf("%q is ambiguous: %s", ref, strings.Join(names, ", "))
178		}
179	}
180	
181	// FindByWorktree returns the task whose checkout contains dir.
182	//
183	// A task lives at exactly one place: its worktree when it has one, otherwise
184	// the main checkout. A task that has a linked worktree therefore does *not*
185	// claim the main checkout — otherwise standing in the main repo would match
186	// every worktree-based task of that repo. Among candidates, the longest path
187	// match wins so a nested checkout beats its parent.
188	func (s *Store) FindByWorktree(dir string) (*Task, error) {
189		all, err := s.List()
190		if err != nil {
191			return nil, err
192		}
193		under := func(dir, root string) bool {
194			return root != "" && (dir == root || strings.HasPrefix(dir, root+string(filepath.Separator)))
195		}
196		var best *Task
197		var bestLen int
198		for _, t := range all {
199			root := t.WorktreePath
200			if root == "" {
201				root = t.RepoPath
202			}
203			if under(dir, root) && len(root) > bestLen {
204				best, bestLen = t, len(root)
205			}
206		}
207		if best == nil {
208			return nil, fmt.Errorf("%q: %w", dir, ErrNotFound)
209		}
210		return best, nil
211	}
212	
213	// stateRank orders states so the inventory reads as an attention queue.
214	func stateRank(s State) int {
215		switch s {
216		case Hot:
217			return 0
218		case Warm:
219			return 1
220		case Cold:
221			return 2
222		case Done:
223			return 3
224		}
225		return 4
226	}
227	
228	// Sort orders tasks hot-first, then by most recently updated.
229	func Sort(ts []*Task) {
230		sort.SliceStable(ts, func(i, j int) bool {
231			ri, rj := stateRank(ts[i].State), stateRank(ts[j].State)
232			if ri != rj {
233				return ri < rj
234			}
235			if !ts[i].Updated.Equal(ts[j].Updated) {
236				return ts[i].Updated.After(ts[j].Updated)
237			}
238			return ts[i].ID < ts[j].ID
239		})
240	}

17		// Hot: worktree and branch exist, a runtime session is open, actively worked on.
18		Hot State = "hot"
19		// Warm: worktree and branch kept, runtime closed. Back within days.
20		Warm State = "warm"
21		// Cold: committed and pushed, worktree removed. Reconstructible anywhere.
22		Cold State = "cold"
23		// Done: merged. Kept only until the entry is reaped.
24		Done State = "done"
25	)
26	
27	// States lists the lifecycle in order, for help text and validation.
28	var States = []State{Hot, Warm, Cold, Done}
29	
30	// ParseState validates a user-supplied state name.
31	func ParseState(s string) (State, error) {
32		got := State(strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(s)))
33		for _, valid := range States {
34			if got == valid {
35				return got, nil
36			}
37		}
38		return "", fmt.Errorf("unknown state %q: want one of %s", s, JoinStates(", "))
39	}
40	
41	// JoinStates renders the valid state names.
42	func JoinStates(sep string) string {
43		parts := make([]string, len(States))
44		for i, s := range States {
45			parts[i] = string(s)
46		}
47		return strings.Join(parts, sep)
48	}
49	
50	// Icon is the glyph shown in the inventory.
51	func (s State) Icon() string {
52		switch s {
53		case Hot:
54			return "🔥"
55		case Warm:
56			return "🌤"
57		case Cold:
58			return "❄️"
59		case Done:
60			return "✅"
61		}
62		return "?"
63	}
64	
65	// Label is the uppercase column form.
66	func (s State) Label() string { return strings.ToUpper(string(s)) }
67	
68	// CheckoutMode is how a task occupies the repository filesystem.
69	type CheckoutMode string
70	
71	const (
72		// ModeWorktree owns a linked worktree and branch.
73		ModeWorktree CheckoutMode = "worktree"
74		// ModeBranch uses a short-lived branch in the canonical checkout.
75		ModeBranch CheckoutMode = "branch"
76		// ModeDirect tracks ad-hoc work on the branch already checked out in the
77		// canonical repo — usually main — without creating a branch or worktree.
78		ModeDirect CheckoutMode = "direct"
79	)
80	
81	// Task is one change stream. Field names are the TOML keys.
82	type Task struct {
83		// ID is derived from repo and branch; it is the filename stem and is not
84		// stored inside the file.
85		ID string `toml:"-"`
86	
87		// Name is the human label ("atp security recovery").
88		Name string `toml:"name"`
89		// Repo is the repository's display name.
90		Repo string `toml:"repo"`
91		// RepoPath is the main checkout, the directory git commands run in.
92		RepoPath string `toml:"repo_path"`
93		// Branch is the change stream's identity — the one durable handle that
94		// survives every machine, worktree and runtime.
95		Branch string `toml:"branch"`
96		// Base is the ref the branch was created from, recorded so `dev done` can
97		// integrate without re-guessing.
98		Base string `toml:"base"`
99		// WorktreePath is the linked checkout, empty when the task works directly
100		// in the main checkout or has gone cold.
101		WorktreePath string `toml:"worktree_path"`
102		// Mode says whether this task uses a worktree, a branch in the canonical
103		// checkout, or the current branch directly. Older entries infer it.
104		Mode CheckoutMode `toml:"mode"`
105	
106		State State `toml:"state"`
107		// Owner is the hostname that last held this task hot. One writer per
108		// branch at a time avoids two machines diverging the same history.
109		Owner string `toml:"owner"`
110		// Next is the single most valuable field in the file: what to do when you
111		// come back. Without it, parking a task still loses the thread.
112		Next string   `toml:"next"`
113		Note string   `toml:"note"`
114		Tags []string `toml:"tags"`
115	
116		// AgentSession records a resumable agent context ("claude:<uuid>"), so a
117		// parked task can be resumed with its conversation intact.
118		AgentSession string `toml:"agent_session"`
119		// RuntimeHandle is the last known runtime session id (e.g. a herdr
120		// workspace id). Advisory only — always re-resolved against the live
121		// runtime before use.
122		RuntimeHandle string `toml:"runtime_handle"`
123	
124		Created time.Time `toml:"created"`
125		Updated time.Time `toml:"updated"`
126	}
127	
128	// EffectiveMode returns the explicit mode, or infers a legacy task. Before
129	// modes were recorded, a path meant worktree and no path meant a canonical
130	// branch task; direct mode is never guessed because it changes integration
131	// semantics and must be explicit.
132	func (t Task) EffectiveMode() CheckoutMode {
133		if t.Mode != "" {
134			return t.Mode
135		}
136		if t.WorktreePath != "" {
137			return ModeWorktree
138		}
139		return ModeBranch
140	}
141	
142	// Title is the display name, falling back to the branch when unnamed.
143	func (t Task) Title() string {
144		if t.Name != "" {
145			return t.Name
146		}
147		return t.Branch
148	}
149	
150	// OwnedBy reports whether host is this task's owner. An empty owner means
151	// unclaimed, which counts as owned by anyone.
152	func (t Task) OwnedBy(host string) bool { return t.Owner == "" || t.Owner == host }
153	
154	// Validate rejects a task that could not be acted on later.
155	func (t Task) Validate() error {
156		switch {
157		case t.Repo == "":
158			return fmt.Errorf("task %s: repo is required", t.ID)
159		case t.Branch == "":
160			return fmt.Errorf("task %s: branch is required", t.ID)
161		case t.RepoPath == "":
162			return fmt.Errorf("task %s: repo_path is required", t.ID)
163		}
164		if _, err := ParseState(string(t.State)); err != nil {
165			return fmt.Errorf("task %s: %w", t.ID, err)
166		}
167		switch t.Mode {
168		case "", ModeWorktree, ModeBranch, ModeDirect:
169		default:
170			return fmt.Errorf("task %s: unknown mode %q", t.ID, t.Mode)
171		}
172		return nil
173	}
174

1	package config
2	
3	import (
4		"fmt"
5		"time"
6	)
7	
8	// PostCreate accepts either of two TOML shapes, because both read naturally:
9	//
10	//	post_create = "auto"
11	//	post_create = ["uv sync", "npm ci"]
12	type PostCreate struct {
13		Auto     bool
14		Commands []string
15	}
16	
17	// UnmarshalTOML implements toml.Unmarshaler.
18	func (p *PostCreate) UnmarshalTOML(v any) error {
19		switch t := v.(type) {
20		case string:
21			if t != "auto" {
22				return fmt.Errorf("post_create: %q is not a valid string form (use \"auto\" or a list of commands)", t)
23			}
24			*p = PostCreate{Auto: true}
25			return nil
26		case []any:
27			cmds := make([]string, 0, len(t))
28			for i, e := range t {
29				s, ok := e.(string)
30				if !ok {
31					return fmt.Errorf("post_create[%d]: want a command string, got %T", i, e)
32				}
33				cmds = append(cmds, s)
34			}
35			*p = PostCreate{Commands: cmds}
36			return nil
37		default:
38			return fmt.Errorf("post_create: want \"auto\" or a list of command strings, got %T", v)
39		}
40	}
41	
42	// MarshalTOML implements toml.Marshaler so a config round-trips.
43	func (p PostCreate) MarshalTOML() ([]byte, error) {
44		if p.Auto {
45			return []byte(`"auto"`), nil
46		}
47		out := []byte("[")
48		for i, c := range p.Commands {
49			if i > 0 {
50				out = append(out, ", "...)
51			}
52			out = append(out, fmt.Sprintf("%q", c)...)
53		}
54		return append(out, ']'), nil
55	}
56	
57	// Duration is a time.Duration written in TOML as a Go duration string
58	// ("10m", "90s"), which is friendlier than a bare number of seconds.
59	type Duration struct{ time.Duration }
60	
61	// UnmarshalTOML implements toml.Unmarshaler.
62	func (d *Duration) UnmarshalTOML(v any) error {
63		switch t := v.(type) {
64		case string:
65			parsed, err := time.ParseDuration(t)
66			if err != nil {
67				return fmt.Errorf("duration %q: %w", t, err)
68			}
69			d.Duration = parsed
70			return nil
71		case int64:
72			d.Duration = time.Duration(t) * time.Second
73			return nil
74		default:
75			return fmt.Errorf("duration: want a string like \"10m\", got %T", v)
76		}
77	}
78	
79	// MarshalTOML implements toml.Marshaler.
80	func (d Duration) MarshalTOML() ([]byte, error) {
81		return []byte(fmt.Sprintf("%q", d.Duration.String())), nil
82	}

1	package config
2	
3	import (
4		"os"
5		"path/filepath"
6		"strings"
7	)
8	
9	// XDG base directories, resolved the way the spec prescribes: honor the
10	// environment variable when it holds an absolute path, otherwise fall back to
11	// the documented default under $HOME.
12	
13	func xdgDir(envVar, fallback string) string {
14		if v := os.Getenv(envVar); filepath.IsAbs(v) {
15			return v
16		}
17		return filepath.Join(home(), fallback)
18	}
19	
20	func home() string {
21		if h, err := os.UserHomeDir(); err == nil && h != "" {
22			return h
23		}
24		return os.Getenv("HOME")
25	}
26	
27	// ConfigHome is $XDG_CONFIG_HOME (default ~/.config).
28	func ConfigHome() string { return xdgDir("XDG_CONFIG_HOME", ".config") }
29	
30	// DataHome is $XDG_DATA_HOME (default ~/.local/share).
31	func DataHome() string { return xdgDir("XDG_DATA_HOME", ".local/share") }
32	
33	// CacheHome is $XDG_CACHE_HOME (default ~/.cache).
34	func CacheHome() string { return xdgDir("XDG_CACHE_HOME", ".cache") }
35	
36	// ConfigFile is the path dev loads its TOML configuration from.
37	func ConfigFile() string { return filepath.Join(ConfigHome(), "dev", "config.toml") }
38	
39	// Expand resolves a leading ~ and any environment variables in p, then makes
40	// the result absolute. Paths in config.toml are written by humans, so both
41	// "~/Worktrees" and "$WORK/trees" have to work.
42	func Expand(p string) string {
43		if p == "" {
44			return ""
45		}
46		p = os.ExpandEnv(p)
47		switch {
48		case p == "~":
49			p = home()
50		case strings.HasPrefix(p, "~/"):
51			p = filepath.Join(home(), p[2:])
52		}
53		if abs, err := filepath.Abs(p); err == nil {
54			return abs
55		}
56		return filepath.Clean(p)
57	}
58	
59	// Contract renders p with $HOME collapsed back to ~, for display only.
60	func Contract(p string) string {
61		h := home()
62		if h != "" && p == h {
63			return "~"
64		}
65		if h != "" && strings.HasPrefix(p, h+string(filepath.Separator)) {
66			return "~" + p[len(h):]
67		}
68		return p
69	}
