package catalog

import (
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"io/fs"
	"net/url"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"sort"
	"strings"
	"sync"

	"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/pathx"
)

var ErrAmbiguous = errors.New("ambiguous catalog match")

// AmbiguousMatchError reports records that cannot be safely distinguished. A
// remote-only ambiguity is never resolved by picking the first entry.
type AmbiguousMatchError struct {
	Observation Observation
	CandidateIDs []string
	Reason       string
}

func (e *AmbiguousMatchError) Error() string {
	reason := e.Reason
	if reason == "" {
		reason = "multiple records match"
	}
	return fmt.Sprintf("%s: %s (%s)", ErrAmbiguous, reason, strings.Join(e.CandidateIDs, ", "))
}

func (e *AmbiguousMatchError) Unwrap() error { return ErrAmbiguous }

// Observation is live repository identity gathered from discovery. Path is the
// navigation path, RealPath its physical target, and either common-dir field may
// carry Git's shared administrative directory. CommonDir matches repo.Repo;
// GitCommonDir is accepted for callers using gitx.Repo terminology.
type Observation struct {
	Host string
	Path string
	RealPath string
	CommonDir string
	GitCommonDir string
	Name string
	RemoteIdentity string
}

// Registry adds live matching and lazy repository persistence to a Store.
type Registry struct {
	store *Store
	mu    sync.Mutex
}

// NewRegistry returns a registry backed by store.
func NewRegistry(store *Store) *Registry { return &Registry{store: store} }

// Store exposes the durable store for callers that need listing APIs.
func (r *Registry) Store() *Store { return r.store }

// Match finds an observation without changing the catalog. Exact canonical path
// or common-directory identity on the same host always wins. A remote identity
// is considered only as a conservative relocation hint.
func (r *Registry) Match(observation Observation) (*Entry, error) {
	normalized, err := normalizeObservation(observation, false)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	entry, _, err := r.match(normalized)
	return entry, err
}

// EnsureRepository returns the matching repository, attaching the observed host
// location when safe. If nothing matches—or a remote is ambiguous because it
// may describe another live clone—it creates a distinct repository record.
func (r *Registry) EnsureRepository(observation Observation) (*Entry, error) {
	normalized, err := normalizeObservation(observation, true)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if r == nil || r.store == nil {
		return nil, errors.New("catalog registry has no store")
	}

	r.mu.Lock()
	defer r.mu.Unlock()

	matched, method, matchErr := r.match(normalized)
	if matchErr == nil {
		return r.attach(matched.ID, normalized)
	}
	if !errors.Is(matchErr, ErrNotFound) && !(errors.Is(matchErr, ErrAmbiguous) && method == matchRemote) {
		return nil, matchErr
	}

	entry := &Entry{
		Kind:           KindRepository,
		Name:           normalized.Name,
		RemoteIdentity: normalized.RemoteIdentity,
		Locations: map[string]Location{
			normalized.Host: locationFromObservation(normalized),
		},
	}
	if err := r.store.Create(entry); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return entry.Clone(), nil
}

// Patch applies an atomic catalog mutation.
func (r *Registry) Patch(id string, mutate func(*Entry) error) (*Entry, error) {
	if r == nil || r.store == nil {
		return nil, errors.New("catalog registry has no store")
	}
	return r.store.Update(id, mutate)
}

// Attach explicitly records observation as id's present location. Explicit
// attachment may update a changed remote because the caller supplied the stable
// catalog identity rather than asking the remote hint to choose one.
func (r *Registry) Attach(id string, observation Observation) (*Entry, error) {
	normalized, err := normalizeObservation(observation, true)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if r == nil || r.store == nil {
		return nil, errors.New("catalog registry has no store")
	}
	return r.attach(id, normalized)
}

func (r *Registry) attach(id string, observation Observation) (*Entry, error) {
	return r.store.Update(id, func(entry *Entry) error {
		if observation.RemoteIdentity != "" {
			entry.RemoteIdentity = observation.RemoteIdentity
		}
		return entry.SetLocation(observation.Host, locationFromObservation(observation))
	})
}

// FindByPath performs only exact host+canonical-path matching; it never falls
// back to a remote identity.
func (r *Registry) FindByPath(host, path string) (*Entry, error) {
	normalized, err := normalizeObservation(Observation{Host: host, Path: path}, false)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	entries, err := r.entries()
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	matches := exactMatches(entries, normalized)
	return selectExact(normalized, matches)
}

// FindByCommonDir performs exact host+Git-common-directory matching.
func (r *Registry) FindByCommonDir(host, commonDir string) (*Entry, error) {
	normalized, err := normalizeObservation(Observation{Host: host, CommonDir: commonDir}, false)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	entries, err := r.entries()
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	matches := exactMatches(entries, normalized)
	return selectExact(normalized, matches)
}

type matchMethod int

const (
	matchNone matchMethod = iota
	matchExact
	matchRemote
)

func (r *Registry) match(observation Observation) (*Entry, matchMethod, error) {
	entries, err := r.entries()
	if err != nil {
		return nil, matchNone, err
	}
	if matches := exactMatches(entries, observation); len(matches) > 0 {
		entry, err := selectExact(observation, matches)
		return entry, matchExact, err
	}
	if observation.RemoteIdentity == "" {
		return nil, matchNone, fmt.Errorf("catalog observation %q: %w", observation.Path, ErrNotFound)
	}

	var remoteMatches []*Entry
	for _, entry := range entries {
		if NormalizeRemoteIdentity(entry.RemoteIdentity) == observation.RemoteIdentity {
			remoteMatches = append(remoteMatches, entry)
		}
	}
	Sort(remoteMatches)
	switch len(remoteMatches) {
	case 0:
		return nil, matchNone, fmt.Errorf("remote %q: %w", observation.RemoteIdentity, ErrNotFound)
	case 1:
		if remoteCanRelocate(remoteMatches[0], observation) {
			return remoteMatches[0], matchRemote, nil
		}
		return nil, matchRemote, ambiguous(observation, remoteMatches,
			"remote also belongs to a different live clone on this host")
	default:
		return nil, matchRemote, ambiguous(observation, remoteMatches,
			"remote identity matches multiple catalog records")
	}
}

func (r *Registry) entries() ([]*Entry, error) {
	if r == nil || r.store == nil {
		return nil, errors.New("catalog registry has no store")
	}
	return r.store.List()
}

func exactMatches(entries []*Entry, observation Observation) []*Entry {
	matched := make(map[string]*Entry)
	observationPaths := canonicalValues(observation.Path, observation.RealPath)
	observationCommon := canonicalValue(observation.CommonDir)
	for _, entry := range entries {
		location, ok := entry.LocationFor(observation.Host)
		if !ok {
			continue
		}
		locationPaths := canonicalValues(location.CurrentPath, location.RealPath)
		pathMatch := intersects(observationPaths, locationPaths)
		commonMatch := observationCommon != "" && observationCommon == canonicalValue(location.GitCommonDir)
		if pathMatch || commonMatch {
			matched[entry.ID] = entry
		}
	}
	out := make([]*Entry, 0, len(matched))
	for _, entry := range matched {
		out = append(out, entry)
	}
	Sort(out)
	return out
}

func selectExact(observation Observation, matches []*Entry) (*Entry, error) {
	switch len(matches) {
	case 0:
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("catalog path %q on host %q: %w", observation.Path, observation.Host, ErrNotFound)
	case 1:
		return matches[0], nil
	default:
		return nil, ambiguous(observation, matches, "canonical path or Git common directory matches multiple records")
	}
}

func ambiguous(observation Observation, entries []*Entry, reason string) error {
	ids := make([]string, len(entries))
	for i, entry := range entries {
		ids[i] = entry.ID
	}
	sort.Strings(ids)
	return &AmbiguousMatchError{Observation: observation, CandidateIDs: ids, Reason: reason}
}

func remoteCanRelocate(entry *Entry, observation Observation) bool {
	location, ok := entry.LocationFor(observation.Host)
	if !ok || location.State != LocationPresent || location.CurrentPath == "" {
		return true
	}
	// Exact aliases and common directories were already handled. A still-present
	// different path is another clone, not evidence that this record moved.
	_, err := os.Stat(location.CurrentPath)
	return errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist)
}

func locationFromObservation(observation Observation) Location {
	currentPath := observation.Path
	if currentPath == "" {
		currentPath = observation.RealPath
	}
	return Location{
		State:        LocationPresent,
		CurrentPath:  currentPath,
		RealPath:     observation.RealPath,
		GitCommonDir: observation.CommonDir,
	}
}

func normalizeObservation(observation Observation, requireLocation bool) (Observation, error) {
	observation.Host = strings.TrimSpace(observation.Host)
	observation.Name = strings.TrimSpace(observation.Name)
	if observation.Host == "" {
		return Observation{}, errors.New("catalog observation host is required")
	}

	commonDir := observation.CommonDir
	if commonDir == "" {
		commonDir = observation.GitCommonDir
	} else if observation.GitCommonDir != "" {
		left, leftErr := pathx.Canonical(commonDir)
		right, rightErr := pathx.Canonical(observation.GitCommonDir)
		if leftErr != nil || rightErr != nil || left != right {
			return Observation{}, errors.New("catalog observation CommonDir and GitCommonDir disagree")
		}
	}

	var err error
	if observation.Path != "" {
		observation.Path, err = absoluteClean(observation.Path)
		if err != nil {
			return Observation{}, fmt.Errorf("catalog observation path: %w", err)
		}
	}
	if observation.RealPath != "" {
		observation.RealPath, err = pathx.Canonical(observation.RealPath)
		if err != nil {
			return Observation{}, fmt.Errorf("catalog observation real path: %w", err)
		}
	} else if observation.Path != "" {
		observation.RealPath, err = pathx.Canonical(observation.Path)
		if err != nil {
			return Observation{}, fmt.Errorf("catalog observation path: %w", err)
		}
	}
	if commonDir != "" {
		observation.CommonDir, err = pathx.Canonical(commonDir)
		if err != nil {
			return Observation{}, fmt.Errorf("catalog observation Git common directory: %w", err)
		}
	}
	observation.GitCommonDir = observation.CommonDir
	observation.RemoteIdentity = NormalizeRemoteIdentity(observation.RemoteIdentity)

	if requireLocation && observation.Path == "" && observation.RealPath == "" {
		return Observation{}, errors.New("catalog repository observation requires a path")
	}
	if observation.Name == "" {
		path := observation.Path
		if path == "" {
			path = observation.RealPath
		}
		observation.Name = filepath.Base(path)
	}
	if requireLocation && (observation.Name == "" || observation.Name == ".") {
		return Observation{}, errors.New("catalog repository observation requires a name")
	}
	return observation, nil
}

func absoluteClean(path string) (string, error) {
	absolute, err := filepath.Abs(path)
	if err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	return filepath.Clean(absolute), nil
}

func canonicalValues(values ...string) map[string]struct{} {
	out := make(map[string]struct{}, len(values))
	for _, value := range values {
		if canonical := canonicalValue(value); canonical != "" {
			out[canonical] = struct{}{}
		}
	}
	return out
}

func canonicalValue(value string) string {
	if value == "" {
		return ""
	}
	canonical, err := pathx.Canonical(value)
	if err != nil {
		return ""
	}
	return canonical
}

func intersects(left, right map[string]struct{}) bool {
	for value := range left {
		if _, ok := right[value]; ok {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}

// NormalizeRemoteIdentity converts common HTTPS and SCP-style Git URLs into a
// stable lower-case host/path key. The result remains only a hint for matching.
func NormalizeRemoteIdentity(identity string) string {
	identity = strings.TrimSpace(identity)
	if identity == "" {
		return ""
	}
	if parsed, err := url.Parse(identity); err == nil && parsed.Scheme != "" && parsed.Host != "" {
		identity = parsed.Host + "/" + strings.TrimPrefix(parsed.Path, "/")
	} else if at := strings.LastIndexByte(identity, '@'); at >= 0 {
		afterUser := identity[at+1:]
		if colon := strings.IndexByte(afterUser, ':'); colon >= 0 {
			identity = afterUser[:colon] + "/" + afterUser[colon+1:]
		}
	}
	identity = strings.Trim(identity, "/")
	identity = strings.TrimSuffix(identity, ".git")
	return strings.ToLower(identity)
}

package catalog_test

import (
	"errors"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"testing"

	"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/catalog"
)

func idSequence(ids ...string) catalog.IDGenerator {
	index := 0
	return func() string {
		if index >= len(ids) {
			return ids[len(ids)-1]
		}
		id := ids[index]
		index++
		return id
	}
}

func TestRegistryMatchesExactCanonicalPathBeforeRemote(t *testing.T) {
	root := t.TempDir()
	physical := filepath.Join(root, "physical")
	if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Join(physical, ".git"), 0o755); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	alias := filepath.Join(root, "alias")
	if err := os.Symlink(physical, alias); err != nil {
		t.Skipf("symlinks unavailable: %v", err)
	}

	store := catalog.NewStore(filepath.Join(root, "assets"),
		catalog.WithIDGenerator(idSequence(firstID, secondID)))
	registry := catalog.NewRegistry(store)
	original, err := registry.EnsureRepository(catalog.Observation{
		Host:           "laptop",
		Path:           physical,
		CommonDir:      filepath.Join(physical, ".git"),
		Name:           "repo",
		RemoteIdentity: "https://github.com/example/repo.git",
	})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}

	matched, err := registry.Match(catalog.Observation{
		Host:           "laptop",
		Path:           alias,
		RemoteIdentity: "github.com/someone/entirely-different",
	})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("Match alias: %v", err)
	}
	if matched.ID != original.ID {
		t.Errorf("canonical path match = %s, want %s", matched.ID, original.ID)
	}
	found, err := registry.FindByPath("laptop", alias)
	if err != nil || found.ID != original.ID {
		t.Errorf("FindByPath = %+v, %v", found, err)
	}
}

func TestRegistryMatchesGitCommonDirectory(t *testing.T) {
	root := t.TempDir()
	mainPath := filepath.Join(root, "main")
	worktreePath := filepath.Join(root, "worktree")
	commonDir := filepath.Join(root, "git-common")
	for _, path := range []string{mainPath, worktreePath, commonDir} {
		if err := os.MkdirAll(path, 0o755); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	}
	registry := catalog.NewRegistry(catalog.NewStore(filepath.Join(root, "assets"),
		catalog.WithIDGenerator(func() string { return firstID })))
	original, err := registry.EnsureRepository(catalog.Observation{
		Host: "desktop", Path: mainPath, CommonDir: commonDir, Name: "repo",
	})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}

	matched, err := registry.Match(catalog.Observation{
		Host: "desktop", Path: worktreePath, GitCommonDir: commonDir, Name: "repo",
	})
	if err != nil || matched.ID != original.ID {
		t.Fatalf("common-dir Match = %+v, %v", matched, err)
	}
	found, err := registry.FindByCommonDir("desktop", commonDir)
	if err != nil || found.ID != original.ID {
		t.Errorf("FindByCommonDir = %+v, %v", found, err)
	}
}

func TestRegistryRemoteAmbiguityNeverAutoMergesClones(t *testing.T) {
	root := t.TempDir()
	paths := []string{
		filepath.Join(root, "clone-one"),
		filepath.Join(root, "clone-two"),
		filepath.Join(root, "clone-three"),
	}
	for _, path := range paths {
		if err := os.MkdirAll(path, 0o755); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	}
	thirdID := "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333"
	store := catalog.NewStore(filepath.Join(root, "assets"),
		catalog.WithIDGenerator(idSequence(firstID, secondID, thirdID)))
	registry := catalog.NewRegistry(store)
	remote := "git@github.com:example/shared.git"

	first, err := registry.EnsureRepository(catalog.Observation{
		Host: "laptop", Path: paths[0], Name: "shared", RemoteIdentity: remote,
	})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	second, err := registry.EnsureRepository(catalog.Observation{
		Host: "laptop", Path: paths[1], Name: "shared-copy", RemoteIdentity: remote,
	})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if first.ID == second.ID {
		t.Fatal("a second live clone was auto-merged by remote identity")
	}

	_, err = registry.Match(catalog.Observation{
		Host: "laptop", Path: paths[2], Name: "third", RemoteIdentity: remote,
	})
	if !errors.Is(err, catalog.ErrAmbiguous) {
		t.Fatalf("ambiguous remote Match = %v, want ErrAmbiguous", err)
	}
	var ambiguous *catalog.AmbiguousMatchError
	if !errors.As(err, &ambiguous) || len(ambiguous.CandidateIDs) != 2 {
		t.Errorf("ambiguous candidates = %#v", err)
	}

	third, err := registry.EnsureRepository(catalog.Observation{
		Host: "laptop", Path: paths[2], Name: "third", RemoteIdentity: remote,
	})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if third.ID == first.ID || third.ID == second.ID {
		t.Error("EnsureRepository chose an ambiguous remote candidate")
	}
	entries, err := store.List()
	if err != nil || len(entries) != 3 {
		t.Errorf("catalog should retain three clone identities: %d, %v", len(entries), err)
	}

	// Even with an ambiguous remote, an exact path is authoritative.
	matched, err := registry.Match(catalog.Observation{
		Host: "laptop", Path: paths[0], RemoteIdentity: remote,
	})
	if err != nil || matched.ID != first.ID {
		t.Errorf("exact path did not win: %+v, %v", matched, err)
	}
}

func TestRegistryUsesUniqueRemoteForMissingRelocation(t *testing.T) {
	root := t.TempDir()
	oldPath := filepath.Join(root, "old")
	newPath := filepath.Join(root, "new")
	if err := os.MkdirAll(oldPath, 0o755); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	registry := catalog.NewRegistry(catalog.NewStore(filepath.Join(root, "assets"),
		catalog.WithIDGenerator(idSequence(firstID, secondID))))
	remote := "https://github.com/example/moved.git"
	original, err := registry.EnsureRepository(catalog.Observation{
		Host: "laptop", Path: oldPath, Name: "moved", RemoteIdentity: remote,
	})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := os.RemoveAll(oldPath); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := os.MkdirAll(newPath, 0o755); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}

	relocated, err := registry.EnsureRepository(catalog.Observation{
		Host: "laptop", Path: newPath, Name: "moved", RemoteIdentity: remote,
	})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if relocated.ID != original.ID {
		t.Errorf("unique missing relocation created %s, want stable %s", relocated.ID, original.ID)
	}
	location, _ := relocated.LocationFor("laptop")
	if location.CurrentPath != newPath {
		t.Errorf("relocated path = %q, want %q", location.CurrentPath, newPath)
	}
}

func TestRegistryAttachesHostsAndPatchesAtomically(t *testing.T) {
	root := t.TempDir()
	laptop := filepath.Join(root, "laptop", "repo")
	server := filepath.Join(root, "server", "repo")
	for _, path := range []string{laptop, server} {
		if err := os.MkdirAll(path, 0o755); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	}
	registry := catalog.NewRegistry(catalog.NewStore(filepath.Join(root, "assets"),
		catalog.WithIDGenerator(func() string { return firstID })))
	entry, err := registry.EnsureRepository(catalog.Observation{
		Host: "laptop", Path: laptop, Name: "repo", RemoteIdentity: "github.com/example/repo",
	})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	entry, err = registry.EnsureRepository(catalog.Observation{
		Host: "server", Path: server, Name: "repo", RemoteIdentity: "github.com/example/repo",
	})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if len(entry.Locations) != 2 {
		t.Fatalf("locations = %+v", entry.Locations)
	}

	entry, err = registry.Patch(entry.ID, func(candidate *catalog.Entry) error {
		candidate.Tags = []string{" Work ", "work", "API"}
		return nil
	})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if !entry.HasTag("api") || !entry.HasTag("WORK") || len(entry.Tags) != 2 {
		t.Errorf("Patch did not normalize tags: %v", entry.Tags)
	}
}

26	// Diagnostic describes one record skipped by a directory listing. The listing
27	// still returns every valid record; callers decide whether and where to render
28	// these notices.
29	type Diagnostic struct {
30		Path string
31		Err  error
32	}
33	
34	func (d Diagnostic) Error() string {
35		return fmt.Sprintf("skipping %s: %v", filepath.Base(d.Path), d.Err)
36	}
37	
38	func (d Diagnostic) Unwrap() error { return d.Err }
39	
40	// IDGenerator supplies stable random filename stems. It is injectable so tests
41	// can assert exact filenames without weakening production randomness.
42	type IDGenerator func() string
43	
44	// DiagnosticSink receives non-fatal per-record listing failures.
45	type DiagnosticSink func(Diagnostic)
46	
47	// StoreOption configures a Store.
48	type StoreOption func(*Store)
49	
50	// WithIDGenerator replaces UUID generation.
51	func WithIDGenerator(generator IDGenerator) StoreOption {
52		return func(store *Store) { store.generateID = generator }
53	}
54	
55	// WithClock replaces timestamp generation.
56	func WithClock(clock func() time.Time) StoreOption {
57		return func(store *Store) { store.clock = clock }
58	}
59	
60	// WithDiagnosticSink directs skipped-record notices to sink.
61	func WithDiagnosticSink(sink DiagnosticSink) StoreOption {
62		return func(store *Store) { store.diagnostics = sink }
63	}
64	
65	// WithDiagnosticWriter writes one line per skipped record to writer. It never
66	// defaults to a process-global stream.
67	func WithDiagnosticWriter(writer io.Writer) StoreOption {
68		if writer == nil {
69			return func(*Store) {}
70		}
71		return WithDiagnosticSink(func(diagnostic Diagnostic) {
72			fmt.Fprintln(writer, diagnostic.Error())
73		})
74	}
75	
76	// Store is a directory of one TOML file per asset.
77	type Store struct {
78		Dir string
79	
80		mu          sync.Mutex
81		generateID  IDGenerator
82		clock       func() time.Time
83		diagnostics DiagnosticSink
84	}
85	
86	// NewStore returns a catalog rooted at dir.
87	func NewStore(dir string, options ...StoreOption) *Store {
88		store := &Store{
89			Dir:        dir,
90			generateID: uuid.NewString,
91			clock:      time.Now,
92		}
93		for _, option := range options {
94			if option != nil {
95				option(store)
96			}
97		}
98		return store
99	}

101	func (s *Store) path(id string) string { return filepath.Join(s.Dir, id+".toml") }

103	// Create assigns a random stable ID and atomically persists entry. The caller's
104	// value is updated only after the rename succeeds.
105	func (s *Store) Create(entry *Entry) error {
106		if entry == nil {
107			return errors.New("create nil catalog entry")
108		}
109		if entry.ID != "" {
110			return fmt.Errorf("create catalog asset: ID is assigned by the store")
111		}
112	
113		s.mu.Lock()
114		defer s.mu.Unlock()
115	
116		if err := os.MkdirAll(s.Dir, 0o755); err != nil {
117			return fmt.Errorf("create catalog directory: %w", err)
118		}
119		for range 32 {
120			candidate := entry.Clone()
121			candidate.ID = s.nextID()
122			if err := ValidateID(candidate.ID); err != nil {
123				return fmt.Errorf("generated catalog ID: %w", err)
124			}
125			if _, err := os.Lstat(s.path(candidate.ID)); err == nil {
126				continue
127			} else if !errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
128				return fmt.Errorf("check catalog ID %s: %w", candidate.ID, err)
129			}
130	
131			now := s.now()
132			candidate.SchemaVersion = CurrentSchemaVersion
133			if candidate.Created.IsZero() {
134				candidate.Created = now
135			}
136			if candidate.Discovered.IsZero() {
137				candidate.Discovered = now
138			}
139			candidate.Updated = now
140			prepareNested(candidate, now)
141			candidate.Normalize()
142			if err := candidate.Validate(); err != nil {
143				return err
144			}
145			if err := s.writeAtomic(candidate); err != nil {
146				return err
147			}
148			*entry = *candidate
149			return nil
150		}
151		return fmt.Errorf("generate unique catalog ID: %w", ErrAlreadyExists)
152	}

154	// Get loads one asset by exact ID.
155	func (s *Store) Get(id string) (*Entry, error) {
156		if err := ValidateID(id); err != nil {
157			return nil, err
158		}
159		return s.get(id)
160	}
161	
162	func (s *Store) get(id string) (*Entry, error) {
163		var entry Entry
164		if _, err := toml.DecodeFile(s.path(id), &entry); err != nil {
165			if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
166				return nil, fmt.Errorf("%q: %w", id, ErrNotFound)
167			}
168			return nil, fmt.Errorf("read catalog asset %s: %w", id, err)
169		}
170		entry.ID = id
171		if entry.SchemaVersion != 0 && entry.SchemaVersion != CurrentSchemaVersion {
172			return nil, &UnsupportedSchemaError{ID: id, Version: entry.SchemaVersion}
173		}
174		// Version zero is the only implicit form: it means the schema marker was
175		// absent, not that an unknown future layout should be guessed.
176		if entry.SchemaVersion == 0 {
177			entry.SchemaVersion = CurrentSchemaVersion
178		}
179		entry.Normalize()
180		if err := entry.Validate(); err != nil {
181			return nil, fmt.Errorf("validate catalog asset %s: %w", id, err)
182		}
183		return &entry, nil
184	}
185	
186	// List loads every valid record in deterministic ID order. Per-record failures
187	// are skipped and sent to the configured diagnostic sink; directory-level
188	// failures are returned.
189	func (s *Store) List() ([]*Entry, error) {
190		entries, diagnostics, err := s.ListWithDiagnostics()
191		if err != nil {
192			return nil, err
193		}
194		if s.diagnostics != nil {
195			for _, diagnostic := range diagnostics {
196				s.diagnostics(diagnostic)
197			}
198		}
199		return entries, nil
200	}
201	
202	// ListWithDiagnostics is List's explicit diagnostic form. It is useful to
203	// services that want to aggregate notices rather than render them immediately.
204	func (s *Store) ListWithDiagnostics() ([]*Entry, []Diagnostic, error) {
205		directoryEntries, err := os.ReadDir(s.Dir)
206		if err != nil {
207			if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
208				return nil, nil, nil
209			}
210			return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("read catalog directory: %w", err)
211		}
212	
213		var entries []*Entry
214		var diagnostics []Diagnostic
215		for _, directoryEntry := range directoryEntries {
216			name := directoryEntry.Name()
217			if directoryEntry.IsDir() || strings.HasPrefix(name, ".") || !strings.HasSuffix(name, ".toml") {
218				continue
219			}
220			id := strings.TrimSuffix(name, ".toml")
221			entry, err := s.Get(id)
222			if err != nil {
223				diagnostics = append(diagnostics, Diagnostic{Path: filepath.Join(s.Dir, name), Err: err})
224				continue
225			}
226			entries = append(entries, entry)
227		}
228		Sort(entries)
229		sort.Slice(diagnostics, func(i, j int) bool { return diagnostics[i].Path < diagnostics[j].Path })
230		return entries, diagnostics, nil
231	}
232	
233	// Update applies mutate to a deep copy and atomically replaces the record only
234	// if the mutation and validation both succeed. ID, Created, and Discovered are
235	// immutable.
236	func (s *Store) Update(id string, mutate func(*Entry) error) (*Entry, error) {
237		if err := ValidateID(id); err != nil {
238			return nil, err
239		}
240		if mutate == nil {
241			return nil, errors.New("catalog update requires a mutation")
242		}
243	
244		s.mu.Lock()
245		defer s.mu.Unlock()
246	
247		current, err := s.get(id)
248		if err != nil {
249			return nil, err
250		}
251		updated := current.Clone()
252		if err := mutate(updated); err != nil {
253			return nil, err
254		}
255		if updated.ID != current.ID {
256			return nil, errors.New("catalog update cannot change ID")
257		}
258		if updated.SchemaVersion != current.SchemaVersion {
259			return nil, errors.New("catalog update cannot change schema version")
260		}
261		if !updated.Created.Equal(current.Created) {
262			return nil, errors.New("catalog update cannot change Created")
263		}
264		if !updated.Discovered.Equal(current.Discovered) {
265			return nil, errors.New("catalog update cannot change Discovered")
266		}
267	
268		now := s.now()
269		updated.Updated = now
270		prepareNested(updated, now)
271		updated.Normalize()
272		if err := updated.Validate(); err != nil {
273			return nil, err
274		}
275		if err := s.writeAtomic(updated); err != nil {
276			return nil, err
277		}
278		return updated.Clone(), nil
279	}
280	
281	// Sort orders entries by stable ID.
282	func Sort(entries []*Entry) {
283		sort.SliceStable(entries, func(i, j int) bool {
284			return entries[i].ID < entries[j].ID
285		})
286	}
287	
288	func (s *Store) writeAtomic(entry *Entry) error {
289		temporary, err := os.CreateTemp(s.Dir, "."+entry.ID+".*.tmp")
290		if err != nil {
291			return fmt.Errorf("create catalog temp file: %w", err)
292		}
293		name := temporary.Name()
294		defer os.Remove(name)
295	
296		if err := toml.NewEncoder(temporary).Encode(entry); err != nil {
297			_ = temporary.Close()
298			return fmt.Errorf("encode catalog asset %s: %w", entry.ID, err)
299		}
300		if err := temporary.Close(); err != nil {
301			return fmt.Errorf("close catalog temp file: %w", err)
302		}
303		if err := os.Chmod(name, 0o644); err != nil {
304			return fmt.Errorf("set catalog file mode: %w", err)
305		}
306		if err := os.Rename(name, s.path(entry.ID)); err != nil {
307			return fmt.Errorf("replace catalog asset %s: %w", entry.ID, err)
308		}
309		return nil
310	}
311	
312	func (s *Store) nextID() string {
313		if s.generateID == nil {
314			return uuid.NewString()
315		}
316		return s.generateID()
317	}
318	
319	func (s *Store) now() time.Time {
320		if s.clock == nil {
321			return time.Now().UTC()
322		}
323		return s.clock().UTC()
324	}
325	
326	func prepareNested(entry *Entry, now time.Time) {
327		if entry.Experiment != nil && entry.Experiment.Started.IsZero() {
328			entry.Experiment.Started = now
329		}
330		for host, location := range entry.Locations {
331			if location.Updated.IsZero() {
332				location.Updated = now
333				entry.Locations[host] = location
334			}
335		}
336		if entry.RecoveryReceipt != nil && entry.RecoveryReceipt.Created.IsZero() {
337			entry.RecoveryReceipt.Created = now
338		}

1	// Package pathx provides the path-safety checks shared by filesystem lifecycle
2	// operations. The checks are strict: a destination must be below its root, not
3	// merely share a string prefix with it, and symlinks are resolved before that
4	// decision is made.
5	package pathx
6	
7	import (
8		"errors"
9		"fmt"
10		"io/fs"
11		"path/filepath"
12		"slices"
13		"strings"
14	)
15	
16	var (
17		// ErrOutsideRoot reports a path that does not resolve below the requested root.
18		ErrOutsideRoot = errors.New("path is outside root")
19		// ErrRoot reports an operation that named the root itself rather than a child.
20		ErrRoot = errors.New("path is the root itself")
21		// ErrTraversal reports an explicit .. component in an unclean input path.
22		ErrTraversal = errors.New("path contains parent traversal")
23		// ErrInvalidComponent reports a value that is not one filesystem component.
24		ErrInvalidComponent = errors.New("invalid path component")
25	)
26	
27	// Canonical returns an absolute, clean path with symlinks resolved. If the final
28	// path does not exist yet, it resolves the nearest existing ancestor and then
29	// appends the missing suffix. This is the form needed to validate a destination
30	// before creating or moving anything into it.
31	func Canonical(path string) (string, error) {
32		if path == "" {
33			return "", fmt.Errorf("canonical path: empty path")
34		}
35		absolute, err := filepath.Abs(path)
36		if err != nil {
37			return "", fmt.Errorf("make %q absolute: %w", path, err)
38		}
39		absolute = filepath.Clean(absolute)
40	
41		probe := absolute
42		var missing []string
43		for {
44			resolved, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(probe)
45			if err == nil {
46				slices.Reverse(missing)
47				parts := append([]string{resolved}, missing...)
48				return filepath.Clean(filepath.Join(parts...)), nil
49			}
50			if !errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
51				return "", fmt.Errorf("resolve %q: %w", path, err)
52			}
53			parent := filepath.Dir(probe)
54			if parent == probe {
55				return "", fmt.Errorf("resolve %q: no existing ancestor: %w", path, err)
56			}
57			missing = append(missing, filepath.Base(probe))
58			probe = parent
59		}
60	}
61	
62	// CanonicalChild returns candidate in canonical form when it resolves strictly
63	// below root. It rejects root itself, lexical .. traversal, sibling-prefix
64	// confusion, and paths that escape through a symlink.
65	func CanonicalChild(root, candidate string) (string, error) {
66		if hasParentTraversal(candidate) {
67			return "", fmt.Errorf("%q: %w", candidate, ErrTraversal)
68		}
69		canonicalRoot, err := Canonical(root)
70		if err != nil {
71			return "", fmt.Errorf("canonicalize root: %w", err)
72		}
73		canonicalCandidate, err := Canonical(candidate)
74		if err != nil {
75			return "", fmt.Errorf("canonicalize candidate: %w", err)
76		}
77	
78		rel, err := filepath.Rel(canonicalRoot, canonicalCandidate)
79		if err != nil {
80			return "", fmt.Errorf("compare %q with root %q: %w", candidate, root, err)
81		}
82		switch {
83		case rel == ".":
84			return "", fmt.Errorf("%q: %w", candidate, ErrRoot)
85		case filepath.IsAbs(rel), rel == "..", strings.HasPrefix(rel, ".."+string(filepath.Separator)):
86			return "", fmt.Errorf("%q is not below %q: %w", candidate, root, ErrOutsideRoot)
87		default:
88			return canonicalCandidate, nil
89		}
90	}
91	
92	// IsChild reports whether candidate resolves strictly below root. Policy
93	// rejections are returned as false without hiding filesystem errors.
94	func IsChild(root, candidate string) (bool, error) {
95		_, err := CanonicalChild(root, candidate)
96		if err == nil {
97			return true, nil
98		}
99		if errors.Is(err, ErrOutsideRoot) || errors.Is(err, ErrRoot) || errors.Is(err, ErrTraversal) {
100			return false, nil
101		}
102		return false, err
103	}
104	
105	// ValidateComponent requires a non-empty relative value containing exactly one
106	// path component. Both slash styles are rejected so state synced between Unix
107	// and Windows cannot acquire a different meaning on another host.
108	func ValidateComponent(component string) error {
109		switch {
110		case component == "":
111			return fmt.Errorf("empty component: %w", ErrInvalidComponent)
112		case strings.ContainsRune(component, '\x00'):
113			return fmt.Errorf("component contains NUL: %w", ErrInvalidComponent)
114		case component == "." || component == "..":
115			return fmt.Errorf("component %q is reserved: %w", component, ErrInvalidComponent)
116		case filepath.IsAbs(component) || filepath.VolumeName(component) != "":
117			return fmt.Errorf("component %q is absolute: %w", component, ErrInvalidComponent)
118		case strings.ContainsAny(component, `/\\`):
119			return fmt.Errorf("component %q contains a path separator: %w", component, ErrInvalidComponent)
120		case filepath.Clean(component) != component || filepath.Base(component) != component:
121			return fmt.Errorf("component %q is not a single clean name: %w", component, ErrInvalidComponent)
122		default:
123			return nil
124		}
125	}
126	
127	// JoinChild validates every component, joins it below root, and returns the
128	// canonical destination. It is suitable for paths such as
129	// <project-root>/<category>/<name>, where each user-supplied value must remain a
130	// single component.
131	func JoinChild(root string, components ...string) (string, error) {
132		if len(components) == 0 {
133			return "", fmt.Errorf("join child: no components: %w", ErrRoot)
134		}
135		for i, component := range components {
136			if err := ValidateComponent(component); err != nil {
137				return "", fmt.Errorf("component %d: %w", i, err)
138			}
139		}
140		return CanonicalChild(root, filepath.Join(append([]string{root}, components...)...))
141	}
142	
143	func hasParentTraversal(path string) bool {
144		for _, component := range strings.FieldsFunc(path, func(r rune) bool {
145			return r == '/' || r == '\\'
146		}) {
147			if component == ".." {
148				return true
149			}
150		}
151		return false
152	}
153

318			"git_common_dir": location.GitCommonDir,
319		} {

321				return fmt.Errorf("location %s %s contains NUL", host, field)
322			}
323		}
324		switch location.State {
325		case LocationPresent:
326			if location.CurrentPath == "" {
327				return fmt.Errorf("location %s: present state requires current_path", host)
328			}
329		case LocationArchived:
330			if location.CurrentPath == "" || location.RestorePath == "" {
331				return fmt.Errorf("location %s: archived state requires current_path and restore_path", host)
332			}
333		case LocationEvicted:
334			if location.RestorePath == "" {
335				return fmt.Errorf("location %s: evicted state requires restore_path", host)
336			}
337		default:
338			return fmt.Errorf("location %s: unknown state %q", host, location.State)
339		}
340		return nil
341	}

53		a.Registry = catalog.NewRegistry(a.Catalog)

59	func (a *App) Runtime() runtime.Runtime {
60		if a.noRuntime {

62		}
63		backend := a.Cfg.Runtime.Backend
64		if a.runtimeOverride != "" {
65			backend = a.runtimeOverride
66		}

68		if h, ok := rt.(*runtime.Herdr); ok {
69			return h.WithMetadataSource(a.Cfg.Runtime.MetadataSource)
70		}
71		return rt
72	}

## Phase 0 — Gather the diff

Run `git diff @{upstream}...HEAD` (or `git diff main...HEAD` / `git diff HEAD~1`
if there's no upstream) to get the unified diff under review. If there are
uncommitted changes, or the range diff is empty, also run `git diff HEAD` and
include the working-tree changes in scope — the review often runs before the
commit. If a PR number, branch name, or file path was passed as an argument,
review that target instead. Treat this diff as the review scope.
## Phase 1 — Find candidates (10 angles, single pass)

Work through **10 angles** yourself, in sequence, in this same
context — do not spawn subagents. Each surfaces candidate findings with
`file`, `line`, a one-line `summary`, and a concrete `failure_scenario`.

### Angle A — line-by-line diff scan

Read every hunk in the diff, line by line. Then Read the enclosing function for
each hunk — bugs in unchanged lines of a touched function are in scope (the PR
re-exposes or fails to fix them). For every line ask: what input, state, timing,
or platform makes this line wrong? Look for inverted/wrong conditions,
off-by-one, null/undefined deref, missing `await`, falsy-zero checks,
wrong-variable copy-paste, error swallowed in catch, unescaped regex metachars.

### Angle B — removed-behavior auditor

For every line the diff DELETES or replaces, name the invariant or behavior it
enforced, then search the new code for where that invariant is re-established.
If you can't find it, that's a candidate: a removed guard, a dropped error
path, a narrowed validation, a deleted test that was covering a real case.

### Angle C — cross-file tracer

For each function the diff changes, find its callers (Grep for the symbol) and
check whether the change breaks any call site: a new precondition, a changed
return shape, a new exception, a timing/ordering dependency. Also check callees:
does a parallel change in the same PR make a call unsafe?

### Angle D — language-pitfall specialist

Scan for the classic pitfalls of the diff's language/framework — for example:
JS falsy-zero, `==` coercion, closure-captured loop var; Python mutable default
args, late-binding closures; Go nil-map write, range-var capture; SQL injection;
timezone/DST drift; float equality. Flag any instance the diff introduces.

### Angle E — wrapper/proxy correctness

When the PR adds or modifies a type that wraps another (cache, proxy, decorator,
adapter): check that every method routes to the wrapped instance and not back
through a registry/session/global — e.g. a caching provider holding a
`delegate` field that resolves IDs via `session.get(...)` instead of
`delegate.get(...)` will re-enter the cache or recurse. Also check that the
wrapper forwards all the methods the callers actually use.

### Reuse

The angles above hunt for bugs; this one and the next two hunt for cleanup in
the changed code. Flag new code that re-implements something the codebase
already has — Grep shared/utility modules and files adjacent to the change,
and name the existing helper to call instead.

### Simplification

Flag unnecessary complexity the diff adds: redundant or derivable state,
copy-paste with slight variation, deep nesting, dead code left behind. Name
the simpler form that does the same job.

### Efficiency

Flag wasted work the diff introduces: redundant computation or repeated I/O,
independent operations run sequentially, blocking work added to startup or
hot paths. Also flag long-lived objects built from closures or captured
environments — they keep the entire enclosing scope alive for the object's
lifetime (a memory leak when that scope holds large values); prefer a
class/struct that copies only the fields it needs. Name the cheaper
alternative.

### Altitude

Check that each change is implemented at the right depth, not as a fragile
bandaid. Special cases layered on shared infrastructure are a sign the fix
isn't deep enough — prefer generalizing the underlying mechanism over adding
special cases.

### Conventions (CLAUDE.md)

Find the CLAUDE.md files that govern the changed code: the user-level
~/.claude/CLAUDE.md, the repo-root CLAUDE.md, plus any CLAUDE.md or
CLAUDE.local.md in a directory that is an ancestor of a changed file (a
directory's CLAUDE.md only applies to files at or below it). Read each one

Only flag a violation when you can quote the exact rule and the exact line
that breaks it — no style preferences, no vague "spirit of the doc"

 // Load reads configuration and prepares the shared stores.

 // Runtime resolves the multiplexer backend for this invocation, honouring
 // --runtime and --no-runtime.
 func (a *App) Runtime() runtime.Runtime {
 	if a.noRuntime {
 		return runtime.None{}
 	}
 	backend := a.Cfg.Runtime.Backend
 	if a.runtimeOverride != "" {
 		backend = a.runtimeOverride
 	}

 func (a *App) cdDirective(dir string) {
 	fmt.Fprintf(a.Out, "cd %s\n", shellQuote(dir))
 }

 func ctxOf() context.Context { return context.Background() }

+func TestAppLoadInitializesCatalog(t *testing.T) {
+	dataHome := t.TempDir()
+	t.Setenv("XDG_DATA_HOME", dataHome)
+	var diagnostics bytes.Buffer
+	app := &App{
+		Out:        io.Discard,
+		Err:        &diagnostics,
+		configPath: filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "missing.toml"),
+	}
+	if err := app.Load(); err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	if app.Tasks == nil || app.Catalog == nil || app.Registry == nil {
+		t.Fatalf("stores were not initialized: %+v", app)
+	}
+	if got, want := app.Catalog.Dir, filepath.Join(dataHome, "dev", "assets"); got != want {
+		t.Errorf("catalog dir = %q, want %q", got, want)
+	}
+	if app.Registry.Store() != app.Catalog {
+		t.Error("registry should use App's catalog store")
+	}
+
+	if err := os.MkdirAll(app.Catalog.Dir, 0o755); err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(app.Catalog.Dir, "broken.toml"), []byte("not = = toml"), 0o644); err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	if _, err := app.Catalog.List(); err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	if !strings.Contains(diagnostics.String(), "dev: warning: skipping broken.toml") {
+		t.Errorf("catalog diagnostics did not use App.Err: %q", diagnostics.String())
+	}
+}

 func TestExternalToolCommandModesAreExplicit(t *testing.T) {
 	app := &App{Cfg: config.Default()}
 	app.Cfg.TUI.Tools = []config.Tool{
 		{Key: "N", Name: "normal", Run: "printf normal"},
 		{Key: "I", Name: "interactive", Run: "my-shell-alias --flag", Interactive: true},
 	}
 	got := externalTools(app)
 	if len(got) != 2 {
 		t.Fatalf("got %d tools", len(got))
 	}
 	if len(got[0].Command) != 3 || got[0].Command[1] != "-c" || got[0].Command[2] != "printf normal" {
 		t.Errorf("ordinary command = %v", got[0].Command)
 	}
 	if len(got[1].Command) != 5 || got[1].Command[1] != "-lic" ||
 		got[1].Command[2] != `eval "$1"` || got[1].Command[4] != "my-shell-alias --flag" {
 		t.Errorf("interactive command must evaluate after rc loading: %v", got[1].Command)
 	}
 }
 
 func TestCommandRunnableCachesProbe(t *testing.T) {
 	// A known executable is enough to assert a stable result. The sync.Once in
 	// the closure is what prevents interactive probes from launching a login
 	// shell on every TUI frame.
 	check := commandRunnable("go version", false)
 	first := check()
 	for i := 0; i < 10; i++ {
 		if check() != first {
 			t.Fatal("availability result changed within one dashboard")
 		}
 	}
 }

 // probeVars is a dummy environment used to validate a template without having
 // a real repo in hand.
 func (c Config) probeVars() Vars {
 	return Vars{
 		"worktree_root": Expand(c.Paths.WorktreeRoot),
 		"repo":          "repo",
 		"repo_path":     "/repo",
 		"branch":        "branch",
 		"category":      "category",
 		"host":          "host",
 		"date":          "2006-01-02",
 	}
 }
 
-// StateDir is the expanded directory holding tasks/, stats.db and cache/.
+// StateDir is the expanded directory holding tasks/, assets/ and stats.db.
 func (c Config) StateDir() string { return Expand(c.Paths.StateDir) }
 
 // TasksDir holds one TOML file per task.
 func (c Config) TasksDir() string { return filepath.Join(c.StateDir(), "tasks") }
 
+// AssetsDir holds one TOML file per catalog asset.
+func (c Config) AssetsDir() string { return filepath.Join(c.StateDir(), "assets") }
+
 // ScanRoots returns the expanded repo discovery roots.
 func (c Config) ScanRoots() []string {
 	out := make([]string, 0, len(c.Paths.ScanRoots))
 	for _, r := range c.Paths.ScanRoots {
 		if e := Expand(r); e != "" {
 			out = append(out, e)
 		}
 	}
 	return out
 }
 
 // WorktreePathFor renders the configured template for one repo+branch pair.
 func (c Config) WorktreePathFor(repoName, repoPath, branch, category string) (string, error) {
 	v := Vars{
 		"worktree_root": Expand(c.Paths.WorktreeRoot),
 		"repo":          repoName,
 		"repo_path":     repoPath,
 		"branch":        branch,
 		"category":      category,
 		"host":          Hostname(),
 		"date":          time.Now().Format("2006-01-02"),
 	}
 	rendered, err := Render(c.Paths.WorktreePath, v)
 	if err != nil {
 		return "", err
 	}
 	return Expand(rendered), nil
 }
 
 // Hostname is the machine identity recorded as a task's owner.
 func Hostname() string {
 	if h, err := os.Hostname(); err == nil && h != "" {
 		return h
 	}
 	return "unknown"
 }

315	func validateLocation(host string, location Location) error {
316		if host == "" {

318		}
319		if host != strings.TrimSpace(host) {

321		}
322		fields := []struct {
323			name  string
324			value string
325		}{
326			{"current_path", location.CurrentPath},
327			{"restore_path", location.RestorePath},
328			{"real_path", location.RealPath},
329			{"git_common_dir", location.GitCommonDir},
330		}
331		for _, field := range fields {
332			if strings.ContainsRune(field.value, '\x00') {
333				return fmt.Errorf("location %s %s contains NUL", host, field.name)
334			}
335		}
336		switch location.State {
337		case LocationPresent:
338			if location.CurrentPath == "" {
339				return fmt.Errorf("location %s: present state requires current_path", host)
340			}
341		case LocationArchived:
342			if location.CurrentPath == "" || location.RestorePath == "" {
343				return fmt.Errorf("location %s: archived state requires current_path and restore_path", host)
344			}
345		case LocationEvicted:
346			if location.RestorePath == "" {

348			}
349		default:
350			return fmt.Errorf("location %s: unknown state %q", host, location.State)
351		}
352		return nil
353	}

35		return fmt.Sprintf("skipping %s: %v", filepath.Base(d.Path), d.Err)
36	}
37	
38	func (d Diagnostic) Unwrap() error { return d.Err }
39	
40	// IDGenerator supplies stable random filename stems. It is injectable so tests
41	// can assert exact filenames without weakening production randomness.
42	type IDGenerator func() string
43	
44	// DiagnosticSink receives non-fatal per-record listing failures.
45	type DiagnosticSink func(Diagnostic)
46	
47	// StoreOption configures a Store.
48	type StoreOption func(*Store)
49	
50	// WithIDGenerator replaces UUID generation.
51	func WithIDGenerator(generator IDGenerator) StoreOption {
52		return func(store *Store) { store.generateID = generator }
53	}
54	
55	// WithClock replaces timestamp generation.
56	func WithClock(clock func() time.Time) StoreOption {
57		return func(store *Store) { store.clock = clock }
58	}
59	
60	// WithDiagnosticSink directs skipped-record notices to sink.
61	func WithDiagnosticSink(sink DiagnosticSink) StoreOption {
62		return func(store *Store) { store.diagnostics = sink }
63	}
64	
65	// WithDiagnosticWriter writes one line per skipped record to writer. It never
66	// defaults to a process-global stream.
67	func WithDiagnosticWriter(writer io.Writer) StoreOption {
68		if writer == nil {
69			return func(*Store) {}
70		}
71		return WithDiagnosticSink(func(diagnostic Diagnostic) {
72			fmt.Fprintln(writer, diagnostic.Error())
73		})
74	}
75	
76	// Store is a directory of one TOML file per asset.
77	type Store struct {
78		Dir string
79	
80		mu          sync.Mutex
81		generateID  IDGenerator
82		clock       func() time.Time
83		diagnostics DiagnosticSink
84	}
85	
86	// NewStore returns a catalog rooted at dir.
87	func NewStore(dir string, options ...StoreOption) *Store {
88		store := &Store{
89			Dir:        dir,
90			generateID: uuid.NewString,
91			clock:      time.Now,
92		}
93		for _, option := range options {
94			if option != nil {
95				option(store)
96			}
97		}
98		return store
99	}
100	
101	func (s *Store) path(id string) string { return filepath.Join(s.Dir, id+".toml") }
102	
103	// Create assigns a random stable ID and atomically persists entry. The caller's
104	// value is updated only after the rename succeeds.
105	func (s *Store) Create(entry *Entry) error {
106		if entry == nil {
107			return errors.New("create nil catalog entry")
108		}
109		if entry.ID != "" {
110			return fmt.Errorf("create catalog asset: ID is assigned by the store")
111		}
112	
113		s.mu.Lock()
114		defer s.mu.Unlock()
115	
116		for range 32 {
117			candidate := entry.Clone()
118			candidate.ID = s.nextID()
119			if err := ValidateID(candidate.ID); err != nil {
120				return fmt.Errorf("generated catalog ID: %w", err)
121			}
122	
123			now := s.now()
124			candidate.SchemaVersion = CurrentSchemaVersion
125			if candidate.Created.IsZero() {
126				candidate.Created = now
127			}
128			if candidate.Discovered.IsZero() {
129				candidate.Discovered = now
130			}
131			candidate.Updated = now
132			prepareNested(candidate, now)
133			candidate.Normalize()
134			if err := candidate.Validate(); err != nil {
135				return err
136			}
137			if err := os.MkdirAll(s.Dir, 0o755); err != nil {
138				return fmt.Errorf("create catalog directory: %w", err)
139			}
140			if _, err := os.Lstat(s.path(candidate.ID)); err == nil {
141				continue
142			} else if !errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
143				return fmt.Errorf("check catalog ID %s: %w", candidate.ID, err)
144			}
145			if err := s.writeAtomic(candidate); err != nil {
146				return err
147			}
148			*entry = *candidate
149			return nil
150		}
151		return fmt.Errorf("generate unique catalog ID: %w", ErrAlreadyExists)
152	}
153	
154	// Get loads one asset by exact ID.
155	func (s *Store) Get(id string) (*Entry, error) {
156		if err := ValidateID(id); err != nil {
157			return nil, err
158		}
159		return s.get(id)
160	}
161	
162	func (s *Store) get(id string) (*Entry, error) {
163		data, err := os.ReadFile(s.path(id))
164		if err != nil {
165			if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
166				return nil, fmt.Errorf("%q: %w", id, ErrNotFound)
167			}
168			return nil, fmt.Errorf("read catalog asset %s: %w", id, err)
169		}
170		var header struct {
171			SchemaVersion int `toml:"schema_version"`
172		}
173		if _, err := toml.Decode(string(data), &header); err != nil {
174			return nil, fmt.Errorf("decode catalog asset %s schema: %w", id, err)
175		}
176		if header.SchemaVersion != 0 && header.SchemaVersion != CurrentSchemaVersion {
177			return nil, &UnsupportedSchemaError{ID: id, Version: header.SchemaVersion}
178		}
179	
180		var entry Entry
181		if _, err := toml.Decode(string(data), &entry); err != nil {
182			return nil, fmt.Errorf("decode catalog asset %s: %w", id, err)
183		}
184		entry.ID = id
185		// Version zero is the only implicit form: it means the schema marker was
186		// absent, not that an unknown future layout should be guessed.
187		if entry.SchemaVersion == 0 {
188			entry.SchemaVersion = CurrentSchemaVersion
189		}
190		entry.Normalize()
191		if err := entry.Validate(); err != nil {
192			return nil, fmt.Errorf("validate catalog asset %s: %w", id, err)
193		}
194		return &entry, nil
195	}
196	
197	// List loads every valid record in deterministic ID order. Per-record failures
198	// are skipped and sent to the configured diagnostic sink; directory-level
199	// failures are returned.
200	func (s *Store) List() ([]*Entry, error) {
201		entries, diagnostics, err := s.ListWithDiagnostics()
202		if err != nil {
203			return nil, err
204		}
205		if s.diagnostics != nil {
206			for _, diagnostic := range diagnostics {
207				s.diagnostics(diagnostic)
208			}
209		}
210		return entries, nil
211	}
212	
213	// ListWithDiagnostics is List's explicit diagnostic form. It is useful to
214	// services that want to aggregate notices rather than render them immediately.
215	func (s *Store) ListWithDiagnostics() ([]*Entry, []Diagnostic, error) {
216		directoryEntries, err := os.ReadDir(s.Dir)
217		if err != nil {
218			if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
219				return nil, nil, nil
220			}
221			return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("read catalog directory: %w", err)
222		}
223	
224		var entries []*Entry
225		var diagnostics []Diagnostic
226		for _, directoryEntry := range directoryEntries {
227			name := directoryEntry.Name()
228			if directoryEntry.IsDir() || strings.HasPrefix(name, ".") || !strings.HasSuffix(name, ".toml") {
229				continue
230			}
231			id := strings.TrimSuffix(name, ".toml")
232			entry, err := s.Get(id)
233			if err != nil {
234				diagnostics = append(diagnostics, Diagnostic{Path: filepath.Join(s.Dir, name), Err: err})
235				continue
236			}
237			entries = append(entries, entry)
238		}
239		Sort(entries)
240		sort.Slice(diagnostics, func(i, j int) bool { return diagnostics[i].Path < diagnostics[j].Path })
241		return entries, diagnostics, nil
242	}
243	
244	// Update applies mutate to a deep copy and atomically replaces the record only
245	// if the mutation and validation both succeed. ID, Created, and Discovered are
246	// immutable.
247	func (s *Store) Update(id string, mutate func(*Entry) error) (*Entry, error) {
248		if err := ValidateID(id); err != nil {
249			return nil, err
250		}
251		if mutate == nil {
252			return nil, errors.New("catalog update requires a mutation")
253		}
254	
255		s.mu.Lock()
256		defer s.mu.Unlock()
257	
258		current, err := s.get(id)
259		if err != nil {
260			return nil, err
261		}
262		updated := current.Clone()
263		if err := mutate(updated); err != nil {
264			return nil, err
265		}
266		if updated.ID != current.ID {
267			return nil, errors.New("catalog update cannot change ID")
268		}
269		if updated.SchemaVersion != current.SchemaVersion {
270			return nil, errors.New("catalog update cannot change schema version")
271		}
272		if !updated.Created.Equal(current.Created) {
273			return nil, errors.New("catalog update cannot change Created")
274		}
275		if !updated.Discovered.Equal(current.Discovered) {
276			return nil, errors.New("catalog update cannot change Discovered")
277		}
278	
279		now := s.now()
280		updated.Updated = now
281		prepareNested(updated, now)
282		updated.Normalize()
283		if err := updated.Validate(); err != nil {
284			return nil, err
285		}
286		if err := s.writeAtomic(updated); err != nil {
287			return nil, err
288		}
289		return updated.Clone(), nil
290	}
291	
292	// Sort orders entries by stable ID.
293	func Sort(entries []*Entry) {
294		sort.SliceStable(entries, func(i, j int) bool {
295			return entries[i].ID < entries[j].ID
296		})
297	}
298	
299	func (s *Store) writeAtomic(entry *Entry) error {
300		temporary, err := os.CreateTemp(s.Dir, "."+entry.ID+".*.tmp")
301		if err != nil {
302			return fmt.Errorf("create catalog temp file: %w", err)
303		}
304		name := temporary.Name()
305		defer os.Remove(name)
306	
307		if err := toml.NewEncoder(temporary).Encode(entry); err != nil {
308			_ = temporary.Close()
309			return fmt.Errorf("encode catalog asset %s: %w", entry.ID, err)
310		}
311		if err := temporary.Close(); err != nil {
312			return fmt.Errorf("close catalog temp file: %w", err)
313		}
314		if err := os.Chmod(name, 0o644); err != nil {
315			return fmt.Errorf("set catalog file mode: %w", err)
316		}
317		if err := os.Rename(name, s.path(entry.ID)); err != nil {
318			return fmt.Errorf("replace catalog asset %s: %w", entry.ID, err)
319		}
320		return nil
321	}
322	
323	func (s *Store) nextID() string {
324		if s.generateID == nil {
325			return uuid.NewString()
326		}
327		return s.generateID()
328	}
329	
330	func (s *Store) now() time.Time {
331		if s.clock == nil {
332			return time.Now().UTC()
333		}
334		return s.clock().UTC()
335	}
336	
337	func prepareNested(entry *Entry, now time.Time) {
338		if entry.Experiment != nil && entry.Experiment.Started.IsZero() {
339			entry.Experiment.Started = now
340		}
341		for host, location := range entry.Locations {
342			if location.Updated.IsZero() {
343				location.Updated = now
344				entry.Locations[host] = location
345			}
346		}
347		if entry.RecoveryReceipt != nil && entry.RecoveryReceipt.Created.IsZero() {
348			entry.RecoveryReceipt.Created = now
349		}
350		if entry.MoveIntent != nil && entry.MoveIntent.Started.IsZero() {
351			entry.MoveIntent.Started = now
352		}
353	}
354

17	var ErrAmbiguous = errors.New("ambiguous catalog match")
18	
19	// AmbiguousMatchError reports records that cannot be safely distinguished. A
20	// remote-only ambiguity is never resolved by picking the first entry.
21	type AmbiguousMatchError struct {
22		Observation  Observation
23		CandidateIDs []string
24		Reason       string
25	}
26	
27	func (e *AmbiguousMatchError) Error() string {
28		reason := e.Reason
29		if reason == "" {
30			reason = "multiple records match"
31		}
32		return fmt.Sprintf("%s: %s (%s)", ErrAmbiguous, reason, strings.Join(e.CandidateIDs, ", "))
33	}
34	
35	func (e *AmbiguousMatchError) Unwrap() error { return ErrAmbiguous }

37	// Observation is live repository identity gathered from discovery. Path is the
38	// navigation path, RealPath its physical target, and either common-dir field may
39	// carry Git's shared administrative directory. CommonDir matches repo.Repo;
40	// GitCommonDir is accepted for callers using gitx.Repo terminology.
41	type Observation struct {
42		Host           string
43		Path           string
44		RealPath       string
45		CommonDir      string
46		GitCommonDir   string
47		Name           string
48		RemoteIdentity string
49	}

51	// Registry adds live matching and lazy repository persistence to a Store.
52	type Registry struct {
53		store *Store
54		mu    sync.Mutex
55	}
56	
57	// NewRegistry returns a registry backed by store.
58	func NewRegistry(store *Store) *Registry { return &Registry{store: store} }
59	
60	// Store exposes the durable store for callers that need listing APIs.
61	func (r *Registry) Store() *Store { return r.store }
62	
63	// Match finds an observation without changing the catalog. Exact canonical path
64	// or common-directory identity on the same host always wins. A remote identity
65	// is considered only as a conservative relocation hint.
66	func (r *Registry) Match(observation Observation) (*Entry, error) {
67		normalized, err := normalizeObservation(observation, false)
68		if err != nil {
69			return nil, err
70		}
71		entry, _, err := r.match(normalized)
72		return entry, err
73	}
74	
75	// EnsureRepository returns the matching repository, attaching the observed host
76	// location when safe. If nothing matches—or a remote is ambiguous because it
77	// may describe another live clone—it creates a distinct repository record.
78	func (r *Registry) EnsureRepository(observation Observation) (*Entry, error) {
79		normalized, err := normalizeObservation(observation, true)
80		if err != nil {
81			return nil, err
82		}
83		if r == nil || r.store == nil {
84			return nil, errors.New("catalog registry has no store")
85		}
86	
87		r.mu.Lock()
88		defer r.mu.Unlock()
89	
90		matched, method, matchErr := r.match(normalized)
91		if matchErr == nil {
92			return r.attach(matched.ID, normalized)
93		}
94		if !errors.Is(matchErr, ErrNotFound) && !(errors.Is(matchErr, ErrAmbiguous) && method == matchRemote) {
95			return nil, matchErr
96		}
97	
98		entry := &Entry{
99			Kind:           KindRepository,
100			Name:           normalized.Name,
101			RemoteIdentity: normalized.RemoteIdentity,
102			Locations: map[string]Location{
103				normalized.Host: locationFromObservation(normalized),
104			},
105		}
106		if err := r.store.Create(entry); err != nil {
107			return nil, err
108		}
109		return entry.Clone(), nil
110	}

112	// Patch applies an atomic catalog mutation.

116		}

120	// Attach explicitly records observation as id's present location. Explicit
121	// attachment may update a changed remote because the caller supplied the stable
122	// catalog identity rather than asking the remote hint to choose one.
123	func (r *Registry) Attach(id string, observation Observation) (*Entry, error) {
124		normalized, err := normalizeObservation(observation, true)
125		if err != nil {
126			return nil, err
127		}
128		if r == nil || r.store == nil {
129			return nil, errors.New("catalog registry has no store")
130		}

134	func (r *Registry) attach(id string, observation Observation) (*Entry, error) {
135		return r.store.Update(id, func(entry *Entry) error {
136			if observation.RemoteIdentity != "" {
137				entry.RemoteIdentity = observation.RemoteIdentity
138			}
139			return entry.SetLocation(observation.Host, locationFromObservation(observation))
140		})
141	}

143	// FindByPath performs only exact host+canonical-path matching; it never falls
144	// back to a remote identity.
145	func (r *Registry) FindByPath(host, path string) (*Entry, error) {
146		normalized, err := normalizeObservation(Observation{Host: host, Path: path}, false)
147		if err != nil {
148			return nil, err
149		}
150		entries, err := r.entries()
151		if err != nil {
152			return nil, err

154		matches := exactMatches(entries, normalized)
155		return selectExact(normalized, matches)
156	}

158	// FindByCommonDir performs exact host+Git-common-directory matching.
159	func (r *Registry) FindByCommonDir(host, commonDir string) (*Entry, error) {
160		normalized, err := normalizeObservation(Observation{Host: host, CommonDir: commonDir}, false)
161		if err != nil {
162			return nil, err
163		}
164		entries, err := r.entries()
165		if err != nil {
166			return nil, err
167		}
168		matches := exactMatches(entries, normalized)
169		return selectExact(normalized, matches)

172	type matchMethod int
173	
174	const (
175		matchNone matchMethod = iota
176		matchExact
177		matchRemote
178	)
179	
180	func (r *Registry) match(observation Observation) (*Entry, matchMethod, error) {
181		entries, err := r.entries()
182		if err != nil {
183			return nil, matchNone, err
184		}
185		if matches := exactMatches(entries, observation); len(matches) > 0 {
186			entry, err := selectExact(observation, matches)
187			return entry, matchExact, err
188		}
189		if observation.RemoteIdentity == "" {
190			return nil, matchNone, fmt.Errorf("catalog observation %q: %w", observation.Path, ErrNotFound)
191		}
192	
193		var remoteMatches []*Entry
194		for _, entry := range entries {
195			if NormalizeRemoteIdentity(entry.RemoteIdentity) == observation.RemoteIdentity {
196				remoteMatches = append(remoteMatches, entry)
197			}
198		}
199		Sort(remoteMatches)
200		switch len(remoteMatches) {
201		case 0:
202			return nil, matchNone, fmt.Errorf("remote %q: %w", observation.RemoteIdentity, ErrNotFound)
203		case 1:
204			if remoteCanRelocate(remoteMatches[0], observation) {
205				return remoteMatches[0], matchRemote, nil
206			}
207			return nil, matchRemote, ambiguous(observation, remoteMatches,
208				"remote also belongs to a different live clone on this host")
209		default:
210			return nil, matchRemote, ambiguous(observation, remoteMatches,
211				"remote identity matches multiple catalog records")
212		}
213	}
214	
215	func (r *Registry) entries() ([]*Entry, error) {
216		if r == nil || r.store == nil {
217			return nil, errors.New("catalog registry has no store")
218		}
219		return r.store.List()
220	}
221	
222	func exactMatches(entries []*Entry, observation Observation) []*Entry {
223		matched := make(map[string]*Entry)
224		observationPaths := canonicalValues(observation.Path, observation.RealPath)
225		observationCommon := canonicalValue(observation.CommonDir)
226		for _, entry := range entries {
227			location, ok := entry.LocationFor(observation.Host)
228			if !ok {
229				continue
230			}
231			locationPaths := canonicalValues(location.CurrentPath, location.RestorePath, location.RealPath)
232			pathMatch := intersects(observationPaths, locationPaths)
233			commonMatch := observationCommon != "" && observationCommon == canonicalValue(location.GitCommonDir)
234			if pathMatch || commonMatch {
235				matched[entry.ID] = entry
236			}
237		}
238		out := make([]*Entry, 0, len(matched))
239		for _, entry := range matched {
240			out = append(out, entry)
241		}
242		Sort(out)
243		return out
244	}
245	
246	func selectExact(observation Observation, matches []*Entry) (*Entry, error) {
247		switch len(matches) {
248		case 0:
249			return nil, fmt.Errorf("catalog path %q on host %q: %w", observation.Path, observation.Host, ErrNotFound)
250		case 1:
251			return matches[0], nil
252		default:
253			return nil, ambiguous(observation, matches, "canonical path or Git common directory matches multiple records")
254		}
255	}
256	
257	func ambiguous(observation Observation, entries []*Entry, reason string) error {
258		ids := make([]string, len(entries))
259		for i, entry := range entries {
260			ids[i] = entry.ID
261		}
262		sort.Strings(ids)
263		return &AmbiguousMatchError{Observation: observation, CandidateIDs: ids, Reason: reason}
264	}
265	
266	func remoteCanRelocate(entry *Entry, observation Observation) bool {
267		location, ok := entry.LocationFor(observation.Host)
268		if !ok || location.CurrentPath == "" {
269			return true
270		}
271		// Exact aliases, restore paths, and common directories were already handled.
272		// Any still-present bytes at a different path—including an archive—make the
273		// remote ambiguous rather than evidence that this record moved.
274		_, err := os.Stat(location.CurrentPath)
275		return errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist)
276	}
277	
278	func locationFromObservation(observation Observation) Location {
279		currentPath := observation.Path
280		if currentPath == "" {
281			currentPath = observation.RealPath
282		}
283		return Location{
284			State:        LocationPresent,
285			CurrentPath:  currentPath,
286			RealPath:     observation.RealPath,
287			GitCommonDir: observation.CommonDir,
288		}
289	}

291	func normalizeObservation(observation Observation, requireLocation bool) (Observation, error) {
292		observation.Host = strings.TrimSpace(observation.Host)
293		observation.Name = strings.TrimSpace(observation.Name)
294		if observation.Host == "" {
295			return Observation{}, errors.New("catalog observation host is required")
296		}
297	
298		commonDir := observation.CommonDir
299		if commonDir == "" {
300			commonDir = observation.GitCommonDir
301		} else if observation.GitCommonDir != "" {
302			left, leftErr := pathx.Canonical(commonDir)
303			right, rightErr := pathx.Canonical(observation.GitCommonDir)
304			if leftErr != nil || rightErr != nil || left != right {
305				return Observation{}, errors.New("catalog observation CommonDir and GitCommonDir disagree")
306			}
307		}
308	
309		var err error
310		if observation.Path != "" {
311			observation.Path, err = absoluteClean(observation.Path)
312			if err != nil {
313				return Observation{}, fmt.Errorf("catalog observation path: %w", err)
314			}
315		}
316		if observation.RealPath != "" {
317			observation.RealPath, err = pathx.Canonical(observation.RealPath)
318			if err != nil {
319				return Observation{}, fmt.Errorf("catalog observation real path: %w", err)
320			}
321		} else if observation.Path != "" {
322			observation.RealPath, err = pathx.Canonical(observation.Path)
323			if err != nil {
324				return Observation{}, fmt.Errorf("catalog observation path: %w", err)
325			}
326		}
327		if commonDir != "" {
328			observation.CommonDir, err = pathx.Canonical(commonDir)
329			if err != nil {
330				return Observation{}, fmt.Errorf("catalog observation Git common directory: %w", err)
331			}
332		}
333		observation.GitCommonDir = observation.CommonDir
334		observation.RemoteIdentity = NormalizeRemoteIdentity(observation.RemoteIdentity)
335	
336		if requireLocation && observation.Path == "" && observation.RealPath == "" {
337			return Observation{}, errors.New("catalog repository observation requires a path")
338		}
339		if observation.Name == "" {
340			path := observation.Path
341			if path == "" {
342				path = observation.RealPath
343			}
344			observation.Name = filepath.Base(path)
345		}
346		if requireLocation && (observation.Name == "" || observation.Name == ".") {
347			return Observation{}, errors.New("catalog repository observation requires a name")
348		}
349		return observation, nil
350	}
351	
352	func absoluteClean(path string) (string, error) {
353		absolute, err := filepath.Abs(path)
354		if err != nil {
355			return "", err
356		}
357		return filepath.Clean(absolute), nil
358	}
359	
360	func canonicalValues(values ...string) map[string]struct{} {
361		out := make(map[string]struct{}, len(values))
362		for _, value := range values {
363			if canonical := canonicalValue(value); canonical != "" {
364				out[canonical] = struct{}{}
365			}
366		}
367		return out
368	}
369	
370	func canonicalValue(value string) string {
371		if value == "" {
372			return ""
373		}
374		canonical, err := pathx.Canonical(value)
375		if err != nil {
376			return ""
377		}
378		return canonical
379	}
380	
381	func intersects(left, right map[string]struct{}) bool {
382		for value := range left {
383			if _, ok := right[value]; ok {
384				return true
385			}
386		}
387		return false
388	}
389	
390	// NormalizeRemoteIdentity converts common HTTPS and SCP-style Git URLs into a
391	// stable lower-case host/path key. The result remains only a hint for matching.
392	func NormalizeRemoteIdentity(identity string) string {
393		identity = strings.TrimSpace(identity)
394		if identity == "" {
395			return ""
396		}
397		if parsed, err := url.Parse(identity); err == nil && parsed.Scheme != "" && parsed.Host != "" {
398			identity = parsed.Host + "/" + strings.TrimPrefix(parsed.Path, "/")
399		} else if at := strings.LastIndexByte(identity, '@'); at >= 0 {
400			afterUser := identity[at+1:]
401			if colon := strings.IndexByte(afterUser, ':'); colon >= 0 {
402				identity = afterUser[:colon] + "/" + afterUser[colon+1:]
403			}
404		}
405		identity = strings.Trim(identity, "/")
406		identity = strings.TrimSuffix(identity, ".git")
407		return strings.ToLower(identity)
408	}

1	// Package pathx provides the path-safety checks shared by filesystem lifecycle
2	// operations. The checks are strict: a destination must be below its root, not
3	// merely share a string prefix with it, and symlinks are resolved before that
4	// decision is made.
5	package pathx
6	
7	import (
8		"errors"
9		"fmt"
10		"io/fs"
11		"path/filepath"
12		"slices"
13		"strings"
14	)
15	
16	var (
17		// ErrOutsideRoot reports a path that does not resolve below the requested root.
18		ErrOutsideRoot = errors.New("path is outside root")
19		// ErrRoot reports an operation that named the root itself rather than a child.
20		ErrRoot = errors.New("path is the root itself")
21		// ErrTraversal reports an explicit .. component in an unclean input path.
22		ErrTraversal = errors.New("path contains parent traversal")
23		// ErrInvalidComponent reports a value that is not one filesystem component.
24		ErrInvalidComponent = errors.New("invalid path component")
25	)
26	
27	// Canonical returns an absolute, clean path with symlinks resolved. If the final
28	// path does not exist yet, it resolves the nearest existing ancestor and then
29	// appends the missing suffix. This is the form needed to validate a destination
30	// before creating or moving anything into it.
31	func Canonical(path string) (string, error) {
32		if path == "" {
33			return "", fmt.Errorf("canonical path: empty path")
34		}
35		absolute, err := filepath.Abs(path)
36		if err != nil {
37			return "", fmt.Errorf("make %q absolute: %w", path, err)
38		}
39		absolute = filepath.Clean(absolute)
40	
41		probe := absolute
42		var missing []string
43		for {
44			resolved, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(probe)
45			if err == nil {
46				slices.Reverse(missing)
47				parts := append([]string{resolved}, missing...)
48				return filepath.Clean(filepath.Join(parts...)), nil
49			}
50			if !errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
51				return "", fmt.Errorf("resolve %q: %w", path, err)
52			}
53			parent := filepath.Dir(probe)
54			if parent == probe {
55				return "", fmt.Errorf("resolve %q: no existing ancestor: %w", path, err)
56			}
57			missing = append(missing, filepath.Base(probe))
58			probe = parent
59		}
60	}
61	
62	// CanonicalChild returns candidate in canonical form when it resolves strictly
63	// below root. It rejects root itself, lexical .. traversal, sibling-prefix
64	// confusion, and paths that escape through a symlink.
65	func CanonicalChild(root, candidate string) (string, error) {
66		if hasParentTraversal(candidate) {
67			return "", fmt.Errorf("%q: %w", candidate, ErrTraversal)
68		}
69		canonicalRoot, err := Canonical(root)
70		if err != nil {
71			return "", fmt.Errorf("canonicalize root: %w", err)
72		}
73		canonicalCandidate, err := Canonical(candidate)
74		if err != nil {
75			return "", fmt.Errorf("canonicalize candidate: %w", err)
76		}
77	
78		rel, err := filepath.Rel(canonicalRoot, canonicalCandidate)
79		if err != nil {
80			return "", fmt.Errorf("compare %q with root %q: %w", candidate, root, err)
81		}
82		switch {
83		case rel == ".":
84			return "", fmt.Errorf("%q: %w", candidate, ErrRoot)
85		case filepath.IsAbs(rel), rel == "..", strings.HasPrefix(rel, ".."+string(filepath.Separator)):
86			return "", fmt.Errorf("%q is not below %q: %w", candidate, root, ErrOutsideRoot)
87		default:
88			return canonicalCandidate, nil
89		}
90	}
91	
92	// IsChild reports whether candidate resolves strictly below root. Policy
93	// rejections are returned as false without hiding filesystem errors.
94	func IsChild(root, candidate string) (bool, error) {
95		_, err := CanonicalChild(root, candidate)
96		if err == nil {
97			return true, nil
98		}
99		if errors.Is(err, ErrOutsideRoot) || errors.Is(err, ErrRoot) || errors.Is(err, ErrTraversal) {
100			return false, nil
101		}
102		return false, err
103	}
104	
105	// ValidateComponent requires a non-empty relative value containing exactly one
106	// path component. Both slash styles are rejected so state synced between Unix
107	// and Windows cannot acquire a different meaning on another host.
108	func ValidateComponent(component string) error {
109		switch {
110		case strings.TrimSpace(component) == "":
111			return fmt.Errorf("empty component: %w", ErrInvalidComponent)
112		case strings.ContainsRune(component, '\x00'):
113			return fmt.Errorf("component contains NUL: %w", ErrInvalidComponent)
114		case component == "." || component == "..":
115			return fmt.Errorf("component %q is reserved: %w", component, ErrInvalidComponent)
116		case filepath.IsAbs(component) || filepath.VolumeName(component) != "" || driveQualified(component):
117			return fmt.Errorf("component %q is absolute or drive-qualified: %w", component, ErrInvalidComponent)
118		case strings.ContainsAny(component, `/\\`):
119			return fmt.Errorf("component %q contains a path separator: %w", component, ErrInvalidComponent)
120		case filepath.Clean(component) != component || filepath.Base(component) != component:
121			return fmt.Errorf("component %q is not a single clean name: %w", component, ErrInvalidComponent)
122		default:
123			return nil
124		}
125	}
126	
127	// JoinChild validates every component, joins it below root, and returns the
128	// canonical destination. It is suitable for paths such as
129	// <project-root>/<category>/<name>, where each user-supplied value must remain a
130	// single component.
131	func JoinChild(root string, components ...string) (string, error) {
132		if len(components) == 0 {
133			return "", fmt.Errorf("join child: no components: %w", ErrRoot)
134		}
135		for i, component := range components {
136			if err := ValidateComponent(component); err != nil {
137				return "", fmt.Errorf("component %d: %w", i, err)
138			}
139		}
140		canonicalRoot, err := Canonical(root)
141		if err != nil {
142			return "", fmt.Errorf("canonicalize root: %w", err)
143		}
144		return CanonicalChild(canonicalRoot, filepath.Join(append([]string{canonicalRoot}, components...)...))
145	}
146	
147	func driveQualified(component string) bool {
148		if len(component) < 2 || component[1] != ':' {
149			return false
150		}
151		letter := component[0]
152		return letter >= 'a' && letter <= 'z' || letter >= 'A' && letter <= 'Z'
153	}
154	
155	func hasParentTraversal(path string) bool {
156		for _, component := range strings.FieldsFunc(path, func(r rune) bool {
157			return r == '/' || r == '\\'
158		}) {
159			if component == ".." {
160				return true
161			}
162		}
163		return false
164	}
