1	package task
2	
3	import (
4		"errors"
5		"fmt"
6		"io/fs"
7		"os"
8		"path/filepath"
9		"regexp"
10		"sort"
11		"strings"
12		"time"
13	
14		"github.com/BurntSushi/toml"
15	)
16	
17	// ErrNotFound is returned when no task matches an identifier.
18	var ErrNotFound = errors.New("no such task")
19	
20	// Store is a directory of one-TOML-file-per-task.
21	//
22	// One file per task, rather than a single registry document, is a deliberate
23	// choice: the state directory is meant to be syncable across machines (it can
24	// simply be a git repo), and a shared central file would conflict on every
25	// parallel edit while separate files merge cleanly.
26	type Store struct{ Dir string }
27	
28	// NewStore returns a store rooted at dir.
29	func NewStore(dir string) *Store { return &Store{Dir: dir} }
30	
31	var idUnsafe = regexp.MustCompile(`[^a-zA-Z0-9._-]+`)
32	
33	// MakeID derives the stable filename stem for a repo+branch pair.
34	func MakeID(repo, branch string) string {
35		clean := func(s string) string {
36			s = idUnsafe.ReplaceAllString(s, "-")
37			for strings.Contains(s, "--") {
38				s = strings.ReplaceAll(s, "--", "-")
39			}
40			return strings.Trim(s, "-._")
41		}
42		r, b := clean(repo), clean(branch)
43		if r == "" {
44			r = "repo"
45		}
46		if b == "" {
47			b = "branch"
48		}
49		return r + "__" + b
50	}
51	
52	func (s *Store) path(id string) string { return filepath.Join(s.Dir, id+".toml") }
53	
54	// Save writes a task, stamping Updated (and Created on first write).
55	func (s *Store) Save(t *Task) error {
56		if t.ID == "" {
57			t.ID = MakeID(t.Repo, t.Branch)
58		}
59		if err := t.Validate(); err != nil {
60			return err
61		}
62		now := time.Now().UTC().Truncate(time.Second)
63		if t.Created.IsZero() {
64			t.Created = now
65		}
66		t.Updated = now
67	
68		if err := os.MkdirAll(s.Dir, 0o755); err != nil {
69			return fmt.Errorf("create state dir: %w", err)
70		}
71		// Write to a temp file and rename, so an interrupted write can never leave
72		// a half-parsed task behind.
73		tmp, err := os.CreateTemp(s.Dir, "."+t.ID+".*.tmp")
74		if err != nil {
75			return err
76		}
77		defer os.Remove(tmp.Name())
78		enc := toml.NewEncoder(tmp)
79		if err := enc.Encode(t); err != nil {
80			tmp.Close()
81			return fmt.Errorf("encode task %s: %w", t.ID, err)
82		}
83		if err := tmp.Close(); err != nil {
84			return err
85		}
86		if err := os.Chmod(tmp.Name(), 0o644); err != nil {
87			return err
88		}
89		return os.Rename(tmp.Name(), s.path(t.ID))
90	}
91	
92	// Get loads one task by its exact id.
93	func (s *Store) Get(id string) (*Task, error) {
94		var t Task
95		if _, err := toml.DecodeFile(s.path(id), &t); err != nil {
96			if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
97				return nil, fmt.Errorf("%q: %w", id, ErrNotFound)
98			}
99			return nil, fmt.Errorf("read task %s: %w", id, err)
100		}
101		t.ID = id
102		return &t, nil
103	}
104	
105	// List loads every task, sorted by state (hot first) then most recent.
106	func (s *Store) List() ([]*Task, error) {
107		entries, err := os.ReadDir(s.Dir)
108		if err != nil {
109			if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
110				return nil, nil // no state yet is a normal, empty inventory
111			}
112			return nil, err
113		}
114		var out []*Task
115		for _, e := range entries {
116			name := e.Name()
117			if e.IsDir() || !strings.HasSuffix(name, ".toml") || strings.HasPrefix(name, ".") {
118				continue
119			}
120			id := strings.TrimSuffix(name, ".toml")
121			t, err := s.Get(id)
122			if err != nil {
123				// One corrupt file must not hide the rest of the inventory.
124				fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "dev: warning: skipping %s: %v\n", name, err)
125				continue
126			}
127			out = append(out, t)
128		}
129		Sort(out)
130		return out, nil
131	}
132	
133	// Delete removes a task entry. It never touches git state.
134	func (s *Store) Delete(id string) error {
135		err := os.Remove(s.path(id))
136		if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
137			return fmt.Errorf("%q: %w", id, ErrNotFound)
138		}
139		return err
140	}
141	
142	// Resolve finds a task from a loose user-supplied reference: an exact id, an
143	// exact branch, or a unique case-insensitive substring of the id, name or
144	// branch. An ambiguous reference is an error listing the candidates rather
145	// than a silent pick.
146	func (s *Store) Resolve(ref string) (*Task, error) {
147		if ref == "" {
148			return nil, fmt.Errorf("empty task reference: %w", ErrNotFound)
149		}
150		all, err := s.List()
151		if err != nil {
152			return nil, err
153		}
154		for _, t := range all {
155			if t.ID == ref || t.Branch == ref {
156				return t, nil
157			}
158		}
159		needle := strings.ToLower(ref)
160		var hits []*Task
161		for _, t := range all {
162			hay := strings.ToLower(t.ID + " " + t.Name + " " + t.Branch + " " + t.Repo)
163			if strings.Contains(hay, needle) {
164				hits = append(hits, t)
165			}
166		}
167		switch len(hits) {
168		case 1:
169			return hits[0], nil
170		case 0:
171			return nil, fmt.Errorf("%q: %w", ref, ErrNotFound)
172		default:
173			names := make([]string, len(hits))
174			for i, t := range hits {
175				names[i] = t.ID
176			}
177			return nil, fmt.Errorf("%q is ambiguous: %s", ref, strings.Join(names, ", "))
178		}
179	}
180	
181	// FindByWorktree returns the task whose checkout contains dir.
182	//
183	// A task lives at exactly one place: its worktree when it has one, otherwise
184	// the main checkout. A task that has a linked worktree therefore does *not*
185	// claim the main checkout — otherwise standing in the main repo would match
186	// every worktree-based task of that repo. Among candidates, the longest path
187	// match wins so a nested checkout beats its parent.
188	func (s *Store) FindByWorktree(dir string) (*Task, error) {
189		all, err := s.List()
190		if err != nil {
191			return nil, err
192		}
193		under := func(dir, root string) bool {
194			return root != "" && (dir == root || strings.HasPrefix(dir, root+string(filepath.Separator)))
195		}
196		var best *Task
197		var bestLen int
198		for _, t := range all {
199			root := t.WorktreePath
200			if root == "" {
201				root = t.RepoPath
202			}
203			if under(dir, root) && len(root) > bestLen {
204				best, bestLen = t, len(root)
205			}
206		}
207		if best == nil {
208			return nil, fmt.Errorf("%q: %w", dir, ErrNotFound)
209		}
210		return best, nil
211	}
212	
213	// stateRank orders states so the inventory reads as an attention queue.
214	func stateRank(s State) int {
215		switch s {
216		case Hot:
217			return 0
218		case Warm:
219			return 1
220		case Cold:
221			return 2
222		case Done:
223			return 3
224		}
225		return 4
226	}
227	
228	// Sort orders tasks hot-first, then by most recently updated.
229	func Sort(ts []*Task) {
230		sort.SliceStable(ts, func(i, j int) bool {
231			ri, rj := stateRank(ts[i].State), stateRank(ts[j].State)
232			if ri != rj {
233				return ri < rj
234			}
235			if !ts[i].Updated.Equal(ts[j].Updated) {
236				return ts[i].Updated.After(ts[j].Updated)
237			}
238			return ts[i].ID < ts[j].ID
239		})
240	}
241
```

256	// Load reads config.toml over the defaults. A missing file is not an error —
257	// dev must be useful with zero setup. A malformed file is, because silently
258	// falling back to defaults would send worktrees to the wrong volume.
259	func Load(path string) (Config, error) {
260		cfg := Default()
261		if path == "" {
262			path = ConfigFile()
263		}
264		md, err := toml.DecodeFile(path, &cfg)
265		switch {
266		case errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist):
267			return cfg, nil
268		case err != nil:
269			return cfg, fmt.Errorf("read %s: %w", path, err)
270		}
271		if undecoded := md.Undecoded(); len(undecoded) > 0 {
272			// Unknown keys are usually typos ("worktree_dir" vs "worktree_root").
273			// Warn rather than fail so a newer config still works on an older dev.
274			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "dev: warning: unknown key(s) in %s: %v\n", path, undecoded)
275		}

282	func (c Config) Validate() error {

312		if !validStrategy(c.Worktree.Strategy) {

314		}
315		for ecosystem, strategy := range c.Worktree.Strategies {

318					ecosystem, strategy)

324			"category": true, "path": true,

328				return fmt.Errorf("tui.repos.columns[%d] %q: unknown column", i, column)
329			}

333		default:
334			return fmt.Errorf("tui.repos.sort %q: want activity, latest, name, git or tasks", c.TUI.Repos.Sort)

350			}
351			seen[t.Key] = t.Name

1	// Package cli assembles dev's command tree. Commands stay thin: they parse
2	// flags, call into the domain packages, and render. All policy lives in
3	// config, catalog, gitx, wt, task and runtime so it can be tested without a terminal.
4	package cli
5	
6	import (
7		"context"
8		"fmt"
9		"io"
10		"os"
11	
12		"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/catalog"
13		"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/config"
14		"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/runtime"
15		"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/task"
16	)
17	
18	// App is the state shared by every command.
19	type App struct {
20		Cfg      config.Config
21		Tasks    *task.Store
22		Catalog  *catalog.Store
23		Registry *catalog.Registry
24	
25		Out io.Writer
26		Err io.Writer
27	
28		// configPath is the --config override; empty means the XDG default.
29		configPath string
30		// runtimeOverride is the --runtime flag; empty means use the config.
31		runtimeOverride string
32		// noRuntime disables all multiplexer interaction for one invocation.
33		noRuntime bool
34	}
35	
36	// Load reads configuration and prepares the shared stores.
37	func (a *App) Load() error {
38		cfg, err := config.Load(a.configPath)
39		if err != nil {
40			return err
41		}
42		a.Cfg = cfg
43		if a.Out == nil {
44			a.Out = os.Stdout
45		}
46		if a.Err == nil {
47			a.Err = os.Stderr
48		}
49		a.Tasks = task.NewStore(cfg.TasksDir())
50		a.Catalog = catalog.NewStore(cfg.AssetsDir(), catalog.WithDiagnosticSink(func(diagnostic catalog.Diagnostic) {
51			fmt.Fprintf(a.Err, "dev: warning: %s\n", diagnostic.Error())
52		}))
53		a.Registry = catalog.NewRegistry(a.Catalog)
54		return nil
55	}
56	
57	// Runtime resolves the multiplexer backend for this invocation, honouring
58	// --runtime and --no-runtime.
59	func (a *App) Runtime() runtime.Runtime {
60		if a.noRuntime {
61			return runtime.None{}
62		}
63		backend := a.Cfg.Runtime.Backend
64		if a.runtimeOverride != "" {
65			backend = a.runtimeOverride
66		}
67		rt := runtime.Select(backend)
68		if h, ok := rt.(*runtime.Herdr); ok {
69			return h.WithMetadataSource(a.Cfg.Runtime.MetadataSource)
70		}
71		return rt
72	}
73	
74	// printf writes to the command's stdout.
75	func (a *App) printf(format string, args ...any) {
76		fmt.Fprintf(a.Out, format, args...)
77	}
78	
79	// warnf writes a non-fatal notice to stderr, so it never pollutes piped output.
80	func (a *App) warnf(format string, args ...any) {
81		fmt.Fprintf(a.Err, "dev: "+format+"\n", args...)
82	}
83	
84	// cdDirective emits the marker the shell wrapper installed by
85	// `dev shell-init` looks for. A child process cannot change its parent's
86	// working directory, so the only way `dev resume` can leave the user *in* the
87	// checkout is to ask the shell to do it.
88	func (a *App) cdDirective(dir string) {
89		fmt.Fprintf(a.Out, "cd %s\n", shellQuote(dir))
90	}

93	func ctxOf() context.Context { return context.Background() }

17	const CurrentSchemaVersion = 1
18	
19	var (
20		// ErrUnsupportedSchema identifies a catalog record written with an unknown
21		// nonzero schema. Callers must surface it instead of interpreting newer data
22		// using today's shape.
23		ErrUnsupportedSchema = errors.New("unsupported catalog schema version")
24		// ErrInvalidID identifies a filename stem that cannot safely name one record.
25		ErrInvalidID = errors.New("invalid catalog ID")
26	)
27	
28	// UnsupportedSchemaError describes a record whose schema this version cannot
29	// read. It supports errors.Is(err, ErrUnsupportedSchema).
30	type UnsupportedSchemaError struct {
31		ID      string
32		Version int
33	}
34	
35	func (e *UnsupportedSchemaError) Error() string {
36		if e.ID == "" {
37			return fmt.Sprintf("catalog schema version %d: %v", e.Version, ErrUnsupportedSchema)
38		}
39		return fmt.Sprintf("catalog asset %s has schema version %d: %v", e.ID, e.Version, ErrUnsupportedSchema)
40	}
41	
42	func (e *UnsupportedSchemaError) Unwrap() error { return ErrUnsupportedSchema }
43	
44	// Kind distinguishes short-lived experiments from ordinary repositories.
45	type Kind string
46	
47	const (
48		KindTry        Kind = "try"
49		KindRepository Kind = "repository"
50	
51		// Short aliases keep call sites readable when the type already supplies the
52		// context, for example Entry{Kind: catalog.Repository}.
53		Try        = KindTry
54		Repository = KindRepository
55	)
56	
57	// ExperimentPhase is the retained lifecycle of an experiment, including after
58	// it graduates into a repository.
59	type ExperimentPhase string
60	
61	const (
62		PhaseActive     ExperimentPhase = "active"
63		PhaseDeprecated ExperimentPhase = "deprecated"
64		PhaseGraduated  ExperimentPhase = "graduated"
65	
66		Active     = PhaseActive
67		Deprecated = PhaseDeprecated
68		Graduated  = PhaseGraduated
69	)
70	
71	// LocationState describes what remains on one host.
72	type LocationState string
73	
74	const (
75		LocationPresent  LocationState = "present"
76		LocationArchived LocationState = "archived"
77		LocationEvicted  LocationState = "evicted"
78	
79		Present  = LocationPresent
80		Archived = LocationArchived
81		Evicted  = LocationEvicted
82	)
83	
84	// Experiment records provenance that must survive renames and graduation.
85	type Experiment struct {
86		Phase ExperimentPhase `toml:"phase" json:"phase"`
87	
88		Started      time.Time `toml:"started" json:"started"`
89		OriginalPath string    `toml:"original_path" json:"original_path"`
90	
91		DeprecatedAt   time.Time `toml:"deprecated_at" json:"deprecated_at"`
92		DeprecatedPath string    `toml:"deprecated_path" json:"deprecated_path"`
93		GraduatedAt    time.Time `toml:"graduated_at" json:"graduated_at"`
94		GraduatedPath  string    `toml:"graduated_path" json:"graduated_path"`
95	}
96	
97	// Location is one host's knowledge of an asset. CurrentPath is where bytes live
98	// now; RestorePath is where an archived or evicted asset should return. RealPath
99	// and GitCommonDir make symlink aliases and linked worktrees match the same clone.
100	type Location struct {
101		State LocationState `toml:"state" json:"state"`
102	
103		CurrentPath  string `toml:"current_path" json:"current_path"`
104		RestorePath  string `toml:"restore_path" json:"restore_path"`
105		RealPath     string `toml:"real_path" json:"real_path"`
106		GitCommonDir string `toml:"git_common_dir" json:"git_common_dir"`
107	
108		Updated time.Time `toml:"updated" json:"updated"`
109	}
110	
111	// RecoveryReceipt is enough metadata to explain and verify how an evicted asset
112	// can be reconstructed. Different recovery methods use different subsets.
113	type RecoveryReceipt struct {
114		Host           string    `toml:"host" json:"host"`
115		Method         string    `toml:"method" json:"method"`
116		SourcePath     string    `toml:"source_path" json:"source_path"`
117		RestorePath    string    `toml:"restore_path" json:"restore_path"`
118		RemoteIdentity string    `toml:"remote_identity" json:"remote_identity"`
119		Revision       string    `toml:"revision" json:"revision"`
120		ArchivePath    string    `toml:"archive_path" json:"archive_path"`
121		Checksum       string    `toml:"checksum" json:"checksum"`
122		Created        time.Time `toml:"created" json:"created"`
123		Verified       time.Time `toml:"verified" json:"verified"`
124	}
125	
126	// MoveIntent is written before a filesystem rename and cleared after the new
127	// location is durable. A surviving intent lets later commands reconcile a move
128	// interrupted between those two points.
129	type MoveIntent struct {
130		Host            string    `toml:"host" json:"host"`
131		Operation       string    `toml:"operation" json:"operation"`
132		SourcePath      string    `toml:"source_path" json:"source_path"`
133		DestinationPath string    `toml:"destination_path" json:"destination_path"`
134		Started         time.Time `toml:"started" json:"started"`
135	}
136	
137	// Entry is one logical asset. ID is the stable filename stem and is deliberately
138	// not duplicated inside the TOML document.
139	type Entry struct {
140		SchemaVersion int      `toml:"schema_version" json:"schema_version"`
141		ID            string   `toml:"-" json:"id"`
142		Kind          Kind     `toml:"kind" json:"kind"`
143		Name          string   `toml:"name" json:"name"`
144		Note          string   `toml:"note" json:"note"`
145		Tags          []string `toml:"tags" json:"tags"`
146	
147		// RemoteIdentity is a relocation hint, never sufficient on its own when
148		// several records or live clones could be the observation's owner.
149		RemoteIdentity string `toml:"remote_identity" json:"remote_identity"`
150	
151		Experiment      *Experiment         `toml:"experiment,omitempty" json:"experiment,omitempty"`
152		Locations       map[string]Location `toml:"locations" json:"locations"`
153		RecoveryReceipt *RecoveryReceipt    `toml:"recovery_receipt,omitempty" json:"recovery_receipt,omitempty"`
154		MoveIntent      *MoveIntent         `toml:"move_intent,omitempty" json:"move_intent,omitempty"`
155	
156		Created    time.Time `toml:"created" json:"created"`
157		Discovered time.Time `toml:"discovered" json:"discovered"`
158		LastOpened time.Time `toml:"last_opened" json:"last_opened"`
159		Updated    time.Time `toml:"updated" json:"updated"`
160	}
161	
162	var validID = regexp.MustCompile(`^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]*$`)
163	
164	// ValidateID checks that id can be used as exactly one visible filename stem.
165	func ValidateID(id string) error {
166		if !validID.MatchString(id) || filepath.Base(id) != id || id == "." || id == ".." {
167			return fmt.Errorf("%q: %w", id, ErrInvalidID)
168		}
169		return nil
170	}
171	
172	// NormalizeTags trims, lowercases, deduplicates and sorts tags. Sorting makes
173	// persisted output deterministic regardless of the order in which callers add
174	// labels.
175	func NormalizeTags(tags []string) []string {
176		seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(tags))
177		for _, tag := range tags {
178			tag = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(tag))
179			if tag != "" {
180				seen[tag] = struct{}{}
181			}
182		}
183		out := make([]string, 0, len(seen))
184		for tag := range seen {
185			out = append(out, tag)
186		}
187		sort.Strings(out)
188		return out
189	}
190	
191	// Normalize applies the lossless normalizations stores use before validation.
192	func (e *Entry) Normalize() {
193		if e == nil {
194			return
195		}
196		e.Name = strings.TrimSpace(e.Name)
197		e.Tags = NormalizeTags(e.Tags)
198		if e.Experiment != nil && e.Experiment.Phase == "" {
199			e.Experiment.Phase = PhaseActive
200		}
201	}
202	
203	// Title is the human label, falling back to the stable ID for damaged display
204	// data. Persisted entries still require a name during validation.
205	func (e Entry) Title() string {
206		if e.Name != "" {
207			return e.Name
208		}
209		return e.ID
210	}
211	
212	// HasTag reports membership after applying the same normalization as storage.
213	func (e Entry) HasTag(tag string) bool {
214		tag = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(tag))
215		return tag != "" && slices.Contains(e.Tags, tag)
216	}
217	
218	// LocationFor returns host's location without exposing the map for mutation.
219	func (e Entry) LocationFor(host string) (Location, bool) {
220		location, ok := e.Locations[host]
221		return location, ok
222	}
223	
224	// SetLocation validates and records one host location.
225	func (e *Entry) SetLocation(host string, location Location) error {
226		if e == nil {
227			return errors.New("set location on nil catalog entry")
228		}
229		if err := validateLocation(host, location); err != nil {
230			return err
231		}
232		if e.Locations == nil {
233			e.Locations = make(map[string]Location)
234		}
235		e.Locations[host] = location
236		return nil
237	}
238	
239	// Clone returns a deep copy suitable for mutation before an atomic update.
240	func (e Entry) Clone() *Entry {
241		clone := e
242		clone.Tags = append([]string(nil), e.Tags...)
243		if e.Experiment != nil {
244			value := *e.Experiment
245			clone.Experiment = &value
246		}
247		if e.RecoveryReceipt != nil {
248			value := *e.RecoveryReceipt
249			clone.RecoveryReceipt = &value
250		}
251		if e.MoveIntent != nil {
252			value := *e.MoveIntent
253			clone.MoveIntent = &value
254		}
255		if e.Locations != nil {
256			clone.Locations = make(map[string]Location, len(e.Locations))
257			for host, location := range e.Locations {
258				clone.Locations[host] = location
259			}
260		}
261		return &clone
262	}
263	
264	// Validate rejects records that later lifecycle operations could not interpret
265	// safely. Store.Create fills identity and timestamps before calling it.
266	func (e Entry) Validate() error {
267		if e.SchemaVersion != CurrentSchemaVersion {
268			return &UnsupportedSchemaError{ID: e.ID, Version: e.SchemaVersion}
269		}
270		if err := ValidateID(e.ID); err != nil {
271			return err
272		}
273		switch e.Kind {
274		case KindTry, KindRepository:
275		default:
276			return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s: unknown kind %q", e.ID, e.Kind)
277		}
278		if strings.TrimSpace(e.Name) == "" {
279			return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s: name is required", e.ID)
280		}
281		if !slices.Equal(e.Tags, NormalizeTags(e.Tags)) {
282			return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s: tags must be normalized lowercase values", e.ID)
283		}
284		if e.Experiment != nil {
285			switch e.Experiment.Phase {
286			case PhaseActive, PhaseDeprecated, PhaseGraduated:
287			default:
288				return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s: unknown experiment phase %q", e.ID, e.Experiment.Phase)
289			}
290		}
291		hosts := make([]string, 0, len(e.Locations))
292		for host := range e.Locations {
293			hosts = append(hosts, host)
294		}
295		sort.Strings(hosts)
296		for _, host := range hosts {
297			if err := validateLocation(host, e.Locations[host]); err != nil {
298				return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s: %w", e.ID, err)
299			}
300		}
301		if e.MoveIntent != nil {
302			if e.MoveIntent.SourcePath == "" || e.MoveIntent.DestinationPath == "" {
303				return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s: move intent requires source and destination paths", e.ID)
304			}
305			if e.MoveIntent.SourcePath == e.MoveIntent.DestinationPath {
306				return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s: move intent source and destination are identical", e.ID)
307			}
308		}
309		if e.Created.IsZero() || e.Discovered.IsZero() || e.Updated.IsZero() {
310			return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s: created, discovered and updated timestamps are required", e.ID)
311		}
312		return nil
313	}
314	
315	func validateLocation(host string, location Location) error {
316		if host == "" {
317			return errors.New("location host is required")
318		}
319		if host != strings.TrimSpace(host) {
320			return fmt.Errorf("location host %q is not normalized", host)
321		}
322		fields := []struct {
323			name  string
324			value string
325		}{
326			{"current_path", location.CurrentPath},
327			{"restore_path", location.RestorePath},
328			{"real_path", location.RealPath},
329			{"git_common_dir", location.GitCommonDir},
330		}
331		for _, field := range fields {
332			if strings.ContainsRune(field.value, '\x00') {
333				return fmt.Errorf("location %s %s contains NUL", host, field.name)
334			}
335		}
336		switch location.State {
337		case LocationPresent:
338			if location.CurrentPath == "" {
339				return fmt.Errorf("location %s: present state requires current_path", host)
340			}
341		case LocationArchived:
342			if location.CurrentPath == "" || location.RestorePath == "" {
343				return fmt.Errorf("location %s: archived state requires current_path and restore_path", host)
344			}
345		case LocationEvicted:
346			if location.RestorePath == "" {
347				return fmt.Errorf("location %s: evicted state requires restore_path", host)
348			}
349		default:
350			return fmt.Errorf("location %s: unknown state %q", host, location.State)
351		}
352		return nil
353	}
354

19	var (

26	// Diagnostic describes one record skipped by a directory listing. The listing
27	// still returns every valid record; callers decide whether and where to render
28	// these notices.
29	type Diagnostic struct {
30		Path string
31		Err  error
32	}
33	
34	func (d Diagnostic) Error() string {
35		return fmt.Sprintf("skipping %s: %v", filepath.Base(d.Path), d.Err)
36	}
37	
38	func (d Diagnostic) Unwrap() error { return d.Err }
39	
40	// IDGenerator supplies stable random filename stems. It is injectable so tests
41	// can assert exact filenames without weakening production randomness.
42	type IDGenerator func() string
43	
44	// DiagnosticSink receives non-fatal per-record listing failures.
45	type DiagnosticSink func(Diagnostic)
46	
47	// StoreOption configures a Store.
48	type StoreOption func(*Store)
49	
50	// WithIDGenerator replaces UUID generation.
51	func WithIDGenerator(generator IDGenerator) StoreOption {
52		return func(store *Store) { store.generateID = generator }
53	}
54	
55	// WithClock replaces timestamp generation.
56	func WithClock(clock func() time.Time) StoreOption {
57		return func(store *Store) { store.clock = clock }
58	}
59	
60	// WithDiagnosticSink directs skipped-record notices to sink.
61	func WithDiagnosticSink(sink DiagnosticSink) StoreOption {
62		return func(store *Store) { store.diagnostics = sink }
63	}
64	
65	// WithDiagnosticWriter writes one line per skipped record to writer. It never
66	// defaults to a process-global stream.
67	func WithDiagnosticWriter(writer io.Writer) StoreOption {
68		if writer == nil {
69			return func(*Store) {}
70		}
71		return WithDiagnosticSink(func(diagnostic Diagnostic) {
72			fmt.Fprintln(writer, diagnostic.Error())
73		})
74	}
75	
76	// Store is a directory of one TOML file per asset.
77	type Store struct {
78		Dir string
79	
80		mu          sync.Mutex
81		generateID  IDGenerator
82		clock       func() time.Time
83		diagnostics DiagnosticSink
84	}
85	
86	// NewStore returns a catalog rooted at dir.
87	func NewStore(dir string, options ...StoreOption) *Store {
88		store := &Store{
89			Dir:        dir,
90			generateID: uuid.NewString,
91			clock:      time.Now,
92		}
93		for _, option := range options {
94			if option != nil {
95				option(store)
96			}
97		}
98		return store
99	}
100	
101	func (s *Store) path(id string) string { return filepath.Join(s.Dir, id+".toml") }
102	
103	// Create assigns a random stable ID and atomically persists entry. The caller's
104	// value is updated only after the rename succeeds.
105	func (s *Store) Create(entry *Entry) error {
106		if entry == nil {
107			return errors.New("create nil catalog entry")
108		}
109		if entry.ID != "" {
110			return fmt.Errorf("create catalog asset: ID is assigned by the store")
111		}
112	
113		s.mu.Lock()
114		defer s.mu.Unlock()
115	
116		for range 32 {
117			candidate := entry.Clone()
118			candidate.ID = s.nextID()
119			if err := ValidateID(candidate.ID); err != nil {
120				return fmt.Errorf("generated catalog ID: %w", err)
121			}
122	
123			now := s.now()
124			candidate.SchemaVersion = CurrentSchemaVersion
125			if candidate.Created.IsZero() {
126				candidate.Created = now
127			}
128			if candidate.Discovered.IsZero() {
129				candidate.Discovered = now
130			}
131			candidate.Updated = now
132			prepareNested(candidate, now)
133			candidate.Normalize()
134			if err := candidate.Validate(); err != nil {
135				return err
136			}
137			if err := os.MkdirAll(s.Dir, 0o755); err != nil {
138				return fmt.Errorf("create catalog directory: %w", err)
139			}
140			if _, err := os.Lstat(s.path(candidate.ID)); err == nil {
141				continue
142			} else if !errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
143				return fmt.Errorf("check catalog ID %s: %w", candidate.ID, err)
144			}
145			if err := s.writeAtomic(candidate); err != nil {
146				return err
147			}
148			*entry = *candidate
149			return nil
150		}
151		return fmt.Errorf("generate unique catalog ID: %w", ErrAlreadyExists)
152	}

154	// Get loads one asset by exact ID.
155	func (s *Store) Get(id string) (*Entry, error) {
156		if err := ValidateID(id); err != nil {
157			return nil, err
158		}
159		return s.get(id)
160	}
161	
162	func (s *Store) get(id string) (*Entry, error) {
163		data, err := os.ReadFile(s.path(id))
164		if err != nil {
165			if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
166				return nil, fmt.Errorf("%q: %w", id, ErrNotFound)
167			}
168			return nil, fmt.Errorf("read catalog asset %s: %w", id, err)
169		}
170		var header struct {
171			SchemaVersion int `toml:"schema_version"`
172		}
173		if _, err := toml.Decode(string(data), &header); err != nil {
174			return nil, fmt.Errorf("decode catalog asset %s schema: %w", id, err)
175		}
176		if header.SchemaVersion != 0 && header.SchemaVersion != CurrentSchemaVersion {
177			return nil, &UnsupportedSchemaError{ID: id, Version: header.SchemaVersion}
178		}
179	
180		var entry Entry
181		if _, err := toml.Decode(string(data), &entry); err != nil {
182			return nil, fmt.Errorf("decode catalog asset %s: %w", id, err)
183		}
184		entry.ID = id
185		// Version zero is the only implicit form: it means the schema marker was
186		// absent, not that an unknown future layout should be guessed.
187		if entry.SchemaVersion == 0 {
188			entry.SchemaVersion = CurrentSchemaVersion
189		}
190		entry.Normalize()
191		if err := entry.Validate(); err != nil {
192			return nil, fmt.Errorf("validate catalog asset %s: %w", id, err)
193		}
194		return &entry, nil
195	}
196	
197	// List loads every valid record in deterministic ID order. Per-record failures
198	// are skipped and sent to the configured diagnostic sink; directory-level
199	// failures are returned.
200	func (s *Store) List() ([]*Entry, error) {
201		entries, diagnostics, err := s.ListWithDiagnostics()
202		if err != nil {
203			return nil, err
204		}
205		if s.diagnostics != nil {
206			for _, diagnostic := range diagnostics {
207				s.diagnostics(diagnostic)
208			}
209		}
210		return entries, nil
211	}
212	
213	// ListWithDiagnostics is List's explicit diagnostic form. It is useful to
214	// services that want to aggregate notices rather than render them immediately.
215	func (s *Store) ListWithDiagnostics() ([]*Entry, []Diagnostic, error) {
216		directoryEntries, err := os.ReadDir(s.Dir)
217		if err != nil {
218			if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
219				return nil, nil, nil
220			}
221			return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("read catalog directory: %w", err)
222		}
223	
224		var entries []*Entry
225		var diagnostics []Diagnostic
226		for _, directoryEntry := range directoryEntries {
227			name := directoryEntry.Name()
228			if directoryEntry.IsDir() || strings.HasPrefix(name, ".") || !strings.HasSuffix(name, ".toml") {
229				continue
230			}
231			id := strings.TrimSuffix(name, ".toml")
232			entry, err := s.Get(id)
233			if err != nil {
234				diagnostics = append(diagnostics, Diagnostic{Path: filepath.Join(s.Dir, name), Err: err})
235				continue
236			}
237			entries = append(entries, entry)
238		}
239		Sort(entries)
240		sort.Slice(diagnostics, func(i, j int) bool { return diagnostics[i].Path < diagnostics[j].Path })
241		return entries, diagnostics, nil
242	}
243	
244	// Update applies mutate to a deep copy and atomically replaces the record only
245	// if the mutation and validation both succeed. ID, Created, and Discovered are
246	// immutable.
247	func (s *Store) Update(id string, mutate func(*Entry) error) (*Entry, error) {
248		if err := ValidateID(id); err != nil {
249			return nil, err
250		}
251		if mutate == nil {
252			return nil, errors.New("catalog update requires a mutation")
253		}
254	
255		s.mu.Lock()
256		defer s.mu.Unlock()
257	
258		current, err := s.get(id)
259		if err != nil {
260			return nil, err
261		}
262		updated := current.Clone()
263		if err := mutate(updated); err != nil {
264			return nil, err
265		}
266		if updated.ID != current.ID {
267			return nil, errors.New("catalog update cannot change ID")
268		}
269		if updated.SchemaVersion != current.SchemaVersion {
270			return nil, errors.New("catalog update cannot change schema version")
271		}
272		if !updated.Created.Equal(current.Created) {
273			return nil, errors.New("catalog update cannot change Created")
274		}
275		if !updated.Discovered.Equal(current.Discovered) {
276			return nil, errors.New("catalog update cannot change Discovered")
277		}
278	
279		now := s.now()
280		updated.Updated = now
281		prepareNested(updated, now)
282		updated.Normalize()
283		if err := updated.Validate(); err != nil {
284			return nil, err
285		}
286		if err := s.writeAtomic(updated); err != nil {
287			return nil, err
288		}
289		return updated.Clone(), nil
290	}
291	
292	// Sort orders entries by stable ID.
293	func Sort(entries []*Entry) {
294		sort.SliceStable(entries, func(i, j int) bool {
295			return entries[i].ID < entries[j].ID
296		})
297	}
298	
299	func (s *Store) writeAtomic(entry *Entry) error {
300		temporary, err := os.CreateTemp(s.Dir, "."+entry.ID+".*.tmp")
301		if err != nil {
302			return fmt.Errorf("create catalog temp file: %w", err)
303		}
304		name := temporary.Name()
305		defer os.Remove(name)
306	
307		if err := toml.NewEncoder(temporary).Encode(entry); err != nil {
308			_ = temporary.Close()
309			return fmt.Errorf("encode catalog asset %s: %w", entry.ID, err)
310		}
311		if err := temporary.Close(); err != nil {
312			return fmt.Errorf("close catalog temp file: %w", err)
313		}
314		if err := os.Chmod(name, 0o644); err != nil {
315			return fmt.Errorf("set catalog file mode: %w", err)
316		}
317		if err := os.Rename(name, s.path(entry.ID)); err != nil {
318			return fmt.Errorf("replace catalog asset %s: %w", entry.ID, err)
319		}
320		return nil
321	}
322	
323	func (s *Store) nextID() string {
324		if s.generateID == nil {
325			return uuid.NewString()
326		}
327		return s.generateID()
328	}
329	
330	func (s *Store) now() time.Time {
331		if s.clock == nil {
332			return time.Now().UTC()
333		}
334		return s.clock().UTC()
335	}
336	
337	func prepareNested(entry *Entry, now time.Time) {
338		if entry.Experiment != nil && entry.Experiment.Started.IsZero() {
339			entry.Experiment.Started = now
340		}
341		for host, location := range entry.Locations {
342			if location.Updated.IsZero() {
343				location.Updated = now
344				entry.Locations[host] = location
345			}
346		}
347		if entry.RecoveryReceipt != nil && entry.RecoveryReceipt.Created.IsZero() {
348			entry.RecoveryReceipt.Created = now
349		}
350		if entry.MoveIntent != nil && entry.MoveIntent.Started.IsZero() {
351			entry.MoveIntent.Started = now
352		}
353	}
354

17	var ErrAmbiguous = errors.New("ambiguous catalog match")
18	
19	// AmbiguousMatchError reports records that cannot be safely distinguished. A
20	// remote-only ambiguity is never resolved by picking the first entry.
21	type AmbiguousMatchError struct {
22		Observation  Observation
23		CandidateIDs []string
24		Reason       string
25	}
26	
27	func (e *AmbiguousMatchError) Error() string {
28		reason := e.Reason
29		if reason == "" {
30			reason = "multiple records match"
31		}
32		return fmt.Sprintf("%s: %s (%s)", ErrAmbiguous, reason, strings.Join(e.CandidateIDs, ", "))
33	}
34	
35	func (e *AmbiguousMatchError) Unwrap() error { return ErrAmbiguous }
36	
37	// Observation is live repository identity gathered from discovery. Path is the
38	// navigation path, RealPath its physical target, and either common-dir field may
39	// carry Git's shared administrative directory. CommonDir matches repo.Repo;
40	// GitCommonDir is accepted for callers using gitx.Repo terminology.
41	type Observation struct {
42		Host           string
43		Path           string
44		RealPath       string
45		CommonDir      string
46		GitCommonDir   string
47		Name           string
48		RemoteIdentity string
49	}
50	
51	// Registry adds live matching and lazy repository persistence to a Store.
52	type Registry struct {
53		store *Store
54		mu    sync.Mutex
55	}
56	
57	// NewRegistry returns a registry backed by store.
58	func NewRegistry(store *Store) *Registry { return &Registry{store: store} }
59	
60	// Store exposes the durable store for callers that need listing APIs.
61	func (r *Registry) Store() *Store { return r.store }
62	
63	// Match finds an observation without changing the catalog. Exact canonical path
64	// or common-directory identity on the same host always wins. A remote identity
65	// is considered only as a conservative relocation hint.
66	func (r *Registry) Match(observation Observation) (*Entry, error) {
67		normalized, err := normalizeObservation(observation, false)
68		if err != nil {
69			return nil, err
70		}
71		entry, _, err := r.match(normalized)
72		return entry, err
73	}
74	
75	// EnsureRepository returns the matching repository, attaching the observed host
76	// location when safe. If nothing matches—or a remote is ambiguous because it
77	// may describe another live clone—it creates a distinct repository record.
78	func (r *Registry) EnsureRepository(observation Observation) (*Entry, error) {
79		normalized, err := normalizeObservation(observation, true)
80		if err != nil {
81			return nil, err
82		}
83		if r == nil || r.store == nil {
84			return nil, errors.New("catalog registry has no store")
85		}
86	
87		r.mu.Lock()
88		defer r.mu.Unlock()
89	
90		matched, method, matchErr := r.match(normalized)
91		if matchErr == nil {
92			return r.attach(matched.ID, normalized)
93		}
94		if !errors.Is(matchErr, ErrNotFound) && !(errors.Is(matchErr, ErrAmbiguous) && method == matchRemote) {
95			return nil, matchErr
96		}
97	
98		entry := &Entry{
99			Kind:           KindRepository,
100			Name:           normalized.Name,
101			RemoteIdentity: normalized.RemoteIdentity,
102			Locations: map[string]Location{
103				normalized.Host: locationFromObservation(normalized),
104			},
105		}
106		if err := r.store.Create(entry); err != nil {
107			return nil, err
108		}
109		return entry.Clone(), nil
110	}
111	
112	// Patch applies an atomic catalog mutation.
113	func (r *Registry) Patch(id string, mutate func(*Entry) error) (*Entry, error) {
114		if r == nil || r.store == nil {
115			return nil, errors.New("catalog registry has no store")
116		}
117		return r.store.Update(id, mutate)
118	}
119	
120	// Attach explicitly records observation as id's present location. Explicit
121	// attachment may update a changed remote because the caller supplied the stable
122	// catalog identity rather than asking the remote hint to choose one.
123	func (r *Registry) Attach(id string, observation Observation) (*Entry, error) {
124		normalized, err := normalizeObservation(observation, true)
125		if err != nil {
126			return nil, err
127		}
128		if r == nil || r.store == nil {
129			return nil, errors.New("catalog registry has no store")
130		}
131		return r.attach(id, normalized)
132	}
133	
134	func (r *Registry) attach(id string, observation Observation) (*Entry, error) {
135		return r.store.Update(id, func(entry *Entry) error {
136			if observation.RemoteIdentity != "" {
137				entry.RemoteIdentity = observation.RemoteIdentity
138			}
139			return entry.SetLocation(observation.Host, locationFromObservation(observation))
140		})
141	}
142	
143	// FindByPath performs only exact host+canonical-path matching; it never falls
144	// back to a remote identity.
145	func (r *Registry) FindByPath(host, path string) (*Entry, error) {
146		normalized, err := normalizeObservation(Observation{Host: host, Path: path}, false)
147		if err != nil {
148			return nil, err
149		}
150		entries, err := r.entries()
151		if err != nil {
152			return nil, err
153		}
154		matches := exactMatches(entries, normalized)
155		return selectExact(normalized, matches)
156	}
157	
158	// FindByCommonDir performs exact host+Git-common-directory matching.
159	func (r *Registry) FindByCommonDir(host, commonDir string) (*Entry, error) {
160		normalized, err := normalizeObservation(Observation{Host: host, CommonDir: commonDir}, false)
161		if err != nil {
162			return nil, err
163		}
164		entries, err := r.entries()
165		if err != nil {
166			return nil, err
167		}
168		matches := exactMatches(entries, normalized)
169		return selectExact(normalized, matches)
170	}
171	
172	type matchMethod int
173	
174	const (
175		matchNone matchMethod = iota
176		matchExact
177		matchRemote
178	)
179	
180	func (r *Registry) match(observation Observation) (*Entry, matchMethod, error) {
181		entries, err := r.entries()
182		if err != nil {
183			return nil, matchNone, err
184		}
185		if matches := exactMatches(entries, observation); len(matches) > 0 {
186			entry, err := selectExact(observation, matches)
187			return entry, matchExact, err
188		}
189		if observation.RemoteIdentity == "" {
190			return nil, matchNone, fmt.Errorf("catalog observation %q: %w", observation.Path, ErrNotFound)
191		}
192	
193		var remoteMatches []*Entry
194		for _, entry := range entries {
195			if NormalizeRemoteIdentity(entry.RemoteIdentity) == observation.RemoteIdentity {
196				remoteMatches = append(remoteMatches, entry)
197			}
198		}
199		Sort(remoteMatches)
200		switch len(remoteMatches) {
201		case 0:
202			return nil, matchNone, fmt.Errorf("remote %q: %w", observation.RemoteIdentity, ErrNotFound)
203		case 1:
204			if remoteCanRelocate(remoteMatches[0], observation) {
205				return remoteMatches[0], matchRemote, nil
206			}
207			return nil, matchRemote, ambiguous(observation, remoteMatches,
208				"remote also belongs to a different live clone on this host")
209		default:
210			return nil, matchRemote, ambiguous(observation, remoteMatches,
211				"remote identity matches multiple catalog records")
212		}
213	}
214	
215	func (r *Registry) entries() ([]*Entry, error) {
216		if r == nil || r.store == nil {
217			return nil, errors.New("catalog registry has no store")
218		}
219		return r.store.List()
220	}
221	
222	func exactMatches(entries []*Entry, observation Observation) []*Entry {
223		matched := make(map[string]*Entry)
224		observationPaths := canonicalValues(observation.Path, observation.RealPath)
225		observationCommon := canonicalValue(observation.CommonDir)
226		for _, entry := range entries {
227			location, ok := entry.LocationFor(observation.Host)
228			if !ok {
229				continue
230			}
231			locationPaths := canonicalValues(location.CurrentPath, location.RestorePath, location.RealPath)
232			pathMatch := intersects(observationPaths, locationPaths)
233			commonMatch := observationCommon != "" && observationCommon == canonicalValue(location.GitCommonDir)
234			if pathMatch || commonMatch {
235				matched[entry.ID] = entry
236			}
237		}
238		out := make([]*Entry, 0, len(matched))
239		for _, entry := range matched {
240			out = append(out, entry)
241		}
242		Sort(out)
243		return out
244	}
245	
246	func selectExact(observation Observation, matches []*Entry) (*Entry, error) {
247		switch len(matches) {
248		case 0:
249			return nil, fmt.Errorf("catalog path %q on host %q: %w", observation.Path, observation.Host, ErrNotFound)
250		case 1:
251			return matches[0], nil
252		default:
253			return nil, ambiguous(observation, matches, "canonical path or Git common directory matches multiple records")
254		}
255	}
256	
257	func ambiguous(observation Observation, entries []*Entry, reason string) error {
258		ids := make([]string, len(entries))
259		for i, entry := range entries {
260			ids[i] = entry.ID
261		}
262		sort.Strings(ids)
263		return &AmbiguousMatchError{Observation: observation, CandidateIDs: ids, Reason: reason}
264	}
265	
266	func remoteCanRelocate(entry *Entry, observation Observation) bool {
267		location, ok := entry.LocationFor(observation.Host)
268		if !ok || location.CurrentPath == "" {
269			return true
270		}
271		// Exact aliases, restore paths, and common directories were already handled.
272		// Any still-present bytes at a different path—including an archive—make the
273		// remote ambiguous rather than evidence that this record moved.
274		_, err := os.Stat(location.CurrentPath)
275		return errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist)
276	}
277	
278	func locationFromObservation(observation Observation) Location {
279		currentPath := observation.Path
280		if currentPath == "" {
281			currentPath = observation.RealPath
282		}
283		return Location{
284			State:        LocationPresent,
285			CurrentPath:  currentPath,
286			RealPath:     observation.RealPath,
287			GitCommonDir: observation.CommonDir,
288		}
289	}
290	
291	func normalizeObservation(observation Observation, requireLocation bool) (Observation, error) {
292		observation.Host = strings.TrimSpace(observation.Host)
293		observation.Name = strings.TrimSpace(observation.Name)
294		if observation.Host == "" {
295			return Observation{}, errors.New("catalog observation host is required")
296		}
297	
298		commonDir := observation.CommonDir
299		if commonDir == "" {
300			commonDir = observation.GitCommonDir
301		} else if observation.GitCommonDir != "" {
302			left, leftErr := pathx.Canonical(commonDir)
303			right, rightErr := pathx.Canonical(observation.GitCommonDir)
304			if leftErr != nil || rightErr != nil || left != right {
305				return Observation{}, errors.New("catalog observation CommonDir and GitCommonDir disagree")
306			}
307		}
308	
309		var err error
310		if observation.Path != "" {
311			observation.Path, err = absoluteClean(observation.Path)
312			if err != nil {
313				return Observation{}, fmt.Errorf("catalog observation path: %w", err)
314			}
315		}
316		if observation.RealPath != "" {
317			observation.RealPath, err = pathx.Canonical(observation.RealPath)
318			if err != nil {
319				return Observation{}, fmt.Errorf("catalog observation real path: %w", err)
320			}
321		} else if observation.Path != "" {
322			observation.RealPath, err = pathx.Canonical(observation.Path)
323			if err != nil {
324				return Observation{}, fmt.Errorf("catalog observation path: %w", err)
325			}
326		}
327		if commonDir != "" {
328			observation.CommonDir, err = pathx.Canonical(commonDir)
329			if err != nil {
330				return Observation{}, fmt.Errorf("catalog observation Git common directory: %w", err)
331			}
332		}
333		observation.GitCommonDir = observation.CommonDir
334		observation.RemoteIdentity = NormalizeRemoteIdentity(observation.RemoteIdentity)
335	
336		if requireLocation && observation.Path == "" && observation.RealPath == "" {
337			return Observation{}, errors.New("catalog repository observation requires a path")
338		}
339		if observation.Name == "" {
340			path := observation.Path
341			if path == "" {
342				path = observation.RealPath
343			}
344			observation.Name = filepath.Base(path)
345		}
346		if requireLocation && (observation.Name == "" || observation.Name == ".") {
347			return Observation{}, errors.New("catalog repository observation requires a name")
348		}
349		return observation, nil
350	}
351	
352	func absoluteClean(path string) (string, error) {
353		absolute, err := filepath.Abs(path)
354		if err != nil {
355			return "", err
356		}
357		return filepath.Clean(absolute), nil
358	}
359	
360	func canonicalValues(values ...string) map[string]struct{} {
361		out := make(map[string]struct{}, len(values))
362		for _, value := range values {
363			if canonical := canonicalValue(value); canonical != "" {
364				out[canonical] = struct{}{}
365			}
366		}
367		return out
368	}
369	
370	func canonicalValue(value string) string {
371		if value == "" {
372			return ""
373		}
374		canonical, err := pathx.Canonical(value)
375		if err != nil {
376			return ""
377		}
378		return canonical
379	}
380	
381	func intersects(left, right map[string]struct{}) bool {
382		for value := range left {
383			if _, ok := right[value]; ok {
384				return true
385			}
386		}
387		return false
388	}
389	
390	// NormalizeRemoteIdentity converts common HTTPS and SCP-style Git URLs into a
391	// stable lower-case host/path key. The result remains only a hint for matching.
392	func NormalizeRemoteIdentity(identity string) string {
393		identity = strings.TrimSpace(identity)
394		if identity == "" {
395			return ""
396		}
397		if parsed, err := url.Parse(identity); err == nil && parsed.Scheme != "" && parsed.Host != "" {
398			identity = parsed.Host + "/" + strings.TrimPrefix(parsed.Path, "/")
399		} else if at := strings.LastIndexByte(identity, '@'); at >= 0 {
400			afterUser := identity[at+1:]
401			if colon := strings.IndexByte(afterUser, ':'); colon >= 0 {
402				identity = afterUser[:colon] + "/" + afterUser[colon+1:]
403			}
404		}
405		identity = strings.Trim(identity, "/")
406		identity = strings.TrimSuffix(identity, ".git")
407		return strings.ToLower(identity)
408	}

1	// Package pathx provides the path-safety checks shared by filesystem lifecycle
2	// operations. The checks are strict: a destination must be below its root, not
3	// merely share a string prefix with it, and symlinks are resolved before that
4	// decision is made.
5	package pathx
6	
7	import (
8		"errors"
9		"fmt"
10		"io/fs"
11		"path/filepath"
12		"slices"
13		"strings"
14	)
15	
16	var (
17		// ErrOutsideRoot reports a path that does not resolve below the requested root.
18		ErrOutsideRoot = errors.New("path is outside root")
19		// ErrRoot reports an operation that named the root itself rather than a child.
20		ErrRoot = errors.New("path is the root itself")
21		// ErrTraversal reports an explicit .. component in an unclean input path.
22		ErrTraversal = errors.New("path contains parent traversal")
23		// ErrInvalidComponent reports a value that is not one filesystem component.
24		ErrInvalidComponent = errors.New("invalid path component")
25	)
26	
27	// Canonical returns an absolute, clean path with symlinks resolved. If the final
28	// path does not exist yet, it resolves the nearest existing ancestor and then
29	// appends the missing suffix. This is the form needed to validate a destination
30	// before creating or moving anything into it.
31	func Canonical(path string) (string, error) {
32		if path == "" {
33			return "", fmt.Errorf("canonical path: empty path")
34		}
35		absolute, err := filepath.Abs(path)
36		if err != nil {
37			return "", fmt.Errorf("make %q absolute: %w", path, err)
38		}
39		absolute = filepath.Clean(absolute)
40	
41		probe := absolute
42		var missing []string
43		for {
44			resolved, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(probe)
45			if err == nil {
46				slices.Reverse(missing)
47				parts := append([]string{resolved}, missing...)
48				return filepath.Clean(filepath.Join(parts...)), nil
49			}
50			if !errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
51				return "", fmt.Errorf("resolve %q: %w", path, err)
52			}
53			parent := filepath.Dir(probe)
54			if parent == probe {
55				return "", fmt.Errorf("resolve %q: no existing ancestor: %w", path, err)
56			}
57			missing = append(missing, filepath.Base(probe))
58			probe = parent
59		}
60	}
61	
62	// CanonicalChild returns candidate in canonical form when it resolves strictly
63	// below root. It rejects root itself, lexical .. traversal, sibling-prefix
64	// confusion, and paths that escape through a symlink.
65	func CanonicalChild(root, candidate string) (string, error) {
66		if hasParentTraversal(candidate) {
67			return "", fmt.Errorf("%q: %w", candidate, ErrTraversal)
68		}
69		canonicalRoot, err := Canonical(root)
70		if err != nil {
71			return "", fmt.Errorf("canonicalize root: %w", err)
72		}
73		canonicalCandidate, err := Canonical(candidate)
74		if err != nil {
75			return "", fmt.Errorf("canonicalize candidate: %w", err)
76		}
77	
78		rel, err := filepath.Rel(canonicalRoot, canonicalCandidate)
79		if err != nil {
80			return "", fmt.Errorf("compare %q with root %q: %w", candidate, root, err)
81		}
82		switch {
83		case rel == ".":
84			return "", fmt.Errorf("%q: %w", candidate, ErrRoot)
85		case filepath.IsAbs(rel), rel == "..", strings.HasPrefix(rel, ".."+string(filepath.Separator)):
86			return "", fmt.Errorf("%q is not below %q: %w", candidate, root, ErrOutsideRoot)
87		default:
88			return canonicalCandidate, nil
89		}
90	}
91	
92	// IsChild reports whether candidate resolves strictly below root. Policy
93	// rejections are returned as false without hiding filesystem errors.
94	func IsChild(root, candidate string) (bool, error) {
95		_, err := CanonicalChild(root, candidate)
96		if err == nil {
97			return true, nil
98		}
99		if errors.Is(err, ErrOutsideRoot) || errors.Is(err, ErrRoot) || errors.Is(err, ErrTraversal) {
100			return false, nil
101		}
102		return false, err
103	}
104	
105	// ValidateComponent requires a non-empty relative value containing exactly one
106	// path component. Both slash styles are rejected so state synced between Unix
107	// and Windows cannot acquire a different meaning on another host.
108	func ValidateComponent(component string) error {
109		switch {
110		case strings.TrimSpace(component) == "":
111			return fmt.Errorf("empty component: %w", ErrInvalidComponent)
112		case strings.ContainsRune(component, '\x00'):
113			return fmt.Errorf("component contains NUL: %w", ErrInvalidComponent)
114		case component == "." || component == "..":
115			return fmt.Errorf("component %q is reserved: %w", component, ErrInvalidComponent)
116		case filepath.IsAbs(component) || filepath.VolumeName(component) != "" || driveQualified(component):
117			return fmt.Errorf("component %q is absolute or drive-qualified: %w", component, ErrInvalidComponent)
118		case strings.ContainsAny(component, `/\\`):
119			return fmt.Errorf("component %q contains a path separator: %w", component, ErrInvalidComponent)
120		case filepath.Clean(component) != component || filepath.Base(component) != component:
121			return fmt.Errorf("component %q is not a single clean name: %w", component, ErrInvalidComponent)
122		default:
123			return nil
124		}
125	}
126	
127	// JoinChild validates every component, joins it below root, and returns the
128	// canonical destination. It is suitable for paths such as
129	// <project-root>/<category>/<name>, where each user-supplied value must remain a
130	// single component.
131	func JoinChild(root string, components ...string) (string, error) {
132		if len(components) == 0 {
133			return "", fmt.Errorf("join child: no components: %w", ErrRoot)
134		}
135		for i, component := range components {
136			if err := ValidateComponent(component); err != nil {
137				return "", fmt.Errorf("component %d: %w", i, err)
138			}
139		}
140		canonicalRoot, err := Canonical(root)
141		if err != nil {
142			return "", fmt.Errorf("canonicalize root: %w", err)
143		}
144		return CanonicalChild(canonicalRoot, filepath.Join(append([]string{canonicalRoot}, components...)...))
145	}
146	
147	func driveQualified(component string) bool {
148		if len(component) < 2 || component[1] != ':' {
149			return false
150		}
151		letter := component[0]
152		return letter >= 'a' && letter <= 'z' || letter >= 'A' && letter <= 'Z'
153	}
154	
155	func hasParentTraversal(path string) bool {
156		for _, component := range strings.FieldsFunc(path, func(r rune) bool {
157			return r == '/' || r == '\\'
158		}) {
159			if component == ".." {
160				return true
161			}
162		}
163		return false
164	}

1	// Package cli assembles dev's command tree. Commands stay thin: they parse
2	// flags, call into the domain packages, and render. All policy lives in
3	// config, catalog, gitx, wt, task and runtime so it can be tested without a terminal.
4	package cli
5	
6	import (
7		"context"
8		"fmt"
9		"io"
10		"os"
11	
12		"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/catalog"
13		"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/config"
14		"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/runtime"
15		"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/task"
16	)
17	
18	// App is the state shared by every command.
19	type App struct {
20		Cfg      config.Config
21		Tasks    *task.Store
22		Catalog  *catalog.Store
23		Registry *catalog.Registry
24	
25		Out io.Writer
26		Err io.Writer
27	
28		// configPath is the --config override; empty means the XDG default.
29		configPath string
30		// runtimeOverride is the --runtime flag; empty means use the config.
31		runtimeOverride string
32		// noRuntime disables all multiplexer interaction for one invocation.
33		noRuntime bool
34	}
35	
36	// Load reads configuration and prepares the shared stores.
37	func (a *App) Load() error {
38		cfg, err := config.Load(a.configPath)
39		if err != nil {
40			return err
41		}
42		a.Cfg = cfg
43		if a.Out == nil {
44			a.Out = os.Stdout
45		}
46		if a.Err == nil {
47			a.Err = os.Stderr
48		}
49		a.Tasks = task.NewStore(cfg.TasksDir())
50		a.Catalog = catalog.NewStore(cfg.AssetsDir(), catalog.WithDiagnosticSink(func(diagnostic catalog.Diagnostic) {
51			fmt.Fprintf(a.Err, "dev: warning: %s\n", diagnostic.Error())
52		}))
53		a.Registry = catalog.NewRegistry(a.Catalog)
54		return nil
55	}
56	
57	// Runtime resolves the multiplexer backend for this invocation, honouring
58	// --runtime and --no-runtime.
59	func (a *App) Runtime() runtime.Runtime {
60		if a.noRuntime {
61			return runtime.None{}
62		}
63		backend := a.Cfg.Runtime.Backend
64		if a.runtimeOverride != "" {
65			backend = a.runtimeOverride
66		}
67		rt := runtime.Select(backend)
68		if h, ok := rt.(*runtime.Herdr); ok {
69			return h.WithMetadataSource(a.Cfg.Runtime.MetadataSource)
70		}
71		return rt
72	}
73	
74	// printf writes to the command's stdout.
75	func (a *App) printf(format string, args ...any) {
76		fmt.Fprintf(a.Out, format, args...)
77	}
78	
79	// warnf writes a non-fatal notice to stderr, so it never pollutes piped output.
80	func (a *App) warnf(format string, args ...any) {
81		fmt.Fprintf(a.Err, "dev: "+format+"\n", args...)
82	}
83	
84	// cdDirective emits the marker the shell wrapper installed by
85	// `dev shell-init` looks for. A child process cannot change its parent's
86	// working directory, so the only way `dev resume` can leave the user *in* the
87	// checkout is to ask the shell to do it.
88	func (a *App) cdDirective(dir string) {
89		fmt.Fprintf(a.Out, "cd %s\n", shellQuote(dir))
90	}
91	
92	// ctx is the cancellable context commands run under.
93	func ctxOf() context.Context { return context.Background() }
94

274			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "dev: warning: unknown key(s) in %s: %v\n", path, undecoded)

```text
1	# `dev try` TUI、asset metadata 與安全回收
2	
3	## Context
4	
5	目前 `dev try`（`internal/cli/try.go`）只掃描 `paths.tries_root` 的第一層目錄，以 directory mtime 排序，並把 create/clone/open/render 全放在 Cobra handler；`dev graduate`（`internal/cli/graduate.go`）也自行處理 resolve、move、Git 初始化與 remote。這足以快速開實驗，卻無法可靠回答「最近用過什麼、哪些值得保留、哪些可安全釋放空間」，也沒有能在 local directory 被移除後繼續存在的索引。
6	
7	目標是把 TRY 作為主 TUI 的第四個 view，同時保留 `dev try <name>` 的低摩擦與可腳本化 CLI。資料與安全規則放在共用 domain service，不放進 Bubble Tea；普通 repository 與 Try 共用 tags／notes／穩定 ID，但只有真正的 Try entry 具有 Try lifecycle。容量預設代表刪除該 local checkout 真正擁有、可回收的 logical bytes，而不是含糊地選擇是否「扣掉 `.git`」。
8	
9	採用以下產品語意：
10	
11	- `active`／`deprecated`／`graduated` 是人為 lifecycle phase。
12	- `present`／`archived`／`evicted` 是每台機器的 local disposition；archive 不等於刪除，evict 不等於 deprecated。
13	- `important`、`keep`、`experiment` 等 tags 可組合；普通 repo 的 `experiment` tag 只分類，不會建立 Try lifecycle。
14	- Git tries 預設只顯示於 TRY，避免與 REPOS 重複；可用 `--include-tries`／TUI「顯示全部」查看。Graduated entry 保留歷史與 ID，並改在 REPOS 顯示。
15	- Archive 是 `TriesRoot` 內同 filesystem 的可逆隱藏搬移；evict 才釋放空間。Remote create/push 永遠需要明示，且「有 remote」不等於「資料可恢復」。
16

1	package task
2	
3	import (
4		"errors"
5		"fmt"
6		"io/fs"
7		"os"
8		"path/filepath"
9		"regexp"
10		"sort"
11		"strings"
12		"time"
13	
14		"github.com/BurntSushi/toml"
15	)
16	
17	// ErrNotFound is returned when no task matches an identifier.
18	var ErrNotFound = errors.New("no such task")
19	
20	// Store is a directory of one-TOML-file-per-task.
21	//
22	// One file per task, rather than a single registry document, is a deliberate
23	// choice: the state directory is meant to be syncable across machines (it can
24	// simply be a git repo), and a shared central file would conflict on every
25	// parallel edit while separate files merge cleanly.
26	type Store struct{ Dir string }
27	
28	// NewStore returns a store rooted at dir.
29	func NewStore(dir string) *Store { return &Store{Dir: dir} }
30	
31	var idUnsafe = regexp.MustCompile(`[^a-zA-Z0-9._-]+`)
32	
33	// MakeID derives the stable filename stem for a repo+branch pair.
34	func MakeID(repo, branch string) string {
35		clean := func(s string) string {
36			s = idUnsafe.ReplaceAllString(s, "-")
37			for strings.Contains(s, "--") {
38				s = strings.ReplaceAll(s, "--", "-")
39			}
40			return strings.Trim(s, "-._")
41		}
42		r, b := clean(repo), clean(branch)
43		if r == "" {
44			r = "repo"
45		}
46		if b == "" {
47			b = "branch"
48		}
49		return r + "__" + b
50	}
51	
52	func (s *Store) path(id string) string { return filepath.Join(s.Dir, id+".toml") }
53	
54	// Save writes a task, stamping Updated (and Created on first write).
55	func (s *Store) Save(t *Task) error {
56		if t.ID == "" {
57			t.ID = MakeID(t.Repo, t.Branch)
58		}
59		if err := t.Validate(); err != nil {
60			return err
61		}
62		now := time.Now().UTC().Truncate(time.Second)
63		if t.Created.IsZero() {
64			t.Created = now
65		}
66		t.Updated = now
67	
68		if err := os.MkdirAll(s.Dir, 0o755); err != nil {
69			return fmt.Errorf("create state dir: %w", err)
70		}
71		// Write to a temp file and rename, so an interrupted write can never leave
72		// a half-parsed task behind.
73		tmp, err := os.CreateTemp(s.Dir, "."+t.ID+".*.tmp")
74		if err != nil {
75			return err
76		}
77		defer os.Remove(tmp.Name())
78		enc := toml.NewEncoder(tmp)
79		if err := enc.Encode(t); err != nil {
80			tmp.Close()
81			return fmt.Errorf("encode task %s: %w", t.ID, err)
82		}
83		if err := tmp.Close(); err != nil {
84			return err
85		}
86		if err := os.Chmod(tmp.Name(), 0o644); err != nil {
87			return err
88		}
89		return os.Rename(tmp.Name(), s.path(t.ID))
90	}
91	
92	// Get loads one task by its exact id.
93	func (s *Store) Get(id string) (*Task, error) {
94		var t Task
95		if _, err := toml.DecodeFile(s.path(id), &t); err != nil {
96			if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
97				return nil, fmt.Errorf("%q: %w", id, ErrNotFound)
98			}
99			return nil, fmt.Errorf("read task %s: %w", id, err)
100		}
101		t.ID = id
102		return &t, nil
103	}
104	
105	// List loads every task, sorted by state (hot first) then most recent.
106	func (s *Store) List() ([]*Task, error) {
107		entries, err := os.ReadDir(s.Dir)
108		if err != nil {
109			if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
110				return nil, nil // no state yet is a normal, empty inventory
111			}
112			return nil, err
113		}
114		var out []*Task
115		for _, e := range entries {
116			name := e.Name()
117			if e.IsDir() || !strings.HasSuffix(name, ".toml") || strings.HasPrefix(name, ".") {
118				continue
119			}
120			id := strings.TrimSuffix(name, ".toml")
121			t, err := s.Get(id)
122			if err != nil {
123				// One corrupt file must not hide the rest of the inventory.
124				fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "dev: warning: skipping %s: %v\n", name, err)
125				continue
126			}
127			out = append(out, t)
128		}
129		Sort(out)
130		return out, nil
131	}
132	
133	// Delete removes a task entry. It never touches git state.
134	func (s *Store) Delete(id string) error {
135		err := os.Remove(s.path(id))
136		if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
137			return fmt.Errorf("%q: %w", id, ErrNotFound)
138		}
139		return err
140	}
141	
142	// Resolve finds a task from a loose user-supplied reference: an exact id, an
143	// exact branch, or a unique case-insensitive substring of the id, name or
144	// branch. An ambiguous reference is an error listing the candidates rather
145	// than a silent pick.
146	func (s *Store) Resolve(ref string) (*Task, error) {
147		if ref == "" {
148			return nil, fmt.Errorf("empty task reference: %w", ErrNotFound)
149		}
150		all, err := s.List()
151		if err != nil {
152			return nil, err
153		}
154		for _, t := range all {
155			if t.ID == ref || t.Branch == ref {
156				return t, nil
157			}
158		}
159		needle := strings.ToLower(ref)
160		var hits []*Task
161		for _, t := range all {
162			hay := strings.ToLower(t.ID + " " + t.Name + " " + t.Branch + " " + t.Repo)
163			if strings.Contains(hay, needle) {
164				hits = append(hits, t)
165			}
166		}
167		switch len(hits) {
168		case 1:
169			return hits[0], nil
170		case 0:
171			return nil, fmt.Errorf("%q: %w", ref, ErrNotFound)
172		default:
173			names := make([]string, len(hits))
174			for i, t := range hits {
175				names[i] = t.ID
176			}
177			return nil, fmt.Errorf("%q is ambiguous: %s", ref, strings.Join(names, ", "))
178		}
179	}
180	
181	// FindByWorktree returns the task whose checkout contains dir.
182	//
183	// A task lives at exactly one place: its worktree when it has one, otherwise
184	// the main checkout. A task that has a linked worktree therefore does *not*
185	// claim the main checkout — otherwise standing in the main repo would match
186	// every worktree-based task of that repo. Among candidates, the longest path
187	// match wins so a nested checkout beats its parent.
188	func (s *Store) FindByWorktree(dir string) (*Task, error) {
189		all, err := s.List()
190		if err != nil {
191			return nil, err
192		}
193		under := func(dir, root string) bool {
194			return root != "" && (dir == root || strings.HasPrefix(dir, root+string(filepath.Separator)))
195		}
196		var best *Task
197		var bestLen int
198		for _, t := range all {
199			root := t.WorktreePath
200			if root == "" {
201				root = t.RepoPath
202			}
203			if under(dir, root) && len(root) > bestLen {
204				best, bestLen = t, len(root)
205			}
206		}
207		if best == nil {
208			return nil, fmt.Errorf("%q: %w", dir, ErrNotFound)
209		}
210		return best, nil
211	}
212	
213	// stateRank orders states so the inventory reads as an attention queue.
214	func stateRank(s State) int {
215		switch s {
216		case Hot:
217			return 0
218		case Warm:
219			return 1
220		case Cold:
221			return 2
222		case Done:
223			return 3
224		}
225		return 4
226	}
227	
228	// Sort orders tasks hot-first, then by most recently updated.
229	func Sort(ts []*Task) {
230		sort.SliceStable(ts, func(i, j int) bool {
231			ri, rj := stateRank(ts[i].State), stateRank(ts[j].State)
232			if ri != rj {
233				return ri < rj
234			}
235			if !ts[i].Updated.Equal(ts[j].Updated) {
236				return ts[i].Updated.After(ts[j].Updated)
237			}
238			return ts[i].ID < ts[j].ID
239		})
240	}
241

1	// Package repo discovers the repositories a user actually owns by walking the
2	// configured scan roots. It answers "what projects do I have?", which is a
3	// different question from "what am I working on?" — that one belongs to
4	// package task.
5	package repo
6	
7	import (
8		"context"
9		"io/fs"
10		"os"
11		"path/filepath"
12		"sort"
13		"strings"
14	
15		"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/gitx"
16	)
17	
18	// Repo is one discovered repository.
19	type Repo struct {
20		// Name is the directory basename, which is how users refer to it.
21		Name string
22		// Path is the absolute path reached through the scan root. It may be a
23		// symlink from a bootstrap index; commands intentionally keep that human
24		// navigation path rather than replacing it with the physical one.
25		Path string
26		// RealPath is the physical checkout path.
27		RealPath string
28		// Symlink reports that Path is an alias to RealPath.
29		Symlink bool
30		// Root is the scan root it was found under.
31		Root string
32		// Category is the path between the scan root and the repo ("Quant",
33		// "Web/Frontend"), empty for a repo sitting directly in the root. It is
34		// human organisation metadata, preserved for `dev graduate` to place new
35		// projects consistently.
36		Category string
37		// CommonDir is Git's shared administrative directory. Its worktrees/
38		// children let inventory count linked checkouts without another git
39		// process per repository.
40		CommonDir string
41		// Bare reports a bare repository (a worktree hub).
42		Bare bool
43		// HasGit distinguishes a real repo from a plain directory that was found
44		// in a scan root; non-repos are reported so `dev repo list` can offer to
45		// initialise them.
46		HasGit bool
47	}
48	
49	// Display renders "Category/Name" or just "Name".
50	func (r Repo) Display() string {
51		if r.Category == "" {
52			return r.Name
53		}
54		return r.Category + "/" + r.Name
55	}
56	
57	// Options tunes discovery.
58	type Options struct {
59		// MaxDepth limits how deep below a scan root a repo may be found. The
60		// default layout is <root>/<Category>/<Repo>, so 2 suffices; 3 leaves room
61		// for a nested grouping without walking an entire home directory.
62		MaxDepth int
63		// IncludeNonRepos reports plain directories alongside repositories.
64		IncludeNonRepos bool
65	}
66	
67	// DefaultOptions is the discovery configuration used by dev's commands.
68	func DefaultOptions() Options { return Options{MaxDepth: 3} }
69	
70	// skipDirs are never descended into. These are large, never contain a project
71	// the user organises by hand, and walking them dominates scan time.
72	var skipDirs = map[string]bool{
73		"node_modules": true, ".venv": true, "venv": true, "target": true,
74		"vendor": true, "__pycache__": true, ".tox": true, "dist": true,
75		"build": true, ".next": true, ".cache": true, ".terraform": true,
76		"Library": true, ".Trash": true,
77	}
78	
79	// Discover walks every root and returns the repositories found, sorted by
80	// display name. Unreadable directories are skipped rather than fatal — a scan
81	// root that has been unmounted must not break `dev ls`.
82	func Discover(ctx context.Context, roots []string, opts Options) ([]Repo, error) {
83		if opts.MaxDepth <= 0 {
84			opts.MaxDepth = DefaultOptions().MaxDepth
85		}
86		seen := map[string]bool{}
87		// clone identities stop a physical path and a symlink index from showing
88		// the same repository twice. The first scan root wins, which lets users
89		// choose whether the curated index or the physical hierarchy is their UI
90		// simply by ordering scan_roots.
91		identities := map[string]bool{}
92		var out []Repo
93	
94		for _, root := range roots {
95			info, err := os.Stat(root)
96			if err != nil || !info.IsDir() {
97				continue // a missing scan root is normal on a fresh machine
98			}
99			rootClean := filepath.Clean(root)
100	
101			err = filepath.WalkDir(rootClean, func(path string, d fs.DirEntry, err error) error {
102				if err != nil {
103					return nil // unreadable entry: skip, keep walking
104				}
105				if ctx.Err() != nil {
106					return ctx.Err()
107				}
108				if path == rootClean {
109					return nil
110				}
111				name := d.Name()
112				isLink := d.Type()&os.ModeSymlink != 0
113				isDir := d.IsDir()
114				if isLink {
115					// WalkDir does not follow symlinks. Inspect a direct symlink to
116					// a repository, but do not recurse through arbitrary symlinked
117					// containers — bootstrap does that with cycle detection.
118					if info, err := os.Stat(path); err == nil {
119						isDir = info.IsDir()
120					}
121				}
122				if !isDir {
123					return nil
124				}
125				if skipDirs[name] || (strings.HasPrefix(name, ".") && name != ".bare") {
126					return filepath.SkipDir
127				}
128	
129				rel, _ := filepath.Rel(rootClean, path)
130				depth := len(strings.Split(rel, string(filepath.Separator)))
131	
132				if isRepoDir(path) {
133					real, _ := filepath.EvalSymlinks(path)
134					if real == "" {
135						real = path
136					}
137					bare := isBareDir(path)
138					identity, commonDir := real, real
139					if !bare {
140						if g, err := gitx.Discover(ctx, path); err == nil {
141							// A linked worktree is execution state, not another
142							// project in the repo inventory.
143							if g.IsLinkedWorktree {
144								return filepath.SkipDir
145							}
146							identity, commonDir = g.GitCommonDir, g.GitCommonDir
147							real = g.MainRoot
148						}
149					}
150					if !seen[path] && !identities[identity] {
151						seen[path], identities[identity] = true, true
152						out = append(out, Repo{
153							Name:      name,
154							Path:      path,
155							RealPath:  real,
156							Symlink:   isLink,
157							Root:      rootClean,
158							Category:  filepath.ToSlash(filepath.Dir(rel)),
159							CommonDir: commonDir,
160							Bare:      bare,
161							HasGit:    true,
162						})
163					}
164					// Never descend into a repo: its subdirectories are source
165					// code, and any nested .git is a submodule or a worktree that
166					// belongs to this repo, not a project of its own.
167					return filepath.SkipDir
168				}
169				if depth >= opts.MaxDepth {
170					return filepath.SkipDir
171				}
172				if opts.IncludeNonRepos && depth == 1 {
173					if !seen[path] {
174						seen[path] = true
175						out = append(out, Repo{Name: name, Path: path, Root: rootClean, Category: ""})
176					}
177				}
178				return nil
179			})
180			if err != nil && ctx.Err() != nil {
181				return out, ctx.Err()
182			}
183		}
184	
185		for i := range out {
186			if out[i].Category == "." {
187				out[i].Category = ""
188			}
189		}
190		sort.Slice(out, func(i, j int) bool {
191			if out[i].Name != out[j].Name {
192				return strings.ToLower(out[i].Name) < strings.ToLower(out[j].Name)
193			}
194			return out[i].Path < out[j].Path
195		})
196		return out, nil
197	}
198	
199	// isRepoDir reports whether path is a repository root: it holds a .git entry
200	// (directory for a normal clone, file for a linked worktree or submodule).
201	func isRepoDir(path string) bool {
202		if _, err := os.Lstat(filepath.Join(path, ".git")); err == nil {
203			return true
204		}
205		return isBareDir(path)
206	}
207	
208	// isBareDir recognises a bare repository by its skeleton, without shelling out.
209	func isBareDir(path string) bool {
210		for _, marker := range []string{"HEAD", "objects", "refs"} {
211			if _, err := os.Stat(filepath.Join(path, marker)); err != nil {
212				return false
213			}
214		}
215		return true
216	}
217	
218	// Resolve finds a repo by name, display name, or path.
219	//
220	// Matching is deliberately layered: an exact name or path wins outright, and
221	// only then does a substring search run — so a repo literally named "web"
222	// is never shadowed by "web-frontend".
223	func Resolve(ctx context.Context, roots []string, ref string) (Repo, []Repo, error) {
224		all, err := Discover(ctx, roots, DefaultOptions())
225		if err != nil {
226			return Repo{}, nil, err
227		}
228		if abs, err := filepath.Abs(ref); err == nil {
229			if g, err := gitx.Discover(ctx, abs); err == nil {
230				real, _ := filepath.EvalSymlinks(abs)
231				if real == "" {
232					real = g.MainRoot
233				}
234				// Preserve an explicit navigation alias. The caller named this
235				// path on purpose; resolving it to the physical checkout would
236				// defeat a bootstrap symlink catalog.
237				return Repo{
238					Name: filepath.Base(abs), Path: abs, RealPath: real,
239					Symlink: real != abs, CommonDir: g.GitCommonDir, HasGit: true, Bare: g.Bare,
240				}, nil, nil
241			}
242		}
243		for _, r := range all {
244			if r.Name == ref || r.Display() == ref || r.Path == ref {
245				return r, nil, nil
246			}
247		}
248		needle := strings.ToLower(ref)
249		var hits []Repo
250		for _, r := range all {
251			if strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(r.Display()), needle) {
252				hits = append(hits, r)
253			}
254		}
255		switch len(hits) {
256		case 1:
257			return hits[0], nil, nil
258		case 0:
259			return Repo{}, nil, &NotFoundError{Ref: ref}
260		default:
261			return Repo{}, hits, &AmbiguousError{Ref: ref, Candidates: hits}
262		}
263	}
264	
265	// NotFoundError reports a repo reference that matched nothing.
266	type NotFoundError struct{ Ref string }
267	
268	func (e *NotFoundError) Error() string { return "no repository matching " + e.Ref }
269	
270	// AmbiguousError reports a repo reference that matched several repos.
271	type AmbiguousError struct {
272		Ref        string
273		Candidates []Repo
274	}
275	
276	func (e *AmbiguousError) Error() string {
277		names := make([]string, len(e.Candidates))
278		for i, c := range e.Candidates {
279			names[i] = c.Display()
280		}
281		return e.Ref + " is ambiguous: " + strings.Join(names, ", ")
282	}
