9	
10	// Repo identifies one repository, independent of which worktree you are
11	// standing in. Two linked worktrees of the same clone share a Key.
12	type Repo struct {
13		// Root is the working-tree root of the checkout that was probed.
14		Root string
15		// GitCommonDir is the shared .git directory — the same value for every
16		// worktree of a clone, which makes it the natural identity.
17		GitCommonDir string
18		// Name is the basename users recognise the repo by.
19		Name string
20		// IsLinkedWorktree reports whether Root is a linked worktree rather than
21		// the main checkout.
22		IsLinkedWorktree bool
23		// MainRoot is the main (non-linked) checkout of this clone.
24		MainRoot string
25		// Bare reports whether the main checkout is a bare repository.
26		Bare bool
27	}
28	
29	// Key is the stable identity of the clone, shared by all its worktrees.
30	func (r Repo) Key() string { return r.GitCommonDir }
31	
32	// Discover probes dir and reports the repository containing it.
33	func Discover(ctx context.Context, dir string) (Repo, error) {
34		// A single rev-parse call answers everything: batching avoids four
35		// process spawns per repo, which matters when scanning 39 of them.
36		out, err := run(ctx, dir,
37			"rev-parse",
38			"--path-format=absolute",
39			"--show-toplevel",
40			"--git-common-dir",
41			"--is-bare-repository",
42		)
43		if err != nil {
44			return Repo{}, err
45		}
46		f := lines(out)
47		r := Repo{}
48		// A bare repo has no toplevel, so git prints one fewer line.
49		switch len(f) {
50		case 3:
51			r.Root = f[0]
52			r.GitCommonDir = f[1]
53			r.Bare = f[2] == "true"
54		case 2:
55			r.GitCommonDir = f[0]
56			r.Bare = f[1] == "true"
57		default:
58			return Repo{}, ErrNotARepo
59		}
60	
61		// The main checkout is the parent of the common .git dir, except for a
62		// bare repo (where the common dir *is* the repo).
63		if r.Bare {
64			r.MainRoot = strings.TrimSuffix(r.GitCommonDir, string(filepath.Separator))
65		} else {
66			r.MainRoot = filepath.Dir(r.GitCommonDir)
67		}
68		r.IsLinkedWorktree = r.Root != "" && r.Root != r.MainRoot
69		r.Name = filepath.Base(r.MainRoot)
70		if r.Bare {
71			// ".../foo/.bare" or ".../foo.git" should both read as "foo".
72			r.Name = strings.TrimSuffix(filepath.Base(r.MainRoot), ".git")
73			if strings.HasPrefix(r.Name, ".") {
74				r.Name = filepath.Base(filepath.Dir(r.MainRoot))
75			}
76		}
77		return r, nil
78	}
79	
80	// IsRepo reports whether dir is inside a git working tree, without the cost of
81	// a full Discover.
82	func IsRepo(ctx context.Context, dir string) bool {
83		_, err := run(ctx, dir, "rev-parse", "--git-dir")
84		return err == nil
85	}
86	
87	// DefaultBranch resolves the repository's default branch — origin/HEAD when the
88	// remote advertises it, else the first of main/master that exists locally.
89	// Returns "" when nothing can be determined, which callers must treat as
90	// "ask the user" rather than guessing.
91	func DefaultBranch(ctx context.Context, dir string) string {
92		if out, err := run(ctx, dir, "symbolic-ref", "--short", "refs/remotes/origin/HEAD"); err == nil {
93			if _, b, ok := strings.Cut(out, "/"); ok {
94				return b
95			}
96		}
97		for _, cand := range []string{"main", "master", "trunk", "develop"} {
98			if _, err := run(ctx, dir, "show-ref", "--verify", "--quiet", "refs/heads/"+cand); err == nil {
99				return cand
100			}
101		}
102		return ""
103	}
104	
105	// Remote returns the push URL of the named remote ("origin" when empty).
106	func Remote(ctx context.Context, dir, name string) string {
107		if name == "" {
108			name = "origin"
109		}
110		out, err := run(ctx, dir, "remote", "get-url", name)
111		if err != nil {
112			return ""
113		}
114		return out
115	}
116	
117	// RemoteFromConfig reads one remote URL directly from a Git common directory.
118	// It is the zero-process path used by whole-machine inventory, where spawning
119	// `git remote get-url` once per repo dominated startup. Includes and URL
120	// rewriting are deliberately not evaluated; callers that need Git's complete
121	// semantics should use Remote instead.
122	func RemoteFromConfig(commonDir, name string) string {
123		if commonDir == "" {
124			return ""
125		}
126		if name == "" {
127			name = "origin"
128		}
129		b, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(commonDir, "config"))
130		if err != nil {
131			return ""
132		}
133		want := `remote "` + name + `"`
134		section := ""
135		for _, raw := range strings.Split(string(b), "\n") {
136			line := strings.TrimSpace(raw)
137			if line == "" || strings.HasPrefix(line, "#") || strings.HasPrefix(line, ";") {
138				continue
139			}
140			if strings.HasPrefix(line, "[") && strings.HasSuffix(line, "]") {
141				section = strings.TrimSpace(line[1 : len(line)-1])
142				continue
143			}
144			if section != want {
145				continue
146			}
147			key, value, ok := strings.Cut(line, "=")
148			if ok && strings.TrimSpace(key) == "url" {
149				return strings.Trim(strings.TrimSpace(value), `"`)
150			}
151		}
152		return ""
153	}

1	package forge

3	import (

5		"errors"

7		"os"
8		"path/filepath"
9		"time"
10	)
11	
12	// Cache is the on-disk forge inventory. It exists for UI latency, not as a
13	// source of truth: the REMOTE tab should open instantly, and r refreshes it.
14	type Cache struct {
15		FetchedAt time.Time    `json:"fetched_at"`
16		Repos     []RemoteRepo `json:"repos"`
17	}
18	
19	// LoadCache returns a fresh cache, or false when it is missing, malformed or
20	// older than maxAge. A stale cache is deliberately not returned: showing a
21	// deleted private repo as current is more confusing than a brief reload.
22	func LoadCache(path string, maxAge time.Duration) (Cache, bool) {
23		b, err := os.ReadFile(path)
24		if err != nil {
25			return Cache{}, false
26		}
27		var c Cache
28		if json.Unmarshal(b, &c) != nil || c.FetchedAt.IsZero() {
29			return Cache{}, false
30		}
31		if maxAge > 0 && time.Since(c.FetchedAt) > maxAge {
32			return Cache{}, false
33		}
34		return c, true
35	}
36	
37	// SaveCache atomically replaces the cache. A partial forge response may be
38	// cached — its FetchedAt still says exactly when it was observed.
39	func SaveCache(path string, repos []RemoteRepo) error {
40		if path == "" {
41			return errors.New("empty cache path")
42		}
43		if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(path), 0o755); err != nil {
44			return err
45		}
46		b, err := json.MarshalIndent(Cache{FetchedAt: time.Now().UTC(), Repos: repos}, "", "  ")
47		if err != nil {
48			return err
49		}
50		b = append(b, '\n')
51		tmp, err := os.CreateTemp(filepath.Dir(path), ".remotes-*.tmp")
52		if err != nil {
53			return err
54		}
55		name := tmp.Name()
56		defer os.Remove(name)
57		if _, err := tmp.Write(b); err != nil {
58			tmp.Close()
59			return err
60		}
61		if err := tmp.Close(); err != nil {
62			return err
63		}
64		if err := os.Chmod(name, 0o600); err != nil {
65			return err
66		}
67		return os.Rename(name, path)
68	}
69	
70	// CacheExists reports whether any cache file exists, even stale. Used only for
71	// diagnostics.
72	func CacheExists(path string) bool {
73		_, err := os.Stat(path)
74		return err == nil || !errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist)
75	}

```text
# `dev try` TUI、asset metadata 與安全回收

## Context

目前 `dev try`（`internal/cli/try.go`）只掃描 `paths.tries_root` 的第一層目錄，以 directory mtime 排序，並把 create/clone/open/render 全放在 Cobra handler；`dev graduate`（`internal/cli/graduate.go`）也自行處理 resolve、move、Git 初始化與 remote。這足以快速開實驗，卻無法可靠回答「最近用過什麼、哪些值得保留、哪些可安全釋放空間」，也沒有能在 local directory 被移除後繼續存在的索引。

目標是把 TRY 作為主 TUI 的第四個 view，同時保留 `dev try <name>` 的低摩擦與可腳本化 CLI。資料與安全規則放在共用 domain service，不放進 Bubble Tea；普通 repository 與 Try 共用 tags／notes／穩定 ID，但只有真正的 Try entry 具有 Try lifecycle。容量預設代表刪除該 local checkout 真正擁有、可回收的 logical bytes，而不是含糊地選擇是否「扣掉 `.git`」。

採用以下產品語意：

- `active`／`deprecated`／`graduated` 是人為 lifecycle phase。
- `present`／`archived`／`evicted` 是每台機器的 local disposition；archive 不等於刪除，evict 不等於 deprecated。
- `important`、`keep`、`experiment` 等 tags 可組合；普通 repo 的 `experiment` tag 只分類，不會建立 Try lifecycle。
- Git tries 預設只顯示於 TRY，避免與 REPOS 重複；可用 `--include-tries`／TUI「顯示全部」查看。Graduated entry 保留歷史與 ID，並改在 REPOS 顯示。
- Archive 是 `TriesRoot` 內同 filesystem 的可逆隱藏搬移；evict 才釋放空間。Remote create/push 永遠需要明示，且「有 remote」不等於「資料可恢復」。

## 1. 建立共享 asset catalog 與安全 path primitives

新增 `internal/catalog`，不要擴充 `task.Task`：Try 可以是 non-Git，也沒有 branch/task/runtime，而 `task.State` 的 hot/warm/cold/done 是另一種生命週期。

- `Entry` 以隨機穩定 ID（檔名）保存 `schema_version`、kind (`try|repository`)、name/note/tags、可選的 `Experiment` metadata、timestamps、per-host `Location`、已驗證的 `RecoveryReceipt` 與短暫 `MoveIntent`。
- `Experiment` 保存 phase、slug/origin、deprecated/graduated timestamps 與 from/to；`Location` 保存 host、disposition、目前/還原 path 與 changed time。
- Store 位於 `Config.AssetsDir()`（`<state_dir>/assets/<id>.toml`），沿用 `task.Store` 的一筆一檔、temp+close+chmod+rename 原子更新與壞檔隔離模式；diagnostics 由 API 回傳或注入 logger，不直接寫 `os.Stderr`。
- Registry 提供 `List/Get/Update/FindByPath/EnsureRepository/Attach/Patch`。普通 repo 只在第一次 mark/note/track 時建立 entry，不為所有 scan roots 預先落盤。
- Match 先用 host + canonical path／Git common-dir；remote identity 只作 relocate 提示，遇到同 remote 多 clone 時不得自動合併。
- Locations 按 `config.Hostname()` 分開，讓 syncable state 不會把「A 機已 evict」誤當成所有機器都沒有 checkout。
- Live Git status、runtime、size 不寫入 catalog；recovery receipt 只記錄某次 backup 驗證的 remote、HEAD/ref digest 與時間，apply 前仍須重驗。

新增 `internal/pathx` 給 graduate/archive/reclaim 共用：以 `filepath.Abs/Clean/Rel` 與可解析部分的 `EvalSymlinks` 做 separator-aware containment，拒絕 root 本身、`..`、symlink escape 與 `/tries/foo` 對 `/tries/foobar` 的 prefix 誤判；category/name 僅允許單一 path component。

## 2. 抽出 `internal/experiment`，讓舊 CLI 與 TUI 共用

把 `internal/cli/try.go`、`internal/cli/graduate.go` 的 policy 移入 `experiment.Service`；Cobra 只解析 flags、呼叫 service、render 結果。核心 API 包含：

- `Reconcile/List/Resolve/ResolveOrCreate/Touch`
- `Deprecate/Reactivate/Archive/Restore/Graduate`
- request/result types 明確描述 dry-run plan、move、catalog transition 與需要重新載入的 inventory。

Reconcile/backfill 規則：

1. 掃描 `TriesRoot` 第一層並跳過隱藏目錄（含 `.dev`）；首次看到既有目錄時配置 ID，不搬、不改名、不寫 repo sidecar。
2. 日期前綴只用來回填 `CreatedAt`；不再把 directory mtime 當 last-used。Open 成功後 `Touch`，列表 activity 取 `max(LastOpenedAt, last Git commit)`，都未知就顯示 unknown。
3. Resolve 順序為 exact ID、完整 basename、去日期後完整名稱、唯一 substring；多個 substring 必須回 ambiguity，不再靜默挑最新。
4. Clone 預設採 `owner-repo` slug；同日碰撞以 `-2/-3` versioning，不覆寫也不誤開另一個 Try。
5. 外部手動搬移且無唯一身份時，以 `dev tries attach <id> <path>` 明確重新連結。

Lifecycle filesystem 行為：

- `deprecate/reactivate` 只改 phase，不搬檔。
- `archive` 搬到 `<tries_root>/.dev/archive/<id>/<basename>`，記住 restore path；`restore` 拒絕覆蓋已存在目的地。
- `graduate` 保留 ID/tags/note/Experiment history，將 kind 改為 repository、更新 location；normal directory 用 `os.Rename`，linked worktree 新增並使用 `gitx.MoveWorktree`（`git worktree move`）。MVP 對跨 filesystem move 明確拒絕。
- Non-Git Try 的 Git init/initial commit 在搬移前完成，失敗時仍留在原處；remote create/push 在本機 graduation 成功後才做，失敗不謊稱 remote 成功，也不回滾已完成的本機 graduation。
- Archive/graduate 先寫 `MoveIntent`、執行 move、再 finalize；`Reconcile` 根據 from/to 實際存在性修復中斷狀態。Catalog finalize 失敗時嘗試搬回並回報。
- Evicted tombstone 保留最後 path、phase、tags、remote/recovery receipt 與時間；首版不自動 GC/forget catalog history。

## 3. 保持 CLI 相容並加入管理入口

保留既有語法與行為：

- `dev try [name] [--clone URL] [--no-git]`、`dev try --list`
- `dev graduate [try]` 與現有 flags

新增 sibling `dev tries` group，避免把今天合法的 `dev try archive` 從「開啟名為 archive 的 Try」變成 subcommand：

- `list [query] [--all] [--json] [--sizes]`
- `open/touch/attach/mark`
- `deprecate/reactivate/archive/restore`
- `graduate`（與 top-level `dev graduate` 共用同一 service）
- `backup --remote <name> [--push] [--create --private]`
- `evict <ref...> [--apply]` 與明確 data-loss acknowledgements

Repository 共用 metadata：

- 在現有 `dev repo` group 加 `mark <repo> --add/--remove/--note`。
- `repo list` 加 `--include-tries`、`--json`、`--sizes`，透過 catalog join 顯示 tags/mark；不改 `repo.Discover` 的通用掃描與 common-dir 去重。
- 新增 `dev reclaim` 作跨 Try/repo 的 read-only 候選報告（age/tag/size/kind filters）；只有 `--apply` 才執行，且共用 `reclaim.Service`。
- `important` 置頂並加強 destructive warning；`keep` 排除預設 reclaim 候選且需 `--override-keep`；`task.Task.Tags` 維持 task/change-stream metadata，不自動同步。
- JSON 使用可向後擴充的 nested `asset`、`size`、`reclaim` objects；未知 size 用 `null`，不以 `0` 冒充。

## 4. 實作一致的容量模型

新增 `internal/diskusage`；在 `gitx.Repo` 的同一次 `rev-parse` 補取 checkout-specific `GitDir`，搭配既有 `GitCommonDir/Key/MainRoot/IsLinkedWorktree` 判斷 ownership。

`Usage` 至少包含：

- `checkout_bytes`：checkout root 內 logical `Lstat.Size()`，跳過 root `.git` entry；不 follow symlink，symlink 只算自身，sparse file 以 logical length 計。
- `private_git_bytes`：只屬於此 checkout、刪除此 checkout 可回收的 Git admin data。
- `shared_git_bytes`：shared common-dir 的非重疊 logical bytes，只供 detail/context，不歸到每個 worktree。
- `owned_bytes = checkout + private_git`：TRY/REPOS `SIZE` 欄的預設值。
- `total_bytes`：僅在 standalone ownership 完整、沒有 shared ambiguity 時提供。
- `complete/unreadable_entries/measured_at/cached`；partial 顯示為 `≥N`，不可包裝成精確值。

Ownership 規則：standalone clone 且 common-dir 位於目標內時，`.git` 算 private；linked worktree 只算自己的 checkout 與可唯一歸屬的 gitdir，common objects/refs 算 shared；main checkout 仍有 linked worktrees或 external git-dir 時，common-dir 不算其 reclaimable bytes。各欄位不得重複計數。

效能與快取：

- Portable Go walker、context cancellation、最多 2 個背景 scanner；列表/TUI startup 不同步遞迴所有 repo。
- `$XDG_CACHE_HOME/dev/sizes-v1.json` 使用 versioned key（canonical checkout/git/common dirs）與原子 `0600` 寫入，TTL 10 分鐘；nested 變更主要依 TTL，不假裝 root mtime 能完整 invalidation。
- Create/clone/archive/restore/graduate/evict、外部 TUI tool 返回後精準 invalidate；`r` 強制重測當前 local view。
- TUI 先套 fresh cache，再以 `loadID + sizeMsg` 流式逐列更新；切 view/reload 時 cancel 舊 batch，晚到訊息因 load ID 不符而忽略。每個 `sizeMsg` 後排下一個 channel receive command，避免阻塞 Tea loop。

## 5. 安全 backup／reclaim／evict

新增 `internal/reclaim`，將 inspect/plan、backup、evict、restore 與 finding codes 放在 domain；CLI/TUI 只呈現 plan 並收集明確意圖。`Apply` 必須在真正 move/remove 前重新 inspect，不能信任幾秒前的畫面。

Git preflight 除了重用 `gitx.StatusOf/Discover/Worktrees`，新增 `gitx.RecoverySnapshot` 檢查：

- staged/unstaged/untracked/conflicted 與 merge/rebase/cherry-pick/bisect 等進行中狀態；
- ignored files（尤其 `.env`、dependencies/build artifacts）及 unreadable content；
- local heads/tags/notes、stash，以及指定 remote 的實際 refs/OIDs；
- linked/locked/prunable worktrees、shared common-dir ownership；
- submodule、nested Git repo、Git LFS；首版無法完整證明時直接阻擋 safe eviction；
- catalog `keep`、未完成 task、live runtime、目前 cwd 位於 target、alias/symlink containment。

操作語意：

- `backup --push` 明確推送選定 heads/tags/notes，再以 `ls-remote` 驗證並寫 receipt；stash 不自動藏到特殊 ref。`forge.CreateRepo(...Push:true)` 不能單獨當完整 backup proof。
- Standalone Git 只有在 worktree clean、ignored 已處理、所有受保護 refs 已由指定 remote 驗證且無 blocker 時可 safe-evict。
- Linked worktree 若 clean 且 branch/commit 仍由可用 shared common-dir 保留，使用 `git worktree remove`；永不刪 branch/common-dir。Main clone 仍有 linked worktree 時阻擋整個 clone eviction。
- Non-Git 預設只能 archive；要永久丟棄須明示 `--discard-without-backup`。Dirty/untracked/ignored/keep 各自使用名稱精確的 `--discard-dirty`、`--discard-ignored`、`--override-keep`，不提供含糊 `--force`，`--yes` 也不能代替 data-loss flags。
- 普通 directory eviction 先寫 intent、rename 至同 parent staging name、再 remove；這提供可 reconcile 的 metadata，不宣稱未備份資料在中途刪除後可復原。Safe eviction 已有 remote receipt；unsafe discard 明確顯示不可恢復。
- 批次操作預設 report-only；apply 前顯示每筆 canonical path、owned bytes、recovery source、blockers/warnings，要求完全大寫 `YES`。只有命令列明確列出 refs 時 `--yes` 可略過互動，廣泛 filter 不可靜默批次刪除。

首版刻意不做：跨 filesystem copy-verify-delete、non-Git/dirty 自動 tar/object-store backup、LFS/submodule/nested-repo 完整備份、allocated blocks/APFS clone/hardlink dedup、daemon/watch/automatic GC、remote repo deletion或 forge archive。

## 6. 整合主 TUI，而不是建立第二套 TUI

在既有 `internal/tui` model 增加 `ViewTries`，順序為 `TASKS | REPOS | TRY | REMOTE`；保留 header/filter/window/footer、runtime handoff、external tools 與 lazy REMOTE。Try-specific row/render/update 拆到獨立檔案，避免繼續膨脹 `model.go`/`view.go`。

- `TryRow` 帶 catalog summary + live experiment/Git/runtime/size facts；Model 增加 `tries`, `tryCursor`, per-view visibility/sort state，並讓 `currentDir()` 只對 present Try 回傳路徑。
- 將新增 callbacks 分組為 `TryActions`、`SizeActions`、`ReclaimActions` 嵌入 `Actions`，不要再加一長串平坦欄位；`internal/cli/tui.go` 注入同一批 experiment/catalog/reclaim services。
- 使用 `triesMsg/reposMsg/sizeMsg/tryActionMsg` 做 targeted refresh。Graduate/archive/restore/evict 更新 TRY + REPOS + local remote matching，但絕不因此重新查 gh/glab。
- TRY table 顯示 mark/name、phase·where、Git、last activity、`SIZE=owned_bytes`；detail 分列 checkout/private/shared Git、tags/note、origin/recovery 與 reclaim findings。REPOS 加 mark/size，窄畫面優先隱藏較次要 WT/task tally，不隱藏名稱/Git/size。
- 預設排序：important/keep、activity、name；提供 activity/size/name 切換。Reclaim overlay 固定按 eligible owned bytes 由大到小。
- 擴充 filter 為一般 AND terms 加 `tag:`、`phase:`、`where:`、`reclaimable:`、`size:>…`；`a` 採 view-specific「顯示全部」（TASKS=done、REPOS=tries、TRY=archived/deprecated/graduated/evicted）。
- 新增可重用 full-screen overlay/form state，沿用 stats overlay 的模式；create/graduate/backup/action palette 與 reclaim multi-select/review/exact-YES 不再塞進現有單一 `textinput` mode switch。
- 實作已被 reserved/docs 宣告但目前缺少的 `?` help overlay，集中顯示 context keys；這是新 view 可發現性的一部分。現有 cold-task Enter 文案落差與 taskflow callback 重構留在獨立工作，不混入本功能。
- REMOTE local matching 同時考慮 repository 與 Try，標示 `LocalKind`；即使 Git Try 預設不在 REPOS，也不能被 REMOTE 誤顯示成未 clone。

## 7. 實作順序

1. **Catalog/path 基礎**：`Config.AssetsDir`、schema/store/registry、canonical containment、multihost locations、tests；`App.Load` 初始化 catalog。
2. **Experiment vertical slice**：backfill/resolve/create/open/touch，讓既有 `dev try` 成為薄 adapter，所有舊語法與測試先保持通過。
3. **Lifecycle + graduate**：deprecate/archive/restore、move journal、`gitx.MoveWorktree`、graduate service；top-level `dev graduate` 與新 `dev tries graduate` 共用。
4. **Management/annotations**：`dev tries` group、`repo mark`、catalog inventory join、REPOS suppression/REMOTE LocalKind、JSON contracts。
5. **基本 TRY TUI**：第四 view、open/create/mark/deprecate/archive/graduate、help/form overlays與 targeted reload，先交付可用的互動流程。
6. **Disk usage**：Git ownership、scanner/cache/CLI flags，再接入 TRY/REPOS streaming size、filter/sort/detail。
7. **Reclaim**：RecoverySnapshot、backup receipts、report-first CLI、safe evict/restore與 explicit discard；最後接入 TUI multi-select review/apply。
8. **文件/e2e**：README、`internal/help/topics/tui.md`、bundled skill/command reference、reserved keys、`scripts/e2e.sh`。

目前 Go 基線已包含 direct tasks、rich Git status、heatmap與 config reload（HEAD `90276d5`）；直接建立其上，不重做已解決的 config wiring，也不回退那些型別。現有 `.specstory` 修改/未追蹤檔不屬於本功能，實作時不得覆寫或混入功能變更。

12	
13	func xdgDir(envVar, fallback string) string {
14		if v := os.Getenv(envVar); filepath.IsAbs(v) {
15			return v
16		}
17		return filepath.Join(home(), fallback)
18	}

23		}
24		return os.Getenv("HOME")
25	}

27	// ConfigHome is $XDG_CONFIG_HOME (default ~/.config).

29	
30	// DataHome is $XDG_DATA_HOME (default ~/.local/share).
31	func DataHome() string { return xdgDir("XDG_DATA_HOME", ".local/share") }

33	// CacheHome is $XDG_CACHE_HOME (default ~/.cache).
34	func CacheHome() string { return xdgDir("XDG_CACHE_HOME", ".cache") }
35	
36	// ConfigFile is the path dev loads its TOML configuration from.
37	func ConfigFile() string { return filepath.Join(ConfigHome(), "dev", "config.toml") }
38	
39	// Expand resolves a leading ~ and any environment variables in p, then makes
40	// the result absolute. Paths in config.toml are written by humans, so both
41	// "~/Worktrees" and "$WORK/trees" have to work.
42	func Expand(p string) string {
43		if p == "" {
44			return ""
45		}
46		p = os.ExpandEnv(p)
47		switch {
48		case p == "~":
49			p = home()
50		case strings.HasPrefix(p, "~/"):
51			p = filepath.Join(home(), p[2:])
52		}
53		if abs, err := filepath.Abs(p); err == nil {
54			return abs
55		}
56		return filepath.Clean(p)
57	}
58	
59	// Contract renders p with $HOME collapsed back to ~, for display only.
60	func Contract(p string) string {
61		h := home()
62		if h != "" && p == h {
63			return "~"
64		}
65		if h != "" && strings.HasPrefix(p, h+string(filepath.Separator)) {
66			return "~" + p[len(h):]

package os // import "os"

func Rename(oldpath, newpath string) error
    Rename renames (moves) oldpath to newpath. If newpath already exists and
    is not a directory, Rename replaces it. If newpath already exists and is
    a directory, Rename returns an error. OS-specific restrictions may apply
    when oldpath and newpath are in different directories. Even within the
    same directory, on non-Unix platforms Rename is not an atomic operation.
    If there is an error, it will be of type *LinkError.

package filepath // import "path/filepath"

func EvalSymlinks(path string) (string, error)
    EvalSymlinks returns the path name after the evaluation of any symbolic
    links. If path is relative the result will be relative to the current
    directory, unless one of the components is an absolute symbolic link.
    EvalSymlinks calls Clean on the result.
```
</details></tool-use>

The system must ensure that it doesn’t merge multiple live clones to avoid this issue. This is a significant concern that needs to be addressed.

I’m thinking that the `remoteCanRelocate` function should thoroughly check all location evidence. It needs to consider the current path, RealPath, and possibly the GitCommonDir. If any path exists, it should return false. It’s important to look for archived states and ensure that existing paths block remote merges. We must detect live clones accurately and ensure that all paths are checked properly to avoid any potential issues. It’s crucial to refine this logic for better accuracy. 

**Improving anyPathExists function**

I’m thinking about the `anyPathExists` helper function. It should treat permission errors as existing or unknown, which is safer by returning false. The current function should only return false if there's an error indicating "not exist"—otherwise, true if empty. For nonempty candidates, I'll use `os.Stat`; if it doesn't return nil or the error isn’t "not exist," then relocation isn't possible. If all paths are missing, then true returns. It’s essential to ensure this logic is strong and testable.

```text
# Repo quick notes + TUI notes workflow

## Context

The user wants quick thoughts attached to a repository and triggerable directly
from the TASKS/REPOS TUI. Notes must live in dev's sidecar state rather than
creating another dot-folder in every repository. The in-progress
`try-tui-metadata-reclamation` / `dev-try-wobbly-lovelace` work is introducing
`internal/catalog` with stable asset IDs, path/symlink/common-dir matching and
cross-host locations. Notes should wait for that work to land and use its stable
repository ID rather than invent a competing identity.

Chosen interaction:

- multiple append-only notes, not one overwritable scratchpad;
- `n` adds a quick one-line note to the selected local repo;
- `N` opens a notes overlay for browse/search/edit/delete;
- Markdown files are durable truth; SQLite FTS is a disposable index;
- `td` and `beads` stay optional future adapters, not core dependencies.

## Dependency / sequencing

1. Wait until the catalog agent's changes are committed and available on the
   current branch.
2. Verify the final `catalog.Registry` API and storage location before writing
   notes code. Reuse `EnsureRepository`, `Match`, stable `Entry.ID`, and
   host-local location matching.
3. Do not modify or stage the other agent's currently untracked
   `internal/catalog/`, `internal/pathx/`, or App/config integration while it is
   active.

## Storage design

### Durable source of truth

```
$XDG_DATA_HOME/dev/notes/
└── <catalog-repository-id>/
    ├── <uuid>.md
    └── <uuid>.md
```

One file per thought minimizes cross-machine merge conflicts and keeps every
note readable/exportable without dev. Each file uses YAML/TOML-style frontmatter
plus Markdown body:

```markdown
---
schema_version: 1
id: <uuid>
repository_id: <catalog-id>
created: 2026-08-27T10:30:00Z
updated: 2026-08-27T10:30:00Z
tags: [idea, follow-up]
---

Try replacing the polling loop with an event subscription.
```

The filename ID and frontmatter ID must agree. Writes are temp-file + atomic
rename. Editing preserves ID/created/repository ID. Deleting requires explicit
confirmation (`--yes` escape hatch).

### Search index (disposable)

```
$XDG_CACHE_HOME/dev/notes.db
```

Use the existing pure-Go `modernc.org/sqlite` dependency with FTS5. Index note
body, tags, repo display name and catalog ID. The Markdown files remain
authoritative; if the database is absent/stale/corrupt, rebuild it.

- `dev note reindex` performs an explicit rebuild.
- add/edit/delete update the index incrementally.
- search detects a missing index and builds it.
- `dev cache list` reports `notes`; `dev cache clear notes` deletes only the
  FTS database and never the Markdown source.
- `stats.db` remains activity-only. Do not add note tables to it.

## CLI surface

Add `internal/note/` for the file store and FTS index, then wire:

```bash
dev note add [repo] "thought" [--tag TAG...]
dev note add [repo] --editor
dev note list [repo] [--tag TAG] [--json]
dev note show <note-id>
dev note search <query> [--repo REPO] [--json]
dev note edit <note-id> [--editor CMD]
dev note delete <note-id> [--yes]
dev note path [repo]
dev note reindex
```

Repo inference follows existing command conventions: explicit repo argument,
otherwise task/repository containing cwd. Resolve/ensure repository identity
through the catalog Registry using observed host, navigation path, real path,
Git common dir and normalised remote identity.

`add` requires text or `--editor`; it must not silently create an empty note.
Structured output goes to stdout; diagnostics to stderr.

## TUI interaction

Extend the existing context-sensitive key model in `internal/tui/model.go` and
`internal/tui/view.go`:

### Quick add (`n`)

- TASKS / REPOS: `n` opens a one-line prompt for the selected repo.
- REMOTE: only enabled when a local clone exists.
- Enter atomically creates one note and refreshes note counts/latest preview.
- Esc cancels without writing.

### Notes overlay (`N`)

Default scope is the selected repository:

```text
NOTES · dev-cli                                     4 notes

  WHEN   TAGS              THOUGHT
▸ 2m     idea,git          distinguish staged vs unstaged counts
  3d     follow-up         test glab member endpoint on newer CLI

j/k move · / search · Enter expand · a add · e edit · d delete · Esc back
```

- `/` uses the FTS index and searches body/tags/repo.
- Enter toggles expanded Markdown body.
- `a` enters the same add prompt as `n`.
- `e` suspends Bubble Tea via `tea.ExecProcess`, using the existing editor
  resolution (`--editor`/VISUAL/EDITOR/nvim/vim/vi), then atomically validates
  and reindexes the edited note.
- `d` enters a visible confirmation mode; no one-key deletion.
- The global `e = edit config` remains unchanged outside the notes overlay.

Add a configurable `notes` REPOS column (count), but do not enable it by
default because the default table is already width-constrained. The selected
repo/task detail pane shows note count and latest-note preview.

## Catalog integration

Create a small adapter from live `repo.Repo` / task checkout facts to
`catalog.Observation`; reuse it from CLI and TUI. The note store keys only by
catalog ID, never by mutable filesystem path. A rename, symlink index, physical
move or second host therefore keeps the same notes.

The existing `catalog.Entry.Note` field is not used as the multi-note store.
Leave it compatible for the catalog agent; optionally plan a later migration of
non-empty legacy `Entry.Note` into one append-only note after both features are
stable.

## External task-tool boundary

Keep the TODO entries for `td` and `beads`. A future adapter may detect their
repo-local dot-folders and delegate through their CLIs. It must not mirror those
tasks into dev notes or create their folders automatically. Notes are informal
sidecar thoughts; td/beads are structured repo-local task systems.

## Critical files

- New: `internal/note/{note,store,index}.go` and tests.
- Catalog integration: the final committed `internal/catalog` APIs and
  `internal/cli/app.go` registry wiring.
- CLI: new `internal/cli/note.go`, `internal/cli/root.go`, `internal/cli/cache.go`.
- TUI: `internal/tui/{model,rows,view}.go`, `internal/cli/tui.go` and tests.
- Config/path helpers: `internal/config/config.go` only if note paths/options
  need an explicit surface.
- Docs/skill: README, storage/TUI help topics, `internal/skill/dev-cli`,
  generated command reference, TODO promotion.

## Verification

### Unit

- note frontmatter round-trip and schema/ID validation;
- atomic create/edit and safe delete;
- one-note-per-file concurrency and deterministic ordering;
- catalog ID survives repo rename/symlink/host location change;
- FTS body/tag/repo search, missing-index rebuild and incremental update;
- clearing `notes.db` leaves Markdown files untouched;
- malformed note is diagnosed without hiding valid notes.

### TUI

- `n` adds to the selected TASK/REPO and is disabled for uncloned REMOTE;
- `N` overlay navigation, live search, expand, editor callback and confirmed
  delete;

15			return v
16		}
17		return filepath.Join(home(), fallback)
18	}

23		}

25	}

38	
39	// Expand resolves a leading ~ and any environment variables in p, then makes
40	// the result absolute. Paths in config.toml are written by humans, so both
41	// "~/Worktrees" and "$WORK/trees" have to work.
42	func Expand(p string) string {
43		if p == "" {
44			return ""
45		}
46		p = os.ExpandEnv(p)
47		switch {
48		case p == "~":
49			p = home()
50		case strings.HasPrefix(p, "~/"):
51			p = filepath.Join(home(), p[2:])
52		}
53		if abs, err := filepath.Abs(p); err == nil {
54			return abs
55		}
56		return filepath.Clean(p)
57	}
58	
59	// Contract renders p with $HOME collapsed back to ~, for display only.
60	func Contract(p string) string {
61		h := home()
62		if h != "" && p == h {
63			return "~"
64		}
65		if h != "" && strings.HasPrefix(p, h+string(filepath.Separator)) {
66			return "~" + p[len(h):]

126			}
127			path := filepath.Join(root, e.Name())
128			t := tryEntry{name: e.Name(), path: path, modified: info.ModTime()}
129			if _, err := os.Stat(filepath.Join(path, ".git")); err == nil {
130				t.isRepo = true
131				if st, err := gitx.StatusOf(ctxOf(), path); err == nil {
132					t.dirty = st.Dirty()
133				}
134			}
135			tries = append(tries, t)
136		}
137		if len(tries) == 0 {
138			fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "No tries yet under %s\n", config.Contract(root))
139			return nil
140		}
141		// Most recently touched first: "what was I doing yesterday?" is the
142		// question a list of experiments actually gets asked.
143		sort.Slice(tries, func(i, j int) bool { return tries[i].modified.After(tries[j].modified) })
144	
145		tbl := NewTable("TRY", "AGE", "GIT")
146		for _, t := range tries {
147			gitCol := "—"
148			switch {
149			case t.isRepo && t.dirty:
150				gitCol = "repo ●"
151			case t.isRepo:
152				gitCol = "repo"
153			}
154			tbl.Add(truncate(t.name, 44), humanAge(time.Since(t.modified)), gitCol)
155		}
156		tbl.Render(app.Out)
157		fmt.Fprintf(app.Err, "\n%d tries under %s — promote one with `dev graduate <try>`\n",
158			len(tries), config.Contract(root))
159		return nil
160	}
161	
162	// findTry locates an existing try whose name contains the slug, preferring the
163	// most recent when several match.
164	func findTry(root, slug string) string {
165		entries, err := os.ReadDir(root)
166		if err != nil {
167			return ""
168		}
169		var best string
170		var bestTime time.Time
171		for _, e := range entries {
172			if !e.IsDir() || !strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(e.Name()), strings.ToLower(slug)) {
173				continue
174			}
175			info, err := e.Info()
176			if err != nil {
177				continue
178			}
179			if info.ModTime().After(bestTime) {
180				best, bestTime = filepath.Join(root, e.Name()), info.ModTime()
181			}
182		}
183		return best
184	}
185	
186	func openOrCD(app *App, ctx context.Context, dir, label string) error {
187		rt := app.Runtime()
188		if rt.Name() == "none" {
189			app.cdDirective(dir)
190			return nil
191		}
192		if _, err := openCheckout(ctx, rt, dir, label); err != nil {
193			app.warnf("could not open a session: %v", err)
194		}
195		return nil
196	}
197

128	// resolveTry finds the try directory to graduate: an explicit reference, or
129	// the try containing the current directory.
130	func resolveTry(app *App, triesRoot string, args []string) (string, error) {
131		if len(args) == 1 {
132			ref := args[0]
133			if abs := config.Expand(ref); isDir(abs) {
134				return abs, nil
135			}
136			direct := filepath.Join(triesRoot, ref)
137			if isDir(direct) {
138				return direct, nil
139			}
140			if match := findTry(triesRoot, ref); match != "" {
141				return match, nil
142			}
143			return "", fmt.Errorf("no try matching %q under %s", ref, config.Contract(triesRoot))
144		}
145	
146		cwd, err := os.Getwd()
147		if err != nil {
148			return "", err
149		}
150		if !strings.HasPrefix(cwd, triesRoot+string(filepath.Separator)) {
151			return "", fmt.Errorf("%s is not inside %s — name the try to graduate",
152				config.Contract(cwd), config.Contract(triesRoot))
153		}
154		// Walk up to the try's own top-level directory, so running this from a
155		// subdirectory still graduates the whole experiment.
156		rel, _ := filepath.Rel(triesRoot, cwd)
157		first := strings.Split(rel, string(filepath.Separator))[0]
158		return filepath.Join(triesRoot, first), nil
159	}
160	
161	func isDir(p string) bool {
162		info, err := os.Stat(p)
163		return err == nil && info.IsDir()
164	}
165	
166	// ensureInitialCommit gives a repository a first commit if it has none,
167	// seeding a README when the tree is otherwise empty. Reports whether it made
168	// one.
169	func ensureInitialCommit(ctx context.Context, dir, name string) (bool, error) {
170		if _, _, err := gitx.LastCommit(ctx, dir); err == nil {
171			return false, nil // already has history
172		}
173		if empty, err := isEmptyTree(dir); err != nil {
174			return false, err
175		} else if empty {
176			readme := filepath.Join(dir, "README.md")
177			if err := os.WriteFile(readme, []byte("# "+name+"\n"), 0o644); err != nil {
178				return false, err
179			}
180		}
181		if _, err := gitx.Run(ctx, dir, "add", "--all"); err != nil {
182			return false, err
183		}
184		if _, err := gitx.Run(ctx, dir, "commit", "-m", "chore: graduate experiment into a project"); err != nil {
185			return false, err
186		}
187		return true, nil
188	}
189	
190	// isEmptyTree reports a directory with nothing in it but git's own metadata.
191	func isEmptyTree(dir string) (bool, error) {
192		entries, err := os.ReadDir(dir)
193		if err != nil {
194			return false, err
195		}
196		for _, e := range entries {
197			if e.Name() != ".git" {
198				return false, nil
199			}
200		}
201		return true, nil
202	}

104	// tryEntry is one scratch directory with the facts needed to rank it.
105	type tryEntry struct {

107		path     string
108		modified time.Time

111	}

113	func listTries(app *App, root string) error {
114		entries, err := os.ReadDir(root)
115		if err != nil {
116			return err
117		}
118		var tries []tryEntry
119		for _, e := range entries {
120			if !e.IsDir() || strings.HasPrefix(e.Name(), ".") {
121				continue
122			}
123			info, err := e.Info()
124			if err != nil {
125				continue
126			}
127			path := filepath.Join(root, e.Name())
128			t := tryEntry{name: e.Name(), path: path, modified: info.ModTime()}
129			if _, err := os.Stat(filepath.Join(path, ".git")); err == nil {
130				t.isRepo = true
131				if st, err := gitx.StatusOf(ctxOf(), path); err == nil {
132					t.dirty = st.Dirty()
133				}
134			}
135			tries = append(tries, t)
136		}
137		if len(tries) == 0 {
138			fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "No tries yet under %s\n", config.Contract(root))
139			return nil
140		}
141		// Most recently touched first: "what was I doing yesterday?" is the
142		// question a list of experiments actually gets asked.
143		sort.Slice(tries, func(i, j int) bool { return tries[i].modified.After(tries[j].modified) })
144	
145		tbl := NewTable("TRY", "AGE", "GIT")
146		for _, t := range tries {
147			gitCol := "—"
148			switch {
149			case t.isRepo && t.dirty:
150				gitCol = "repo ●"
151			case t.isRepo:
152				gitCol = "repo"
153			}
154			tbl.Add(truncate(t.name, 44), humanAge(time.Since(t.modified)), gitCol)
155		}
156		tbl.Render(app.Out)
157		fmt.Fprintf(app.Err, "\n%d tries under %s — promote one with `dev graduate <try>`\n",
158			len(tries), config.Contract(root))
159		return nil
160	}
161	
162	// findTry locates an existing try whose name contains the slug, preferring the
163	// most recent when several match.
164	func findTry(root, slug string) string {
165		entries, err := os.ReadDir(root)
166		if err != nil {
167			return ""
168		}
169		var best string
170		var bestTime time.Time
171		for _, e := range entries {
172			if !e.IsDir() || !strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(e.Name()), strings.ToLower(slug)) {
173				continue
174			}
175			info, err := e.Info()
176			if err != nil {
177				continue
178			}
179			if info.ModTime().After(bestTime) {
180				best, bestTime = filepath.Join(root, e.Name()), info.ModTime()
181			}
182		}
183		return best
184	}
185	
186	func openOrCD(app *App, ctx context.Context, dir, label string) error {
187		rt := app.Runtime()
188		if rt.Name() == "none" {
189			app.cdDirective(dir)
190			return nil
191		}
192		if _, err := openCheckout(ctx, rt, dir, label); err != nil {
193			app.warnf("could not open a session: %v", err)
194		}
195		return nil
196	}

32			Long: `Move a try out of the scratch directory and into your projects tree.
33	
34	An experiment that turns out to matter should stop being an experiment, and
35	that transition is where things usually get lost — the directory keeps its date
36	prefix forever, or it gets copied by hand and the history is left behind.
37	
38	graduate moves the directory to <project_root>/<category>/<name>, drops the
39	date prefix, makes sure it has a git repo and a first commit, and optionally
40	creates the remote with gh or glab.
41	
42	With no argument, the try containing the current directory is used.`,
43			Args: cobra.MaximumNArgs(1),
44			RunE: func(cmd *cobra.Command, args []string) error {
45				ctx := ctxOf()
46				triesRoot := config.Expand(app.Cfg.Paths.TriesRoot)
47	
48				src, err := resolveTry(app, triesRoot, args)
49				if err != nil {
50					return err
51				}
52				if name == "" {
53					name = datePrefix.ReplaceAllString(filepath.Base(src), "")
54				}
55				if name == "" {
56					return fmt.Errorf("could not derive a project name from %s — pass --name", src)
57				}
58	
59				dest := filepath.Join(config.Expand(app.Cfg.Paths.ProjectRoot), category, name)
60				if _, err := os.Stat(dest); err == nil {
61					return fmt.Errorf("%s already exists", config.Contract(dest))
62				}
63	
64				fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "graduate  %s\n", config.Contract(src))
65				fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "       →  %s\n", config.Contract(dest))

69				}
70

72					return err
73				}
74				// Rename first: it is atomic within a filesystem and leaves
75				// nothing half-copied if it fails.
76				if err := os.Rename(src, dest); err != nil {
77					return fmt.Errorf("move %s: %w\n"+
78						"If the projects root is on another filesystem, copy it by hand and remove the try",
79						config.Contract(src), err)
80				}

128	// resolveTry finds the try directory to graduate: an explicit reference, or
129	// the try containing the current directory.
130	func resolveTry(app *App, triesRoot string, args []string) (string, error) {
131		if len(args) == 1 {
132			ref := args[0]
133			if abs := config.Expand(ref); isDir(abs) {
134				return abs, nil
135			}
136			direct := filepath.Join(triesRoot, ref)
137			if isDir(direct) {
138				return direct, nil
139			}
140			if match := findTry(triesRoot, ref); match != "" {
141				return match, nil
142			}
143			return "", fmt.Errorf("no try matching %q under %s", ref, config.Contract(triesRoot))
144		}
145	
146		cwd, err := os.Getwd()
147		if err != nil {
148			return "", err
149		}
150		if !strings.HasPrefix(cwd, triesRoot+string(filepath.Separator)) {
151			return "", fmt.Errorf("%s is not inside %s — name the try to graduate",
152				config.Contract(cwd), config.Contract(triesRoot))
153		}
154		// Walk up to the try's own top-level directory, so running this from a
155		// subdirectory still graduates the whole experiment.
156		rel, _ := filepath.Rel(triesRoot, cwd)
157		first := strings.Split(rel, string(filepath.Separator))[0]
158		return filepath.Join(triesRoot, first), nil
159	}
160	
161	func isDir(p string) bool {
162		info, err := os.Stat(p)
163		return err == nil && info.IsDir()
164	}
165	
166	// ensureInitialCommit gives a repository a first commit if it has none,
167	// seeding a README when the tree is otherwise empty. Reports whether it made
168	// one.
169	func ensureInitialCommit(ctx context.Context, dir, name string) (bool, error) {
170		if _, _, err := gitx.LastCommit(ctx, dir); err == nil {
171			return false, nil // already has history
172		}
173		if empty, err := isEmptyTree(dir); err != nil {
174			return false, err
175		} else if empty {
176			readme := filepath.Join(dir, "README.md")
177			if err := os.WriteFile(readme, []byte("# "+name+"\n"), 0o644); err != nil {
178				return false, err
179			}
180		}
181		if _, err := gitx.Run(ctx, dir, "add", "--all"); err != nil {
182			return false, err
183		}
184		if _, err := gitx.Run(ctx, dir, "commit", "-m", "chore: graduate experiment into a project"); err != nil {
185			return false, err
186		}
187		return true, nil
188	}
189	
190	// isEmptyTree reports a directory with nothing in it but git's own metadata.
191	func isEmptyTree(dir string) (bool, error) {
192		entries, err := os.ReadDir(dir)
193		if err != nil {
194			return false, err
195		}
196		for _, e := range entries {
197			if e.Name() != ".git" {
198				return false, nil
199			}
200		}
201		return true, nil
202	}
203

2	// operations. The checks are strict: a destination must be below its root, not
3	// merely share a string prefix with it, and symlinks are resolved before that
4	// decision is made.
5	package pathx

7	import (
8		"errors"
9		"fmt"
10		"io/fs"
11		"os"
12		"path/filepath"
13		"slices"
14		"strings"
15	)

17	var (
18		// ErrOutsideRoot reports a path that does not resolve below the requested root.
19		ErrOutsideRoot = errors.New("path is outside root")
20		// ErrRoot reports an operation that named the root itself rather than a child.
21		ErrRoot = errors.New("path is the root itself")
22		// ErrTraversal reports an explicit .. component in an unclean input path.
23		ErrTraversal = errors.New("path contains parent traversal")
24		// ErrInvalidComponent reports a value that is not one filesystem component.
25		ErrInvalidComponent = errors.New("invalid path component")

28	// Canonical returns an absolute, clean path with symlinks resolved. If the final
29	// path does not exist yet, it resolves the nearest existing ancestor and then
30	// appends the missing suffix. This is the form needed to validate a destination
31	// before creating or moving anything into it.
32	func Canonical(path string) (string, error) {
33		if path == "" {
34			return "", fmt.Errorf("canonical path: empty path")
35		}
36		absolute, err := filepath.Abs(path)
37		if err != nil {
38			return "", fmt.Errorf("make %q absolute: %w", path, err)
39		}
40		absolute = filepath.Clean(absolute)
41	
42		probe := absolute
43		var missing []string
44		for {
45			resolved, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(probe)
46			if err == nil {
47				slices.Reverse(missing)
48				parts := append([]string{resolved}, missing...)
49				return filepath.Clean(filepath.Join(parts...)), nil
50			}
51			if !errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
52				return "", fmt.Errorf("resolve %q: %w", path, err)
53			}
54			// EvalSymlinks reports ErrNotExist both for a genuinely missing component
55			// and for a symlink whose target is missing. Treating the latter as an
56			// ordinary lexical suffix would make an escape look as though it remained
57			// below its root. Resolve the link target explicitly before appending the
58			// still-missing suffix.
59			if info, lstatErr := os.Lstat(probe); lstatErr == nil && info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 {
60				target, readErr := os.Readlink(probe)
61				if readErr != nil {
62					return "", fmt.Errorf("read unresolved symlink %q: %w", probe, readErr)
63				}
64				if !filepath.IsAbs(target) {
65					target = filepath.Join(filepath.Dir(probe), target)
66				}
67				resolved, resolveErr := Canonical(target)
68				if resolveErr != nil {
69					return "", fmt.Errorf("resolve target of %q: %w", probe, resolveErr)
70				}
71				slices.Reverse(missing)
72				parts := append([]string{resolved}, missing...)
73				return filepath.Clean(filepath.Join(parts...)), nil
74			} else if lstatErr != nil && !errors.Is(lstatErr, fs.ErrNotExist) {
75				return "", fmt.Errorf("inspect unresolved path %q: %w", probe, lstatErr)
76			}
77			parent := filepath.Dir(probe)
78			if parent == probe {
79				return "", fmt.Errorf("resolve %q: no existing ancestor: %w", path, err)
80			}
81			missing = append(missing, filepath.Base(probe))
82			probe = parent
83		}
84	}
85	
86	// CanonicalChild returns candidate in canonical form when it resolves strictly
87	// below root. It rejects root itself, lexical .. traversal, sibling-prefix
88	// confusion, and paths that escape through a symlink.
89	func CanonicalChild(root, candidate string) (string, error) {
90		if hasParentTraversal(candidate) {
91			return "", fmt.Errorf("%q: %w", candidate, ErrTraversal)
92		}
93		canonicalRoot, err := Canonical(root)
94		if err != nil {
95			return "", fmt.Errorf("canonicalize root: %w", err)

100		}

102		rel, err := filepath.Rel(canonicalRoot, canonicalCandidate)
103		if err != nil {
104			return "", fmt.Errorf("compare %q with root %q: %w", candidate, root, err)
105		}
106		switch {
107		case rel == ".":
108			return "", fmt.Errorf("%q: %w", candidate, ErrRoot)
109		case filepath.IsAbs(rel), rel == "..", strings.HasPrefix(rel, ".."+string(filepath.Separator)):
110			return "", fmt.Errorf("%q is not below %q: %w", candidate, root, ErrOutsideRoot)
111		default:
112			return canonicalCandidate, nil
113		}
114	}

116	// IsChild reports whether candidate resolves strictly below root. Policy
117	// rejections are returned as false without hiding filesystem errors.
118	func IsChild(root, candidate string) (bool, error) {
119		_, err := CanonicalChild(root, candidate)
120		if err == nil {
121			return true, nil
122		}
123		if errors.Is(err, ErrOutsideRoot) || errors.Is(err, ErrRoot) || errors.Is(err, ErrTraversal) {
124			return false, nil
125		}
126		return false, err
127	}

129	// ValidateComponent requires a non-empty relative value containing exactly one
130	// path component. Both slash styles are rejected so state synced between Unix
131	// and Windows cannot acquire a different meaning on another host.
132	func ValidateComponent(component string) error {
133		switch {
134		case strings.TrimSpace(component) == "":
135			return fmt.Errorf("empty component: %w", ErrInvalidComponent)
136		case containsControl(component):
137			return fmt.Errorf("component contains a control character: %w", ErrInvalidComponent)
138		case component == "." || component == "..":
139			return fmt.Errorf("component %q is reserved: %w", component, ErrInvalidComponent)
140		case filepath.IsAbs(component) || filepath.VolumeName(component) != "" || driveQualified(component):
141			return fmt.Errorf("component %q is absolute or drive-qualified: %w", component, ErrInvalidComponent)
142		case strings.ContainsAny(component, `/\\`):
143			return fmt.Errorf("component %q contains a path separator: %w", component, ErrInvalidComponent)
144		case invalidWindowsComponent(component):
145			return fmt.Errorf("component %q has Windows-special semantics: %w", component, ErrInvalidComponent)
146		case filepath.Clean(component) != component || filepath.Base(component) != component:
147			return fmt.Errorf("component %q is not a single clean name: %w", component, ErrInvalidComponent)
148		default:
149			return nil
150		}
151	}
152	
153	// JoinChild validates every component, joins it below root, and returns the
154	// canonical destination. It is suitable for paths such as
155	// <project-root>/<category>/<name>, where each user-supplied value must remain a
156	// single component.
157	func JoinChild(root string, components ...string) (string, error) {
158		if len(components) == 0 {
159			return "", fmt.Errorf("join child: no components: %w", ErrRoot)
160		}
161		for i, component := range components {
162			if err := ValidateComponent(component); err != nil {
163				return "", fmt.Errorf("component %d: %w", i, err)
164			}
165		}
166		canonicalRoot, err := Canonical(root)
167		if err != nil {
168			return "", fmt.Errorf("canonicalize root: %w", err)
169		}
170		return CanonicalChild(canonicalRoot, filepath.Join(append([]string{canonicalRoot}, components...)...))
171	}
172

174		for _, r := range component {

177			}
178		}
179		return false
180	}

182	func invalidWindowsComponent(component string) bool {
183		if strings.ContainsAny(component, `<>:"|?*`) || strings.HasSuffix(component, " ") || strings.HasSuffix(component, ".") {
184			return true
185		}
186		base := component
187		if before, _, ok := strings.Cut(base, "."); ok {
188			base = before
189		}
190		switch strings.ToUpper(base) {
191		case "CON", "PRN", "AUX", "NUL", "CLOCK$",
192			"COM1", "COM2", "COM3", "COM4", "COM5", "COM6", "COM7", "COM8", "COM9",
193			"LPT1", "LPT2", "LPT3", "LPT4", "LPT5", "LPT6", "LPT7", "LPT8", "LPT9":
194			return true
195		default:

198	}

201		if len(component) < 2 || component[1] != ':' {

203		}

214			}

91			return nil, errors.New("catalog registry has no store")
92		}
93		return r.store.Update(id, mutate)
94	}
95	
96	// Match finds an observation without changing the catalog. Exact canonical path
97	// or common-directory identity on the same host always wins. A remote identity
98	// is considered only as a conservative relocation hint.
99	func (r *Registry) Match(observation Observation) (*Entry, error) {
100		normalized, err := normalizeObservation(observation, false)
101		if err != nil {
102			return nil, err
103		}
104		entry, _, err := r.match(normalized)
105		return entry, err
106	}
107	
108	// EnsureRepository returns the matching repository, attaching the observed host
109	// location when safe. If nothing matches—or a remote is ambiguous because it
110	// may describe another live clone—it creates a distinct repository record.
111	func (r *Registry) EnsureRepository(observation Observation) (*Entry, error) {
112		normalized, err := normalizeObservation(observation, true)
113		if err != nil {
114			return nil, err
115		}
116		if r == nil || r.store == nil {
117			return nil, errors.New("catalog registry has no store")
118		}
119	
120		r.mu.Lock()
121		defer r.mu.Unlock()
122	
123		matched, method, matchErr := r.match(normalized)
124		if matchErr == nil {
125			return r.attach(matched.ID, normalized)
126		}
127		if !errors.Is(matchErr, ErrNotFound) && !(errors.Is(matchErr, ErrAmbiguous) && method == matchRemote) {
128			return nil, matchErr
129		}
130	
131		entry := &Entry{
132			Kind:           KindRepository,
133			Name:           normalized.Name,
134			RemoteIdentity: normalized.RemoteIdentity,
135			Locations: map[string]Location{
136				normalized.Host: locationFromObservation(normalized),
137			},
138		}
139		if err := r.store.Create(entry); err != nil {
140			return nil, err
141		}
142		return entry.Clone(), nil
143	}
144	
145	// Patch applies an atomic catalog mutation.
146	func (r *Registry) Patch(id string, mutate func(*Entry) error) (*Entry, error) {
147		return r.Update(id, mutate)
148	}
149	
150	// Attach explicitly records observation as id's present location. Explicit
151	// attachment may update a changed remote because the caller supplied the stable
152	// catalog identity rather than asking the remote hint to choose one.
153	func (r *Registry) Attach(id string, observation Observation) (*Entry, error) {
154		normalized, err := normalizeObservation(observation, true)
155		if err != nil {
156			return nil, err
157		}
158		if r == nil || r.store == nil {
159			return nil, errors.New("catalog registry has no store")
160		}
161		return r.attach(id, normalized)
162	}
163	
164	func (r *Registry) attach(id string, observation Observation) (*Entry, error) {
165		return r.store.Update(id, func(entry *Entry) error {
166			if observation.RemoteIdentity != "" {
167				entry.RemoteIdentity = observation.RemoteIdentity
168			}
169			location := locationFromObservation(observation)
170			if previous, ok := entry.LocationFor(observation.Host); ok && location.GitCommonDir == "" &&
171				intersects(canonicalValues(observation.Path, observation.RealPath),
172					canonicalValues(previous.CurrentPath, previous.RestorePath, previous.RealPath)) {
173				location.GitCommonDir = previous.GitCommonDir
174			}
175			return entry.SetLocation(observation.Host, location)
176		})
177	}
178	
179	// FindByPath performs only exact host+canonical-path matching; it never falls
180	// back to a remote identity.
181	func (r *Registry) FindByPath(host, path string) (*Entry, error) {
182		normalized, err := normalizeObservation(Observation{Host: host, Path: path}, false)
183		if err != nil {
184			return nil, err
185		}
186		entries, diagnostics, err := r.entriesWithDiagnostics()
187		if err != nil {
188			return nil, err
189		}
190		matches := exactMatches(entries, normalized)
191		if len(matches) == 0 && len(diagnostics) > 0 {
192			return nil, incompleteCatalogError(diagnostics)
193		}
194		return selectExact(normalized, matches)
195	}
196	
197	// FindByCommonDir performs exact host+Git-common-directory matching.
198	func (r *Registry) FindByCommonDir(host, commonDir string) (*Entry, error) {
199		normalized, err := normalizeObservation(Observation{Host: host, CommonDir: commonDir}, false)
200		if err != nil {
201			return nil, err
202		}
203		entries, diagnostics, err := r.entriesWithDiagnostics()
204		if err != nil {
205			return nil, err
206		}
207		matches := exactMatches(entries, normalized)
208		if len(matches) == 0 && len(diagnostics) > 0 {
209			return nil, incompleteCatalogError(diagnostics)
210		}
211		return selectExact(normalized, matches)
212	}
213	
214	type matchMethod int
215	
216	const (
217		matchNone matchMethod = iota
218		matchExact
219		matchRemote
220	)
221	
222	func (r *Registry) match(observation Observation) (*Entry, matchMethod, error) {
223		entries, diagnostics, err := r.entriesWithDiagnostics()
224		if err != nil {
225			return nil, matchNone, err
226		}
227		if matches := exactMatches(entries, observation); len(matches) > 0 {
228			entry, err := selectExact(observation, matches)
229			return entry, matchExact, err
230		}
231		if len(diagnostics) > 0 {
232			return nil, matchNone, incompleteCatalogError(diagnostics)
233		}
234		if observation.RemoteIdentity == "" {
235			return nil, matchNone, fmt.Errorf("catalog observation %q: %w", observation.Path, ErrNotFound)
236		}
237	
238		var remoteMatches []*Entry
239		for _, entry := range entries {
240			if NormalizeRemoteIdentity(entry.RemoteIdentity) == observation.RemoteIdentity {
241				remoteMatches = append(remoteMatches, entry)
242			}
243		}
244		Sort(remoteMatches)
245		switch len(remoteMatches) {
246		case 0:
247			return nil, matchNone, fmt.Errorf("remote %q: %w", observation.RemoteIdentity, ErrNotFound)
248		case 1:
249			if remoteCanRelocate(remoteMatches[0], observation) {
250				return remoteMatches[0], matchRemote, nil
251			}
252			return nil, matchRemote, ambiguous(observation, remoteMatches,
253				"remote also belongs to a different live clone on this host")
254		default:
255			return nil, matchRemote, ambiguous(observation, remoteMatches,
256				"remote identity matches multiple catalog records")
257		}
258	}
259	
260	func (r *Registry) entriesWithDiagnostics() ([]*Entry, []Diagnostic, error) {
261		if r == nil || r.store == nil {
262			return nil, nil, errors.New("catalog registry has no store")
263		}
264		return r.store.ListWithDiagnostics()
265	}
266	
267	func incompleteCatalogError(diagnostics []Diagnostic) error {
268		errorsToJoin := make([]error, 1, len(diagnostics)+1)
269		errorsToJoin[0] = ErrIncompleteCatalog
270		for _, diagnostic := range diagnostics {
271			errorsToJoin = append(errorsToJoin, diagnostic)
272		}
273		return errors.Join(errorsToJoin...)
274	}
275	
276	func exactMatches(entries []*Entry, observation Observation) []*Entry {
277		matched := make(map[string]*Entry)
278		observationPaths := canonicalValues(observation.Path, observation.RealPath)
279		observationCommon := canonicalValue(observation.CommonDir)
280		for _, entry := range entries {
281			location, ok := entry.LocationFor(observation.Host)
282			if !ok {
283				continue
284			}
285			locationPaths := canonicalValues(location.CurrentPath, location.RestorePath, location.RealPath)
286			pathMatch := intersects(observationPaths, locationPaths)
287			commonMatch := observationCommon != "" && observationCommon == canonicalValue(location.GitCommonDir)
288			if pathMatch || commonMatch {
289				matched[entry.ID] = entry
290			}
291		}
292		out := make([]*Entry, 0, len(matched))
293		for _, entry := range matched {
294			out = append(out, entry)
295		}
296		Sort(out)
297		return out
298	}
299	
300	func selectExact(observation Observation, matches []*Entry) (*Entry, error) {
301		switch len(matches) {
302		case 0:
303			return nil, fmt.Errorf("catalog path %q on host %q: %w", observation.Path, observation.Host, ErrNotFound)
304		case 1:
305			return matches[0], nil
306		default:
307			return nil, ambiguous(observation, matches, "canonical path or Git common directory matches multiple records")
308		}
309	}
310	
311	func ambiguous(observation Observation, entries []*Entry, reason string) error {
312		ids := make([]string, len(entries))
313		for i, entry := range entries {
314			ids[i] = entry.ID
315		}
316		sort.Strings(ids)
317		return &AmbiguousMatchError{Observation: observation, CandidateIDs: ids, Reason: reason}
318	}
319	
320	func remoteCanRelocate(entry *Entry, observation Observation) bool {
321		location, ok := entry.LocationFor(observation.Host)
322		if !ok {
323			return true
324		}
325		// Exact aliases, restore paths, and common directories were already handled.
326		// A navigation symlink may disappear while its physical clone or Git common
327		// directory remains, so every stored identity path must be absent before the
328		// remote can be treated as relocation evidence. Archives also deliberately
329		// block relocation while their bytes remain.
330		for _, path := range []string{
331			location.CurrentPath,
332			location.RestorePath,
333			location.RealPath,
334			location.GitCommonDir,
335		} {
336			if path == "" {
337				continue
338			}
339			if _, err := os.Stat(path); err == nil || !errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
340				return false
341			}
342		}
343		return true
344	}
345	
346	func locationFromObservation(observation Observation) Location {
347		currentPath := observation.Path
348		if currentPath == "" {
349			currentPath = observation.RealPath
350		}
351		return Location{
352			State:        LocationPresent,
353			CurrentPath:  currentPath,
354			RealPath:     observation.RealPath,
355			GitCommonDir: observation.CommonDir,
356		}
357	}
358	
359	func normalizeObservation(observation Observation, requireLocation bool) (Observation, error) {
360		observation.Host = strings.TrimSpace(observation.Host)
361		observation.Name = strings.TrimSpace(observation.Name)
362		if observation.Host == "" {
363			return Observation{}, errors.New("catalog observation host is required")
364		}
365	
366		commonDir := observation.CommonDir
367		if commonDir == "" {
368			commonDir = observation.GitCommonDir
369		} else if observation.GitCommonDir != "" {
370			left, leftErr := pathx.Canonical(commonDir)
371			right, rightErr := pathx.Canonical(observation.GitCommonDir)
372			if leftErr != nil || rightErr != nil || left != right {
373				return Observation{}, errors.New("catalog observation CommonDir and GitCommonDir disagree")
374			}
375		}
376	
377		var err error
378		canonicalPath := ""
379		if observation.Path != "" {
380			observation.Path, err = absoluteClean(observation.Path)
381			if err != nil {
382				return Observation{}, fmt.Errorf("catalog observation path: %w", err)
383			}
384			canonicalPath, err = pathx.Canonical(observation.Path)
385			if err != nil {
386				return Observation{}, fmt.Errorf("catalog observation path: %w", err)
387			}
388		}
389		if observation.RealPath != "" {
390			observation.RealPath, err = pathx.Canonical(observation.RealPath)
391			if err != nil {
392				return Observation{}, fmt.Errorf("catalog observation real path: %w", err)
393			}
394			if canonicalPath != "" && canonicalPath != observation.RealPath {
395				return Observation{}, fmt.Errorf("catalog observation Path and RealPath disagree: %q != %q",
396					canonicalPath, observation.RealPath)
397			}
398		} else {
399			observation.RealPath = canonicalPath
400		}
401		if commonDir != "" {
402			observation.CommonDir, err = pathx.Canonical(commonDir)
403			if err != nil {
404				return Observation{}, fmt.Errorf("catalog observation Git common directory: %w", err)
405			}
406		}
407		observation.GitCommonDir = observation.CommonDir
408		observation.RemoteIdentity = NormalizeRemoteIdentity(observation.RemoteIdentity)
409	
410		if requireLocation && observation.Path == "" && observation.RealPath == "" {
411			return Observation{}, errors.New("catalog repository observation requires a path")
412		}
413		if requireLocation {
414			path := observation.Path
415			if path == "" {
416				path = observation.RealPath
417			}
418			info, statErr := os.Stat(path)
419			if statErr != nil {
420				return Observation{}, fmt.Errorf("catalog repository observation path %q: %w", path, statErr)
421			}
422			if !info.IsDir() {
423				return Observation{}, fmt.Errorf("catalog repository observation path %q is not a directory", path)
424			}
425		}
426		if observation.Name == "" {
427			path := observation.Path
428			if path == "" {
429				path = observation.RealPath
430			}
431			if path != "" {
432				observation.Name = filepath.Base(path)
433			}
434		}
435		if requireLocation && (observation.Name == "" || observation.Name == ".") {
436			return Observation{}, errors.New("catalog repository observation requires a name")
437		}
438		return observation, nil
439	}
440	
441	func absoluteClean(path string) (string, error) {
442		absolute, err := filepath.Abs(path)
443		if err != nil {
444			return "", err
445		}
446		return filepath.Clean(absolute), nil
447	}
448	
449	func canonicalValues(values ...string) map[string]struct{} {
450		out := make(map[string]struct{}, len(values))
451		for _, value := range values {
452			if canonical := canonicalValue(value); canonical != "" {
453				out[canonical] = struct{}{}
454			}
455		}
456		return out
457	}
458	
459	func canonicalValue(value string) string {
460		if value == "" {
461			return ""
462		}
463		canonical, err := pathx.Canonical(value)
464		if err != nil {
465			return ""
466		}
467		return canonical
468	}
469	
470	func intersects(left, right map[string]struct{}) bool {
471		for value := range left {
472			if _, ok := right[value]; ok {
473				return true
474			}
475		}
476		return false
477	}
478	
479	// NormalizeRemoteIdentity converts common HTTPS and SCP-style Git URLs into a
480	// stable host/path key. Hosts are case-insensitive, but paths are preserved
481	// because arbitrary Git servers may use a case-sensitive repository namespace.
482	// The result remains only a hint for matching.
483	func NormalizeRemoteIdentity(identity string) string {
484		identity = strings.TrimSpace(identity)
485		if identity == "" {
486			return ""
487		}
488		if parsed, err := url.Parse(identity); err == nil && parsed.Scheme != "" && parsed.Host != "" {
489			return remoteIdentityKey(parsed.Host, parsed.Path)
490		}
491	
492		afterUser := identity
493		if at := strings.LastIndexByte(afterUser, '@'); at >= 0 {
494			afterUser = afterUser[at+1:]
495		}
496		if host, remotePath, ok := splitSCPLike(afterUser); ok {
497			return remoteIdentityKey(host, remotePath)
498		}
499	
500		identity = strings.Trim(identity, "/")
501		if host, remotePath, ok := strings.Cut(identity, "/"); ok {
502			return remoteIdentityKey(host, remotePath)
503		}
504		return strings.ToLower(trimGitSuffix(identity))
505	}
506	
507	func splitSCPLike(identity string) (string, string, bool) {
508		if strings.HasPrefix(identity, "[") {
509			if end := strings.Index(identity, "]:"); end >= 0 {
510				return identity[:end+1], identity[end+2:], true
511			}
512		}
513		colon := strings.IndexByte(identity, ':')
514		if colon <= 0 || strings.ContainsAny(identity[:colon], `/\\`) {
515			return "", "", false
516		}
517		return identity[:colon], identity[colon+1:], true
518	}
519	
520	func remoteIdentityKey(host, remotePath string) string {
521		host = strings.ToLower(strings.Trim(host, "/"))
522		remotePath = trimGitSuffix(strings.Trim(remotePath, "/"))
523		if remotePath == "" {
524			return host
525		}
526		return host + "/" + remotePath
527	}
528	
529	func trimGitSuffix(value string) string {
530		if len(value) >= len(".git") && strings.EqualFold(value[len(value)-len(".git"):], ".git") {
531			return value[:len(value)-len(".git")]
532		}
533		return value
534	}
535

185		out := make([]string, 0, len(seen))
186		for tag := range seen {
187			out = append(out, tag)
188		}
189		sort.Strings(out)
190		return out
191	}

193	// Normalize applies the lossless normalizations stores use before validation.
194	func (e *Entry) Normalize() {
195		if e == nil {
196			return
197		}
198		e.Name = strings.TrimSpace(e.Name)
199		e.Tags = NormalizeTags(e.Tags)
200		if e.Experiment != nil {
201			e.Experiment.Slug = strings.TrimSpace(e.Experiment.Slug)
202		}
203	}
204	
205	// Title is the human label, falling back to the stable ID for damaged display
206	// data. Persisted entries still require a name during validation.
207	func (e Entry) Title() string {
208		if e.Name != "" {
209			return e.Name
210		}
211		return e.ID
212	}
213	
214	// HasTag reports membership after applying the same normalization as storage.
215	func (e Entry) HasTag(tag string) bool {
216		tag = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(tag))
217		return tag != "" && slices.Contains(e.Tags, tag)
218	}
219	
220	// LocationFor returns host's location without exposing the map for mutation.
221	func (e Entry) LocationFor(host string) (Location, bool) {
222		location, ok := e.Locations[host]
223		return location, ok
224	}
225	
226	// SetLocation validates and records one host location.
227	func (e *Entry) SetLocation(host string, location Location) error {
228		if e == nil {
229			return errors.New("set location on nil catalog entry")
230		}
231		if err := validateLocation(host, location); err != nil {
232			return err
233		}
234		if e.Locations == nil {
235			e.Locations = make(map[string]Location)
236		}
237		e.Locations[host] = location
238		return nil
239	}

241	// Clone returns a deep copy suitable for mutation before an atomic update.
242	func (e Entry) Clone() *Entry {
243		clone := e
244		clone.Tags = append([]string(nil), e.Tags...)
245		if e.Experiment != nil {
246			value := *e.Experiment
247			clone.Experiment = &value
248		}
249		if e.RecoveryReceipt != nil {
250			value := *e.RecoveryReceipt
251			clone.RecoveryReceipt = &value
252		}
253		if e.MoveIntent != nil {
254			value := *e.MoveIntent
255			clone.MoveIntent = &value
256		}
257		if e.Locations != nil {
258			clone.Locations = make(map[string]Location, len(e.Locations))
259			for host, location := range e.Locations {
260				clone.Locations[host] = location
261			}
262		}
263		return &clone
264	}
265	
266	// Validate rejects records that later lifecycle operations could not interpret
267	// safely. Store.Create fills identity and timestamps before calling it.
268	func (e Entry) Validate() error {
269		if e.SchemaVersion != CurrentSchemaVersion {
270			return &UnsupportedSchemaError{ID: e.ID, Version: e.SchemaVersion}
271		}
272		if err := ValidateID(e.ID); err != nil {
273			return err
274		}
275		switch e.Kind {
276		case KindTry, KindRepository:
277		default:
278			return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s: unknown kind %q", e.ID, e.Kind)
279		}
280		if strings.TrimSpace(e.Name) == "" {
281			return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s: name is required", e.ID)
282		}
283		if !slices.Equal(e.Tags, NormalizeTags(e.Tags)) {
284			return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s: tags must be normalized lowercase values", e.ID)
285		}
286		if e.Experiment != nil {
287			switch e.Experiment.Phase {
288			case PhaseActive, PhaseDeprecated, PhaseGraduated:
289			default:
290				return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s: unknown experiment phase %q", e.ID, e.Experiment.Phase)
291			}
292		}
293		hosts := make([]string, 0, len(e.Locations))
294		for host := range e.Locations {
295			hosts = append(hosts, host)
296		}
297		sort.Strings(hosts)
298		for _, host := range hosts {
299			if err := validateLocation(host, e.Locations[host]); err != nil {
300				return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s: %w", e.ID, err)
301			}
302		}
303		if e.RecoveryReceipt != nil {
304			if err := validateRecoveryReceipt(*e.RecoveryReceipt); err != nil {
305				return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s: %w", e.ID, err)
306			}
307		}
308		if e.MoveIntent != nil {
309			if err := validateMoveIntent(*e.MoveIntent); err != nil {
310				return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s: %w", e.ID, err)
311			}
312		}
313		if e.Created.IsZero() || e.Discovered.IsZero() || e.Updated.IsZero() {
314			return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s: created, discovered and updated timestamps are required", e.ID)
315		}
316		return nil
317	}
318	
319	func validateLocation(host string, location Location) error {
320		if host == "" {
321			return errors.New("location host is required")
322		}
323		if host != strings.TrimSpace(host) {
324			return fmt.Errorf("location host %q is not normalized", host)
325		}
326		fields := []struct {
327			name  string
328			value string
329		}{
330			{"current_path", location.CurrentPath},
331			{"restore_path", location.RestorePath},
332			{"real_path", location.RealPath},
333			{"git_common_dir", location.GitCommonDir},
334		}
335		for _, field := range fields {
336			if strings.ContainsRune(field.value, '\x00') {
337				return fmt.Errorf("location %s %s contains NUL", host, field.name)
338			}
339		}
340		if location.Updated.IsZero() {
341			return fmt.Errorf("location %s: updated timestamp is required", host)
342		}
343		switch location.State {
344		case LocationPresent:
345			if location.CurrentPath == "" {
346				return fmt.Errorf("location %s: present state requires current_path", host)
347			}
348		case LocationArchived:
349			if location.CurrentPath == "" || location.RestorePath == "" {
350				return fmt.Errorf("location %s: archived state requires current_path and restore_path", host)
351			}
352		case LocationEvicted:
353			if location.RestorePath == "" {
354				return fmt.Errorf("location %s: evicted state requires restore_path", host)
355			}
356		default:
357			return fmt.Errorf("location %s: unknown state %q", host, location.State)
358		}
359		return nil
360	}
361	
362	func validateRecoveryReceipt(receipt RecoveryReceipt) error {
363		if err := validateHostValue("recovery receipt host", receipt.Host); err != nil {
364			return err
365		}
366		if receipt.Method == "" || receipt.Method != strings.TrimSpace(receipt.Method) {
367			return errors.New("recovery receipt method is required and must be normalized")
368		}
369		if receipt.Created.IsZero() || receipt.Verified.IsZero() {
370			return errors.New("recovery receipt requires created and verified timestamps")
371		}
372		fields := []struct {
373			name  string
374			value string
375		}{
376			{"source_path", receipt.SourcePath},
377			{"restore_path", receipt.RestorePath},
378			{"remote_identity", receipt.RemoteIdentity},
379			{"revision", receipt.Revision},
380			{"archive_path", receipt.ArchivePath},
381			{"checksum", receipt.Checksum},
382		}
383		return validateStringFields("recovery receipt", fields)
384	}
385	
386	func validateMoveIntent(intent MoveIntent) error {
387		if err := validateHostValue("move intent host", intent.Host); err != nil {
388			return err
389		}
390		if intent.Operation == "" || intent.Operation != strings.TrimSpace(intent.Operation) {
391			return errors.New("move intent operation is required and must be normalized")
392		}
393		if intent.Started.IsZero() {
394			return errors.New("move intent started timestamp is required")
395		}
396		if intent.SourcePath == "" || intent.DestinationPath == "" {
397			return errors.New("move intent requires source and destination paths")
398		}
399		if err := validateStringFields("move intent", []struct {
400			name  string
401			value string
402		}{
403			{"source_path", intent.SourcePath},
404			{"destination_path", intent.DestinationPath},
405		}); err != nil {
406			return err
407		}
408		if cleanSyncedPath(intent.SourcePath) == cleanSyncedPath(intent.DestinationPath) {
409			return errors.New("move intent source and destination are identical")
410		}
411		return nil
412	}
413	
414	func validateHostValue(name, host string) error {
415		if host == "" {
416			return fmt.Errorf("%s is required", name)
417		}
418		if host != strings.TrimSpace(host) || strings.ContainsRune(host, '\x00') {
419			return fmt.Errorf("%s %q is not normalized", name, host)
420		}
421		return nil
422	}
423	
424	func validateStringFields(scope string, fields []struct {
425		name  string
426		value string
427	}) error {
428		for _, field := range fields {
429			if strings.ContainsRune(field.value, '\x00') {
430				return fmt.Errorf("%s %s contains NUL", scope, field.name)
431			}
432		}
433		return nil
434	}
435	
436	func cleanSyncedPath(value string) string {
437		return path.Clean(strings.ReplaceAll(value, `\`, "/"))
438	}
439

162	func (s *Store) get(id string) (*Entry, error) {
163		data, err := os.ReadFile(s.path(id))

174			return nil, fmt.Errorf("decode catalog asset %s schema: %w", id, err)
175		}

178		}

197		}

217	// ListWithDiagnostics is List's explicit diagnostic form. It is useful to

219	func (s *Store) ListWithDiagnostics() ([]*Entry, []Diagnostic, error) {
220		directoryEntries, err := os.ReadDir(s.Dir)
221		if err != nil {
222			if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
223				return nil, nil, nil
224			}

229		var diagnostics []Diagnostic
230		for _, directoryEntry := range directoryEntries {

235			id := strings.TrimSuffix(name, ".toml")

237			if err != nil {

241			entries = append(entries, entry)

243		Sort(entries)
244		sort.Slice(diagnostics, func(i, j int) bool { return diagnostics[i].Path < diagnostics[j].Path })

246	}

248	// Update applies mutate to a deep copy and atomically replaces the record only
249	// if the mutation and validation both succeed. ID, Created, and Discovered are
250	// immutable.
251	func (s *Store) Update(id string, mutate func(*Entry) error) (*Entry, error) {
252		if err := ValidateID(id); err != nil {
253			return nil, err
254		}
255		if mutate == nil {
256			return nil, errors.New("catalog update requires a mutation")
257		}
258	
259		s.mu.Lock()
260		defer s.mu.Unlock()
261	
262		current, err := s.get(id)
263		if err != nil {
264			return nil, err
265		}
266		updated := current.Clone()
267		if err := mutate(updated); err != nil {
268			return nil, err
269		}
270		if updated.ID != current.ID {
271			return nil, errors.New("catalog update cannot change ID")
272		}
273		if updated.SchemaVersion != current.SchemaVersion {
274			return nil, errors.New("catalog update cannot change schema version")
275		}
276		if !updated.Created.Equal(current.Created) {
277			return nil, errors.New("catalog update cannot change Created")
278		}
279		if !updated.Discovered.Equal(current.Discovered) {
280			return nil, errors.New("catalog update cannot change Discovered")
281		}

283		now := s.now()
284		updated.Updated = now
285		prepareNested(updated, now)
286		stampChangedLocations(current, updated, now)

288		if err := updated.Validate(); err != nil {
289			return nil, err
290		}
291		if err := s.writeAtomic(updated); err != nil {
292			return nil, err
293		}
294		return updated.Clone(), nil
295	}

297	// Sort orders entries by stable ID.
298	func Sort(entries []*Entry) {
299		sort.SliceStable(entries, func(i, j int) bool {
300			return entries[i].ID < entries[j].ID
301		})
302	}

304	func (s *Store) writeAtomic(entry *Entry) error {
305		temporary, err := os.CreateTemp(s.Dir, "."+entry.ID+".*.tmp")
306		if err != nil {
307			return fmt.Errorf("create catalog temp file: %w", err)
308		}
309		name := temporary.Name()
310		defer os.Remove(name)
311	
312		if err := toml.NewEncoder(temporary).Encode(entry); err != nil {
313			_ = temporary.Close()
314			return fmt.Errorf("encode catalog asset %s: %w", entry.ID, err)
315		}
316		if err := temporary.Close(); err != nil {
317			return fmt.Errorf("close catalog temp file: %w", err)
318		}
319		if err := os.Chmod(name, 0o644); err != nil {
320			return fmt.Errorf("set catalog file mode: %w", err)
321		}
322		if err := os.Rename(name, s.path(entry.ID)); err != nil {
323			return fmt.Errorf("replace catalog asset %s: %w", entry.ID, err)
324		}
325		return nil
326	}

342	func prepareNested(entry *Entry, now time.Time) {
343		if entry.Experiment != nil {
344			if entry.Experiment.Phase == "" {
345				entry.Experiment.Phase = PhaseActive
346			}
347			if entry.Experiment.Started.IsZero() {
348				entry.Experiment.Started = now
349			}
350		}
351		for host, location := range entry.Locations {
352			if location.Updated.IsZero() {
353				location.Updated = now
354				entry.Locations[host] = location
355			}
356		}
357		if entry.RecoveryReceipt != nil && entry.RecoveryReceipt.Created.IsZero() {
358			entry.RecoveryReceipt.Created = now
359		}
360		if entry.MoveIntent != nil && entry.MoveIntent.Started.IsZero() {
361			entry.MoveIntent.Started = now
362		}
363	}

365	func stampChangedLocations(current, updated *Entry, now time.Time) {
366		for host, location := range updated.Locations {
367			previous, existed := current.Locations[host]
368			if !existed || locationPayloadChanged(previous, location) {
369				location.Updated = now
370			} else {

372				// host's location must not make it look newly observed.
373				location.Updated = previous.Updated

375			updated.Locations[host] = location
376		}
377	}

379	func locationPayloadChanged(left, right Location) bool {
380		left.Updated = time.Time{}
381		right.Updated = time.Time{}
382		return left != right
