239	// Clone returns a deep copy suitable for mutation before an atomic update.
240	func (e Entry) Clone() *Entry {
241		clone := e
242		clone.Tags = append([]string(nil), e.Tags...)
243		if e.Experiment != nil {
244			value := *e.Experiment
245			clone.Experiment = &value
246		}
247		if e.RecoveryReceipt != nil {
248			value := *e.RecoveryReceipt
249			clone.RecoveryReceipt = &value
250		}
251		if e.MoveIntent != nil {
252			value := *e.MoveIntent
253			clone.MoveIntent = &value
254		}
255		if e.Locations != nil {
256			clone.Locations = make(map[string]Location, len(e.Locations))
257			for host, location := range e.Locations {
258				clone.Locations[host] = location
259			}
260		}
261		return &clone
262	}

264	// Validate rejects records that later lifecycle operations could not interpret
265	// safely. Store.Create fills identity and timestamps before calling it.
266	func (e Entry) Validate() error {
267		if e.SchemaVersion != CurrentSchemaVersion {
268			return &UnsupportedSchemaError{ID: e.ID, Version: e.SchemaVersion}
269		}
270		if err := ValidateID(e.ID); err != nil {
271			return err
272		}
273		switch e.Kind {
274		case KindTry, KindRepository:
275		default:
276			return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s: unknown kind %q", e.ID, e.Kind)
277		}
278		if strings.TrimSpace(e.Name) == "" {
279			return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s: name is required", e.ID)
280		}
281		if !slices.Equal(e.Tags, NormalizeTags(e.Tags)) {
282			return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s: tags must be normalized lowercase values", e.ID)
283		}
284		if e.Experiment != nil {
285			switch e.Experiment.Phase {
286			case PhaseActive, PhaseDeprecated, PhaseGraduated:
287			default:
288				return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s: unknown experiment phase %q", e.ID, e.Experiment.Phase)
289			}
290			if e.Experiment.Started.IsZero() {
291				return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s: experiment started timestamp is required", e.ID)
292			}
293			if e.Experiment.Slug != "" {
294				if err := pathx.ValidateComponent(e.Experiment.Slug); err != nil {
295					return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s: experiment slug: %w", e.ID, err)
296				}
297			}
298			if err := validateStringFields("experiment", []struct {
299				name  string
300				value string
301			}{
302				{"slug", e.Experiment.Slug},
303				{"original_path", e.Experiment.OriginalPath},
304				{"deprecated_path", e.Experiment.DeprecatedPath},
305				{"graduated_path", e.Experiment.GraduatedPath},
306			}); err != nil {
307				return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s: %w", e.ID, err)
308			}
309		}
310		hosts := make([]string, 0, len(e.Locations))
311		for host := range e.Locations {
312			hosts = append(hosts, host)
313		}
314		sort.Strings(hosts)
315		for _, host := range hosts {
316			if err := validateLocation(host, e.Locations[host]); err != nil {
317				return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s: %w", e.ID, err)
318			}
319		}
320		if e.RecoveryReceipt != nil {
321			if err := validateRecoveryReceipt(*e.RecoveryReceipt); err != nil {
322				return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s: %w", e.ID, err)
323			}
324		}
325		if e.MoveIntent != nil {
326			if err := validateMoveIntent(*e.MoveIntent); err != nil {
327				return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s: %w", e.ID, err)
328			}
329		}
330		if e.Created.IsZero() || e.Discovered.IsZero() || e.Updated.IsZero() {
331			return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s: created, discovered and updated timestamps are required", e.ID)
332		}
333		return nil
334	}

336	func validateLocation(host string, location Location) error {
337		return validateLocationValue(host, location, true)
338	}
339	
340	func validateLocationForSet(host string, location Location) error {
341		return validateLocationValue(host, location, false)
342	}
343	
344	func validateLocationValue(host string, location Location, requireUpdated bool) error {
345		if err := validateHostValue("location host", host); err != nil {
346			return err
347		}
348		fields := []struct {
349			name  string
350			value string
351		}{
352			{"current_path", location.CurrentPath},
353			{"restore_path", location.RestorePath},
354			{"real_path", location.RealPath},
355			{"git_common_dir", location.GitCommonDir},
356		}
357		for _, field := range fields {
358			if strings.ContainsRune(field.value, '\x00') {
359				return fmt.Errorf("location %s %s contains NUL", host, field.name)
360			}
361		}
362		if requireUpdated && location.Updated.IsZero() {
363			return fmt.Errorf("location %s: updated timestamp is required", host)
364		}
365		switch location.State {
366		case LocationPresent:
367			if location.CurrentPath == "" {
368				return fmt.Errorf("location %s: present state requires current_path", host)
369			}
370		case LocationArchived:
371			if location.CurrentPath == "" || location.RestorePath == "" {
372				return fmt.Errorf("location %s: archived state requires current_path and restore_path", host)
373			}
374		case LocationEvicted:
375			if location.RestorePath == "" {
376				return fmt.Errorf("location %s: evicted state requires restore_path", host)
377			}
378		default:
379			return fmt.Errorf("location %s: unknown state %q", host, location.State)
380		}
381		return nil
382	}
383	
384	func validateRecoveryReceipt(receipt RecoveryReceipt) error {
385		if err := validateHostValue("recovery receipt host", receipt.Host); err != nil {
386			return err
387		}
388		if receipt.Method == "" || receipt.Method != strings.TrimSpace(receipt.Method) {
389			return errors.New("recovery receipt method is required and must be normalized")
390		}
391		if receipt.Created.IsZero() || receipt.Verified.IsZero() {
392			return errors.New("recovery receipt requires created and verified timestamps")
393		}
394		fields := []struct {
395			name  string
396			value string
397		}{
398			{"source_path", receipt.SourcePath},
399			{"restore_path", receipt.RestorePath},
400			{"remote_identity", receipt.RemoteIdentity},
401			{"revision", receipt.Revision},
402			{"archive_path", receipt.ArchivePath},
403			{"checksum", receipt.Checksum},
404		}
405		return validateStringFields("recovery receipt", fields)
406	}
407	
408	func validateMoveIntent(intent MoveIntent) error {
409		if err := validateHostValue("move intent host", intent.Host); err != nil {
410			return err
411		}
412		if intent.Operation == "" || intent.Operation != strings.TrimSpace(intent.Operation) {
413			return errors.New("move intent operation is required and must be normalized")
414		}
415		if intent.Started.IsZero() {
416			return errors.New("move intent started timestamp is required")
417		}
418		if intent.SourcePath == "" || intent.DestinationPath == "" {
419			return errors.New("move intent requires source and destination paths")
420		}
421		if err := validateStringFields("move intent", []struct {
422			name  string
423			value string
424		}{
425			{"source_path", intent.SourcePath},
426			{"destination_path", intent.DestinationPath},
427		}); err != nil {
428			return err
429		}
430		if filepath.Clean(intent.SourcePath) == filepath.Clean(intent.DestinationPath) {
431			return errors.New("move intent source and destination are identical")
432		}
433		return nil
434	}
435	
436	func validateHostValue(name, host string) error {
437		if host == "" {
438			return fmt.Errorf("%s is required", name)
439		}
440		if host != strings.TrimSpace(host) || strings.ContainsRune(host, '\x00') {
441			return fmt.Errorf("%s %q is not normalized", name, host)
442		}
443		return nil
444	}
445	
446	func validateStringFields(scope string, fields []struct {
447		name  string
448		value string
449	}) error {
450		for _, field := range fields {
451			if strings.ContainsRune(field.value, '\x00') {
452				return fmt.Errorf("%s %s contains NUL", scope, field.name)
453			}
454		}
455		return nil
456	}

459		return path.Clean(strings.ReplaceAll(value, `\`, "/"))
460	}

26	// Diagnostic describes one record skipped by a directory listing. The listing
27	// still returns every valid record; callers decide whether and where to render
28	// these notices.
29	type Diagnostic struct {
30		Path string
31		Err  error
32	}
33	
34	func (d Diagnostic) Error() string {
35		return fmt.Sprintf("skipping %s: %v", filepath.Base(d.Path), d.Err)

40	// IDGenerator supplies stable random filename stems. It is injectable so tests
41	// can assert exact filenames without weakening production randomness.
42	type IDGenerator func() string
43	
44	// DiagnosticSink receives non-fatal per-record listing failures.
45	type DiagnosticSink func(Diagnostic)
46	
47	// StoreOption configures a Store.
48	type StoreOption func(*Store)
49	
50	// WithIDGenerator replaces UUID generation.
51	func WithIDGenerator(generator IDGenerator) StoreOption {
52		return func(store *Store) { store.generateID = generator }
53	}
54	
55	// WithClock replaces timestamp generation.
56	func WithClock(clock func() time.Time) StoreOption {
57		return func(store *Store) { store.clock = clock }
58	}
59	
60	// WithDiagnosticSink directs skipped-record notices to sink.
61	func WithDiagnosticSink(sink DiagnosticSink) StoreOption {
62		return func(store *Store) { store.diagnostics = sink }
63	}
64	
65	// WithDiagnosticWriter writes one line per skipped record to writer. It never
66	// defaults to a process-global stream.
67	func WithDiagnosticWriter(writer io.Writer) StoreOption {
68		if writer == nil {
69			return func(*Store) {}
70		}
71		return WithDiagnosticSink(func(diagnostic Diagnostic) {
72			fmt.Fprintln(writer, diagnostic.Error())
73		})
74	}

76	// Store is a directory of one TOML file per asset.
77	type Store struct {

81		generateID  IDGenerator

83		diagnostics DiagnosticSink

86	// NewStore returns a catalog rooted at dir.
87	func NewStore(dir string, options ...StoreOption) *Store {
88		store := &Store{
89			Dir:        dir,
90			generateID: uuid.NewString,
91			clock:      time.Now,
92		}
93		for _, option := range options {
94			if option != nil {
95				option(store)
96			}
97		}
98		return store

101	func (s *Store) path(id string) string { return filepath.Join(s.Dir, id+".toml") }

103	// Create assigns a random stable ID and atomically persists entry. The caller's
104	// value is updated only after the rename succeeds.
105	func (s *Store) Create(entry *Entry) error {
106		if entry == nil {
107			return errors.New("create nil catalog entry")
108		}
109		if entry.ID != "" {
110			return fmt.Errorf("create catalog asset: ID is assigned by the store")
111		}
112	
113		s.mu.Lock()
114		defer s.mu.Unlock()
115	
116		for range 32 {
117			candidate := entry.Clone()
118			candidate.ID = s.nextID()
119			if err := ValidateID(candidate.ID); err != nil {
120				return fmt.Errorf("generated catalog ID: %w", err)
121			}
122	
123			now := s.now()
124			candidate.SchemaVersion = CurrentSchemaVersion
125			if candidate.Created.IsZero() {
126				candidate.Created = now
127			}
128			if candidate.Discovered.IsZero() {
129				candidate.Discovered = now
130			}
131			candidate.Updated = now
132			prepareNewNested(candidate, now)
133			candidate.Normalize()
134			if err := candidate.Validate(); err != nil {
135				return err
136			}
137			if err := os.MkdirAll(s.Dir, 0o755); err != nil {
138				return fmt.Errorf("create catalog directory: %w", err)
139			}
140			if _, err := os.Lstat(s.path(candidate.ID)); err == nil {
141				continue
142			} else if !errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
143				return fmt.Errorf("check catalog ID %s: %w", candidate.ID, err)
144			}
145			if err := s.writeAtomic(candidate); err != nil {
146				return err
147			}
148			*entry = *candidate
149			return nil
150		}
151		return fmt.Errorf("generate unique catalog ID: %w", ErrAlreadyExists)
152	}

154	// Get loads one asset by exact ID.
155	func (s *Store) Get(id string) (*Entry, error) {
156		if err := ValidateID(id); err != nil {
157			return nil, err
158		}
159		return s.get(id)

162	func (s *Store) get(id string) (*Entry, error) {
163		data, err := os.ReadFile(s.path(id))
164		if err != nil {
165			if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
166				return nil, fmt.Errorf("%q: %w", id, ErrNotFound)
167			}
168			return nil, fmt.Errorf("read catalog asset %s: %w", id, err)
169		}
170		var header struct {
171			SchemaVersion int `toml:"schema_version"`
172		}
173		if _, err := toml.Decode(string(data), &header); err != nil {
174			return nil, fmt.Errorf("decode catalog asset %s schema: %w", id, err)
175		}
176		if header.SchemaVersion != 0 && header.SchemaVersion != CurrentSchemaVersion {
177			return nil, &UnsupportedSchemaError{ID: id, Version: header.SchemaVersion}
178		}
179	
180		var entry Entry
181		metadata, err := toml.Decode(string(data), &entry)
182		if err != nil {
183			return nil, fmt.Errorf("decode catalog asset %s: %w", id, err)
184		}
185		if undecoded := metadata.Undecoded(); len(undecoded) > 0 {
186			return nil, fmt.Errorf("decode catalog asset %s: unknown field(s): %v", id, undecoded)
187		}
188		entry.ID = id
189		// Version zero is the only implicit form: it means the schema marker was
190		// absent, not that an unknown future layout should be guessed.
191		if entry.SchemaVersion == 0 {
192			entry.SchemaVersion = CurrentSchemaVersion
193		}
194		entry.Normalize()
195		if err := entry.Validate(); err != nil {
196			return nil, fmt.Errorf("validate catalog asset %s: %w", id, err)
197		}
198		return &entry, nil
199	}

201	// List loads every valid record in deterministic ID order. Per-record failures
202	// are skipped and sent to the configured diagnostic sink; directory-level
203	// failures are returned.
204	func (s *Store) List() ([]*Entry, error) {
205		entries, diagnostics, err := s.ListWithDiagnostics()
206		if err != nil {
207			return nil, err
208		}
209		s.reportDiagnostics(diagnostics)
210		return entries, nil
211	}
212	
213	func (s *Store) reportDiagnostics(diagnostics []Diagnostic) {
214		if s.diagnostics == nil {
215			return
216		}
217		for _, diagnostic := range diagnostics {
218			s.diagnostics(diagnostic)
219		}
220	}
221	
222	// ListWithDiagnostics is List's explicit diagnostic form. It is useful to
223	// services that want to aggregate notices rather than render them immediately.
224	func (s *Store) ListWithDiagnostics() ([]*Entry, []Diagnostic, error) {
225		directoryEntries, err := os.ReadDir(s.Dir)
226		if err != nil {
227			if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
228				return nil, nil, nil
229			}
230			return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("read catalog directory: %w", err)
231		}
232	
233		var entries []*Entry
234		var diagnostics []Diagnostic
235		for _, directoryEntry := range directoryEntries {
236			name := directoryEntry.Name()
237			if directoryEntry.IsDir() || strings.HasPrefix(name, ".") || !strings.HasSuffix(name, ".toml") {
238				continue
239			}
240			id := strings.TrimSuffix(name, ".toml")
241			entry, err := s.Get(id)
242			if err != nil {
243				diagnostics = append(diagnostics, Diagnostic{Path: filepath.Join(s.Dir, name), Err: err})
244				continue
245			}
246			entries = append(entries, entry)
247		}
248		Sort(entries)
249		sort.Slice(diagnostics, func(i, j int) bool { return diagnostics[i].Path < diagnostics[j].Path })
250		return entries, diagnostics, nil
251	}
252	
253	// Update applies mutate to a deep copy and atomically replaces the record only
254	// if the mutation and validation both succeed. ID, Created, and Discovered are
255	// immutable.
256	func (s *Store) Update(id string, mutate func(*Entry) error) (*Entry, error) {
257		if err := ValidateID(id); err != nil {
258			return nil, err
259		}
260		if mutate == nil {
261			return nil, errors.New("catalog update requires a mutation")
262		}
263	
264		s.mu.Lock()
265		defer s.mu.Unlock()
266	
267		current, err := s.get(id)
268		if err != nil {
269			return nil, err
270		}
271		updated := current.Clone()
272		if err := mutate(updated); err != nil {
273			return nil, err
274		}
275		if updated.ID != current.ID {
276			return nil, errors.New("catalog update cannot change ID")
277		}
278		if updated.SchemaVersion != current.SchemaVersion {
279			return nil, errors.New("catalog update cannot change schema version")
280		}
281		if !updated.Created.Equal(current.Created) {
282			return nil, errors.New("catalog update cannot change Created")
283		}
284		if !updated.Discovered.Equal(current.Discovered) {
285			return nil, errors.New("catalog update cannot change Discovered")
286		}
287	
288		now := s.now()
289		updated.Updated = now
290		prepareUpdatedNested(current, updated, now)
291		stampChangedLocations(current, updated, now)
292		updated.Normalize()
293		if err := updated.Validate(); err != nil {
294			return nil, err
295		}
296		if err := s.writeAtomic(updated); err != nil {
297			return nil, err
298		}
299		return updated.Clone(), nil
300	}
301	
302	// Sort orders entries by stable ID.
303	func Sort(entries []*Entry) {
304		sort.SliceStable(entries, func(i, j int) bool {
305			return entries[i].ID < entries[j].ID
306		})
307	}
308	
309	func (s *Store) writeAtomic(entry *Entry) error {
310		temporary, err := os.CreateTemp(s.Dir, "."+entry.ID+".*.tmp")
311		if err != nil {
312			return fmt.Errorf("create catalog temp file: %w", err)
313		}
314		name := temporary.Name()
315		defer os.Remove(name)
316	
317		if err := toml.NewEncoder(temporary).Encode(entry); err != nil {
318			_ = temporary.Close()
319			return fmt.Errorf("encode catalog asset %s: %w", entry.ID, err)
320		}
321		if err := temporary.Close(); err != nil {
322			return fmt.Errorf("close catalog temp file: %w", err)
323		}
324		if err := os.Chmod(name, 0o644); err != nil {
325			return fmt.Errorf("set catalog file mode: %w", err)
326		}
327		if err := os.Rename(name, s.path(entry.ID)); err != nil {
328			return fmt.Errorf("replace catalog asset %s: %w", entry.ID, err)
329		}
330		return nil
331	}
332	
333	func (s *Store) nextID() string {
334		if s.generateID == nil {
335			return uuid.NewString()
336		}
337		return s.generateID()
338	}
339	
340	func (s *Store) now() time.Time {
341		if s.clock == nil {
342			return time.Now().UTC()
343		}
344		return s.clock().UTC()
345	}
346	
347	func prepareNewNested(entry *Entry, now time.Time) {
348		if entry.Experiment != nil {
349			if entry.Experiment.Phase == "" {
350				entry.Experiment.Phase = PhaseActive
351			}
352			if entry.Experiment.Started.IsZero() {
353				entry.Experiment.Started = now
354			}
355		}
356		for host, location := range entry.Locations {
357			if location.Updated.IsZero() {
358				location.Updated = now
359				entry.Locations[host] = location
360			}
361		}
362		if entry.RecoveryReceipt != nil && entry.RecoveryReceipt.Created.IsZero() {
363			entry.RecoveryReceipt.Created = now
364		}
365		if entry.MoveIntent != nil && entry.MoveIntent.Started.IsZero() {
366			entry.MoveIntent.Started = now
367		}
368	}
369	
370	func prepareUpdatedNested(current, updated *Entry, now time.Time) {
371		if current.Experiment == nil && updated.Experiment != nil {
372			if updated.Experiment.Phase == "" {
373				updated.Experiment.Phase = PhaseActive
374			}
375			if updated.Experiment.Started.IsZero() {
376				updated.Experiment.Started = now
377			}
378		}
379		if updated.RecoveryReceipt != nil && updated.RecoveryReceipt.Created.IsZero() &&
380			(current.RecoveryReceipt == nil || recoveryPayloadChanged(*current.RecoveryReceipt, *updated.RecoveryReceipt)) {
381			updated.RecoveryReceipt.Created = now
382		}
383		if updated.MoveIntent != nil && updated.MoveIntent.Started.IsZero() &&
384			(current.MoveIntent == nil || moveIntentPayloadChanged(*current.MoveIntent, *updated.MoveIntent)) {
385			updated.MoveIntent.Started = now
386		}
387	}
388	
389	func recoveryPayloadChanged(left, right RecoveryReceipt) bool {
390		left.Created = time.Time{}
391		right.Created = time.Time{}
392		return left != right
393	}
394	
395	func moveIntentPayloadChanged(left, right MoveIntent) bool {
396		left.Started = time.Time{}
397		right.Started = time.Time{}
398		return left != right
399	}
400	
401	func stampChangedLocations(current, updated *Entry, now time.Time) {
402		for host, location := range updated.Locations {
403			previous, existed := current.Locations[host]
404			if !existed || locationPayloadChanged(previous, location) {
405				location.Updated = now
406			} else {
407				// Updated is store-owned metadata. A mutation that did not change this
408				// host's location must not make it look newly observed.
409				location.Updated = previous.Updated
410			}
411			updated.Locations[host] = location
412		}
413	}
414	
415	func locationPayloadChanged(left, right Location) bool {
416		left.Updated = time.Time{}
417		right.Updated = time.Time{}
418		return left != right
419	}
420

22	// AmbiguousMatchError reports records that cannot be safely distinguished. A
23	// remote-only ambiguity is never resolved by picking the first entry.
24	type AmbiguousMatchError struct {
25		Observation  Observation
26		CandidateIDs []string
27		Reason       string
28	}
29	
30	func (e *AmbiguousMatchError) Error() string {
31		reason := e.Reason
32		if reason == "" {
33			reason = "multiple records match"
34		}
35		return fmt.Sprintf("%s: %s (%s)", ErrAmbiguous, reason, strings.Join(e.CandidateIDs, ", "))

40	// Observation is live repository identity gathered from discovery. Path is the
41	// navigation path, RealPath its physical target, and either common-dir field may
42	// carry Git's shared administrative directory. CommonDir matches repo.Repo;
43	// GitCommonDir is accepted for callers using gitx.Repo terminology.
44	type Observation struct {
45		Host           string
46		Path           string
47		RealPath       string
48		CommonDir      string
49		GitCommonDir   string
50		Name           string
51		RemoteIdentity string

96	// Match finds an observation without changing the catalog. Exact canonical path
97	// or common-directory identity on the same host always wins. A remote identity
98	// is considered only as a conservative relocation hint.
99	func (r *Registry) Match(observation Observation) (*Entry, error) {
100		normalized, err := normalizeObservation(observation, false)
101		if err != nil {
102			return nil, err
103		}

108	// EnsureRepository returns the matching repository, attaching the observed host
109	// location when safe. If nothing matches—or a remote is ambiguous because it
110	// may describe another live clone—it creates a distinct repository record.
111	func (r *Registry) EnsureRepository(observation Observation) (*Entry, error) {
112		normalized, err := normalizeObservation(observation, true)
113		if err != nil {
114			return nil, err
115		}
116		if r == nil || r.store == nil {
117			return nil, errors.New("catalog registry has no store")
118		}
119	
120		r.mu.Lock()
121		defer r.mu.Unlock()
122	
123		matched, method, matchErr := r.match(normalized)
124		if matchErr == nil {
125			return r.attach(matched.ID, normalized)
126		}
127		if !errors.Is(matchErr, ErrNotFound) && !(errors.Is(matchErr, ErrAmbiguous) && method == matchRemote) {
128			return nil, matchErr
129		}
130	
131		entry := &Entry{
132			Kind:           KindRepository,
133			Name:           normalized.Name,
134			RemoteIdentity: normalized.RemoteIdentity,
135			Locations: map[string]Location{
136				normalized.Host: locationFromObservation(normalized),
137			},
138		}
139		if err := r.store.Create(entry); err != nil {
140			return nil, err
141		}
142		return entry.Clone(), nil
143	}

164	func (r *Registry) attach(id string, observation Observation) (*Entry, error) {
165		return r.store.Update(id, func(entry *Entry) error {
166			if observation.RemoteIdentity != "" {
167				entry.RemoteIdentity = observation.RemoteIdentity
168			}
169			location := locationFromObservation(observation)
170			if previous, ok := entry.LocationFor(observation.Host); ok && location.GitCommonDir == "" &&
171				intersects(canonicalValues(observation.Path, observation.RealPath),
172					canonicalValues(previous.CurrentPath, previous.RestorePath, previous.RealPath)) {
173				location.GitCommonDir = previous.GitCommonDir
174			}
175			return entry.SetLocation(observation.Host, location)
176		})
177	}

179	// FindByPath performs only exact host+canonical-path matching; it never falls

183		if err != nil {

192			return nil, incompleteCatalogError(diagnostics)

194		if len(matches) > 0 {

198	}

203		if err != nil {

220	type matchMethod int
221	
222	const (
223		matchNone matchMethod = iota
224		matchExact
225		matchRemote
226	)
227	
228	func (r *Registry) match(observation Observation) (*Entry, matchMethod, error) {
229		entries, diagnostics, err := r.entriesWithDiagnostics()
230		if err != nil {
231			return nil, matchNone, err
232		}
233		if matches := exactMatches(entries, observation); len(matches) > 0 {
234			r.store.reportDiagnostics(diagnostics)
235			entry, err := selectExact(observation, matches)
236			return entry, matchExact, err
237		}
238		if len(diagnostics) > 0 {
239			return nil, matchNone, incompleteCatalogError(diagnostics)
240		}
241		if observation.RemoteIdentity == "" {
242			return nil, matchNone, fmt.Errorf("catalog observation %q: %w", observation.Path, ErrNotFound)
243		}
244	
245		var remoteMatches []*Entry
246		for _, entry := range entries {
247			if NormalizeRemoteIdentity(entry.RemoteIdentity) == observation.RemoteIdentity {
248				remoteMatches = append(remoteMatches, entry)
249			}
250		}
251		Sort(remoteMatches)
252		switch len(remoteMatches) {
253		case 0:
254			return nil, matchNone, fmt.Errorf("remote %q: %w", observation.RemoteIdentity, ErrNotFound)
255		case 1:
256			if remoteCanRelocate(remoteMatches[0], observation) {
257				return remoteMatches[0], matchRemote, nil
258			}
259			return nil, matchRemote, ambiguous(observation, remoteMatches,
260				"remote also belongs to a different live clone on this host")
261		default:
262			return nil, matchRemote, ambiguous(observation, remoteMatches,
263				"remote identity matches multiple catalog records")
264		}
265	}

267	func (r *Registry) entriesWithDiagnostics() ([]*Entry, []Diagnostic, error) {
268		if r == nil || r.store == nil {
269			return nil, nil, errors.New("catalog registry has no store")
270		}
271		return r.store.ListWithDiagnostics()
272	}

274	func incompleteCatalogError(diagnostics []Diagnostic) error {
275		errorsToJoin := make([]error, 1, len(diagnostics)+1)
276		errorsToJoin[0] = ErrIncompleteCatalog
277		for _, diagnostic := range diagnostics {
278			errorsToJoin = append(errorsToJoin, diagnostic)
279		}
280		return errors.Join(errorsToJoin...)
281	}

283	func exactMatches(entries []*Entry, observation Observation) []*Entry {
284		matched := make(map[string]*Entry)
285		observationPaths := canonicalValues(observation.Path, observation.RealPath)
286		observationCommon := canonicalValue(observation.CommonDir)
287		for _, entry := range entries {
288			location, ok := entry.LocationFor(observation.Host)
289			if !ok {
290				continue
291			}
292			locationPaths := canonicalValues(location.CurrentPath, location.RestorePath, location.RealPath)
293			pathMatch := intersects(observationPaths, locationPaths)
294			commonMatch := observationCommon != "" && observationCommon == canonicalValue(location.GitCommonDir)
295			if pathMatch || commonMatch {
296				matched[entry.ID] = entry
297			}
298		}
299		out := make([]*Entry, 0, len(matched))
300		for _, entry := range matched {
301			out = append(out, entry)
302		}
303		Sort(out)
304		return out
305	}
306	
307	func selectExact(observation Observation, matches []*Entry) (*Entry, error) {
308		switch len(matches) {
309		case 0:
310			return nil, fmt.Errorf("catalog path %q on host %q: %w", observation.Path, observation.Host, ErrNotFound)
311		case 1:
312			return matches[0], nil
313		default:
314			return nil, ambiguous(observation, matches, "canonical path or Git common directory matches multiple records")
315		}
316	}
317	
318	func ambiguous(observation Observation, entries []*Entry, reason string) error {
319		ids := make([]string, len(entries))
320		for i, entry := range entries {
321			ids[i] = entry.ID
322		}
323		sort.Strings(ids)
324		return &AmbiguousMatchError{Observation: observation, CandidateIDs: ids, Reason: reason}
325	}
326	
327	func remoteCanRelocate(entry *Entry, observation Observation) bool {
328		location, ok := entry.LocationFor(observation.Host)
329		if !ok {
330			return true
331		}
332		// Exact aliases, restore paths, and common directories were already handled.
333		// A navigation symlink may disappear while its physical clone or Git common
334		// directory remains, so every stored identity path must be absent before the
335		// remote can be treated as relocation evidence. Archives also deliberately
336		// block relocation while their bytes remain.
337		for _, path := range []string{
338			location.CurrentPath,
339			location.RestorePath,
340			location.RealPath,
341			location.GitCommonDir,
342		} {
343			if path == "" {
344				continue
345			}
346			if pathMayStillExist(path) {
347				return false
348			}
349		}
350		return true
351	}
352	
353	func pathMayStillExist(path string) bool {
354		if _, err := os.Lstat(path); err == nil || !errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
355			// Lstat deliberately counts a dangling symlink as existing evidence.
356			return true
357		}
358		canonical, err := pathx.Canonical(path)
359		if err != nil {
360			return true
361		}
362		_, err = os.Stat(canonical)
363		return err == nil || !errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist)
364	}
365	
366	func locationFromObservation(observation Observation) Location {
367		currentPath := observation.Path
368		if currentPath == "" {
369			currentPath = observation.RealPath
370		}
371		return Location{
372			State:        LocationPresent,
373			CurrentPath:  currentPath,
374			RealPath:     observation.RealPath,
375			GitCommonDir: observation.CommonDir,
376		}
377	}
378	
379	func normalizeObservation(observation Observation, requireLocation bool) (Observation, error) {
380		observation.Host = strings.TrimSpace(observation.Host)
381		observation.Name = strings.TrimSpace(observation.Name)
382		if observation.Host == "" {
383			return Observation{}, errors.New("catalog observation host is required")
384		}
385	
386		commonDir := observation.CommonDir
387		if commonDir == "" {
388			commonDir = observation.GitCommonDir
389		} else if observation.GitCommonDir != "" {
390			left, leftErr := pathx.Canonical(commonDir)
391			right, rightErr := pathx.Canonical(observation.GitCommonDir)
392			if leftErr != nil || rightErr != nil || left != right {
393				return Observation{}, errors.New("catalog observation CommonDir and GitCommonDir disagree")
394			}
395		}
396	
397		var err error
398		canonicalPath := ""
399		if observation.Path != "" {
400			observation.Path, err = absoluteClean(observation.Path)
401			if err != nil {
402				return Observation{}, fmt.Errorf("catalog observation path: %w", err)
403			}
404			canonicalPath, err = pathx.Canonical(observation.Path)
405			if err != nil {
406				return Observation{}, fmt.Errorf("catalog observation path: %w", err)
407			}
408		}
409		if observation.RealPath != "" {
410			observation.RealPath, err = pathx.Canonical(observation.RealPath)
411			if err != nil {
412				return Observation{}, fmt.Errorf("catalog observation real path: %w", err)
413			}
414			if canonicalPath != "" && canonicalPath != observation.RealPath {
415				return Observation{}, fmt.Errorf("catalog observation Path and RealPath disagree: %q != %q",
416					canonicalPath, observation.RealPath)
417			}
418		} else {
419			observation.RealPath = canonicalPath
420		}
421		if commonDir != "" {
422			observation.CommonDir, err = pathx.Canonical(commonDir)
423			if err != nil {
424				return Observation{}, fmt.Errorf("catalog observation Git common directory: %w", err)
425			}
426		}
427		observation.GitCommonDir = observation.CommonDir
428		observation.RemoteIdentity = NormalizeRemoteIdentity(observation.RemoteIdentity)
429	
430		if requireLocation && observation.Path == "" && observation.RealPath == "" {
431			return Observation{}, errors.New("catalog repository observation requires a path")
432		}
433		if requireLocation {
434			path := observation.Path
435			if path == "" {
436				path = observation.RealPath
437			}
438			info, statErr := os.Stat(path)
439			if statErr != nil {
440				return Observation{}, fmt.Errorf("catalog repository observation path %q: %w", path, statErr)
441			}
442			if !info.IsDir() {
443				return Observation{}, fmt.Errorf("catalog repository observation path %q is not a directory", path)
444			}
445			if observation.CommonDir != "" {
446				commonInfo, commonErr := os.Stat(observation.CommonDir)
447				if commonErr != nil {
448					return Observation{}, fmt.Errorf("catalog repository observation Git common directory %q: %w",
449						observation.CommonDir, commonErr)
450				}
451				if !commonInfo.IsDir() {
452					return Observation{}, fmt.Errorf("catalog repository observation Git common directory %q is not a directory",
453						observation.CommonDir)
454				}
455			}
456		}
457		if observation.Name == "" {
458			path := observation.Path
459			if path == "" {
460				path = observation.RealPath
461			}
462			if path != "" {
463				observation.Name = filepath.Base(path)
464			}
465		}
466		if requireLocation && (observation.Name == "" || observation.Name == ".") {
467			return Observation{}, errors.New("catalog repository observation requires a name")
468		}
469		return observation, nil
470	}
471	
472	func absoluteClean(path string) (string, error) {
473		absolute, err := filepath.Abs(path)
474		if err != nil {
475			return "", err
476		}
477		return filepath.Clean(absolute), nil
478	}

480	func canonicalValues(values ...string) map[string]struct{} {
481		out := make(map[string]struct{}, len(values))
482		for _, value := range values {
483			if canonical := canonicalValue(value); canonical != "" {
484				out[canonical] = struct{}{}
485			}
486		}
487		return out
488	}
489	
490	func canonicalValue(value string) string {
491		if value == "" {
492			return ""
493		}
494		canonical, err := pathx.Canonical(value)
495		if err != nil {
496			return ""
497		}
498		return canonical
499	}
500	
501	func intersects(left, right map[string]struct{}) bool {
502		for value := range left {
503			if _, ok := right[value]; ok {
504				return true
505			}
506		}
507		return false
508	}
509	
510	// NormalizeRemoteIdentity converts common HTTPS and SCP-style Git URLs into a
511	// stable host/path key. Hosts are case-insensitive, but paths are preserved
512	// because arbitrary Git servers may use a case-sensitive repository namespace.
513	// The result remains only a hint for matching.
514	func NormalizeRemoteIdentity(identity string) string {
515		identity = strings.TrimSpace(identity)
516		if identity == "" {
517			return ""
518		}
519		if parsed, err := url.Parse(identity); err == nil && parsed.Scheme != "" && parsed.Host != "" {
520			return remoteIdentityKey(parsed.Host, parsed.Path)
521		}
522	
523		afterUser := identity
524		if at := strings.LastIndexByte(afterUser, '@'); at >= 0 {
525			afterUser = afterUser[at+1:]
526		}
527		if host, remotePath, ok := splitSCPLike(afterUser); ok {
528			return remoteIdentityKey(host, remotePath)
529		}
530	
531		identity = strings.Trim(identity, "/")
532		if host, remotePath, ok := strings.Cut(identity, "/"); ok {
533			return remoteIdentityKey(host, remotePath)
534		}
535		return strings.ToLower(trimGitSuffix(identity))
536	}
537	
538	func splitSCPLike(identity string) (string, string, bool) {
539		if strings.HasPrefix(identity, "[") {
540			if end := strings.Index(identity, "]:"); end >= 0 {
541				return identity[:end+1], identity[end+2:], true
542			}
543		}
544		colon := strings.IndexByte(identity, ':')
545		if colon <= 0 || strings.ContainsAny(identity[:colon], `/\\`) {
546			return "", "", false
547		}
548		return identity[:colon], identity[colon+1:], true
549	}
550	
551	func remoteIdentityKey(host, remotePath string) string {
552		host = strings.ToLower(strings.Trim(host, "/"))
553		remotePath = trimGitSuffix(strings.Trim(remotePath, "/"))
554		if remotePath == "" {
555			return host
556		}
557		return host + "/" + remotePath
558	}
559	
560	func trimGitSuffix(value string) string {
561		return strings.TrimSuffix(value, ".git")
562	}

13	func idSequence(ids ...string) catalog.IDGenerator {
14		index := 0
15		return func() string {
16			if index >= len(ids) {
17				return ids[len(ids)-1]
18			}
19			id := ids[index]
20			index++
21			return id
22		}
23	}

1	// Package pathx provides the path-safety checks shared by filesystem lifecycle
2	// operations. The checks are strict: a destination must be below its root, not
3	// merely share a string prefix with it, and symlinks are resolved before that
4	// decision is made.
5	package pathx
6	
7	import (
8		"errors"
9		"fmt"
10		"io/fs"
11		"os"
12		"path/filepath"
13		"slices"
14		"strings"
15	)
16	
17	var (
18		// ErrOutsideRoot reports a path that does not resolve below the requested root.
19		ErrOutsideRoot = errors.New("path is outside root")
20		// ErrRoot reports an operation that named the root itself rather than a child.
21		ErrRoot = errors.New("path is the root itself")
22		// ErrTraversal reports an explicit .. component in an unclean input path.
23		ErrTraversal = errors.New("path contains parent traversal")
24		// ErrInvalidComponent reports a value that is not one filesystem component.
25		ErrInvalidComponent = errors.New("invalid path component")
26	)
27	
28	// Canonical returns an absolute, clean path with symlinks resolved. If the final
29	// path does not exist yet, it resolves the nearest existing ancestor and then
30	// appends the missing suffix. This is the form needed to validate a destination
31	// before creating or moving anything into it.
32	func Canonical(path string) (string, error) {
33		if path == "" {
34			return "", fmt.Errorf("canonical path: empty path")
35		}
36		absolute, err := filepath.Abs(path)
37		if err != nil {
38			return "", fmt.Errorf("make %q absolute: %w", path, err)
39		}
40		absolute = filepath.Clean(absolute)
41	
42		probe := absolute
43		var missing []string
44		for {
45			resolved, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(probe)
46			if err == nil {
47				slices.Reverse(missing)
48				parts := append([]string{resolved}, missing...)
49				return filepath.Clean(filepath.Join(parts...)), nil
50			}
51			if !errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
52				return "", fmt.Errorf("resolve %q: %w", path, err)
53			}
54			// EvalSymlinks reports ErrNotExist both for a genuinely missing component
55			// and for a symlink whose target is missing. Treating the latter as an
56			// ordinary lexical suffix would make an escape look as though it remained
57			// below its root. Resolve the link target explicitly before appending the
58			// still-missing suffix.
59			if info, lstatErr := os.Lstat(probe); lstatErr == nil && info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 {
60				target, readErr := os.Readlink(probe)
61				if readErr != nil {
62					return "", fmt.Errorf("read unresolved symlink %q: %w", probe, readErr)
63				}
64				if !filepath.IsAbs(target) {
65					target = filepath.Join(filepath.Dir(probe), target)
66				}
67				resolved, resolveErr := Canonical(target)
68				if resolveErr != nil {
69					return "", fmt.Errorf("resolve target of %q: %w", probe, resolveErr)
70				}
71				slices.Reverse(missing)
72				parts := append([]string{resolved}, missing...)
73				return filepath.Clean(filepath.Join(parts...)), nil
74			} else if lstatErr != nil && !errors.Is(lstatErr, fs.ErrNotExist) {
75				return "", fmt.Errorf("inspect unresolved path %q: %w", probe, lstatErr)
76			}
77			parent := filepath.Dir(probe)
78			if parent == probe {
79				return "", fmt.Errorf("resolve %q: no existing ancestor: %w", path, err)
80			}
81			missing = append(missing, filepath.Base(probe))
82			probe = parent
83		}
84	}
85	
86	// CanonicalChild returns candidate in canonical form when it resolves strictly
87	// below root. It rejects root itself, lexical .. traversal, sibling-prefix
88	// confusion, and paths that escape through a symlink.
89	func CanonicalChild(root, candidate string) (string, error) {
90		if hasParentTraversal(candidate) {
91			return "", fmt.Errorf("%q: %w", candidate, ErrTraversal)
92		}
93		canonicalRoot, err := Canonical(root)
94		if err != nil {
95			return "", fmt.Errorf("canonicalize root: %w", err)
96		}
97		canonicalCandidate, err := Canonical(candidate)
98		if err != nil {
99			return "", fmt.Errorf("canonicalize candidate: %w", err)
100		}
101	
102		rel, err := filepath.Rel(canonicalRoot, canonicalCandidate)
103		if err != nil {
104			return "", fmt.Errorf("compare %q with root %q: %w", candidate, root, err)
105		}
106		switch {
107		case rel == ".":
108			return "", fmt.Errorf("%q: %w", candidate, ErrRoot)
109		case filepath.IsAbs(rel), rel == "..", strings.HasPrefix(rel, ".."+string(filepath.Separator)):
110			return "", fmt.Errorf("%q is not below %q: %w", candidate, root, ErrOutsideRoot)
111		default:
112			return canonicalCandidate, nil
113		}
114	}
115	
116	// IsChild reports whether candidate resolves strictly below root. Policy
117	// rejections are returned as false without hiding filesystem errors.
118	func IsChild(root, candidate string) (bool, error) {
119		_, err := CanonicalChild(root, candidate)
120		if err == nil {
121			return true, nil
122		}
123		if errors.Is(err, ErrOutsideRoot) || errors.Is(err, ErrRoot) || errors.Is(err, ErrTraversal) {
124			return false, nil
125		}
126		return false, err
127	}
128	
129	// ValidateComponent requires a non-empty relative value containing exactly one
130	// path component. Both slash styles are rejected so state synced between Unix
131	// and Windows cannot acquire a different meaning on another host.
132	func ValidateComponent(component string) error {
133		switch {
134		case strings.TrimSpace(component) == "":
135			return fmt.Errorf("empty component: %w", ErrInvalidComponent)
136		case strings.ContainsRune(component, '\x00'):
137			return fmt.Errorf("component contains NUL: %w", ErrInvalidComponent)
138		case component == "." || component == "..":
139			return fmt.Errorf("component %q is reserved: %w", component, ErrInvalidComponent)
140		case filepath.IsAbs(component) || filepath.VolumeName(component) != "" || driveQualified(component):
141			return fmt.Errorf("component %q is absolute or drive-qualified: %w", component, ErrInvalidComponent)
142		case strings.ContainsAny(component, `/\\`):
143			return fmt.Errorf("component %q contains a path separator: %w", component, ErrInvalidComponent)
144		case filepath.Clean(component) != component || filepath.Base(component) != component:
145			return fmt.Errorf("component %q is not a single clean name: %w", component, ErrInvalidComponent)
146		default:
147			return nil
148		}
149	}
150	
151	// JoinChild validates every component, joins it below root, and returns the
152	// canonical destination. It is suitable for paths such as
153	// <project-root>/<category>/<name>, where each user-supplied value must remain a
154	// single component.
155	func JoinChild(root string, components ...string) (string, error) {
156		if len(components) == 0 {
157			return "", fmt.Errorf("join child: no components: %w", ErrRoot)
158		}
159		for i, component := range components {
160			if err := ValidateComponent(component); err != nil {
161				return "", fmt.Errorf("component %d: %w", i, err)
162			}
163		}
164		canonicalRoot, err := Canonical(root)
165		if err != nil {
166			return "", fmt.Errorf("canonicalize root: %w", err)
167		}
168		return CanonicalChild(canonicalRoot, filepath.Join(append([]string{canonicalRoot}, components...)...))
169	}
170	
171	func driveQualified(component string) bool {
172		if len(component) < 2 || component[1] != ':' {
173			return false
174		}
175		letter := component[0]
176		return letter >= 'a' && letter <= 'z' || letter >= 'A' && letter <= 'Z'
177	}
178	
179	func hasParentTraversal(path string) bool {
180		for _, component := range strings.FieldsFunc(path, func(r rune) bool {
181			return r == '/' || r == '\\'
182		}) {
183			if component == ".." {
184				return true
185			}
186		}
187		return false
188	}
189

344	func validateLocationValue(host string, location Location, requireUpdated bool) error {
345		if err := validateHostValue("location host", host); err != nil {
346			return err
347		}
348		fields := []struct {
349			name  string
350			value string
351		}{
352			{"current_path", location.CurrentPath},
353			{"restore_path", location.RestorePath},
354			{"real_path", location.RealPath},
355			{"git_common_dir", location.GitCommonDir},
356		}
357		for _, field := range fields {
358			if strings.ContainsRune(field.value, '\x00') {
359				return fmt.Errorf("location %s %s contains NUL", host, field.name)
360			}
361		}
362		if requireUpdated && location.Updated.IsZero() {
363			return fmt.Errorf("location %s: updated timestamp is required", host)
364		}
365		switch location.State {
366		case LocationPresent:
367			if location.CurrentPath == "" {
368				return fmt.Errorf("location %s: present state requires current_path", host)
369			}
370		case LocationArchived:
371			if location.CurrentPath == "" || location.RestorePath == "" {
372				return fmt.Errorf("location %s: archived state requires current_path and restore_path", host)
373			}
374		case LocationEvicted:
375			if location.RestorePath == "" {
376				return fmt.Errorf("location %s: evicted state requires restore_path", host)
377			}
378		default:
379			return fmt.Errorf("location %s: unknown state %q", host, location.State)
380		}
381		return nil
382	}

400			{"remote_identity", receipt.RemoteIdentity},

403			{"checksum", receipt.Checksum},

439		}
440		if host != strings.TrimSpace(host) || strings.ContainsRune(host, '\x00') {
441			return fmt.Errorf("%s %q is not normalized", name, host)
442		}
443		return nil
444	}
445	
446	func validateStringFields(scope string, fields []struct {
447		name  string
448		value string
449	}) error {
450		for _, field := range fields {
451			if strings.ContainsRune(field.value, '\x00') {
452				return fmt.Errorf("%s %s contains NUL", scope, field.name)
453			}
454		}
455		return nil
456	}
457

224	func (s *Store) ListWithDiagnostics() ([]*Entry, []Diagnostic, error) {
225		directoryEntries, err := os.ReadDir(s.Dir)

238				continue

240			id := strings.TrimSuffix(name, ".toml")

250		return entries, diagnostics, nil

253	// Update applies mutate to a deep copy and atomically replaces the record only
254	// if the mutation and validation both succeed. ID, Created, and Discovered are
255	// immutable.
256	func (s *Store) Update(id string, mutate func(*Entry) error) (*Entry, error) {
257		if err := ValidateID(id); err != nil {
258			return nil, err
259		}
260		if mutate == nil {
261			return nil, errors.New("catalog update requires a mutation")
262		}
263	
264		s.mu.Lock()
265		defer s.mu.Unlock()
266	
267		current, err := s.get(id)
268		if err != nil {
269			return nil, err
270		}
271		updated := current.Clone()
272		if err := mutate(updated); err != nil {
273			return nil, err
274		}
275		if updated.ID != current.ID {
276			return nil, errors.New("catalog update cannot change ID")
277		}
278		if updated.SchemaVersion != current.SchemaVersion {
279			return nil, errors.New("catalog update cannot change schema version")
280		}
281		if !updated.Created.Equal(current.Created) {
282			return nil, errors.New("catalog update cannot change Created")
283		}
284		if !updated.Discovered.Equal(current.Discovered) {
285			return nil, errors.New("catalog update cannot change Discovered")
286		}
287	
288		now := s.now()
289		updated.Updated = now
290		prepareUpdatedNested(current, updated, now)
291		stampChangedLocations(current, updated, now)
292		updated.Normalize()
293		if err := updated.Validate(); err != nil {
294			return nil, err
295		}
296		if err := s.writeAtomic(updated); err != nil {
297			return nil, err
298		}
299		return updated.Clone(), nil
300	}

302	// Sort orders entries by stable ID.
303	func Sort(entries []*Entry) {
304		sort.SliceStable(entries, func(i, j int) bool {
305			return entries[i].ID < entries[j].ID
306		})
307	}

309	func (s *Store) writeAtomic(entry *Entry) error {
310		temporary, err := os.CreateTemp(s.Dir, "."+entry.ID+".*.tmp")
311		if err != nil {
312			return fmt.Errorf("create catalog temp file: %w", err)
313		}
314		name := temporary.Name()
315		defer os.Remove(name)
316	
317		if err := toml.NewEncoder(temporary).Encode(entry); err != nil {
318			_ = temporary.Close()
319			return fmt.Errorf("encode catalog asset %s: %w", entry.ID, err)
320		}
321		if err := temporary.Close(); err != nil {
322			return fmt.Errorf("close catalog temp file: %w", err)
323		}
324		if err := os.Chmod(name, 0o644); err != nil {
325			return fmt.Errorf("set catalog file mode: %w", err)
326		}
327		if err := os.Rename(name, s.path(entry.ID)); err != nil {
328			return fmt.Errorf("replace catalog asset %s: %w", entry.ID, err)
329		}
330		return nil
331	}

347	func prepareNewNested(entry *Entry, now time.Time) {
348		if entry.Experiment != nil {
349			if entry.Experiment.Phase == "" {
350				entry.Experiment.Phase = PhaseActive
351			}
352			if entry.Experiment.Started.IsZero() {
353				entry.Experiment.Started = now
354			}
355		}
356		for host, location := range entry.Locations {
357			if location.Updated.IsZero() {
358				location.Updated = now
359				entry.Locations[host] = location
360			}
361		}
362		if entry.RecoveryReceipt != nil && entry.RecoveryReceipt.Created.IsZero() {
363			entry.RecoveryReceipt.Created = now
364		}
365		if entry.MoveIntent != nil && entry.MoveIntent.Started.IsZero() {
366			entry.MoveIntent.Started = now
367		}
368	}
369	
370	func prepareUpdatedNested(current, updated *Entry, now time.Time) {
371		if current.Experiment == nil && updated.Experiment != nil {
372			if updated.Experiment.Phase == "" {
373				updated.Experiment.Phase = PhaseActive
374			}
375			if updated.Experiment.Started.IsZero() {
376				updated.Experiment.Started = now
377			}
378		}
379		if updated.RecoveryReceipt != nil && updated.RecoveryReceipt.Created.IsZero() &&
380			(current.RecoveryReceipt == nil || recoveryPayloadChanged(*current.RecoveryReceipt, *updated.RecoveryReceipt)) {
381			updated.RecoveryReceipt.Created = now
382		}
383		if updated.MoveIntent != nil && updated.MoveIntent.Started.IsZero() &&
384			(current.MoveIntent == nil || moveIntentPayloadChanged(*current.MoveIntent, *updated.MoveIntent)) {
385			updated.MoveIntent.Started = now
386		}
387	}
388	
389	func recoveryPayloadChanged(left, right RecoveryReceipt) bool {
390		left.Created = time.Time{}
391		right.Created = time.Time{}
392		return left != right
393	}
394	
395	func moveIntentPayloadChanged(left, right MoveIntent) bool {
396		left.Started = time.Time{}
397		right.Started = time.Time{}
398		return left != right
399	}
400	
401	func stampChangedLocations(current, updated *Entry, now time.Time) {
402		for host, location := range updated.Locations {
403			previous, existed := current.Locations[host]
404			if !existed || locationPayloadChanged(previous, location) {
405				location.Updated = now
406			} else {
407				// Updated is store-owned metadata. A mutation that did not change this
408				// host's location must not make it look newly observed.
409				location.Updated = previous.Updated
410			}
411			updated.Locations[host] = location
412		}
413	}
414	
415	func locationPayloadChanged(left, right Location) bool {
416		left.Updated = time.Time{}
417		right.Updated = time.Time{}
418		return left != right
419	}

228	func (r *Registry) match(observation Observation) (*Entry, matchMethod, error) {
229		entries, diagnostics, err := r.entriesWithDiagnostics()
230		if err != nil {
231			return nil, matchNone, err

241		if observation.RemoteIdentity == "" {
242			return nil, matchNone, fmt.Errorf("catalog observation %q: %w", observation.Path, ErrNotFound)
243		}

245		var remoteMatches []*Entry
246		for _, entry := range entries {

248				remoteMatches = append(remoteMatches, entry)

251		Sort(remoteMatches)

253		case 0:
254			return nil, matchNone, fmt.Errorf("remote %q: %w", observation.RemoteIdentity, ErrNotFound)
255		case 1:

274	func incompleteCatalogError(diagnostics []Diagnostic) error {
275		errorsToJoin := make([]error, 1, len(diagnostics)+1)
276		errorsToJoin[0] = ErrIncompleteCatalog

283	func exactMatches(entries []*Entry, observation Observation) []*Entry {
284		matched := make(map[string]*Entry)
285		observationPaths := canonicalValues(observation.Path, observation.RealPath)
286		observationCommon := canonicalValue(observation.CommonDir)
287		for _, entry := range entries {
288			location, ok := entry.LocationFor(observation.Host)
289			if !ok {
290				continue
291			}
292			locationPaths := canonicalValues(location.CurrentPath, location.RestorePath, location.RealPath)
293			pathMatch := intersects(observationPaths, locationPaths)
294			commonMatch := observationCommon != "" && observationCommon == canonicalValue(location.GitCommonDir)
295			if pathMatch || commonMatch {
296				matched[entry.ID] = entry
297			}
298		}
299		out := make([]*Entry, 0, len(matched))
300		for _, entry := range matched {
301			out = append(out, entry)
302		}
303		Sort(out)
304		return out
305	}

327	func remoteCanRelocate(entry *Entry, observation Observation) bool {
328		location, ok := entry.LocationFor(observation.Host)
329		if !ok {
330			return true
331		}
332		// Exact aliases, restore paths, and common directories were already handled.
333		// A navigation symlink may disappear while its physical clone or Git common
334		// directory remains, so every stored identity path must be absent before the
335		// remote can be treated as relocation evidence. Archives also deliberately
336		// block relocation while their bytes remain.
337		for _, path := range []string{
338			location.CurrentPath,
339			location.RestorePath,
340			location.RealPath,
341			location.GitCommonDir,
342		} {
343			if path == "" {
344				continue
345			}
346			if pathMayStillExist(path) {
347				return false
348			}
349		}
350		return true
351	}

353	func pathMayStillExist(path string) bool {

356			return true
357		}
358		canonical, err := pathx.Canonical(path)
359		if err != nil {
360			return true
361		}
362		_, err = os.Stat(canonical)
363		return err == nil || !errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist)
364	}

374			RealPath:     observation.RealPath,

510	// NormalizeRemoteIdentity converts common HTTPS and SCP-style Git URLs into a
511	// stable host/path key. Hosts are case-insensitive, but paths are preserved
512	// because arbitrary Git servers may use a case-sensitive repository namespace.
513	// The result remains only a hint for matching.
514	func NormalizeRemoteIdentity(identity string) string {
515		identity = strings.TrimSpace(identity)
516		if identity == "" {
517			return ""
518		}
519		if parsed, err := url.Parse(identity); err == nil && parsed.Scheme != "" && parsed.Host != "" {
520			return remoteIdentityKey(parsed.Host, parsed.Path)
521		}
522	
523		afterUser := identity
524		if at := strings.LastIndexByte(afterUser, '@'); at >= 0 {
525			afterUser = afterUser[at+1:]
526		}
527		if host, remotePath, ok := splitSCPLike(afterUser); ok {
528			return remoteIdentityKey(host, remotePath)
529		}
530	
531		identity = strings.Trim(identity, "/")
532		if host, remotePath, ok := strings.Cut(identity, "/"); ok {
533			return remoteIdentityKey(host, remotePath)
534		}
535		return strings.ToLower(trimGitSuffix(identity))
536	}
537	
538	func splitSCPLike(identity string) (string, string, bool) {
539		if strings.HasPrefix(identity, "[") {
540			if end := strings.Index(identity, "]:"); end >= 0 {
541				return identity[:end+1], identity[end+2:], true
542			}
543		}
544		colon := strings.IndexByte(identity, ':')
545		if colon <= 0 || strings.ContainsAny(identity[:colon], `/\\`) {
546			return "", "", false
547		}
548		return identity[:colon], identity[colon+1:], true
549	}
550	
551	func remoteIdentityKey(host, remotePath string) string {
552		host = strings.ToLower(strings.Trim(host, "/"))
553		remotePath = trimGitSuffix(strings.Trim(remotePath, "/"))
554		if remotePath == "" {
555			return host
556		}
557		return host + "/" + remotePath
558	}

1	// Package pathx provides the path-safety checks shared by filesystem lifecycle
2	// operations. The checks are strict: a destination must be below its root, not
3	// merely share a string prefix with it, and symlinks are resolved before that
4	// decision is made.
5	package pathx
6	
7	import (
8		"errors"
9		"fmt"
10		"io/fs"
11		"os"
12		"path/filepath"
13		"slices"
14		"strings"
15	)
16	
17	var (
18		// ErrOutsideRoot reports a path that does not resolve below the requested root.
19		ErrOutsideRoot = errors.New("path is outside root")
20		// ErrRoot reports an operation that named the root itself rather than a child.
21		ErrRoot = errors.New("path is the root itself")
22		// ErrTraversal reports an explicit .. component in an unclean input path.
23		ErrTraversal = errors.New("path contains parent traversal")
24		// ErrInvalidComponent reports a value that is not one filesystem component.
25		ErrInvalidComponent = errors.New("invalid path component")
26	)
27	
28	// Canonical returns an absolute, clean path with symlinks resolved. If the final
29	// path does not exist yet, it resolves the nearest existing ancestor and then
30	// appends the missing suffix. This is the form needed to validate a destination
31	// before creating or moving anything into it.
32	func Canonical(path string) (string, error) {
33		if path == "" {
34			return "", fmt.Errorf("canonical path: empty path")
35		}
36		absolute, err := filepath.Abs(path)
37		if err != nil {
38			return "", fmt.Errorf("make %q absolute: %w", path, err)
39		}
40		absolute = filepath.Clean(absolute)
41	
42		probe := absolute
43		var missing []string
44		for {
45			resolved, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(probe)
46			if err == nil {
47				slices.Reverse(missing)
48				parts := append([]string{resolved}, missing...)
49				return filepath.Clean(filepath.Join(parts...)), nil
50			}
51			if !errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
52				return "", fmt.Errorf("resolve %q: %w", path, err)
53			}
54			// EvalSymlinks reports ErrNotExist both for a genuinely missing component
55			// and for a symlink whose target is missing. Treating the latter as an
56			// ordinary lexical suffix would make an escape look as though it remained
57			// below its root. Resolve the link target explicitly before appending the
58			// still-missing suffix.
59			if info, lstatErr := os.Lstat(probe); lstatErr == nil && info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 {
60				target, readErr := os.Readlink(probe)
61				if readErr != nil {
62					return "", fmt.Errorf("read unresolved symlink %q: %w", probe, readErr)
63				}
64				if !filepath.IsAbs(target) {
65					target = filepath.Join(filepath.Dir(probe), target)
66				}
67				resolved, resolveErr := Canonical(target)
68				if resolveErr != nil {
69					return "", fmt.Errorf("resolve target of %q: %w", probe, resolveErr)
70				}
71				slices.Reverse(missing)
72				parts := append([]string{resolved}, missing...)
73				return filepath.Clean(filepath.Join(parts...)), nil
74			} else if lstatErr != nil && !errors.Is(lstatErr, fs.ErrNotExist) {
75				return "", fmt.Errorf("inspect unresolved path %q: %w", probe, lstatErr)
76			}
77			parent := filepath.Dir(probe)
78			if parent == probe {
79				return "", fmt.Errorf("resolve %q: no existing ancestor: %w", path, err)
80			}
81			missing = append(missing, filepath.Base(probe))
82			probe = parent
83		}
84	}
85	
86	// CanonicalChild returns candidate in canonical form when it resolves strictly
87	// below root. It rejects root itself, lexical .. traversal, sibling-prefix
88	// confusion, and paths that escape through a symlink.
89	func CanonicalChild(root, candidate string) (string, error) {
90		if hasParentTraversal(candidate) {
91			return "", fmt.Errorf("%q: %w", candidate, ErrTraversal)
92		}
93		canonicalRoot, err := Canonical(root)
94		if err != nil {
95			return "", fmt.Errorf("canonicalize root: %w", err)
96		}
97		canonicalCandidate, err := Canonical(candidate)
98		if err != nil {
99			return "", fmt.Errorf("canonicalize candidate: %w", err)
100		}
101	
102		rel, err := filepath.Rel(canonicalRoot, canonicalCandidate)
103		if err != nil {
104			return "", fmt.Errorf("compare %q with root %q: %w", candidate, root, err)
105		}
106		switch {
107		case rel == ".":
108			return "", fmt.Errorf("%q: %w", candidate, ErrRoot)
109		case filepath.IsAbs(rel), rel == "..", strings.HasPrefix(rel, ".."+string(filepath.Separator)):
110			return "", fmt.Errorf("%q is not below %q: %w", candidate, root, ErrOutsideRoot)
111		default:
112			return canonicalCandidate, nil
113		}
114	}
115	
116	// IsChild reports whether candidate resolves strictly below root. Policy
117	// rejections are returned as false without hiding filesystem errors.
118	func IsChild(root, candidate string) (bool, error) {
119		_, err := CanonicalChild(root, candidate)
120		if err == nil {
121			return true, nil
122		}
123		if errors.Is(err, ErrOutsideRoot) || errors.Is(err, ErrRoot) || errors.Is(err, ErrTraversal) {
124			return false, nil
125		}
126		return false, err
127	}
128	
129	// ValidateComponent requires a non-empty relative value containing exactly one
130	// path component. Both slash styles are rejected so state synced between Unix
131	// and Windows cannot acquire a different meaning on another host.
132	func ValidateComponent(component string) error {
133		switch {
134		case strings.TrimSpace(component) == "":
135			return fmt.Errorf("empty component: %w", ErrInvalidComponent)
136		case strings.ContainsRune(component, '\x00'):
137			return fmt.Errorf("component contains NUL: %w", ErrInvalidComponent)
138		case component == "." || component == "..":
139			return fmt.Errorf("component %q is reserved: %w", component, ErrInvalidComponent)
140		case filepath.IsAbs(component) || filepath.VolumeName(component) != "" || driveQualified(component):
141			return fmt.Errorf("component %q is absolute or drive-qualified: %w", component, ErrInvalidComponent)
142		case strings.ContainsAny(component, `/\\`):
143			return fmt.Errorf("component %q contains a path separator: %w", component, ErrInvalidComponent)
144		case filepath.Clean(component) != component || filepath.Base(component) != component:
145			return fmt.Errorf("component %q is not a single clean name: %w", component, ErrInvalidComponent)
146		default:
147			return nil
148		}
149	}
150	
151	// JoinChild validates every component, joins it below root, and returns the
152	// canonical destination. It is suitable for paths such as
153	// <project-root>/<category>/<name>, where each user-supplied value must remain a
154	// single component.
155	func JoinChild(root string, components ...string) (string, error) {
156		if len(components) == 0 {
157			return "", fmt.Errorf("join child: no components: %w", ErrRoot)
158		}
159		for i, component := range components {
160			if err := ValidateComponent(component); err != nil {
161				return "", fmt.Errorf("component %d: %w", i, err)
162			}
163		}
164		canonicalRoot, err := Canonical(root)
165		if err != nil {
166			return "", fmt.Errorf("canonicalize root: %w", err)
167		}
168		return CanonicalChild(canonicalRoot, filepath.Join(append([]string{canonicalRoot}, components...)...))
169	}
170	
171	func driveQualified(component string) bool {
172		if len(component) < 2 || component[1] != ':' {
173			return false
174		}
175		letter := component[0]
176		return letter >= 'a' && letter <= 'z' || letter >= 'A' && letter <= 'Z'
177	}
178	
179	func hasParentTraversal(path string) bool {
180		for _, component := range strings.FieldsFunc(path, func(r rune) bool {
181			return r == '/' || r == '\\'
182		}) {
183			if component == ".." {
184				return true
185			}
186		}
187		return false
188	}

 			return fmt.Errorf("tui.tools[%d]: key %q is already bound to %q", i, t.Key, prev)
 		}
 		seen[t.Key] = t.Name
 	}
 	return nil
 }
 
 // probeVars is a dummy environment used to validate a template without having

 func (c Config) probeVars() Vars {
 	return Vars{
 		"worktree_root": Expand(c.Paths.WorktreeRoot),
 		"repo":          "repo",
 		"repo_path":     "/repo",
 		"branch":        "branch",
 		"category":      "category",
 		"host":          "host",

 }

+// StateDir is the expanded directory holding tasks/, assets/ and stats.db.
 func (c Config) StateDir() string { return Expand(c.Paths.StateDir) }
 
 // TasksDir holds one TOML file per task.
 func (c Config) TasksDir() string { return filepath.Join(c.StateDir(), "tasks") }
 
+// AssetsDir holds one TOML file per catalog asset.
+func (c Config) AssetsDir() string { return filepath.Join(c.StateDir(), "assets") }
+
 // ScanRoots returns the expanded repo discovery roots.
 func (c Config) ScanRoots() []string {
 	out := make([]string, 0, len(c.Paths.ScanRoots))
 	for _, r := range c.Paths.ScanRoots {
 		if e := Expand(r); e != "" {
 			out = append(out, e)
 		}
 	}
 	return out
 }
 
 // WorktreePathFor renders the configured template for one repo+branch pair.
 func (c Config) WorktreePathFor(repoName, repoPath, branch, category string) (string, error) {
 	v := Vars{
 		"worktree_root": Expand(c.Paths.WorktreeRoot),
 		"repo":          repoName,
 		"repo_path":     repoPath,
 		"branch":        branch,
 		"category":      category,
 		"host":          Hostname(),
 		"date":          time.Now().Format("2006-01-02"),
 	}
 	rendered, err := Render(c.Paths.WorktreePath, v)
 	if err != nil {
 		return "", err
 	}
 	return Expand(rendered), nil
 }
 
 // Hostname is the machine identity recorded as a task's owner.
 func Hostname() string {
 	if h, err := os.Hostname(); err == nil && h != "" {
 		return h
 	}
 	return "unknown"
 }

 func TestSlug(t *testing.T) {
 	for _, tc := range []struct{ in, want string }{

 		{"main", "main"},
 		{"fix/GX-123_race", "fix-GX-123_race"},

 	} {

 			t.Errorf("Slug(%q) = %q, want %q", tc.in, got, tc.want)
 		}
 	}
 }
 
 func TestRender(t *testing.T) {
 	vars := Vars{"worktree_root": "/mnt/wt", "repo": "MyRepo", "branch": "feat/x"}
 
 	for _, tc := range []struct{ tmpl, want string }{

 		{"{{ worktree_root }}/{{ branch | slug }}", "/mnt/wt/feat-x"},

 		{"no-vars", "no-vars"},
 	} {

 			t.Fatalf("Render(%q): %v", tc.tmpl, err)

 func TestRenderRejectsUnknown(t *testing.T) {

 	} else if !strings.Contains(err.Error(), "known:") {

165	var validID = regexp.MustCompile(`^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]*$`)
166	
167	// ValidateID checks that id can be used as exactly one visible filename stem.
168	func ValidateID(id string) error {
169		if !validID.MatchString(id) || filepath.Base(id) != id || id == "." || id == ".." {
170			return fmt.Errorf("%q: %w", id, ErrInvalidID)
171		}
172		return nil
173	}

175	// NormalizeTags trims, lowercases, deduplicates and sorts tags. Sorting makes
176	// persisted output deterministic regardless of the order in which callers add
177	// labels.
178	func NormalizeTags(tags []string) []string {
179		seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(tags))
180		for _, tag := range tags {
181			tag = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(tag))
182			if tag != "" {
183				seen[tag] = struct{}{}
184			}
185		}
186		out := make([]string, 0, len(seen))
187		for tag := range seen {
188			out = append(out, tag)
189		}
190		sort.Strings(out)
191		return out
192	}
193	
194	// Normalize applies the lossless normalizations stores use before validation.
195	func (e *Entry) Normalize() {
196		if e == nil {
197			return
198		}
199		e.Name = strings.TrimSpace(e.Name)
200		e.Tags = NormalizeTags(e.Tags)
201	}

203	// Title is the human label, falling back to the stable ID for damaged display
204	// data. Persisted entries still require a name during validation.

210	}

212	// HasTag reports membership after applying the same normalization as storage.
213	func (e Entry) HasTag(tag string) bool {
214		tag = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(tag))
215		return tag != "" && slices.Contains(e.Tags, tag)
216	}

218	// LocationFor returns host's location without exposing the map for mutation.

239	// Clone returns a deep copy suitable for mutation before an atomic update.
240	func (e Entry) Clone() *Entry {
241		clone := e
242		clone.Tags = append([]string(nil), e.Tags...)
243		if e.Experiment != nil {
244			value := *e.Experiment
245			clone.Experiment = &value
246		}
247		if e.RecoveryReceipt != nil {

249			clone.RecoveryReceipt = &value

251		if e.MoveIntent != nil {

253			clone.MoveIntent = &value

257			for host, location := range e.Locations {

264	// Validate rejects records that later lifecycle operations could not interpret
265	// safely. Store.Create fills identity and timestamps before calling it.
266	func (e Entry) Validate() error {
267		if e.SchemaVersion != CurrentSchemaVersion {
268			return &UnsupportedSchemaError{ID: e.ID, Version: e.SchemaVersion}
269		}

289			}
290			if e.Experiment.Started.IsZero() {

292			}
293			if e.Experiment.Slug != "" {

304				{"deprecated_path", e.Experiment.DeprecatedPath},

306			}); err != nil {

308			}
309		}
310		hosts := make([]string, 0, len(e.Locations))
311		for host := range e.Locations {

331			return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s: created, discovered and updated timestamps are required", e.ID)
332		}
333		return nil
334	}

336	func validateLocation(host string, location Location) error {
337		return validateLocationValue(host, location, true)
338	}
339	
340	func validateLocationForSet(host string, location Location) error {
341		return validateLocationValue(host, location, false)
342	}
343	
344	func validateLocationValue(host string, location Location, requireUpdated bool) error {
345		if err := validateHostValue("location host", host); err != nil {
346			return err
347		}
348		fields := []struct {
349			name  string
350			value string
351		}{
352			{"current_path", location.CurrentPath},
353			{"restore_path", location.RestorePath},
354			{"real_path", location.RealPath},
355			{"git_common_dir", location.GitCommonDir},
356		}
357		for _, field := range fields {
358			if strings.ContainsRune(field.value, '\x00') {
359				return fmt.Errorf("location %s %s contains NUL", host, field.name)
360			}
361		}
362		if requireUpdated && location.Updated.IsZero() {
363			return fmt.Errorf("location %s: updated timestamp is required", host)
364		}
365		switch location.State {
366		case LocationPresent:
367			if location.CurrentPath == "" {
368				return fmt.Errorf("location %s: present state requires current_path", host)
369			}
370		case LocationArchived:
371			if location.CurrentPath == "" || location.RestorePath == "" {
372				return fmt.Errorf("location %s: archived state requires current_path and restore_path", host)
373			}
374		case LocationEvicted:
375			if location.RestorePath == "" {
376				return fmt.Errorf("location %s: evicted state requires restore_path", host)
377			}
378		default:
379			return fmt.Errorf("location %s: unknown state %q", host, location.State)
380		}
381		return nil
382	}

384	func validateRecoveryReceipt(receipt RecoveryReceipt) error {
385		if err := validateHostValue("recovery receipt host", receipt.Host); err != nil {
386			return err
387		}
388		if receipt.Method == "" || receipt.Method != strings.TrimSpace(receipt.Method) {
389			return errors.New("recovery receipt method is required and must be normalized")
390		}
391		if receipt.Created.IsZero() || receipt.Verified.IsZero() {
392			return errors.New("recovery receipt requires created and verified timestamps")
393		}
394		fields := []struct {
395			name  string
396			value string
397		}{
398			{"method", receipt.Method},
399			{"source_path", receipt.SourcePath},
400			{"restore_path", receipt.RestorePath},
401			{"remote_identity", receipt.RemoteIdentity},
402			{"revision", receipt.Revision},
403			{"archive_path", receipt.ArchivePath},
404			{"checksum", receipt.Checksum},
405		}
406		return validateStringFields("recovery receipt", fields)
407	}

409	func validateMoveIntent(intent MoveIntent) error {
410		if err := validateHostValue("move intent host", intent.Host); err != nil {

414			return errors.New("move intent operation is required and must be normalized")

423			name  string

425		}{

427			{"source_path", intent.SourcePath},
428			{"destination_path", intent.DestinationPath},
429		}); err != nil {

432		if filepath.Clean(intent.SourcePath) == filepath.Clean(intent.DestinationPath) {

434		}
435		return nil
436	}

The production sweep found one additional conservative-matching defect: local Git remotes such as `file:///…`, `../origin.git`, or Windows drive paths were being converted into global-looking remote keys, so identical local spellings on two hosts could merge unrelated assets. I’m making local remotes ineligible as relocation hints and preserving non-`git` SCP usernames for home-relative paths; HTTPS/SCP hosting equivalence remains intact.

9	
10	// Repo identifies one repository, independent of which worktree you are
11	// standing in. Two linked worktrees of the same clone share a Key.
12	type Repo struct {
13		// Root is the working-tree root of the checkout that was probed.
14		Root string
15		// GitCommonDir is the shared .git directory — the same value for every
16		// worktree of a clone, which makes it the natural identity.
17		GitCommonDir string
18		// Name is the basename users recognise the repo by.
19		Name string
20		// IsLinkedWorktree reports whether Root is a linked worktree rather than
21		// the main checkout.

23		// MainRoot is the main (non-linked) checkout of this clone.
24		MainRoot string
25		// Bare reports whether the main checkout is a bare repository.
26		Bare bool
27	}

29	// Key is the stable identity of the clone, shared by all its worktrees.
30	func (r Repo) Key() string { return r.GitCommonDir }
31	
32	// Discover probes dir and reports the repository containing it.
33	func Discover(ctx context.Context, dir string) (Repo, error) {
34		// A single rev-parse call answers everything: batching avoids four
35		// process spawns per repo, which matters when scanning 39 of them.
36		out, err := run(ctx, dir,
37			"rev-parse",
38			"--path-format=absolute",
39			"--show-toplevel",
40			"--git-common-dir",
41			"--is-bare-repository",
42		)
43		if err != nil {
44			return Repo{}, err
45		}
46		f := lines(out)
47		r := Repo{}
48		// A bare repo has no toplevel, so git prints one fewer line.
49		switch len(f) {
50		case 3:
51			r.Root = f[0]
52			r.GitCommonDir = f[1]
53			r.Bare = f[2] == "true"
54		case 2:
55			r.GitCommonDir = f[0]
56			r.Bare = f[1] == "true"
57		default:
58			return Repo{}, ErrNotARepo
59		}
60	
61		// The main checkout is the parent of the common .git dir, except for a
62		// bare repo (where the common dir *is* the repo).
63		if r.Bare {
64			r.MainRoot = strings.TrimSuffix(r.GitCommonDir, string(filepath.Separator))
65		} else {
66			r.MainRoot = filepath.Dir(r.GitCommonDir)
67		}
68		r.IsLinkedWorktree = r.Root != "" && r.Root != r.MainRoot
69		r.Name = filepath.Base(r.MainRoot)
70		if r.Bare {
71			// ".../foo/.bare" or ".../foo.git" should both read as "foo".
72			r.Name = strings.TrimSuffix(filepath.Base(r.MainRoot), ".git")
73			if strings.HasPrefix(r.Name, ".") {
74				r.Name = filepath.Base(filepath.Dir(r.MainRoot))
75			}
76		}
77		return r, nil
78	}

80	// IsRepo reports whether dir is inside a git working tree, without the cost of
81	// a full Discover.
82	func IsRepo(ctx context.Context, dir string) bool {
83		_, err := run(ctx, dir, "rev-parse", "--git-dir")
84		return err == nil
85	}

87	// DefaultBranch resolves the repository's default branch — origin/HEAD when the
88	// remote advertises it, else the first of main/master that exists locally.
89	// Returns "" when nothing can be determined, which callers must treat as
90	// "ask the user" rather than guessing.
91	func DefaultBranch(ctx context.Context, dir string) string {
92		if out, err := run(ctx, dir, "symbolic-ref", "--short", "refs/remotes/origin/HEAD"); err == nil {
93			if _, b, ok := strings.Cut(out, "/"); ok {
94				return b
95			}
96		}
97		for _, cand := range []string{"main", "master", "trunk", "develop"} {
98			if _, err := run(ctx, dir, "show-ref", "--verify", "--quiet", "refs/heads/"+cand); err == nil {
99				return cand
100			}
101		}
102		return ""
103	}

105	// Remote returns the push URL of the named remote ("origin" when empty).
106	func Remote(ctx context.Context, dir, name string) string {
107		if name == "" {
108			name = "origin"
109		}
110		out, err := run(ctx, dir, "remote", "get-url", name)
111		if err != nil {
112			return ""
113		}
114		return out
115	}

117	// RemoteFromConfig reads one remote URL directly from a Git common directory.
118	// It is the zero-process path used by whole-machine inventory, where spawning
119	// `git remote get-url` once per repo dominated startup. Includes and URL
120	// rewriting are deliberately not evaluated; callers that need Git's complete
121	// semantics should use Remote instead.
122	func RemoteFromConfig(commonDir, name string) string {
123		if commonDir == "" {
124			return ""
125		}
126		if name == "" {
127			name = "origin"
128		}
129		b, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(commonDir, "config"))
130		if err != nil {
131			return ""
132		}
133		want := `remote "` + name + `"`
134		section := ""
135		for _, raw := range strings.Split(string(b), "\n") {
136			line := strings.TrimSpace(raw)
137			if line == "" || strings.HasPrefix(line, "#") || strings.HasPrefix(line, ";") {
138				continue
139			}
140			if strings.HasPrefix(line, "[") && strings.HasSuffix(line, "]") {
141				section = strings.TrimSpace(line[1 : len(line)-1])
142				continue
143			}
144			if section != want {
145				continue
146			}
147			key, value, ok := strings.Cut(line, "=")
148			if ok && strings.TrimSpace(key) == "url" {
149				return strings.Trim(strings.TrimSpace(value), `"`)
150			}
151		}
152		return ""
153	}
