```text
34	func (s *Service) Reconcile(ctx context.Context) ([]Item, []Diagnostic, error) {
35		if err := s.ensureTriesRoot(); err != nil {
36			return nil, nil, err
37		}
38		entries, catalogProblems, err := s.store.ListWithDiagnostics()
39		if err != nil {
40			return nil, nil, err
41		}
42		diagnostics := catalogDiagnostics(catalogProblems)
43	
44		directoryEntries, err := os.ReadDir(s.triesRoot)
45		if err != nil {
46			return nil, diagnostics, fmt.Errorf("read tries root %s: %w", s.triesRoot, err)
47		}
48		paths := make([]string, 0, len(directoryEntries))
49		for _, entry := range directoryEntries {
50			if strings.HasPrefix(entry.Name(), ".") {
51				continue
52			}
53			paths = append(paths, filepath.Join(s.triesRoot, entry.Name()))
54		}
55		probes := boundedMap(ctx, s.workers, paths, func(ctx context.Context, path string) directoryProbe {
56			return s.probeDirectory(ctx, path)
57		})
58	
59		items := make([]Item, 0, len(probes))
60		for _, probe := range probes {
61			if probe.diagnostic != nil {
62				diagnostics = append(diagnostics, *probe.diagnostic)
63			}
64			if !probe.valid {
65				continue
66			}
67	
68			matches := matchingEntries(entries, s.host, probe)
69			switch len(matches) {
70			case 0:
71				entry := s.newEntry(probe)
72				if err := s.catalogCreate(entry); err != nil {
73					item := s.transientItem(probe, err)
74					items = append(items, item)
75					diagnostics = append(diagnostics, Diagnostic{
76						Path: probe.live.CurrentPath, Operation: "catalog try", Err: err,
77					})
78					continue
79				}
80				entries = append(entries, entry)
81				items = append(items, itemFromEntry(entry, probe.live))
82			case 1:
83				entry := matches[0]
84				updated, updateErr := s.refreshEntry(entry, probe)
85				if updateErr != nil {
86					item := itemFromEntry(entry, probe.live)
87					item.CatalogError = updateErr
88					items = append(items, item)
89					diagnostics = append(diagnostics, Diagnostic{
90						Path: probe.live.CurrentPath, Operation: "refresh catalog try", Err: updateErr,
91					})
92					continue
93				}
94				replaceEntry(entries, updated)
95				items = append(items, itemFromEntry(updated, probe.live))
96			default:
97				matchedItems := make([]Item, len(matches))
98				for index, entry := range matches {
99					matchedItems[index] = itemFromEntry(entry, probe.live)
100				}
101				ambiguous := &AmbiguousError{Ref: probe.live.CurrentPath, Candidates: candidatesOf(matchedItems)}
102				item := s.transientItem(probe, ambiguous)
103				items = append(items, item)
104				diagnostics = append(diagnostics, Diagnostic{
105					Path: probe.live.CurrentPath, Operation: "match catalog try", Err: ambiguous,
106				})
107			}
108		}
109	
110		items = deduplicateItems(items)
111		sortItemsByName(items)
112		sortDiagnostics(diagnostics)
113		return items, diagnostics, nil
114	}
115	
116	// List reconciles visible directories, joins requested catalog history, and
117	// enriches Git repositories with bounded status/last-commit probes.
118	func (s *Service) List(ctx context.Context, options ListOptions) ([]Item, []Diagnostic, error) {
119		visible, diagnostics, err := s.Reconcile(ctx)
120		if err != nil {
121			return visible, diagnostics, err
122		}
123	
124		entries, catalogProblems, err := s.store.ListWithDiagnostics()
125		if err != nil {
126			return visible, diagnostics, err
127		}
128		diagnostics = append(diagnostics, catalogDiagnostics(catalogProblems)...)
129	
130		items := make([]Item, 0, len(entries)+len(visible))
131		seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(visible))
132		for _, item := range visible {
133			if item.ID != "" {
134				seen[item.ID] = struct{}{}
135			}
136			items = append(items, item)
137		}
138	
139		for _, entry := range entries {
140			if _, ok := seen[entry.ID]; ok {
141				continue
142			}
143			graduated := entry.Kind == catalog.KindRepository && entry.Experiment != nil &&
144				entry.Experiment.Phase == catalog.PhaseGraduated
145			if graduated {
146				if !options.IncludeGraduated {
147					continue
148				}
149			} else if entry.Kind != catalog.KindTry || entry.Experiment == nil {
150				continue
151			}
152	
153			location, located := entry.LocationFor(s.host)
154			present := located && location.State == catalog.LocationPresent && !s.hiddenStorage(location.CurrentPath)
155			if present {
156				isDirectory, statErr := directoryExists(location.CurrentPath)
157				if statErr != nil {
158					diagnostics = append(diagnostics, Diagnostic{
159						Path: location.CurrentPath, Operation: "stat catalog try", Err: statErr,
160					})
161					present = false
162				} else {
163					present = isDirectory
164				}
165			}
166			if !present && !options.IncludeNonPresent {
167				continue
168			}
169	
170			live := LiveFacts{Present: present}
171			if located {
172				live.CurrentPath = location.CurrentPath
173				live.RealPath = location.RealPath
174			}
175			if present {
176				probe := s.probeDirectory(ctx, location.CurrentPath)
177				if probe.diagnostic != nil {
178					diagnostics = append(diagnostics, *probe.diagnostic)
179				}
180				if probe.valid {
181					live = probe.live
182				}
183			}
184			items = append(items, itemFromEntry(entry, live))
185		}
186	
187		if query := strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(options.Query)); query != "" {
188			filtered := items[:0]
189			for _, item := range items {
190				if strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(item.SearchText()), query) {
191					filtered = append(filtered, item)
192				}
193			}
194			items = filtered
195		}
196		if !options.SkipEnrichment {
197			items = s.enrich(ctx, items)
198		}
199		sortItemsByActivity(items)
200		diagnostics = deduplicateDiagnostics(diagnostics)
201		sortDiagnostics(diagnostics)
202		return items, diagnostics, nil
203	}
204	
205	// Resolve applies stable, deterministic matching: exact ID, exact basename,
206	// exact date-stripped name/slug, then one unique case-insensitive substring.
207	func (s *Service) Resolve(ctx context.Context, ref string) (Item, []Diagnostic, error) {
208		items, diagnostics, err := s.List(ctx, ListOptions{})
209		if err != nil {
210			return Item{}, diagnostics, err
211		}
212		ref = strings.TrimSpace(ref)
213		if ref == "" {
214			return Item{}, diagnostics, &NotFoundError{Ref: ref, Root: s.triesRoot}
215		}
216	
217		if looksLikePath(ref) {
218			pathRef := config.Expand(ref)
219			if canonical, canonicalErr := pathx.Canonical(pathRef); canonicalErr == nil {
220				var matches []Item
221				for _, item := range items {
222					if samePath(canonical, item.Live.CurrentPath) {
223						matches = append(matches, item)
224					}
225				}
226				if len(matches) > 0 {
227					return selectResolved(ref, matches, diagnostics)
228				}
229			}
230		}
231	
232		for _, match := range []func(Item) bool{
233			func(item Item) bool { return item.ID != "" && item.ID == ref },
234			func(item Item) bool { return item.Basename == ref },
235			func(item Item) bool {
236				stripped, _, _ := splitDatedBasename(item.Basename)
237				return stripped == ref || item.Name == ref || item.Slug == ref
238			},
239		} {
240			var matches []Item
241			for _, item := range items {
242				if match(item) {
243					matches = append(matches, item)
244				}
245			}
246			if len(matches) > 0 {
247				return selectResolved(ref, matches, diagnostics)
248			}
249		}
250	
251		needle := strings.ToLower(ref)
252		var matches []Item
253		for _, item := range items {
254			stripped, _, _ := splitDatedBasename(item.Basename)
255			for _, value := range []string{item.ID, item.Basename, stripped, item.Name, item.Slug} {
256				if value != "" && strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(value), needle) {
257					matches = append(matches, item)
258					break
259				}
260			}
261		}
262		if len(matches) == 0 {
263			return Item{}, diagnostics, &NotFoundError{Ref: ref, Root: s.triesRoot}
264		}
265		return selectResolved(ref, matches, diagnostics)
266	}
267	
268	func selectResolved(ref string, matches []Item, diagnostics []Diagnostic) (Item, []Diagnostic, error) {
269		if len(matches) == 1 {
270			return matches[0], diagnostics, nil
271		}
272		return Item{}, diagnostics, &AmbiguousError{Ref: ref, Candidates: candidatesOf(matches)}
273	}
274	
275	// ResolveOrCreate preserves the low-friction dev try behavior: an existing
276	// non-clone match wins; clone requests always get a collision-safe new path.
277	func (s *Service) ResolveOrCreate(ctx context.Context, request CreateRequest) (CreateResult, error) {
278		if request.Clone == "" {
279			name := config.Slug(strings.ReplaceAll(request.Name, " ", "-"))
280			item, diagnostics, err := s.Resolve(ctx, name)
281			if err == nil {
282				result := CreateResult{
283					Item: item, Path: item.Live.CurrentPath, Existing: true,
284					Tracked: item.ID != "" && item.CatalogError == nil, Diagnostics: diagnostics,
285				}
286				if !result.Tracked {
287					trackingErr := item.CatalogError
288					if trackingErr == nil {
289						trackingErr = errors.New("matching directory has no catalog ID")
290					}
291					return result, fmt.Errorf("existing try at %s is not tracked in the catalog: %w", result.Path, trackingErr)
292				}
293				return result, nil
294			}
295			if !errors.Is(err, ErrNotFound) {
296				return CreateResult{Diagnostics: diagnostics}, err
297			}
298		}
299		return s.Create(ctx, request)
300	}
301	
302	// Create makes a new collision-safe dated directory or clone and catalogs it
303	// only after the filesystem operation succeeds.
304	func (s *Service) Create(ctx context.Context, request CreateRequest) (CreateResult, error) {
305		var result CreateResult
306		if err := s.ensureTriesRoot(); err != nil {
307			return result, err
308		}
309		name := request.Name
310		if request.Clone != "" && strings.TrimSpace(name) == "" {
311			name = cloneDefaultName(request.Clone)
312		}
313		slug := config.Slug(strings.ReplaceAll(name, " ", "-"))
314		if err := pathx.ValidateComponent(slug); err != nil {
315			return result, fmt.Errorf("try name %q: %w", name, err)
316		}
317	
318		path, err := s.availableDatedPath(slug)
319		if err != nil {
320			return result, err
321		}
322		result.Path = path
323		if request.Clone != "" {
324			cloneRef := normalizeCloneRef(request.Clone)
325			if _, err := s.gitRun(ctx, s.triesRoot, "clone", cloneRef, path); err != nil {
326				return result, fmt.Errorf("clone try into %s: %w", path, err)
327			}
328			result.Created = true
329			result.Cloned = true
330		} else {
331			if err := os.Mkdir(path, 0o755); err != nil {
332				return result, fmt.Errorf("create try %s: %w", path, err)
333			}
334			result.Created = true
335			if !request.NoGit {
336				if _, err := s.gitRun(ctx, path, "init", "-b", "main"); err != nil {
337					result.InitWarning = err
338				}
339			}
340		}
341	
342		canonical, canonicalErr := pathx.Canonical(path)
343		if canonicalErr != nil {
344			return result, fmt.Errorf("try exists at %s but its canonical path could not be determined: %w", path, canonicalErr)
345		}
346		result.Path = canonical
347		items, diagnostics, reconcileErr := s.Reconcile(ctx)
348		result.Diagnostics = diagnostics
349		if reconcileErr != nil {
350			return result, fmt.Errorf("try exists at %s but catalog reconciliation failed: %w", canonical, reconcileErr)
351		}
352		for _, item := range items {
353			if samePath(item.Live.CurrentPath, canonical) {
354				result.Item = item
355				result.Tracked = item.ID != "" && item.CatalogError == nil
356				break
357			}
358		}
359		if !result.Tracked {
360			trackingErr := result.Item.CatalogError
361			if trackingErr == nil {
362				trackingErr = errors.New("reconciliation did not produce a catalog record")
363			}
364			return result, fmt.Errorf("try exists at %s but could not be added to the catalog: %w", canonical, trackingErr)
365		}
366		enriched := s.enrich(ctx, []Item{result.Item})
367		if len(enriched) == 1 {
368			result.Item = enriched[0]
369		}
370		return result, nil
371	}
372	
373	// Touch updates LastOpened only after a caller has successfully handed off the
374	// selected OpenTarget.
375	func (s *Service) Touch(_ context.Context, id string) (TouchResult, error) {
376		if id == "" {
377			return TouchResult{}, &NotFoundError{Ref: id, Root: s.triesRoot}
378		}
379		now := s.now()
380		updated, err := s.catalogUpdate(id, func(entry *catalog.Entry) error {
381			if entry.Experiment == nil ||
382				(entry.Kind != catalog.KindTry && !(entry.Kind == catalog.KindRepository && entry.Experiment.Phase == catalog.PhaseGraduated)) {
383				return &NotFoundError{Ref: id, Root: s.triesRoot}
384			}
385			location, ok := entry.LocationFor(s.host)
386			if !ok || location.State != catalog.LocationPresent {
387				return &NotFoundError{Ref: id, Root: s.triesRoot}
388			}
389			entry.LastOpened = now
390			return nil
391		})
392		if err != nil {
393			if errors.Is(err, catalog.ErrNotFound) {
394				return TouchResult{}, &NotFoundError{Ref: id, Root: s.triesRoot}
395			}
396			return TouchResult{}, fmt.Errorf("touch try %s: %w", id, err)
397		}
398		location, _ := updated.LocationFor(s.host)
399		item := itemFromEntry(updated, LiveFacts{
400			Present:     location.State == catalog.LocationPresent,
401			CurrentPath: location.CurrentPath, RealPath: location.RealPath,
402		})
403		return TouchResult{Item: item, TouchedAt: now}, nil
404	}
405	
406	func (s *Service) probeDirectory(ctx context.Context, path string) directoryProbe {
407		probe := directoryProbe{basename: filepath.Base(path)}
408		if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
409			probe.diagnostic = &Diagnostic{Path: path, Operation: "inspect try", Err: err}
410			return probe
411		}
412		info, err := os.Stat(path)
413		if err != nil {
414			probe.diagnostic = &Diagnostic{Path: path, Operation: "stat try", Err: err}
415			return probe
416		}
417		if !info.IsDir() {
418			return probe
419		}
420		canonical, err := pathx.Canonical(path)
421		if err != nil {
422			probe.diagnostic = &Diagnostic{Path: path, Operation: "canonicalize try", Err: err}
423			return probe
424		}
425		probe.valid = true
426		probe.live = LiveFacts{Present: true, CurrentPath: canonical, RealPath: canonical}
427		probe.basename = filepath.Base(canonical)
428		_, markerErr := os.Lstat(filepath.Join(canonical, ".git"))
429		probe.gitMarker = markerErr == nil || !errors.Is(markerErr, fs.ErrNotExist)
430	
431		repository, discoverErr := s.gitDiscover(ctx, canonical)
432		if discoverErr != nil {
433			if probe.gitMarker {
434				probe.live.DiscoverError = discoverErr
435				probe.diagnostic = &Diagnostic{Path: canonical, Operation: "discover Git try", Err: discoverErr}
436			}
437			return probe
438		}
439		repositoryRoot := repository.Root
440		if repository.Bare {
441			repositoryRoot = repository.MainRoot
442		}
443		canonicalRoot, rootErr := pathx.Canonical(repositoryRoot)
444		if rootErr != nil || !samePath(canonicalRoot, canonical) {
445			// A TriesRoot may itself be inside a repository. Its child directories are
446			// not independent Git Tries merely because rev-parse walks to that parent.
447			return probe
448		}
449		repository.Root = canonicalRoot
450		if repository.MainRoot != "" {
451			if canonicalMain, mainErr := pathx.Canonical(repository.MainRoot); mainErr == nil {
452				repository.MainRoot = canonicalMain
453			}
454		}
455		if repository.GitCommonDir != "" {
456			commonDir, commonErr := pathx.Canonical(repository.GitCommonDir)
457			if commonErr != nil {
458				probe.live.DiscoverError = commonErr
459				probe.diagnostic = &Diagnostic{Path: canonical, Operation: "canonicalize Git common directory", Err: commonErr}
460			} else {
461				repository.GitCommonDir = commonDir
462			}
463		}
464		probe.live.Repo = &repository
465		probe.originURL = gitx.RemoteFromConfig(repository.GitCommonDir, "origin")
466		return probe
467	}
468	
469	func (s *Service) enrich(ctx context.Context, items []Item) []Item {
470		return boundedMap(ctx, s.workers, items, func(ctx context.Context, item Item) Item {
471			if item.Live.Repo == nil || item.Live.CurrentPath == "" {
472				return item
473			}
474			status, statusErr := s.gitStatus(ctx, item.Live.CurrentPath)
475			if statusErr != nil {
476				item.Live.StatusError = statusErr
477			} else {
478				item.Live.Status = &status
479			}
480			unix, subject, commitErr := s.gitLastCommit(ctx, item.Live.CurrentPath)
481			if commitErr != nil {
482				item.Live.LastCommitError = commitErr
483			} else if unix > 0 {
484				item.Live.LastCommit = time.Unix(unix, 0)
485				item.Live.LastCommitSubject = subject
486			}
487			return item
488		})
489	}
490	
491	func (s *Service) newEntry(probe directoryProbe) *catalog.Entry {
492		name, started, dated := splitDatedBasename(filepath.Base(probe.live.CurrentPath))
493		if name == "" {
494			name = filepath.Base(probe.live.CurrentPath)
495		}
496		if !dated {
497			started = s.now()
498		}
499		entry := &catalog.Entry{
500			Kind:           catalog.KindTry,
501			Name:           name,
502			RemoteIdentity: catalog.NormalizeRemoteIdentity(probe.originURL),
503			Experiment: &catalog.Experiment{
504				Phase: catalog.PhaseActive, Slug: config.Slug(name),
505				OriginURL: probe.originURL, Started: started,
506				OriginalPath: probe.live.CurrentPath,
507			},
508			Locations: map[string]catalog.Location{
509				s.host: locationFromProbe(probe, catalog.Location{}),
510			},
511		}
512		if dated {
513			entry.Created = started
514		}
515		return entry
516	}
517	
518	func (s *Service) transientItem(probe directoryProbe, catalogErr error) Item {
519		name, started, dated := splitDatedBasename(filepath.Base(probe.live.CurrentPath))
520		if name == "" {
521			name = filepath.Base(probe.live.CurrentPath)
522		}
523		if !dated {
524			started = s.now()
525		}
526		return Item{
527			Name: name, Basename: filepath.Base(probe.live.CurrentPath), Slug: config.Slug(name),
528			Phase: catalog.PhaseActive, Created: started, Started: started,
529			OriginURL: probe.originURL, RemoteIdentity: catalog.NormalizeRemoteIdentity(probe.originURL),
530			Live: probe.live, CatalogError: catalogErr,
531		}
532	}
533	
534	func (s *Service) refreshEntry(entry *catalog.Entry, probe directoryProbe) (*catalog.Entry, error) {
535		location, _ := entry.LocationFor(s.host)
536		wantedLocation := locationFromProbe(probe, location)
537		wantedOrigin := entry.Experiment.OriginURL
538		wantedIdentity := entry.RemoteIdentity
539		if probe.originURL != "" {
540			wantedOrigin = probe.originURL
541			wantedIdentity = catalog.NormalizeRemoteIdentity(probe.originURL)
542		}
543		if locationEqual(location, wantedLocation) && entry.Experiment.OriginURL == wantedOrigin &&
544			entry.RemoteIdentity == wantedIdentity {
545			return entry, nil
546		}
547		return s.catalogUpdate(entry.ID, func(updated *catalog.Entry) error {
548			if updated.Kind != catalog.KindTry || updated.Experiment == nil || updated.Experiment.Phase == catalog.PhaseGraduated {
549				return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s is not an active Try", updated.ID)
550			}
551			if probe.originURL != "" {
552				updated.Experiment.OriginURL = probe.originURL
553				updated.RemoteIdentity = catalog.NormalizeRemoteIdentity(probe.originURL)
554			}
555			return updated.SetLocation(s.host, wantedLocation)
556		})
557	}
558	
559	func locationFromProbe(probe directoryProbe, previous catalog.Location) catalog.Location {
560		commonDir := ""
561		if probe.live.Repo != nil {
562			commonDir = probe.live.Repo.GitCommonDir
563		} else if probe.gitMarker && probe.live.DiscoverError != nil {
564			// A transient Git failure must not erase identity gathered earlier.
565			commonDir = previous.GitCommonDir
566		}
567		return catalog.Location{
568			State:        catalog.LocationPresent,
569			CurrentPath:  probe.live.CurrentPath,
570			RealPath:     probe.live.RealPath,
571			GitCommonDir: commonDir,
572		}
573	}
574	
575	func locationEqual(left, right catalog.Location) bool {
576		left.Updated = time.Time{}
577		right.Updated = time.Time{}
578		return left == right
579	}
580	
581	func matchingEntries(entries []*catalog.Entry, host string, probe directoryProbe) []*catalog.Entry {
582		matched := make(map[string]*catalog.Entry)
583		for _, entry := range entries {
584			if entry.Kind != catalog.KindTry || entry.Experiment == nil || entry.Experiment.Phase == catalog.PhaseGraduated {
585				continue
586			}
587			location, located := entry.LocationFor(host)
588			if located {
589				pathMatch := samePath(probe.live.CurrentPath, location.CurrentPath) ||
590					samePath(probe.live.CurrentPath, location.RealPath) ||
591					samePath(probe.live.CurrentPath, location.RestorePath)
592				commonMatch := probe.live.Repo != nil && probe.live.Repo.GitCommonDir != "" &&
593					samePath(probe.live.Repo.GitCommonDir, location.GitCommonDir)
594				if pathMatch || commonMatch {
595					matched[entry.ID] = entry
596				}
597			} else if samePath(probe.live.CurrentPath, entry.Experiment.OriginalPath) {
598				matched[entry.ID] = entry
599			}
600		}
601		out := make([]*catalog.Entry, 0, len(matched))
602		for _, entry := range matched {
603			out = append(out, entry)
604		}
605		catalog.Sort(out)
606		return out
607	}
608	
609	func replaceEntry(entries []*catalog.Entry, replacement *catalog.Entry) {
610		for index, entry := range entries {
611			if entry.ID == replacement.ID {
612				entries[index] = replacement
613				return
614			}
615		}
616	}
617	
618	func splitDatedBasename(basename string) (string, time.Time, bool) {
619		if len(basename) <= len("2006-01-02-") || basename[10] != '-' {
620			return basename, time.Time{}, false
621		}
622		parsed, err := time.Parse("2006-01-02", basename[:10])
623		if err != nil || parsed.Format("2006-01-02") != basename[:10] {
624			return basename, time.Time{}, false
625		}
626		name := basename[11:]
627		if name == "" {
628			return basename, time.Time{}, false
629		}
630		return name, parsed, true
631	}
632	
633	func (s *Service) availableDatedPath(slug string) (string, error) {
634		prefix := s.clock().Format("2006-01-02") + "-" + slug
635		for version := 1; version < 10_000; version++ {
636			basename := prefix
637			if version > 1 {
638				basename = fmt.Sprintf("%s-%d", prefix, version)
639			}
640			candidate, err := pathx.JoinChild(s.triesRoot, basename)
641			if err != nil {
642				return "", fmt.Errorf("choose try destination: %w", err)
643			}
644			if _, err := os.Lstat(candidate); errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
645				return candidate, nil
646			} else if err != nil {
647				return "", fmt.Errorf("inspect try destination %s: %w", candidate, err)
648			}
649		}
650		return "", fmt.Errorf("choose a unique destination for %q", slug)
651	}

653	func cloneDefaultName(ref string) string {
654		if localClonePath(ref) {
655			trimmed := strings.TrimSuffix(strings.TrimSuffix(ref, string(filepath.Separator)), ".git")
656			return config.Slug(filepath.Base(trimmed))
657		}
658		if _, identity := forge.IdentityFromURL(ref); identity != "" {
659			return config.Slug(strings.ReplaceAll(identity, "/", "-"))
660		}
661		identity := clonePathIdentity(ref)
662		if identity != "" {
663			return config.Slug(strings.ReplaceAll(identity, "/", "-"))
664		}
665		trimmed := strings.TrimSuffix(strings.TrimSuffix(ref, "/"), ".git")
666		if index := strings.LastIndexAny(trimmed, "/:"); index >= 0 {
667			trimmed = trimmed[index+1:]
668		}
669		return config.Slug(trimmed)
670	}

672	func normalizeCloneRef(ref string) string {
673		ref = strings.TrimSpace(ref)
674		if localClonePath(ref) {
675			return ref
676		}
677		kind := forge.FromURL(ref)
678		if kind == forge.Unknown {
679			return ref
680		}
681		adapter, err := forge.For(kind)
682		if err != nil {
683			return ref
684		}
685		return adapter.CloneURL(ref)
686	}

688	func localClonePath(ref string) bool {
689		if filepath.IsAbs(ref) || strings.HasPrefix(ref, "file://") || strings.HasPrefix(ref, "./") ||
690			strings.HasPrefix(ref, "../") || strings.HasPrefix(ref, "~/") {
691			return true
692		}
693		_, err := os.Stat(ref)
694		return err == nil
695	}
696	
697	func clonePathIdentity(ref string) string {
698		if parsed, err := url.Parse(ref); err == nil && parsed.Host != "" {
699			return strings.Trim(strings.TrimSuffix(parsed.Path, ".git"), "/")
700		}
701		if at := strings.LastIndexByte(ref, '@'); at >= 0 {
702			ref = ref[at+1:]
703		}
704		if colon := strings.IndexByte(ref, ':'); colon >= 0 {
705			ref = ref[colon+1:]
706		}
707		ref = strings.Trim(strings.TrimSuffix(ref, ".git"), "/")
708		if strings.Contains(ref, "/") {
709			return ref
710		}
711		return ""
712	}

736	func samePath(left, right string) bool {

750	func sortItemsByName(items []Item) {
751		sort.SliceStable(items, func(i, j int) bool {
752			left, right := strings.ToLower(items[i].DisplayName()), strings.ToLower(items[j].DisplayName())
753			if left != right {
754				return left < right
755			}
756			if items[i].DisplayName() != items[j].DisplayName() {
757				return items[i].DisplayName() < items[j].DisplayName()
758			}
759			return items[i].ID < items[j].ID
760		})
761	}
762	
763	func sortItemsByActivity(items []Item) {
764		sort.SliceStable(items, func(i, j int) bool {
765			left, right := items[i].Activity(), items[j].Activity()
766			if !left.Equal(right) {
767				if left.IsZero() {
768					return false
769				}
770				if right.IsZero() {
771					return true
772				}
773				return left.After(right)
774			}
775			leftName, rightName := strings.ToLower(items[i].DisplayName()), strings.ToLower(items[j].DisplayName())
776			if leftName != rightName {
777				return leftName < rightName
778			}
779			return items[i].ID < items[j].ID
780		})
781	}

787			}
788			return diagnostics[i].Operation < diagnostics[j].Operation

792	func deduplicateItems(items []Item) []Item {
793		seenIDs := make(map[string]struct{}, len(items))
794		seenPaths := make(map[string]struct{}, len(items))
795		out := items[:0]
796		for _, item := range items {
797			if item.ID != "" {
798				if _, ok := seenIDs[item.ID]; ok {
799					continue
800				}
801				seenIDs[item.ID] = struct{}{}
802			} else if item.Live.CurrentPath != "" {
803				if _, ok := seenPaths[item.Live.CurrentPath]; ok {
804					continue
805				}
806				seenPaths[item.Live.CurrentPath] = struct{}{}
807			}
808			out = append(out, item)
809		}
810		return out
811	}

813	func deduplicateDiagnostics(diagnostics []Diagnostic) []Diagnostic {
814		seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(diagnostics))
815		out := diagnostics[:0]
816		for _, diagnostic := range diagnostics {
817			key := diagnostic.Path + "\x00" + diagnostic.Operation + "\x00" + fmt.Sprint(diagnostic.Err)
818			if _, ok := seen[key]; ok {
819				continue
820			}
821			seen[key] = struct{}{}
822			out = append(out, diagnostic)
823		}
824		return out

827	func boundedMap[Input, Output any](ctx context.Context, limit int, input []Input, work func(context.Context, Input) Output) []Output {
828		if len(input) == 0 {
829			return nil
830		}
831		if limit <= 0 || limit > len(input) {
832			limit = len(input)
833		}
834		type job struct {
835			index int
836			value Input
837		}
838		type result struct {
839			index int
840			value Output
841		}
842		jobs := make(chan job, len(input))
843		results := make(chan result, len(input))
844		for index, value := range input {
845			jobs <- job{index: index, value: value}
846		}
847		close(jobs)
848	
849		var workers sync.WaitGroup
850		workers.Add(limit)
851		for range limit {
852			go func() {
853				defer workers.Done()
854				for next := range jobs {
855					results <- result{index: next.index, value: work(ctx, next.value)}
856				}
857			}()
858		}
859		workers.Wait()
860		close(results)
861	
862		out := make([]Output, len(input))
863		for result := range results {
864			out[result.index] = result.value
865		}
866		return out
867	}
868
```

```text
129	// Graduate prepares Git while the Try is still at its source, performs one
130	// same-filesystem rename, and atomically transitions the same catalog ID.
131	func (s *Service) Graduate(ctx context.Context, request GraduateRequest) (GraduateResult, error) {
132		plan, err := s.PlanGraduate(ctx, request)
133		result := GraduateResult{Plan: plan, Item: plan.Item, Diagnostics: plan.Diagnostics}
134		if err != nil {
135			return result, err
136		}
137		if request.DryRun {
138			return result, nil
139		}
140	
141		if plan.NeedsGitInit {
142			if _, err := s.gitRun(ctx, plan.Source, "init", "-b", "main"); err != nil {
143				return result, fmt.Errorf("initialize Git before graduating %s: %w", plan.Source, err)
144			}
145			result.GitInitialized = true
146		}
147		if plan.NeedsInitialCommit {
148			made, err := s.ensureInitialCommit(ctx, plan.Source, plan.Name)
149			if err != nil {
150				return result, fmt.Errorf("make initial commit before graduating %s: %w", plan.Source, err)
151			}
152			result.InitialCommitMade = made
153		}
154	
155		// Recheck collision and device after Git preparation, before the only move.
156		if err := rejectExisting(plan.Destination); err != nil {
157			return result, err
158		}
159		if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(plan.Destination), 0o755); err != nil {
160			return result, fmt.Errorf("create graduation category: %w", err)
161		}
162		sameDevice, err := s.sameFilesystem(plan.Source, plan.Destination)
163		if err != nil {
164			return result, fmt.Errorf("compare graduation filesystems: %w", err)
165		}
166		if !sameDevice {
167			return result, fmt.Errorf("move %s to %s: %w", plan.Source, plan.Destination, ErrCrossFilesystem)
168		}
169		if err := s.rename(plan.Source, plan.Destination); err != nil {
170			if errors.Is(err, syscall.EXDEV) {
171				return result, fmt.Errorf("move %s to %s: %w", plan.Source, plan.Destination, ErrCrossFilesystem)
172			}
173			return result, fmt.Errorf("move %s to %s: %w", plan.Source, plan.Destination, err)
174		}
175		result.Moved = true
176	
177		probe := s.probeDirectory(ctx, plan.Destination)
178		if !probe.valid || probe.live.Repo == nil || probe.live.DiscoverError != nil {
179			cause := probe.live.DiscoverError
180			if cause == nil && probe.diagnostic != nil {
181				cause = probe.diagnostic.Err
182			}
183			if cause == nil {
184				cause = errors.New("moved project is not a discoverable Git repository")
185			}
186			return s.rollbackGraduation(result, cause)
187		}
188	
189		now := s.now()
190		updated, updateErr := s.catalogUpdate(plan.Item.ID, func(entry *catalog.Entry) error {
191			if entry.Kind != catalog.KindTry || entry.Experiment == nil || entry.Experiment.Phase == catalog.PhaseGraduated {
192				return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s is no longer an active Try", entry.ID)
193			}
194			entry.Kind = catalog.KindRepository
195			entry.Name = plan.Name
196			entry.Experiment.Phase = catalog.PhaseGraduated
197			entry.Experiment.GraduatedAt = now
198			entry.Experiment.GraduatedPath = probe.live.CurrentPath
199			if probe.originURL != "" {
200				entry.Experiment.OriginURL = probe.originURL
201				entry.RemoteIdentity = catalog.NormalizeRemoteIdentity(probe.originURL)
202			}
203			previous, _ := entry.LocationFor(s.host)
204			return entry.SetLocation(s.host, locationFromProbe(probe, previous))
205		})
206		if updateErr != nil {
207			return s.rollbackGraduation(result, updateErr)
208		}
209		if updated == nil {
210			return s.rollbackGraduation(result, errors.New("catalog update returned no graduated entry"))
211		}
212	
213		item := itemFromEntry(updated, probe.live)
214		enriched := s.enrich(ctx, []Item{item})
215		if len(enriched) == 1 {
216			item = enriched[0]
217		}
218		result.Item = item
219		return result, nil
220	}

300		} else if !errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
301			return fmt.Errorf("inspect graduation destination %s: %w", path, err)

303		return nil

308		if err != nil {
309			return false, err
310		}
311		for _, entry := range entries {

314			}

319	func sameFilesystem(source, destination string) (bool, error) {
320		sourceAncestor, err := nearestExisting(source)
321		if err != nil {
322			return false, err
323		}
324		destinationAncestor, err := nearestExisting(destination)
325		if err != nil {
326			return false, err
327		}
328		sourceInfo, err := os.Stat(sourceAncestor)
329		if err != nil {
330			return false, err
331		}
332		destinationInfo, err := os.Stat(destinationAncestor)
333		if err != nil {
334			return false, err
335		}
336		sourceDevice, sourceOK := deviceNumber(sourceInfo)
337		destinationDevice, destinationOK := deviceNumber(destinationInfo)
338		if !sourceOK || !destinationOK {
339			// os.Rename remains the final authority on platforms whose FileInfo does
340			// not expose a Unix-style device number.
341			return true, nil
342		}
343		return sourceDevice == destinationDevice, nil
344	}
345	
346	func nearestExisting(path string) (string, error) {
347		path = filepath.Clean(path)
348		for {
349			if _, err := os.Stat(path); err == nil {
350				return path, nil
351			} else if !errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
352				return "", err
353			}
354			parent := filepath.Dir(path)
355			if parent == path {
356				return "", fmt.Errorf("no existing ancestor for %s", path)
357			}
358			path = parent
359		}
360	}

362	func deviceNumber(info fs.FileInfo) (uint64, bool) {
363		value := reflect.ValueOf(info.Sys())
364		if !value.IsValid() {
365			return 0, false
366		}
367		if value.Kind() == reflect.Pointer {
368			if value.IsNil() {
369				return 0, false
370			}
371			value = value.Elem()
372		}
373		if value.Kind() != reflect.Struct {
374			return 0, false
375		}
376		device := value.FieldByName("Dev")
377		if !device.IsValid() {
378			return 0, false
379		}
380		switch device.Kind() {
381		case reflect.Uint, reflect.Uint8, reflect.Uint16, reflect.Uint32, reflect.Uint64, reflect.Uintptr:
382			return device.Uint(), true
383		case reflect.Int, reflect.Int8, reflect.Int16, reflect.Int32, reflect.Int64:
384			return uint64(device.Int()), true
385		default:
386			return 0, false
387		}
388	}
389
```

```text
61				if err := openOrCD(app, ctx, target.Path, target.Label); err != nil {
62					return err
63				}
64				_, err = service.Touch(ctx, target.CatalogID)
65				return err
66			},

75	func newExperimentService(app *App) (*experiment.Service, error) {
76		return experiment.NewService(experiment.ServiceConfig{
77			Registry:    app.Registry,
78			Store:       app.Catalog,
79			TriesRoot:   config.Expand(app.Cfg.Paths.TriesRoot),
80			ProjectRoot: config.Expand(app.Cfg.Paths.ProjectRoot),
81			Host:        config.Hostname(),
82			Clock:       time.Now,
83		})

86	func listTries(app *App, ctx context.Context, service *experiment.Service, root string) error {
87		items, diagnostics, err := service.List(ctx, experiment.ListOptions{})
88		warnExperimentDiagnostics(app, diagnostics)
89		if err != nil {
90			return err
91		}
92		if len(items) == 0 {
93			fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "No tries yet under %s\n", config.Contract(root))
94			return nil
95		}
96	
97		table := NewTable("TRY", "AGE", "GIT")
98		for _, item := range items {
99			gitColumn := "—"
100			switch {
101			case item.Live.Repo != nil && item.Live.Status != nil && item.Live.Status.Dirty():
102				gitColumn = "repo ●"
103			case item.Live.Repo != nil && item.Live.StatusError != nil:
104				gitColumn = "repo ?"
105			case item.Live.Repo != nil:
106				gitColumn = "repo"
107			case item.Live.DiscoverError != nil:
108				gitColumn = "error"
109			}
110			age := "unknown"
111			if activity := item.Activity(); !activity.IsZero() {
112				age = humanAge(time.Since(activity))
113			}
114			table.Add(truncate(item.DisplayName(), 44), age, gitColumn)
115		}
116		table.Render(app.Out)
117		fmt.Fprintf(app.Err, "\n%d tries under %s — promote one with `dev graduate <try>`\n",
118			len(items), config.Contract(root))
119		return nil
120	}
121	
122	func warnExperimentDiagnostics(app *App, diagnostics []experiment.Diagnostic) {
123		for _, diagnostic := range diagnostics {
124			app.warnf("%s", diagnostic.Error())
125		}
126	}

128	func openOrCD(app *App, ctx context.Context, dir, label string) error {
129		runtime := app.Runtime()
130		if runtime.Name() == "none" {
131			app.cdDirective(dir)
132			return nil
133		}
134		if _, err := openCheckout(ctx, runtime, dir, label); err != nil {
135			app.warnf("could not open a session: %v", err)
136		}
137		return nil
138	}
```

```text
24			Long: `Move a try out of the scratch directory and into your projects tree.
25	
26	An experiment that turns out to matter should stop being an experiment, and
27	that transition is where things usually get lost — the directory keeps its date
28	prefix forever, or it gets copied by hand and the history is left behind.
29	
30	graduate moves the directory to <project_root>/<category>/<name>, drops the
31	date prefix, makes sure it has a git repo and a first commit, and optionally
32	creates the remote with gh or glab.
33	
34	With no argument, the try containing the current directory is used.`,
35			Args: cobra.MaximumNArgs(1),
36			RunE: func(cmd *cobra.Command, args []string) error {
37				ctx := ctxOf()
38				service, err := newExperimentService(app)
39				if err != nil {
40					return err
41				}
42				ref := ""
43				if len(args) == 1 {
44					ref = args[0]
45				}
46				request := experiment.GraduateRequest{
47					Ref: ref, Category: category, Name: name, DryRun: dryRun,
48				}
49				plan, err := service.PlanGraduate(ctx, request)
50				warnExperimentDiagnostics(app, plan.Diagnostics)
51				if err != nil {
52					return err
53				}
54	
55				fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "graduate  %s\n", config.Contract(plan.Source))
56				fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "       →  %s\n", config.Contract(plan.Destination))
57				if dryRun {
58					fmt.Fprintln(app.Out, "\n(dry run — nothing moved)")
59					return nil
60				}
61	
62				result, err := service.Graduate(ctx, request)
63				if err != nil {
64					return err
65				}
66				if result.GitInitialized {
67					fmt.Fprintln(app.Out, "   git init")
68				}
69				if result.InitialCommitMade {
70					fmt.Fprintln(app.Out, "   committed the existing work")
71				}
72	
73				if remote {
74					adapter, err := forge.Preferred()
75					if err != nil {
76						app.warnf("%v — the project is in place; add a remote by hand", err)
77					} else {
78						remoteURL, createErr := adapter.CreateRepo(ctx, result.Plan.Destination, forge.RepoRequest{
79							Name: result.Plan.Name, Private: private, Push: push,
```

```text
1	// Package cli assembles dev's command tree. Commands stay thin: they parse
2	// flags, call into the domain packages, and render. All policy lives in
3	// config, catalog, gitx, wt, task and runtime so it can be tested without a terminal.
4	package cli
5	
6	import (
7		"context"
8		"fmt"
9		"io"
10		"os"
11	
12		"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/catalog"
13		"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/config"
14		"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/runtime"
15		"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/task"
16	)
17	
18	// App is the state shared by every command.
19	type App struct {
20		Cfg      config.Config
21		Tasks    *task.Store
22		Catalog  *catalog.Store
23		Registry *catalog.Registry
24	
25		Out io.Writer
26		Err io.Writer
27	
28		// configPath is the --config override; empty means the XDG default.
29		configPath string
30		// runtimeOverride is the --runtime flag; empty means use the config.
31		runtimeOverride string
32		// noRuntime disables all multiplexer interaction for one invocation.
33		noRuntime bool
34	}
35	
36	// Load reads configuration and prepares the shared stores.
37	func (a *App) Load() error {
38		cfg, err := config.Load(a.configPath)
39		if err != nil {
40			return err
41		}
42		a.Cfg = cfg
43		if a.Out == nil {
44			a.Out = os.Stdout
45		}
46		if a.Err == nil {
47			a.Err = os.Stderr
48		}
49		a.Tasks = task.NewStore(cfg.TasksDir())
50		a.Catalog = catalog.NewStore(cfg.AssetsDir(), catalog.WithDiagnosticSink(func(diagnostic catalog.Diagnostic) {
51			fmt.Fprintf(a.Err, "dev: warning: %s\n", diagnostic.Error())
52		}))
53		a.Registry = catalog.NewRegistry(a.Catalog)
54		return nil
55	}
56	
57	// Runtime resolves the multiplexer backend for this invocation, honouring
58	// --runtime and --no-runtime.
59	func (a *App) Runtime() runtime.Runtime {
60		if a.noRuntime {
61			return runtime.None{}
62		}
63		backend := a.Cfg.Runtime.Backend
64		if a.runtimeOverride != "" {
65			backend = a.runtimeOverride
66		}
67		rt := runtime.Select(backend)
68		if h, ok := rt.(*runtime.Herdr); ok {
69			return h.WithMetadataSource(a.Cfg.Runtime.MetadataSource)
70		}
71		return rt
72	}
73	
74	// printf writes to the command's stdout.
75	func (a *App) printf(format string, args ...any) {
76		fmt.Fprintf(a.Out, format, args...)
77	}
78	
79	// warnf writes a non-fatal notice to stderr, so it never pollutes piped output.
80	func (a *App) warnf(format string, args ...any) {
81		fmt.Fprintf(a.Err, "dev: "+format+"\n", args...)
82	}
83	
84	// cdDirective emits the marker the shell wrapper installed by
85	// `dev shell-init` looks for. A child process cannot change its parent's
86	// working directory, so the only way `dev resume` can leave the user *in* the
87	// checkout is to ask the shell to do it.
88	func (a *App) cdDirective(dir string) {
89		fmt.Fprintf(a.Out, "cd %s\n", shellQuote(dir))
90	}
91	
92	// ctx is the cancellable context commands run under.
93	func ctxOf() context.Context { return context.Background() }
94
```

```text
31	}

33	func newHarness(t *testing.T) *harness {
34		t.Helper()
35		home := t.TempDir()
36		scanRoot := filepath.Join(home, "Program")
37		wtRoot := filepath.Join(home, "Worktrees")
38		if err := os.MkdirAll(scanRoot, 0o755); err != nil {
39			t.Fatal(err)
40		}
41	
42		// A repo inside the scan root, so `dev` discovers it the way it would in
43		// real use rather than via an absolute path.
44		r := gittest.New(t)
45		dest := filepath.Join(scanRoot, "demo")
46		if err := os.Rename(r.Root, dest); err != nil {
47			t.Fatal(err)
48		}
49		r.Root = dest
50	
51		// Isolate every path dev touches from the developer's real machine.
52		t.Setenv("HOME", home)
53		t.Setenv("XDG_DATA_HOME", filepath.Join(home, ".local", "share"))
54		t.Setenv("XDG_CONFIG_HOME", filepath.Join(home, ".config"))
55		t.Setenv("XDG_CACHE_HOME", filepath.Join(home, ".cache"))
56	
57		configPath := filepath.Join(home, "config.toml")
58		cfg := "" +
59			"[paths]\n" +
60			"scan_roots = [\"" + scanRoot + "\"]\n" +
61			"project_root = \"" + scanRoot + "\"\n" +
62			"tries_root = \"" + filepath.Join(home, "tries") + "\"\n" +
63			"worktree_root = \"" + wtRoot + "\"\n" +
64			"state_dir = \"" + filepath.Join(home, "state") + "\"\n" +
65			"\n[runtime]\nbackend = \"none\"\n" +
66			"\n[worktree]\ninclude = [\".env\"]\npost_create = []\n"
67		if err := os.WriteFile(configPath, []byte(cfg), 0o644); err != nil {
68			t.Fatal(err)
69		}
70		return &harness{t: t, home: home, configPath: configPath, scanRoot: scanRoot, wtRoot: wtRoot, repo: r}
71	}

73	// run executes one dev invocation, capturing its output. Commands write
74	// through App, so the writers passed to NewRootCommandWithIO are all that is
75	// needed — no file-descriptor juggling.
76	func (h *harness) run(args ...string) (string, string, error) {
77		h.t.Helper()
78		var out, errBuf bytes.Buffer
79		root := cli.NewRootCommandWithIO(&out, &errBuf)
80		root.SetArgs(append([]string{"--config", h.configPath}, args...))
81		err := root.Execute()
82		return out.String(), errBuf.String(), err
83	}

89			h.t.Fatalf("dev %s: %v\nstderr: %s", strings.Join(args, " "), err, errOut)
90		}
91		return out
92	}

94	func TestLifecycleEndToEnd(t *testing.T) {

96	
97		// An empty inventory should tell the user how to start, not print nothing.

101		}

117		}
118
```

```text
251	// LastCommit reports the author timestamp of HEAD as a Unix epoch, and the
252	// subject line. Used to age a task in `dev sweep`.
253	func LastCommit(ctx context.Context, dir string) (unix int64, subject string, err error) {
254		out, err := run(ctx, dir, "log", "-1", "--format=%at%x00%s")
255		if err != nil || out == "" {
256			return 0, "", err
257		}
258		ts, subj, _ := strings.Cut(out, "\x00")
259		unix, _ = strconv.ParseInt(ts, 10, 64)
260		return unix, subj, nil
261	}
262	
263	// WipCommit stages everything and records a checkpoint commit.
264	//
265	// A checkpoint commit is deliberately preferred over `git stash`: a stash is
266	// invisible in the log, easy to forget, and cannot be pushed — so it can never
267	// travel to another machine, which is exactly what parking a task needs.
268	func WipCommit(ctx context.Context, dir, message string) (bool, error) {
269		st, err := StatusOf(ctx, dir)
270		if err != nil {
271			return false, err
272		}
273		if !st.Dirty() {
274			return false, nil
275		}
276		if st.Conflicted > 0 {
277			return false, &Error{Args: []string{"commit"}, Dir: dir,
278				Stderr: "checkout has unmerged paths; resolve the conflict before parking"}
279		}
280		if _, err := run(ctx, dir, "add", "--all"); err != nil {
281			return false, err
282		}
283		if message == "" {
284			message = "wip: checkpoint"
285		}
286		if _, err := run(ctx, dir, "commit", "--no-verify", "-m", message); err != nil {
287			return false, err
288		}
289		return true, nil
```

```text
15	func (g *gh) Kind() Kind      { return GitHub }
16	func (g *gh) Bin() string     { return "gh" }

19	// CreatePR opens a GitHub pull request.
20	func (g *gh) CreatePR(ctx context.Context, dir string, req PRRequest) (string, error) {
21		if !g.Available() {
22			return "", &ErrNoCLI{Kind: GitHub, Bin: "gh"}
23		}
24		args := []string{"pr", "create", "--base", req.Base, "--head", req.Head}
25		switch {
26		case req.Title != "":
27			args = append(args, "--title", req.Title, "--body", req.Body)
28		default:
29			// --fill derives title and body from the branch's commits, which is
30			// the right default for a solo workflow where the commits already say
31			// what happened.
32			args = append(args, "--fill")
33		}
34		if req.Draft {
35			args = append(args, "--draft")
36		}
37		if req.Web {
38			args = append(args, "--web")
39		}
40		out, err := run(ctx, "gh", dir, args...)
41		return lastURL(out), err
42	}
43	
44	// CreateRepo creates a GitHub repository from the local checkout.
45	func (g *gh) CreateRepo(ctx context.Context, dir string, req RepoRequest) (string, error) {
46		if !g.Available() {
47			return "", &ErrNoCLI{Kind: GitHub, Bin: "gh"}
48		}
49		remote := req.RemoteName
50		if remote == "" {
51			remote = "origin"
52		}
53		args := []string{"repo", "create", req.Name, "--source", ".", "--remote", remote}
54		if req.Private {
55			args = append(args, "--private")
56		} else {
57			args = append(args, "--public")
58		}
59		if req.Description != "" {
60			args = append(args, "--description", req.Description)
61		}
62		if req.Push {
63			args = append(args, "--push")
64		}
65		out, err := run(ctx, "gh", dir, args...)
66		return lastURL(out), err
67	}
68	
69	// CloneURL renders a clone target. gh accepts a bare owner/name, so a
70	// shorthand reference is passed through untouched.
71	func (g *gh) CloneURL(ref string) string {
72		if strings.Contains(ref, "://") || strings.HasPrefix(ref, "git@") {
73			return ref
74		}
75		return "https://github.com/" + strings.TrimSuffix(ref, ".git") + ".git"
76	}
77	
78	// lastURL picks the URL out of a CLI's chatter, which may print progress
79	// lines before the created resource's address.
80	func lastURL(out string) string {
81		var found string
82		for _, line := range strings.Fields(out) {
83			if strings.HasPrefix(line, "http://") || strings.HasPrefix(line, "https://") {
84				found = line
85			}
86		}
87		if found == "" {
88			return strings.TrimSpace(out)
89		}
90		return found
91	}

93	// ListRepos lists GitHub repositories visible to the authenticated user —
94	// owned, collaborated on, and organisation membership — most recently pushed
95	// first. gh api is intentionally used instead of a custom HTTP client:
96	// authentication and token refresh stay owned by the forge CLI.
97	func (g *gh) ListRepos(ctx context.Context, limit int) ([]RemoteRepo, error) {
98		if !g.Available() {
99			return nil, &ErrNoCLI{Kind: GitHub, Bin: "gh"}
100		}
101		ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, 15*time.Second)
102		defer cancel()
103		if limit <= 0 {
104			limit = 100
105		}
106		// GitHub caps per_page at 100. The remote view is a navigator, not a
107		// complete backup inventory; / filters this recent working set.
108		if limit > 100 {
109			limit = 100
110		}
111		out, err := run(ctx, "gh", "", "api", "user/repos", "--method", "GET",
112			"-f", "per_page="+strconv.Itoa(limit), "-f", "sort=pushed", "-f", "direction=desc")
113		if err != nil {
114			return nil, err
115		}
116		return parseGitHubRepos(out)
117	}
118	
119	func parseGitHubRepos(out string) ([]RemoteRepo, error) {
120		var raw []struct {
121			Name          string `json:"name"`
122			FullName      string `json:"full_name"`
123			Description   string `json:"description"`
124			URL           string `json:"html_url"`
125			CloneURL      string `json:"clone_url"`
126			SSHURL        string `json:"ssh_url"`
127			Visibility    string `json:"visibility"`
128			Fork          bool   `json:"fork"`
129			Archived      bool   `json:"archived"`
130			PushedAt      string `json:"pushed_at"`
131			DefaultBranch string `json:"default_branch"`
132		}
133		if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(out), &raw); err != nil {
134			return nil, fmt.Errorf("decode gh api user/repos: %w", err)
135		}
136		result := make([]RemoteRepo, 0, len(raw))
137		for _, r := range raw {
138			updated, _ := time.Parse(time.RFC3339, r.PushedAt)
139			result = append(result, RemoteRepo{
140				Forge: GitHub, Name: r.Name, FullName: r.FullName,
141				Description: r.Description, URL: r.URL,
142				CloneURL: r.CloneURL, SSHURL: r.SSHURL,
143				Visibility: r.Visibility, DefaultBranch: r.DefaultBranch,
144				Archived: r.Archived, Fork: r.Fork, UpdatedAt: updated,
145			})
146		}
147		return result, nil
148	}
```

**Evaluating commit scenarios**

I’m considering what happens if a commit hook fails after running `git add`; the index stays staged, but the repo state changes, and there's no rollback. I’m noticing that non-Git prep failures might leave the `.git` directory and the staged index, but some specs allow that. Also, if an existing no-commit Git fails, it just leaves the staged files, which is acceptable.

**Analyzing rollback scenarios**

I'm diving into the complexities of a catalog finalization failure rollback. If I rename back successfully, it won't reverse Git initialization or the commit; it just keeps the catalog active with a new repo/commit. If the update hook partially writes the final catalog and then errors out, the rollback will restore the filesystem, but the catalog will still point to the destination. 

I’m also thinking about how a rollback rename could potentially overwrite existing directories, especially on Unix, where renaming can lead to unexpected behavior if the source has been recreated as an empty directory. It’s important to avoid this destructive overwrite. 

**Considering symlink and collision issues**

I realize I may need to create a report regarding how a source can be a symlink. When using `os.Rename`, it replaces the symlink with the destination, which deletes the alias. For rollback safety, I think it's best to use `Lstat` to check the path and refuse any actions if a destination exists.

Now, about destination collision: I’m noting that I should perform a `rejectExisting` check before creating the parent directory. According to Go’s `os.Rename` documentation, renaming to an existing empty directory will return an error, so that should be safe.

```text
+	h := newHarness(t)
+	triesRoot := filepath.Join(h.home, "tries")
+	for _, name := range []string{"2026-08-20-cache-alpha", "2026-08-21-cache-beta"} {
+		if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Join(triesRoot, name), 0o755); err != nil {
+			t.Fatal(err)
+		}
+	}
+	_, _, err := h.run("try", "cache")
+	if err == nil || !strings.Contains(err.Error(), "ambiguous") ||
+		!strings.Contains(err.Error(), "cache-alpha") || !strings.Contains(err.Error(), "cache-beta") {
+		t.Errorf("ambiguous try error = %v", err)
+	}
+	entries, readErr := os.ReadDir(triesRoot)
+	if readErr != nil || len(entries) != 2 {
+		t.Errorf("ambiguous selection created a duplicate: %d, %v", len(entries), readErr)
+	}
+}
+
+func TestTryListDoesNotUseDirectoryMTimeAsActivity(t *testing.T) {
+	h := newHarness(t)
+	path := filepath.Join(h.home, "tries", "legacy-non-git")
+	if err := os.MkdirAll(path, 0o755); err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	future := time.Now().Add(365 * 24 * time.Hour)
+	if err := os.Chtimes(path, future, future); err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	out := h.mustRun("try", "--list")
+	if !strings.Contains(out, "legacy-non-git") || !strings.Contains(out, "unknown") {
+		t.Errorf("Try list invented mtime activity: %q", out)
+	}
+}
+
+func TestTryCloneUsesLocalRepositoryAndVersionsCollisions(t *testing.T) {
+	h := newHarness(t)
+	h.mustRun("try", "--clone", h.repo.Root)
+	h.mustRun("try", "--clone", h.repo.Root)
+	entries, err := os.ReadDir(filepath.Join(h.home, "tries"))
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	if len(entries) != 2 {
+		t.Fatalf("clone entries = %d, want 2", len(entries))
+	}
+	var names []string
+	for _, entry := range entries {
+		names = append(names, entry.Name())
+	}
+	if !strings.HasSuffix(names[0], "-demo") || !strings.HasSuffix(names[1], "-demo-2") {
+		t.Errorf("clone collision names = %v", names)
+	}
+}
```

```text
131	func (s *Service) Graduate(ctx context.Context, request GraduateRequest) (GraduateResult, error) {
132		plan, err := s.PlanGraduate(ctx, request)
133		result := GraduateResult{Plan: plan, Item: plan.Item, Diagnostics: plan.Diagnostics}

136		}

139		}
140

143				return result, fmt.Errorf("initialize Git before graduating %s: %w", plan.Source, err)
144			}
145			result.GitInitialized = true
146		}
147		if plan.NeedsInitialCommit {

152			result.InitialCommitMade = made

222	func (s *Service) resolveGraduateItem(ctx context.Context, request GraduateRequest) (Item, []Diagnostic, error) {
223		if strings.TrimSpace(request.Ref) != "" {
224			return s.Resolve(ctx, request.Ref)
225		}
226		current := request.CurrentDir
227		if current == "" {
228			var err error
229			current, err = s.getwd()
230			if err != nil {
231				return Item{}, nil, fmt.Errorf("get current directory: %w", err)
232			}
233		}
234		canonicalCurrent, err := pathx.CanonicalChild(s.triesRoot, current)
235		if err != nil {
236			return Item{}, nil, fmt.Errorf("%s is not inside %s — name the try to graduate", current, s.triesRoot)
237		}
238		canonicalRoot, err := pathx.Canonical(s.triesRoot)
239		if err != nil {
240			return Item{}, nil, err
241		}
242		relative, err := filepath.Rel(canonicalRoot, canonicalCurrent)
243		if err != nil {
244			return Item{}, nil, err
245		}
246		first, _, _ := strings.Cut(relative, string(filepath.Separator))
247		if first == "" || first == "." || strings.HasPrefix(first, ".") {
248			return Item{}, nil, fmt.Errorf("%s is not inside a visible try under %s", current, s.triesRoot)
249		}
250		return s.Resolve(ctx, filepath.Join(s.triesRoot, first))
251	}

261	func (s *Service) ensureInitialCommit(ctx context.Context, directory, name string) (bool, error) {

304			Cause: cause, RollbackErr: rollbackErr,
305		}
306	}
```

```text
284	// ResolveOrCreate preserves the low-friction dev try behavior: an existing
285	// non-clone match wins; clone requests always get a collision-safe new path.
286	func (s *Service) ResolveOrCreate(ctx context.Context, request CreateRequest) (CreateResult, error) {
287		if request.Clone == "" {
288			name := config.Slug(strings.ReplaceAll(request.Name, " ", "-"))
289			item, diagnostics, err := s.Resolve(ctx, name)
290			if err == nil {
291				result := CreateResult{
292					Item: item, Path: item.Live.CurrentPath, Existing: true,
293					Tracked: item.ID != "" && item.CatalogError == nil, Diagnostics: diagnostics,
294				}
295				if !result.Tracked {
296					trackingErr := item.CatalogError
297					if trackingErr == nil {
298						trackingErr = errors.New("matching directory has no catalog ID")
299					}
300					return result, fmt.Errorf("existing try at %s is not tracked in the catalog: %w", result.Path, trackingErr)
301				}
302				return result, nil
303			}
304			if !errors.Is(err, ErrNotFound) {
305				return CreateResult{Diagnostics: diagnostics}, err
306			}
307		}
308		return s.Create(ctx, request)
309	}
```

```text
137	// same-filesystem rename, and atomically transitions the same catalog ID.
138	func (s *Service) Graduate(ctx context.Context, request GraduateRequest) (GraduateResult, error) {
139		plan, err := s.PlanGraduate(ctx, request)
140		result := GraduateResult{Plan: plan, Item: plan.Item, Diagnostics: plan.Diagnostics}
141		if err != nil {
142			return result, err
143		}

145			return result, nil
146		}
147	
148		if plan.NeedsGitInit {

150				return result, fmt.Errorf("initialize Git before graduating %s: %w", plan.Source, err)
151			}
152			result.GitInitialized = true
153		}
154		if plan.NeedsInitialCommit {
155			made, err := s.ensureInitialCommit(ctx, plan.Source, plan.Name)

158			}
159			result.InitialCommitMade = made
160		}
161

163		if err := rejectExisting(plan.Destination); err != nil {
164			return result, err
165		}

168		}

170		if err != nil {
171			return result, fmt.Errorf("compare graduation filesystems: %w", err)
172		}

175		}

181		}

229	func (s *Service) resolveGraduateItem(ctx context.Context, request GraduateRequest) (Item, []Diagnostic, error) {
230		if strings.TrimSpace(request.Ref) != "" {
231			return s.Resolve(ctx, request.Ref)
232		}
233		current := request.CurrentDir
234		if current == "" {
235			var err error
236			current, err = s.getwd()
237			if err != nil {
238				return Item{}, nil, fmt.Errorf("get current directory: %w", err)
239			}
240		}
241		canonicalCurrent, err := pathx.CanonicalChild(s.triesRoot, current)
242		if err != nil {
243			return Item{}, nil, fmt.Errorf("%s is not inside %s — name the try to graduate", current, s.triesRoot)
244		}
245		canonicalRoot, err := pathx.Canonical(s.triesRoot)
246		if err != nil {
247			return Item{}, nil, err
248		}
249		relative, err := filepath.Rel(canonicalRoot, canonicalCurrent)
250		if err != nil {
251			return Item{}, nil, err
252		}
253		first, _, _ := strings.Cut(relative, string(filepath.Separator))
254		if first == "" || first == "." || strings.HasPrefix(first, ".") {
255			return Item{}, nil, fmt.Errorf("%s is not inside a visible try under %s", current, s.triesRoot)
256		}
257		return s.Resolve(ctx, filepath.Join(s.triesRoot, first))
258	}
```

```text
290		} else if nested {
291			return fmt.Errorf("graduation destination %s is inside its source %s", destination, source)
292		}
```

```text
139	func (s *Service) Graduate(ctx context.Context, request GraduateRequest) (GraduateResult, error) {
140		plan, err := s.PlanGraduate(ctx, request)
```

```text
86	func listTries(app *App, ctx context.Context, service *experiment.Service, root string) error {
87		items, diagnostics, err := service.List(ctx, experiment.ListOptions{})
88		warnExperimentDiagnostics(app, diagnostics)
89		if err != nil {
90			return err
91		}
92		if len(items) == 0 {
93			fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "No tries yet under %s\n", config.Contract(root))
94			return nil
95		}
96	
97		table := NewTable("TRY", "AGE", "GIT")
98		for _, item := range items {
99			gitColumn := "—"
100			switch {
101			case item.Live.Repo != nil && item.Live.Status != nil && item.Live.Status.Dirty():
102				gitColumn = "repo ●"
103			case item.Live.Repo != nil && item.Live.StatusError != nil:
104				gitColumn = "repo ?"
105			case item.Live.Repo != nil:
106				gitColumn = "repo"
107			case item.Live.DiscoverError != nil:
108				gitColumn = "error"
109			}
110			age := "unknown"
111			if activity := item.Activity(); !activity.IsZero() {
112				age = humanAge(time.Since(activity))
113			}
114			table.Add(truncate(item.DisplayName(), 44), age, gitColumn)
115		}
116		table.Render(app.Out)
117		fmt.Fprintf(app.Err, "\n%d tries under %s — promote one with `dev graduate <try>`\n",
118			len(items), config.Contract(root))
119		return nil
120	}
```

```text
461	func (s *Service) Touch(_ context.Context, id string) (TouchResult, error) {
462		if id == "" {
463			return TouchResult{}, &NotFoundError{Ref: id, Root: s.triesRoot}
464		}
465		now := s.now()
466		updated, err := s.catalogUpdate(id, func(entry *catalog.Entry) error {
467			if entry.Experiment == nil ||
468				(entry.Kind != catalog.KindTry && !(entry.Kind == catalog.KindRepository && entry.Experiment.Phase == catalog.PhaseGraduated)) {
469				return &NotFoundError{Ref: id, Root: s.triesRoot}
470			}
471			location, ok := entry.LocationFor(s.host)
472			if !ok || location.State != catalog.LocationPresent {
473				return &NotFoundError{Ref: id, Root: s.triesRoot}
474			}
475			entry.LastOpened = now
476			return nil
477		})
478		if err != nil {
479			if errors.Is(err, catalog.ErrNotFound) {
480				return TouchResult{}, &NotFoundError{Ref: id, Root: s.triesRoot}
481			}
482			return TouchResult{}, fmt.Errorf("touch try %s: %w", id, err)
483		}
484		location, _ := updated.LocationFor(s.host)
485		item := itemFromEntry(updated, LiveFacts{
486			Present:     location.State == catalog.LocationPresent,
487			CurrentPath: location.CurrentPath, RealPath: location.RealPath,
488		})
489		return TouchResult{Item: item, TouchedAt: now}, nil
490	}

492	func (s *Service) probeDirectory(ctx context.Context, path string) directoryProbe {
493		probe := directoryProbe{}
494		if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
495			probe.diagnostic = &Diagnostic{Path: path, Operation: "inspect try", Err: err}
496			return probe
497		}
498		info, err := os.Stat(path)
499		if err != nil {
500			probe.diagnostic = &Diagnostic{Path: path, Operation: "stat try", Err: err}
501			return probe
502		}
503		if !info.IsDir() {
504			return probe
505		}
506		canonical, err := pathx.Canonical(path)
507		if err != nil {
508			probe.diagnostic = &Diagnostic{Path: path, Operation: "canonicalize try", Err: err}
509			return probe
510		}
511		probe.valid = true
512		probe.live = LiveFacts{Present: true, CurrentPath: canonical, RealPath: canonical}
513		_, markerErr := os.Lstat(filepath.Join(canonical, ".git"))
514		probe.gitMarker = markerErr == nil || !errors.Is(markerErr, fs.ErrNotExist)
515	
516		repository, discoverErr := s.gitDiscover(ctx, canonical)
517		if discoverErr != nil {
518			if probe.gitMarker {
519				probe.live.DiscoverError = discoverErr
520				probe.diagnostic = &Diagnostic{Path: canonical, Operation: "discover Git try", Err: discoverErr}
521			}
522			return probe
523		}
524		repositoryRoot := repository.Root
525		if repository.Bare {
526			repositoryRoot = repository.MainRoot
527		}
528		canonicalRoot, rootErr := pathx.Canonical(repositoryRoot)
529		if rootErr != nil || !samePath(canonicalRoot, canonical) {
530			// A TriesRoot may itself be inside a repository. Its child directories are
531			// not independent Git Tries merely because rev-parse walks to that parent.
532			return probe
533		}
534		repository.Root = canonicalRoot
535		if repository.MainRoot != "" {

537				repository.MainRoot = canonicalMain
538			}
539		}
540		if repository.GitCommonDir != "" {
541			commonDir, commonErr := pathx.Canonical(repository.GitCommonDir)
542			if commonErr != nil {
543				probe.live.DiscoverError = commonErr
544				probe.diagnostic = &Diagnostic{Path: canonical, Operation: "canonicalize Git common directory", Err: commonErr}
545			} else {
546				repository.GitCommonDir = commonDir
547			}
548		}
549		probe.live.Repo = &repository
550		probe.originURL = gitx.RemoteFromConfig(repository.GitCommonDir, "origin")
551		return probe
```

```text
1	// Package runtime abstracts the terminal multiplexer that hosts a checkout.
2	//
3	// dev deliberately owns no terminal state of its own. A runtime is where a
4	// task is *live*; the durable facts live in git and in the task registry. That
5	// separation is the whole point: closing a runtime session must never feel
6	// like abandoning a task, so every adapter here is expected to be lossy and
7	// re-derivable.
8	package runtime
9	
10	import (
11		"context"
12		"fmt"
13		"os/exec"
14		"strings"
15	)
16	
17	// Session is one live workspace/session of a runtime backend.
18	type Session struct {
19		// Handle is the backend's own identifier (a herdr workspace id, a tmux
20		// session name). Opaque to the rest of dev.
21		Handle string
22		Label  string
23		// Dirs lists the working directories observed in this session. A session
24		// can span several (multiple panes), which is why this is not a single
25		// value.
26		Dirs []string
27		// AgentStatus is the backend's view of agent activity, when it has one:
28		// "working", "idle", "done", "waiting". Empty when unsupported.
29		AgentStatus string
30		// AgentSessions lists resumable agent context ids, e.g. "claude:<uuid>".
31		AgentSessions []string
32		Focused       bool
33	}
34	
35	// Covers reports whether the session has a pane rooted at or under dir.
36	func (s Session) Covers(dir string) bool {
37		for _, d := range s.Dirs {
38			// A pane inside the repository makes it live. The inverse is not
39			// true: a generic pane at $HOME does not make every repository below
40			// $HOME active.
41			if d == dir || strings.HasPrefix(d, dir+"/") {
42				return true
43			}
44		}
45		return false
46	}
47	
48	// Runtime is the contract every backend satisfies. Adapters must degrade
49	// gracefully: an unavailable backend returns errors rather than panicking, and
50	// List on an idle backend returns an empty slice, not an error.
51	type Runtime interface {
52		// Name is the backend identifier used in config and in `dev doctor`.
53		Name() string
54		// Available reports whether this backend can be used on this machine right
55		// now (binary installed and, where relevant, a server reachable).
56		Available() bool
57		// Open makes dir live and returns a handle. Opening something already open
58		// focuses it rather than duplicating it.
59		Open(ctx context.Context, dir, label string) (string, error)
60		// Close ends the session without touching the checkout, the branch or the
61		// task entry.
62		Close(ctx context.Context, handle string) error
63		// List enumerates live sessions.
64		List(ctx context.Context) ([]Session, error)
65		// Annotate attaches display-only metadata to a session (state, next
66		// action). Backends without a metadata channel implement this as a no-op.
67		Annotate(ctx context.Context, handle string, kv map[string]string) error
68	}
69	
70	// WorktreeOpener is implemented by backends that understand git worktrees and
71	// can present one as a first-class session grouped under its parent repo.
72	// dev always creates the worktree itself — this only surfaces it.
73	type WorktreeOpener interface {
74		OpenWorktree(ctx context.Context, path, label string) (string, error)
75	}
76	
77	// ErrUnavailable reports a backend that is not usable on this machine.
78	type ErrUnavailable struct{ Backend, Reason string }
79	
80	func (e *ErrUnavailable) Error() string {
81		return fmt.Sprintf("runtime %s unavailable: %s", e.Backend, e.Reason)
82	}
83	
84	// Select resolves a configured backend name to a Runtime.
85	//
86	// "auto" prefers the richest backend that is actually available: herdr (which
87	// models workspaces, worktrees and agent sessions), then tmux, then None.
88	// None is always available so dev never hard-fails for lack of a multiplexer.
89	func Select(backend string) Runtime {
90		herdr, tmux, none := NewHerdr(), NewTmux(), None{}
91		switch backend {
92		case "herdr":
93			return herdr
94		case "tmux":
95			return tmux
96		case "none":
97			return none
98		case "", "auto":
99			if herdr.Available() {
100				return herdr
101			}
102			if tmux.Available() {
103				return tmux
104			}
105			return none
106		}
107		return none
108	}
109	
110	// All returns every backend, for `dev doctor` to report on.
111	func All() []Runtime { return []Runtime{NewHerdr(), NewTmux(), None{}} }
112	
113	// haveBinary reports whether name is on PATH.
114	func haveBinary(name string) bool {
115		_, err := exec.LookPath(name)
116		return err == nil
117	}
118
```

```text
344	// NewService validates and normalizes the injected service dependencies.
345	func NewService(config ServiceConfig) (*Service, error) {
346		store := config.Store
347		registry := config.Registry
348		if store == nil && registry != nil {
349			store = registry.Store()
350		}
351		if registry == nil && store != nil {
352			registry = catalog.NewRegistry(store)
353		}
354		if store == nil || registry == nil {
355			return nil, errors.New("experiment service requires a catalog registry and store")
356		}
357		if registry.Store() != store {
358			return nil, errors.New("experiment service registry and store do not share a catalog")
359		}
360	
361		triesRoot, err := absoluteRoot(config.TriesRoot, "tries root")
362		if err != nil {
363			return nil, err
364		}
365		projectRoot, err := absoluteRoot(config.ProjectRoot, "project root")
366		if err != nil {
367			return nil, err
368		}
369		host := strings.TrimSpace(config.Host)
370		if host == "" || host != config.Host || strings.ContainsRune(host, '\x00') {
371			return nil, errors.New("experiment service host is required and must be normalized")
372		}
373		clock := config.Clock
374		if clock == nil {
375			clock = time.Now
376		}
377		workers := config.MaxEnrichment
378		if workers <= 0 {
379			workers = 4
380		}
381	
382		s := &Service{
383			registry: registry, store: store,
384			triesRoot: triesRoot, projectRoot: projectRoot, host: host,
385			clock: clock, workers: workers,
386			gitRun: gitx.Run, gitDiscover: gitx.Discover,
387			gitStatus: gitx.StatusOf, gitLastCommit: gitx.LastCommit,
388			rename: os.Rename, sameFilesystem: sameFilesystem,
389			getwd: os.Getwd,
390		}
391		s.catalogCreate = store.Create
392		s.catalogUpdate = registry.Update
393		applyHooks(s, config.Hooks)
394		return s, nil
395	}

427	func absoluteRoot(root, label string) (string, error) {
428		if strings.TrimSpace(root) == "" {
429			return "", fmt.Errorf("experiment service %s is required", label)
430		}
431		absolute, err := filepath.Abs(root)
432		if err != nil {
433			return "", fmt.Errorf("make %s absolute: %w", label, err)
434		}
435		return filepath.Clean(absolute), nil
436	}

447	func candidatesOf(items []Item) []Candidate {
448		candidates := make([]Candidate, len(items))
449		for index, item := range items {
450			candidates[index] = Candidate{
451				ID: item.ID, Name: item.Name, Basename: item.Basename, Path: item.Live.CurrentPath,
452			}
453		}
454		sort.Slice(candidates, func(i, j int) bool {
455			left, right := strings.ToLower(candidates[i].Basename), strings.ToLower(candidates[j].Basename)
456			if left != right {
457				return left < right
458			}
459			if candidates[i].Basename != candidates[j].Basename {
460				return candidates[i].Basename < candidates[j].Basename
461			}
462			return candidates[i].ID < candidates[j].ID
463		})
464		return candidates
465	}
466	
467	func itemFromEntry(entry *catalog.Entry, live LiveFacts) Item {
468		if entry == nil {
469			return Item{Live: live}
470		}
471		copy := entry.Clone()
472		item := Item{
473			Entry: copy,
474			ID:    copy.ID, Kind: copy.Kind, Name: copy.Name,
475			Note: copy.Note, Tags: append([]string(nil), copy.Tags...),
476			Created: copy.Created, LastOpened: copy.LastOpened,
477			RemoteIdentity: copy.RemoteIdentity,
478			Live:           live,
479		}
480		if copy.Experiment != nil {
481			item.Slug = copy.Experiment.Slug
482			item.Phase = copy.Experiment.Phase
483			item.Started = copy.Experiment.Started
484			item.OriginURL = copy.Experiment.OriginURL
485		}
486		if item.Live.CurrentPath != "" {
487			item.Basename = filepath.Base(item.Live.CurrentPath)
488		} else if copy.Experiment != nil && copy.Experiment.OriginalPath != "" {
489			item.Basename = filepath.Base(copy.Experiment.OriginalPath)
490		}
491		return item
492	}

502	func directoryExists(path string) (bool, error) {
503		info, err := os.Stat(path)
504		if err == nil {
505			return info.IsDir(), nil
506		}
507		if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
508			return false, nil
509		}
```

```text
31	// Reconcile backfills every immediate, non-hidden directory under TriesRoot.
32	// It never moves, renames, or writes into a discovered directory.
33	func (s *Service) Reconcile(ctx context.Context) ([]Item, []Diagnostic, error) {
34		s.reconcileMu.Lock()
35		defer s.reconcileMu.Unlock()
36	
37		if err := s.ensureTriesRoot(); err != nil {
38			return nil, nil, err
39		}
40		entries, catalogProblems, err := s.store.ListWithDiagnostics()
41		if err != nil {
42			return nil, nil, err
43		}
44		diagnostics := catalogDiagnostics(catalogProblems)
45	
46		directoryEntries, err := os.ReadDir(s.triesRoot)
47		if err != nil {
48			return nil, diagnostics, fmt.Errorf("read tries root %s: %w", s.triesRoot, err)
49		}
50		paths := make([]string, 0, len(directoryEntries))
51		for _, entry := range directoryEntries {
52			if strings.HasPrefix(entry.Name(), ".") {
53				continue
54			}
55			paths = append(paths, filepath.Join(s.triesRoot, entry.Name()))
56		}
57		probes := boundedMap(ctx, s.workers, paths, func(ctx context.Context, path string) directoryProbe {
58			return s.probeDirectory(ctx, path)
59		})
60	
61		items := make([]Item, 0, len(probes))
62		for _, probe := range probes {
63			if probe.diagnostic != nil {
64				diagnostics = append(diagnostics, *probe.diagnostic)
65			}
66			if !probe.valid {
67				continue
68			}
69	
70			matches := matchingEntries(entries, s.host, probe)
71			if len(matches) == 0 && len(catalogProblems) == 0 && probe.originURL != "" {
72				matched, matchErr := s.registry.Match(observationFromProbe(s.host, probe))
73				switch {
74				case matchErr == nil && eligibleTryRecord(matched):
75					matches = []*catalog.Entry{matched}
76				case matchErr == nil:
77					// A graduated experiment at the same identity is history, not an
78					// active Try to revive implicitly.
79				case errors.Is(matchErr, catalog.ErrNotFound), errors.Is(matchErr, catalog.ErrAmbiguous):
80					// A live clone must get its own identity when the remote hint is
81					// absent or ambiguous.
82				default:
83					item := s.transientItem(probe, matchErr)
84					items = append(items, item)
85					diagnostics = append(diagnostics, Diagnostic{
86						Path: probe.live.CurrentPath, Operation: "match catalog try", Err: matchErr,
87					})
88					continue
89				}
90			}
91			switch len(matches) {
92			case 0:
93				if len(catalogProblems) > 0 {
94					// The catalog diagnostic is reported once, while each live item carries
95					// the same typed tracking error for callers that try to mutate it.
96					items = append(items, s.transientItem(probe, incompleteCatalogError(catalogProblems)))
97					continue
98				}
99				entry := s.newEntry(probe)
100				if err := s.catalogCreate(entry); err != nil {
101					item := s.transientItem(probe, err)
102					items = append(items, item)
103					diagnostics = append(diagnostics, Diagnostic{
104						Path: probe.live.CurrentPath, Operation: "catalog try", Err: err,
105					})
106					continue
107				}
108				entries = append(entries, entry)
109				items = append(items, itemFromEntry(entry, probe.live))
110			case 1:
111				entry := matches[0]
112				updated, updateErr := s.refreshEntry(entry, probe)
113				if updateErr != nil {
114					item := itemFromEntry(entry, probe.live)
115					item.CatalogError = updateErr
116					items = append(items, item)
117					diagnostics = append(diagnostics, Diagnostic{
118						Path: probe.live.CurrentPath, Operation: "refresh catalog try", Err: updateErr,
119					})
120					continue
121				}
122				replaceEntry(entries, updated)
123				items = append(items, itemFromEntry(updated, probe.live))
124			default:
125				matchedItems := make([]Item, len(matches))
126				for index, entry := range matches {
127					matchedItems[index] = itemFromEntry(entry, probe.live)
128				}
129				ambiguous := &AmbiguousError{Ref: probe.live.CurrentPath, Candidates: candidatesOf(matchedItems)}
130				item := s.transientItem(probe, ambiguous)
131				items = append(items, item)
132				diagnostics = append(diagnostics, Diagnostic{
133					Path: probe.live.CurrentPath, Operation: "match catalog try", Err: ambiguous,
134				})
135			}
136		}
137	
138		items = deduplicateItems(items)
139		sortItemsByName(items)
140		sortDiagnostics(diagnostics)
141		return items, diagnostics, nil
142	}

144	// List reconciles visible directories, joins requested catalog history, and
145	// enriches Git repositories with bounded status/last-commit probes.
146	func (s *Service) List(ctx context.Context, options ListOptions) ([]Item, []Diagnostic, error) {
147		visible, diagnostics, err := s.Reconcile(ctx)
148		if err != nil {
149			return visible, diagnostics, err
150		}
151	
152		entries, catalogProblems, err := s.store.ListWithDiagnostics()
153		if err != nil {
154			return visible, diagnostics, err
155		}
156		diagnostics = append(diagnostics, catalogDiagnostics(catalogProblems)...)
157	
158		items := make([]Item, 0, len(entries)+len(visible))
159		seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(visible))
160		seenPaths := make(map[string]struct{}, len(visible))
161		for _, item := range visible {
162			if item.ID != "" {
163				seen[item.ID] = struct{}{}
164			}
165			if item.Live.CurrentPath != "" {
166				seenPaths[item.Live.CurrentPath] = struct{}{}
167			}
168			items = append(items, item)
169		}
170	
171		for _, entry := range entries {
172			if _, ok := seen[entry.ID]; ok {
173				continue
174			}
175			if location, ok := entry.LocationFor(s.host); ok {
176				if _, pathSeen := seenPaths[location.CurrentPath]; pathSeen {
177					continue
178				}
179			}
180			graduated := entry.Kind == catalog.KindRepository && entry.Experiment != nil &&
181				entry.Experiment.Phase == catalog.PhaseGraduated
182			if graduated {
183				if !options.IncludeGraduated {
184					continue
185				}
186			} else if entry.Kind != catalog.KindTry || entry.Experiment == nil {
187				continue
188			}
189	
190			location, located := entry.LocationFor(s.host)
191			present := located && location.State == catalog.LocationPresent && !s.hiddenStorage(location.CurrentPath)
192			if present {
193				isDirectory, statErr := directoryExists(location.CurrentPath)
194				if statErr != nil {
195					diagnostics = append(diagnostics, Diagnostic{
196						Path: location.CurrentPath, Operation: "stat catalog try", Err: statErr,
197					})
198					present = false
199				} else {
200					present = isDirectory
201				}
202			}
203			if !present && !options.IncludeNonPresent {
204				continue
205			}
206	
207			live := LiveFacts{Present: present}
208			if located {
209				live.CurrentPath = location.CurrentPath
210				live.RealPath = location.RealPath
211			}
212			if present {
213				probe := s.probeDirectory(ctx, location.CurrentPath)
214				if probe.diagnostic != nil {
215					diagnostics = append(diagnostics, *probe.diagnostic)
216				}
217				if probe.valid {
218					live = probe.live
219				}
220			}
221			items = append(items, itemFromEntry(entry, live))
222		}
223	
224		if query := strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(options.Query)); query != "" {
225			filtered := items[:0]
226			for _, item := range items {
227				if strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(item.SearchText()), query) {
228					filtered = append(filtered, item)
229				}
230			}
231			items = filtered
232		}
233		if !options.SkipEnrichment {
234			items = s.enrich(ctx, items)
235		}
236		sortItemsByActivity(items)
237		diagnostics = deduplicateDiagnostics(diagnostics)
238		sortDiagnostics(diagnostics)
239		return items, diagnostics, nil
240	}
```
