242	// Resolve applies stable, deterministic matching: exact ID, exact basename,
243	// exact date-stripped name/slug, then one unique case-insensitive substring.
244	func (s *Service) Resolve(ctx context.Context, ref string) (Item, []Diagnostic, error) {
245		items, diagnostics, err := s.List(ctx, ListOptions{})
246		if err != nil {
247			return Item{}, diagnostics, err
248		}
249		ref = strings.TrimSpace(ref)
250		if ref == "" {
251			return Item{}, diagnostics, &NotFoundError{Ref: ref, Root: s.triesRoot}
252		}
253	
254		if looksLikePath(ref) {
255			pathRef := config.Expand(ref)
256			if canonical, canonicalErr := pathx.Canonical(pathRef); canonicalErr == nil {
257				var matches []Item
258				for _, item := range items {
259					if samePath(canonical, item.Live.CurrentPath) {
260						matches = append(matches, item)
261					}
262				}
263				if len(matches) > 0 {
264					return selectResolved(ref, matches, diagnostics)
265				}
266			}
267		}
268	
269		for _, match := range []func(Item) bool{
270			func(item Item) bool { return item.ID != "" && item.ID == ref },
271			func(item Item) bool { return item.Basename == ref },
272			func(item Item) bool {
273				stripped, _, _ := splitDatedBasename(item.Basename)
274				return stripped == ref || item.Name == ref || item.Slug == ref
275			},
276		} {
277			var matches []Item
278			for _, item := range items {
279				if match(item) {
280					matches = append(matches, item)
281				}
282			}
283			if len(matches) > 0 {
284				return selectResolved(ref, matches, diagnostics)
285			}
286		}
287	
288		needle := strings.ToLower(ref)
289		var matches []Item
290		for _, item := range items {
291			stripped, _, _ := splitDatedBasename(item.Basename)
292			for _, value := range []string{item.Basename, stripped, item.Name, item.Slug} {
293				if value != "" && strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(value), needle) {
294					matches = append(matches, item)
295					break
296				}
297			}
298		}
299		if len(matches) == 0 {
300			return Item{}, diagnostics, &NotFoundError{Ref: ref, Root: s.triesRoot}
301		}
302		return selectResolved(ref, matches, diagnostics)
303	}
304	
305	func selectResolved(ref string, matches []Item, diagnostics []Diagnostic) (Item, []Diagnostic, error) {
306		if len(matches) == 1 {
307			return matches[0], diagnostics, nil
308		}
309		return Item{}, diagnostics, &AmbiguousError{Ref: ref, Candidates: candidatesOf(matches)}
310	}

312	// ResolveOrCreate preserves the low-friction dev try behavior: an existing
313	// non-clone match wins; clone requests always get a collision-safe new path.
314	func (s *Service) ResolveOrCreate(ctx context.Context, request CreateRequest) (CreateResult, error) {
315		if request.Clone == "" {
316			name := config.Slug(strings.ReplaceAll(request.Name, " ", "-"))
317			item, diagnostics, err := s.Resolve(ctx, name)
318			if err == nil {
319				result := CreateResult{
320					Item: item, Path: item.Live.CurrentPath, Existing: true,
321					Tracked: item.ID != "" && item.CatalogError == nil, Diagnostics: diagnostics,
322				}
323				if !result.Tracked {
324					trackingErr := item.CatalogError
325					if trackingErr == nil {
326						trackingErr = errors.New("matching directory has no catalog ID")
327					}
328					return result, fmt.Errorf("existing try at %s is not tracked in the catalog: %w", result.Path, trackingErr)
329				}
330				return result, nil
331			}
332			if !errors.Is(err, ErrNotFound) {
333				return CreateResult{Diagnostics: diagnostics}, err
334			}
335		}
336		return s.Create(ctx, request)
337	}
338	
339	// Create makes a new collision-safe dated directory or clone and catalogs it
340	// only after the filesystem operation succeeds.
341	func (s *Service) Create(ctx context.Context, request CreateRequest) (CreateResult, error) {
342		var result CreateResult
343		if err := s.ensureTriesRoot(); err != nil {
344			return result, err
345		}
346		name := request.Name
347		if request.Clone != "" && strings.TrimSpace(name) == "" {
348			name = cloneDefaultName(request.Clone)
349		}
350		slug := config.Slug(strings.ReplaceAll(name, " ", "-"))
351		if err := pathx.ValidateComponent(slug); err != nil {
352			return result, fmt.Errorf("try name %q: %w", name, err)
353		}
354	
355		path, err := s.availableDatedPath(slug)
356		if err != nil {
357			return result, err
358		}
359		result.Path = path
360		if request.Clone != "" {
361			cloneRef := normalizeCloneRef(request.Clone)
362			if _, err := s.gitRun(ctx, s.triesRoot, "clone", cloneRef, path); err != nil {
363				return result, fmt.Errorf("clone try into %s: %w", path, err)
364			}
365			result.Created = true
366			result.Cloned = true
367		} else {
368			if err := os.Mkdir(path, 0o755); err != nil {
369				return result, fmt.Errorf("create try %s: %w", path, err)
370			}
371			result.Created = true
372			if !request.NoGit {
373				if _, err := s.gitRun(ctx, path, "init", "-b", "main"); err != nil {
374					result.InitWarning = err
375				}
376			}
377		}
378	
379		canonical, canonicalErr := pathx.Canonical(path)
380		if canonicalErr != nil {
381			return result, fmt.Errorf("try exists at %s but its canonical path could not be determined: %w", path, canonicalErr)
382		}
383		result.Path = canonical
384		items, diagnostics, reconcileErr := s.Reconcile(ctx)
385		result.Diagnostics = diagnostics
386		if reconcileErr != nil {
387			return result, fmt.Errorf("try exists at %s but catalog reconciliation failed: %w", canonical, reconcileErr)
388		}
389		for _, item := range items {
390			if samePath(item.Live.CurrentPath, canonical) {
391				result.Item = item
392				result.Tracked = item.ID != "" && item.CatalogError == nil
393				break
394			}
395		}
396		if !result.Tracked {
397			trackingErr := result.Item.CatalogError
398			if trackingErr == nil {
399				trackingErr = errors.New("reconciliation did not produce a catalog record")
400			}
401			return result, fmt.Errorf("try exists at %s but could not be added to the catalog: %w", canonical, trackingErr)
402		}
403		enriched := s.enrich(ctx, []Item{result.Item})
404		if len(enriched) == 1 {
405			result.Item = enriched[0]
406		}
407		return result, nil
408	}

410	// RefreshOrigin re-probes origin after an explicit external remote-creation
411	// step and persists its raw URL and normalized identity on the same catalog ID.
412	func (s *Service) RefreshOrigin(ctx context.Context, id string) (Item, error) {
413		entry, err := s.registry.Get(id)
414		if err != nil {
415			return Item{}, fmt.Errorf("load experiment %s for origin refresh: %w", id, err)
416		}
417		if entry.Experiment == nil ||
418			(entry.Kind != catalog.KindTry && !(entry.Kind == catalog.KindRepository && entry.Experiment.Phase == catalog.PhaseGraduated)) {
419			return Item{}, &NotFoundError{Ref: id, Root: s.triesRoot}
420		}
421		location, ok := entry.LocationFor(s.host)
422		if !ok || location.State != catalog.LocationPresent || location.CurrentPath == "" {
423			return Item{}, &NotFoundError{Ref: id, Root: s.triesRoot}
424		}
425		probe := s.probeDirectory(ctx, location.CurrentPath)
426		if !probe.valid || probe.live.Repo == nil || probe.live.DiscoverError != nil {
427			if probe.diagnostic != nil {
428				return Item{}, fmt.Errorf("refresh experiment origin: %w", probe.diagnostic.Err)
429			}
430			return Item{}, errors.New("refresh experiment origin: path is not a discoverable Git repository")
431		}
432		if probe.originURL == "" {
433			return Item{}, errors.New("refresh experiment origin: Git origin is not configured")
434		}
435		updated, err := s.catalogUpdate(id, func(current *catalog.Entry) error {
436			currentLocation, found := current.LocationFor(s.host)
437			if !found || currentLocation.State != catalog.LocationPresent ||
438				!samePath(currentLocation.CurrentPath, probe.live.CurrentPath) {
439				return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s moved or was reassigned before origin refresh", id)
440			}
441			if current.Experiment == nil {
442				return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s no longer has experiment provenance", id)
443			}
444			current.Experiment.OriginURL = probe.originURL
445			current.RemoteIdentity = catalog.NormalizeRemoteIdentity(probe.originURL)
446			return current.SetLocation(s.host, locationFromProbe(probe, currentLocation))
447		})
448		if err != nil {
449			return Item{}, fmt.Errorf("refresh experiment origin: %w", err)
450		}
451		item := itemFromEntry(updated, probe.live)
452		enriched := s.enrich(ctx, []Item{item})
453		if len(enriched) == 1 {
454			item = enriched[0]
455		}
456		return item, nil
457	}

459	// Touch updates LastOpened only after a caller has successfully handed off the
460	// selected OpenTarget.
461	func (s *Service) Touch(_ context.Context, id string) (TouchResult, error) {
462		if id == "" {
463			return TouchResult{}, &NotFoundError{Ref: id, Root: s.triesRoot}
464		}
465		now := s.now()
466		updated, err := s.catalogUpdate(id, func(entry *catalog.Entry) error {
467			if entry.Experiment == nil ||
468				(entry.Kind != catalog.KindTry && !(entry.Kind == catalog.KindRepository && entry.Experiment.Phase == catalog.PhaseGraduated)) {
469				return &NotFoundError{Ref: id, Root: s.triesRoot}
470			}
471			location, ok := entry.LocationFor(s.host)
472			if !ok || location.State != catalog.LocationPresent {
473				return &NotFoundError{Ref: id, Root: s.triesRoot}
474			}
475			entry.LastOpened = now
476			return nil
477		})
478		if err != nil {
479			if errors.Is(err, catalog.ErrNotFound) {
480				return TouchResult{}, &NotFoundError{Ref: id, Root: s.triesRoot}
481			}
482			return TouchResult{}, fmt.Errorf("touch try %s: %w", id, err)
483		}
484		location, _ := updated.LocationFor(s.host)
485		item := itemFromEntry(updated, LiveFacts{
486			Present:     location.State == catalog.LocationPresent,
487			CurrentPath: location.CurrentPath, RealPath: location.RealPath,
488		})
489		return TouchResult{Item: item, TouchedAt: now}, nil
490	}

492	func (s *Service) probeDirectory(ctx context.Context, path string) directoryProbe {
493		probe := directoryProbe{}
494		if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
495			probe.diagnostic = &Diagnostic{Path: path, Operation: "inspect try", Err: err}
496			return probe
497		}
498		info, err := os.Stat(path)
499		if err != nil {
500			probe.diagnostic = &Diagnostic{Path: path, Operation: "stat try", Err: err}
501			return probe
502		}
503		if !info.IsDir() {
504			return probe
505		}
506		canonical, err := pathx.Canonical(path)
507		if err != nil {
508			probe.diagnostic = &Diagnostic{Path: path, Operation: "canonicalize try", Err: err}
509			return probe
510		}
511		probe.valid = true
512		probe.live = LiveFacts{Present: true, CurrentPath: canonical, RealPath: canonical}
513		_, markerErr := os.Lstat(filepath.Join(canonical, ".git"))
514		probe.gitMarker = markerErr == nil || !errors.Is(markerErr, fs.ErrNotExist)
515	
516		repository, discoverErr := s.gitDiscover(ctx, canonical)
517		if discoverErr != nil {
518			if probe.gitMarker {
519				probe.live.DiscoverError = discoverErr
520				probe.diagnostic = &Diagnostic{Path: canonical, Operation: "discover Git try", Err: discoverErr}
521			}
522			return probe
523		}
524		repositoryRoot := repository.Root
525		if repository.Bare {
526			repositoryRoot = repository.MainRoot
527		}
528		canonicalRoot, rootErr := pathx.Canonical(repositoryRoot)
529		if rootErr != nil || !samePath(canonicalRoot, canonical) {
530			// A TriesRoot may itself be inside a repository. Its child directories are
531			// not independent Git Tries merely because rev-parse walks to that parent.
532			return probe
533		}
534		repository.Root = canonicalRoot
535		if repository.MainRoot != "" {
536			if canonicalMain, mainErr := pathx.Canonical(repository.MainRoot); mainErr == nil {
537				repository.MainRoot = canonicalMain
538			}
539		}
540		if repository.GitCommonDir != "" {
541			commonDir, commonErr := pathx.Canonical(repository.GitCommonDir)
542			if commonErr != nil {
543				probe.live.DiscoverError = commonErr
544				probe.diagnostic = &Diagnostic{Path: canonical, Operation: "canonicalize Git common directory", Err: commonErr}
545			} else {
546				repository.GitCommonDir = commonDir
547			}
548		}
549		probe.live.Repo = &repository
550		probe.originURL = gitx.RemoteFromConfig(repository.GitCommonDir, "origin")
551		return probe
552	}

554	func (s *Service) enrich(ctx context.Context, items []Item) []Item {
555		return boundedMap(ctx, s.workers, items, func(ctx context.Context, item Item) Item {
556			if item.Live.Repo == nil || item.Live.CurrentPath == "" {
557				return item
558			}
559			status, statusErr := s.gitStatus(ctx, item.Live.CurrentPath)
560			if statusErr != nil {
561				item.Live.StatusError = statusErr
562			} else {
563				item.Live.Status = &status
564			}
565			unix, subject, commitErr := s.gitLastCommit(ctx, item.Live.CurrentPath)
566			if commitErr != nil {
567				item.Live.LastCommitError = commitErr
568			} else if unix > 0 {
569				item.Live.LastCommit = time.Unix(unix, 0)
570				item.Live.LastCommitSubject = subject
571			}
572			return item
573		})
574	}

576	func (s *Service) experimentFromProbe(probe directoryProbe) *catalog.Experiment {
577		name, started, dated := splitDatedBasename(filepath.Base(probe.live.CurrentPath))
578		if strings.TrimSpace(name) == "" {
579			name = "unnamed"
580		} else {
581			name = strings.TrimSpace(name)
582		}
583		if !dated {
584			started = s.now()
585		}
586		return &catalog.Experiment{
587			Phase: catalog.PhaseActive, Slug: config.Slug(name),
588			OriginURL: probe.originURL, Started: started,
589			OriginalPath: probe.live.CurrentPath,
590		}
591	}
592	
593	func (s *Service) newEntry(probe directoryProbe) *catalog.Entry {
594		name, started, dated := splitDatedBasename(filepath.Base(probe.live.CurrentPath))
595		if strings.TrimSpace(name) == "" {
596			name = "unnamed"
597		} else {
598			name = strings.TrimSpace(name)
599		}
600		if !dated {
601			started = s.now()
602		}
603		entry := &catalog.Entry{
604			Kind:           catalog.KindTry,
605			Name:           name,
606			RemoteIdentity: catalog.NormalizeRemoteIdentity(probe.originURL),
607			Experiment: &catalog.Experiment{

641	func (s *Service) refreshEntry(entry *catalog.Entry, probe directoryProbe) (*catalog.Entry, error) {
642		location, _ := entry.LocationFor(s.host)
643		wantedLocation := locationFromProbe(probe, location)
644		if entry.Kind == catalog.KindRepository && entry.Experiment == nil {
645			metadata := s.experimentFromProbe(probe)
646			return s.catalogUpdate(entry.ID, func(updated *catalog.Entry) error {
647				if updated.Kind != catalog.KindRepository || updated.Experiment != nil {
648					return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s changed before it could become a Try", updated.ID)
649				}
650				updated.Kind = catalog.KindTry
651				updated.Experiment = metadata
652				if probe.originURL != "" {
653					updated.RemoteIdentity = catalog.NormalizeRemoteIdentity(probe.originURL)
654				}
655				return updated.SetLocation(s.host, wantedLocation)
656			})
657		}
658	
659		wantedOrigin := entry.Experiment.OriginURL
660		wantedIdentity := entry.RemoteIdentity
661		if probe.originURL != "" {
662			wantedOrigin = probe.originURL
663			wantedIdentity = catalog.NormalizeRemoteIdentity(probe.originURL)
664		}
665		if locationEqual(location, wantedLocation) && entry.Experiment.OriginURL == wantedOrigin &&
666			entry.RemoteIdentity == wantedIdentity {
667			return entry, nil
668		}
669		return s.catalogUpdate(entry.ID, func(updated *catalog.Entry) error {
670			if updated.Kind != catalog.KindTry || updated.Experiment == nil || updated.Experiment.Phase == catalog.PhaseGraduated {
671				return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s is not an active Try", updated.ID)
672			}
673			if probe.originURL != "" {
674				updated.Experiment.OriginURL = probe.originURL
675				updated.RemoteIdentity = catalog.NormalizeRemoteIdentity(probe.originURL)
676			}
677			return updated.SetLocation(s.host, wantedLocation)
678		})
679	}

724	func matchingEntries(entries []*catalog.Entry, host string, probe directoryProbe) []*catalog.Entry {
725		matched := make(map[string]*catalog.Entry)
726		for _, entry := range entries {
727			if !eligibleLocalRecord(entry) {

729			}
730			location, located := entry.LocationFor(host)
731			if located {
732				pathMatch := samePath(probe.live.CurrentPath, location.CurrentPath) ||
733					samePath(probe.live.CurrentPath, location.RealPath) ||
734					samePath(probe.live.CurrentPath, location.RestorePath)
735				commonMatch := probe.live.Repo != nil && probe.live.Repo.GitCommonDir != "" &&
736					samePath(probe.live.Repo.GitCommonDir, location.GitCommonDir)
737				if pathMatch || commonMatch {
738					matched[entry.ID] = entry
739				}
740			} else if entry.Experiment != nil && samePath(probe.live.CurrentPath, entry.Experiment.OriginalPath) {
741				matched[entry.ID] = entry
742			}
743		}
744		out := make([]*catalog.Entry, 0, len(matched))
745		for _, entry := range matched {
746			out = append(out, entry)
747		}
748		catalog.Sort(out)
749		return out
750	}

770	func splitDatedBasename(basename string) (string, time.Time, bool) {
771		if len(basename) <= len("2006-01-02-") || basename[10] != '-' {
772			return basename, time.Time{}, false
773		}
774		parsed, err := time.Parse("2006-01-02", basename[:10])
775		if err != nil || parsed.Format("2006-01-02") != basename[:10] {
776			return basename, time.Time{}, false
777		}
778		name := basename[11:]
779		if name == "" {
780			return basename, time.Time{}, false
781		}
782		return name, parsed, true
783	}

785	func (s *Service) availableDatedPath(slug string) (string, error) {
786		prefix := s.clock().Format("2006-01-02") + "-" + slug
787		for version := 1; version < 10_000; version++ {
788			basename := prefix
789			if version > 1 {
790				basename = fmt.Sprintf("%s-%d", prefix, version)
791			}
792			candidate, err := pathx.JoinChild(s.triesRoot, basename)
793			if err != nil {
794				return "", fmt.Errorf("choose try destination: %w", err)
795			}
796			if _, err := os.Lstat(candidate); errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
797				return candidate, nil
798			} else if err != nil {
799				return "", fmt.Errorf("inspect try destination %s: %w", candidate, err)
800			}
801		}
802		return "", fmt.Errorf("choose a unique destination for %q", slug)
803	}

805	func cloneDefaultName(ref string) string {
806		if localClonePath(ref) {
807			trimmed := strings.TrimSuffix(strings.TrimSuffix(ref, string(filepath.Separator)), ".git")
808			return config.Slug(filepath.Base(trimmed))
809		}
810		if _, identity := forge.IdentityFromURL(ref); identity != "" {
811			return config.Slug(strings.ReplaceAll(identity, "/", "-"))
812		}
813		identity := clonePathIdentity(ref)
814		if identity != "" {
815			return config.Slug(strings.ReplaceAll(identity, "/", "-"))
816		}
817		trimmed := strings.TrimSuffix(strings.TrimSuffix(ref, "/"), ".git")
818		if index := strings.LastIndexAny(trimmed, "/:"); index >= 0 {
819			trimmed = trimmed[index+1:]
820		}
821		return config.Slug(trimmed)
822	}

824	func normalizeCloneRef(ref string) string {
825		ref = strings.TrimSpace(ref)
826		if localClonePath(ref) {
827			return ref
828		}
829		kind := forge.FromURL(ref)
830		if kind == forge.Unknown {
831			return ref
832		}
833		adapter, err := forge.For(kind)
834		if err != nil {
835			return ref
836		}
837		return adapter.CloneURL(ref)
838	}

840	func localClonePath(ref string) bool {
841		if filepath.IsAbs(ref) || strings.HasPrefix(ref, "file://") || strings.HasPrefix(ref, "./") ||
842			strings.HasPrefix(ref, "../") || strings.HasPrefix(ref, "~/") {
843			return true
844		}
845		_, err := os.Stat(ref)
846		return err == nil
847	}
848	
849	func clonePathIdentity(ref string) string {
850		if parsed, err := url.Parse(ref); err == nil && parsed.Host != "" {
851			return strings.Trim(strings.TrimSuffix(parsed.Path, ".git"), "/")
852		}
853		if at := strings.LastIndexByte(ref, '@'); at >= 0 {
854			ref = ref[at+1:]
855		}
856		if colon := strings.IndexByte(ref, ':'); colon >= 0 {
857			ref = ref[colon+1:]
858		}
859		ref = strings.Trim(strings.TrimSuffix(ref, ".git"), "/")
860		if strings.Contains(ref, "/") {
861			return ref
862		}
863		return ""
864	}

866	func (s *Service) hiddenStorage(path string) bool {
867		if path == "" {
868			return false
869		}
870		canonicalRoot, rootErr := pathx.Canonical(s.triesRoot)
871		canonicalPath, pathErr := pathx.Canonical(path)
872		if rootErr != nil || pathErr != nil {
873			return false
874		}
875		relative, err := filepath.Rel(canonicalRoot, canonicalPath)
876		if err != nil || relative == "." || strings.HasPrefix(relative, ".."+string(filepath.Separator)) {
877			return false
878		}
879		first, _, _ := strings.Cut(relative, string(filepath.Separator))
880		return strings.HasPrefix(first, ".")
881	}

883	func looksLikePath(ref string) bool {
884		return filepath.IsAbs(ref) || strings.HasPrefix(ref, ".") || strings.HasPrefix(ref, "~") ||
885			strings.ContainsAny(ref, `/\\`)
886	}

888	func samePath(left, right string) bool {
889		if left == "" || right == "" {
890			return false
891		}
892		leftCanonical, leftErr := pathx.Canonical(left)
893		rightCanonical, rightErr := pathx.Canonical(right)
894		if leftErr == nil && rightErr == nil {
895			return leftCanonical == rightCanonical
896		}
897		leftAbsolute, leftAbsErr := filepath.Abs(left)
898		rightAbsolute, rightAbsErr := filepath.Abs(right)
899		return leftAbsErr == nil && rightAbsErr == nil && filepath.Clean(leftAbsolute) == filepath.Clean(rightAbsolute)
900	}

902	func sortItemsByName(items []Item) {
903		sort.SliceStable(items, func(i, j int) bool {
904			left, right := strings.ToLower(items[i].DisplayName()), strings.ToLower(items[j].DisplayName())
905			if left != right {
906				return left < right
907			}
908			if items[i].DisplayName() != items[j].DisplayName() {
909				return items[i].DisplayName() < items[j].DisplayName()
910			}
911			return items[i].ID < items[j].ID
912		})
913	}
914	
915	func sortItemsByActivity(items []Item) {
916		sort.SliceStable(items, func(i, j int) bool {
917			left, right := items[i].Activity(), items[j].Activity()
918			if !left.Equal(right) {
919				if left.IsZero() {
920					return false
921				}
922				if right.IsZero() {
923					return true
924				}
925				return left.After(right)
926			}
927			leftName, rightName := strings.ToLower(items[i].DisplayName()), strings.ToLower(items[j].DisplayName())
928			if leftName != rightName {
929				return leftName < rightName
930			}
931			return items[i].ID < items[j].ID
932		})
933	}
934	
935	func sortDiagnostics(diagnostics []Diagnostic) {
936		sort.SliceStable(diagnostics, func(i, j int) bool {
937			if diagnostics[i].Path != diagnostics[j].Path {
938				return diagnostics[i].Path < diagnostics[j].Path
939			}
940			return diagnostics[i].Operation < diagnostics[j].Operation
941		})
942	}

944	func deduplicateItems(items []Item) []Item {
945		seenIDs := make(map[string]struct{}, len(items))
946		seenPaths := make(map[string]struct{}, len(items))
947		out := items[:0]
948		for _, item := range items {
949			if item.ID != "" {
950				if _, ok := seenIDs[item.ID]; ok {
951					continue
952				}
953				seenIDs[item.ID] = struct{}{}
954			} else if item.Live.CurrentPath != "" {
955				if _, ok := seenPaths[item.Live.CurrentPath]; ok {
956					continue
957				}
958				seenPaths[item.Live.CurrentPath] = struct{}{}
959			}
960			out = append(out, item)
961		}
962		return out
963	}
964	
965	func deduplicateDiagnostics(diagnostics []Diagnostic) []Diagnostic {
966		seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(diagnostics))
967		out := diagnostics[:0]
968		for _, diagnostic := range diagnostics {
969			key := diagnostic.Path + "\x00" + diagnostic.Operation + "\x00" + fmt.Sprint(diagnostic.Err)
970			if _, ok := seen[key]; ok {
971				continue
972			}
973			seen[key] = struct{}{}
974			out = append(out, diagnostic)
975		}
976		return out
977	}

979	func boundedMap[Input, Output any](ctx context.Context, limit int, input []Input, work func(context.Context, Input) Output) []Output {
980		if len(input) == 0 {
981			return nil
982		}
983		if limit <= 0 || limit > len(input) {
984			limit = len(input)
985		}
986		type job struct {
987			index int
988			value Input
989		}
990		type result struct {
991			index int
992			value Output
993		}
994		jobs := make(chan job, len(input))
995		results := make(chan result, len(input))
996		for index, value := range input {
997			jobs <- job{index: index, value: value}
998		}
999		close(jobs)
1000	
1001		var workers sync.WaitGroup
1002		workers.Add(limit)
1003		for range limit {
1004			go func() {
1005				defer workers.Done()
1006				for next := range jobs {
1007					results <- result{index: next.index, value: work(ctx, next.value)}
1008				}
1009			}()
1010		}
1011		workers.Wait()
1012		close(results)
1013	
1014		out := make([]Output, len(input))
1015		for result := range results {
1016			out[result.index] = result.value
1017		}
1018		return out
1019	}

137	// Graduate prepares Git while the Try is still at its source, performs one
138	// same-filesystem rename, and atomically transitions the same catalog ID.
139	func (s *Service) Graduate(ctx context.Context, request GraduateRequest) (GraduateResult, error) {
140		plan, err := s.PlanGraduate(ctx, request)
141		result := GraduateResult{Plan: plan, Item: plan.Item, Diagnostics: plan.Diagnostics}
142		if err != nil {
143			return result, err
144		}
145		if request.DryRun {
146			return result, nil
147		}
148		if err := s.validateCatalogSource(plan.Item.ID, plan.Source); err != nil {
149			return result, err
150		}
151		if err := s.validateGraduatePaths(plan); err != nil {
152			return result, err
153		}
154	
155		if plan.NeedsGitInit {
156			if _, err := s.gitRun(ctx, plan.Source, "init", "-b", "main"); err != nil {
157				return result, fmt.Errorf("initialize Git before graduating %s: %w", plan.Source, err)
158			}
159			result.GitInitialized = true
160		}
161		if plan.NeedsInitialCommit {
162			made, err := s.ensureInitialCommit(ctx, plan.Source, plan.Name)
163			if err != nil {
164				return result, fmt.Errorf("make initial commit before graduating %s: %w", plan.Source, err)
165			}
166			result.InitialCommitMade = made
167		}
168	
169		// Revalidate containment, catalog ownership, collision, and device after Git
170		// preparation. Each check precedes the only move, so a stale plan fails with
171		// the source still in place.
172		if err := s.validateCatalogSource(plan.Item.ID, plan.Source); err != nil {
173			return result, err
174		}
175		if err := s.validateGraduatePaths(plan); err != nil {
176			return result, err
177		}
178		if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(plan.Destination), 0o755); err != nil {
179			return result, fmt.Errorf("create graduation category: %w", err)
180		}
181		if err := s.validateGraduatePaths(plan); err != nil {
182			return result, err
183		}
184		sameDevice, err := s.sameFilesystem(plan.Source, plan.Destination)
185		if err != nil {
186			return result, fmt.Errorf("compare graduation filesystems: %w", err)
187		}
188		if !sameDevice {
189			return result, fmt.Errorf("move %s to %s: %w", plan.Source, plan.Destination, ErrCrossFilesystem)
190		}
191		if err := s.validateGraduatePaths(plan); err != nil {
192			return result, err
193		}
194		if err := s.validateCatalogSource(plan.Item.ID, plan.Source); err != nil {
195			return result, err
196		}
197		if err := s.rename(plan.Source, plan.Destination); err != nil {
198			if errors.Is(err, syscall.EXDEV) {
199				return result, fmt.Errorf("move %s to %s: %w", plan.Source, plan.Destination, ErrCrossFilesystem)
200			}
201			return result, fmt.Errorf("move %s to %s: %w", plan.Source, plan.Destination, err)
202		}
203		result.Moved = true
204	
205		probe := s.probeDirectory(ctx, plan.Destination)
206		if !probe.valid || probe.live.Repo == nil || probe.live.DiscoverError != nil {
207			cause := probe.live.DiscoverError
208			if cause == nil && probe.diagnostic != nil {
209				cause = probe.diagnostic.Err
210			}
211			if cause == nil {
212				cause = errors.New("moved project is not a discoverable Git repository")
213			}
214			return s.rollbackGraduation(result, cause)
215		}
216	
217		now := s.now()
218		updated, updateErr := s.catalogUpdate(plan.Item.ID, func(entry *catalog.Entry) error {
219			if entry.Kind != catalog.KindTry || entry.Experiment == nil || entry.Experiment.Phase == catalog.PhaseGraduated {
220				return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s is no longer an active Try", entry.ID)
221			}
222			location, ok := entry.LocationFor(s.host)
223			if !ok || location.State != catalog.LocationPresent || !storedLocationMatches(location, plan.Source) {
224				return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s moved or was reassigned after graduation planning", entry.ID)
225			}
226			entry.Kind = catalog.KindRepository
227			entry.Name = plan.Name
228			entry.Experiment.Phase = catalog.PhaseGraduated
229			entry.Experiment.GraduatedAt = now
230			entry.Experiment.GraduatedPath = probe.live.CurrentPath
231			if probe.originURL != "" {
232				entry.Experiment.OriginURL = probe.originURL
233				entry.RemoteIdentity = catalog.NormalizeRemoteIdentity(probe.originURL)
234			}
235			previous, _ := entry.LocationFor(s.host)
236			return entry.SetLocation(s.host, locationFromProbe(probe, previous))
237		})
238		if updateErr != nil {
239			return s.rollbackGraduation(result, updateErr)
240		}
241		if updated == nil {
242			return s.rollbackGraduation(result, errors.New("catalog update returned no graduated entry"))
243		}
244	
245		item := itemFromEntry(updated, probe.live)
246		enriched := s.enrich(ctx, []Item{item})
247		if len(enriched) == 1 {
248			item = enriched[0]
249		}
250		result.Item = item
251		return result, nil
252	}
253	
254	func (s *Service) validateCatalogSource(id, source string) error {
255		entry, err := s.registry.Get(id)
256		if err != nil {
257			return fmt.Errorf("reload catalog source %s: %w", id, err)
258		}
259		if entry.Kind != catalog.KindTry || entry.Experiment == nil || entry.Experiment.Phase == catalog.PhaseGraduated {
260			return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s is no longer an active Try", id)
261		}
262		location, ok := entry.LocationFor(s.host)
263		if !ok || location.State != catalog.LocationPresent || !storedLocationMatches(location, source) {
264			return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s moved or was reassigned after graduation planning", id)
265		}
266		return nil
267	}
268	
269	func (s *Service) validateGraduatePaths(plan GraduatePlan) error {
270		source, err := pathx.CanonicalChild(s.triesRoot, plan.Source)
271		if err != nil {
272			return fmt.Errorf("revalidate graduation source: %w", err)
273		}
274		if source != plan.Source {
275			return fmt.Errorf("graduation source changed after planning: %s became %s", plan.Source, source)
276		}
277		components := []string{plan.Name}
278		if plan.Category != "" {
279			components = []string{plan.Category, plan.Name}
280		}
281		destination, err := pathx.JoinChild(s.projectRoot, components...)
282		if err != nil {
283			return fmt.Errorf("revalidate graduation destination: %w", err)
284		}
285		if destination != plan.Destination {
286			return fmt.Errorf("graduation destination changed after planning: %s became %s", plan.Destination, destination)
287		}
288		if err := rejectExisting(destination); err != nil {
289			return err
290		}
291		if nested, nestedErr := pathx.IsChild(source, destination); nestedErr != nil {
292			return fmt.Errorf("revalidate graduation destination: %w", nestedErr)
293		} else if nested {
294			return fmt.Errorf("graduation destination %s is inside its source %s", destination, source)
295		}
296		return nil
297	}
298	
299	func storedLocationMatches(location catalog.Location, source string) bool {
300		return filepath.Clean(location.CurrentPath) == source || filepath.Clean(location.RealPath) == source
301	}
302	
303	func (s *Service) resolveGraduateItem(ctx context.Context, request GraduateRequest) (Item, []Diagnostic, error) {
304		if strings.TrimSpace(request.Ref) != "" {
305			return s.Resolve(ctx, request.Ref)
306		}
307		current := request.CurrentDir
308		if current == "" {
309			var err error
310			current, err = s.getwd()
311			if err != nil {
312				return Item{}, nil, fmt.Errorf("get current directory: %w", err)
313			}
314		}
315		canonicalCurrent, err := pathx.CanonicalChild(s.triesRoot, current)
316		if err != nil {
317			return Item{}, nil, fmt.Errorf("%s is not inside %s — name the try to graduate", current, s.triesRoot)
318		}
319		canonicalRoot, err := pathx.Canonical(s.triesRoot)
320		if err != nil {
321			return Item{}, nil, err
322		}
323		relative, err := filepath.Rel(canonicalRoot, canonicalCurrent)
324		if err != nil {
325			return Item{}, nil, err
326		}
327		first, _, _ := strings.Cut(relative, string(filepath.Separator))
328		if first == "" || first == "." || strings.HasPrefix(first, ".") {
329			return Item{}, nil, fmt.Errorf("%s is not inside a visible try under %s", current, s.triesRoot)
330		}
331		return s.Resolve(ctx, filepath.Join(s.triesRoot, first))
332	}
333	
334	func (s *Service) hasCommit(ctx context.Context, directory string) bool {
335		if unix, _, err := s.gitLastCommit(ctx, directory); err == nil && unix > 0 {
336			return true
337		}
338		_, err := s.gitRun(ctx, directory, "rev-parse", "--verify", "HEAD")
339		return err == nil
340	}
341	
342	func (s *Service) ensureInitialCommit(ctx context.Context, directory, name string) (bool, error) {
343		if s.hasCommit(ctx, directory) {
344			return false, nil
345		}
346		empty, err := isEmptyWorkTree(directory)
347		if err != nil {
348			return false, err
349		}
350		if empty {
351			readme := filepath.Join(directory, "README.md")
352			file, err := os.OpenFile(readme, os.O_WRONLY|os.O_CREATE|os.O_EXCL, 0o644)
353			if err != nil {
354				return false, err
355			}
356			if _, err := fmt.Fprintf(file, "# %s\n", name); err != nil {
357				_ = file.Close()
358				return false, err
359			}
360			if err := file.Close(); err != nil {
361				return false, err
362			}
363		}
364		if _, err := s.gitRun(ctx, directory, "add", "--all"); err != nil {
365			return false, err
366		}
367		if _, err := s.gitRun(ctx, directory, "commit", "-m", "chore: graduate experiment into a project"); err != nil {
368			return false, err
369		}
370		return true, nil
371	}
372	
373	func (s *Service) rollbackGraduation(result GraduateResult, cause error) (GraduateResult, error) {
374		rollbackErr := rejectExisting(result.Plan.Source)
375		if rollbackErr == nil {
376			rollbackErr = s.rename(result.Plan.Destination, result.Plan.Source)
377		}
378		result.RollbackError = rollbackErr
379		result.RolledBack = rollbackErr == nil
380		if rollbackErr == nil {
381			result.Moved = false
382		}
383		return result, &FinalizeError{
384			Source: result.Plan.Source, Destination: result.Plan.Destination,
385			Cause: cause, RollbackErr: rollbackErr,
386		}
387	}
388	
389	func rejectExisting(path string) error {
390		if _, err := os.Lstat(path); err == nil {
391			return fmt.Errorf("%s already exists", path)
392		} else if !errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
393			return fmt.Errorf("inspect graduation destination %s: %w", path, err)
394		}
395		return nil
396	}
397	
398	func isEmptyWorkTree(directory string) (bool, error) {
399		entries, err := os.ReadDir(directory)
400		if err != nil {
401			return false, err
402		}
403		for _, entry := range entries {
404			if entry.Name() != ".git" {
405				return false, nil
406			}
407		}
408		return true, nil
409	}
410	
411	func sameFilesystem(source, destination string) (bool, error) {
412		sourceAncestor, err := nearestExisting(source)
413		if err != nil {
414			return false, err
415		}
416		destinationAncestor, err := nearestExisting(destination)
417		if err != nil {
418			return false, err
419		}
420		sourceInfo, err := os.Stat(sourceAncestor)
421		if err != nil {
422			return false, err
423		}
424		destinationInfo, err := os.Stat(destinationAncestor)
425		if err != nil {
426			return false, err
427		}
428		sourceDevice, sourceOK := deviceNumber(sourceInfo)
429		destinationDevice, destinationOK := deviceNumber(destinationInfo)
430		if !sourceOK || !destinationOK {
431			// os.Rename remains the final authority on platforms whose FileInfo does
432			// not expose a Unix-style device number.
433			return true, nil
434		}
435		return sourceDevice == destinationDevice, nil
436	}
437	
438	func nearestExisting(path string) (string, error) {
439		path = filepath.Clean(path)
440		for {
441			if _, err := os.Stat(path); err == nil {
442				return path, nil
443			} else if !errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
444				return "", err
445			}
446			parent := filepath.Dir(path)
447			if parent == path {
448				return "", fmt.Errorf("no existing ancestor for %s", path)
449			}
450			path = parent
451		}
452	}
453	
454	func deviceNumber(info fs.FileInfo) (uint64, bool) {
455		value := reflect.ValueOf(info.Sys())
456		if !value.IsValid() {
457			return 0, false
458		}
459		if value.Kind() == reflect.Pointer {
460			if value.IsNil() {
461				return 0, false
462			}
463			value = value.Elem()
464		}
465		if value.Kind() != reflect.Struct {
466			return 0, false
467		}
468		device := value.FieldByName("Dev")
469		if !device.IsValid() {
470			return 0, false
471		}
472		switch device.Kind() {
473		case reflect.Uint, reflect.Uint8, reflect.Uint16, reflect.Uint32, reflect.Uint64, reflect.Uintptr:
474			return device.Uint(), true
475		case reflect.Int, reflect.Int8, reflect.Int16, reflect.Int32, reflect.Int64:
476			return uint64(device.Int()), true
477		default:
478			return 0, false
479		}
480	}

86	func listTries(app *App, ctx context.Context, service *experiment.Service, root string) error {

88		warnExperimentDiagnostics(app, diagnostics)

94			return nil
95		}
96	
97		table := NewTable("TRY", "AGE", "GIT")
98		for _, item := range items {
99			gitColumn := "—"
100			switch {
101			case item.Live.Repo != nil && item.Live.Status != nil && item.Live.Status.Dirty():
102				gitColumn = "repo ●"
103			case item.Live.Repo != nil && item.Live.StatusError != nil:
104				gitColumn = "repo ?"
105			case item.Live.Repo != nil:
106				gitColumn = "repo"
107			case item.Live.DiscoverError != nil:
108				gitColumn = "error"
109			}
110			age := "unknown"
111			if activity := item.Activity(); !activity.IsZero() {
112				age = humanAge(time.Since(activity))
113			}
114			table.Add(truncate(item.DisplayName(), 44), age, gitColumn)
115		}
116		table.Render(app.Out)
117		fmt.Fprintf(app.Err, "\n%d tries under %s — promote one with `dev graduate <try>`\n",
118			len(items), config.Contract(root))
119		return nil
120	}

12	func newGraduateCmd(app *App) *cobra.Command {

16			private  bool

18			push     bool
19			dryRun   bool

21		cmd := &cobra.Command{
22			Use:   "graduate [try]",
23			Short: "Promote an experiment into a real project",
24			Long: `Move a try out of the scratch directory and into your projects tree.
25	
26	An experiment that turns out to matter should stop being an experiment, and
27	that transition is where things usually get lost — the directory keeps its date
28	prefix forever, or it gets copied by hand and the history is left behind.
29	
30	graduate moves the directory to <project_root>/<category>/<name>, drops the
31	date prefix, makes sure it has a git repo and a first commit, and optionally
32	creates the remote with gh or glab.
33	
34	With no argument, the try containing the current directory is used.`,
35			Args: cobra.MaximumNArgs(1),
36			RunE: func(cmd *cobra.Command, args []string) error {
37				ctx := ctxOf()
38				service, err := newExperimentService(app)
39				if err != nil {
40					return err
41				}
42				ref := ""
43				if len(args) == 1 {
44					ref = args[0]
45				}
46				request := experiment.GraduateRequest{
47					Ref: ref, Category: category, Name: name, DryRun: dryRun,
48				}
49				plan, err := service.PlanGraduate(ctx, request)
50				warnExperimentDiagnostics(app, plan.Diagnostics)
51				if err != nil {
52					return err
53				}
54	
55				fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "graduate  %s\n", config.Contract(plan.Source))
56				fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "       →  %s\n", config.Contract(plan.Destination))
57				if dryRun {
58					fmt.Fprintln(app.Out, "\n(dry run — nothing moved)")
59					return nil
60				}
61	
62				result, err := service.Graduate(ctx, request)
63				if err != nil {
64					return err
65				}
66				if result.GitInitialized {
67					fmt.Fprintln(app.Out, "   git init")
68				}
69				if result.InitialCommitMade {
70					fmt.Fprintln(app.Out, "   committed the existing work")
71				}
72	
73				if remote {
74					adapter, err := forge.Preferred()
75					if err != nil {
76						app.warnf("%v — the project is in place; add a remote by hand", err)
77					} else {
78						remoteURL, createErr := adapter.CreateRepo(ctx, result.Plan.Destination, forge.RepoRequest{
79							Name: result.Plan.Name, Private: private, Push: push,
80						})
81						if createErr != nil {

98					return nil
99				}
100				_, err = service.Touch(ctx, result.Item.ID)
101				return err
102			},
103		}

34		t.Setenv("GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL", os.DevNull)

36		t.Setenv("GIT_AUTHOR_NAME", "dev test")
37		t.Setenv("GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL", "dev@example.test")
38		t.Setenv("GIT_COMMITTER_NAME", "dev test")
39		t.Setenv("GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL", "dev@example.test")
40		root := t.TempDir()
41		tries := filepath.Join(root, "tries")
42		projects := filepath.Join(root, "projects")
43		for _, directory := range []string{tries, projects} {
44			if err := os.MkdirAll(directory, 0o755); err != nil {
45				t.Fatal(err)
46			}
47		}
48		now := time.Date(2026, time.August, 27, 15, 30, 0, 0, time.UTC)
49		sequence := 0
50		store := catalog.NewStore(filepath.Join(root, "assets"),
51			catalog.WithClock(func() time.Time { return now }),
52			catalog.WithIDGenerator(func() string {
53				sequence++
54				return fmt.Sprintf("try-%03d", sequence)
55			}))
56		registry := catalog.NewRegistry(store)
57		service, err := experiment.NewService(experiment.ServiceConfig{
58			Registry: registry, Store: store,
59			TriesRoot: tries, ProjectRoot: projects, Host: "test-host",
60			Clock: func() time.Time { return now }, MaxEnrichment: maxWorkers,
61			Hooks: hooks,
62		})
63		if err != nil {
64			t.Fatal(err)
65		}
66		return &fixture{
67			t: t, root: root, tries: tries, projects: projects,
68			store: store, registry: registry, service: service, now: &now,
69		}
70	}

74		path := filepath.Join(f.tries, name)

81	func runGit(t *testing.T, directory string, args ...string) string {
82		t.Helper()
83		command := exec.Command("git", args...)
84		command.Dir = directory
85		command.Env = append(os.Environ(),
86			"GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null",
87			"GIT_CONFIG_SYSTEM=/dev/null",
88			"GIT_AUTHOR_NAME=dev test",
89			"GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL=dev@example.test",
90			"GIT_COMMITTER_NAME=dev test",
91			"GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL=dev@example.test",
92			"GIT_AUTHOR_DATE=2026-08-22T10:00:00Z",
93			"GIT_COMMITTER_DATE=2026-08-22T10:00:00Z",
94		)
95		output, err := command.CombinedOutput()
96		if err != nil {
97			t.Fatalf("git %s in %s: %v\n%s", strings.Join(args, " "), directory, err, output)
98		}
99		return strings.TrimSpace(string(output))
100	}

102	func initRepo(t *testing.T, directory string, commit bool) {
103		t.Helper()
104		if err := os.MkdirAll(directory, 0o755); err != nil {
105			t.Fatal(err)
106		}
107		runGit(t, directory, "init", "--initial-branch=main")
108		if !commit {
109			return
110		}
111		if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(directory, "README.md"), []byte("# experiment\n"), 0o644); err != nil {
112			t.Fatal(err)
113		}
114		runGit(t, directory, "add", "README.md")
115		runGit(t, directory, "commit", "-m", "initial experiment")
116	}

118	func itemByBase(t *testing.T, items []experiment.Item, basename string) experiment.Item {
119		t.Helper()
120		for _, item := range items {
121			if item.Basename == basename {
122				return item
123			}
124		}
125		t.Fatalf("no item %q in %+v", basename, items)
126		return experiment.Item{}
127	}

129	func TestReconcileBackfillsGitAndNonGitDirectoriesIdempotently(t *testing.T) {
130		f := newFixture(t, experiment.Hooks{}, 2)
131		gitPath := f.mkdir("2026-08-20-owner-repo")
132		initRepo(t, gitPath, true)
133		runGit(t, gitPath, "remote", "add", "origin", "git@github.com:owner/repo.git")
134		plainPath := f.mkdir("plain-notes")
135		hiddenPath := filepath.Join(f.tries, ".dev", "archive", "hidden")
136		if err := os.MkdirAll(hiddenPath, 0o755); err != nil {
137			t.Fatal(err)
138		}
139		mtime := time.Date(2030, time.January, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
140		if err := os.Chtimes(plainPath, mtime, mtime); err != nil {
141			t.Fatal(err)
142		}
143	
144		first, diagnostics, err := f.service.List(context.Background(), experiment.ListOptions{})
145		if err != nil {
146			t.Fatal(err)
147		}
148		if len(diagnostics) != 0 {
149			t.Fatalf("unexpected diagnostics: %+v", diagnostics)
150		}
151		if len(first) != 2 {
152			t.Fatalf("List returned %d items, want 2", len(first))
153		}
154	
155		gitItem := itemByBase(t, first, "2026-08-20-owner-repo")
156		if gitItem.ID == "" || gitItem.Live.Repo == nil || gitItem.Live.Status == nil {
157			t.Fatalf("Git item lacks durable/live facts: %+v", gitItem)
158		}
159		if got, want := gitItem.Name, "owner-repo"; got != want {
160			t.Errorf("Name = %q, want %q", got, want)
161		}
162		if got, want := gitItem.OriginURL, "git@github.com:owner/repo.git"; got != want {
163			t.Errorf("OriginURL = %q, want %q", got, want)
164		}
165		if got, want := gitItem.RemoteIdentity, "github.com/owner/repo"; got != want {
166			t.Errorf("RemoteIdentity = %q, want %q", got, want)
167		}
168		wantStarted := time.Date(2026, time.August, 20, 0, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
169		if !gitItem.Created.Equal(wantStarted) || !gitItem.Started.Equal(wantStarted) {
170			t.Errorf("dated timestamps = %s / %s, want %s", gitItem.Created, gitItem.Started, wantStarted)
171		}
172		canonicalGitPath, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(gitPath)
173		if err != nil {
174			t.Fatal(err)
175		}
176		location, ok := gitItem.Entry.LocationFor("test-host")
177		if !ok || location.CurrentPath != canonicalGitPath || location.RealPath != canonicalGitPath || location.GitCommonDir == "" {
178			t.Errorf("catalog location = %+v, %v", location, ok)
179		}
180	
181		plainItem := itemByBase(t, first, "plain-notes")
182		if plainItem.Live.Repo != nil || plainItem.Live.Status != nil {
183			t.Errorf("plain directory was presented as Git: %+v", plainItem.Live)
184		}
185		if activity := plainItem.Activity(); !activity.IsZero() {
186			t.Errorf("directory mtime leaked into activity: %s", activity)
187		}
188		if _, err := os.Stat(filepath.Join(plainPath, ".git")); !errors.Is(err, os.ErrNotExist) {
189			t.Errorf("backfill wrote inside non-Git Try: %v", err)
190		}
191	
192		second, diagnostics, err := f.service.List(context.Background(), experiment.ListOptions{})
193		if err != nil || len(diagnostics) != 0 {
194			t.Fatalf("second List: %v, %+v", err, diagnostics)
195		}
196		if itemByBase(t, second, gitItem.Basename).ID != gitItem.ID ||
197			itemByBase(t, second, plainItem.Basename).ID != plainItem.ID {
198			t.Error("reconciliation changed stable IDs")
199		}
200		entries, err := f.store.List()
201		if err != nil || len(entries) != 2 {
202			t.Fatalf("catalog entries = %d, %v", len(entries), err)
203		}
204	}

352	func TestResolveUsesExactPrecedenceAndReportsDeterministicAmbiguity(t *testing.T) {
353		f := newFixture(t, experiment.Hooks{}, 2)
354		for _, name := range []string{
355			"2026-08-01-cache-alpha",
356			"2026-08-02-cache-beta",
357			"scratch",
358		} {
359			f.mkdir(name)
360		}
361		items, _, err := f.service.List(context.Background(), experiment.ListOptions{})
362		if err != nil {
363			t.Fatal(err)
364		}
365		alpha := itemByBase(t, items, "2026-08-01-cache-alpha")
366	
367		for label, ref := range map[string]string{
368			"stable ID": alpha.ID,
369			"basename":  alpha.Basename,
370			"stripped":  "cache-alpha",
371		} {
372			resolved, _, err := f.service.Resolve(context.Background(), ref)
373			if err != nil || resolved.ID != alpha.ID {
374				t.Errorf("Resolve by %s = %+v, %v", label, resolved, err)
375			}
376		}
377	
378		_, _, err = f.service.Resolve(context.Background(), "CACHE")
379		var ambiguous *experiment.AmbiguousError
380		if !errors.Is(err, experiment.ErrAmbiguous) || !errors.As(err, &ambiguous) {
381			t.Fatalf("ambiguous Resolve = %v", err)
382		}
383		if len(ambiguous.Candidates) != 2 ||
384			ambiguous.Candidates[0].Basename != "2026-08-01-cache-alpha" ||
385			ambiguous.Candidates[1].Basename != "2026-08-02-cache-beta" {
386			t.Errorf("ambiguous candidates = %+v", ambiguous.Candidates)
387		}
388	
389		_, _, err = f.service.Resolve(context.Background(), "missing")
390		var notFound *experiment.NotFoundError
391		if !errors.Is(err, experiment.ErrNotFound) || !errors.As(err, &notFound) {
392			t.Errorf("missing Resolve = %v", err)
393		}
394	
395		created, err := f.service.ResolveOrCreate(context.Background(), experiment.CreateRequest{Name: "001", NoGit: true})
396		if err != nil {
397			t.Fatal(err)
398		}
399		if created.Existing || !strings.HasSuffix(created.Path, "-001") {
400			t.Errorf("name matched an unrelated ID substring: %+v", created)
401		}
402	
403		scratch := itemByBase(t, items, "scratch")
404		if err := os.RemoveAll(scratch.Live.CurrentPath); err != nil {
405			t.Fatal(err)
406		}
407		if _, _, err := f.service.Resolve(context.Background(), "scratch"); !errors.Is(err, experiment.ErrNotFound) {
408			t.Errorf("host-nonpresent Try should be excluded, got %v", err)
409		}
410	}

344	// NewService validates and normalizes the injected service dependencies.
345	func NewService(config ServiceConfig) (*Service, error) {
346		store := config.Store
347		registry := config.Registry
348		if store == nil && registry != nil {
349			store = registry.Store()
350		}
351		if registry == nil && store != nil {
352			registry = catalog.NewRegistry(store)
353		}
354		if store == nil || registry == nil {
355			return nil, errors.New("experiment service requires a catalog registry and store")
356		}
357		if registry.Store() != store {
358			return nil, errors.New("experiment service registry and store do not share a catalog")
359		}
360	
361		triesRoot, err := absoluteRoot(config.TriesRoot, "tries root")
362		if err != nil {
363			return nil, err
364		}
365		projectRoot, err := absoluteRoot(config.ProjectRoot, "project root")
366		if err != nil {
367			return nil, err
368		}
369		host := strings.TrimSpace(config.Host)
370		if host == "" || host != config.Host || strings.ContainsRune(host, '\x00') {
371			return nil, errors.New("experiment service host is required and must be normalized")
372		}
373		clock := config.Clock
374		if clock == nil {
375			clock = time.Now
376		}
377		workers := config.MaxEnrichment
378		if workers <= 0 {
379			workers = 4
380		}
381	
382		s := &Service{
383			registry: registry, store: store,
384			triesRoot: triesRoot, projectRoot: projectRoot, host: host,
385			clock: clock, workers: workers,
386			gitRun: gitx.Run, gitDiscover: gitx.Discover,
387			gitStatus: gitx.StatusOf, gitLastCommit: gitx.LastCommit,
388			rename: os.Rename, sameFilesystem: sameFilesystem,
389			getwd: os.Getwd,
390		}
391		s.catalogCreate = store.Create
392		s.catalogUpdate = registry.Update
393		applyHooks(s, config.Hooks)
394		return s, nil
395	}

447	func candidatesOf(items []Item) []Candidate {
448		candidates := make([]Candidate, len(items))
449		for index, item := range items {
450			candidates[index] = Candidate{
451				ID: item.ID, Name: item.Name, Basename: item.Basename, Path: item.Live.CurrentPath,
452			}
453		}
454		sort.Slice(candidates, func(i, j int) bool {
455			left, right := strings.ToLower(candidates[i].Basename), strings.ToLower(candidates[j].Basename)
456			if left != right {
457				return left < right
458			}
459			if candidates[i].Basename != candidates[j].Basename {
460				return candidates[i].Basename < candidates[j].Basename
461			}
462			return candidates[i].ID < candidates[j].ID
463		})
464		return candidates
465	}

467	func itemFromEntry(entry *catalog.Entry, live LiveFacts) Item {
468		if entry == nil {
469			return Item{Live: live}
470		}
471		copy := entry.Clone()
472		item := Item{
473			Entry: copy,
474			ID:    copy.ID, Kind: copy.Kind, Name: copy.Name,
475			Note: copy.Note, Tags: append([]string(nil), copy.Tags...),
476			Created: copy.Created, LastOpened: copy.LastOpened,
477			RemoteIdentity: copy.RemoteIdentity,
478			Live:           live,
479		}
480		if copy.Experiment != nil {
481			item.Slug = copy.Experiment.Slug
482			item.Phase = copy.Experiment.Phase
483			item.Started = copy.Experiment.Started
484			item.OriginURL = copy.Experiment.OriginURL
485		}
486		if item.Live.CurrentPath != "" {
487			item.Basename = filepath.Base(item.Live.CurrentPath)
488		} else if copy.Experiment != nil && copy.Experiment.OriginalPath != "" {
489			item.Basename = filepath.Base(copy.Experiment.OriginalPath)
490		}
491		return item
492	}

34		}

41	// PlanGraduate resolves and validates a local move without changing either
42	// repository contents or the destination tree. Resolution may backfill catalog
43	// metadata for a legacy directory, but dry-run never initializes or moves it.
44	func (s *Service) PlanGraduate(ctx context.Context, request GraduateRequest) (GraduatePlan, error) {
45		item, diagnostics, err := s.resolveGraduateItem(ctx, request)
46		plan := GraduatePlan{Item: item, DryRun: request.DryRun, Diagnostics: diagnostics}
47		if err != nil {
48			return plan, err
49		}
50		if item.ID == "" || item.CatalogError != nil {
51			if item.CatalogError != nil {
52				return plan, fmt.Errorf("try %s is not safely tracked: %w", item.DisplayName(), item.CatalogError)
53			}
54			return plan, fmt.Errorf("try %s is not safely tracked in the catalog", item.DisplayName())
55		}
56		if !item.Live.Present || item.Live.CurrentPath == "" {
57			return plan, &NotFoundError{Ref: request.Ref, Root: s.triesRoot}
58		}
59	
60		source, err := pathx.CanonicalChild(s.triesRoot, item.Live.CurrentPath)
61		if err != nil {
62			return plan, fmt.Errorf("graduate source %s: %w", item.Live.CurrentPath, err)
63		}
64		canonicalRoot, err := pathx.Canonical(s.triesRoot)
65		if err != nil {
66			return plan, fmt.Errorf("canonicalize tries root: %w", err)
67		}
68		relative, err := filepath.Rel(canonicalRoot, source)
69		if err != nil {
70			return plan, fmt.Errorf("locate try under root: %w", err)
71		}
72		if relative == "." || strings.Contains(relative, string(filepath.Separator)) || strings.HasPrefix(relative, ".") {
73			return plan, fmt.Errorf("graduate source %s is not an immediate visible child of %s", source, canonicalRoot)
74		}
75	
76		name := request.Name
77		if name == "" {
78			name, _, _ = splitDatedBasename(filepath.Base(source))
79		}
80		if name == "" {
81			return plan, fmt.Errorf("could not derive a project name from %s — pass --name", source)
82		}
83		if err := pathx.ValidateComponent(name); err != nil {
84			return plan, fmt.Errorf("project name %q: %w", name, err)
85		}
86		if name != strings.TrimSpace(name) {
87			return plan, fmt.Errorf("project name %q is not normalized: %w", name, pathx.ErrInvalidComponent)
88		}
89		if request.Category != "" {
90			if err := pathx.ValidateComponent(request.Category); err != nil {
91				return plan, fmt.Errorf("project category %q: %w", request.Category, err)
92			}

95			}

101		}

106		if err := rejectExisting(destination); err != nil {

110			return plan, fmt.Errorf("validate graduation destination: %w", nestedErr)
111		} else if nested {

113		}
114		sameDevice, err := s.sameFilesystem(source, destination)

126		}
127	
128		plan.Source = source
129		plan.Destination = destination
130		plan.Category = request.Category
131		plan.Name = name
132		plan.NeedsGitInit = item.Live.Repo == nil
133		plan.NeedsInitialCommit = plan.NeedsGitInit || !s.hasCommit(ctx, source)
134		return plan, nil
135	}
136	
137	// Graduate prepares Git while the Try is still at its source, performs one
138	// same-filesystem rename, and atomically transitions the same catalog ID.
139	func (s *Service) Graduate(ctx context.Context, request GraduateRequest) (GraduateResult, error) {
140		plan, err := s.PlanGraduate(ctx, request)
141		result := GraduateResult{Plan: plan, Item: plan.Item, Diagnostics: plan.Diagnostics}
142		if err != nil {
143			return result, err
144		}
145		if request.DryRun {
146			return result, nil
147		}
148		if err := s.validateCatalogSource(plan.Item.ID, plan.Source); err != nil {
149			return result, err
150		}
151		if err := s.validateGraduatePaths(plan); err != nil {
152			return result, err
153		}
154	
155		if plan.NeedsGitInit {
156			if _, err := s.gitRun(ctx, plan.Source, "init", "-b", "main"); err != nil {
157				return result, fmt.Errorf("initialize Git before graduating %s: %w", plan.Source, err)
158			}
159			result.GitInitialized = true
160		}
161		if plan.NeedsInitialCommit {
162			made, err := s.ensureInitialCommit(ctx, plan.Source, plan.Name)
163			if err != nil {
164				return result, fmt.Errorf("make initial commit before graduating %s: %w", plan.Source, err)
165			}
166			result.InitialCommitMade = made
167		}
168	
169		// Revalidate containment, catalog ownership, collision, and device after Git
170		// preparation. Each check precedes the only move, so a stale plan fails with
171		// the source still in place.
172		if err := s.validateCatalogSource(plan.Item.ID, plan.Source); err != nil {
173			return result, err
174		}
175		if err := s.validateGraduatePaths(plan); err != nil {
176			return result, err
177		}
178		if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(plan.Destination), 0o755); err != nil {
179			return result, fmt.Errorf("create graduation category: %w", err)
180		}
181		if err := s.validateGraduatePaths(plan); err != nil {
182			return result, err
183		}
184		sameDevice, err := s.sameFilesystem(plan.Source, plan.Destination)
185		if err != nil {
186			return result, fmt.Errorf("compare graduation filesystems: %w", err)
187		}
188		if !sameDevice {
189			return result, fmt.Errorf("move %s to %s: %w", plan.Source, plan.Destination, ErrCrossFilesystem)
190		}
191		if err := s.validateGraduatePaths(plan); err != nil {
192			return result, err
193		}
194		if err := s.validateCatalogSource(plan.Item.ID, plan.Source); err != nil {
195			return result, err
196		}
197		if err := s.rename(plan.Source, plan.Destination); err != nil {
198			if errors.Is(err, syscall.EXDEV) {
199				return result, fmt.Errorf("move %s to %s: %w", plan.Source, plan.Destination, ErrCrossFilesystem)
200			}
201			return result, fmt.Errorf("move %s to %s: %w", plan.Source, plan.Destination, err)
202		}
203		result.Moved = true
204	
205		probe := s.probeDirectory(ctx, plan.Destination)
206		if !probe.valid || probe.live.Repo == nil || probe.live.DiscoverError != nil {
207			cause := probe.live.DiscoverError
208			if cause == nil && probe.diagnostic != nil {
209				cause = probe.diagnostic.Err
210			}
211			if cause == nil {
212				cause = errors.New("moved project is not a discoverable Git repository")
213			}
214			return s.rollbackGraduation(result, cause)
215		}
216	
217		now := s.now()
218		updated, updateErr := s.catalogUpdate(plan.Item.ID, func(entry *catalog.Entry) error {
219			if entry.Kind != catalog.KindTry || entry.Experiment == nil || entry.Experiment.Phase == catalog.PhaseGraduated {
220				return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s is no longer an active Try", entry.ID)
221			}
222			location, ok := entry.LocationFor(s.host)
223			if !ok || location.State != catalog.LocationPresent || !storedLocationMatches(location, plan.Source) {
224				return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s moved or was reassigned after graduation planning", entry.ID)
225			}
226			entry.Kind = catalog.KindRepository
227			entry.Name = plan.Name
228			entry.Experiment.Phase = catalog.PhaseGraduated
229			entry.Experiment.GraduatedAt = now
230			entry.Experiment.GraduatedPath = probe.live.CurrentPath
231			if probe.originURL != "" {
232				entry.Experiment.OriginURL = probe.originURL
233				entry.RemoteIdentity = catalog.NormalizeRemoteIdentity(probe.originURL)
234			}
235			previous, _ := entry.LocationFor(s.host)
236			return entry.SetLocation(s.host, locationFromProbe(probe, previous))
237		})
238		if updateErr != nil {
239			return s.rollbackGraduation(result, updateErr)
240		}
241		if updated == nil {
242			return s.rollbackGraduation(result, errors.New("catalog update returned no graduated entry"))
243		}
244	
245		item := itemFromEntry(updated, probe.live)
246		enriched := s.enrich(ctx, []Item{item})
247		if len(enriched) == 1 {
248			item = enriched[0]
249		}
250		result.Item = item
251		return result, nil
252	}
253	
254	func (s *Service) validateCatalogSource(id, source string) error {
255		entry, err := s.registry.Get(id)
256		if err != nil {
257			return fmt.Errorf("reload catalog source %s: %w", id, err)
258		}
259		if entry.Kind != catalog.KindTry || entry.Experiment == nil || entry.Experiment.Phase == catalog.PhaseGraduated {
260			return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s is no longer an active Try", id)
261		}
262		location, ok := entry.LocationFor(s.host)
263		if !ok || location.State != catalog.LocationPresent || !storedLocationMatches(location, source) {
264			return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s moved or was reassigned after graduation planning", id)
265		}
266		return nil
267	}
268	
269	func (s *Service) validateGraduatePaths(plan GraduatePlan) error {
270		source, err := pathx.CanonicalChild(s.triesRoot, plan.Source)
271		if err != nil {
272			return fmt.Errorf("revalidate graduation source: %w", err)
273		}
274		if source != plan.Source {
275			return fmt.Errorf("graduation source changed after planning: %s became %s", plan.Source, source)
276		}
277		components := []string{plan.Name}
278		if plan.Category != "" {
279			components = []string{plan.Category, plan.Name}
280		}
281		destination, err := pathx.JoinChild(s.projectRoot, components...)
282		if err != nil {
283			return fmt.Errorf("revalidate graduation destination: %w", err)
284		}
285		if destination != plan.Destination {
286			return fmt.Errorf("graduation destination changed after planning: %s became %s", plan.Destination, destination)
287		}
288		if err := rejectExisting(destination); err != nil {
289			return err
290		}
291		if nested, nestedErr := pathx.IsChild(source, destination); nestedErr != nil {
292			return fmt.Errorf("revalidate graduation destination: %w", nestedErr)
293		} else if nested {
294			return fmt.Errorf("graduation destination %s is inside its source %s", destination, source)
295		}
296		return nil
297	}
298	
299	func storedLocationMatches(location catalog.Location, source string) bool {
300		return filepath.Clean(location.CurrentPath) == source || filepath.Clean(location.RealPath) == source
301	}
302	
303	func (s *Service) resolveGraduateItem(ctx context.Context, request GraduateRequest) (Item, []Diagnostic, error) {
304		if strings.TrimSpace(request.Ref) != "" {
305			return s.Resolve(ctx, request.Ref)
306		}
307		current := request.CurrentDir
308		if current == "" {
309			var err error
310			current, err = s.getwd()
311			if err != nil {
312				return Item{}, nil, fmt.Errorf("get current directory: %w", err)
313			}
314		}
315		canonicalCurrent, err := pathx.CanonicalChild(s.triesRoot, current)
316		if err != nil {
317			return Item{}, nil, fmt.Errorf("%s is not inside %s — name the try to graduate", current, s.triesRoot)
318		}
319		canonicalRoot, err := pathx.Canonical(s.triesRoot)
320		if err != nil {
321			return Item{}, nil, err
322		}
323		relative, err := filepath.Rel(canonicalRoot, canonicalCurrent)
324		if err != nil {
325			return Item{}, nil, err
326		}
327		first, _, _ := strings.Cut(relative, string(filepath.Separator))
328		if first == "" || first == "." || strings.HasPrefix(first, ".") {
329			return Item{}, nil, fmt.Errorf("%s is not inside a visible try under %s", current, s.triesRoot)
330		}
331		return s.Resolve(ctx, filepath.Join(s.triesRoot, first))
332	}
333	
334	func (s *Service) hasCommit(ctx context.Context, directory string) bool {
335		if unix, _, err := s.gitLastCommit(ctx, directory); err == nil && unix > 0 {
336			return true
337		}
338		_, err := s.gitRun(ctx, directory, "rev-parse", "--verify", "HEAD")
339		return err == nil
340	}
341	
342	func (s *Service) ensureInitialCommit(ctx context.Context, directory, name string) (bool, error) {
343		if s.hasCommit(ctx, directory) {
344			return false, nil
345		}
346		empty, err := isEmptyWorkTree(directory)
347		if err != nil {
348			return false, err
349		}
350		if empty {
351			readme := filepath.Join(directory, "README.md")
352			file, err := os.OpenFile(readme, os.O_WRONLY|os.O_CREATE|os.O_EXCL, 0o644)
353			if err != nil {
354				return false, err
355			}
356			if _, err := fmt.Fprintf(file, "# %s\n", name); err != nil {
357				_ = file.Close()
358				return false, err
359			}
360			if err := file.Close(); err != nil {
361				return false, err
362			}
363		}
364		if _, err := s.gitRun(ctx, directory, "add", "--all"); err != nil {
365			return false, err
366		}
367		if _, err := s.gitRun(ctx, directory, "commit", "-m", "chore: graduate experiment into a project"); err != nil {
368			return false, err
369		}
370		return true, nil
371	}
372	
373	func (s *Service) rollbackGraduation(result GraduateResult, cause error) (GraduateResult, error) {
374		rollbackErr := rejectExisting(result.Plan.Source)
375		if rollbackErr == nil {
376			rollbackErr = s.rename(result.Plan.Destination, result.Plan.Source)
377		}
378		result.RollbackError = rollbackErr
379		result.RolledBack = rollbackErr == nil
380		if rollbackErr == nil {
381			result.Moved = false
382		}
383		return result, &FinalizeError{
384			Source: result.Plan.Source, Destination: result.Plan.Destination,
385			Cause: cause, RollbackErr: rollbackErr,
386		}
387	}
388	
389	func rejectExisting(path string) error {
390		if _, err := os.Lstat(path); err == nil {
391			return fmt.Errorf("%s already exists", path)
392		} else if !errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
393			return fmt.Errorf("inspect graduation destination %s: %w", path, err)
394		}
395		return nil
396	}
397	
398	func isEmptyWorkTree(directory string) (bool, error) {
399		entries, err := os.ReadDir(directory)
400		if err != nil {
401			return false, err
402		}
403		for _, entry := range entries {
404			if entry.Name() != ".git" {
405				return false, nil
406			}
407		}
408		return true, nil
409	}
410

412		sourceAncestor, err := nearestExisting(source)

414			return false, err
415		}
416		destinationAncestor, err := nearestExisting(destination)
417		if err != nil {
418			return false, err
419		}
420		sourceInfo, err := os.Stat(sourceAncestor)

410	// RefreshOrigin re-probes origin after an explicit external remote-creation
411	// step and persists its raw URL and normalized identity on the same catalog ID.
412	func (s *Service) RefreshOrigin(ctx context.Context, id string) (Item, error) {
413		entry, err := s.registry.Get(id)
414		if err != nil {
415			return Item{}, fmt.Errorf("load experiment %s for origin refresh: %w", id, err)
416		}
417		if entry.Experiment == nil ||
418			(entry.Kind != catalog.KindTry && !(entry.Kind == catalog.KindRepository && entry.Experiment.Phase == catalog.PhaseGraduated)) {
419			return Item{}, &NotFoundError{Ref: id, Root: s.triesRoot}
420		}
421		location, ok := entry.LocationFor(s.host)
422		if !ok || location.State != catalog.LocationPresent || location.CurrentPath == "" {
423			return Item{}, &NotFoundError{Ref: id, Root: s.triesRoot}
424		}
425		probe := s.probeDirectory(ctx, location.CurrentPath)
426		if !probe.valid || probe.live.Repo == nil || probe.live.DiscoverError != nil {
427			if probe.diagnostic != nil {
428				return Item{}, fmt.Errorf("refresh experiment origin: %w", probe.diagnostic.Err)
429			}
430			return Item{}, errors.New("refresh experiment origin: path is not a discoverable Git repository")
431		}
432		if probe.originURL == "" {
433			return Item{}, errors.New("refresh experiment origin: Git origin is not configured")
434		}
435		updated, err := s.catalogUpdate(id, func(current *catalog.Entry) error {
436			currentLocation, found := current.LocationFor(s.host)
437			if !found || currentLocation.State != catalog.LocationPresent ||
438				!samePath(currentLocation.CurrentPath, probe.live.CurrentPath) {
439				return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s moved or was reassigned before origin refresh", id)
440			}
441			if current.Experiment == nil {
442				return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s no longer has experiment provenance", id)
443			}
444			current.Experiment.OriginURL = probe.originURL
445			current.RemoteIdentity = catalog.NormalizeRemoteIdentity(probe.originURL)
446			return current.SetLocation(s.host, locationFromProbe(probe, currentLocation))
447		})
448		if err != nil {
449			return Item{}, fmt.Errorf("refresh experiment origin: %w", err)
450		}
451		item := itemFromEntry(updated, probe.live)
452		enriched := s.enrich(ctx, []Item{item})
453		if len(enriched) == 1 {
454			item = enriched[0]
455		}
456		return item, nil
457	}

459	// Touch updates LastOpened only after a caller has successfully handed off the
460	// selected OpenTarget.
461	func (s *Service) Touch(_ context.Context, id string) (TouchResult, error) {
462		if id == "" {
463			return TouchResult{}, &NotFoundError{Ref: id, Root: s.triesRoot}
464		}
465		now := s.now()
466		updated, err := s.catalogUpdate(id, func(entry *catalog.Entry) error {
467			if entry.Experiment == nil ||
468				(entry.Kind != catalog.KindTry && !(entry.Kind == catalog.KindRepository && entry.Experiment.Phase == catalog.PhaseGraduated)) {
469				return &NotFoundError{Ref: id, Root: s.triesRoot}
470			}
471			location, ok := entry.LocationFor(s.host)
472			if !ok || location.State != catalog.LocationPresent {
473				return &NotFoundError{Ref: id, Root: s.triesRoot}
474			}
475			entry.LastOpened = now
476			return nil
477		})
478		if err != nil {
479			if errors.Is(err, catalog.ErrNotFound) {
480				return TouchResult{}, &NotFoundError{Ref: id, Root: s.triesRoot}
481			}
482			return TouchResult{}, fmt.Errorf("touch try %s: %w", id, err)
483		}
484		location, _ := updated.LocationFor(s.host)
485		item := itemFromEntry(updated, LiveFacts{
486			Present:     location.State == catalog.LocationPresent,
487			CurrentPath: location.CurrentPath, RealPath: location.RealPath,
488		})
489		return TouchResult{Item: item, TouchedAt: now}, nil

903	func sortItemsByName(items []Item) {
904		sort.SliceStable(items, func(i, j int) bool {
905			left, right := strings.ToLower(items[i].DisplayName()), strings.ToLower(items[j].DisplayName())
906			if left != right {
907				return left < right
908			}
909			if items[i].DisplayName() != items[j].DisplayName() {
910				return items[i].DisplayName() < items[j].DisplayName()
911			}

916	func sortItemsByActivity(items []Item) {

919			if !left.Equal(right) {
920				if left.IsZero() {
921					return false
922				}
923				if right.IsZero() {
924					return true
925				}
926				return left.After(right)
927			}
928			leftName, rightName := strings.ToLower(items[i].DisplayName()), strings.ToLower(items[j].DisplayName())
929			if leftName != rightName {
930				return leftName < rightName
931			}
932			return items[i].ID < items[j].ID
933		})
934	}

945	func deduplicateItems(items []Item) []Item {
946		seenIDs := make(map[string]struct{}, len(items))
947		seenPaths := make(map[string]struct{}, len(items))
948		out := items[:0]
949		for _, item := range items {
950			if item.ID != "" {
951				if _, ok := seenIDs[item.ID]; ok {
952					continue
953				}
954				seenIDs[item.ID] = struct{}{}
955			} else if item.Live.CurrentPath != "" {

958				}

961			out = append(out, item)
962		}

964	}

966	func deduplicateDiagnostics(diagnostics []Diagnostic) []Diagnostic {
967		seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(diagnostics))
968		out := diagnostics[:0]
969		for _, diagnostic := range diagnostics {
970			key := diagnostic.Path + "\x00" + diagnostic.Operation + "\x00" + fmt.Sprint(diagnostic.Err)
971			if _, ok := seen[key]; ok {
972				continue
973			}
974			seen[key] = struct{}{}
975			out = append(out, diagnostic)
976		}
977		return out
978	}

980	func boundedMap[Input, Output any](ctx context.Context, limit int, input []Input, work func(context.Context, Input) Output) []Output {
981		if len(input) == 0 {
982			return nil
983		}
984		if limit <= 0 || limit > len(input) {
985			limit = len(input)
986		}
987		type job struct {
988			index int
989			value Input
990		}
991		type result struct {
992			index int
993			value Output
994		}
995		jobs := make(chan job, len(input))
996		results := make(chan result, len(input))
997		for index, value := range input {
998			jobs <- job{index: index, value: value}
999		}
1000		close(jobs)
1001	
1002		var workers sync.WaitGroup
1003		workers.Add(limit)
1004		for range limit {
1005			go func() {
1006				defer workers.Done()
1007				for next := range jobs {
1008					results <- result{index: next.index, value: work(ctx, next.value)}
1009				}
1010			}()
1011		}
1012		workers.Wait()
1013		close(results)
1014	
1015		out := make([]Output, len(input))
1016		for result := range results {
1017			out[result.index] = result.value
1018		}
1019		return out
1020	}
1021

`high effort → Agent tool unavailable → single-pass inline → ≤10 findings`

You are reviewing for **recall** at high effort: catch every real bug a careful
reviewer would catch in one sitting. At this level, catching real bugs matters
more than avoiding false positives. Err on the side of surfacing.

The Agent tool isn't available in this context, so the usual
multi-agent fan-out and subagent verify pass can't run. Work through every
angle below yourself, in this same context, in one pass — do not skip angles
for lack of fan-out. Re-check each candidate against the diff before keeping
it; drop anything you can't back up with a concrete failure scenario.

## Phase 0 — Gather the diff

Run `git diff @{upstream}...HEAD` (or `git diff main...HEAD` / `git diff HEAD~1`
if there's no upstream) to get the unified diff under review. If there are
uncommitted changes, or the range diff is empty, also run `git diff HEAD` and
include the working-tree changes in scope — the review often runs before the
commit. If a PR number, branch name, or file path was passed as an argument,
review that target instead. Treat this diff as the review scope.
## Phase 1 — Find candidates (8 angles, single pass)

Work through **8 angles** yourself, in sequence, in this same
context — do not spawn subagents. Each surfaces candidate findings with
`file`, `line`, a one-line `summary`, and a concrete `failure_scenario`.

### Angle A — line-by-line diff scan

Read every hunk in the diff, line by line. Then Read the enclosing function for
each hunk — bugs in unchanged lines of a touched function are in scope (the PR
re-exposes or fails to fix them). For every line ask: what input, state, timing,
or platform makes this line wrong? Look for inverted/wrong conditions,
off-by-one, null/undefined deref, missing `await`, falsy-zero checks,
wrong-variable copy-paste, error swallowed in catch, unescaped regex metachars.

### Angle B — removed-behavior auditor

For every line the diff DELETES or replaces, name the invariant or behavior it
enforced, then search the new code for where that invariant is re-established.
If you can't find it, that's a candidate: a removed guard, a dropped error
path, a narrowed validation, a deleted test that was covering a real case.

### Angle C — cross-file tracer

For each function the diff changes, find its callers (Grep for the symbol) and
check whether the change breaks any call site: a new precondition, a changed
return shape, a new exception, a timing/ordering dependency. Also check callees:
does a parallel change in the same PR make a call unsafe?

### Reuse

The angles above hunt for bugs; this one and the next two hunt for cleanup in
the changed code. Flag new code that re-implements something the codebase
already has — Grep shared/utility modules and files adjacent to the change,
and name the existing helper to call instead.

### Simplification

Flag unnecessary complexity the diff adds: redundant or derivable state,
copy-paste with slight variation, deep nesting, dead code left behind. Name
the simpler form that does the same job.

### Efficiency

Flag wasted work the diff introduces: redundant computation or repeated I/O,
independent operations run sequentially, blocking work added to startup or
hot paths. Also flag long-lived objects built from closures or captured
environments — they keep the entire enclosing scope alive for the object's
lifetime (a memory leak when that scope holds large values); prefer a
class/struct that copies only the fields it needs. Name the cheaper
alternative.

### Altitude

Check that each change is implemented at the right depth, not as a fragile
bandaid. Special cases layered on shared infrastructure are a sign the fix
isn't deep enough — prefer generalizing the underlying mechanism over adding
special cases.

### Conventions (CLAUDE.md)

Find the CLAUDE.md files that govern the changed code: the user-level
~/.claude/CLAUDE.md, the repo-root CLAUDE.md, plus any CLAUDE.md or
CLAUDE.local.md in a directory that is an ancestor of a changed file (a
directory's CLAUDE.md only applies to files at or below it). Read each one
that exists, then check the diff for clear violations of the rules they state.

Only flag a violation when you can quote the exact rule and the exact line
that breaks it — no style preferences, no vague "spirit of the doc"
inferences. In the finding, name the CLAUDE.md path and quote the rule so the
report can cite it. If no CLAUDE.md applies, return nothing for this angle.

Cleanup, altitude, and conventions candidates use the same
`file`/`line`/`summary` shape; in `failure_scenario`, state the concrete
cost (what is duplicated, wasted, harder to maintain, or which CLAUDE.md rule
is broken) instead of a crash. Correctness bugs always outrank cleanup,
altitude, and conventions findings when the output cap forces a cut.

## Phase 2 — Dedup and self-check (no subagent verify)

Dedup near-duplicates (same defect, same location, same reason → keep one).
Re-check each remaining candidate yourself against the diff before keeping it.

## Output

Return findings as a JSON array of at most 10 objects:

```json
[
  {
    "file": "path/to/file.ext",
    "line": 123,
    "summary": "one-sentence statement of the bug",
    "failure_scenario": "concrete inputs/state → wrong output/crash"
  }
]
```

Ranked most-severe first. If more than 10 survive, keep the 10 most
severe. If nothing survives verification, return `[]`. Do not call the
ReportFindings tool even if it is available - this review's
output contract is the JSON block above.

State clearly in your summary that this was a single-pass review done without
the Agent tool, not the full multi-agent fan-out, so whoever reads
it isn't misled about what actually ran.


## Applying fixes (--fix)

The `--fix` flag was passed. After producing the findings list, apply the
findings to the working tree instead of stopping at the report: fix each one
directly — correctness bugs and reuse/simplification/efficiency cleanups alike.
Skip any finding whose fix would change intended behavior, require changes well
outside the reviewed diff, or that you judge to be a false positive — note the
skip rather than arguing with it. Finish with a brief summary of what was fixed
and what was skipped.
