+func TestTryArchiveRemainsAPositionalName(t *testing.T) {
+	h := newHarness(t)
+	out := h.mustRun("try", "archive", "--no-git")
+	if !strings.Contains(out, "archive") {
+		t.Fatalf("try archive output: %q", out)
+	}
+	triesRoot := filepath.Join(h.home, "tries")
+	entries, err := os.ReadDir(triesRoot)
+	if err != nil || len(entries) != 1 {
+		t.Fatalf("try archive entries = %d, %v", len(entries), err)
+	}
+	path := filepath.Join(triesRoot, entries[0].Name())
+	if !strings.HasSuffix(entries[0].Name(), "-archive") {
+		t.Errorf("archive was not treated as a positional name: %q", entries[0].Name())
+	}
+	if _, err := os.Stat(filepath.Join(path, ".git")); !os.IsNotExist(err) {
+		t.Errorf("--no-git created Git metadata: %v", err)
+	}
+
+	// A second positional invocation selects the same Try rather than becoming a
+	// future management subcommand or creating a duplicate.
+	h.mustRun("try", "archive", "--no-git")
+	entries, err = os.ReadDir(triesRoot)
+	if err != nil || len(entries) != 1 {
+		t.Errorf("second try archive entries = %d, %v", len(entries), err)
+	}
+}
+

+	h := newHarness(t)

+	_, _, err := h.run("try", "cache")
+	if err == nil || !strings.Contains(err.Error(), "ambiguous") ||
+		!strings.Contains(err.Error(), "cache-alpha") || !strings.Contains(err.Error(), "cache-beta") {
+		t.Errorf("ambiguous try error = %v", err)
+	}
+	entries, readErr := os.ReadDir(triesRoot)
+	if readErr != nil || len(entries) != 2 {
+		t.Errorf("ambiguous selection created a duplicate: %d, %v", len(entries), readErr)
+	}
+}
+

+func TestGraduateRemoteRefreshesCatalogOrigin(t *testing.T) {

+	binDir := t.TempDir()
+	gh := filepath.Join(binDir, "gh")
+	script := `#!/bin/sh
+set -eu
+if [ "$1" != "repo" ] || [ "$2" != "create" ]; then
+  exit 2
+fi
+git remote add origin "git@github.com:owner/$3.git"
+printf 'https://github.com/owner/%s\n' "$3"
+`
+	if err := os.WriteFile(gh, []byte(script), 0o755); err != nil {

+	}
+	t.Setenv("PATH", binDir+string(os.PathListSeparator)+os.Getenv("PATH"))
+	out := h.mustRun("graduate", "remote-origin", "--remote", "--push=false")

+		t.Errorf("graduated catalog did not retain remote origin:\n%s", body)
+	}
+}

+func TestAppLoadInitializesCatalog(t *testing.T) {
+	dataHome := t.TempDir()
+	t.Setenv("XDG_DATA_HOME", dataHome)
+	var diagnostics bytes.Buffer
+	app := &App{
+		Out:        io.Discard,
+		Err:        &diagnostics,
+		configPath: filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "missing.toml"),
+	}
+	if err := app.Load(); err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	if app.Tasks == nil || app.Catalog == nil || app.Registry == nil {
+		t.Fatalf("stores were not initialized: %+v", app)
+	}
+	if got, want := app.Catalog.Dir, filepath.Join(dataHome, "dev", "assets"); got != want {
+		t.Errorf("catalog dir = %q, want %q", got, want)
+	}
+	if app.Registry.Store() != app.Catalog {
+		t.Error("registry should use App's catalog store")
+	}
+
+	if err := os.MkdirAll(app.Catalog.Dir, 0o755); err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(app.Catalog.Dir, "broken.toml"), []byte("not = = toml"), 0o644); err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	if _, err := app.Catalog.List(); err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	if !strings.Contains(diagnostics.String(), "dev: warning: skipping broken.toml") {
+		t.Errorf("catalog diagnostics did not use App.Err: %q", diagnostics.String())
+	}
+}

+func TestPosixShellWrapperEvaluatesTrailingCDDirective(t *testing.T) {
+	bash, err := exec.LookPath("bash")
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Skipf("bash unavailable: %v", err)
+	}
+	target := t.TempDir()
+	fake := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "fake-dev")
+	directive := "cd " + shellQuote(target)
+	body := "#!/bin/sh\nprintf '%s\\n' opened " + shellQuote(directive) + "\n"
+	if err := os.WriteFile(fake, []byte(body), 0o755); err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	wrapper := fmt.Sprintf(posixInit, shellQuote(fake), "bash")
+	script := wrapper + "\ncd /\ndev try\nprintf 'PWD=%s\\n' \"$PWD\"\n"
+	command := exec.Command(bash, "-c", script)
+	output, err := command.CombinedOutput()
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatalf("run generated shell wrapper: %v\n%s", err, output)
+	}
+	want := "opened\nPWD=" + target + "\n"
+	if string(output) != want {
+		t.Errorf("wrapper output = %q, want %q", output, want)
+	}
+}

119		Method         string    `toml:"method" json:"method"`
120		SourcePath     string    `toml:"source_path" json:"source_path"`
121		RestorePath    string    `toml:"restore_path" json:"restore_path"`
122		RemoteIdentity string    `toml:"remote_identity" json:"remote_identity"`
123		RemoteName     string    `toml:"remote_name" json:"remote_name"`
124		RemoteURL      string    `toml:"remote_url" json:"remote_url"`
125		Revision       string    `toml:"revision" json:"revision"`
126		RefsDigest     string    `toml:"refs_digest" json:"refs_digest"`
127		ArchivePath    string    `toml:"archive_path" json:"archive_path"`
128		Checksum       string    `toml:"checksum" json:"checksum"`
129		Created        time.Time `toml:"created" json:"created"`
130		Verified       time.Time `toml:"verified" json:"verified"`
131	}
132	
133	// MoveIntent is written before a filesystem rename and cleared after the new
134	// location is durable. A surviving intent lets later commands reconcile a move
135	// interrupted between those two points.
136	type MoveIntent struct {
137		Host            string    `toml:"host" json:"host"`
138		Operation       string    `toml:"operation" json:"operation"`
139		SourcePath      string    `toml:"source_path" json:"source_path"`
140		DestinationPath string    `toml:"destination_path" json:"destination_path"`
141		Started         time.Time `toml:"started" json:"started"`
142	}
143	
144	// Entry is one logical asset. ID is the stable filename stem and is deliberately
145	// not duplicated inside the TOML document.
146	type Entry struct {
147		SchemaVersion int      `toml:"schema_version" json:"schema_version"`
148		ID            string   `toml:"-" json:"id"`
149		Kind          Kind     `toml:"kind" json:"kind"`
150		Name          string   `toml:"name" json:"name"`
151		Note          string   `toml:"note" json:"note"`
152		Tags          []string `toml:"tags" json:"tags"`
153	
154		// RemoteIdentity is a relocation hint, never sufficient on its own when
155		// several records or live clones could be the observation's owner.
156		RemoteIdentity string `toml:"remote_identity" json:"remote_identity"`
157	
158		Experiment      *Experiment         `toml:"experiment,omitempty" json:"experiment,omitempty"`
159		Locations       map[string]Location `toml:"locations" json:"locations"`
160		RecoveryReceipt *RecoveryReceipt    `toml:"recovery_receipt,omitempty" json:"recovery_receipt,omitempty"`
161		MoveIntent      *MoveIntent         `toml:"move_intent,omitempty" json:"move_intent,omitempty"`
162	
163		Created    time.Time `toml:"created" json:"created"`
164		Discovered time.Time `toml:"discovered" json:"discovered"`
165		LastOpened time.Time `toml:"last_opened" json:"last_opened"`
166		Updated    time.Time `toml:"updated" json:"updated"`
167	}
168	
169	var validID = regexp.MustCompile(`^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]*$`)
170	
171	// ValidateID checks that id can be used as exactly one visible filename stem.
172	func ValidateID(id string) error {
173		if !validID.MatchString(id) || filepath.Base(id) != id || id == "." || id == ".." {
174			return fmt.Errorf("%q: %w", id, ErrInvalidID)
175		}
176		return nil
177	}
178	
179	// NormalizeTags trims, lowercases, deduplicates and sorts tags. Sorting makes
180	// persisted output deterministic regardless of the order in which callers add
181	// labels.
182	func NormalizeTags(tags []string) []string {
183		seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(tags))
184		for _, tag := range tags {
185			tag = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(tag))
186			if tag != "" {
187				seen[tag] = struct{}{}
188			}
189		}
190		out := make([]string, 0, len(seen))
191		for tag := range seen {
192			out = append(out, tag)
193		}
194		sort.Strings(out)
195		return out
196	}
197	
198	// Normalize applies the lossless normalizations stores use before validation.
199	func (e *Entry) Normalize() {
200		if e == nil {
201			return
202		}
203		e.Name = strings.TrimSpace(e.Name)
204		e.Tags = NormalizeTags(e.Tags)
205		e.RemoteIdentity = NormalizeRemoteIdentity(e.RemoteIdentity)
206		if e.RecoveryReceipt != nil {
207			e.RecoveryReceipt.RemoteIdentity = NormalizeRemoteIdentity(e.RecoveryReceipt.RemoteIdentity)
208		}
209	}
210	
211	// Title is the human label, falling back to the stable ID for damaged display
212	// data. Persisted entries still require a name during validation.
213	func (e Entry) Title() string {
214		if e.Name != "" {
215			return e.Name
216		}
217		return e.ID
218	}
219	
220	// HasTag reports membership after applying the same normalization as storage.
221	func (e Entry) HasTag(tag string) bool {
222		tag = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(tag))
223		return tag != "" && slices.Contains(e.Tags, tag)
224	}
225	
226	// LocationFor returns host's location without exposing the map for mutation.
227	func (e Entry) LocationFor(host string) (Location, bool) {
228		location, ok := e.Locations[host]
229		return location, ok
230	}
231	
232	// SetLocation validates and records one host location.
233	func (e *Entry) SetLocation(host string, location Location) error {
234		if e == nil {
235			return errors.New("set location on nil catalog entry")
236		}
237		if err := validateLocationForSet(host, location); err != nil {
238			return err
239		}
240		if e.Locations == nil {
241			e.Locations = make(map[string]Location)
242		}
243		e.Locations[host] = location
244		return nil
245	}
246	
247	// Clone returns a deep copy suitable for mutation before an atomic update.
248	func (e Entry) Clone() *Entry {
249		clone := e
250		clone.Tags = append([]string(nil), e.Tags...)
251		if e.Experiment != nil {
252			value := *e.Experiment
253			clone.Experiment = &value
254		}
255		if e.RecoveryReceipt != nil {
256			value := *e.RecoveryReceipt
257			clone.RecoveryReceipt = &value
258		}
259		if e.MoveIntent != nil {
260			value := *e.MoveIntent
261			clone.MoveIntent = &value
262		}
263		if e.Locations != nil {
264			clone.Locations = make(map[string]Location, len(e.Locations))
265			for host, location := range e.Locations {
266				clone.Locations[host] = location
267			}
268		}
269		return &clone
270	}
271	
272	// Validate rejects records that later lifecycle operations could not interpret
273	// safely. Store.Create fills identity and timestamps before calling it.
274	func (e Entry) Validate() error {
275		if e.SchemaVersion != CurrentSchemaVersion {
276			return &UnsupportedSchemaError{ID: e.ID, Version: e.SchemaVersion}
277		}
278		if err := ValidateID(e.ID); err != nil {
279			return err
280		}
281		switch e.Kind {
282		case KindTry:
283			if e.Experiment == nil {
284				return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s: try kind requires experiment metadata", e.ID)
285			}
286		case KindRepository:
287		default:
288			return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s: unknown kind %q", e.ID, e.Kind)
289		}
290		if strings.TrimSpace(e.Name) == "" {
291			return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s: name is required", e.ID)
292		}
293		if !slices.Equal(e.Tags, NormalizeTags(e.Tags)) {
294			return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s: tags must be normalized lowercase values", e.ID)
295		}
296		if e.Experiment != nil {
297			switch e.Experiment.Phase {
298			case PhaseActive, PhaseDeprecated, PhaseGraduated:
299			default:
300				return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s: unknown experiment phase %q", e.ID, e.Experiment.Phase)
301			}
302			switch {
303			case e.Kind == KindTry && e.Experiment.Phase == PhaseGraduated:
304				return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s: graduated experiment must be a repository", e.ID)
305			case e.Kind == KindRepository && e.Experiment.Phase != PhaseGraduated:
306				return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s: repository experiment history must be graduated", e.ID)
307			}
308			if e.Experiment.Started.IsZero() {
309				return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s: experiment started timestamp is required", e.ID)
310			}
311			if e.Experiment.Slug == "" {
312				return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s: experiment slug is required", e.ID)
313			}
314			if err := pathx.ValidateComponent(e.Experiment.Slug); err != nil {
315				return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s: experiment slug: %w", e.ID, err)
316			}
317			if e.Experiment.OriginalPath == "" {
318				return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s: experiment original path is required", e.ID)
319			}
320			switch e.Experiment.Phase {
321			case PhaseDeprecated:
322				if e.Experiment.DeprecatedAt.IsZero() || e.Experiment.DeprecatedPath == "" {
323					return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s: deprecated experiment requires timestamp and path", e.ID)
324				}
325			case PhaseGraduated:
326				if e.Experiment.GraduatedAt.IsZero() || e.Experiment.GraduatedPath == "" {
327					return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s: graduated experiment requires timestamp and path", e.ID)
328				}
329			}
330			if err := validateStringFields("experiment", []struct {
331				name  string
332				value string
333			}{
334				{"slug", e.Experiment.Slug},
335				{"origin_url", e.Experiment.OriginURL},
336				{"original_path", e.Experiment.OriginalPath},
337				{"deprecated_path", e.Experiment.DeprecatedPath},
338				{"graduated_path", e.Experiment.GraduatedPath},
339			}); err != nil {
340				return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s: %w", e.ID, err)
341			}
342		}
343		hosts := make([]string, 0, len(e.Locations))
344		for host := range e.Locations {
345			hosts = append(hosts, host)
346		}
347		sort.Strings(hosts)
348		for _, host := range hosts {
349			if err := validateLocation(host, e.Locations[host]); err != nil {
350				return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s: %w", e.ID, err)
351			}
352		}
353		if e.RecoveryReceipt != nil {
354			if err := validateRecoveryReceipt(*e.RecoveryReceipt); err != nil {
355				return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s: %w", e.ID, err)
356			}
357		}
358		if e.MoveIntent != nil {
359			if err := validateMoveIntent(*e.MoveIntent); err != nil {
360				return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s: %w", e.ID, err)
361			}
362		}
363		if e.Created.IsZero() || e.Discovered.IsZero() || e.Updated.IsZero() {
364			return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s: created, discovered and updated timestamps are required", e.ID)
365		}
366		return nil
367	}
368	
369	func validateLocation(host string, location Location) error {
370		return validateLocationValue(host, location, true)
371	}
372	
373	func validateLocationForSet(host string, location Location) error {
374		return validateLocationValue(host, location, false)
375	}
376	
377	func validateLocationValue(host string, location Location, requireUpdated bool) error {
378		if err := validateHostValue("location host", host); err != nil {
379			return err
380		}
381		fields := []struct {
382			name  string
383			value string
384		}{
385			{"current_path", location.CurrentPath},
386			{"restore_path", location.RestorePath},
387			{"real_path", location.RealPath},
388			{"git_common_dir", location.GitCommonDir},
389		}
390		for _, field := range fields {
391			if strings.ContainsRune(field.value, '\x00') {
392				return fmt.Errorf("location %s %s contains NUL", host, field.name)
393			}
394		}
395		if requireUpdated && location.Updated.IsZero() {
396			return fmt.Errorf("location %s: updated timestamp is required", host)
397		}
398		switch location.State {
399		case LocationPresent:
400			if location.CurrentPath == "" {
401				return fmt.Errorf("location %s: present state requires current_path", host)
402			}
403		case LocationArchived:
404			if location.CurrentPath == "" || location.RestorePath == "" {
405				return fmt.Errorf("location %s: archived state requires current_path and restore_path", host)
406			}
407		case LocationEvicted:
408			if location.RestorePath == "" {
409				return fmt.Errorf("location %s: evicted state requires restore_path", host)
410			}
411		default:
412			return fmt.Errorf("location %s: unknown state %q", host, location.State)
413		}
414		return nil
415	}
416	
417	func validateRecoveryReceipt(receipt RecoveryReceipt) error {
418		if err := validateHostValue("recovery receipt host", receipt.Host); err != nil {
419			return err
420		}
421		if receipt.Method == "" || receipt.Method != strings.TrimSpace(receipt.Method) {
422			return errors.New("recovery receipt method is required and must be normalized")
423		}
424		if receipt.Created.IsZero() || receipt.Verified.IsZero() {
425			return errors.New("recovery receipt requires created and verified timestamps")
426		}
427		fields := []struct {
428			name  string
429			value string
430		}{
431			{"method", receipt.Method},
432			{"source_path", receipt.SourcePath},
433			{"restore_path", receipt.RestorePath},
434			{"remote_identity", receipt.RemoteIdentity},
435			{"remote_name", receipt.RemoteName},
436			{"remote_url", receipt.RemoteURL},
437			{"revision", receipt.Revision},
438			{"refs_digest", receipt.RefsDigest},
439			{"archive_path", receipt.ArchivePath},
440			{"checksum", receipt.Checksum},
441		}
442		return validateStringFields("recovery receipt", fields)
443	}
444	
445	func validateMoveIntent(intent MoveIntent) error {
446		if err := validateHostValue("move intent host", intent.Host); err != nil {
447			return err
448		}
449		if intent.Operation == "" || intent.Operation != strings.TrimSpace(intent.Operation) {
450			return errors.New("move intent operation is required and must be normalized")
451		}
452		if intent.Started.IsZero() {
453			return errors.New("move intent started timestamp is required")
454		}
455		if intent.SourcePath == "" || intent.DestinationPath == "" {
456			return errors.New("move intent requires source and destination paths")
457		}
458		if err := validateStringFields("move intent", []struct {
459			name  string
460			value string
461		}{
462			{"operation", intent.Operation},
463			{"source_path", intent.SourcePath},
464			{"destination_path", intent.DestinationPath},
465		}); err != nil {
466			return err
467		}
468		if filepath.Clean(intent.SourcePath) == filepath.Clean(intent.DestinationPath) {
469			return errors.New("move intent source and destination are identical")
470		}
471		return nil
472	}
473	
474	func validateHostValue(name, host string) error {
475		if host == "" {
476			return fmt.Errorf("%s is required", name)
477		}
478		if host != strings.TrimSpace(host) || strings.ContainsRune(host, '\x00') {
479			return fmt.Errorf("%s %q is not normalized", name, host)
480		}
481		return nil
482	}
483	
484	func validateStringFields(scope string, fields []struct {
485		name  string
486		value string
487	}) error {
488		for _, field := range fields {
489			if strings.ContainsRune(field.value, '\x00') {
490				return fmt.Errorf("%s %s contains NUL", scope, field.name)
491			}
492		}
493		return nil
494	}

17	var (

22	// AmbiguousMatchError reports records that cannot be safely distinguished. A
23	// remote-only ambiguity is never resolved by picking the first entry.
24	type AmbiguousMatchError struct {
25		Observation  Observation
26		CandidateIDs []string
27		Reason       string
28	}
29	
30	func (e *AmbiguousMatchError) Error() string {
31		reason := e.Reason
32		if reason == "" {
33			reason = "multiple records match"
34		}
35		return fmt.Sprintf("%s: %s (%s)", ErrAmbiguous, reason, strings.Join(e.CandidateIDs, ", "))
36	}
37	
38	func (e *AmbiguousMatchError) Unwrap() error { return ErrAmbiguous }
39	
40	// Observation is live repository identity gathered from discovery. Path is the
41	// navigation path, RealPath its physical target, and either common-dir field may
42	// carry Git's shared administrative directory. CommonDir matches repo.Repo;
43	// GitCommonDir is accepted for callers using gitx.Repo terminology.
44	type Observation struct {
45		Host           string
46		Path           string
47		RealPath       string
48		CommonDir      string
49		GitCommonDir   string
50		Name           string
51		RemoteIdentity string
52	}

54	// Registry adds live matching and lazy repository persistence to a Store.
55	type Registry struct {
56		store *Store
57		mu    sync.Mutex
58	}
59	
60	// NewRegistry returns a registry backed by store.
61	func NewRegistry(store *Store) *Registry { return &Registry{store: store} }
62	
63	// Store exposes the durable store for callers that need lower-level APIs.
64	func (r *Registry) Store() *Store {
65		if r == nil {
66			return nil
67		}
68		return r.store
69	}
70	
71	// List returns every readable catalog entry and reports skipped records through
72	// the Store's configured diagnostic sink.
73	func (r *Registry) List() ([]*Entry, error) {
74		if r == nil || r.store == nil {
75			return nil, errors.New("catalog registry has no store")
76		}
77		return r.store.List()
78	}
79	
80	// Get loads one entry by stable catalog ID.
81	func (r *Registry) Get(id string) (*Entry, error) {
82		if r == nil || r.store == nil {
83			return nil, errors.New("catalog registry has no store")
84		}
85		return r.store.Get(id)

87	
88	// Update applies an atomic mutation to one entry.
89	func (r *Registry) Update(id string, mutate func(*Entry) error) (*Entry, error) {
90		if r == nil || r.store == nil {
91			return nil, errors.New("catalog registry has no store")
92		}
93		r.mu.Lock()
94		defer r.mu.Unlock()
95		return r.store.Update(id, mutate)
96	}
97	
98	// Match finds an observation without changing the catalog. Exact canonical path
99	// or common-directory identity on the same host always wins. A remote identity
100	// is considered only as a conservative relocation hint.
101	func (r *Registry) Match(observation Observation) (*Entry, error) {
102		normalized, err := normalizeObservation(observation, false)
103		if err != nil {
104			return nil, err
105		}
106		entry, _, err := r.match(normalized)
107		return entry, err
108	}
109	
110	// EnsureRepository returns the matching repository, attaching the observed host
111	// location when safe. If nothing matches—or a remote is ambiguous because it
112	// may describe another live clone—it creates a distinct repository record.
113	func (r *Registry) EnsureRepository(observation Observation) (*Entry, error) {
114		normalized, err := normalizeObservation(observation, true)
115		if err != nil {
116			return nil, err
117		}
118		if r == nil || r.store == nil {
119			return nil, errors.New("catalog registry has no store")
120		}
121	
122		r.mu.Lock()
123		defer r.mu.Unlock()
124	
125		matched, method, matchErr := r.match(normalized)
126		if matchErr == nil {
127			return r.attach(matched.ID, normalized)
128		}
129		if !errors.Is(matchErr, ErrNotFound) && !(errors.Is(matchErr, ErrAmbiguous) && method == matchRemote) {
130			return nil, matchErr
131		}
132	
133		entry := &Entry{
134			Kind:           KindRepository,
135			Name:           normalized.Name,
136			RemoteIdentity: normalized.RemoteIdentity,
137			Locations: map[string]Location{
138				normalized.Host: locationFromObservation(normalized),
139			},
140		}
141		if err := r.store.Create(entry); err != nil {
142			return nil, err
143		}
144		return entry.Clone(), nil
145	}
146	
147	// Patch applies an atomic catalog mutation.
148	func (r *Registry) Patch(id string, mutate func(*Entry) error) (*Entry, error) {
149		return r.Update(id, mutate)
150	}

152	// Attach explicitly records observation as id's present location. Explicit
153	// attachment may update a changed remote because the caller supplied the stable
154	// catalog identity rather than asking the remote hint to choose one.
155	func (r *Registry) Attach(id string, observation Observation) (*Entry, error) {
156		normalized, err := normalizeObservation(observation, true)
157		if err != nil {
158			return nil, err
159		}
160		if r == nil || r.store == nil {
161			return nil, errors.New("catalog registry has no store")
162		}
163		r.mu.Lock()
164		defer r.mu.Unlock()
165		return r.attach(id, normalized)
166	}

168	func (r *Registry) attach(id string, observation Observation) (*Entry, error) {
169		return r.store.Update(id, func(entry *Entry) error {
170			if observation.RemoteIdentity != "" {
171				entry.RemoteIdentity = observation.RemoteIdentity
172			}
173			location := locationFromObservation(observation)
174			if previous, ok := entry.LocationFor(observation.Host); ok && location.GitCommonDir == "" &&
175				intersects(canonicalValues(observation.Path, observation.RealPath),
176					canonicalValues(previous.CurrentPath, previous.RestorePath, previous.RealPath)) {
177				location.GitCommonDir = previous.GitCommonDir
178			}
179			return entry.SetLocation(observation.Host, location)
180		})
181	}
182	
183	// FindByPath performs only exact host+canonical-path matching; it never falls
184	// back to a remote identity.
185	func (r *Registry) FindByPath(host, path string) (*Entry, error) {
186		normalized, err := normalizeObservation(Observation{Host: host, Path: path}, false)
187		if err != nil {
188			return nil, err
189		}
190		entries, diagnostics, err := r.entriesWithDiagnostics()
191		if err != nil {
192			return nil, err
193		}
194		matches := exactMatches(entries, normalized)
195		if len(matches) == 0 && len(diagnostics) > 0 {
196			return nil, incompleteCatalogError(diagnostics)
197		}
198		if len(matches) > 0 {
199			r.store.reportDiagnostics(diagnostics)
200		}
201		return selectExact(normalized, matches)
202	}

204	// FindByCommonDir performs exact host+Git-common-directory matching.
205	func (r *Registry) FindByCommonDir(host, commonDir string) (*Entry, error) {
206		normalized, err := normalizeObservation(Observation{Host: host, CommonDir: commonDir}, false)
207		if err != nil {
208			return nil, err
209		}
210		entries, diagnostics, err := r.entriesWithDiagnostics()
211		if err != nil {
212			return nil, err
213		}
214		matches := exactMatches(entries, normalized)
215		if len(matches) == 0 && len(diagnostics) > 0 {
216			return nil, incompleteCatalogError(diagnostics)
217		}
218		if len(matches) > 0 {
219			r.store.reportDiagnostics(diagnostics)
220		}
221		return selectExact(normalized, matches)
222	}

224	type matchMethod int
225	
226	const (
227		matchNone matchMethod = iota
228		matchExact
229		matchRemote
230	)
231	
232	func (r *Registry) match(observation Observation) (*Entry, matchMethod, error) {
233		entries, diagnostics, err := r.entriesWithDiagnostics()
234		if err != nil {
235			return nil, matchNone, err
236		}
237		if matches := exactMatches(entries, observation); len(matches) > 0 {
238			r.store.reportDiagnostics(diagnostics)
239			entry, err := selectExact(observation, matches)
240			return entry, matchExact, err
241		}
242		if len(diagnostics) > 0 {
243			return nil, matchNone, incompleteCatalogError(diagnostics)
244		}
245		if observation.RemoteIdentity == "" {
246			return nil, matchNone, fmt.Errorf("catalog observation %q: %w", observation.Path, ErrNotFound)
247		}
248	
249		var remoteMatches []*Entry
250		for _, entry := range entries {
251			if NormalizeRemoteIdentity(entry.RemoteIdentity) == observation.RemoteIdentity {
252				remoteMatches = append(remoteMatches, entry)
253			}
254		}
255		Sort(remoteMatches)
256		switch len(remoteMatches) {
257		case 0:
258			return nil, matchNone, fmt.Errorf("remote %q: %w", observation.RemoteIdentity, ErrNotFound)
259		case 1:
260			if remoteCanRelocate(remoteMatches[0], observation) {
261				return remoteMatches[0], matchRemote, nil
262			}
263			return nil, matchRemote, ambiguous(observation, remoteMatches,
264				"remote also belongs to a different live clone on this host")
265		default:
266			return nil, matchRemote, ambiguous(observation, remoteMatches,
267				"remote identity matches multiple catalog records")
268		}
269	}
270	
271	func (r *Registry) entriesWithDiagnostics() ([]*Entry, []Diagnostic, error) {
272		if r == nil || r.store == nil {
273			return nil, nil, errors.New("catalog registry has no store")
274		}
275		return r.store.ListWithDiagnostics()
276	}
277	
278	func incompleteCatalogError(diagnostics []Diagnostic) error {
279		errorsToJoin := make([]error, 1, len(diagnostics)+1)
280		errorsToJoin[0] = ErrIncompleteCatalog
281		for _, diagnostic := range diagnostics {
282			errorsToJoin = append(errorsToJoin, diagnostic)
283		}
284		return errors.Join(errorsToJoin...)
285	}
286	
287	func exactMatches(entries []*Entry, observation Observation) []*Entry {
288		matched := make(map[string]*Entry)
289		observationPaths := canonicalValues(observation.Path, observation.RealPath)
290		observationCommon := canonicalValue(observation.CommonDir)
291		for _, entry := range entries {
292			location, ok := entry.LocationFor(observation.Host)
293			if !ok {
294				continue
295			}
296			locationPaths := canonicalValues(location.CurrentPath, location.RestorePath, location.RealPath)
297			pathMatch := intersects(observationPaths, locationPaths)
298			commonMatch := observationCommon != "" && observationCommon == canonicalValue(location.GitCommonDir)
299			if pathMatch || commonMatch {
300				matched[entry.ID] = entry
301			}
302		}
303		out := make([]*Entry, 0, len(matched))
304		for _, entry := range matched {
305			out = append(out, entry)
306		}
307		Sort(out)
308		return out
309	}
310	
311	func selectExact(observation Observation, matches []*Entry) (*Entry, error) {
312		switch len(matches) {
313		case 0:
314			return nil, fmt.Errorf("catalog path %q on host %q: %w", observation.Path, observation.Host, ErrNotFound)
315		case 1:
316			return matches[0], nil
317		default:
318			return nil, ambiguous(observation, matches, "canonical path or Git common directory matches multiple records")
319		}
320	}
321	
322	func ambiguous(observation Observation, entries []*Entry, reason string) error {
323		ids := make([]string, len(entries))
324		for i, entry := range entries {
325			ids[i] = entry.ID
326		}
327		sort.Strings(ids)
328		return &AmbiguousMatchError{Observation: observation, CandidateIDs: ids, Reason: reason}
329	}
330	
331	func remoteCanRelocate(entry *Entry, observation Observation) bool {
332		location, ok := entry.LocationFor(observation.Host)
333		if !ok {
334			return true
335		}
336		// Exact aliases, restore paths, and common directories were already handled.
337		// A navigation symlink may disappear while its physical clone or Git common
338		// directory remains, so every stored identity path must be absent before the
339		// remote can be treated as relocation evidence. Archives also deliberately
340		// block relocation while their bytes remain.
341		for _, path := range []string{
342			location.CurrentPath,
343			location.RestorePath,
344			location.RealPath,
345			location.GitCommonDir,
346		} {
347			if path == "" {
348				continue
349			}
350			if pathMayStillExist(path) {
351				return false
352			}
353		}
354		return true
355	}
356	
357	func pathMayStillExist(path string) bool {
358		if _, err := os.Lstat(path); err == nil || !errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
359			// Lstat deliberately counts a dangling symlink as existing evidence.
360			return true
361		}
362		canonical, err := pathx.Canonical(path)
363		if err != nil {
364			return true
365		}
366		_, err = os.Stat(canonical)
367		return err == nil || !errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist)
368	}
369	
370	func locationFromObservation(observation Observation) Location {
371		currentPath := observation.Path
372		if currentPath == "" {
373			currentPath = observation.RealPath
374		}
375		return Location{
376			State:        LocationPresent,
377			CurrentPath:  currentPath,
378			RealPath:     observation.RealPath,
379			GitCommonDir: observation.CommonDir,
380		}
381	}
382	
383	func normalizeObservation(observation Observation, requireLocation bool) (Observation, error) {
384		observation.Host = strings.TrimSpace(observation.Host)
385		observation.Name = strings.TrimSpace(observation.Name)
386		if observation.Host == "" {
387			return Observation{}, errors.New("catalog observation host is required")
388		}
389	
390		commonDir := observation.CommonDir
391		if commonDir == "" {
392			commonDir = observation.GitCommonDir
393		} else if observation.GitCommonDir != "" {
394			left, leftErr := pathx.Canonical(commonDir)
395			right, rightErr := pathx.Canonical(observation.GitCommonDir)
396			if leftErr != nil || rightErr != nil || left != right {
397				return Observation{}, errors.New("catalog observation CommonDir and GitCommonDir disagree")
398			}
399		}
400	
401		var err error
402		canonicalPath := ""
403		if observation.Path != "" {
404			observation.Path, err = absoluteClean(observation.Path)
405			if err != nil {
406				return Observation{}, fmt.Errorf("catalog observation path: %w", err)
407			}
408			canonicalPath, err = pathx.Canonical(observation.Path)
409			if err != nil {
410				return Observation{}, fmt.Errorf("catalog observation path: %w", err)
411			}
412		}
413		if observation.RealPath != "" {
414			observation.RealPath, err = pathx.Canonical(observation.RealPath)
415			if err != nil {
416				return Observation{}, fmt.Errorf("catalog observation real path: %w", err)
417			}
418			if canonicalPath != "" && canonicalPath != observation.RealPath {
419				return Observation{}, fmt.Errorf("catalog observation Path and RealPath disagree: %q != %q",
420					canonicalPath, observation.RealPath)
421			}
422		} else {
423			observation.RealPath = canonicalPath
424		}
425		if commonDir != "" {
426			observation.CommonDir, err = pathx.Canonical(commonDir)
427			if err != nil {
428				return Observation{}, fmt.Errorf("catalog observation Git common directory: %w", err)
429			}
430		}
431		observation.GitCommonDir = observation.CommonDir
432		observation.RemoteIdentity = NormalizeRemoteIdentity(observation.RemoteIdentity)
433	
434		if requireLocation && observation.Path == "" && observation.RealPath == "" {
435			return Observation{}, errors.New("catalog repository observation requires a path")
436		}
437		if requireLocation {
438			path := observation.Path
439			if path == "" {
440				path = observation.RealPath
441			}
442			info, statErr := os.Stat(path)
443			if statErr != nil {
444				return Observation{}, fmt.Errorf("catalog repository observation path %q: %w", path, statErr)
445			}
446			if !info.IsDir() {
447				return Observation{}, fmt.Errorf("catalog repository observation path %q is not a directory", path)
448			}
449			if observation.CommonDir != "" {
450				commonInfo, commonErr := os.Stat(observation.CommonDir)
451				if commonErr != nil {
452					return Observation{}, fmt.Errorf("catalog repository observation Git common directory %q: %w",
453						observation.CommonDir, commonErr)
454				}
455				if !commonInfo.IsDir() {
456					return Observation{}, fmt.Errorf("catalog repository observation Git common directory %q is not a directory",
457						observation.CommonDir)
458				}
459			}
460		}
461		if observation.Name == "" {
462			path := observation.Path
463			if path == "" {
464				path = observation.RealPath
465			}
466			if path != "" {
467				observation.Name = filepath.Base(path)
468			}
469		}
470		if requireLocation && (observation.Name == "" || observation.Name == ".") {
471			return Observation{}, errors.New("catalog repository observation requires a name")
472		}
473		return observation, nil
474	}
475	
476	func absoluteClean(path string) (string, error) {
477		absolute, err := filepath.Abs(path)
478		if err != nil {
479			return "", err
480		}
481		return filepath.Clean(absolute), nil
482	}
483	
484	func canonicalValues(values ...string) map[string]struct{} {
485		out := make(map[string]struct{}, len(values))
486		for _, value := range values {
487			if canonical := canonicalValue(value); canonical != "" {
488				out[canonical] = struct{}{}
489			}
490		}
491		return out
492	}
493	
494	func canonicalValue(value string) string {
495		if value == "" {
496			return ""
497		}
498		canonical, err := pathx.Canonical(value)
499		if err != nil {
500			return ""
501		}
502		return canonical
503	}
504	
505	func intersects(left, right map[string]struct{}) bool {
506		for value := range left {
507			if _, ok := right[value]; ok {
508				return true
509			}
510		}
511		return false
512	}
513	
514	// NormalizeRemoteIdentity converts common HTTPS and SCP-style Git URLs into a
515	// stable host/path key. Hosts are case-insensitive, but paths are preserved
516	// because arbitrary Git servers may use a case-sensitive repository namespace.
517	// The result remains only a hint for matching.
518	func NormalizeRemoteIdentity(identity string) string {
519		identity = strings.TrimSpace(identity)
520		if identity == "" {
521			return ""
522		}
523		if parsed, err := url.Parse(identity); err == nil && parsed.Scheme != "" {
524			if strings.EqualFold(parsed.Scheme, "file") {
525				return ""
526			}
527			if parsed.Host != "" {
528				return remoteIdentityKey(parsed.Host, parsed.EscapedPath())
529			}
530		}
531		if looksLikeLocalRemote(identity) {
532			return ""
533		}
534	
535		afterUser := identity
536		user := ""
537		if at := strings.LastIndexByte(afterUser, '@'); at >= 0 {
538			user, afterUser = afterUser[:at], afterUser[at+1:]
539		}
540		if host, remotePath, ok := splitSCPLike(afterUser); ok {
541			if user != "" && !strings.EqualFold(user, "git") && !strings.HasPrefix(remotePath, "/") {
542				remotePath = "~" + user + "/" + remotePath
543			}
544			return remoteIdentityKey(host, remotePath)
545		}
546	
547		identity = strings.Trim(identity, "/")
548		if host, remotePath, ok := strings.Cut(identity, "/"); ok {
549			return remoteIdentityKey(host, remotePath)
550		}
551		return ""
552	}
553	
554	func looksLikeLocalRemote(identity string) bool {
555		if filepath.IsAbs(identity) || strings.HasPrefix(identity, `\\`) {
556			return true
557		}
558		for _, prefix := range []string{"./", "../", "~/", `.\`, `..\`, `~\`} {
559			if strings.HasPrefix(identity, prefix) {
560				return true
561			}
562		}
563		if len(identity) >= 2 && identity[1] == ':' {
564			letter := identity[0]
565			if letter >= 'a' && letter <= 'z' || letter >= 'A' && letter <= 'Z' {
566				return true
567			}
568		}
569		return !strings.ContainsAny(identity, `/\:@`)
570	}
571	
572	func splitSCPLike(identity string) (string, string, bool) {
573		if strings.HasPrefix(identity, "[") {
574			if end := strings.Index(identity, "]:"); end >= 0 {
575				return identity[:end+1], identity[end+2:], true
576			}
577		}
578		colon := strings.IndexByte(identity, ':')
579		if colon <= 0 || strings.ContainsAny(identity[:colon], `/\\`) {
580			return "", "", false
581		}
582		return identity[:colon], identity[colon+1:], true
583	}
584	
585	func remoteIdentityKey(host, remotePath string) string {
586		host = strings.ToLower(strings.Trim(host, "/"))
587		remotePath = trimGitSuffix(strings.Trim(remotePath, "/"))
588		if host == "" || remotePath == "" {
589			return ""
590		}
591		return host + "/" + remotePath
592	}
593	
594	func trimGitSuffix(value string) string {
595		return strings.TrimSuffix(value, ".git")
596	}
597

26	// Diagnostic describes one record skipped by a directory listing. The listing

103	// Create assigns a random stable ID and atomically persists entry. The caller's
104	// value is updated only after the rename succeeds.
105	func (s *Store) Create(entry *Entry) error {
106		if entry == nil {
107			return errors.New("create nil catalog entry")
108		}
109		if entry.ID != "" {
110			return fmt.Errorf("create catalog asset: ID is assigned by the store")
111		}
112	
113		s.mu.Lock()
114		defer s.mu.Unlock()
115	
116		for range 32 {
117			candidate := entry.Clone()
118			candidate.ID = s.nextID()
119			if err := ValidateID(candidate.ID); err != nil {
120				return fmt.Errorf("generated catalog ID: %w", err)
121			}
122	
123			now := s.now()
124			candidate.SchemaVersion = CurrentSchemaVersion
125			if candidate.Created.IsZero() {
126				candidate.Created = now
127			}
128			if candidate.Discovered.IsZero() {
129				candidate.Discovered = now
130			}
131			candidate.Updated = now
132			prepareNewNested(candidate, now)
133			candidate.Normalize()
134			if err := candidate.Validate(); err != nil {
135				return err
136			}
137			if err := os.MkdirAll(s.Dir, 0o755); err != nil {
138				return fmt.Errorf("create catalog directory: %w", err)
139			}
140			if _, err := os.Lstat(s.path(candidate.ID)); err == nil {
141				continue
142			} else if !errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
143				return fmt.Errorf("check catalog ID %s: %w", candidate.ID, err)
144			}
145			if err := s.writeAtomic(candidate); err != nil {
146				return err
147			}
148			*entry = *candidate
149			return nil
150		}
151		return fmt.Errorf("generate unique catalog ID: %w", ErrAlreadyExists)
152	}

162	func (s *Store) get(id string) (*Entry, error) {
163		data, err := os.ReadFile(s.path(id))
164		if err != nil {
165			if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
166				return nil, fmt.Errorf("%q: %w", id, ErrNotFound)
167			}
168			return nil, fmt.Errorf("read catalog asset %s: %w", id, err)
169		}
170		var header struct {
171			SchemaVersion int `toml:"schema_version"`
172		}
173		if _, err := toml.Decode(string(data), &header); err != nil {
174			return nil, fmt.Errorf("decode catalog asset %s schema: %w", id, err)
175		}
176		if header.SchemaVersion != 0 && header.SchemaVersion != CurrentSchemaVersion {
177			return nil, &UnsupportedSchemaError{ID: id, Version: header.SchemaVersion}
178		}
179	
180		var entry Entry
181		metadata, err := toml.Decode(string(data), &entry)
182		if err != nil {
183			return nil, fmt.Errorf("decode catalog asset %s: %w", id, err)
184		}
185		if undecoded := metadata.Undecoded(); len(undecoded) > 0 {
186			return nil, fmt.Errorf("decode catalog asset %s: unknown field(s): %v", id, undecoded)
187		}
188		entry.ID = id
189		// Version zero is the only implicit form: it means the schema marker was
190		// absent, not that an unknown future layout should be guessed.
191		if entry.SchemaVersion == 0 {
192			entry.SchemaVersion = CurrentSchemaVersion
193		}
194		entry.Normalize()
195		if err := entry.Validate(); err != nil {
196			return nil, fmt.Errorf("validate catalog asset %s: %w", id, err)
197		}
198		return &entry, nil
199	}

222	// ListWithDiagnostics is List's explicit diagnostic form. It is useful to
223	// services that want to aggregate notices rather than render them immediately.
224	func (s *Store) ListWithDiagnostics() ([]*Entry, []Diagnostic, error) {
225		directoryEntries, err := os.ReadDir(s.Dir)
226		if err != nil {
227			if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
228				return nil, nil, nil
229			}
230			return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("read catalog directory: %w", err)
231		}
232	
233		var entries []*Entry
234		var diagnostics []Diagnostic
235		for _, directoryEntry := range directoryEntries {
236			name := directoryEntry.Name()
237			if directoryEntry.IsDir() || strings.HasPrefix(name, ".") || !strings.HasSuffix(name, ".toml") {
238				continue
239			}
240			id := strings.TrimSuffix(name, ".toml")
241			entry, err := s.Get(id)
242			if err != nil {
243				diagnostics = append(diagnostics, Diagnostic{Path: filepath.Join(s.Dir, name), Err: err})
244				continue
245			}
246			entries = append(entries, entry)
247		}
248		Sort(entries)
249		sort.Slice(diagnostics, func(i, j int) bool { return diagnostics[i].Path < diagnostics[j].Path })
250		return entries, diagnostics, nil
251	}

253	// Update applies mutate to a deep copy and atomically replaces the record only
254	// if the mutation and validation both succeed. ID, Created, and Discovered are
255	// immutable.
256	func (s *Store) Update(id string, mutate func(*Entry) error) (*Entry, error) {
257		if err := ValidateID(id); err != nil {
258			return nil, err
259		}
260		if mutate == nil {
261			return nil, errors.New("catalog update requires a mutation")
262		}
263	
264		s.mu.Lock()
265		defer s.mu.Unlock()
266	
267		current, err := s.get(id)
268		if err != nil {
269			return nil, err
270		}
271		updated := current.Clone()
272		if err := mutate(updated); err != nil {
273			return nil, err
274		}
275		if updated.ID != current.ID {
276			return nil, errors.New("catalog update cannot change ID")
277		}
278		if updated.SchemaVersion != current.SchemaVersion {
279			return nil, errors.New("catalog update cannot change schema version")
280		}
281		if !updated.Created.Equal(current.Created) {
282			return nil, errors.New("catalog update cannot change Created")
283		}
284		if !updated.Discovered.Equal(current.Discovered) {
285			return nil, errors.New("catalog update cannot change Discovered")
286		}
287	
288		now := s.now()
289		updated.Updated = now
290		prepareUpdatedNested(current, updated, now)
291		stampChangedLocations(current, updated, now)
292		updated.Normalize()
293		if err := updated.Validate(); err != nil {
294			return nil, err
295		}
296		if err := s.writeAtomic(updated); err != nil {
297			return nil, err
298		}
299		return updated.Clone(), nil
300	}

302	// Sort orders entries by stable ID.
303	func Sort(entries []*Entry) {
304		sort.SliceStable(entries, func(i, j int) bool {
305			return entries[i].ID < entries[j].ID
306		})
307	}
308	
309	func (s *Store) writeAtomic(entry *Entry) error {
310		temporary, err := os.CreateTemp(s.Dir, "."+entry.ID+".*.tmp")
311		if err != nil {
312			return fmt.Errorf("create catalog temp file: %w", err)
313		}
314		name := temporary.Name()
315		defer os.Remove(name)
316	
317		if err := toml.NewEncoder(temporary).Encode(entry); err != nil {
318			_ = temporary.Close()
319			return fmt.Errorf("encode catalog asset %s: %w", entry.ID, err)
320		}
321		if err := temporary.Close(); err != nil {
322			return fmt.Errorf("close catalog temp file: %w", err)
323		}
324		if err := os.Chmod(name, 0o644); err != nil {
325			return fmt.Errorf("set catalog file mode: %w", err)
326		}
327		if err := os.Rename(name, s.path(entry.ID)); err != nil {
328			return fmt.Errorf("replace catalog asset %s: %w", entry.ID, err)
329		}
330		return nil
331	}
332	
333	func (s *Store) nextID() string {
334		if s.generateID == nil {
335			return uuid.NewString()
336		}
337		return s.generateID()
338	}
339	
340	func (s *Store) now() time.Time {
341		if s.clock == nil {
342			return time.Now().UTC()
343		}
344		return s.clock().UTC()
345	}
346	
347	func prepareNewNested(entry *Entry, now time.Time) {
348		if entry.Experiment != nil {
349			if entry.Experiment.Phase == "" {
350				entry.Experiment.Phase = PhaseActive
351			}
352			if entry.Experiment.Started.IsZero() {
353				entry.Experiment.Started = now
354			}
355		}
356		for host, location := range entry.Locations {
357			if location.Updated.IsZero() {
358				location.Updated = now
359				entry.Locations[host] = location
360			}
361		}
362		if entry.RecoveryReceipt != nil && entry.RecoveryReceipt.Created.IsZero() {
363			entry.RecoveryReceipt.Created = now
364		}
365		if entry.MoveIntent != nil && entry.MoveIntent.Started.IsZero() {
366			entry.MoveIntent.Started = now
367		}
368	}
369	
370	func prepareUpdatedNested(current, updated *Entry, now time.Time) {
371		if current.Experiment == nil && updated.Experiment != nil {
372			if updated.Experiment.Phase == "" {
373				updated.Experiment.Phase = PhaseActive
374			}
375			if updated.Experiment.Started.IsZero() {
376				updated.Experiment.Started = now
377			}
378		}
379		if updated.RecoveryReceipt != nil && updated.RecoveryReceipt.Created.IsZero() &&
380			(current.RecoveryReceipt == nil || recoveryPayloadChanged(*current.RecoveryReceipt, *updated.RecoveryReceipt)) {
381			updated.RecoveryReceipt.Created = now
382		}
383		if updated.MoveIntent != nil && updated.MoveIntent.Started.IsZero() &&
384			(current.MoveIntent == nil || moveIntentPayloadChanged(*current.MoveIntent, *updated.MoveIntent)) {
385			updated.MoveIntent.Started = now
386		}
387	}
388	
389	func recoveryPayloadChanged(left, right RecoveryReceipt) bool {
390		left.Created = time.Time{}
391		right.Created = time.Time{}
392		return left != right
393	}
394	
395	func moveIntentPayloadChanged(left, right MoveIntent) bool {
396		left.Started = time.Time{}
397		right.Started = time.Time{}
398		return left != right
399	}
400	
401	func stampChangedLocations(current, updated *Entry, now time.Time) {
402		for host, location := range updated.Locations {
403			previous, existed := current.Locations[host]
404			if !existed || locationPayloadChanged(previous, location) {
405				location.Updated = now
406			} else {
407				// Updated is store-owned metadata. A mutation that did not change this
408				// host's location must not make it look newly observed.
409				location.Updated = previous.Updated
410			}
411			updated.Locations[host] = location
412		}
413	}
414	
415	func locationPayloadChanged(left, right Location) bool {
416		left.Updated = time.Time{}
417		right.Updated = time.Time{}
418		return left != right
419	}
420

13	func idSequence(ids ...string) catalog.IDGenerator {
14		index := 0
15		return func() string {
16			if index >= len(ids) {
17				return ids[len(ids)-1]
18			}
19			id := ids[index]
20			index++
21			return id
22		}

31	// Reconcile backfills every immediate, non-hidden directory under TriesRoot.
32	// It never moves, renames, or writes into a discovered directory.
33	func (s *Service) Reconcile(ctx context.Context) ([]Item, []Diagnostic, error) {
34		s.reconcileMu.Lock()
35		defer s.reconcileMu.Unlock()
36	
37		if err := s.ensureTriesRoot(); err != nil {
38			return nil, nil, err
39		}
40		entries, catalogProblems, err := s.store.ListWithDiagnostics()
41		if err != nil {
42			return nil, nil, err
43		}
44		diagnostics := catalogDiagnostics(catalogProblems)
45	
46		directoryEntries, err := os.ReadDir(s.triesRoot)
47		if err != nil {
48			return nil, diagnostics, fmt.Errorf("read tries root %s: %w", s.triesRoot, err)
49		}
50		paths := make([]string, 0, len(directoryEntries))
51		for _, entry := range directoryEntries {
52			if strings.HasPrefix(entry.Name(), ".") {
53				continue
54			}
55			paths = append(paths, filepath.Join(s.triesRoot, entry.Name()))
56		}
57		probes := boundedMap(ctx, s.workers, paths, func(ctx context.Context, path string) directoryProbe {
58			return s.probeDirectory(ctx, path)
59		})
60	
61		items := make([]Item, 0, len(probes))
62		for _, probe := range probes {
63			if probe.diagnostic != nil {
64				diagnostics = append(diagnostics, *probe.diagnostic)
65			}
66			if !probe.valid {
67				continue
68			}
69	
70			matches := matchingEntries(entries, s.host, probe)
71			if len(matches) == 0 && len(catalogProblems) == 0 && probe.originURL != "" {
72				matched, matchErr := s.registry.Match(observationFromProbe(s.host, probe))
73				switch {
74				case matchErr == nil && eligibleTryRecord(matched):
75					matches = []*catalog.Entry{matched}
76				case matchErr == nil:
77					// A graduated experiment at the same identity is history, not an
78					// active Try to revive implicitly.
79				case errors.Is(matchErr, catalog.ErrNotFound), errors.Is(matchErr, catalog.ErrAmbiguous):
80					// A live clone must get its own identity when the remote hint is
81					// absent or ambiguous.
82				default:
83					item := s.transientItem(probe, matchErr)
84					items = append(items, item)
85					diagnostics = append(diagnostics, Diagnostic{
86						Path: probe.live.CurrentPath, Operation: "match catalog try", Err: matchErr,
87					})
88					continue
89				}
90			}
91			switch len(matches) {
92			case 0:
93				if len(catalogProblems) > 0 {
94					// The catalog diagnostic is reported once, while each live item carries
95					// the same typed tracking error for callers that try to mutate it.
96					items = append(items, s.transientItem(probe, incompleteCatalogError(catalogProblems)))
97					continue
98				}
99				entry := s.newEntry(probe)
100				if err := s.catalogCreate(entry); err != nil {
101					item := s.transientItem(probe, err)
102					items = append(items, item)
103					diagnostics = append(diagnostics, Diagnostic{
104						Path: probe.live.CurrentPath, Operation: "catalog try", Err: err,
105					})
106					continue
107				}
108				entries = append(entries, entry)
109				items = append(items, itemFromEntry(entry, probe.live))
110			case 1:
111				entry := matches[0]
112				updated, updateErr := s.refreshEntry(entry, probe)
113				if updateErr != nil {
114					item := itemFromEntry(entry, probe.live)
115					item.CatalogError = updateErr
116					items = append(items, item)
117					diagnostics = append(diagnostics, Diagnostic{
118						Path: probe.live.CurrentPath, Operation: "refresh catalog try", Err: updateErr,
119					})
120					continue
121				}
122				replaceEntry(entries, updated)
123				items = append(items, itemFromEntry(updated, probe.live))
124			default:
125				matchedItems := make([]Item, len(matches))
126				for index, entry := range matches {
127					matchedItems[index] = itemFromEntry(entry, probe.live)
128				}
129				ambiguous := &AmbiguousError{Ref: probe.live.CurrentPath, Candidates: candidatesOf(matchedItems)}
130				item := s.transientItem(probe, ambiguous)
131				items = append(items, item)
132				diagnostics = append(diagnostics, Diagnostic{
133					Path: probe.live.CurrentPath, Operation: "match catalog try", Err: ambiguous,
134				})
135			}
136		}
137	
138		items = deduplicateItems(items)
139		sortItemsByName(items)
140		sortDiagnostics(diagnostics)
141		return items, diagnostics, nil
142	}

144	// List reconciles visible directories, joins requested catalog history, and
145	// enriches Git repositories with bounded status/last-commit probes.
146	func (s *Service) List(ctx context.Context, options ListOptions) ([]Item, []Diagnostic, error) {
147		visible, diagnostics, err := s.Reconcile(ctx)
148		if err != nil {
149			return visible, diagnostics, err
150		}
151	
152		entries, catalogProblems, err := s.store.ListWithDiagnostics()
153		if err != nil {
154			return visible, diagnostics, err
155		}
156		diagnostics = append(diagnostics, catalogDiagnostics(catalogProblems)...)
157	
158		items := make([]Item, 0, len(entries)+len(visible))
159		seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(visible))
160		seenPaths := make(map[string]struct{}, len(visible))
161		for _, item := range visible {
162			if item.ID != "" {
163				seen[item.ID] = struct{}{}
164			}
165			if item.Live.CurrentPath != "" {
166				seenPaths[item.Live.CurrentPath] = struct{}{}
167			}
168			items = append(items, item)
169		}
170	
171		for _, entry := range entries {
172			if _, ok := seen[entry.ID]; ok {
173				continue
174			}
175			if location, ok := entry.LocationFor(s.host); ok {
176				if _, pathSeen := seenPaths[location.CurrentPath]; pathSeen {
177					continue
178				}
179			}
180			graduated := entry.Kind == catalog.KindRepository && entry.Experiment != nil &&
181				entry.Experiment.Phase == catalog.PhaseGraduated
182			if graduated {
183				if !options.IncludeGraduated {
184					continue
185				}
186			} else if entry.Kind != catalog.KindTry || entry.Experiment == nil {
187				continue
188			}
189	
190			location, located := entry.LocationFor(s.host)
191			present := located && location.State == catalog.LocationPresent && !s.hiddenStorage(location.CurrentPath)
192			if present {
193				isDirectory, statErr := directoryExists(location.CurrentPath)
194				if statErr != nil {
195					diagnostics = append(diagnostics, Diagnostic{
196						Path: location.CurrentPath, Operation: "stat catalog try", Err: statErr,
197					})
198					present = false
199				} else {
200					present = isDirectory
201				}
202			}
203			if !present && !options.IncludeNonPresent {
204				continue
205			}
206	
207			live := LiveFacts{Present: present}
208			if located {
209				live.CurrentPath = location.CurrentPath
210				live.RealPath = location.RealPath
211			}
212			if present {
213				probe := s.probeDirectory(ctx, location.CurrentPath)
214				if probe.diagnostic != nil {
215					diagnostics = append(diagnostics, *probe.diagnostic)
216				}
217				if probe.valid {
218					live = probe.live
219				}
220			}
221			items = append(items, itemFromEntry(entry, live))
222		}
223	
224		if query := strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(options.Query)); query != "" {
225			filtered := items[:0]
226			for _, item := range items {
227				if strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(item.SearchText()), query) {
228					filtered = append(filtered, item)
229				}
230			}
231			items = filtered
232		}
233		if !options.SkipEnrichment {
234			items = s.enrich(ctx, items)
235		}
236		sortItemsByActivity(items)
237		diagnostics = deduplicateDiagnostics(diagnostics)
238		sortDiagnostics(diagnostics)
239		return items, diagnostics, nil
240	}

242	// Resolve applies stable, deterministic matching: exact ID, exact basename,
243	// exact date-stripped name/slug, then one unique case-insensitive substring.
244	func (s *Service) Resolve(ctx context.Context, ref string) (Item, []Diagnostic, error) {
245		items, diagnostics, err := s.List(ctx, ListOptions{})
246		if err != nil {
247			return Item{}, diagnostics, err
248		}
249		ref = strings.TrimSpace(ref)
250		if ref == "" {
251			return Item{}, diagnostics, &NotFoundError{Ref: ref, Root: s.triesRoot}
252		}
253	
254		if looksLikePath(ref) {
255			pathRef := config.Expand(ref)
256			if canonical, canonicalErr := pathx.Canonical(pathRef); canonicalErr == nil {
257				var matches []Item
258				for _, item := range items {
259					if samePath(canonical, item.Live.CurrentPath) {
260						matches = append(matches, item)
261					}
262				}
263				if len(matches) > 0 {
264					return selectResolved(ref, matches, diagnostics)
265				}
266			}
267		}
268	
269		for _, match := range []func(Item) bool{
270			func(item Item) bool { return item.ID != "" && item.ID == ref },
271			func(item Item) bool { return item.Basename == ref },
272			func(item Item) bool {
273				stripped, _, _ := splitDatedBasename(item.Basename)
274				return stripped == ref || item.Name == ref || item.Slug == ref
275			},
276		} {
277			var matches []Item
278			for _, item := range items {
279				if match(item) {
280					matches = append(matches, item)
281				}
282			}
283			if len(matches) > 0 {
284				return selectResolved(ref, matches, diagnostics)
285			}
286		}
287	
288		needle := strings.ToLower(ref)
289		var matches []Item
290		for _, item := range items {
291			stripped, _, _ := splitDatedBasename(item.Basename)
292			for _, value := range []string{item.Basename, stripped, item.Name, item.Slug} {
293				if value != "" && strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(value), needle) {
294					matches = append(matches, item)
295					break
296				}
297			}
298		}
299		if len(matches) == 0 {
300			return Item{}, diagnostics, &NotFoundError{Ref: ref, Root: s.triesRoot}
301		}
302		return selectResolved(ref, matches, diagnostics)
303	}
304	
305	func selectResolved(ref string, matches []Item, diagnostics []Diagnostic) (Item, []Diagnostic, error) {
306		if len(matches) == 1 {
307			return matches[0], diagnostics, nil
308		}
309		return Item{}, diagnostics, &AmbiguousError{Ref: ref, Candidates: candidatesOf(matches)}
310	}

312	// ResolveOrCreate preserves the low-friction dev try behavior: an existing
313	// non-clone match wins; clone requests always get a collision-safe new path.
314	func (s *Service) ResolveOrCreate(ctx context.Context, request CreateRequest) (CreateResult, error) {
315		if request.Clone == "" {
316			name := config.Slug(strings.ReplaceAll(request.Name, " ", "-"))
317			item, diagnostics, err := s.Resolve(ctx, name)
318			if err == nil {
319				result := CreateResult{
320					Item: item, Path: item.Live.CurrentPath, Existing: true,
321					Tracked: item.ID != "" && item.CatalogError == nil, Diagnostics: diagnostics,
322				}
323				if !result.Tracked {
324					trackingErr := item.CatalogError
325					if trackingErr == nil {
326						trackingErr = errors.New("matching directory has no catalog ID")
327					}
328					return result, fmt.Errorf("existing try at %s is not tracked in the catalog: %w", result.Path, trackingErr)
329				}
330				return result, nil
331			}
332			if !errors.Is(err, ErrNotFound) {
333				return CreateResult{Diagnostics: diagnostics}, err
334			}
335		}
336		return s.Create(ctx, request)
337	}
338	
339	// Create makes a new collision-safe dated directory or clone and catalogs it
340	// only after the filesystem operation succeeds.
341	func (s *Service) Create(ctx context.Context, request CreateRequest) (CreateResult, error) {
342		var result CreateResult
343		if err := s.ensureTriesRoot(); err != nil {
344			return result, err
345		}
346		name := request.Name
347		if request.Clone != "" && strings.TrimSpace(name) == "" {
348			name = cloneDefaultName(request.Clone)
349		}
350		slug := config.Slug(strings.ReplaceAll(name, " ", "-"))
351		if err := pathx.ValidateComponent(slug); err != nil {
352			return result, fmt.Errorf("try name %q: %w", name, err)
353		}
354	
355		path, err := s.availableDatedPath(slug)
356		if err != nil {
357			return result, err
358		}
359		result.Path = path
360		if request.Clone != "" {
361			cloneRef := normalizeCloneRef(request.Clone)
362			if _, err := s.gitRun(ctx, s.triesRoot, "clone", cloneRef, path); err != nil {
363				return result, fmt.Errorf("clone try into %s: %w", path, err)
364			}
365			result.Created = true
366			result.Cloned = true
367		} else {
368			if err := os.Mkdir(path, 0o755); err != nil {
369				return result, fmt.Errorf("create try %s: %w", path, err)
370			}
371			result.Created = true
372			if !request.NoGit {
373				if _, err := s.gitRun(ctx, path, "init", "-b", "main"); err != nil {
374					result.InitWarning = err
375				}
376			}
377		}
378	
379		canonical, canonicalErr := pathx.Canonical(path)
380		if canonicalErr != nil {
381			return result, fmt.Errorf("try exists at %s but its canonical path could not be determined: %w", path, canonicalErr)
382		}
383		result.Path = canonical
384		items, diagnostics, reconcileErr := s.Reconcile(ctx)
385		result.Diagnostics = diagnostics
386		if reconcileErr != nil {
387			return result, fmt.Errorf("try exists at %s but catalog reconciliation failed: %w", canonical, reconcileErr)
388		}
389		for _, item := range items {
390			if samePath(item.Live.CurrentPath, canonical) {
391				result.Item = item
392				result.Tracked = item.ID != "" && item.CatalogError == nil
393				break
394			}
395		}
396		if !result.Tracked {
397			trackingErr := result.Item.CatalogError
398			if trackingErr == nil {
399				trackingErr = errors.New("reconciliation did not produce a catalog record")
400			}
401			return result, fmt.Errorf("try exists at %s but could not be added to the catalog: %w", canonical, trackingErr)
402		}
403		enriched := s.enrich(ctx, []Item{result.Item})
404		if len(enriched) == 1 {
405			result.Item = enriched[0]
406		}
407		return result, nil
408	}

410	// RefreshOrigin re-probes origin after an explicit external remote-creation
411	// step and persists its raw URL and normalized identity on the same catalog ID.
412	func (s *Service) RefreshOrigin(ctx context.Context, id string) (Item, error) {
413		entry, err := s.registry.Get(id)
414		if err != nil {
415			return Item{}, fmt.Errorf("load experiment %s for origin refresh: %w", id, err)
416		}
417		if entry.Experiment == nil ||
418			(entry.Kind != catalog.KindTry && !(entry.Kind == catalog.KindRepository && entry.Experiment.Phase == catalog.PhaseGraduated)) {
419			return Item{}, &NotFoundError{Ref: id, Root: s.triesRoot}
420		}
421		location, ok := entry.LocationFor(s.host)
422		if !ok || location.State != catalog.LocationPresent || location.CurrentPath == "" {
423			return Item{}, &NotFoundError{Ref: id, Root: s.triesRoot}
424		}
425		probe := s.probeDirectory(ctx, location.CurrentPath)
426		if !probe.valid || probe.live.Repo == nil || probe.live.DiscoverError != nil {
427			if probe.diagnostic != nil {
428				return Item{}, fmt.Errorf("refresh experiment origin: %w", probe.diagnostic.Err)
429			}
430			return Item{}, errors.New("refresh experiment origin: path is not a discoverable Git repository")
431		}
432		if probe.originURL == "" {
433			return Item{}, errors.New("refresh experiment origin: Git origin is not configured")
434		}
435		updated, err := s.catalogUpdate(id, func(current *catalog.Entry) error {
436			currentLocation, found := current.LocationFor(s.host)
437			if !found || currentLocation.State != catalog.LocationPresent ||
438				!samePath(currentLocation.CurrentPath, probe.live.CurrentPath) {
439				return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s moved or was reassigned before origin refresh", id)
440			}
441			if current.Experiment == nil {
442				return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s no longer has experiment provenance", id)
443			}
444			current.Experiment.OriginURL = probe.originURL
445			current.RemoteIdentity = catalog.NormalizeRemoteIdentity(probe.originURL)
446			return current.SetLocation(s.host, locationFromProbe(probe, currentLocation))
447		})
448		if err != nil {
449			return Item{}, fmt.Errorf("refresh experiment origin: %w", err)
450		}
451		item := itemFromEntry(updated, probe.live)
452		enriched := s.enrich(ctx, []Item{item})
453		if len(enriched) == 1 {
454			item = enriched[0]
455		}
456		return item, nil
457	}

459	// Touch updates LastOpened only after a caller has successfully handed off the
460	// selected OpenTarget.
461	func (s *Service) Touch(_ context.Context, id string) (TouchResult, error) {
462		if id == "" {
463			return TouchResult{}, &NotFoundError{Ref: id, Root: s.triesRoot}
464		}
465		now := s.now()
466		updated, err := s.catalogUpdate(id, func(entry *catalog.Entry) error {
467			if entry.Experiment == nil ||
468				(entry.Kind != catalog.KindTry && !(entry.Kind == catalog.KindRepository && entry.Experiment.Phase == catalog.PhaseGraduated)) {
469				return &NotFoundError{Ref: id, Root: s.triesRoot}
470			}
471			location, ok := entry.LocationFor(s.host)
472			if !ok || location.State != catalog.LocationPresent {
473				return &NotFoundError{Ref: id, Root: s.triesRoot}
474			}
475			entry.LastOpened = now
476			return nil
477		})
478		if err != nil {
479			if errors.Is(err, catalog.ErrNotFound) {
480				return TouchResult{}, &NotFoundError{Ref: id, Root: s.triesRoot}
481			}
482			return TouchResult{}, fmt.Errorf("touch try %s: %w", id, err)
483		}
484		location, _ := updated.LocationFor(s.host)
485		item := itemFromEntry(updated, LiveFacts{
486			Present:     location.State == catalog.LocationPresent,
487			CurrentPath: location.CurrentPath, RealPath: location.RealPath,
488		})
489		return TouchResult{Item: item, TouchedAt: now}, nil
490	}

492	func (s *Service) probeDirectory(ctx context.Context, path string) directoryProbe {
493		probe := directoryProbe{}
494		if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
495			probe.diagnostic = &Diagnostic{Path: path, Operation: "inspect try", Err: err}
496			return probe
497		}
498		info, err := os.Stat(path)
499		if err != nil {
500			probe.diagnostic = &Diagnostic{Path: path, Operation: "stat try", Err: err}
501			return probe
502		}
503		if !info.IsDir() {
504			return probe
505		}
506		canonical, err := pathx.Canonical(path)
507		if err != nil {
508			probe.diagnostic = &Diagnostic{Path: path, Operation: "canonicalize try", Err: err}
509			return probe
510		}
511		probe.valid = true
512		probe.live = LiveFacts{Present: true, CurrentPath: canonical, RealPath: canonical}
513		_, markerErr := os.Lstat(filepath.Join(canonical, ".git"))
514		probe.gitMarker = markerErr == nil || !errors.Is(markerErr, fs.ErrNotExist)
515	
516		repository, discoverErr := s.gitDiscover(ctx, canonical)
517		if discoverErr != nil {
518			if probe.gitMarker {
519				probe.live.DiscoverError = discoverErr
520				probe.diagnostic = &Diagnostic{Path: canonical, Operation: "discover Git try", Err: discoverErr}
521			}
522			return probe
523		}
524		repositoryRoot := repository.Root
525		if repository.Bare {
526			repositoryRoot = repository.MainRoot
527		}
528		canonicalRoot, rootErr := pathx.Canonical(repositoryRoot)
529		if rootErr != nil || !samePath(canonicalRoot, canonical) {
530			// A TriesRoot may itself be inside a repository. Its child directories are
531			// not independent Git Tries merely because rev-parse walks to that parent.
532			return probe
533		}
534		repository.Root = canonicalRoot
535		if repository.MainRoot != "" {
536			if canonicalMain, mainErr := pathx.Canonical(repository.MainRoot); mainErr == nil {
537				repository.MainRoot = canonicalMain
538			}
539		}
540		if repository.GitCommonDir != "" {
541			commonDir, commonErr := pathx.Canonical(repository.GitCommonDir)
542			if commonErr != nil {
543				probe.live.DiscoverError = commonErr
544				probe.diagnostic = &Diagnostic{Path: canonical, Operation: "canonicalize Git common directory", Err: commonErr}
545				repository.GitCommonDir = ""
546			} else {
547				repository.GitCommonDir = commonDir
548			}
549		}
550		probe.live.Repo = &repository
551		probe.originURL = gitx.RemoteFromConfig(repository.GitCommonDir, "origin")
552		return probe
553	}

555	func (s *Service) enrich(ctx context.Context, items []Item) []Item {
556		return boundedMap(ctx, s.workers, items, func(ctx context.Context, item Item) Item {
557			if item.Live.Repo == nil || item.Live.CurrentPath == "" {
558				return item
559			}
560			status, statusErr := s.gitStatus(ctx, item.Live.CurrentPath)
561			if statusErr != nil {
562				item.Live.StatusError = statusErr
563			} else {
564				item.Live.Status = &status
565			}
566			unix, subject, commitErr := s.gitLastCommit(ctx, item.Live.CurrentPath)
567			if commitErr != nil {
568				item.Live.LastCommitError = commitErr
569			} else if unix > 0 {
570				item.Live.LastCommit = time.Unix(unix, 0).UTC()
571				item.Live.LastCommitSubject = subject
572			}
573			return item
574		})
575	}

642	func (s *Service) refreshEntry(entry *catalog.Entry, probe directoryProbe) (*catalog.Entry, error) {
643		location, _ := entry.LocationFor(s.host)
644		wantedLocation := locationFromProbe(probe, location)
645		if entry.Kind == catalog.KindRepository && entry.Experiment == nil {
646			metadata := s.experimentFromProbe(probe)
647			return s.catalogUpdate(entry.ID, func(updated *catalog.Entry) error {
648				if updated.Kind != catalog.KindRepository || updated.Experiment != nil {
649					return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s changed before it could become a Try", updated.ID)
650				}
651				updated.Kind = catalog.KindTry
652				updated.Experiment = metadata
653				if probe.originURL != "" {
654					updated.RemoteIdentity = catalog.NormalizeRemoteIdentity(probe.originURL)
655				}
656				return updated.SetLocation(s.host, wantedLocation)
657			})
658		}
659	
660		wantedOrigin := entry.Experiment.OriginURL
661		wantedIdentity := entry.RemoteIdentity
662		if probe.originURL != "" {
663			wantedOrigin = probe.originURL
664			wantedIdentity = catalog.NormalizeRemoteIdentity(probe.originURL)
665		}
666		if locationEqual(location, wantedLocation) && entry.Experiment.OriginURL == wantedOrigin &&
667			entry.RemoteIdentity == wantedIdentity {
668			return entry, nil
669		}
670		return s.catalogUpdate(entry.ID, func(updated *catalog.Entry) error {
671			if updated.Kind != catalog.KindTry || updated.Experiment == nil || updated.Experiment.Phase == catalog.PhaseGraduated {
672				return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s is not an active Try", updated.ID)
673			}
674			if probe.originURL != "" {
675				updated.Experiment.OriginURL = probe.originURL
676				updated.RemoteIdentity = catalog.NormalizeRemoteIdentity(probe.originURL)
677			}
678			return updated.SetLocation(s.host, wantedLocation)
679		})
680	}

682	func locationFromProbe(probe directoryProbe, previous catalog.Location) catalog.Location {
683		commonDir := ""
684		if probe.live.Repo != nil && probe.live.DiscoverError == nil {
685			commonDir = probe.live.Repo.GitCommonDir
686		} else if probe.gitMarker && probe.live.DiscoverError != nil {
687			// A transient Git failure must not erase identity gathered earlier.
688			commonDir = previous.GitCommonDir
689		}
690		return catalog.Location{
691			State:        catalog.LocationPresent,
692			CurrentPath:  probe.live.CurrentPath,
693			RealPath:     probe.live.RealPath,
694			GitCommonDir: commonDir,
695		}
696	}
697	
698	func locationEqual(left, right catalog.Location) bool {
699		left.Updated = time.Time{}
700		right.Updated = time.Time{}
701		return left == right
702	}

706			entry.Experiment.Phase != catalog.PhaseGraduated

709	func eligibleLocalRecord(entry *catalog.Entry) bool {
710		return eligibleTryRecord(entry) ||

725	func matchingEntries(entries []*catalog.Entry, host string, probe directoryProbe) []*catalog.Entry {
726		matched := make(map[string]*catalog.Entry)
727		for _, entry := range entries {
728			if !eligibleLocalRecord(entry) {
729				continue
730			}
731			location, located := entry.LocationFor(host)
732			if located {
733				pathMatch := samePath(probe.live.CurrentPath, location.CurrentPath) ||
734					samePath(probe.live.CurrentPath, location.RealPath) ||
735					samePath(probe.live.CurrentPath, location.RestorePath)
736				commonMatch := probe.live.Repo != nil && probe.live.Repo.GitCommonDir != "" &&
737					samePath(probe.live.Repo.GitCommonDir, location.GitCommonDir)
738				if pathMatch || commonMatch {
739					matched[entry.ID] = entry
740				}
741			} else if entry.Experiment != nil && samePath(probe.live.CurrentPath, entry.Experiment.OriginalPath) {
742				matched[entry.ID] = entry
743			}
744		}
745		out := make([]*catalog.Entry, 0, len(matched))
746		for _, entry := range matched {
747			out = append(out, entry)
748		}
749		catalog.Sort(out)
750		return out
751	}

771	func splitDatedBasename(basename string) (string, time.Time, bool) {
772		if len(basename) <= len("2006-01-02-") || basename[10] != '-' {
773			return basename, time.Time{}, false
774		}
775		parsed, err := time.Parse("2006-01-02", basename[:10])
776		if err != nil || parsed.Format("2006-01-02") != basename[:10] {
777			return basename, time.Time{}, false
778		}
779		name := basename[11:]
780		if name == "" {
781			return basename, time.Time{}, false
782		}
783		return name, parsed, true
784	}
785	
786	func (s *Service) availableDatedPath(slug string) (string, error) {
787		prefix := s.clock().Format("2006-01-02") + "-" + slug
788		for version := 1; version < 10_000; version++ {
789			basename := prefix
790			if version > 1 {
791				basename = fmt.Sprintf("%s-%d", prefix, version)
792			}
793			candidate, err := pathx.JoinChild(s.triesRoot, basename)
794			if err != nil {
795				return "", fmt.Errorf("choose try destination: %w", err)
796			}
797			if _, err := os.Lstat(candidate); errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
798				return candidate, nil
799			} else if err != nil {
800				return "", fmt.Errorf("inspect try destination %s: %w", candidate, err)
801			}
802		}
803		return "", fmt.Errorf("choose a unique destination for %q", slug)
804	}

806	func cloneDefaultName(ref string) string {
807		if localClonePath(ref) {
808			trimmed := strings.TrimSuffix(strings.TrimSuffix(ref, string(filepath.Separator)), ".git")
809			return config.Slug(filepath.Base(trimmed))
810		}
811		if _, identity := forge.IdentityFromURL(ref); identity != "" {
812			return config.Slug(strings.ReplaceAll(identity, "/", "-"))
813		}
814		identity := clonePathIdentity(ref)
815		if identity != "" {
816			return config.Slug(strings.ReplaceAll(identity, "/", "-"))
817		}
818		trimmed := strings.TrimSuffix(strings.TrimSuffix(ref, "/"), ".git")
819		if index := strings.LastIndexAny(trimmed, "/:"); index >= 0 {
820			trimmed = trimmed[index+1:]
821		}
822		return config.Slug(trimmed)
823	}
824	
825	func normalizeCloneRef(ref string) string {
826		ref = strings.TrimSpace(ref)
827		if localClonePath(ref) {
828			return ref
829		}
830		kind := forge.FromURL(ref)
831		if kind != forge.Unknown {
832			adapter, err := forge.For(kind)
833			if err == nil {
834				return adapter.CloneURL(ref)
835			}
836			return ref
837		}
838		if !strings.Contains(ref, "://") && !strings.HasPrefix(ref, "git@") && strings.Contains(ref, "/") {
839			if adapter, err := forge.Preferred(); err == nil {
840				return adapter.CloneURL(ref)
841			}
842		}
843		return ref
844	}
845	
846	func localClonePath(ref string) bool {
847		if filepath.IsAbs(ref) || strings.HasPrefix(ref, "file://") || strings.HasPrefix(ref, "./") ||
848			strings.HasPrefix(ref, "../") || strings.HasPrefix(ref, "~/") {
849			return true
850		}
851		_, err := os.Stat(ref)
852		return err == nil
853	}
854	
855	func clonePathIdentity(ref string) string {
856		if parsed, err := url.Parse(ref); err == nil && parsed.Host != "" {
857			return strings.Trim(strings.TrimSuffix(parsed.Path, ".git"), "/")
858		}
859		if at := strings.LastIndexByte(ref, '@'); at >= 0 {
860			ref = ref[at+1:]
861		}
862		if colon := strings.IndexByte(ref, ':'); colon >= 0 {
863			ref = ref[colon+1:]
864		}
865		ref = strings.Trim(strings.TrimSuffix(ref, ".git"), "/")
866		if strings.Contains(ref, "/") {
867			return ref
868		}
869		return ""
870	}

872	func (s *Service) hiddenStorage(path string) bool {
873		if path == "" {
874			return false
875		}
876		if hiddenImmediateChild(s.triesRoot, path) {
877			return true
878		}
879		canonicalRoot, rootErr := pathx.Canonical(s.triesRoot)
880		canonicalPath, pathErr := pathx.Canonical(path)
881		if rootErr != nil || pathErr != nil {
882			return false
883		}
884		return hiddenImmediateChild(canonicalRoot, canonicalPath)
885	}
886	
887	func hiddenImmediateChild(root, path string) bool {
888		absoluteRoot, rootErr := filepath.Abs(root)
889		absolutePath, pathErr := filepath.Abs(path)
890		if rootErr != nil || pathErr != nil {
891			return false
892		}
893		relative, err := filepath.Rel(filepath.Clean(absoluteRoot), filepath.Clean(absolutePath))
894		if err != nil || relative == "." || relative == ".." ||
895			strings.HasPrefix(relative, ".."+string(filepath.Separator)) {
896			return false
897		}
898		first, _, _ := strings.Cut(relative, string(filepath.Separator))
899		return strings.HasPrefix(first, ".")
900	}
901	
902	func looksLikePath(ref string) bool {
903		return filepath.IsAbs(ref) || strings.HasPrefix(ref, ".") || strings.HasPrefix(ref, "~") ||
904			strings.ContainsAny(ref, `/\\`)
905	}
906	
907	func samePath(left, right string) bool {
908		if left == "" || right == "" {
909			return false
910		}
911		leftCanonical, leftErr := pathx.Canonical(left)
912		rightCanonical, rightErr := pathx.Canonical(right)
913		if leftErr == nil && rightErr == nil {
914			return leftCanonical == rightCanonical
915		}
916		leftAbsolute, leftAbsErr := filepath.Abs(left)
917		rightAbsolute, rightAbsErr := filepath.Abs(right)
918		return leftAbsErr == nil && rightAbsErr == nil && filepath.Clean(leftAbsolute) == filepath.Clean(rightAbsolute)
919	}

921	func sortItemsByName(items []Item) {
922		sort.SliceStable(items, func(i, j int) bool {
923			left, right := strings.ToLower(items[i].DisplayName()), strings.ToLower(items[j].DisplayName())
924			if left != right {
925				return left < right
926			}
927			if items[i].DisplayName() != items[j].DisplayName() {
928				return items[i].DisplayName() < items[j].DisplayName()
929			}
930			return items[i].ID < items[j].ID
931		})
932	}
933	
934	func sortItemsByActivity(items []Item) {
935		sort.SliceStable(items, func(i, j int) bool {
936			left, right := items[i].Activity(), items[j].Activity()
937			if !left.Equal(right) {
938				if left.IsZero() {
939					return false
940				}
941				if right.IsZero() {
942					return true
943				}
944				return left.After(right)
945			}
946			leftName, rightName := strings.ToLower(items[i].DisplayName()), strings.ToLower(items[j].DisplayName())
947			if leftName != rightName {
948				return leftName < rightName
949			}
950			return items[i].ID < items[j].ID
951		})
952	}
953	
954	func sortDiagnostics(diagnostics []Diagnostic) {
955		sort.SliceStable(diagnostics, func(i, j int) bool {
956			if diagnostics[i].Path != diagnostics[j].Path {
957				return diagnostics[i].Path < diagnostics[j].Path
958			}
959			return diagnostics[i].Operation < diagnostics[j].Operation
960		})
961	}
