963	func deduplicateItems(items []Item) []Item {
964		seenIDs := make(map[string]struct{}, len(items))
965		seenPaths := make(map[string]struct{}, len(items))
966		out := items[:0]
967		for _, item := range items {
968			if item.ID != "" {
969				if _, ok := seenIDs[item.ID]; ok {
970					continue
971				}
972				seenIDs[item.ID] = struct{}{}
973			} else if item.Live.CurrentPath != "" {
974				if _, ok := seenPaths[item.Live.CurrentPath]; ok {
975					continue
976				}
977				seenPaths[item.Live.CurrentPath] = struct{}{}
978			}
979			out = append(out, item)
980		}
981		return out
982	}
983	
984	func deduplicateDiagnostics(diagnostics []Diagnostic) []Diagnostic {
985		seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(diagnostics))
986		out := diagnostics[:0]
987		for _, diagnostic := range diagnostics {
988			key := diagnostic.Path + "\x00" + diagnostic.Operation + "\x00" + fmt.Sprint(diagnostic.Err)
989			if _, ok := seen[key]; ok {
990				continue
991			}
992			seen[key] = struct{}{}
993			out = append(out, diagnostic)
994		}
995		return out
996	}

998	func boundedMap[Input, Output any](ctx context.Context, limit int, input []Input, work func(context.Context, Input) Output) []Output {
999		if len(input) == 0 {
1000			return nil
1001		}
1002		if limit <= 0 || limit > len(input) {
1003			limit = len(input)
1004		}
1005		type job struct {
1006			index int
1007			value Input
1008		}
1009		type result struct {
1010			index int
1011			value Output
1012		}
1013		jobs := make(chan job, len(input))
1014		results := make(chan result, len(input))
1015		for index, value := range input {
1016			jobs <- job{index: index, value: value}
1017		}
1018		close(jobs)
1019	
1020		var workers sync.WaitGroup
1021		workers.Add(limit)
1022		for range limit {
1023			go func() {
1024				defer workers.Done()
1025				for next := range jobs {
1026					results <- result{index: next.index, value: work(ctx, next.value)}
1027				}
1028			}()
1029		}
1030		workers.Wait()
1031		close(results)
1032	
1033		out := make([]Output, len(input))
1034		for result := range results {
1035			out[result.index] = result.value
1036		}
1037		return out
1038	}
1039

15		"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/pathx"
16	)

18	// ErrCrossFilesystem identifies a graduation that cannot use one atomic rename.
19	var ErrCrossFilesystem = errors.New("cross-filesystem move is not supported")
20	
21	// FinalizeError reports whether a failed post-move catalog transition was
22	// successfully rolled back. Cause remains available through errors.Is/As.
23	type FinalizeError struct {
24		Source      string
25		Destination string
26		Cause       error
27		RollbackErr error
28	}
29	
30	func (e *FinalizeError) Error() string {
31		if e.RollbackErr == nil {
32			return fmt.Sprintf("finalize graduation catalog after moving %s to %s: %v; move rolled back",
33				e.Source, e.Destination, e.Cause)
34		}
35		return fmt.Sprintf("finalize graduation catalog after moving %s to %s: %v; rollback to %s also failed: %v",
36			e.Source, e.Destination, e.Cause, e.Source, e.RollbackErr)
37	}
38	
39	func (e *FinalizeError) Unwrap() []error {
40		if e.RollbackErr == nil {
41			return []error{e.Cause}
42		}
43		return []error{e.Cause, e.RollbackErr}
44	}

46	// PlanGraduate resolves and validates a local move without changing either
47	// repository contents or the destination tree. Resolution may backfill catalog
48	// metadata for a legacy directory, but dry-run never initializes or moves it.
49	func (s *Service) PlanGraduate(ctx context.Context, request GraduateRequest) (GraduatePlan, error) {
50		item, diagnostics, err := s.resolveGraduateItem(ctx, request)
51		plan := GraduatePlan{Item: item, DryRun: request.DryRun, Diagnostics: diagnostics}
52		if err != nil {
53			return plan, err
54		}
55		if item.ID == "" || item.CatalogError != nil {
56			if item.CatalogError != nil {
57				return plan, fmt.Errorf("try %s is not safely tracked: %w", item.DisplayName(), item.CatalogError)
58			}
59			return plan, fmt.Errorf("try %s is not safely tracked in the catalog", item.DisplayName())
60		}
61		if !item.Live.Present || item.Live.CurrentPath == "" {
62			return plan, &NotFoundError{Ref: request.Ref, Root: s.triesRoot}
63		}
64	
65		source, err := pathx.CanonicalChild(s.triesRoot, item.Live.CurrentPath)
66		if err != nil {
67			return plan, fmt.Errorf("graduate source %s: %w", item.Live.CurrentPath, err)
68		}
69		canonicalRoot, err := pathx.Canonical(s.triesRoot)
70		if err != nil {
71			return plan, fmt.Errorf("canonicalize tries root: %w", err)
72		}
73		relative, err := filepath.Rel(canonicalRoot, source)
74		if err != nil {
75			return plan, fmt.Errorf("locate try under root: %w", err)
76		}
77		if relative == "." || strings.Contains(relative, string(filepath.Separator)) || strings.HasPrefix(relative, ".") {
78			return plan, fmt.Errorf("graduate source %s is not an immediate visible child of %s", source, canonicalRoot)
79		}
80	
81		name := request.Name
82		if name == "" {
83			name, _, _ = splitDatedBasename(filepath.Base(source))
84		}
85		if name == "" {
86			return plan, fmt.Errorf("could not derive a project name from %s — pass --name", source)
87		}
88		if err := pathx.ValidateComponent(name); err != nil {
89			return plan, fmt.Errorf("project name %q: %w", name, err)
90		}
91		if name != strings.TrimSpace(name) {
92			return plan, fmt.Errorf("project name %q is not normalized: %w", name, pathx.ErrInvalidComponent)
93		}
94		if request.Category != "" {
95			if err := pathx.ValidateComponent(request.Category); err != nil {
96				return plan, fmt.Errorf("project category %q: %w", request.Category, err)
97			}
98			if request.Category != strings.TrimSpace(request.Category) {
99				return plan, fmt.Errorf("project category %q is not normalized: %w", request.Category, pathx.ErrInvalidComponent)
100			}
101		}
102	
103		components := []string{name}
104		if request.Category != "" {
105			components = []string{request.Category, name}
106		}
107		destination, err := pathx.JoinChild(s.projectRoot, components...)
108		if err != nil {
109			return plan, fmt.Errorf("choose graduation destination: %w", err)
110		}
111		if err := rejectExisting(destination); err != nil {
112			return plan, err
113		}
114		if nested, nestedErr := pathx.IsChild(source, destination); nestedErr != nil {
115			return plan, fmt.Errorf("validate graduation destination: %w", nestedErr)
116		} else if nested {
117			return plan, fmt.Errorf("graduation destination %s is inside its source %s", destination, source)
118		}
119		sameDevice, err := s.sameFilesystem(source, destination)
120		if err != nil {
121			return plan, fmt.Errorf("compare graduation filesystems: %w", err)
122		}
123		if !sameDevice {
124			return plan, fmt.Errorf("move %s to %s: %w", source, destination, ErrCrossFilesystem)
125		}
126		if item.Live.DiscoverError != nil {
127			return plan, fmt.Errorf("inspect Git metadata before graduation: %w", item.Live.DiscoverError)
128		}
129		if item.Live.Repo != nil && item.Live.Repo.IsLinkedWorktree {
130			return plan, errors.New("graduating a linked worktree is not supported yet; graduate its main checkout or wait for worktree-aware moves")
131		}
132	
133		plan.Source = source
134		plan.Destination = destination
135		plan.Category = request.Category
136		plan.Name = name
137		plan.NeedsGitInit = item.Live.Repo == nil
138		plan.NeedsInitialCommit = plan.NeedsGitInit || !s.hasCommit(ctx, source)
139		return plan, nil
140	}
141	
142	// Graduate prepares Git while the Try is still at its source, performs one
143	// same-filesystem rename, and atomically transitions the same catalog ID.
144	func (s *Service) Graduate(ctx context.Context, request GraduateRequest) (GraduateResult, error) {
145		plan, err := s.PlanGraduate(ctx, request)
146		result := GraduateResult{Plan: plan, Item: plan.Item, Diagnostics: plan.Diagnostics}
147		if err != nil {
148			return result, err
149		}
150		if request.DryRun {
151			return result, nil
152		}
153		if err := s.validateCatalogSource(plan.Item.ID, plan.Source); err != nil {
154			return result, err
155		}
156		if err := s.validateGraduatePaths(plan); err != nil {
157			return result, err
158		}
159	
160		if plan.NeedsGitInit {
161			if _, err := s.gitRun(ctx, plan.Source, "init", "-b", "main"); err != nil {
162				return result, fmt.Errorf("initialize Git before graduating %s: %w", plan.Source, err)
163			}
164			result.GitInitialized = true
165		}
166		if plan.NeedsInitialCommit {
167			made, err := s.ensureInitialCommit(ctx, plan.Source, plan.Name)
168			if err != nil {
169				return result, fmt.Errorf("make initial commit before graduating %s: %w", plan.Source, err)
170			}
171			result.InitialCommitMade = made
172		}
173	
174		// Revalidate containment, catalog ownership, collision, and device after Git
175		// preparation. Each check precedes the only move, so a stale plan fails with
176		// the source still in place.
177		if err := s.validateCatalogSource(plan.Item.ID, plan.Source); err != nil {
178			return result, err
179		}
180		if err := s.validateGraduatePaths(plan); err != nil {
181			return result, err
182		}
183		if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(plan.Destination), 0o755); err != nil {
184			return result, fmt.Errorf("create graduation category: %w", err)
185		}
186		if err := s.validateGraduatePaths(plan); err != nil {
187			return result, err
188		}
189		sameDevice, err := s.sameFilesystem(plan.Source, plan.Destination)
190		if err != nil {
191			return result, fmt.Errorf("compare graduation filesystems: %w", err)
192		}
193		if !sameDevice {
194			return result, fmt.Errorf("move %s to %s: %w", plan.Source, plan.Destination, ErrCrossFilesystem)
195		}
196		if err := s.validateGraduatePaths(plan); err != nil {
197			return result, err
198		}
199		if err := s.validateCatalogSource(plan.Item.ID, plan.Source); err != nil {
200			return result, err
201		}
202		if err := s.rename(plan.Source, plan.Destination); err != nil {
203			if errors.Is(err, syscall.EXDEV) {
204				return result, fmt.Errorf("move %s to %s: %w", plan.Source, plan.Destination, ErrCrossFilesystem)
205			}
206			return result, fmt.Errorf("move %s to %s: %w", plan.Source, plan.Destination, err)
207		}
208		result.Moved = true
209	
210		probe := s.probeDirectory(ctx, plan.Destination)
211		if !probe.valid || probe.live.Repo == nil || probe.live.DiscoverError != nil {
212			cause := probe.live.DiscoverError
213			if cause == nil && probe.diagnostic != nil {
214				cause = probe.diagnostic.Err
215			}
216			if cause == nil {
217				cause = errors.New("moved project is not a discoverable Git repository")
218			}
219			return s.rollbackGraduation(result, cause)
220		}
221	
222		now := s.now()
223		updated, updateErr := s.catalogUpdate(plan.Item.ID, func(entry *catalog.Entry) error {
224			if entry.Kind != catalog.KindTry || entry.Experiment == nil || entry.Experiment.Phase == catalog.PhaseGraduated {
225				return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s is no longer an active Try", entry.ID)
226			}
227			location, ok := entry.LocationFor(s.host)
228			if !ok || location.State != catalog.LocationPresent || !storedLocationMatches(location, plan.Source) {
229				return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s moved or was reassigned after graduation planning", entry.ID)
230			}
231			entry.Kind = catalog.KindRepository
232			entry.Name = plan.Name
233			entry.Experiment.Phase = catalog.PhaseGraduated
234			entry.Experiment.GraduatedAt = now
235			entry.Experiment.GraduatedPath = probe.live.CurrentPath
236			if probe.originURL != "" {
237				entry.Experiment.OriginURL = probe.originURL
238				entry.RemoteIdentity = catalog.NormalizeRemoteIdentity(probe.originURL)
239			}
240			previous, _ := entry.LocationFor(s.host)
241			return entry.SetLocation(s.host, locationFromProbe(probe, previous))
242		})
243		if updateErr != nil {
244			return s.rollbackGraduation(result, updateErr)
245		}
246		if updated == nil {
247			return s.rollbackGraduation(result, errors.New("catalog update returned no graduated entry"))
248		}
249	
250		item := itemFromEntry(updated, probe.live)
251		enriched := s.enrich(ctx, []Item{item})
252		if len(enriched) == 1 {
253			item = enriched[0]
254		}
255		result.Item = item
256		return result, nil
257	}
258	
259	func (s *Service) validateCatalogSource(id, source string) error {
260		entry, err := s.registry.Get(id)
261		if err != nil {
262			return fmt.Errorf("reload catalog source %s: %w", id, err)
263		}
264		if entry.Kind != catalog.KindTry || entry.Experiment == nil || entry.Experiment.Phase == catalog.PhaseGraduated {
265			return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s is no longer an active Try", id)
266		}
267		location, ok := entry.LocationFor(s.host)
268		if !ok || location.State != catalog.LocationPresent || !storedLocationMatches(location, source) {
269			return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s moved or was reassigned after graduation planning", id)
270		}
271		return nil
272	}
273	
274	func (s *Service) validateGraduatePaths(plan GraduatePlan) error {
275		source, err := pathx.CanonicalChild(s.triesRoot, plan.Source)
276		if err != nil {
277			return fmt.Errorf("revalidate graduation source: %w", err)
278		}
279		if source != plan.Source {
280			return fmt.Errorf("graduation source changed after planning: %s became %s", plan.Source, source)
281		}
282		components := []string{plan.Name}
283		if plan.Category != "" {
284			components = []string{plan.Category, plan.Name}
285		}
286		destination, err := pathx.JoinChild(s.projectRoot, components...)
287		if err != nil {
288			return fmt.Errorf("revalidate graduation destination: %w", err)
289		}
290		if destination != plan.Destination {
291			return fmt.Errorf("graduation destination changed after planning: %s became %s", plan.Destination, destination)
292		}
293		if err := rejectExisting(destination); err != nil {
294			return err
295		}
296		if nested, nestedErr := pathx.IsChild(source, destination); nestedErr != nil {
297			return fmt.Errorf("revalidate graduation destination: %w", nestedErr)
298		} else if nested {
299			return fmt.Errorf("graduation destination %s is inside its source %s", destination, source)
300		}
301		return nil
302	}
303	
304	func storedLocationMatches(location catalog.Location, source string) bool {
305		return filepath.Clean(location.CurrentPath) == source || filepath.Clean(location.RealPath) == source
306	}
307	
308	func (s *Service) resolveGraduateItem(ctx context.Context, request GraduateRequest) (Item, []Diagnostic, error) {
309		if strings.TrimSpace(request.Ref) != "" {
310			return s.Resolve(ctx, request.Ref)
311		}
312		current := request.CurrentDir
313		if current == "" {
314			var err error
315			current, err = s.getwd()
316			if err != nil {
317				return Item{}, nil, fmt.Errorf("get current directory: %w", err)
318			}
319		}
320		canonicalCurrent, err := pathx.CanonicalChild(s.triesRoot, current)
321		if err != nil {
322			return Item{}, nil, fmt.Errorf("%s is not inside %s — name the try to graduate", current, s.triesRoot)
323		}
324		canonicalRoot, err := pathx.Canonical(s.triesRoot)
325		if err != nil {
326			return Item{}, nil, err
327		}
328		relative, err := filepath.Rel(canonicalRoot, canonicalCurrent)
329		if err != nil {
330			return Item{}, nil, err
331		}
332		first, _, _ := strings.Cut(relative, string(filepath.Separator))
333		if first == "" || first == "." || strings.HasPrefix(first, ".") {
334			return Item{}, nil, fmt.Errorf("%s is not inside a visible try under %s", current, s.triesRoot)
335		}
336		return s.Resolve(ctx, filepath.Join(s.triesRoot, first))
337	}
338	
339	func (s *Service) hasCommit(ctx context.Context, directory string) bool {
340		if unix, _, err := s.gitLastCommit(ctx, directory); err == nil && unix > 0 {
341			return true
342		}
343		_, err := s.gitRun(ctx, directory, "rev-parse", "--verify", "HEAD")
344		return err == nil
345	}
346	
347	func (s *Service) ensureInitialCommit(ctx context.Context, directory, name string) (bool, error) {
348		if s.hasCommit(ctx, directory) {
349			return false, nil
350		}
351		empty, err := isEmptyWorkTree(directory)
352		if err != nil {
353			return false, err
354		}
355		if empty {
356			readme := filepath.Join(directory, "README.md")
357			file, err := os.OpenFile(readme, os.O_WRONLY|os.O_CREATE|os.O_EXCL, 0o644)
358			if err != nil {
359				return false, err
360			}
361			if _, err := fmt.Fprintf(file, "# %s\n", name); err != nil {
362				_ = file.Close()
363				return false, err
364			}
365			if err := file.Close(); err != nil {
366				return false, err
367			}
368		}
369		if _, err := s.gitRun(ctx, directory, "add", "--all"); err != nil {
370			return false, err
371		}
372		if _, err := s.gitRun(ctx, directory, "commit", "-m", "chore: graduate experiment into a project"); err != nil {
373			return false, err
374		}
375		return true, nil
376	}
377	
378	func (s *Service) rollbackGraduation(result GraduateResult, cause error) (GraduateResult, error) {
379		rollbackErr := rejectExisting(result.Plan.Source)
380		if rollbackErr == nil {
381			rollbackErr = s.rename(result.Plan.Destination, result.Plan.Source)
382		}
383		result.RollbackError = rollbackErr
384		result.RolledBack = rollbackErr == nil
385		if rollbackErr == nil {
386			result.Moved = false
387		}
388		return result, &FinalizeError{
389			Source: result.Plan.Source, Destination: result.Plan.Destination,
390			Cause: cause, RollbackErr: rollbackErr,
391		}
392	}
393	
394	func rejectExisting(path string) error {
395		if _, err := os.Lstat(path); err == nil {
396			return fmt.Errorf("%s already exists", path)
397		} else if !errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
398			return fmt.Errorf("inspect graduation destination %s: %w", path, err)
399		}
400		return nil
401	}
402	
403	func isEmptyWorkTree(directory string) (bool, error) {
404		entries, err := os.ReadDir(directory)
405		if err != nil {
406			return false, err
407		}
408		for _, entry := range entries {
409			if entry.Name() != ".git" {
410				return false, nil
411			}
412		}
413		return true, nil
414	}
415	
416	func sameFilesystem(source, destination string) (bool, error) {
417		sourceAncestor, err := nearestExisting(source)
418		if err != nil {
419			return false, err
420		}
421		destinationAncestor, err := nearestExisting(destination)
422		if err != nil {
423			return false, err
424		}
425		sourceInfo, err := os.Stat(sourceAncestor)
426		if err != nil {
427			return false, err
428		}
429		destinationInfo, err := os.Stat(destinationAncestor)
430		if err != nil {
431			return false, err
432		}
433		sourceDevice, sourceOK := deviceNumber(sourceInfo)
434		destinationDevice, destinationOK := deviceNumber(destinationInfo)
435		if !sourceOK || !destinationOK {
436			// os.Rename remains the final authority on platforms whose FileInfo does
437			// not expose a Unix-style device number.
438			return true, nil
439		}
440		return sourceDevice == destinationDevice, nil
441	}
442	
443	func nearestExisting(path string) (string, error) {
444		path = filepath.Clean(path)
445		for {
446			if _, err := os.Stat(path); err == nil {
447				return path, nil
448			} else if !errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
449				return "", err
450			}
451			parent := filepath.Dir(path)
452			if parent == path {
453				return "", fmt.Errorf("no existing ancestor for %s", path)
454			}
455			path = parent
456		}
457	}
458	
459	func deviceNumber(info fs.FileInfo) (uint64, bool) {
460		value := reflect.ValueOf(info.Sys())
461		if !value.IsValid() {
462			return 0, false
463		}
464		if value.Kind() == reflect.Pointer {
465			if value.IsNil() {
466				return 0, false
467			}
468			value = value.Elem()
469		}
470		if value.Kind() != reflect.Struct {
471			return 0, false
472		}
473		device := value.FieldByName("Dev")
474		if !device.IsValid() {
475			return 0, false
476		}
477		switch device.Kind() {
478		case reflect.Uint, reflect.Uint8, reflect.Uint16, reflect.Uint32, reflect.Uint64, reflect.Uintptr:
479			return device.Uint(), true
480		case reflect.Int, reflect.Int8, reflect.Int16, reflect.Int32, reflect.Int64:
481			return uint64(device.Int()), true
482		default:
483			return 0, false
484		}
485	}

26		// ErrAmbiguous identifies a reference that needs a more specific name or ID.
27		ErrAmbiguous = errors.New("ambiguous try reference")

29	
30	// Diagnostic is one non-fatal inventory failure. Other valid Tries remain in
31	// the result when a catalog record, directory, or Git probe cannot be read.
32	type Diagnostic struct {
33		Path      string
34		Operation string
35		Err       error
36	}
37	
38	func (d Diagnostic) Error() string {
39		operation := d.Operation
40		if operation == "" {
41			operation = "inspect"
42		}
43		if d.Path == "" {
44			return fmt.Sprintf("%s: %v", operation, d.Err)
45		}
46		return fmt.Sprintf("%s %s: %v", operation, d.Path, d.Err)
47	}
48	
49	func (d Diagnostic) Unwrap() error { return d.Err }
50	
51	// Candidate is the deterministic, human-readable part of an ambiguous match.
52	type Candidate struct {
53		ID       string
54		Name     string
55		Basename string
56		Path     string
57	}
58	
59	// NotFoundError describes an unsuccessful reference lookup.
60	type NotFoundError struct {
61		Ref  string
62		Root string
63	}
64	
65	func (e *NotFoundError) Error() string {
66		return fmt.Sprintf("no try matching %q under %s", e.Ref, e.Root)
67	}
68	
69	func (e *NotFoundError) Unwrap() error { return ErrNotFound }

71	// AmbiguousError lists every candidate rather than silently picking whichever
72	// directory happened to have the newest mtime.
73	type AmbiguousError struct {
74		Ref        string
75		Candidates []Candidate
76	}
77	
78	func (e *AmbiguousError) Error() string {
79		labels := make([]string, 0, len(e.Candidates))
80		for _, candidate := range e.Candidates {
81			label := candidate.Basename
82			if label == "" {
83				label = candidate.Name
84			}
85			if candidate.ID != "" {
86				label += " (" + candidate.ID + ")"
87			}
88			labels = append(labels, label)
89		}
90		return fmt.Sprintf("try reference %q is ambiguous: %s", e.Ref, strings.Join(labels, ", "))
91	}

345	// NewService validates and normalizes the injected service dependencies.
346	func NewService(config ServiceConfig) (*Service, error) {
347		store := config.Store
348		registry := config.Registry
349		if store == nil && registry != nil {
350			store = registry.Store()
351		}
352		if registry == nil && store != nil {
353			registry = catalog.NewRegistry(store)
354		}
355		if store == nil || registry == nil {
356			return nil, errors.New("experiment service requires a catalog registry and store")
357		}
358		if registry.Store() != store {
359			return nil, errors.New("experiment service registry and store do not share a catalog")
360		}
361	
362		triesRoot, err := absoluteRoot(config.TriesRoot, "tries root")
363		if err != nil {
364			return nil, err
365		}
366		projectRoot, err := absoluteRoot(config.ProjectRoot, "project root")
367		if err != nil {
368			return nil, err
369		}
370		host := strings.TrimSpace(config.Host)
371		if host == "" || host != config.Host || strings.ContainsRune(host, '\x00') {
372			return nil, errors.New("experiment service host is required and must be normalized")
373		}
374		clock := config.Clock
375		if clock == nil {
376			clock = time.Now
377		}
378		workers := config.MaxEnrichment
379		if workers <= 0 {
380			workers = 4
381		}
382	
383		s := &Service{
384			registry: registry, store: store,
385			triesRoot: triesRoot, projectRoot: projectRoot, host: host,
386			clock: clock, workers: workers,
387			gitRun: gitx.Run, gitDiscover: gitx.Discover,
388			gitStatus: gitx.StatusOf, gitLastCommit: gitx.LastCommit,
389			rename: os.Rename, sameFilesystem: sameFilesystem,
390			getwd: os.Getwd,
391		}
392		s.catalogCreate = store.Create
393		s.catalogUpdate = registry.Update
394		applyHooks(s, config.Hooks)
395		return s, nil
396	}

448	func candidatesOf(items []Item) []Candidate {
449		candidates := make([]Candidate, len(items))
450		for index, item := range items {
451			candidates[index] = Candidate{
452				ID: item.ID, Name: item.Name, Basename: item.Basename, Path: item.Live.CurrentPath,
453			}
454		}
455		sort.Slice(candidates, func(i, j int) bool {
456			left, right := strings.ToLower(candidates[i].Basename), strings.ToLower(candidates[j].Basename)
457			if left != right {
458				return left < right
459			}
460			if candidates[i].Basename != candidates[j].Basename {
461				return candidates[i].Basename < candidates[j].Basename
462			}
463			return candidates[i].ID < candidates[j].ID
464		})
465		return candidates
466	}

477			Created: copy.Created, LastOpened: copy.LastOpened,
478			RemoteIdentity: copy.RemoteIdentity,

485			item.OriginURL = copy.Experiment.OriginURL
486		}

489		} else if copy.Experiment != nil && copy.Experiment.OriginalPath != "" {
490			item.Basename = filepath.Base(copy.Experiment.OriginalPath)
491		}

1	// Package pathx provides the path-safety checks shared by filesystem lifecycle
2	// operations. The checks are strict: a destination must be below its root, not
3	// merely share a string prefix with it, and symlinks are resolved before that
4	// decision is made.
5	package pathx
6	
7	import (
8		"errors"
9		"fmt"
10		"io/fs"
11		"os"
12		"path/filepath"
13		"slices"
14		"strings"
15	)
16	
17	var (
18		// ErrOutsideRoot reports a path that does not resolve below the requested root.
19		ErrOutsideRoot = errors.New("path is outside root")
20		// ErrRoot reports an operation that named the root itself rather than a child.
21		ErrRoot = errors.New("path is the root itself")
22		// ErrTraversal reports an explicit .. component in an unclean input path.
23		ErrTraversal = errors.New("path contains parent traversal")
24		// ErrInvalidComponent reports a value that is not one filesystem component.
25		ErrInvalidComponent = errors.New("invalid path component")
26	)
27	
28	// Canonical returns an absolute, clean path with symlinks resolved. If the final
29	// path does not exist yet, it resolves the nearest existing ancestor and then
30	// appends the missing suffix. This is the form needed to validate a destination
31	// before creating or moving anything into it.
32	func Canonical(path string) (string, error) {
33		if path == "" {
34			return "", fmt.Errorf("canonical path: empty path")
35		}
36		absolute, err := filepath.Abs(path)
37		if err != nil {
38			return "", fmt.Errorf("make %q absolute: %w", path, err)
39		}
40		absolute = filepath.Clean(absolute)
41	
42		probe := absolute
43		var missing []string
44		for {
45			resolved, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(probe)
46			if err == nil {
47				slices.Reverse(missing)
48				parts := append([]string{resolved}, missing...)
49				return filepath.Clean(filepath.Join(parts...)), nil
50			}
51			if !errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
52				return "", fmt.Errorf("resolve %q: %w", path, err)
53			}
54			// EvalSymlinks reports ErrNotExist both for a genuinely missing component
55			// and for a symlink whose target is missing. Treating the latter as an
56			// ordinary lexical suffix would make an escape look as though it remained
57			// below its root. Resolve the link target explicitly before appending the
58			// still-missing suffix.
59			if info, lstatErr := os.Lstat(probe); lstatErr == nil && info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 {
60				target, readErr := os.Readlink(probe)
61				if readErr != nil {
62					return "", fmt.Errorf("read unresolved symlink %q: %w", probe, readErr)
63				}
64				if hasParentTraversal(target) {
65					return "", fmt.Errorf("unresolved symlink %q target %q: %w", probe, target, ErrTraversal)
66				}
67				if !filepath.IsAbs(target) {
68					target = filepath.Join(filepath.Dir(probe), target)
69				}
70				resolved, resolveErr := Canonical(target)
71				if resolveErr != nil {
72					return "", fmt.Errorf("resolve target of %q: %w", probe, resolveErr)
73				}
74				slices.Reverse(missing)
75				parts := append([]string{resolved}, missing...)
76				return filepath.Clean(filepath.Join(parts...)), nil
77			} else if lstatErr != nil && !errors.Is(lstatErr, fs.ErrNotExist) {
78				return "", fmt.Errorf("inspect unresolved path %q: %w", probe, lstatErr)
79			}
80			parent := filepath.Dir(probe)
81			if parent == probe {
82				return "", fmt.Errorf("resolve %q: no existing ancestor: %w", path, err)
83			}
84			missing = append(missing, filepath.Base(probe))
85			probe = parent
86		}
87	}
88	
89	// CanonicalChild returns candidate in canonical form when it resolves strictly
90	// below root. It rejects root itself, lexical .. traversal, sibling-prefix
91	// confusion, and paths that escape through a symlink.
92	func CanonicalChild(root, candidate string) (string, error) {
93		if hasParentTraversal(candidate) {
94			return "", fmt.Errorf("%q: %w", candidate, ErrTraversal)
95		}
96		canonicalRoot, err := Canonical(root)
97		if err != nil {
98			return "", fmt.Errorf("canonicalize root: %w", err)
99		}
100		canonicalCandidate, err := Canonical(candidate)
101		if err != nil {
102			return "", fmt.Errorf("canonicalize candidate: %w", err)
103		}
104	
105		rel, err := filepath.Rel(canonicalRoot, canonicalCandidate)
106		if err != nil {
107			return "", fmt.Errorf("compare %q with root %q: %w", candidate, root, err)
108		}
109		switch {
110		case rel == ".":
111			return "", fmt.Errorf("%q: %w", candidate, ErrRoot)
112		case filepath.IsAbs(rel), rel == "..", strings.HasPrefix(rel, ".."+string(filepath.Separator)):
113			return "", fmt.Errorf("%q is not below %q: %w", candidate, root, ErrOutsideRoot)
114		default:
115			return canonicalCandidate, nil
116		}
117	}
118	
119	// IsChild reports whether candidate resolves strictly below root. Policy
120	// rejections are returned as false without hiding filesystem errors.
121	func IsChild(root, candidate string) (bool, error) {
122		_, err := CanonicalChild(root, candidate)
123		if err == nil {
124			return true, nil
125		}
126		if errors.Is(err, ErrOutsideRoot) || errors.Is(err, ErrRoot) || errors.Is(err, ErrTraversal) {
127			return false, nil
128		}
129		return false, err
130	}
131	
132	// ValidateComponent requires a non-empty relative value containing exactly one
133	// path component. Both slash styles are rejected so state synced between Unix
134	// and Windows cannot acquire a different meaning on another host.
135	func ValidateComponent(component string) error {
136		switch {
137		case strings.TrimSpace(component) == "":
138			return fmt.Errorf("empty component: %w", ErrInvalidComponent)
139		case strings.ContainsRune(component, '\x00'):
140			return fmt.Errorf("component contains NUL: %w", ErrInvalidComponent)
141		case component == "." || component == "..":
142			return fmt.Errorf("component %q is reserved: %w", component, ErrInvalidComponent)
143		case filepath.IsAbs(component) || filepath.VolumeName(component) != "" || driveQualified(component):
144			return fmt.Errorf("component %q is absolute or drive-qualified: %w", component, ErrInvalidComponent)
145		case strings.ContainsAny(component, `/\\`):
146			return fmt.Errorf("component %q contains a path separator: %w", component, ErrInvalidComponent)
147		case filepath.Clean(component) != component || filepath.Base(component) != component:
148			return fmt.Errorf("component %q is not a single clean name: %w", component, ErrInvalidComponent)
149		default:
150			return nil
151		}
152	}
153	
154	// JoinChild validates every component, joins it below root, and returns the
155	// canonical destination. It is suitable for paths such as
156	// <project-root>/<category>/<name>, where each user-supplied value must remain a
157	// single component.
158	func JoinChild(root string, components ...string) (string, error) {
159		if len(components) == 0 {
160			return "", fmt.Errorf("join child: no components: %w", ErrRoot)
161		}
162		for i, component := range components {
163			if err := ValidateComponent(component); err != nil {
164				return "", fmt.Errorf("component %d: %w", i, err)
165			}
166		}
167		canonicalRoot, err := Canonical(root)
168		if err != nil {
169			return "", fmt.Errorf("canonicalize root: %w", err)
170		}
171		return CanonicalChild(canonicalRoot, filepath.Join(append([]string{canonicalRoot}, components...)...))
172	}
173	
174	func driveQualified(component string) bool {
175		if len(component) < 2 || component[1] != ':' {
176			return false
177		}
178		letter := component[0]
179		return letter >= 'a' && letter <= 'z' || letter >= 'A' && letter <= 'Z'
180	}
181	
182	func hasParentTraversal(path string) bool {
183		for _, component := range strings.FieldsFunc(path, func(r rune) bool {
184			return r == '/' || r == '\\'
185		}) {
186			if component == ".." {
187				return true
188			}
189		}
190		return false
191	}

12	func TestCanonicalChildAcceptsChildAndRejectsRoot(t *testing.T) {
13		root := t.TempDir()
14		child := filepath.Join(root, "child")
15		if err := os.Mkdir(child, 0o755); err != nil {
16			t.Fatal(err)
17		}
18	
19		got, err := pathx.CanonicalChild(root, child)
20		if err != nil {
21			t.Fatalf("CanonicalChild: %v", err)
22		}
23		want, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(child)
24		if err != nil {
25			t.Fatal(err)
26		}
27		if got != want {
28			t.Errorf("CanonicalChild = %q, want %q", got, want)
29		}
30		if _, err := pathx.CanonicalChild(root, root); !errors.Is(err, pathx.ErrRoot) {
31			t.Errorf("root itself should be rejected with ErrRoot, got %v", err)
32		}
33	}

44		}

47			t.Errorf("sibling prefix should not count as containment, got %v", err)

50		if _, err := pathx.CanonicalChild(root, traversal); !errors.Is(err, pathx.ErrTraversal) {
51			t.Errorf("explicit .. should be rejected before cleaning, got %v", err)

604	func TestReconcileBoundsConcurrentGitDiscovery(t *testing.T) {
605		var active atomic.Int32
606		var maximum atomic.Int32
607		hooks := experiment.Hooks{
608			GitDiscover: func(_ context.Context, directory string) (gitx.Repo, error) {
609				current := active.Add(1)
610				for {
611					seen := maximum.Load()
612					if current <= seen || maximum.CompareAndSwap(seen, current) {
613						break
614					}
615				}
616				time.Sleep(15 * time.Millisecond)
617				active.Add(-1)
618				return gitx.Repo{
619					Root: directory, MainRoot: directory,

1	package gitx
2	
3	import (
4		"context"
5		"os"
6		"path/filepath"
7		"strings"
8	)
9	
10	// Repo identifies one repository, independent of which worktree you are
11	// standing in. Two linked worktrees of the same clone share a Key.
12	type Repo struct {
13		// Root is the working-tree root of the checkout that was probed.
14		Root string
15		// GitCommonDir is the shared .git directory — the same value for every
16		// worktree of a clone, which makes it the natural identity.
17		GitCommonDir string
18		// Name is the basename users recognise the repo by.
19		Name string
20		// IsLinkedWorktree reports whether Root is a linked worktree rather than
21		// the main checkout.
22		IsLinkedWorktree bool
23		// MainRoot is the main (non-linked) checkout of this clone.
24		MainRoot string
25		// Bare reports whether the main checkout is a bare repository.
26		Bare bool
27	}
28	
29	// Key is the stable identity of the clone, shared by all its worktrees.
30	func (r Repo) Key() string { return r.GitCommonDir }
31	
32	// Discover probes dir and reports the repository containing it.
33	func Discover(ctx context.Context, dir string) (Repo, error) {
34		// A single rev-parse call answers everything: batching avoids four
35		// process spawns per repo, which matters when scanning 39 of them.
36		out, err := run(ctx, dir,
37			"rev-parse",
38			"--path-format=absolute",
39			"--show-toplevel",
40			"--git-common-dir",
41			"--is-bare-repository",
42		)
43		if err != nil {
44			return Repo{}, err
45		}
46		f := lines(out)
47		r := Repo{}
48		// A bare repo has no toplevel, so git prints one fewer line.
49		switch len(f) {
50		case 3:
51			r.Root = f[0]
52			r.GitCommonDir = f[1]
53			r.Bare = f[2] == "true"
54		case 2:
55			r.GitCommonDir = f[0]
56			r.Bare = f[1] == "true"
57		default:
58			return Repo{}, ErrNotARepo
59		}
60	
61		// The main checkout is the parent of the common .git dir, except for a
62		// bare repo (where the common dir *is* the repo).
63		if r.Bare {
64			r.MainRoot = strings.TrimSuffix(r.GitCommonDir, string(filepath.Separator))
65		} else {
66			r.MainRoot = filepath.Dir(r.GitCommonDir)
67		}
68		r.IsLinkedWorktree = r.Root != "" && r.Root != r.MainRoot
69		r.Name = filepath.Base(r.MainRoot)
70		if r.Bare {
71			// ".../foo/.bare" or ".../foo.git" should both read as "foo".
72			r.Name = strings.TrimSuffix(filepath.Base(r.MainRoot), ".git")
73			if strings.HasPrefix(r.Name, ".") {
74				r.Name = filepath.Base(filepath.Dir(r.MainRoot))
75			}
76		}
77		return r, nil
78	}
79	
80	// IsRepo reports whether dir is inside a git working tree, without the cost of
81	// a full Discover.
82	func IsRepo(ctx context.Context, dir string) bool {
83		_, err := run(ctx, dir, "rev-parse", "--git-dir")
84		return err == nil
85	}
86	
87	// DefaultBranch resolves the repository's default branch — origin/HEAD when the
88	// remote advertises it, else the first of main/master that exists locally.
89	// Returns "" when nothing can be determined, which callers must treat as
90	// "ask the user" rather than guessing.
91	func DefaultBranch(ctx context.Context, dir string) string {
92		if out, err := run(ctx, dir, "symbolic-ref", "--short", "refs/remotes/origin/HEAD"); err == nil {
93			if _, b, ok := strings.Cut(out, "/"); ok {
94				return b
95			}
96		}
97		for _, cand := range []string{"main", "master", "trunk", "develop"} {
98			if _, err := run(ctx, dir, "show-ref", "--verify", "--quiet", "refs/heads/"+cand); err == nil {
99				return cand
100			}
101		}
102		return ""
103	}
104	
105	// Remote returns the push URL of the named remote ("origin" when empty).
106	func Remote(ctx context.Context, dir, name string) string {
107		if name == "" {
108			name = "origin"
109		}
110		out, err := run(ctx, dir, "remote", "get-url", name)
111		if err != nil {
112			return ""
113		}
114		return out
115	}
116	
117	// RemoteFromConfig reads one remote URL directly from a Git common directory.
118	// It is the zero-process path used by whole-machine inventory, where spawning
119	// `git remote get-url` once per repo dominated startup. Includes and URL
120	// rewriting are deliberately not evaluated; callers that need Git's complete
121	// semantics should use Remote instead.
122	func RemoteFromConfig(commonDir, name string) string {
123		if commonDir == "" {
124			return ""
125		}
126		if name == "" {
127			name = "origin"
128		}
129		b, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(commonDir, "config"))
130		if err != nil {
131			return ""
132		}
133		want := `remote "` + name + `"`
134		section := ""
135		for _, raw := range strings.Split(string(b), "\n") {
136			line := strings.TrimSpace(raw)
137			if line == "" || strings.HasPrefix(line, "#") || strings.HasPrefix(line, ";") {
138				continue
139			}
140			if strings.HasPrefix(line, "[") && strings.HasSuffix(line, "]") {
141				section = strings.TrimSpace(line[1 : len(line)-1])
142				continue
143			}
144			if section != want {
145				continue
146			}
147			key, value, ok := strings.Cut(line, "=")
148			if ok && strings.TrimSpace(key) == "url" {
149				return strings.Trim(strings.TrimSpace(value), `"`)
150			}
151		}
152		return ""
153	}

1	// Package gitx wraps the git porcelain commands dev depends on. Every helper
2	// shells out to git rather than linking a Go implementation: git is already a
3	// hard dependency, its porcelain formats are stable and documented, and this
4	// keeps dev's behaviour identical to what the user sees when they run the same
5	// command by hand.
6	package gitx
7	
8	import (
9		"bytes"
10		"context"
11		"errors"
12		"fmt"
13		"os/exec"
14		"strings"
15	)
16	
17	// ErrNotARepo is returned when a directory is not inside a git working tree.
18	var ErrNotARepo = errors.New("not a git repository")
19	
20	// Error carries the failing command and git's own stderr, which is almost
21	// always more useful than the exit status alone.
22	type Error struct {
23		Args   []string
24		Dir    string
25		Stderr string
26		Err    error
27	}
28	
29	func (e *Error) Error() string {
30		msg := strings.TrimSpace(e.Stderr)
31		if msg == "" {
32			msg = e.Err.Error()
33		}
34		return fmt.Sprintf("git %s: %s", strings.Join(e.Args, " "), msg)
35	}
36	
37	func (e *Error) Unwrap() error { return e.Err }
38	
39	// run executes git in dir and returns trimmed stdout.
40	func run(ctx context.Context, dir string, args ...string) (string, error) {
41		// -c core.quotepath=false keeps non-ASCII paths readable rather than
42		// octal-escaped, which matters for the Chinese-named files in these repos.
43		full := append([]string{"-c", "core.quotepath=false"}, args...)
44		cmd := exec.CommandContext(ctx, "git", full...)
45		cmd.Dir = dir
46		var stdout, stderr bytes.Buffer
47		cmd.Stdout = &stdout
48		cmd.Stderr = &stderr
49		if err := cmd.Run(); err != nil {
50			gerr := &Error{Args: args, Dir: dir, Stderr: stderr.String(), Err: err}
51			if strings.Contains(gerr.Stderr, "not a git repository") {
52				return "", fmt.Errorf("%s: %w", dir, ErrNotARepo)
53			}
54			return "", gerr
55		}
56		return strings.TrimRight(stdout.String(), "\n"), nil
57	}
58	
59	// Run executes an arbitrary git command in dir. Exported for the few callers
60	// (park's wip commit, done's merge) that need a one-off command.
61	func Run(ctx context.Context, dir string, args ...string) (string, error) {
62		return run(ctx, dir, args...)
63	}
64	
65	// lines splits git output into non-empty lines.
66	func lines(s string) []string {
67		if s == "" {
68			return nil
69		}
70		out := strings.Split(s, "\n")
71		filtered := out[:0]
72		for _, l := range out {
73			if l != "" {
74				filtered = append(filtered, l)
75			}
76		}
77		return filtered
78	}
79	
80	// nulLines splits NUL-delimited git output (-z forms).
81	func nulLines(s string) []string {
82		s = strings.TrimRight(s, "\x00")
83		if s == "" {
84			return nil
85		}
86		return strings.Split(s, "\x00")
87	}
88

1	// Package forge wraps the GitHub and GitLab CLIs. Both are optional: every
2	// entry point degrades to plain git, because a workflow that hard-depends on a
3	// forge CLI being installed and authenticated stops working on exactly the
4	// machines where you most need it.
5	package forge
6	
7	import (
8		"bytes"

20	
21	// Kind identifies a forge.
22	type Kind string
23	
24	const (
25		// GitHub is served by the gh CLI.
26		GitHub Kind = "github"
27		// GitLab is served by the glab CLI.
28		GitLab Kind = "gitlab"
29		// Unknown is any other host, or none.
30		Unknown Kind = "unknown"
31	)
32	
33	// ErrNoCLI reports that the forge's CLI is not installed.
34	type ErrNoCLI struct {
35		Kind Kind
36		Bin  string
37	}
38	
39	func (e *ErrNoCLI) Error() string {
40		return fmt.Sprintf("%s support needs the %q CLI, which is not installed", e.Kind, e.Bin)
41	}
42	
43	// Forge is the subset of forge behaviour dev uses.
44	type Forge interface {
45		Kind() Kind
46		// Bin is the CLI binary name.
47		Bin() string
48		Available() bool
49		// CreatePR opens a pull/merge request from head into base.
50		CreatePR(ctx context.Context, dir string, req PRRequest) (string, error)
51		// CreateRepo creates a remote repository from an existing local one.
52		CreateRepo(ctx context.Context, dir string, req RepoRequest) (string, error)
53		// CloneURL renders the clone target for an owner/name reference.
54		CloneURL(ref string) string
55		// ListRepos lists repositories visible to the authenticated user.
56		ListRepos(ctx context.Context, limit int) ([]RemoteRepo, error)
57	}
58	
59	// RemoteRepo is one repository visible through a forge CLI.
60	type RemoteRepo struct {
61		Forge         Kind      `json:"forge"`
62		Name          string    `json:"name"`
63		FullName      string    `json:"full_name"`
64		Description   string    `json:"description,omitempty"`
65		URL           string    `json:"url"`
66		CloneURL      string    `json:"clone_url"`
67		SSHURL        string    `json:"ssh_url,omitempty"`
68		Visibility    string    `json:"visibility,omitempty"`
69		DefaultBranch string    `json:"default_branch,omitempty"`
70		Archived      bool      `json:"archived"`
71		Fork          bool      `json:"fork"`
72		UpdatedAt     time.Time `json:"updated_at,omitempty"`
73	}
74	
75	// Label is the provider-qualified identity shown in a combined list.
76	func (r RemoteRepo) Label() string { return string(r.Forge) + ":" + r.FullName }
77	
78	// All returns both forge adapters, for an aggregate remote inventory.
79	func All() []Forge { return []Forge{&gh{}, &glab{}} }
80	
81	// PRRequest describes a pull/merge request to open.
82	type PRRequest struct {
83		Base  string
84		Head  string
85		Title string
86		Body  string
87		Draft bool
88		// Fill asks the CLI to derive title and body from the commits.
89		Fill bool
90		// Web opens the created request in a browser.
91		Web bool
92	}
93	
94	// RepoRequest describes a remote repository to create.
95	type RepoRequest struct {
96		Name        string
97		Description string
98		Private     bool
99		// Push pushes the current branch after creating the remote.
100		Push bool
101		// RemoteName is the git remote to add, defaulting to origin.
102		RemoteName string
103	}
104	
105	// Detect infers the forge for a checkout from its origin remote. A repo with
106	// no remote, or one on a self-hosted host neither CLI knows, resolves to
107	// Unknown — which callers must treat as "use plain git".
108	func Detect(ctx context.Context, dir string) Kind {
109		return FromURL(gitx.Remote(ctx, dir, "origin"))
110	}
111	
112	// FromURL classifies a remote URL.
113	func FromURL(url string) Kind {
114		u := strings.ToLower(url)
115		switch {
116		case u == "":
117			return Unknown
118		case strings.Contains(u, "github.com"), strings.Contains(u, "github."):
119			return GitHub
120		case strings.Contains(u, "gitlab.com"), strings.Contains(u, "gitlab."):
121			return GitLab
122		}
123		return Unknown
124	}
125	
126	// For returns the adapter for a kind.
127	func For(k Kind) (Forge, error) {
128		switch k {
129		case GitHub:
130			return &gh{}, nil
131		case GitLab:
132			return &glab{}, nil
133		}
134		return nil, errors.New("no forge CLI for this remote; falling back to plain git")
135	}
136	
137	// Preferred returns the first available forge, for commands like `repo new`
138	// that have no existing remote to infer from.
139	func Preferred() (Forge, error) {
140		for _, f := range []Forge{&gh{}, &glab{}} {
141			if f.Available() {
142				return f, nil
143			}
144		}
145		return nil, errors.New("neither gh nor glab is installed")
146	}
147	
148	// run executes a forge CLI, streaming stderr through so the user sees the
149	// CLI's own authentication prompts and error messages verbatim.
150	func run(ctx context.Context, bin, dir string, args ...string) (string, error) {
151		cmd := exec.CommandContext(ctx, bin, args...)
152		cmd.Dir = dir
153		var stdout, stderr bytes.Buffer
154		cmd.Stdout = &stdout
155		cmd.Stderr = &stderr
156		cmd.Stdin = os.Stdin
157		if err := cmd.Run(); err != nil {
158			detail := strings.TrimSpace(stderr.String())
159			if detail != "" {
160				return strings.TrimSpace(stdout.String()), fmt.Errorf("%s %s: %s: %w",
161					bin, strings.Join(args, " "), detail, err)
162			}
163			return strings.TrimSpace(stdout.String()), fmt.Errorf("%s %s: %w", bin, strings.Join(args, " "), err)
164		}
165		return strings.TrimSpace(stdout.String()), nil
166	}
167	
168	func have(bin string) bool {
169		_, err := exec.LookPath(bin)
170		return err == nil
171	}
172	
173	// IdentityFromURL returns a forge and owner/name identity for an HTTPS or SSH
174	// Git remote. It is used to match remote inventories to local clones without
175	// assuming the checkout directory has the same name.
176	func IdentityFromURL(raw string) (Kind, string) {
177		kind := FromURL(raw)
178		if kind == Unknown {
179			return Unknown, ""
180		}
181		s := strings.TrimSpace(raw)
182		if strings.Contains(s, "://") {
183			if parsed, err := url.Parse(s); err == nil {
184				s = strings.TrimPrefix(parsed.Path, "/")
185			}
186		} else if at := strings.IndexByte(s, '@'); at >= 0 {
187			// SCP-style SSH: git@github.com:owner/repo.git
188			s = s[at+1:]
189			if colon := strings.IndexByte(s, ':'); colon >= 0 {
190				s = s[colon+1:]
191			}
192		}
193		s = strings.Trim(strings.TrimSuffix(s, ".git"), "/")
194		return kind, s
195	}

12	// gh drives the GitHub CLI.
13	type gh struct{}
14	
15	func (g *gh) Kind() Kind      { return GitHub }
16	func (g *gh) Bin() string     { return "gh" }
17	func (g *gh) Available() bool { return have("gh") }
18	
19	// CreatePR opens a GitHub pull request.
20	func (g *gh) CreatePR(ctx context.Context, dir string, req PRRequest) (string, error) {
21		if !g.Available() {
22			return "", &ErrNoCLI{Kind: GitHub, Bin: "gh"}
23		}
24		args := []string{"pr", "create", "--base", req.Base, "--head", req.Head}
25		switch {
26		case req.Title != "":
27			args = append(args, "--title", req.Title, "--body", req.Body)
28		default:
29			// --fill derives title and body from the branch's commits, which is
30			// the right default for a solo workflow where the commits already say
31			// what happened.
32			args = append(args, "--fill")
33		}
34		if req.Draft {
35			args = append(args, "--draft")
36		}
37		if req.Web {
38			args = append(args, "--web")
39		}
40		out, err := run(ctx, "gh", dir, args...)
41		return lastURL(out), err
42	}
43	
44	// CreateRepo creates a GitHub repository from the local checkout.
45	func (g *gh) CreateRepo(ctx context.Context, dir string, req RepoRequest) (string, error) {
46		if !g.Available() {
47			return "", &ErrNoCLI{Kind: GitHub, Bin: "gh"}
48		}
49		remote := req.RemoteName
50		if remote == "" {
51			remote = "origin"
52		}
53		args := []string{"repo", "create", req.Name, "--source", ".", "--remote", remote}
54		if req.Private {
55			args = append(args, "--private")
56		} else {
57			args = append(args, "--public")
58		}
59		if req.Description != "" {
60			args = append(args, "--description", req.Description)
61		}
62		if req.Push {
63			args = append(args, "--push")
64		}
65		out, err := run(ctx, "gh", dir, args...)
66		return lastURL(out), err
67	}
68	
69	// CloneURL renders a clone target. gh accepts a bare owner/name, so a
70	// shorthand reference is passed through untouched.
71	func (g *gh) CloneURL(ref string) string {
72		if strings.Contains(ref, "://") || strings.HasPrefix(ref, "git@") {
73			return ref
74		}
75		return "https://github.com/" + strings.TrimSuffix(ref, ".git") + ".git"
76	}
77	
78	// lastURL picks the URL out of a CLI's chatter, which may print progress
79	// lines before the created resource's address.
80	func lastURL(out string) string {
81		var found string
82		for _, line := range strings.Fields(out) {
83			if strings.HasPrefix(line, "http://") || strings.HasPrefix(line, "https://") {
84				found = line
85			}
86		}
87		if found == "" {
88			return strings.TrimSpace(out)
89		}
90		return found
91	}
92	
93	// ListRepos lists GitHub repositories visible to the authenticated user —
94	// owned, collaborated on, and organisation membership — most recently pushed
95	// first. gh api is intentionally used instead of a custom HTTP client:
96	// authentication and token refresh stay owned by the forge CLI.
97	func (g *gh) ListRepos(ctx context.Context, limit int) ([]RemoteRepo, error) {
98		if !g.Available() {
99			return nil, &ErrNoCLI{Kind: GitHub, Bin: "gh"}
100		}
101		ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, 15*time.Second)
102		defer cancel()
103		if limit <= 0 {
104			limit = 100
105		}
106		// GitHub caps per_page at 100. The remote view is a navigator, not a
107		// complete backup inventory; / filters this recent working set.
108		if limit > 100 {
109			limit = 100
110		}
111		out, err := run(ctx, "gh", "", "api", "user/repos", "--method", "GET",
112			"-f", "per_page="+strconv.Itoa(limit), "-f", "sort=pushed", "-f", "direction=desc")
113		if err != nil {
114			return nil, err
115		}
116		return parseGitHubRepos(out)
117	}
118	
119	func parseGitHubRepos(out string) ([]RemoteRepo, error) {
120		var raw []struct {
121			Name          string `json:"name"`
122			FullName      string `json:"full_name"`
123			Description   string `json:"description"`
124			URL           string `json:"html_url"`
125			CloneURL      string `json:"clone_url"`
126			SSHURL        string `json:"ssh_url"`
127			Visibility    string `json:"visibility"`
128			Fork          bool   `json:"fork"`
129			Archived      bool   `json:"archived"`
130			PushedAt      string `json:"pushed_at"`
131			DefaultBranch string `json:"default_branch"`
132		}
133		if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(out), &raw); err != nil {
134			return nil, fmt.Errorf("decode gh api user/repos: %w", err)
135		}
136		result := make([]RemoteRepo, 0, len(raw))
137		for _, r := range raw {
138			updated, _ := time.Parse(time.RFC3339, r.PushedAt)
139			result = append(result, RemoteRepo{
140				Forge: GitHub, Name: r.Name, FullName: r.FullName,
141				Description: r.Description, URL: r.URL,
142				CloneURL: r.CloneURL, SSHURL: r.SSHURL,
143				Visibility: r.Visibility, DefaultBranch: r.DefaultBranch,
144				Archived: r.Archived, Fork: r.Fork, UpdatedAt: updated,
145			})
146		}
147		return result, nil
148	}

13	// Version is set at build time via -ldflags.
14	var Version = "dev"
15	
16	const rootLong = `dev is a thin glue layer over git, worktrees, forges and agent runtimes.
17	
18	It exists to keep three things separate that otherwise collapse into one:
19	
20	  git remote      durable code state, the source of truth
21	  git worktree    a disposable local checkout
22	  herdr / tmux    a per-host live runtime
23	  dev             human intent: what am I working on, and what is next
24	
25	Everything derivable from git or the runtime is derived live. dev persists only
26	what git cannot answer — a task's state, its owner and its next action — so
27	closing a runtime session never means losing the thread.`
28	
29	// NewRootCommand builds the whole command tree writing to the process streams.
30	func NewRootCommand() *cobra.Command {
31		return NewRootCommandWithIO(os.Stdout, os.Stderr)
32	}
33	
34	// NewRootCommandWithIO builds the command tree writing to the given streams.
35	// Commands write through App rather than through cobra, so this is the seam
36	// tests use to capture output without redirecting the process's file
37	// descriptors.
38	func NewRootCommandWithIO(out, errOut io.Writer) *cobra.Command {
39		app := &App{Out: out, Err: errOut}
40	
41		root := &cobra.Command{
42			Use:           "dev",
43			Short:         "Manage repos, worktrees and work-in-progress across agent runtimes",
44			Long:          rootLong,
45			Version:       Version,
46			SilenceUsage:  true,
47			SilenceErrors: true,
48			// Bare `dev` shows the inventory, which is the question the tool
49			// exists to answer.
50			RunE: func(cmd *cobra.Command, args []string) error {
51				if printSkill, _ := cmd.Flags().GetBool("skill"); printSkill {
52					out, err := skill.Render()
53					if err != nil {
54						return err
55					}
56					fmt.Fprint(app.Out, out)
57					return nil
58				}
59				// A terminal gets the dashboard; a pipe gets the listing, so
60				// `dev | grep` and `dev > file` behave as expected.
61				if interactive() {
62					return runTUI(app)
63				}
64				return runList(app, listOptions{})
65			},
66			PersistentPreRunE: func(cmd *cobra.Command, args []string) error {
67				return app.Load()
68			},
69		}
70	
71		pf := root.PersistentFlags()
72		pf.StringVar(&app.configPath, "config", "", "path to config.toml (default: $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/dev/config.toml)")
73		pf.StringVar(&app.runtimeOverride, "runtime", "", "override runtime backend: herdr, tmux or none")
74		pf.BoolVar(&app.noRuntime, "no-runtime", false, "do not touch any terminal multiplexer")

77		// skill, so a dotfiles installer can sync it without vendoring a copy.
78		root.Flags().Bool("skill", false, "print the bundled agent skill and exit")
79	
80		root.AddCommand(

1	// Package cli assembles dev's command tree. Commands stay thin: they parse
2	// flags, call into the domain packages, and render. All policy lives in
3	// config, catalog, gitx, wt, task and runtime so it can be tested without a terminal.
4	package cli
5	
6	import (
7		"context"
8		"fmt"
9		"io"
10		"os"
11	
12		"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/catalog"
13		"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/config"
14		"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/runtime"
15		"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/task"
16	)
17	
18	// App is the state shared by every command.
19	type App struct {
20		Cfg      config.Config
21		Tasks    *task.Store
22		Catalog  *catalog.Store
23		Registry *catalog.Registry
24	
25		Out io.Writer
26		Err io.Writer
27	
28		// configPath is the --config override; empty means the XDG default.
29		configPath string
30		// runtimeOverride is the --runtime flag; empty means use the config.
31		runtimeOverride string
32		// noRuntime disables all multiplexer interaction for one invocation.
33		noRuntime bool
34	}
35	
36	// Load reads configuration and prepares the shared stores.
37	func (a *App) Load() error {
38		cfg, err := config.Load(a.configPath)
39		if err != nil {
40			return err
41		}
42		a.Cfg = cfg
43		if a.Out == nil {
44			a.Out = os.Stdout
45		}
46		if a.Err == nil {
47			a.Err = os.Stderr
48		}
49		a.Tasks = task.NewStore(cfg.TasksDir())
50		a.Catalog = catalog.NewStore(cfg.AssetsDir(), catalog.WithDiagnosticSink(func(diagnostic catalog.Diagnostic) {
51			fmt.Fprintf(a.Err, "dev: warning: %s\n", diagnostic.Error())
52		}))
53		a.Registry = catalog.NewRegistry(a.Catalog)
54		return nil
55	}
56	
57	// Runtime resolves the multiplexer backend for this invocation, honouring
58	// --runtime and --no-runtime.
59	func (a *App) Runtime() runtime.Runtime {
60		if a.noRuntime {
61			return runtime.None{}
62		}
63		backend := a.Cfg.Runtime.Backend
64		if a.runtimeOverride != "" {
65			backend = a.runtimeOverride
66		}
67		rt := runtime.Select(backend)
68		if h, ok := rt.(*runtime.Herdr); ok {
69			return h.WithMetadataSource(a.Cfg.Runtime.MetadataSource)
70		}
71		return rt
72	}
73	
74	// printf writes to the command's stdout.
75	func (a *App) printf(format string, args ...any) {

77	}

80	func (a *App) warnf(format string, args ...any) {
81		fmt.Fprintf(a.Err, "dev: "+format+"\n", args...)
82	}

86	// working directory, so the only way `dev resume` can leave the user *in* the
87	// checkout is to ask the shell to do it.
88	func (a *App) cdDirective(dir string) {
89		fmt.Fprintf(a.Out, "cd %s\n", shellQuote(dir))

2	// and ordinary repositories. Filesystem presence is host-local, so one logical
3	// asset can carry a separate location for every machine that observes it.
4	package catalog
5	
6	import (
7		"errors"

23		// nonzero schema. Callers must surface it instead of interpreting newer data
24		// using today's shape.

26		// ErrInvalidID identifies a filename stem that cannot safely name one record.
27		ErrInvalidID = errors.New("invalid catalog ID")
28	)

30	// UnsupportedSchemaError describes a record whose schema this version cannot
31	// read. It supports errors.Is(err, ErrUnsupportedSchema).

35	}

37	func (e *UnsupportedSchemaError) Error() string {
38		if e.ID == "" {
39			return fmt.Sprintf("catalog schema version %d: %v", e.Version, ErrUnsupportedSchema)
40		}
41		return fmt.Sprintf("catalog asset %s has schema version %d: %v", e.ID, e.Version, ErrUnsupportedSchema)
42	}

162	
163		Created    time.Time `toml:"created" json:"created"`
164		Discovered time.Time `toml:"discovered" json:"discovered"`

169	var validID = regexp.MustCompile(`^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]*$`)
170	
171	// ValidateID checks that id can be used as exactly one visible filename stem.
172	func ValidateID(id string) error {
173		if !validID.MatchString(id) || filepath.Base(id) != id || id == "." || id == ".." {
174			return fmt.Errorf("%q: %w", id, ErrInvalidID)
175		}
176		return nil

178	
179	// NormalizeTags trims, lowercases, deduplicates and sorts tags. Sorting makes
180	// persisted output deterministic regardless of the order in which callers add
181	// labels.
182	func NormalizeTags(tags []string) []string {
183		seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(tags))
184		for _, tag := range tags {
185			tag = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(tag))
186			if tag != "" {
187				seen[tag] = struct{}{}
188			}
189		}
190		out := make([]string, 0, len(seen))
191		for tag := range seen {
192			out = append(out, tag)
193		}
194		sort.Strings(out)
195		return out
196	}
197	
198	// Normalize applies the lossless normalizations stores use before validation.
199	func (e *Entry) Normalize() {
200		if e == nil {
201			return
202		}
203		e.Name = strings.TrimSpace(e.Name)
204		e.Tags = NormalizeTags(e.Tags)
205		e.RemoteIdentity = NormalizeRemoteIdentity(e.RemoteIdentity)
206		if e.RecoveryReceipt != nil {
207			e.RecoveryReceipt.RemoteIdentity = NormalizeRemoteIdentity(e.RecoveryReceipt.RemoteIdentity)
208		}
209	}

216		}

221	func (e Entry) HasTag(tag string) bool {
222		tag = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(tag))
223		return tag != "" && slices.Contains(e.Tags, tag)
224	}

233	func (e *Entry) SetLocation(host string, location Location) error {

235			return errors.New("set location on nil catalog entry")
236		}

239		}

247	// Clone returns a deep copy suitable for mutation before an atomic update.
248	func (e Entry) Clone() *Entry {
249		clone := e
250		clone.Tags = append([]string(nil), e.Tags...)
251		if e.Experiment != nil {
252			value := *e.Experiment
253			clone.Experiment = &value
254		}
255		if e.RecoveryReceipt != nil {

258		}

261			clone.MoveIntent = &value
262		}
263		if e.Locations != nil {
264			clone.Locations = make(map[string]Location, len(e.Locations))
265			for host, location := range e.Locations {
266				clone.Locations[host] = location
267			}
268		}
269		return &clone
270	}

272	// Validate rejects records that later lifecycle operations could not interpret
273	// safely. Store.Create fills identity and timestamps before calling it.
274	func (e Entry) Validate() error {
275		if e.SchemaVersion != CurrentSchemaVersion {
276			return &UnsupportedSchemaError{ID: e.ID, Version: e.SchemaVersion}
277		}
278		if err := ValidateID(e.ID); err != nil {
279			return err
280		}
281		switch e.Kind {
282		case KindTry:
283			if e.Experiment == nil {
284				return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s: try kind requires experiment metadata", e.ID)
285			}

287		default:
288			return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s: unknown kind %q", e.ID, e.Kind)
289		}
290		if strings.TrimSpace(e.Name) == "" {
291			return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s: name is required", e.ID)
292		}
293		if !slices.Equal(e.Tags, NormalizeTags(e.Tags)) {
294			return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s: tags must be normalized lowercase values", e.ID)
295		}

297			switch e.Experiment.Phase {

299			default:
300				return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s: unknown experiment phase %q", e.ID, e.Experiment.Phase)

302			switch {
303			case e.Kind == KindTry && e.Experiment.Phase == PhaseGraduated:
304				return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s: graduated experiment must be a repository", e.ID)
305			case e.Kind == KindRepository && e.Experiment.Phase != PhaseGraduated:
306				return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s: repository experiment history must be graduated", e.ID)
307			}
308			if e.Experiment.Started.IsZero() {
309				return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s: experiment started timestamp is required", e.ID)
310			}
311			if e.Experiment.Slug == "" {
312				return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s: experiment slug is required", e.ID)
313			}
314			if err := pathx.ValidateComponent(e.Experiment.Slug); err != nil {
315				return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s: experiment slug: %w", e.ID, err)
316			}
317			if e.Experiment.OriginalPath == "" {
318				return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s: experiment original path is required", e.ID)
319			}
320			switch e.Experiment.Phase {
321			case PhaseDeprecated:
322				if e.Experiment.DeprecatedAt.IsZero() || e.Experiment.DeprecatedPath == "" {
323					return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s: deprecated experiment requires timestamp and path", e.ID)
324				}
325			case PhaseGraduated:
326				if e.Experiment.GraduatedAt.IsZero() || e.Experiment.GraduatedPath == "" {
327					return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s: graduated experiment requires timestamp and path", e.ID)
328				}
329			}
330			if err := validateStringFields("experiment", []struct {
331				name  string
332				value string
333			}{
334				{"slug", e.Experiment.Slug},
335				{"origin_url", e.Experiment.OriginURL},
336				{"original_path", e.Experiment.OriginalPath},
337				{"deprecated_path", e.Experiment.DeprecatedPath},
338				{"graduated_path", e.Experiment.GraduatedPath},
339			}); err != nil {
340				return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s: %w", e.ID, err)
341			}
342		}
343		hosts := make([]string, 0, len(e.Locations))
344		for host := range e.Locations {
345			hosts = append(hosts, host)
346		}
347		sort.Strings(hosts)
348		for _, host := range hosts {
349			if err := validateLocation(host, e.Locations[host]); err != nil {
350				return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s: %w", e.ID, err)
351			}
352		}
353		if e.RecoveryReceipt != nil {
354			if err := validateRecoveryReceipt(*e.RecoveryReceipt); err != nil {
355				return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s: %w", e.ID, err)
356			}
357		}
358		if e.MoveIntent != nil {
359			if err := validateMoveIntent(*e.MoveIntent); err != nil {
360				return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s: %w", e.ID, err)
361			}
362		}
363		if e.Created.IsZero() || e.Discovered.IsZero() || e.Updated.IsZero() {
364			return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s: created, discovered and updated timestamps are required", e.ID)
365		}
366		return nil
367	}

369	func validateLocation(host string, location Location) error {
370		return validateLocationValue(host, location, true)
371	}
372	
373	func validateLocationForSet(host string, location Location) error {
374		return validateLocationValue(host, location, false)
375	}
376	
377	func validateLocationValue(host string, location Location, requireUpdated bool) error {
378		if err := validateHostValue("location host", host); err != nil {
379			return err
380		}
381		fields := []struct {
382			name  string
383			value string
384		}{
385			{"current_path", location.CurrentPath},
386			{"restore_path", location.RestorePath},
387			{"real_path", location.RealPath},
388			{"git_common_dir", location.GitCommonDir},
389		}
390		for _, field := range fields {
391			if strings.ContainsRune(field.value, '\x00') {
392				return fmt.Errorf("location %s %s contains NUL", host, field.name)
393			}
394		}
395		if requireUpdated && location.Updated.IsZero() {
396			return fmt.Errorf("location %s: updated timestamp is required", host)
397		}
398		switch location.State {
399		case LocationPresent:
400			if location.CurrentPath == "" {
401				return fmt.Errorf("location %s: present state requires current_path", host)
402			}
403		case LocationArchived:
404			if location.CurrentPath == "" || location.RestorePath == "" {
405				return fmt.Errorf("location %s: archived state requires current_path and restore_path", host)
406			}
407		case LocationEvicted:
408			if location.RestorePath == "" {
409				return fmt.Errorf("location %s: evicted state requires restore_path", host)
410			}
411		default:
412			return fmt.Errorf("location %s: unknown state %q", host, location.State)
413		}
414		return nil
415	}

417	func validateRecoveryReceipt(receipt RecoveryReceipt) error {
418		if err := validateHostValue("recovery receipt host", receipt.Host); err != nil {
419			return err
420		}
421		if receipt.Method == "" || receipt.Method != strings.TrimSpace(receipt.Method) {
422			return errors.New("recovery receipt method is required and must be normalized")
423		}
424		if receipt.Created.IsZero() || receipt.Verified.IsZero() {
425			return errors.New("recovery receipt requires created and verified timestamps")
426		}
427		fields := []struct {
428			name  string
429			value string
430		}{
431			{"method", receipt.Method},
432			{"source_path", receipt.SourcePath},
433			{"restore_path", receipt.RestorePath},
434			{"remote_identity", receipt.RemoteIdentity},
435			{"remote_name", receipt.RemoteName},
436			{"remote_url", receipt.RemoteURL},
437			{"revision", receipt.Revision},
438			{"refs_digest", receipt.RefsDigest},
439			{"archive_path", receipt.ArchivePath},
440			{"checksum", receipt.Checksum},
441		}
442		return validateStringFields("recovery receipt", fields)
443	}
444	
445	func validateMoveIntent(intent MoveIntent) error {
446		if err := validateHostValue("move intent host", intent.Host); err != nil {
447			return err
448		}
449		if intent.Operation == "" || intent.Operation != strings.TrimSpace(intent.Operation) {
450			return errors.New("move intent operation is required and must be normalized")
451		}
452		if intent.Started.IsZero() {
453			return errors.New("move intent started timestamp is required")
454		}
455		if intent.SourcePath == "" || intent.DestinationPath == "" {
456			return errors.New("move intent requires source and destination paths")
457		}
458		if err := validateStringFields("move intent", []struct {
459			name  string
460			value string
461		}{
462			{"operation", intent.Operation},
463			{"source_path", intent.SourcePath},
464			{"destination_path", intent.DestinationPath},
465		}); err != nil {
466			return err
467		}
468		if filepath.Clean(intent.SourcePath) == filepath.Clean(intent.DestinationPath) {
469			return errors.New("move intent source and destination are identical")
470		}
471		return nil
472	}
473	
474	func validateHostValue(name, host string) error {
475		if host == "" {
476			return fmt.Errorf("%s is required", name)
477		}
478		if host != strings.TrimSpace(host) || strings.ContainsRune(host, '\x00') {
479			return fmt.Errorf("%s %q is not normalized", name, host)
480		}
481		return nil
482	}
483	
484	func validateStringFields(scope string, fields []struct {
485		name  string
486		value string
487	}) error {
488		for _, field := range fields {
489			if strings.ContainsRune(field.value, '\x00') {
490				return fmt.Errorf("%s %s contains NUL", scope, field.name)
491			}
492		}
493		return nil
494	}

22	// AmbiguousMatchError reports records that cannot be safely distinguished. A
23	// remote-only ambiguity is never resolved by picking the first entry.
24	type AmbiguousMatchError struct {
25		Observation  Observation
26		CandidateIDs []string
27		Reason       string
28	}
29	
30	func (e *AmbiguousMatchError) Error() string {
31		reason := e.Reason
32		if reason == "" {
33			reason = "multiple records match"
34		}
35		return fmt.Sprintf("%s: %s (%s)", ErrAmbiguous, reason, strings.Join(e.CandidateIDs, ", "))
36	}

38	func (e *AmbiguousMatchError) Unwrap() error { return ErrAmbiguous }

40	// Observation is live repository identity gathered from discovery. Path is the
41	// navigation path, RealPath its physical target, and either common-dir field may
42	// carry Git's shared administrative directory. CommonDir matches repo.Repo;
43	// GitCommonDir is accepted for callers using gitx.Repo terminology.
44	type Observation struct {
45		Host           string
46		Path           string
47		RealPath       string
48		CommonDir      string
49		GitCommonDir   string
50		Name           string
51		RemoteIdentity string
52	}

54	// Registry adds live matching and lazy repository persistence to a Store.
55	type Registry struct {
56		store *Store
57		mu    sync.Mutex
58	}
59	
60	// NewRegistry returns a registry backed by store.
61	func NewRegistry(store *Store) *Registry { return &Registry{store: store} }
62	
63	// Store exposes the durable store for callers that need lower-level APIs.
64	func (r *Registry) Store() *Store {
65		if r == nil {
66			return nil
67		}
68		return r.store
69	}
70	
71	// List returns every readable catalog entry and reports skipped records through
72	// the Store's configured diagnostic sink.
73	func (r *Registry) List() ([]*Entry, error) {
74		if r == nil || r.store == nil {
75			return nil, errors.New("catalog registry has no store")
76		}
77		return r.store.List()
78	}

80	// Get loads one entry by stable catalog ID.
81	func (r *Registry) Get(id string) (*Entry, error) {
82		if r == nil || r.store == nil {
83			return nil, errors.New("catalog registry has no store")
84		}
85		return r.store.Get(id)

88	// Update applies an atomic mutation to one entry.
89	func (r *Registry) Update(id string, mutate func(*Entry) error) (*Entry, error) {
90		if r == nil || r.store == nil {
91			return nil, errors.New("catalog registry has no store")
92		}
93		r.mu.Lock()
94		defer r.mu.Unlock()
95		return r.store.Update(id, mutate)
96	}
97	
98	// Match finds an observation without changing the catalog. Exact canonical path
99	// or common-directory identity on the same host always wins. A remote identity
100	// is considered only as a conservative relocation hint.
101	func (r *Registry) Match(observation Observation) (*Entry, error) {
102		normalized, err := normalizeObservation(observation, false)
103		if err != nil {
104			return nil, err
105		}
106		entry, _, err := r.match(normalized)
107		return entry, err
108	}

110	// EnsureRepository returns the matching repository, attaching the observed host
111	// location when safe. If nothing matches—or a remote is ambiguous because it
112	// may describe another live clone—it creates a distinct repository record.
113	func (r *Registry) EnsureRepository(observation Observation) (*Entry, error) {
114		normalized, err := normalizeObservation(observation, true)
115		if err != nil {
116			return nil, err
117		}
118		if r == nil || r.store == nil {
119			return nil, errors.New("catalog registry has no store")
120		}
121	
122		r.mu.Lock()
123		defer r.mu.Unlock()
124	
125		matched, method, matchErr := r.match(normalized)
126		if matchErr == nil {
127			return r.attach(matched.ID, normalized)
128		}
129		if !errors.Is(matchErr, ErrNotFound) && !(errors.Is(matchErr, ErrAmbiguous) && method == matchRemote) {
130			return nil, matchErr
131		}
132	
133		entry := &Entry{
134			Kind:           KindRepository,
135			Name:           normalized.Name,
136			RemoteIdentity: normalized.RemoteIdentity,
137			Locations: map[string]Location{
138				normalized.Host: locationFromObservation(normalized),
139			},
140		}
141		if err := r.store.Create(entry); err != nil {
142			return nil, err
143		}
144		return entry.Clone(), nil
145	}

147	// Patch applies an atomic catalog mutation.
148	func (r *Registry) Patch(id string, mutate func(*Entry) error) (*Entry, error) {

152	// Attach explicitly records observation as id's present location. Explicit
153	// attachment may update a changed remote because the caller supplied the stable
154	// catalog identity rather than asking the remote hint to choose one.
155	func (r *Registry) Attach(id string, observation Observation) (*Entry, error) {
156		normalized, err := normalizeObservation(observation, true)
157		if err != nil {
158			return nil, err
159		}
160		if r == nil || r.store == nil {
161			return nil, errors.New("catalog registry has no store")
162		}

164		defer r.mu.Unlock()

168	func (r *Registry) attach(id string, observation Observation) (*Entry, error) {
169		return r.store.Update(id, func(entry *Entry) error {
170			if observation.RemoteIdentity != "" {
171				entry.RemoteIdentity = observation.RemoteIdentity
172			}
173			location := locationFromObservation(observation)
174			if previous, ok := entry.LocationFor(observation.Host); ok && location.GitCommonDir == "" &&
175				intersects(canonicalValues(observation.Path, observation.RealPath),
176					canonicalValues(previous.CurrentPath, previous.RestorePath, previous.RealPath)) {
177				location.GitCommonDir = previous.GitCommonDir
178			}
179			return entry.SetLocation(observation.Host, location)
180		})
181	}

183	// FindByPath performs only exact host+canonical-path matching; it never falls
184	// back to a remote identity.
185	func (r *Registry) FindByPath(host, path string) (*Entry, error) {
186		normalized, err := normalizeObservation(Observation{Host: host, Path: path}, false)
187		if err != nil {
188			return nil, err
189		}
190		entries, diagnostics, err := r.entriesWithDiagnostics()
191		if err != nil {
192			return nil, err
193		}
194		matches := exactMatches(entries, normalized)
195		if len(matches) == 0 && len(diagnostics) > 0 {
196			return nil, incompleteCatalogError(diagnostics)
197		}
198		if len(matches) > 0 {
199			r.store.reportDiagnostics(diagnostics)
200		}
201		return selectExact(normalized, matches)
202	}

206		normalized, err := normalizeObservation(Observation{Host: host, CommonDir: commonDir}, false)
207		if err != nil {
208			return nil, err
209		}
210		entries, diagnostics, err := r.entriesWithDiagnostics()
211		if err != nil {
212			return nil, err
213		}
214		matches := exactMatches(entries, normalized)
215		if len(matches) == 0 && len(diagnostics) > 0 {
216			return nil, incompleteCatalogError(diagnostics)
217		}
218		if len(matches) > 0 {
