224	type matchMethod int
225	
226	const (
227		matchNone matchMethod = iota
228		matchExact
229		matchRemote
230	)
231	
232	func (r *Registry) match(observation Observation) (*Entry, matchMethod, error) {
233		entries, diagnostics, err := r.entriesWithDiagnostics()
234		if err != nil {
235			return nil, matchNone, err
236		}
237		if matches := exactMatches(entries, observation); len(matches) > 0 {
238			r.store.reportDiagnostics(diagnostics)
239			entry, err := selectExact(observation, matches)
240			return entry, matchExact, err
241		}
242		if len(diagnostics) > 0 {
243			return nil, matchNone, incompleteCatalogError(diagnostics)
244		}
245		if observation.RemoteIdentity == "" {
246			return nil, matchNone, fmt.Errorf("catalog observation %q: %w", observation.Path, ErrNotFound)
247		}
248	
249		var remoteMatches []*Entry
250		for _, entry := range entries {
251			if NormalizeRemoteIdentity(entry.RemoteIdentity) == observation.RemoteIdentity {
252				remoteMatches = append(remoteMatches, entry)
253			}
254		}
255		Sort(remoteMatches)
256		switch len(remoteMatches) {
257		case 0:
258			return nil, matchNone, fmt.Errorf("remote %q: %w", observation.RemoteIdentity, ErrNotFound)
259		case 1:
260			if remoteCanRelocate(remoteMatches[0], observation) {
261				return remoteMatches[0], matchRemote, nil
262			}
263			return nil, matchRemote, ambiguous(observation, remoteMatches,
264				"remote also belongs to a different live clone on this host")
265		default:
266			return nil, matchRemote, ambiguous(observation, remoteMatches,
267				"remote identity matches multiple catalog records")
268		}
269	}
270	
271	func (r *Registry) entriesWithDiagnostics() ([]*Entry, []Diagnostic, error) {
272		if r == nil || r.store == nil {
273			return nil, nil, errors.New("catalog registry has no store")
274		}
275		return r.store.ListWithDiagnostics()
276	}
277	
278	func incompleteCatalogError(diagnostics []Diagnostic) error {
279		errorsToJoin := make([]error, 1, len(diagnostics)+1)
280		errorsToJoin[0] = ErrIncompleteCatalog
281		for _, diagnostic := range diagnostics {
282			errorsToJoin = append(errorsToJoin, diagnostic)
283		}
284		return errors.Join(errorsToJoin...)
285	}
286	
287	func exactMatches(entries []*Entry, observation Observation) []*Entry {
288		matched := make(map[string]*Entry)
289		observationPaths := canonicalValues(observation.Path, observation.RealPath)
290		observationCommon := canonicalValue(observation.CommonDir)
291		for _, entry := range entries {
292			location, ok := entry.LocationFor(observation.Host)
293			if !ok {
294				continue
295			}
296			locationPaths := canonicalValues(location.CurrentPath, location.RestorePath, location.RealPath)
297			pathMatch := intersects(observationPaths, locationPaths)
298			commonMatch := observationCommon != "" && observationCommon == canonicalValue(location.GitCommonDir)
299			if pathMatch || commonMatch {
300				matched[entry.ID] = entry
301			}
302		}
303		out := make([]*Entry, 0, len(matched))
304		for _, entry := range matched {
305			out = append(out, entry)
306		}
307		Sort(out)
308		return out
309	}
310	
311	func selectExact(observation Observation, matches []*Entry) (*Entry, error) {
312		switch len(matches) {
313		case 0:
314			return nil, fmt.Errorf("catalog path %q on host %q: %w", observation.Path, observation.Host, ErrNotFound)
315		case 1:
316			return matches[0], nil
317		default:
318			return nil, ambiguous(observation, matches, "canonical path or Git common directory matches multiple records")
319		}
320	}
321	
322	func ambiguous(observation Observation, entries []*Entry, reason string) error {
323		ids := make([]string, len(entries))
324		for i, entry := range entries {
325			ids[i] = entry.ID
326		}
327		sort.Strings(ids)
328		return &AmbiguousMatchError{Observation: observation, CandidateIDs: ids, Reason: reason}
329	}
330	
331	func remoteCanRelocate(entry *Entry, observation Observation) bool {
332		location, ok := entry.LocationFor(observation.Host)
333		if !ok {
334			return true
335		}
336		// Exact aliases, restore paths, and common directories were already handled.
337		// A navigation symlink may disappear while its physical clone or Git common
338		// directory remains, so every stored identity path must be absent before the
339		// remote can be treated as relocation evidence. Archives also deliberately
340		// block relocation while their bytes remain.
341		for _, path := range []string{
342			location.CurrentPath,
343			location.RestorePath,
344			location.RealPath,
345			location.GitCommonDir,
346		} {
347			if path == "" {
348				continue
349			}
350			if pathMayStillExist(path) {
351				return false
352			}
353		}
354		return true
355	}
356	
357	func pathMayStillExist(path string) bool {
358		if _, err := os.Lstat(path); err == nil || !errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
359			// Lstat deliberately counts a dangling symlink as existing evidence.
360			return true
361		}
362		canonical, err := pathx.Canonical(path)
363		if err != nil {
364			return true
365		}
366		_, err = os.Stat(canonical)
367		return err == nil || !errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist)
368	}
369	
370	func locationFromObservation(observation Observation) Location {
371		currentPath := observation.Path
372		if currentPath == "" {
373			currentPath = observation.RealPath
374		}
375		return Location{
376			State:        LocationPresent,
377			CurrentPath:  currentPath,
378			RealPath:     observation.RealPath,
379			GitCommonDir: observation.CommonDir,
380		}
381	}
382	
383	func normalizeObservation(observation Observation, requireLocation bool) (Observation, error) {
384		observation.Host = strings.TrimSpace(observation.Host)
385		observation.Name = strings.TrimSpace(observation.Name)
386		if observation.Host == "" {
387			return Observation{}, errors.New("catalog observation host is required")
388		}
389	
390		commonDir := observation.CommonDir
391		if commonDir == "" {
392			commonDir = observation.GitCommonDir
393		} else if observation.GitCommonDir != "" {
394			left, leftErr := pathx.Canonical(commonDir)
395			right, rightErr := pathx.Canonical(observation.GitCommonDir)
396			if leftErr != nil || rightErr != nil || left != right {
397				return Observation{}, errors.New("catalog observation CommonDir and GitCommonDir disagree")
398			}
399		}
400	
401		var err error
402		canonicalPath := ""
403		if observation.Path != "" {
404			observation.Path, err = absoluteClean(observation.Path)
405			if err != nil {
406				return Observation{}, fmt.Errorf("catalog observation path: %w", err)
407			}
408			canonicalPath, err = pathx.Canonical(observation.Path)
409			if err != nil {
410				return Observation{}, fmt.Errorf("catalog observation path: %w", err)
411			}
412		}
413		if observation.RealPath != "" {
414			observation.RealPath, err = pathx.Canonical(observation.RealPath)
415			if err != nil {
416				return Observation{}, fmt.Errorf("catalog observation real path: %w", err)
417			}
418			if canonicalPath != "" && canonicalPath != observation.RealPath {
419				return Observation{}, fmt.Errorf("catalog observation Path and RealPath disagree: %q != %q",
420					canonicalPath, observation.RealPath)
421			}
422		} else {
423			observation.RealPath = canonicalPath
424		}
425		if commonDir != "" {
426			observation.CommonDir, err = pathx.Canonical(commonDir)
427			if err != nil {
428				return Observation{}, fmt.Errorf("catalog observation Git common directory: %w", err)
429			}
430		}
431		observation.GitCommonDir = observation.CommonDir
432		observation.RemoteIdentity = NormalizeRemoteIdentity(observation.RemoteIdentity)
433	
434		if requireLocation && observation.Path == "" && observation.RealPath == "" {
435			return Observation{}, errors.New("catalog repository observation requires a path")
436		}
437		if requireLocation {
438			path := observation.Path
439			if path == "" {
440				path = observation.RealPath
441			}
442			info, statErr := os.Stat(path)
443			if statErr != nil {
444				return Observation{}, fmt.Errorf("catalog repository observation path %q: %w", path, statErr)
445			}
446			if !info.IsDir() {
447				return Observation{}, fmt.Errorf("catalog repository observation path %q is not a directory", path)
448			}
449			if observation.CommonDir != "" {
450				commonInfo, commonErr := os.Stat(observation.CommonDir)
451				if commonErr != nil {
452					return Observation{}, fmt.Errorf("catalog repository observation Git common directory %q: %w",
453						observation.CommonDir, commonErr)
454				}
455				if !commonInfo.IsDir() {
456					return Observation{}, fmt.Errorf("catalog repository observation Git common directory %q is not a directory",
457						observation.CommonDir)
458				}
459			}
460		}
461		if observation.Name == "" {
462			path := observation.Path
463			if path == "" {
464				path = observation.RealPath
465			}
466			if path != "" {
467				observation.Name = filepath.Base(path)
468			}
469		}
470		if requireLocation && (observation.Name == "" || observation.Name == ".") {
471			return Observation{}, errors.New("catalog repository observation requires a name")
472		}
473		return observation, nil
474	}
475	
476	func absoluteClean(path string) (string, error) {
477		absolute, err := filepath.Abs(path)
478		if err != nil {
479			return "", err
480		}
481		return filepath.Clean(absolute), nil
482	}

484	func canonicalValues(values ...string) map[string]struct{} {
485		out := make(map[string]struct{}, len(values))
486		for _, value := range values {
487			if canonical := canonicalValue(value); canonical != "" {
488				out[canonical] = struct{}{}
489			}
490		}
491		return out
492	}
493	
494	func canonicalValue(value string) string {
495		if value == "" {
496			return ""
497		}
498		canonical, err := pathx.Canonical(value)
499		if err != nil {
500			return ""
501		}
502		return canonical
503	}
504	
505	func intersects(left, right map[string]struct{}) bool {
506		for value := range left {
507			if _, ok := right[value]; ok {
508				return true
509			}
510		}
511		return false
512	}
513	
514	// NormalizeRemoteIdentity converts common HTTPS and SCP-style Git URLs into a
515	// stable host/path key. Hosts are case-insensitive, but paths are preserved
516	// because arbitrary Git servers may use a case-sensitive repository namespace.
517	// The result remains only a hint for matching.
518	func NormalizeRemoteIdentity(identity string) string {
519		identity = strings.TrimSpace(identity)
520		if identity == "" {
521			return ""
522		}
523		if parsed, err := url.Parse(identity); err == nil && parsed.Scheme != "" {
524			if strings.EqualFold(parsed.Scheme, "file") {
525				return ""
526			}
527			if parsed.Host != "" {
528				return remoteIdentityKey(parsed.Host, parsed.EscapedPath())
529			}
530		}
531		if looksLikeLocalRemote(identity) {
532			return ""
533		}
534	
535		afterUser := identity
536		user := ""
537		if at := strings.LastIndexByte(afterUser, '@'); at >= 0 {
538			user, afterUser = afterUser[:at], afterUser[at+1:]
539		}
540		if host, remotePath, ok := splitSCPLike(afterUser); ok {
541			if user != "" && !strings.EqualFold(user, "git") && !strings.HasPrefix(remotePath, "/") {
542				remotePath = "~" + user + "/" + remotePath
543			}
544			return remoteIdentityKey(host, remotePath)
545		}
546	
547		identity = strings.Trim(identity, "/")
548		if host, remotePath, ok := strings.Cut(identity, "/"); ok {
549			return remoteIdentityKey(host, remotePath)
550		}
551		return ""
552	}
553	
554	func looksLikeLocalRemote(identity string) bool {
555		if filepath.IsAbs(identity) || strings.HasPrefix(identity, `\\`) {
556			return true
557		}
558		for _, prefix := range []string{"./", "../", "~/", `.\`, `..\`, `~\`} {
559			if strings.HasPrefix(identity, prefix) {
560				return true
561			}
562		}
563		if len(identity) >= 2 && identity[1] == ':' {
564			letter := identity[0]
565			if letter >= 'a' && letter <= 'z' || letter >= 'A' && letter <= 'Z' {
566				return true
567			}
568		}
569		return !strings.ContainsAny(identity, `/\:@`)
570	}
571	
572	func splitSCPLike(identity string) (string, string, bool) {
573		if strings.HasPrefix(identity, "[") {
574			if end := strings.Index(identity, "]:"); end >= 0 {
575				return identity[:end+1], identity[end+2:], true
576			}
577		}
578		colon := strings.IndexByte(identity, ':')
579		if colon <= 0 || strings.ContainsAny(identity[:colon], `/\\`) {
580			return "", "", false
581		}
582		return identity[:colon], identity[colon+1:], true
583	}
584	
585	func remoteIdentityKey(host, remotePath string) string {
586		host = strings.ToLower(strings.Trim(host, "/"))
587		remotePath = trimGitSuffix(strings.Trim(remotePath, "/"))
588		if host == "" || remotePath == "" {
589			return ""
590		}
591		return host + "/" + remotePath
592	}
593	
594	func trimGitSuffix(value string) string {
595		return strings.TrimSuffix(value, ".git")
596	}
597

253	// Update applies mutate to a deep copy and atomically replaces the record only
254	// if the mutation and validation both succeed. ID, Created, and Discovered are

256	func (s *Store) Update(id string, mutate func(*Entry) error) (*Entry, error) {
257		if err := ValidateID(id); err != nil {
258			return nil, err
259		}
260		if mutate == nil {
261			return nil, errors.New("catalog update requires a mutation")
262		}

265		defer s.mu.Unlock()

267		current, err := s.get(id)

271		updated := current.Clone()
272		if err := mutate(updated); err != nil {
273			return nil, err
274		}
275		if updated.ID != current.ID {
276			return nil, errors.New("catalog update cannot change ID")
277		}
278		if updated.SchemaVersion != current.SchemaVersion {
279			return nil, errors.New("catalog update cannot change schema version")
280		}
281		if !updated.Created.Equal(current.Created) {
282			return nil, errors.New("catalog update cannot change Created")
283		}
284		if !updated.Discovered.Equal(current.Discovered) {
285			return nil, errors.New("catalog update cannot change Discovered")
286		}

289		updated.Updated = now
290		prepareUpdatedNested(current, updated, now)
291		stampChangedLocations(current, updated, now)

293		if err := updated.Validate(); err != nil {
294			return nil, err
295		}
296		if err := s.writeAtomic(updated); err != nil {
297			return nil, err
298		}
299		return updated.Clone(), nil
300	}

1	// Package pathx provides the path-safety checks shared by filesystem lifecycle
2	// operations. The checks are strict: a destination must be below its root, not
3	// merely share a string prefix with it, and symlinks are resolved before that
4	// decision is made.
5	package pathx
6	
7	import (
8		"errors"
9		"fmt"
10		"io/fs"
11		"os"
12		"path/filepath"
13		"slices"
14		"strings"
15	)
16	
17	var (
18		// ErrOutsideRoot reports a path that does not resolve below the requested root.
19		ErrOutsideRoot = errors.New("path is outside root")
20		// ErrRoot reports an operation that named the root itself rather than a child.
21		ErrRoot = errors.New("path is the root itself")
22		// ErrTraversal reports an explicit .. component in an unclean input path.
23		ErrTraversal = errors.New("path contains parent traversal")
24		// ErrInvalidComponent reports a value that is not one filesystem component.
25		ErrInvalidComponent = errors.New("invalid path component")
26	)
27	
28	// Canonical returns an absolute, clean path with symlinks resolved. If the final
29	// path does not exist yet, it resolves the nearest existing ancestor and then
30	// appends the missing suffix. This is the form needed to validate a destination
31	// before creating or moving anything into it.
32	func Canonical(path string) (string, error) {
33		if path == "" {
34			return "", fmt.Errorf("canonical path: empty path")
35		}
36		absolute, err := filepath.Abs(path)
37		if err != nil {
38			return "", fmt.Errorf("make %q absolute: %w", path, err)
39		}
40		absolute = filepath.Clean(absolute)
41	
42		probe := absolute
43		var missing []string
44		for {
45			resolved, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(probe)
46			if err == nil {
47				slices.Reverse(missing)
48				parts := append([]string{resolved}, missing...)
49				return filepath.Clean(filepath.Join(parts...)), nil
50			}
51			if !errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
52				return "", fmt.Errorf("resolve %q: %w", path, err)
53			}
54			// EvalSymlinks reports ErrNotExist both for a genuinely missing component
55			// and for a symlink whose target is missing. Treating the latter as an
56			// ordinary lexical suffix would make an escape look as though it remained
57			// below its root. Resolve the link target explicitly before appending the
58			// still-missing suffix.
59			if info, lstatErr := os.Lstat(probe); lstatErr == nil && info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 {
60				target, readErr := os.Readlink(probe)
61				if readErr != nil {
62					return "", fmt.Errorf("read unresolved symlink %q: %w", probe, readErr)
63				}
64				if hasParentTraversal(target) {
65					return "", fmt.Errorf("unresolved symlink %q target %q: %w", probe, target, ErrTraversal)
66				}
67				if !filepath.IsAbs(target) {
68					target = filepath.Join(filepath.Dir(probe), target)
69				}
70				resolved, resolveErr := Canonical(target)
71				if resolveErr != nil {
72					return "", fmt.Errorf("resolve target of %q: %w", probe, resolveErr)
73				}
74				slices.Reverse(missing)
75				parts := append([]string{resolved}, missing...)
76				return filepath.Clean(filepath.Join(parts...)), nil
77			} else if lstatErr != nil && !errors.Is(lstatErr, fs.ErrNotExist) {
78				return "", fmt.Errorf("inspect unresolved path %q: %w", probe, lstatErr)
79			}
80			parent := filepath.Dir(probe)
81			if parent == probe {
82				return "", fmt.Errorf("resolve %q: no existing ancestor: %w", path, err)
83			}
84			missing = append(missing, filepath.Base(probe))
85			probe = parent
86		}
87	}
88	
89	// CanonicalChild returns candidate in canonical form when it resolves strictly
90	// below root. It rejects root itself, lexical .. traversal, sibling-prefix
91	// confusion, and paths that escape through a symlink.
92	func CanonicalChild(root, candidate string) (string, error) {
93		if hasParentTraversal(candidate) {
94			return "", fmt.Errorf("%q: %w", candidate, ErrTraversal)
95		}
96		canonicalRoot, err := Canonical(root)
97		if err != nil {
98			return "", fmt.Errorf("canonicalize root: %w", err)
99		}
100		canonicalCandidate, err := Canonical(candidate)
101		if err != nil {
102			return "", fmt.Errorf("canonicalize candidate: %w", err)
103		}
104	
105		rel, err := filepath.Rel(canonicalRoot, canonicalCandidate)
106		if err != nil {
107			return "", fmt.Errorf("compare %q with root %q: %w", candidate, root, err)
108		}
109		switch {
110		case rel == ".":
111			return "", fmt.Errorf("%q: %w", candidate, ErrRoot)
112		case filepath.IsAbs(rel), rel == "..", strings.HasPrefix(rel, ".."+string(filepath.Separator)):
113			return "", fmt.Errorf("%q is not below %q: %w", candidate, root, ErrOutsideRoot)
114		default:
115			return canonicalCandidate, nil
116		}
117	}
118	
119	// IsChild reports whether candidate resolves strictly below root. Policy
120	// rejections are returned as false without hiding filesystem errors.
121	func IsChild(root, candidate string) (bool, error) {
122		_, err := CanonicalChild(root, candidate)
123		if err == nil {
124			return true, nil
125		}
126		if errors.Is(err, ErrOutsideRoot) || errors.Is(err, ErrRoot) || errors.Is(err, ErrTraversal) {
127			return false, nil
128		}
129		return false, err
130	}
131	
132	// ValidateComponent requires a non-empty relative value containing exactly one
133	// path component. Both slash styles are rejected so state synced between Unix
134	// and Windows cannot acquire a different meaning on another host.
135	func ValidateComponent(component string) error {
136		switch {
137		case strings.TrimSpace(component) == "":
138			return fmt.Errorf("empty component: %w", ErrInvalidComponent)
139		case strings.ContainsRune(component, '\x00'):
140			return fmt.Errorf("component contains NUL: %w", ErrInvalidComponent)
141		case component == "." || component == "..":
142			return fmt.Errorf("component %q is reserved: %w", component, ErrInvalidComponent)
143		case filepath.IsAbs(component) || filepath.VolumeName(component) != "" || driveQualified(component):
144			return fmt.Errorf("component %q is absolute or drive-qualified: %w", component, ErrInvalidComponent)
145		case strings.ContainsAny(component, `/\\`):
146			return fmt.Errorf("component %q contains a path separator: %w", component, ErrInvalidComponent)
147		case filepath.Clean(component) != component || filepath.Base(component) != component:
148			return fmt.Errorf("component %q is not a single clean name: %w", component, ErrInvalidComponent)
149		default:
150			return nil
151		}
152	}
153	
154	// JoinChild validates every component, joins it below root, and returns the
155	// canonical destination. It is suitable for paths such as
156	// <project-root>/<category>/<name>, where each user-supplied value must remain a
157	// single component.
158	func JoinChild(root string, components ...string) (string, error) {
159		if len(components) == 0 {
160			return "", fmt.Errorf("join child: no components: %w", ErrRoot)
161		}
162		for i, component := range components {
163			if err := ValidateComponent(component); err != nil {
164				return "", fmt.Errorf("component %d: %w", i, err)
165			}
166		}
167		canonicalRoot, err := Canonical(root)
168		if err != nil {
169			return "", fmt.Errorf("canonicalize root: %w", err)
170		}
171		return CanonicalChild(canonicalRoot, filepath.Join(append([]string{canonicalRoot}, components...)...))
172	}
173	
174	func driveQualified(component string) bool {
175		if len(component) < 2 || component[1] != ':' {
176			return false
177		}
178		letter := component[0]
179		return letter >= 'a' && letter <= 'z' || letter >= 'A' && letter <= 'Z'
180	}
181	
182	func hasParentTraversal(path string) bool {
183		for _, component := range strings.FieldsFunc(path, func(r rune) bool {
184			return r == '/' || r == '\\'
185		}) {
186			if component == ".." {
187				return true
188			}
189		}
190		return false
191	}
192

448	func candidatesOf(items []Item) []Candidate {
449		candidates := make([]Candidate, len(items))
450		for index, item := range items {
451			candidates[index] = Candidate{
452				ID: item.ID, Name: item.Name, Basename: item.Basename, Path: item.Live.CurrentPath,
453			}
454		}
455		sort.Slice(candidates, func(i, j int) bool {
456			left, right := strings.ToLower(candidates[i].Basename), strings.ToLower(candidates[j].Basename)
457			if left != right {
458				return left < right
459			}
460			if candidates[i].Basename != candidates[j].Basename {
461				return candidates[i].Basename < candidates[j].Basename
462			}
463			return candidates[i].ID < candidates[j].ID
464		})
465		return candidates
466	}

468	func itemFromEntry(entry *catalog.Entry, live LiveFacts) Item {
469		if entry == nil {
470			return Item{Live: live}
471		}
472		copy := entry.Clone()
473		item := Item{
474			Entry: copy,
475			ID:    copy.ID, Kind: copy.Kind, Name: copy.Name,
476			Note: copy.Note, Tags: append([]string(nil), copy.Tags...),
477			Created: copy.Created, LastOpened: copy.LastOpened,
478			RemoteIdentity: copy.RemoteIdentity,
479			Live:           live,
480		}
481		if copy.Experiment != nil {
482			item.Slug = copy.Experiment.Slug
483			item.Phase = copy.Experiment.Phase
484			item.Started = copy.Experiment.Started
485			item.OriginURL = copy.Experiment.OriginURL
486		}
487		if item.Live.CurrentPath != "" {
488			item.Basename = filepath.Base(item.Live.CurrentPath)
489		} else if copy.Experiment != nil && copy.Experiment.OriginalPath != "" {
490			item.Basename = filepath.Base(copy.Experiment.OriginalPath)
491		}
492		return item
493	}

499		}

506			return info.IsDir(), nil
507		}
508		if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {

510		}

31	// Reconcile backfills every immediate, non-hidden directory under TriesRoot.
32	// It never moves, renames, or writes into a discovered directory.
33	func (s *Service) Reconcile(ctx context.Context) ([]Item, []Diagnostic, error) {
34		s.reconcileMu.Lock()
35		defer s.reconcileMu.Unlock()
36	
37		if err := s.ensureTriesRoot(); err != nil {
38			return nil, nil, err
39		}
40		entries, catalogProblems, err := s.store.ListWithDiagnostics()
41		if err != nil {
42			return nil, nil, err
43		}
44		diagnostics := catalogDiagnostics(catalogProblems)
45	
46		directoryEntries, err := os.ReadDir(s.triesRoot)
47		if err != nil {
48			return nil, diagnostics, fmt.Errorf("read tries root %s: %w", s.triesRoot, err)
49		}
50		paths := make([]string, 0, len(directoryEntries))
51		for _, entry := range directoryEntries {
52			if strings.HasPrefix(entry.Name(), ".") {
53				continue
54			}
55			paths = append(paths, filepath.Join(s.triesRoot, entry.Name()))
56		}
57		probes := boundedMap(ctx, s.workers, paths, func(ctx context.Context, path string) directoryProbe {
58			return s.probeDirectory(ctx, path)
59		})
60	
61		items := make([]Item, 0, len(probes))
62		for _, probe := range probes {
63			if probe.diagnostic != nil {
64				diagnostics = append(diagnostics, *probe.diagnostic)
65			}
66			if !probe.valid {
67				continue
68			}
69	
70			matches := matchingEntries(entries, s.host, probe)
71			if len(matches) == 0 && len(catalogProblems) == 0 && probe.originURL != "" {
72				matched, matchErr := s.registry.Match(observationFromProbe(s.host, probe))
73				switch {
74				case matchErr == nil && eligibleTryRecord(matched):
75					matches = []*catalog.Entry{matched}
76				case matchErr == nil:
77					// A graduated experiment at the same identity is history, not an
78					// active Try to revive implicitly.
79				case errors.Is(matchErr, catalog.ErrNotFound), errors.Is(matchErr, catalog.ErrAmbiguous):
80					// A live clone must get its own identity when the remote hint is
81					// absent or ambiguous.
82				default:
83					item := s.transientItem(probe, matchErr)
84					items = append(items, item)
85					diagnostics = append(diagnostics, Diagnostic{
86						Path: probe.live.CurrentPath, Operation: "match catalog try", Err: matchErr,
87					})
88					continue
89				}
90			}
91			switch len(matches) {
92			case 0:
93				if len(catalogProblems) > 0 {
94					// The catalog diagnostic is reported once, while each live item carries
95					// the same typed tracking error for callers that try to mutate it.
96					items = append(items, s.transientItem(probe, incompleteCatalogError(catalogProblems)))
97					continue
98				}
99				entry := s.newEntry(probe)
100				if err := s.catalogCreate(entry); err != nil {
101					item := s.transientItem(probe, err)
102					items = append(items, item)
103					diagnostics = append(diagnostics, Diagnostic{
104						Path: probe.live.CurrentPath, Operation: "catalog try", Err: err,
105					})
106					continue
107				}
108				entries = append(entries, entry)
109				items = append(items, itemFromEntry(entry, probe.live))
110			case 1:
111				entry := matches[0]
112				updated, updateErr := s.refreshEntry(entry, probe)
113				if updateErr != nil {
114					item := itemFromEntry(entry, probe.live)
115					item.CatalogError = updateErr
116					items = append(items, item)
117					diagnostics = append(diagnostics, Diagnostic{
118						Path: probe.live.CurrentPath, Operation: "refresh catalog try", Err: updateErr,
119					})
120					continue
121				}
122				replaceEntry(entries, updated)
123				items = append(items, itemFromEntry(updated, probe.live))
124			default:
125				matchedItems := make([]Item, len(matches))
126				for index, entry := range matches {
127					matchedItems[index] = itemFromEntry(entry, probe.live)
128				}
129				ambiguous := &AmbiguousError{Ref: probe.live.CurrentPath, Candidates: candidatesOf(matchedItems)}
130				item := s.transientItem(probe, ambiguous)
131				items = append(items, item)
132				diagnostics = append(diagnostics, Diagnostic{
133					Path: probe.live.CurrentPath, Operation: "match catalog try", Err: ambiguous,
134				})
135			}
136		}
137	
138		items = deduplicateItems(items)
139		sortItemsByName(items)
140		sortDiagnostics(diagnostics)
141		return items, diagnostics, nil
142	}
143	
144	// List reconciles visible directories, joins requested catalog history, and
145	// enriches Git repositories with bounded status/last-commit probes.
146	func (s *Service) List(ctx context.Context, options ListOptions) ([]Item, []Diagnostic, error) {
147		visible, diagnostics, err := s.Reconcile(ctx)
148		if err != nil {
149			return visible, diagnostics, err
150		}
151	
152		entries, catalogProblems, err := s.store.ListWithDiagnostics()
153		if err != nil {
154			return visible, diagnostics, err
155		}
156		diagnostics = append(diagnostics, catalogDiagnostics(catalogProblems)...)
157	
158		items := make([]Item, 0, len(entries)+len(visible))
159		seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(visible))
160		seenPaths := make(map[string]struct{}, len(visible))
161		for _, item := range visible {
162			if item.ID != "" {
163				seen[item.ID] = struct{}{}
164			}
165			if item.Live.CurrentPath != "" {
166				seenPaths[item.Live.CurrentPath] = struct{}{}
167			}
168			items = append(items, item)
169		}
170	
171		for _, entry := range entries {
172			if _, ok := seen[entry.ID]; ok {
173				continue
174			}
175			if location, ok := entry.LocationFor(s.host); ok {
176				if _, pathSeen := seenPaths[location.CurrentPath]; pathSeen {
177					continue
178				}
179			}
180			graduated := entry.Kind == catalog.KindRepository && entry.Experiment != nil &&
181				entry.Experiment.Phase == catalog.PhaseGraduated
182			if graduated {
183				if !options.IncludeGraduated {
184					continue
185				}
186			} else if entry.Kind != catalog.KindTry || entry.Experiment == nil {
187				continue
188			}
189	
190			location, located := entry.LocationFor(s.host)
191			present := located && location.State == catalog.LocationPresent && !s.hiddenStorage(location.CurrentPath)
192			if present {
193				isDirectory, statErr := directoryExists(location.CurrentPath)
194				if statErr != nil {
195					diagnostics = append(diagnostics, Diagnostic{
196						Path: location.CurrentPath, Operation: "stat catalog try", Err: statErr,
197					})
198					present = false
199				} else {
200					present = isDirectory
201				}
202			}
203			if !present && !options.IncludeNonPresent {
204				continue
205			}
206	
207			live := LiveFacts{Present: present}
208			if located {
209				live.CurrentPath = location.CurrentPath
210				live.RealPath = location.RealPath
211			}
212			if present {
213				probe := s.probeDirectory(ctx, location.CurrentPath)
214				if probe.diagnostic != nil {
215					diagnostics = append(diagnostics, *probe.diagnostic)
216				}
217				if probe.valid {
218					live = probe.live
219				}
220			}
221			items = append(items, itemFromEntry(entry, live))
222		}
223	
224		if query := strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(options.Query)); query != "" {
225			filtered := items[:0]
226			for _, item := range items {
227				if strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(item.SearchText()), query) {
228					filtered = append(filtered, item)
229				}
230			}
231			items = filtered
232		}
233		if !options.SkipEnrichment {
234			items = s.enrich(ctx, items)
235		}
236		sortItemsByActivity(items)
237		diagnostics = deduplicateDiagnostics(diagnostics)
238		sortDiagnostics(diagnostics)
239		return items, diagnostics, nil
240	}
241	
242	// Resolve applies stable, deterministic matching: exact ID, exact basename,
243	// exact date-stripped name/slug, then one unique case-insensitive substring.
244	func (s *Service) Resolve(ctx context.Context, ref string) (Item, []Diagnostic, error) {
245		items, diagnostics, err := s.List(ctx, ListOptions{})
246		if err != nil {
247			return Item{}, diagnostics, err
248		}
249		ref = strings.TrimSpace(ref)
250		if ref == "" {
251			return Item{}, diagnostics, &NotFoundError{Ref: ref, Root: s.triesRoot}
252		}
253	
254		if looksLikePath(ref) {
255			pathRef := config.Expand(ref)
256			if canonical, canonicalErr := pathx.Canonical(pathRef); canonicalErr == nil {
257				var matches []Item
258				for _, item := range items {
259					if samePath(canonical, item.Live.CurrentPath) {
260						matches = append(matches, item)
261					}
262				}
263				if len(matches) > 0 {
264					return selectResolved(ref, matches, diagnostics)
265				}
266			}
267		}
268	
269		for _, match := range []func(Item) bool{
270			func(item Item) bool { return item.ID != "" && item.ID == ref },
271			func(item Item) bool { return item.Basename == ref },
272			func(item Item) bool {
273				stripped, _, _ := splitDatedBasename(item.Basename)
274				return stripped == ref || item.Name == ref || item.Slug == ref
275			},
276		} {
277			var matches []Item
278			for _, item := range items {
279				if match(item) {
280					matches = append(matches, item)
281				}
282			}
283			if len(matches) > 0 {
284				return selectResolved(ref, matches, diagnostics)
285			}
286		}
287	
288		needle := strings.ToLower(ref)
289		var matches []Item
290		for _, item := range items {
291			stripped, _, _ := splitDatedBasename(item.Basename)
292			for _, value := range []string{item.Basename, stripped, item.Name, item.Slug} {
293				if value != "" && strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(value), needle) {
294					matches = append(matches, item)
295					break
296				}
297			}
298		}
299		if len(matches) == 0 {
300			return Item{}, diagnostics, &NotFoundError{Ref: ref, Root: s.triesRoot}
301		}
302		return selectResolved(ref, matches, diagnostics)
303	}
304	
305	func selectResolved(ref string, matches []Item, diagnostics []Diagnostic) (Item, []Diagnostic, error) {
306		if len(matches) == 1 {
307			return matches[0], diagnostics, nil
308		}
309		return Item{}, diagnostics, &AmbiguousError{Ref: ref, Candidates: candidatesOf(matches)}
310	}
311	
312	// ResolveOrCreate preserves the low-friction dev try behavior: an existing
313	// non-clone match wins; clone requests always get a collision-safe new path.
314	func (s *Service) ResolveOrCreate(ctx context.Context, request CreateRequest) (CreateResult, error) {
315		if request.Clone == "" {
316			name := config.Slug(strings.ReplaceAll(request.Name, " ", "-"))
317			item, diagnostics, err := s.Resolve(ctx, name)
318			if err == nil {
319				result := CreateResult{
320					Item: item, Path: item.Live.CurrentPath, Existing: true,
321					Tracked: item.ID != "" && item.CatalogError == nil, Diagnostics: diagnostics,
322				}
323				if !result.Tracked {
324					trackingErr := item.CatalogError
325					if trackingErr == nil {
326						trackingErr = errors.New("matching directory has no catalog ID")
327					}
328					return result, fmt.Errorf("existing try at %s is not tracked in the catalog: %w", result.Path, trackingErr)
329				}
330				return result, nil
331			}
332			if !errors.Is(err, ErrNotFound) {
333				return CreateResult{Diagnostics: diagnostics}, err
334			}
335		}
336		return s.Create(ctx, request)
337	}
338	
339	// Create makes a new collision-safe dated directory or clone and catalogs it
340	// only after the filesystem operation succeeds.
341	func (s *Service) Create(ctx context.Context, request CreateRequest) (CreateResult, error) {
342		var result CreateResult
343		if err := s.ensureTriesRoot(); err != nil {
344			return result, err
345		}
346		name := request.Name
347		if request.Clone != "" && strings.TrimSpace(name) == "" {
348			name = cloneDefaultName(request.Clone)
349		}
350		slug := config.Slug(strings.ReplaceAll(name, " ", "-"))
351		if err := pathx.ValidateComponent(slug); err != nil {
352			return result, fmt.Errorf("try name %q: %w", name, err)
353		}
354	
355		path, err := s.availableDatedPath(slug)
356		if err != nil {
357			return result, err
358		}
359		result.Path = path
360		if request.Clone != "" {
361			cloneRef := normalizeCloneRef(request.Clone)
362			if _, err := s.gitRun(ctx, s.triesRoot, "clone", cloneRef, path); err != nil {
363				return result, fmt.Errorf("clone try into %s: %w", path, err)
364			}
365			result.Created = true
366			result.Cloned = true
367		} else {
368			if err := os.Mkdir(path, 0o755); err != nil {
369				return result, fmt.Errorf("create try %s: %w", path, err)
370			}
371			result.Created = true
372			if !request.NoGit {
373				if _, err := s.gitRun(ctx, path, "init", "-b", "main"); err != nil {
374					result.InitWarning = err
375				}
376			}
377		}
378	
379		canonical, canonicalErr := pathx.Canonical(path)
380		if canonicalErr != nil {
381			return result, fmt.Errorf("try exists at %s but its canonical path could not be determined: %w", path, canonicalErr)
382		}
383		result.Path = canonical
384		items, diagnostics, reconcileErr := s.Reconcile(ctx)
385		result.Diagnostics = diagnostics
386		if reconcileErr != nil {
387			return result, fmt.Errorf("try exists at %s but catalog reconciliation failed: %w", canonical, reconcileErr)
388		}
389		for _, item := range items {
390			if samePath(item.Live.CurrentPath, canonical) {
391				result.Item = item
392				result.Tracked = item.ID != "" && item.CatalogError == nil
393				break
394			}
395		}
396		if !result.Tracked {
397			trackingErr := result.Item.CatalogError
398			if trackingErr == nil {
399				trackingErr = errors.New("reconciliation did not produce a catalog record")
400			}
401			return result, fmt.Errorf("try exists at %s but could not be added to the catalog: %w", canonical, trackingErr)
402		}
403		enriched := s.enrich(ctx, []Item{result.Item})
404		if len(enriched) == 1 {
405			result.Item = enriched[0]
406		}
407		return result, nil
408	}
409	
410	// RefreshOrigin re-probes origin after an explicit external remote-creation
411	// step and persists its raw URL and normalized identity on the same catalog ID.
412	func (s *Service) RefreshOrigin(ctx context.Context, id string) (Item, error) {
413		entry, err := s.registry.Get(id)
414		if err != nil {
415			return Item{}, fmt.Errorf("load experiment %s for origin refresh: %w", id, err)
416		}
417		if entry.Experiment == nil ||
418			(entry.Kind != catalog.KindTry && !(entry.Kind == catalog.KindRepository && entry.Experiment.Phase == catalog.PhaseGraduated)) {
419			return Item{}, &NotFoundError{Ref: id, Root: s.triesRoot}
420		}
421		location, ok := entry.LocationFor(s.host)
422		if !ok || location.State != catalog.LocationPresent || location.CurrentPath == "" {
423			return Item{}, &NotFoundError{Ref: id, Root: s.triesRoot}
424		}
425		probe := s.probeDirectory(ctx, location.CurrentPath)
426		if !probe.valid || probe.live.Repo == nil || probe.live.DiscoverError != nil {
427			if probe.diagnostic != nil {
428				return Item{}, fmt.Errorf("refresh experiment origin: %w", probe.diagnostic.Err)
429			}
430			return Item{}, errors.New("refresh experiment origin: path is not a discoverable Git repository")
431		}
432		if probe.originURL == "" {
433			return Item{}, errors.New("refresh experiment origin: Git origin is not configured")
434		}
435		updated, err := s.catalogUpdate(id, func(current *catalog.Entry) error {
436			currentLocation, found := current.LocationFor(s.host)
437			if !found || currentLocation.State != catalog.LocationPresent ||
438				!samePath(currentLocation.CurrentPath, probe.live.CurrentPath) {
439				return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s moved or was reassigned before origin refresh", id)
440			}
441			if current.Experiment == nil {
442				return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s no longer has experiment provenance", id)
443			}
444			current.Experiment.OriginURL = probe.originURL
445			current.RemoteIdentity = catalog.NormalizeRemoteIdentity(probe.originURL)
446			return current.SetLocation(s.host, locationFromProbe(probe, currentLocation))
447		})
448		if err != nil {
449			return Item{}, fmt.Errorf("refresh experiment origin: %w", err)
450		}
451		item := itemFromEntry(updated, probe.live)
452		enriched := s.enrich(ctx, []Item{item})
453		if len(enriched) == 1 {
454			item = enriched[0]
455		}
456		return item, nil
457	}
458	
459	// Touch updates LastOpened only after a caller has successfully handed off the
460	// selected OpenTarget.
461	func (s *Service) Touch(_ context.Context, id string) (TouchResult, error) {
462		if id == "" {
463			return TouchResult{}, &NotFoundError{Ref: id, Root: s.triesRoot}
464		}
465		now := s.now()
466		updated, err := s.catalogUpdate(id, func(entry *catalog.Entry) error {
467			if entry.Experiment == nil ||
468				(entry.Kind != catalog.KindTry && !(entry.Kind == catalog.KindRepository && entry.Experiment.Phase == catalog.PhaseGraduated)) {
469				return &NotFoundError{Ref: id, Root: s.triesRoot}
470			}
471			location, ok := entry.LocationFor(s.host)
472			if !ok || location.State != catalog.LocationPresent {
473				return &NotFoundError{Ref: id, Root: s.triesRoot}
474			}
475			entry.LastOpened = now
476			return nil
477		})
478		if err != nil {
479			if errors.Is(err, catalog.ErrNotFound) {
480				return TouchResult{}, &NotFoundError{Ref: id, Root: s.triesRoot}
481			}
482			return TouchResult{}, fmt.Errorf("touch try %s: %w", id, err)
483		}
484		location, _ := updated.LocationFor(s.host)
485		item := itemFromEntry(updated, LiveFacts{
486			Present:     location.State == catalog.LocationPresent,
487			CurrentPath: location.CurrentPath, RealPath: location.RealPath,
488		})
489		return TouchResult{Item: item, TouchedAt: now}, nil
490	}
491	
492	func (s *Service) probeDirectory(ctx context.Context, path string) directoryProbe {
493		probe := directoryProbe{}
494		if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
495			probe.diagnostic = &Diagnostic{Path: path, Operation: "inspect try", Err: err}
496			return probe
497		}
498		info, err := os.Stat(path)
499		if err != nil {
500			probe.diagnostic = &Diagnostic{Path: path, Operation: "stat try", Err: err}
501			return probe
502		}
503		if !info.IsDir() {
504			return probe
505		}
506		canonical, err := pathx.Canonical(path)
507		if err != nil {
508			probe.diagnostic = &Diagnostic{Path: path, Operation: "canonicalize try", Err: err}
509			return probe
510		}
511		probe.valid = true
512		probe.live = LiveFacts{Present: true, CurrentPath: canonical, RealPath: canonical}
513		_, markerErr := os.Lstat(filepath.Join(canonical, ".git"))
514		probe.gitMarker = markerErr == nil || !errors.Is(markerErr, fs.ErrNotExist)
515	
516		repository, discoverErr := s.gitDiscover(ctx, canonical)
517		if discoverErr != nil {
518			if probe.gitMarker {
519				probe.live.DiscoverError = discoverErr
520				probe.diagnostic = &Diagnostic{Path: canonical, Operation: "discover Git try", Err: discoverErr}
521			}
522			return probe
523		}
524		repositoryRoot := repository.Root
525		if repository.Bare {
526			repositoryRoot = repository.MainRoot
527		}
528		canonicalRoot, rootErr := pathx.Canonical(repositoryRoot)
529		if rootErr != nil || !samePath(canonicalRoot, canonical) {
530			// A TriesRoot may itself be inside a repository. Its child directories are
531			// not independent Git Tries merely because rev-parse walks to that parent.
532			return probe
533		}
534		repository.Root = canonicalRoot
535		if repository.MainRoot != "" {
536			if canonicalMain, mainErr := pathx.Canonical(repository.MainRoot); mainErr == nil {
537				repository.MainRoot = canonicalMain
538			}
539		}
540		if repository.GitCommonDir != "" {
541			commonDir, commonErr := pathx.Canonical(repository.GitCommonDir)
542			if commonErr != nil {
543				probe.live.DiscoverError = commonErr
544				probe.diagnostic = &Diagnostic{Path: canonical, Operation: "canonicalize Git common directory", Err: commonErr}
545				repository.GitCommonDir = ""
546			} else {
547				repository.GitCommonDir = commonDir
548			}
549		}
550		probe.live.Repo = &repository
551		probe.originURL = gitx.RemoteFromConfig(repository.GitCommonDir, "origin")
552		return probe
553	}
554	
555	func (s *Service) enrich(ctx context.Context, items []Item) []Item {
556		return boundedMap(ctx, s.workers, items, func(ctx context.Context, item Item) Item {
557			if item.Live.Repo == nil || item.Live.CurrentPath == "" {
558				return item
559			}
560			status, statusErr := s.gitStatus(ctx, item.Live.CurrentPath)
561			if statusErr != nil {
562				item.Live.StatusError = statusErr
563			} else {
564				item.Live.Status = &status
565			}
566			unix, subject, commitErr := s.gitLastCommit(ctx, item.Live.CurrentPath)
567			if commitErr != nil {
568				item.Live.LastCommitError = commitErr
569			} else if unix > 0 {
570				item.Live.LastCommit = time.Unix(unix, 0).UTC()
571				item.Live.LastCommitSubject = subject
572			}
573			return item
574		})
575	}
576	
577	func (s *Service) experimentFromProbe(probe directoryProbe) *catalog.Experiment {
578		name, started, dated := splitDatedBasename(filepath.Base(probe.live.CurrentPath))
579		if strings.TrimSpace(name) == "" {
580			name = "unnamed"
581		} else {
582			name = strings.TrimSpace(name)
583		}
584		if !dated {
585			started = s.now()
586		}
587		return &catalog.Experiment{
588			Phase: catalog.PhaseActive, Slug: config.Slug(name),
589			OriginURL: probe.originURL, Started: started,
590			OriginalPath: probe.live.CurrentPath,
591		}
592	}
593	
594	func (s *Service) newEntry(probe directoryProbe) *catalog.Entry {
595		name, started, dated := splitDatedBasename(filepath.Base(probe.live.CurrentPath))
596		if strings.TrimSpace(name) == "" {
597			name = "unnamed"
598		} else {
599			name = strings.TrimSpace(name)
600		}
601		if !dated {
602			started = s.now()
603		}
604		entry := &catalog.Entry{
605			Kind:           catalog.KindTry,
606			Name:           name,
607			RemoteIdentity: catalog.NormalizeRemoteIdentity(probe.originURL),
608			Experiment: &catalog.Experiment{
609				Phase: catalog.PhaseActive, Slug: config.Slug(name),
610				OriginURL: probe.originURL, Started: started,
611				OriginalPath: probe.live.CurrentPath,
612			},
613			Locations: map[string]catalog.Location{
614				s.host: locationFromProbe(probe, catalog.Location{}),
615			},
616		}
617		if dated {
618			entry.Created = started
619		}
620		return entry
621	}
622	
623	func (s *Service) transientItem(probe directoryProbe, catalogErr error) Item {
624		name, started, dated := splitDatedBasename(filepath.Base(probe.live.CurrentPath))
625		if strings.TrimSpace(name) == "" {
626			name = "unnamed"
627		} else {
628			name = strings.TrimSpace(name)
629		}
630		if !dated {
631			started = s.now()
632		}
633		return Item{
634			Kind: catalog.KindTry, Name: name,
635			Basename: filepath.Base(probe.live.CurrentPath), Slug: config.Slug(name),
636			Phase: catalog.PhaseActive, Created: started, Started: started,
637			OriginURL: probe.originURL, RemoteIdentity: catalog.NormalizeRemoteIdentity(probe.originURL),
638			Live: probe.live, CatalogError: catalogErr,
639		}
640	}
641	
642	func (s *Service) refreshEntry(entry *catalog.Entry, probe directoryProbe) (*catalog.Entry, error) {
643		location, _ := entry.LocationFor(s.host)
644		wantedLocation := locationFromProbe(probe, location)
645		if entry.Kind == catalog.KindRepository && entry.Experiment == nil {
646			metadata := s.experimentFromProbe(probe)
647			return s.catalogUpdate(entry.ID, func(updated *catalog.Entry) error {
648				if updated.Kind != catalog.KindRepository || updated.Experiment != nil {
649					return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s changed before it could become a Try", updated.ID)
650				}
651				updated.Kind = catalog.KindTry
652				updated.Experiment = metadata
653				if probe.originURL != "" {
654					updated.RemoteIdentity = catalog.NormalizeRemoteIdentity(probe.originURL)
655				}
656				return updated.SetLocation(s.host, wantedLocation)
657			})
658		}
659	
660		wantedOrigin := entry.Experiment.OriginURL
661		wantedIdentity := entry.RemoteIdentity
662		if probe.originURL != "" {
663			wantedOrigin = probe.originURL
664			wantedIdentity = catalog.NormalizeRemoteIdentity(probe.originURL)
665		}
666		if locationEqual(location, wantedLocation) && entry.Experiment.OriginURL == wantedOrigin &&
667			entry.RemoteIdentity == wantedIdentity {
668			return entry, nil
669		}
670		return s.catalogUpdate(entry.ID, func(updated *catalog.Entry) error {
671			if updated.Kind != catalog.KindTry || updated.Experiment == nil || updated.Experiment.Phase == catalog.PhaseGraduated {
672				return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s is not an active Try", updated.ID)
673			}
674			if probe.originURL != "" {
675				updated.Experiment.OriginURL = probe.originURL
676				updated.RemoteIdentity = catalog.NormalizeRemoteIdentity(probe.originURL)
677			}
678			return updated.SetLocation(s.host, wantedLocation)
679		})
680	}

682	func locationFromProbe(probe directoryProbe, previous catalog.Location) catalog.Location {
683		commonDir := ""

685			commonDir = probe.live.Repo.GitCommonDir
686		} else if probe.gitMarker && probe.live.DiscoverError != nil {
687			// A transient Git failure must not erase identity gathered earlier.
688			commonDir = previous.GitCommonDir
689		}
690		return catalog.Location{
691			State:        catalog.LocationPresent,
692			CurrentPath:  probe.live.CurrentPath,
693			RealPath:     probe.live.RealPath,
694			GitCommonDir: commonDir,
695		}
696	}

725	func matchingEntries(entries []*catalog.Entry, host string, probe directoryProbe) []*catalog.Entry {
726		matched := make(map[string]*catalog.Entry)
727		for _, entry := range entries {
728			if !eligibleLocalRecord(entry) {

730			}
731			location, located := entry.LocationFor(host)
732			if located {

734					samePath(probe.live.CurrentPath, location.RealPath) ||
735					samePath(probe.live.CurrentPath, location.RestorePath)
736				commonMatch := probe.live.Repo != nil && probe.live.Repo.GitCommonDir != "" &&
737					samePath(probe.live.Repo.GitCommonDir, location.GitCommonDir)
738				if pathMatch || commonMatch {
739					matched[entry.ID] = entry
740				}
741			} else if entry.Experiment != nil && samePath(probe.live.CurrentPath, entry.Experiment.OriginalPath) {
742				matched[entry.ID] = entry
743			}
744		}
745		out := make([]*catalog.Entry, 0, len(matched))
746		for _, entry := range matched {
747			out = append(out, entry)
748		}
749		catalog.Sort(out)
750		return out
751	}

771	func splitDatedBasename(basename string) (string, time.Time, bool) {
772		if len(basename) <= len("2006-01-02-") || basename[10] != '-' {
773			return basename, time.Time{}, false
774		}
775		parsed, err := time.Parse("2006-01-02", basename[:10])
776		if err != nil || parsed.Format("2006-01-02") != basename[:10] {
777			return basename, time.Time{}, false
778		}
779		name := basename[11:]
780		if name == "" {
781			return basename, time.Time{}, false
782		}
783		return name, parsed, true
784	}

786	func (s *Service) availableDatedPath(slug string) (string, error) {
787		prefix := s.clock().Format("2006-01-02") + "-" + slug
788		for version := 1; version < 10_000; version++ {
789			basename := prefix
790			if version > 1 {
791				basename = fmt.Sprintf("%s-%d", prefix, version)
792			}
793			candidate, err := pathx.JoinChild(s.triesRoot, basename)
794			if err != nil {
795				return "", fmt.Errorf("choose try destination: %w", err)
796			}
797			if _, err := os.Lstat(candidate); errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
798				return candidate, nil
799			} else if err != nil {
800				return "", fmt.Errorf("inspect try destination %s: %w", candidate, err)
801			}
802		}
803		return "", fmt.Errorf("choose a unique destination for %q", slug)
804	}

806	func cloneDefaultName(ref string) string {

809			return config.Slug(filepath.Base(trimmed))

819		if index := strings.LastIndexAny(trimmed, "/:"); index >= 0 {

825	func normalizeCloneRef(ref string) string {
826		ref = strings.TrimSpace(ref)
827		if localClonePath(ref) {
828			return ref
829		}
830		kind := forge.FromURL(ref)
831		if kind != forge.Unknown {
832			adapter, err := forge.For(kind)
833			if err == nil {
834				return adapter.CloneURL(ref)
835			}
836			return ref
837		}
838		if !strings.Contains(ref, "://") && !strings.HasPrefix(ref, "git@") && strings.Contains(ref, "/") {
839			if adapter, err := forge.Preferred(); err == nil {
840				return adapter.CloneURL(ref)
841			}
842		}
843		return ref

846	func localClonePath(ref string) bool {
847		if filepath.IsAbs(ref) || strings.HasPrefix(ref, "file://") || strings.HasPrefix(ref, "./") ||
848			strings.HasPrefix(ref, "../") || strings.HasPrefix(ref, "~/") {
849			return true
850		}
851		_, err := os.Stat(ref)
852		return err == nil

855	func clonePathIdentity(ref string) string {
856		if parsed, err := url.Parse(ref); err == nil && parsed.Host != "" {
857			return strings.Trim(strings.TrimSuffix(parsed.Path, ".git"), "/")
858		}
859		if at := strings.LastIndexByte(ref, '@'); at >= 0 {
860			ref = ref[at+1:]
861		}
862		if colon := strings.IndexByte(ref, ':'); colon >= 0 {
863			ref = ref[colon+1:]
864		}
865		ref = strings.Trim(strings.TrimSuffix(ref, ".git"), "/")
866		if strings.Contains(ref, "/") {
867			return ref
868		}
869		return ""
870	}

872	func (s *Service) hiddenStorage(path string) bool {
873		if path == "" {
874			return false
875		}
876		if hiddenImmediateChild(s.triesRoot, path) {
877			return true
878		}
879		canonicalRoot, rootErr := pathx.Canonical(s.triesRoot)
880		canonicalPath, pathErr := pathx.Canonical(path)

883		}

887	func hiddenImmediateChild(root, path string) bool {
888		absoluteRoot, rootErr := filepath.Abs(root)
889		absolutePath, pathErr := filepath.Abs(path)
890		if rootErr != nil || pathErr != nil {
891			return false
892		}
893		relative, err := filepath.Rel(filepath.Clean(absoluteRoot), filepath.Clean(absolutePath))
894		if err != nil || relative == "." || relative == ".." ||
895			strings.HasPrefix(relative, ".."+string(filepath.Separator)) {
896			return false
897		}
898		first, _, _ := strings.Cut(relative, string(filepath.Separator))
899		return strings.HasPrefix(first, ".")
900	}

902	func looksLikePath(ref string) bool {

904			strings.ContainsAny(ref, `/\\`)

907	func samePath(left, right string) bool {
908		if left == "" || right == "" {
909			return false
910		}
911		leftCanonical, leftErr := pathx.Canonical(left)
912		rightCanonical, rightErr := pathx.Canonical(right)
913		if leftErr == nil && rightErr == nil {
914			return leftCanonical == rightCanonical
915		}
916		leftAbsolute, leftAbsErr := filepath.Abs(left)
917		rightAbsolute, rightAbsErr := filepath.Abs(right)
918		return leftAbsErr == nil && rightAbsErr == nil && filepath.Clean(leftAbsolute) == filepath.Clean(rightAbsolute)
919	}

921	func sortItemsByName(items []Item) {
922		sort.SliceStable(items, func(i, j int) bool {
923			left, right := strings.ToLower(items[i].DisplayName()), strings.ToLower(items[j].DisplayName())
924			if left != right {
925				return left < right
926			}
927			if items[i].DisplayName() != items[j].DisplayName() {
928				return items[i].DisplayName() < items[j].DisplayName()
929			}
930			return items[i].ID < items[j].ID
931		})
932	}
933	
934	func sortItemsByActivity(items []Item) {
935		sort.SliceStable(items, func(i, j int) bool {
936			left, right := items[i].Activity(), items[j].Activity()
937			if !left.Equal(right) {
938				if left.IsZero() {
939					return false
940				}
941				if right.IsZero() {
942					return true
943				}
944				return left.After(right)
945			}
946			leftName, rightName := strings.ToLower(items[i].DisplayName()), strings.ToLower(items[j].DisplayName())
947			if leftName != rightName {
948				return leftName < rightName
949			}
950			return items[i].ID < items[j].ID
951		})
952	}

963	func deduplicateItems(items []Item) []Item {
964		seenIDs := make(map[string]struct{}, len(items))

966		out := items[:0]
967		for _, item := range items {
968			if item.ID != "" {

970					continue

984	func deduplicateDiagnostics(diagnostics []Diagnostic) []Diagnostic {
985		seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(diagnostics))
986		out := diagnostics[:0]
987		for _, diagnostic := range diagnostics {
988			key := diagnostic.Path + "\x00" + diagnostic.Operation + "\x00" + fmt.Sprint(diagnostic.Err)
989			if _, ok := seen[key]; ok {

991			}
992			seen[key] = struct{}{}

998	func boundedMap[Input, Output any](ctx context.Context, limit int, input []Input, work func(context.Context, Input) Output) []Output {
999		if len(input) == 0 {
1000			return nil
1001		}
1002		if limit <= 0 || limit > len(input) {
1003			limit = len(input)
1004		}
1005		type job struct {
1006			index int
1007			value Input
1008		}
1009		type result struct {
1010			index int
1011			value Output
1012		}
1013		jobs := make(chan job, len(input))
1014		results := make(chan result, len(input))
1015		for index, value := range input {
1016			jobs <- job{index: index, value: value}
1017		}
1018		close(jobs)
1019	
1020		var workers sync.WaitGroup
1021		workers.Add(limit)
1022		for range limit {
1023			go func() {
1024				defer workers.Done()
1025				for next := range jobs {
1026					results <- result{index: next.index, value: work(ctx, next.value)}
1027				}
1028			}()
1029		}
1030		workers.Wait()
1031		close(results)
1032	
1033		out := make([]Output, len(input))
1034		for result := range results {
1035			out[result.index] = result.value
1036		}
1037		return out
1038	}
1039

142	// Graduate prepares Git while the Try is still at its source, performs one
143	// same-filesystem rename, and atomically transitions the same catalog ID.
144	func (s *Service) Graduate(ctx context.Context, request GraduateRequest) (GraduateResult, error) {
145		plan, err := s.PlanGraduate(ctx, request)
146		result := GraduateResult{Plan: plan, Item: plan.Item, Diagnostics: plan.Diagnostics}

163			}

190		if err != nil {
191			return result, fmt.Errorf("compare graduation filesystems: %w", err)
192		}
193		if !sameDevice {
194			return result, fmt.Errorf("move %s to %s: %w", plan.Source, plan.Destination, ErrCrossFilesystem)
195		}
196		if err := s.validateGraduatePaths(plan); err != nil {
197			return result, err
198		}
199		if err := s.validateCatalogSource(plan.Item.ID, plan.Source); err != nil {
200			return result, err
201		}
202		if err := s.rename(plan.Source, plan.Destination); err != nil {
203			if errors.Is(err, syscall.EXDEV) {
204				return result, fmt.Errorf("move %s to %s: %w", plan.Source, plan.Destination, ErrCrossFilesystem)
205			}
206			return result, fmt.Errorf("move %s to %s: %w", plan.Source, plan.Destination, err)
207		}
208		result.Moved = true
209	
210		probe := s.probeDirectory(ctx, plan.Destination)
211		if !probe.valid || probe.live.Repo == nil || probe.live.DiscoverError != nil {
212			cause := probe.live.DiscoverError
213			if cause == nil && probe.diagnostic != nil {
214				cause = probe.diagnostic.Err
215			}
216			if cause == nil {
217				cause = errors.New("moved project is not a discoverable Git repository")
218			}
219			return s.rollbackGraduation(result, cause)
220		}
221	
222		now := s.now()
223		updated, updateErr := s.catalogUpdate(plan.Item.ID, func(entry *catalog.Entry) error {
224			if entry.Kind != catalog.KindTry || entry.Experiment == nil || entry.Experiment.Phase == catalog.PhaseGraduated {
225				return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s is no longer an active Try", entry.ID)
226			}
227			location, ok := entry.LocationFor(s.host)
228			if !ok || location.State != catalog.LocationPresent || !storedLocationMatches(location, plan.Source) {
229				return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s moved or was reassigned after graduation planning", entry.ID)
230			}
231			entry.Kind = catalog.KindRepository
232			entry.Name = plan.Name
233			entry.Experiment.Phase = catalog.PhaseGraduated
234			entry.Experiment.GraduatedAt = now
235			entry.Experiment.GraduatedPath = probe.live.CurrentPath
236			if probe.originURL != "" {
237				entry.Experiment.OriginURL = probe.originURL
238				entry.RemoteIdentity = catalog.NormalizeRemoteIdentity(probe.originURL)
239			}
240			previous, _ := entry.LocationFor(s.host)
241			return entry.SetLocation(s.host, locationFromProbe(probe, previous))
242		})
243		if updateErr != nil {
244			return s.rollbackGraduation(result, updateErr)
245		}
246		if updated == nil {
247			return s.rollbackGraduation(result, errors.New("catalog update returned no graduated entry"))
248		}
249	
250		item := itemFromEntry(updated, probe.live)
251		enriched := s.enrich(ctx, []Item{item})
252		if len(enriched) == 1 {
253			item = enriched[0]
254		}
255		result.Item = item
256		return result, nil
257	}
258	
259	func (s *Service) validateCatalogSource(id, source string) error {
260		entry, err := s.registry.Get(id)
261		if err != nil {
262			return fmt.Errorf("reload catalog source %s: %w", id, err)
263		}
264		if entry.Kind != catalog.KindTry || entry.Experiment == nil || entry.Experiment.Phase == catalog.PhaseGraduated {
265			return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s is no longer an active Try", id)
266		}
267		location, ok := entry.LocationFor(s.host)
268		if !ok || location.State != catalog.LocationPresent || !storedLocationMatches(location, source) {
269			return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s moved or was reassigned after graduation planning", id)
270		}
271		return nil
272	}
273	
274	func (s *Service) validateGraduatePaths(plan GraduatePlan) error {
275		source, err := pathx.CanonicalChild(s.triesRoot, plan.Source)
276		if err != nil {
277			return fmt.Errorf("revalidate graduation source: %w", err)
278		}
279		if source != plan.Source {
280			return fmt.Errorf("graduation source changed after planning: %s became %s", plan.Source, source)
281		}
282		components := []string{plan.Name}
283		if plan.Category != "" {
284			components = []string{plan.Category, plan.Name}
285		}
286		destination, err := pathx.JoinChild(s.projectRoot, components...)
287		if err != nil {
288			return fmt.Errorf("revalidate graduation destination: %w", err)
289		}
290		if destination != plan.Destination {
291			return fmt.Errorf("graduation destination changed after planning: %s became %s", plan.Destination, destination)
292		}
293		if err := rejectExisting(destination); err != nil {
294			return err
295		}
296		if nested, nestedErr := pathx.IsChild(source, destination); nestedErr != nil {
297			return fmt.Errorf("revalidate graduation destination: %w", nestedErr)
298		} else if nested {
299			return fmt.Errorf("graduation destination %s is inside its source %s", destination, source)
300		}
301		return nil
302	}
303	
304	func storedLocationMatches(location catalog.Location, source string) bool {
305		return filepath.Clean(location.CurrentPath) == source || filepath.Clean(location.RealPath) == source
306	}
307	
308	func (s *Service) resolveGraduateItem(ctx context.Context, request GraduateRequest) (Item, []Diagnostic, error) {
309		if strings.TrimSpace(request.Ref) != "" {
310			return s.Resolve(ctx, request.Ref)
311		}
312		current := request.CurrentDir
313		if current == "" {
314			var err error
315			current, err = s.getwd()
316			if err != nil {
317				return Item{}, nil, fmt.Errorf("get current directory: %w", err)
318			}
319		}
320		canonicalCurrent, err := pathx.CanonicalChild(s.triesRoot, current)
321		if err != nil {
322			return Item{}, nil, fmt.Errorf("%s is not inside %s — name the try to graduate", current, s.triesRoot)
323		}
324		canonicalRoot, err := pathx.Canonical(s.triesRoot)
325		if err != nil {
326			return Item{}, nil, err
327		}
328		relative, err := filepath.Rel(canonicalRoot, canonicalCurrent)
329		if err != nil {
330			return Item{}, nil, err
331		}
332		first, _, _ := strings.Cut(relative, string(filepath.Separator))
333		if first == "" || first == "." || strings.HasPrefix(first, ".") {
334			return Item{}, nil, fmt.Errorf("%s is not inside a visible try under %s", current, s.triesRoot)
335		}
336		return s.Resolve(ctx, filepath.Join(s.triesRoot, first))
337	}

339	func (s *Service) hasCommit(ctx context.Context, directory string) bool {
340		if unix, _, err := s.gitLastCommit(ctx, directory); err == nil && unix > 0 {
341			return true
342		}
343		_, err := s.gitRun(ctx, directory, "rev-parse", "--verify", "HEAD")
344		return err == nil
345	}

347	func (s *Service) ensureInitialCommit(ctx context.Context, directory, name string) (bool, error) {
348		if s.hasCommit(ctx, directory) {
349			return false, nil
350		}
351		empty, err := isEmptyWorkTree(directory)
352		if err != nil {
353			return false, err
354		}
355		if empty {
356			readme := filepath.Join(directory, "README.md")
357			file, err := os.OpenFile(readme, os.O_WRONLY|os.O_CREATE|os.O_EXCL, 0o644)
358			if err != nil {
359				return false, err
360			}
361			if _, err := fmt.Fprintf(file, "# %s\n", name); err != nil {
362				_ = file.Close()
363				return false, err
364			}
365			if err := file.Close(); err != nil {
366				return false, err
367			}
368		}
369		if _, err := s.gitRun(ctx, directory, "add", "--all"); err != nil {
370			return false, err
371		}
372		if _, err := s.gitRun(ctx, directory, "commit", "-m", "chore: graduate experiment into a project"); err != nil {
373			return false, err
374		}
375		return true, nil
376	}

378	func (s *Service) rollbackGraduation(result GraduateResult, cause error) (GraduateResult, error) {
379		rollbackErr := rejectExisting(result.Plan.Source)
380		if rollbackErr == nil {
381			rollbackErr = s.rename(result.Plan.Destination, result.Plan.Source)
382		}
383		result.RollbackError = rollbackErr
384		result.RolledBack = rollbackErr == nil
385		if rollbackErr == nil {
386			result.Moved = false
387		}
388		return result, &FinalizeError{
389			Source: result.Plan.Source, Destination: result.Plan.Destination,
390			Cause: cause, RollbackErr: rollbackErr,
391		}
392	}

394	func rejectExisting(path string) error {
395		if _, err := os.Lstat(path); err == nil {
396			return fmt.Errorf("%s already exists", path)
397		} else if !errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
398			return fmt.Errorf("inspect graduation destination %s: %w", path, err)
399		}
400		return nil
401	}
402	
403	func isEmptyWorkTree(directory string) (bool, error) {
404		entries, err := os.ReadDir(directory)
405		if err != nil {
406			return false, err
407		}
408		for _, entry := range entries {
409			if entry.Name() != ".git" {
410				return false, nil
411			}
412		}
413		return true, nil
414	}
415	
416	func sameFilesystem(source, destination string) (bool, error) {
417		sourceAncestor, err := nearestExisting(source)
418		if err != nil {
419			return false, err
420		}
421		destinationAncestor, err := nearestExisting(destination)
422		if err != nil {
423			return false, err
424		}
425		sourceInfo, err := os.Stat(sourceAncestor)
426		if err != nil {
427			return false, err
428		}
429		destinationInfo, err := os.Stat(destinationAncestor)
430		if err != nil {
431			return false, err
432		}
433		sourceDevice, sourceOK := deviceNumber(sourceInfo)
434		destinationDevice, destinationOK := deviceNumber(destinationInfo)
435		if !sourceOK || !destinationOK {
436			// os.Rename remains the final authority on platforms whose FileInfo does
437			// not expose a Unix-style device number.
438			return true, nil
439		}
440		return sourceDevice == destinationDevice, nil
441	}
442	
443	func nearestExisting(path string) (string, error) {
444		path = filepath.Clean(path)
445		for {
446			if _, err := os.Stat(path); err == nil {
447				return path, nil
448			} else if !errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
449				return "", err
450			}
451			parent := filepath.Dir(path)
452			if parent == path {
453				return "", fmt.Errorf("no existing ancestor for %s", path)
454			}
455			path = parent
456		}
457	}
458	
459	func deviceNumber(info fs.FileInfo) (uint64, bool) {
460		value := reflect.ValueOf(info.Sys())
461		if !value.IsValid() {
462			return 0, false
463		}
464		if value.Kind() == reflect.Pointer {
465			if value.IsNil() {
466				return 0, false
467			}
468			value = value.Elem()
469		}
470		if value.Kind() != reflect.Struct {
471			return 0, false
472		}
473		device := value.FieldByName("Dev")
474		if !device.IsValid() {
475			return 0, false
476		}
477		switch device.Kind() {
478		case reflect.Uint, reflect.Uint8, reflect.Uint16, reflect.Uint32, reflect.Uint64, reflect.Uintptr:
479			return device.Uint(), true
480		case reflect.Int, reflect.Int8, reflect.Int16, reflect.Int32, reflect.Int64:
481			return uint64(device.Int()), true
482		default:
483			return 0, false
484		}
485	}

627	func TestReconcileBoundsConcurrentGitDiscovery(t *testing.T) {
628		var active atomic.Int32
629		var maximum atomic.Int32
630		hooks := experiment.Hooks{
631			GitDiscover: func(_ context.Context, directory string) (gitx.Repo, error) {
632				current := active.Add(1)
633				for {
634					seen := maximum.Load()
635					if current <= seen || maximum.CompareAndSwap(seen, current) {
636						break
637					}
638				}
639				time.Sleep(15 * time.Millisecond)
640				active.Add(-1)
641				return gitx.Repo{
642					Root: directory, MainRoot: directory,
643					GitCommonDir: filepath.Join(directory, ".git"), Name: filepath.Base(directory),

23	
24	Experiments need a home that is neither /tmp (where they vanish) nor your
25	projects directory (where they accumulate as clutter you are afraid to delete).
26	A try is date-prefixed, disposable by default, and promotable with
27	"dev graduate" when it turns out to be real.
28	
29	  dev try                    list what is there
30	  dev try redis-streams      jump to a matching try, or create 2026-08-27-redis-streams
31	  dev try --clone <url>      clone a repo into a dated try directory`,
32			Args: cobra.MaximumNArgs(1),

34				ctx := ctxOf()

37					return err
38				}

70		flags.StringVar(&clone, "clone", "", "clone a repository into the new try")

72		return cmd
73	}
74	
75	func newExperimentService(app *App) (*experiment.Service, error) {
76		return experiment.NewService(experiment.ServiceConfig{
77			Registry:    app.Registry,
78			Store:       app.Catalog,
79			TriesRoot:   config.Expand(app.Cfg.Paths.TriesRoot),
80			ProjectRoot: config.Expand(app.Cfg.Paths.ProjectRoot),
81			Host:        config.Hostname(),
82			Clock:       time.Now,
83		})
84	}
85	
86	func listTries(app *App, ctx context.Context, service *experiment.Service, root string) error {
87		items, diagnostics, err := service.List(ctx, experiment.ListOptions{})
88		warnExperimentDiagnostics(app, diagnostics)
89		if err != nil {
90			return err
91		}
92		if len(items) == 0 {
93			fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "No tries yet under %s\n", config.Contract(root))
94			return nil
95		}
96	
97		table := NewTable("TRY", "AGE", "GIT")
98		for _, item := range items {
99			gitColumn := "—"
100			switch {
101			case item.Live.Repo != nil && item.Live.Status != nil && item.Live.Status.Dirty():
102				gitColumn = "repo ●"
103			case item.Live.Repo != nil && item.Live.StatusError != nil:
104				gitColumn = "repo ?"
105			case item.Live.Repo != nil:
106				gitColumn = "repo"
107			case item.Live.DiscoverError != nil:
108				gitColumn = "error"
109			}
110			age := "unknown"
111			if activity := item.Activity(); !activity.IsZero() {
112				age = humanAge(time.Since(activity))
113			}
114			table.Add(truncate(item.DisplayName(), 44), age, gitColumn)
115		}
116		table.Render(app.Out)
117		fmt.Fprintf(app.Err, "\n%d tries under %s — promote one with `dev graduate <try>`\n",
118			len(items), config.Contract(root))
119		return nil
120	}
121	
122	func warnExperimentDiagnostics(app *App, diagnostics []experiment.Diagnostic) {
123		for _, diagnostic := range diagnostics {
124			app.warnf("%s", diagnostic.Error())
125		}
126	}
127	
128	func openOrCD(app *App, ctx context.Context, dir, label string) bool {
129		runtime := app.Runtime()
130		if runtime.Name() == "none" {
131			app.cdDirective(dir)
132			return true
133		}
134		if _, err := openCheckout(ctx, runtime, dir, label); err != nil {
135			app.warnf("could not open a session: %v", err)
136			return false
137		}
138		return true
139	}

26	An experiment that turns out to matter should stop being an experiment, and

28	prefix forever, or it gets copied by hand and the history is left behind.
29	
30	graduate moves the directory to <project_root>/<category>/<name>, drops the
31	date prefix, makes sure it has a git repo and a first commit, and optionally
32	creates the remote with gh or glab.
33	
34	With no argument, the try containing the current directory is used.`,

48				}

57				if dryRun {

59					return nil

62				result, err := service.Graduate(ctx, request)
63				if err != nil {

65				}

1	package cli
2	
3	import (
4		"fmt"
5		"os"
6	
7		"github.com/spf13/cobra"
8	)
9	
10	// zshInit and friends define the wrapper that makes `dev resume` able to leave
11	// the user *inside* the checkout.
12	//
13	// A process can never change its parent's working directory, so dev prints a
14	// `cd <path>` directive on stdout and the wrapper evaluates it. This is the
15	// same mechanism try-cli uses, and it is why `dev` is a shell function rather
16	// than only a binary.
17	const posixInit = `# dev shell integration — add to your rc file:
18	#   eval "$(dev shell-init %[2]s)"
19	export DEV_SHELL_INIT=1
20	dev() {
21	  local __dev_out __dev_status __dev_last __dev_before
22	  __dev_out="$(command %[1]s "$@")"
23	  __dev_status=$?
24	  __dev_last="${__dev_out##*$'\n'}"
25	  if [ $__dev_status -eq 0 ] && [ "${__dev_last#cd }" != "$__dev_last" ]; then
26	    if [ "$__dev_out" != "$__dev_last" ]; then
27	      __dev_before="${__dev_out%%$'\n'*}"
28	      [ -n "$__dev_before" ] && printf '%%s\n' "$__dev_before"
29	    fi
30	    eval "$__dev_last"
31	  elif [ -n "$__dev_out" ]; then
32	    printf '%%s\n' "$__dev_out"
33	  fi
34	  return $__dev_status
35	}
36	`
37	
38	const fishInit = `# dev shell integration — add to config.fish:
39	#   dev shell-init fish | source
40	set -gx DEV_SHELL_INIT 1
41	function dev
42	    set -l __dev_out (command %[1]s $argv)
43	    set -l __dev_status $status
44	    set -l __dev_last $__dev_out[-1]
45	    if test $__dev_status -eq 0; and string match -q 'cd *' -- "$__dev_last"
46	        if test (count $__dev_out) -gt 1
47	            printf '%%s\n' $__dev_out[1..-2]
48	        end
49	        eval $__dev_last
50	    else if test (count $__dev_out) -gt 0
51	        printf '%%s\n' $__dev_out
52	    end
53	    return $__dev_status
54	end
55	`
56	
57	func newShellInitCmd(app *App) *cobra.Command {
58		cmd := &cobra.Command{
59			Use:   "shell-init <bash|zsh|fish>",
60			Short: "Print the shell wrapper that lets dev change your directory",
61			Long: `Print a shell function that wraps the dev binary.
62	
63	dev commands that move you into a checkout (resume, try, wt open with the
64	"none" runtime) print a "cd <path>" directive rather than trying to change
65	directory themselves, because a child process cannot change its parent's
66	working directory. The wrapper evaluates that directive.
67	
68	Add to your shell rc file:
69	
70	    eval "$(dev shell-init zsh)"          # bash and zsh
71	    dev shell-init fish | source          # fish`,
72			Args:      cobra.ExactArgs(1),
73			ValidArgs: []string{"bash", "zsh", "fish"},
74			RunE: func(cmd *cobra.Command, args []string) error {
75				self, err := os.Executable()
76				if err != nil || self == "" {
77					self = "dev"
78				}
79				switch args[0] {
80				case "bash", "zsh":
81					fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, posixInit, shellQuote(self), args[0])
82				case "fish":
83					fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, fishInit, shellQuote(self))
84				default:
85					return fmt.Errorf("unsupported shell %q: want bash, zsh or fish", args[0])
86				}
87				return nil
88			},
89		}
90		// Completion is a sibling concern but belongs to the same "wire dev into
91		// my shell" moment, so it hangs off this command.
92		cmd.AddCommand(&cobra.Command{
93			Use:       "completion <bash|zsh|fish>",
94			Short:     "Print shell completions",
95			Args:      cobra.ExactArgs(1),
96			ValidArgs: []string{"bash", "zsh", "fish"},
97			RunE: func(cmd *cobra.Command, args []string) error {
98				root := cmd.Root()
99				switch args[0] {
100				case "bash":
101					return root.GenBashCompletionV2(app.Out, true)
102				case "zsh":
103					return root.GenZshCompletion(app.Out)
104				case "fish":
105					return root.GenFishCompletion(app.Out, true)
106				}
107				return fmt.Errorf("unsupported shell %q", args[0])
108			},
109		})
110		return cmd
111	}

1	// Package cli assembles dev's command tree. Commands stay thin: they parse
2	// flags, call into the domain packages, and render. All policy lives in
3	// config, catalog, gitx, wt, task and runtime so it can be tested without a terminal.
4	package cli
5	
6	import (
7		"context"
8		"fmt"
9		"io"
10		"os"
11	
12		"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/catalog"
13		"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/config"
14		"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/runtime"
15		"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/task"
16	)
17	
18	// App is the state shared by every command.
19	type App struct {
20		Cfg      config.Config
21		Tasks    *task.Store
22		Catalog  *catalog.Store
23		Registry *catalog.Registry
24	
25		Out io.Writer
26		Err io.Writer
27	
28		// configPath is the --config override; empty means the XDG default.
29		configPath string
30		// runtimeOverride is the --runtime flag; empty means use the config.
31		runtimeOverride string
32		// noRuntime disables all multiplexer interaction for one invocation.
33		noRuntime bool
34	}
35	
36	// Load reads configuration and prepares the shared stores.
37	func (a *App) Load() error {
38		cfg, err := config.Load(a.configPath)
39		if err != nil {
40			return err
41		}
42		a.Cfg = cfg
43		if a.Out == nil {
44			a.Out = os.Stdout
45		}
46		if a.Err == nil {
47			a.Err = os.Stderr
48		}
49		a.Tasks = task.NewStore(cfg.TasksDir())
50		a.Catalog = catalog.NewStore(cfg.AssetsDir(), catalog.WithDiagnosticSink(func(diagnostic catalog.Diagnostic) {
51			fmt.Fprintf(a.Err, "dev: warning: %s\n", diagnostic.Error())
52		}))
53		a.Registry = catalog.NewRegistry(a.Catalog)
54		return nil
55	}
56	
57	// Runtime resolves the multiplexer backend for this invocation, honouring
58	// --runtime and --no-runtime.
59	func (a *App) Runtime() runtime.Runtime {
60		if a.noRuntime {
61			return runtime.None{}
62		}
63		backend := a.Cfg.Runtime.Backend
64		if a.runtimeOverride != "" {
65			backend = a.runtimeOverride
66		}
67		rt := runtime.Select(backend)
68		if h, ok := rt.(*runtime.Herdr); ok {
69			return h.WithMetadataSource(a.Cfg.Runtime.MetadataSource)
70		}
71		return rt
72	}
73	
74	// printf writes to the command's stdout.
75	func (a *App) printf(format string, args ...any) {
76		fmt.Fprintf(a.Out, format, args...)
77	}
78	
79	// warnf writes a non-fatal notice to stderr, so it never pollutes piped output.
80	func (a *App) warnf(format string, args ...any) {
81		fmt.Fprintf(a.Err, "dev: "+format+"\n", args...)
82	}
83	
84	// cdDirective emits the marker the shell wrapper installed by
85	// `dev shell-init` looks for. A child process cannot change its parent's
86	// working directory, so the only way `dev resume` can leave the user *in* the
87	// checkout is to ask the shell to do it.
88	func (a *App) cdDirective(dir string) {
89		fmt.Fprintf(a.Out, "cd %s\n", shellQuote(dir))
90	}
91	
92	// ctx is the cancellable context commands run under.
93	func ctxOf() context.Context { return context.Background() }
94
