1	package gitx
2	
3	import (
4		"context"
5		"os"
6		"path/filepath"
7		"strconv"
8		"strings"
9		"time"
10	)
11	
12	// Status is the live git state of one checkout — everything dev's inventory
13	// shows about a task without persisting any of it.
14	type Status struct {
15		Branch   string `json:"branch,omitempty"`
16		Detached bool   `json:"detached"`
17		// Upstream is the tracking ref (e.g. "origin/feat/auth"), empty when the
18		// branch has never been published.
19		Upstream string `json:"upstream,omitempty"`
20		Ahead    int    `json:"ahead"`
21		Behind   int    `json:"behind"`
22		// Changed counts unique changed paths. Staged and Unstaged are index /
23		// working-tree views and can overlap when one path has both kinds of
24		// changes; Changed does not double-count it.
25		Changed   int `json:"changed"`
26		Staged    int `json:"staged"`
27		Unstaged  int `json:"unstaged"`
28		Untracked int `json:"untracked"`
29		// Added, Modified, Deleted and Renamed classify status letters. One path
30		// can contribute to two when its staged and unstaged states differ.
31		Added    int `json:"added"`
32		Modified int `json:"modified"`
33		Deleted  int `json:"deleted"`
34		Renamed  int `json:"renamed"`
35		// LatestChange is the newest mtime among changed files that still exist.
36		// Deleted paths fall back to the checkout's last commit time at the repo
37		// aggregation layer.
38		LatestChange time.Time `json:"latest_change,omitempty"`
39		// Conflicted counts unmerged paths; a non-zero value means the checkout is
40		// mid-merge or mid-rebase and must not be touched automatically.
41		Conflicted int `json:"conflicted"`
42	}
43	
44	// Dirty reports uncommitted work of any kind.
45	func (s Status) Dirty() bool { return s.Changed > 0 }
46	
47	// Published reports whether the branch has an upstream at all.
48	func (s Status) Published() bool { return s.Upstream != "" }
49	
50	// Synced reports a branch that is published and exactly level with upstream.
51	func (s Status) Synced() bool { return s.Published() && s.Ahead == 0 && s.Behind == 0 }
52	
53	// Summary renders the compact, starship-like column used throughout dev:
54	//
55	//	⇕⇡2⇣1 =1 +3 !2 ?4
56	//
57	// Divergence, conflicts, staged, unstaged and untracked paths remain separate
58	// so "dirty" says how and by how much, rather than collapsing to one ●.
59	func (s Status) Summary() string {
60		var parts []string
61		switch {
62		case s.Ahead > 0 && s.Behind > 0:
63			parts = append(parts, "⇕⇡"+strconv.Itoa(s.Ahead)+"⇣"+strconv.Itoa(s.Behind))
64		case s.Ahead > 0:
65			parts = append(parts, "⇡"+strconv.Itoa(s.Ahead))
66		case s.Behind > 0:
67			parts = append(parts, "⇣"+strconv.Itoa(s.Behind))
68		}
69		if s.Conflicted > 0 {
70			parts = append(parts, "="+strconv.Itoa(s.Conflicted))
71		}
72		if s.Staged > 0 {
73			parts = append(parts, "+"+strconv.Itoa(s.Staged))
74		}
75		if s.Unstaged > 0 {
76			parts = append(parts, "!"+strconv.Itoa(s.Unstaged))
77		}
78		if s.Untracked > 0 {
79			parts = append(parts, "?"+strconv.Itoa(s.Untracked))
80		}
81		if len(parts) == 0 {
82			if !s.Published() {
83				return "local"
84			}
85			return "clean"
86		}
87		return strings.Join(parts, " ")
88	}
89	
90	// Breakdown renders the detailed change count shown by `dev status` and the
91	// TUI detail pane. Changed is the unique-path total; staged and unstaged may
92	// overlap, which is stated by presenting them as categories rather than a sum.
93	func (s Status) Breakdown() string {
94		if s.Changed == 0 {
95			return "0 changed paths"
96		}
97		var parts []string
98		if s.Staged > 0 {
99			parts = append(parts, "+"+strconv.Itoa(s.Staged)+" staged")
100		}
101		if s.Unstaged > 0 {
102			parts = append(parts, "!"+strconv.Itoa(s.Unstaged)+" unstaged")
103		}
104		if s.Untracked > 0 {
105			parts = append(parts, "?"+strconv.Itoa(s.Untracked)+" untracked")
106		}
107		if s.Conflicted > 0 {
108			parts = append(parts, "="+strconv.Itoa(s.Conflicted)+" conflicted")
109		}
110		return strconv.Itoa(s.Changed) + " changed paths (" + strings.Join(parts, ", ") + ")"
111	}
112	
113	// TypeBreakdown classifies the status letters when that detail is available.
114	func (s Status) TypeBreakdown() string {
115		var parts []string
116		for _, item := range []struct {
117			n    int
118			name string
119		}{
120			{s.Added, "added"}, {s.Modified, "modified"}, {s.Deleted, "deleted"},
121			{s.Renamed, "renamed/copied"},
122		} {
123			if item.n > 0 {
124				parts = append(parts, strconv.Itoa(item.n)+" "+item.name)
125			}
126		}
127		return strings.Join(parts, ", ")
128	}
129	
130	// StatusOf reads the porcelain v2 status of the checkout at dir. Porcelain v2
131	// is the documented machine-readable format: it reports branch, upstream and
132	// ahead/behind in the same pass as the file states, so one process gives dev
133	// everything it needs.
134	func StatusOf(ctx context.Context, dir string) (Status, error) {
135		out, err := run(ctx, dir, "status", "--porcelain=v2", "--branch", "--untracked-files=normal", "-z")
136		if err != nil {
137			return Status{}, err
138		}
139		var s Status
140		for _, rec := range nulLines(out) {
141			if rec == "" {
142				continue
143			}
144			switch rec[0] {
145			case '#':
146				parseBranchHeader(rec, &s)
147			case '1', '2':
148				// "1 XY ..." ordinary change, "2 XY ..." rename/copy. X is
149				// staged, Y unstaged. This record is one unique changed path even
150				// when both sides are non-dot.
151				f := strings.Fields(rec)
152				if len(f) < 2 || len(f[1]) < 2 {
153					continue
154				}
155				s.Changed++
156				x, y := f[1][0], f[1][1]
157				if x != '.' {
158					s.Staged++
159				}
160				if y != '.' {
161					s.Unstaged++
162				}
163				classifyChange(x, &s)
164				classifyChange(y, &s)
165				updateLatestChange(dir, statusPath(rec), &s)
166			case 'u':
167				s.Changed++
168				s.Conflicted++
169				updateLatestChange(dir, statusPath(rec), &s)
170			case '?':
171				s.Changed++
172				s.Untracked++
173				updateLatestChange(dir, strings.TrimPrefix(rec, "? "), &s)
174			}
175		}
176		return s, nil
177	}
178	
179	// statusPath extracts the final pathname from a porcelain-v2 record while
180	// preserving spaces in it. Rename records have one extra score field; their
181	// old path arrives as the next NUL record and is intentionally ignored.
182	func statusPath(rec string) string {
183		if rec == "" {
184			return ""
185		}
186		var fields int
187		switch rec[0] {
188		case '1':
189			fields = 9
190		case '2':
191			fields = 10
192		case 'u':
193			fields = 11
194		default:
195			return ""
196		}
197		parts := strings.SplitN(rec, " ", fields)
198		if len(parts) != fields {
199			return ""
200		}
201		return parts[fields-1]
202	}
203	
204	func updateLatestChange(dir, path string, s *Status) {
205		if path == "" {
206			return
207		}
208		info, err := os.Stat(filepath.Join(dir, filepath.FromSlash(path)))
209		if err == nil && info.ModTime().After(s.LatestChange) {
210			s.LatestChange = info.ModTime()
211		}
212	}
213	
214	func classifyChange(code byte, s *Status) {
215		switch code {
216		case 'A':
217			s.Added++
218		case 'M', 'T':
219			s.Modified++
220		case 'D':
221			s.Deleted++
222		case 'R', 'C':
223			s.Renamed++
224		}
225	}
226	
227	func parseBranchHeader(rec string, s *Status) {
228		f := strings.Fields(rec)
229		if len(f) < 3 {
230			return
231		}
232		switch f[1] {
233		case "branch.head":
234			if f[2] == "(detached)" {
235				s.Detached = true
236			} else {
237				s.Branch = f[2]
238			}
239		case "branch.upstream":
240			s.Upstream = f[2]
241		case "branch.ab":
242			// "# branch.ab +2 -1"
243			if len(f) < 4 {
244				return
245			}
246			s.Ahead, _ = strconv.Atoi(strings.TrimPrefix(f[2], "+"))
247			s.Behind, _ = strconv.Atoi(strings.TrimPrefix(f[3], "-"))
248		}
249	}
250	
251	// LastCommit reports the author timestamp of HEAD as a Unix epoch, and the
252	// subject line. Used to age a task in `dev sweep`.
253	func LastCommit(ctx context.Context, dir string) (unix int64, subject string, err error) {
254		out, err := run(ctx, dir, "log", "-1", "--format=%at%x00%s")
255		if err != nil || out == "" {
256			return 0, "", err
257		}
258		ts, subj, _ := strings.Cut(out, "\x00")
259		unix, _ = strconv.ParseInt(ts, 10, 64)
260		return unix, subj, nil
261	}
262	
263	// WipCommit stages everything and records a checkpoint commit.
264	//
265	// A checkpoint commit is deliberately preferred over `git stash`: a stash is
266	// invisible in the log, easy to forget, and cannot be pushed — so it can never
267	// travel to another machine, which is exactly what parking a task needs.
268	func WipCommit(ctx context.Context, dir, message string) (bool, error) {
269		st, err := StatusOf(ctx, dir)
270		if err != nil {
271			return false, err
272		}
273		if !st.Dirty() {
274			return false, nil
275		}
276		if st.Conflicted > 0 {
277			return false, &Error{Args: []string{"commit"}, Dir: dir,
278				Stderr: "checkout has unmerged paths; resolve the conflict before parking"}
279		}
280		if _, err := run(ctx, dir, "add", "--all"); err != nil {
281			return false, err
282		}
283		if message == "" {
284			message = "wip: checkpoint"
285		}
286		if _, err := run(ctx, dir, "commit", "--no-verify", "-m", message); err != nil {
287			return false, err
288		}
289		return true, nil
290	}

package cli

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"sort"
	"strings"
	"time"

	"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/config"
	"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/forge"

	"github.com/spf13/cobra"
)

func newTryCmd(app *App) *cobra.Command {
	var (
		list  bool
		clone string
		noGit bool
	)
	cmd := &cobra.Command{
		Use:   "try [name]",
		Short: "Make a dated scratch directory for an experiment",
		Long: `Create (or jump to) a dated experiment directory under paths.tries_root.

Experiments need a home that is neither /tmp (where they vanish) nor your
projects directory (where they accumulate as clutter you are afraid to delete).
A try is date-prefixed, disposable by default, and promotable with
"dev graduate" when it turns out to be real.

  dev try                    list what is there
  dev try redis-streams      jump to a matching try, or create 2026-08-27-redis-streams
  dev try --clone <url>      clone a repo into a dated try directory`,
		Args: cobra.MaximumNArgs(1),
		RunE: func(cmd *cobra.Command, args []string) error {
			ctx := ctxOf()
			root := config.Expand(app.Cfg.Paths.TriesRoot)
			if err := os.MkdirAll(root, 0o755); err != nil {
				return err
			}

			if list || (len(args) == 0 && clone == "") {
				return listTries(app, root)
			}

			name := ""
			if len(args) == 1 {
				name = args[0]
			}
			if clone != "" && name == "" {
				name = repoNameFromRef(clone)
			}
			slug := config.Slug(strings.ReplaceAll(name, " ", "-"))

			// An existing try wins over creating a near-duplicate: the whole
			// point is to stop accumulating test/test2/test-actually.
			if match := findTry(root, slug); match != "" && clone == "" {
				fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "%s\n", config.Contract(match))
				return openOrCD(app, ctx, match, filepath.Base(match))
			}

			dir := filepath.Join(root, time.Now().Format("2006-01-02")+"-"+slug)
			if _, err := os.Stat(dir); err == nil {
				fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "%s\n", config.Contract(dir))
				return openOrCD(app, ctx, dir, filepath.Base(dir))
			}

			if clone != "" {
				url := clone
				if k := forge.FromURL(clone); k != forge.Unknown {
					if f, err := forge.For(k); err == nil {
						url = f.CloneURL(clone)
					}
				}
				if _, err := gitx.Run(ctx, root, "clone", url, dir); err != nil {
					return err
				}
			} else {
				if err := os.MkdirAll(dir, 0o755); err != nil {
					return err
				}
				if !noGit {
					// A try with git history can be graduated without losing
					// the path that got there, which is most of its value.
					if _, err := gitx.Run(ctx, dir, "init", "-b", "main"); err != nil {
						app.warnf("could not git init: %v", err)
					}
				}
			}
			fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "%s\n", config.Contract(dir))
			return openOrCD(app, ctx, dir, filepath.Base(dir))
		},
	}
	f := cmd.Flags()
	f.BoolVarP(&list, "list", "l", false, "list existing tries")
	f.StringVar(&clone, "clone", "", "clone a repository into the new try")
	f.BoolVar(&noGit, "no-git", false, "do not git init the new directory")
	return cmd
}

// tryEntry is one scratch directory with the facts needed to rank it.
type tryEntry struct {
	name     string
	path     string
	modified time.Time
	isRepo   bool
	dirty    bool
}

func listTries(app *App, root string) error {
	entries, err := os.ReadDir(root)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	var tries []tryEntry
	for _, e := range entries {
		if !e.IsDir() || strings.HasPrefix(e.Name(), ".") {
			continue
		}
		info, err := e.Info()
		if err != nil {
			continue
		}
		path := filepath.Join(root, e.Name())
		t := tryEntry{name: e.Name(), path: path, modified: info.ModTime()}
		if _, err := os.Stat(filepath.Join(path, ".git")); err == nil {
			t.isRepo = true
			if st, err := gitx.StatusOf(ctxOf(), path); err == nil {
				t.dirty = st.Dirty()
			}
		}
		tries = append(tries, t)
	}
	if len(tries) == 0 {
		fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "No tries yet under %s\n", config.Contract(root))
		return nil
	}
	// Most recently touched first: "what was I doing yesterday?" is the
	// question a list of experiments actually gets asked.
	sort.Slice(tries, func(i, j int) bool { return tries[i].modified.After(tries[j].modified) })

	tbl := NewTable("TRY", "AGE", "GIT")
	for _, t := range tries {
		gitCol := "—"
		switch {
		case t.isRepo && t.dirty:
			gitCol = "repo ●"
		case t.isRepo:
			gitCol = "repo"
		}
		tbl.Add(truncate(t.name, 44), humanAge(time.Since(t.modified)), gitCol)
	}
	tbl.Render(app.Out)
	fmt.Fprintf(app.Err, "\n%d tries under %s — promote one with `dev graduate <try>`\n",
		len(tries), config.Contract(root))
	return nil
}

// findTry locates an existing try whose name contains the slug, preferring the
// most recent when several match.
func findTry(root, slug string) string {
	entries, err := os.ReadDir(root)
	if err != nil {
		return ""
	}
	var best string
	var bestTime time.Time
	for _, e := range entries {
		if !e.IsDir() || !strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(e.Name()), strings.ToLower(slug)) {
			continue
		}
		info, err := e.Info()
		if err != nil {
			continue
		}
		if info.ModTime().After(bestTime) {
			best, bestTime = filepath.Join(root, e.Name()), info.ModTime()
		}
	}
	return best
}

func openOrCD(app *App, ctx context.Context, dir, label string) error {
	rt := app.Runtime()
	if rt.Name() == "none" {
		app.cdDirective(dir)
		return nil
	}
	if _, err := openCheckout(ctx, rt, dir, label); err != nil {
		app.warnf("could not open a session: %v", err)
	}
	return nil
}

package cli

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"regexp"
	"strings"

	"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/config"
	"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/forge"
	"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/gitx"
	"github.com/spf13/cobra"
)

// datePrefix matches the "2026-08-27-" a try directory carries.
var datePrefix = regexp.MustCompile(`^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}-`)

func newGraduateCmd(app *App) *cobra.Command {
	var (
		category string
		name     string
		private  bool
		remote   bool
		push     bool
		dryRun   bool
	)
	cmd := &cobra.Command{
		Use:   "graduate [try]",
		Short: "Promote an experiment into a real project",
		Long: `Move a try out of the scratch directory and into your projects tree.

An experiment that turns out to matter should stop being an experiment, and
that transition is where things usually get lost — the directory keeps its date
prefix forever, or it gets copied by hand and the history is left behind.

graduate moves the directory to <project_root>/<category>/<name>, drops the
date prefix, makes sure it has a git repo and a first commit, and optionally
creates the remote with gh or glab.

With no argument, the try containing the current directory is used.`,
		Args: cobra.MaximumNArgs(1),
		RunE: func(cmd *cobra.Command, args []string) error {
			ctx := ctxOf()
			triesRoot := config.Expand(app.Cfg.Paths.TriesRoot)

			src, err := resolveTry(app, triesRoot, args)
			if err != nil {
				return err
			}
			if name == "" {
				name = datePrefix.ReplaceAllString(filepath.Base(src), "")
			}
			if name == "" {
				return fmt.Errorf("could not derive a project name from %s — pass --name", src)
			}

			dest := filepath.Join(config.Expand(app.Cfg.Paths.ProjectRoot), category, name)
			if _, err := os.Stat(dest); err == nil {
				return fmt.Errorf("%s already exists", config.Contract(dest))
			}

			fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "graduate  %s\n", config.Contract(src))
			fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "       →  %s\n", config.Contract(dest))
			if dryRun {
				fmt.Fprintln(app.Out, "\n(dry run — nothing moved)")
				return nil
			}

			if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(dest), 0o755); err != nil {
				return err
			}
			// Rename first: it is atomic within a filesystem and leaves
			// nothing half-copied if it fails.
			if err := os.Rename(src, dest); err != nil {
				return fmt.Errorf("move %s: %w\n"+
					"If the projects root is on another filesystem, copy it by hand and remove the try",
					config.Contract(src), err)
			}

			if _, err := os.Stat(filepath.Join(dest, ".git")); err != nil {
				if _, err := gitx.Run(ctx, dest, "init", "-b", "main"); err != nil {
					return err
				}
				fmt.Fprintln(app.Out, "   git init")
			}
			// An experiment usually has files but no commit. A project needs
			// one: without a HEAD there is no default branch, so `dev start`
			// would have nothing to base a worktree on.
			if made, err := ensureInitialCommit(ctx, dest, name); err != nil {
				app.warnf("could not make an initial commit: %v", err)
			} else if made {
				fmt.Fprintln(app.Out, "   committed the existing work")
			}

			if remote {
				f, err := forge.Preferred()
				if err != nil {
					app.warnf("%v — the project is in place; add a remote by hand", err)
				} else {
					url, err := f.CreateRepo(ctx, dest, forge.RepoRequest{
						Name: name, Private: private, Push: push,
					})
					if err != nil {
						app.warnf("could not create the remote: %v", err)
					} else {
						fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "   remote    %s\n", url)
					}
				}
			}

			fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "\n%s is now a project. Start work on it with:\n  dev start %s --task <name>\n",
				name, name)
			return openOrCD(app, ctx, dest, name)
		},
	}
	f := cmd.Flags()
	f.StringVarP(&category, "category", "c", "", "category subdirectory under project_root")
	f.StringVar(&name, "name", "", "project name (default: the try name without its date prefix)")
	f.BoolVar(&private, "private", true, "create the remote as private")
	f.BoolVar(&remote, "remote", false, "create a remote repository with gh or glab")
	f.BoolVar(&push, "push", true, "push after creating the remote")
	f.BoolVar(&dryRun, "dry-run", false, "show what would happen without moving anything")
	return cmd
}

// resolveTry finds the try directory to graduate: an explicit reference, or
// the try containing the current directory.
func resolveTry(app *App, triesRoot string, args []string) (string, error) {
	if len(args) == 1 {
		ref := args[0]
		if abs := config.Expand(ref); isDir(abs) {
			return abs, nil
		}
		direct := filepath.Join(triesRoot, ref)
		if isDir(direct) {
			return direct, nil
		}
		if match := findTry(triesRoot, ref); match != "" {
			return match, nil
		}
		return "", fmt.Errorf("no try matching %q under %s", ref, config.Contract(triesRoot))
	}

	cwd, err := os.Getwd()
	if err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	if !strings.HasPrefix(cwd, triesRoot+string(filepath.Separator)) {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("%s is not inside %s — name the try to graduate",
			config.Contract(cwd), config.Contract(triesRoot))
	}
	// Walk up to the try's own top-level directory, so running this from a
	// subdirectory still graduates the whole experiment.
	rel, _ := filepath.Rel(triesRoot, cwd)
	first := strings.Split(rel, string(filepath.Separator))[0]
	return filepath.Join(triesRoot, first), nil
}

func isDir(p string) bool {
	info, err := os.Stat(p)
	return err == nil && info.IsDir()
}

// ensureInitialCommit gives a repository a first commit if it has none,
// seeding a README when the tree is otherwise empty. Reports whether it made
// one.
func ensureInitialCommit(ctx context.Context, dir, name string) (bool, error) {
	if _, _, err := gitx.LastCommit(ctx, dir); err == nil {
		return false, nil // already has history
	}
	if empty, err := isEmptyTree(dir); err != nil {
		return false, err
	} else if empty {
		readme := filepath.Join(dir, "README.md")
		if err := os.WriteFile(readme, []byte("# "+name+"\n"), 0o644); err != nil {
			return false, err
		}
	}
	if _, err := gitx.Run(ctx, dir, "add", "--all"); err != nil {
		return false, err
	}
	if _, err := gitx.Run(ctx, dir, "commit", "-m", "chore: graduate experiment into a project"); err != nil {
		return false, err
	}
	return true, nil
}

// isEmptyTree reports a directory with nothing in it but git's own metadata.
func isEmptyTree(dir string) (bool, error) {
	entries, err := os.ReadDir(dir)
	if err != nil {
		return false, err
	}
	for _, e := range entries {
		if e.Name() != ".git" {
			return false, nil
		}
	}
	return true, nil
}

```text
package cli

import (
	"fmt"
	"os"

	"github.com/spf13/cobra"
)

// zshInit and friends define the wrapper that makes `dev resume` able to leave
// the user *inside* the checkout.
//
// A process can never change its parent's working directory, so dev prints a
// `cd <path>` directive on stdout and the wrapper evaluates it. This is the
// same mechanism try-cli uses, and it is why `dev` is a shell function rather
// than only a binary.
const posixInit = `# dev shell integration — add to your rc file:
#   eval "$(dev shell-init %[2]s)"
export DEV_SHELL_INIT=1
dev() {
  local __dev_out __dev_status
  __dev_out="$(command %[1]s "$@")"
  __dev_status=$?
  if [ $__dev_status -eq 0 ] && [ "${__dev_out#cd }" != "$__dev_out" ]; then
    eval "$__dev_out"
  elif [ -n "$__dev_out" ]; then
    printf '%%s\n' "$__dev_out"
  fi
  return $__dev_status
}
`

const fishInit = `# dev shell integration — add to config.fish:
#   dev shell-init fish | source
set -gx DEV_SHELL_INIT 1
function dev
    set -l __dev_out (command %[1]s $argv)
    set -l __dev_status $status
    if test $__dev_status -eq 0; and string match -q 'cd *' -- "$__dev_out"
        eval $__dev_out
    else if test -n "$__dev_out"
        printf '%%s\n' $__dev_out
    end
    return $__dev_status
end
`

func newShellInitCmd(app *App) *cobra.Command {
	cmd := &cobra.Command{
		Use:   "shell-init <bash|zsh|fish>",
		Short: "Print the shell wrapper that lets dev change your directory",
		Long: `Print a shell function that wraps the dev binary.

dev commands that move you into a checkout (resume, try, wt open with the
"none" runtime) print a "cd <path>" directive rather than trying to change
directory themselves, because a child process cannot change its parent's
working directory. The wrapper evaluates that directive.

Add to your shell rc file:

    eval "$(dev shell-init zsh)"          # bash and zsh
    dev shell-init fish | source          # fish`,
		Args:      cobra.ExactArgs(1),
		ValidArgs: []string{"bash", "zsh", "fish"},
		RunE: func(cmd *cobra.Command, args []string) error {
			self, err := os.Executable()
			if err != nil || self == "" {
				self = "dev"
			}
			switch args[0] {
			case "bash", "zsh":
				fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, posixInit, shellQuote(self), args[0])
			case "fish":
				fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, fishInit, shellQuote(self))
			default:
				return fmt.Errorf("unsupported shell %q: want bash, zsh or fish", args[0])
			}
			return nil
		},
	}
	// Completion is a sibling concern but belongs to the same "wire dev into
	// my shell" moment, so it hangs off this command.
	cmd.AddCommand(&cobra.Command{
		Use:       "completion <bash|zsh|fish>",
		Short:     "Print shell completions",
		Args:      cobra.ExactArgs(1),
		ValidArgs: []string{"bash", "zsh", "fish"},
		RunE: func(cmd *cobra.Command, args []string) error {
			root := cmd.Root()
			switch args[0] {
			case "bash":
				return root.GenBashCompletionV2(app.Out, true)
			case "zsh":
				return root.GenZshCompletion(app.Out)
			case "fish":
				return root.GenFishCompletion(app.Out, true)
			}
			return fmt.Errorf("unsupported shell %q", args[0])
		},
	})
	return cmd
}

+	if _, err := os.Stat(filepath.Join(path, ".git")); !os.IsNotExist(err) {
+		t.Errorf("--no-git created Git metadata: %v", err)
+	}
+
+	// A second positional invocation selects the same Try rather than becoming a
+	// future management subcommand or creating a duplicate.
+	h.mustRun("try", "archive", "--no-git")
+	entries, err = os.ReadDir(triesRoot)
+	if err != nil || len(entries) != 1 {
+		t.Errorf("second try archive entries = %d, %v", len(entries), err)
+	}
+}
+
+func TestTryAmbiguousNameDoesNotSilentlyPickOne(t *testing.T) {
+	h := newHarness(t)
+	triesRoot := filepath.Join(h.home, "tries")
+	for _, name := range []string{"2026-08-20-cache-alpha", "2026-08-21-cache-beta"} {
+		if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Join(triesRoot, name), 0o755); err != nil {
+			t.Fatal(err)
+		}
+	}
+	_, _, err := h.run("try", "cache")
+	if err == nil || !strings.Contains(err.Error(), "ambiguous") ||
+		!strings.Contains(err.Error(), "cache-alpha") || !strings.Contains(err.Error(), "cache-beta") {
+		t.Errorf("ambiguous try error = %v", err)
+	}
+	entries, readErr := os.ReadDir(triesRoot)
+	if readErr != nil || len(entries) != 2 {
+		t.Errorf("ambiguous selection created a duplicate: %d, %v", len(entries), readErr)
+	}
+}
+
+func TestTryListDoesNotUseDirectoryMTimeAsActivity(t *testing.T) {
+	h := newHarness(t)
+	path := filepath.Join(h.home, "tries", "legacy-non-git")
+	if err := os.MkdirAll(path, 0o755); err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	future := time.Now().Add(365 * 24 * time.Hour)
+	if err := os.Chtimes(path, future, future); err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	out := h.mustRun("try", "--list")
+	if !strings.Contains(out, "legacy-non-git") || !strings.Contains(out, "unknown") {
+		t.Errorf("Try list invented mtime activity: %q", out)
+	}
+}
+
+func TestTryCloneUsesLocalRepositoryAndVersionsCollisions(t *testing.T) {
+	h := newHarness(t)
+	h.mustRun("try", "--clone", h.repo.Root)
+	h.mustRun("try", "--clone", h.repo.Root)
+	entries, err := os.ReadDir(filepath.Join(h.home, "tries"))
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	if len(entries) != 2 {
+		t.Fatalf("clone entries = %d, want 2", len(entries))
+	}
+	var names []string
+	for _, entry := range entries {
+		names = append(names, entry.Name())
+	}
+	if !strings.HasSuffix(names[0], "-demo") || !strings.HasSuffix(names[1], "-demo-2") {
+		t.Errorf("clone collision names = %v", names)
+	}
+}
+
+func TestGraduateRemoteRefreshesCatalogOrigin(t *testing.T) {
+	h := newHarness(t)
+	h.mustRun("try", "remote-origin", "--no-git")
+
+	binDir := t.TempDir()
+	gh := filepath.Join(binDir, "gh")
+	script := `#!/bin/sh
+set -eu
+if [ "$1" != "repo" ] || [ "$2" != "create" ]; then
+  exit 2
+fi
+git remote add origin "git@github.com:owner/$3.git"
+printf 'https://github.com/owner/%s\n' "$3"
+`
+	if err := os.WriteFile(gh, []byte(script), 0o755); err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	t.Setenv("PATH", binDir+string(os.PathListSeparator)+os.Getenv("PATH"))
+	out := h.mustRun("graduate", "remote-origin", "--remote", "--push=false")
+	if !strings.Contains(out, "https://github.com/owner/remote-origin") {
+		t.Fatalf("graduate remote output: %q", out)
+	}
+
+	assets, err := os.ReadDir(filepath.Join(h.home, "state", "assets"))
+	if err != nil || len(assets) != 1 {
+		t.Fatalf("catalog assets = %d, %v", len(assets), err)
+	}
+	body, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(h.home, "state", "assets", assets[0].Name()))
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	if !strings.Contains(string(body), "git@github.com:owner/remote-origin.git") ||
+		!strings.Contains(string(body), "github.com/owner/remote-origin") {
+		t.Errorf("graduated catalog did not retain remote origin:\n%s", body)
+	}
+}

1	// Package gitx wraps the git porcelain commands dev depends on. Every helper
2	// shells out to git rather than linking a Go implementation: git is already a
3	// hard dependency, its porcelain formats are stable and documented, and this
4	// keeps dev's behaviour identical to what the user sees when they run the same
5	// command by hand.
6	package gitx
7	
8	import (
9		"bytes"
10		"context"
11		"errors"
12		"fmt"
13		"os/exec"
14		"strings"
15	)

17	// ErrNotARepo is returned when a directory is not inside a git working tree.
18	var ErrNotARepo = errors.New("not a git repository")
19	
20	// Error carries the failing command and git's own stderr, which is almost
21	// always more useful than the exit status alone.
22	type Error struct {
23		Args   []string
24		Dir    string
25		Stderr string
26		Err    error
27	}
28	
29	func (e *Error) Error() string {
30		msg := strings.TrimSpace(e.Stderr)
31		if msg == "" {
32			msg = e.Err.Error()
33		}
34		return fmt.Sprintf("git %s: %s", strings.Join(e.Args, " "), msg)
35	}
36	
37	func (e *Error) Unwrap() error { return e.Err }
38	
39	// run executes git in dir and returns trimmed stdout.
40	func run(ctx context.Context, dir string, args ...string) (string, error) {
41		// -c core.quotepath=false keeps non-ASCII paths readable rather than
42		// octal-escaped, which matters for the Chinese-named files in these repos.
43		full := append([]string{"-c", "core.quotepath=false"}, args...)
44		cmd := exec.CommandContext(ctx, "git", full...)
45		cmd.Dir = dir
46		var stdout, stderr bytes.Buffer
47		cmd.Stdout = &stdout
48		cmd.Stderr = &stderr
49		if err := cmd.Run(); err != nil {
50			gerr := &Error{Args: args, Dir: dir, Stderr: stderr.String(), Err: err}
51			if strings.Contains(gerr.Stderr, "not a git repository") {
52				return "", fmt.Errorf("%s: %w", dir, ErrNotARepo)
53			}
54			return "", gerr
55		}
56		return strings.TrimRight(stdout.String(), "\n"), nil
57	}
58	
59	// Run executes an arbitrary git command in dir. Exported for the few callers
60	// (park's wip commit, done's merge) that need a one-off command.
61	func Run(ctx context.Context, dir string, args ...string) (string, error) {
62		return run(ctx, dir, args...)
63	}
64	
65	// lines splits git output into non-empty lines.
66	func lines(s string) []string {
67		if s == "" {
68			return nil
69		}
70		out := strings.Split(s, "\n")
71		filtered := out[:0]
72		for _, l := range out {
73			if l != "" {
74				filtered = append(filtered, l)
75			}
76		}
77		return filtered
78	}

83		if s == "" {
84			return nil
85		}
86		return strings.Split(s, "\x00")

12	// Tmux is the fallback backend for machines without herdr. It models a task as
13	// a named tmux session rooted at the checkout.
14	type Tmux struct{ bin string }
15	
16	// NewTmux returns the tmux adapter.

18	
19	// Name implements Runtime.
20	func (t *Tmux) Name() string { return "tmux" }
21	
22	// Available reports whether tmux is installed. Unlike herdr, tmux needs no
23	// running server for `new-session -d` to work, so presence is enough.
24	func (t *Tmux) Available() bool { return haveBinary(t.bin) }
25	
26	func (t *Tmux) run(ctx context.Context, args ...string) (string, error) {
27		cmd := exec.CommandContext(ctx, t.bin, args...)
28		var stdout, stderr bytes.Buffer
29		cmd.Stdout, cmd.Stderr = &stdout, &stderr
30		if err := cmd.Run(); err != nil {
31			msg := strings.TrimSpace(stderr.String())
32			if msg == "" {
33				msg = err.Error()
34			}
35			return "", fmt.Errorf("tmux %s: %s", strings.Join(args, " "), msg)
36		}
37		return strings.TrimRight(stdout.String(), "\n"), nil
38	}
39	
40	// tmuxUnsafe covers the characters tmux treats specially in session names:
41	// a "." or ":" would make the name ambiguous with window/pane addressing.
42	var tmuxUnsafe = regexp.MustCompile(`[.:\s]+`)
43	
44	// SessionName converts a task label into a legal tmux session name.
45	func SessionName(label string) string {
46		s := tmuxUnsafe.ReplaceAllString(label, "-")
47		s = strings.Trim(s, "-")
48		if s == "" {
49			return "dev"
50		}
51		return s
52	}

54	// List implements Runtime. An absent server means "no sessions", not an error.
55	func (t *Tmux) List(ctx context.Context) ([]Session, error) {
56		out, err := t.run(ctx, "list-sessions", "-F", "#{session_name}\t#{session_path}\t#{?session_attached,1,0}")
57		if err != nil {
58			// "no server running on ..." is the normal idle case.
59			if strings.Contains(err.Error(), "no server running") || strings.Contains(err.Error(), "error connecting") {
60				return nil, nil
61			}
62			return nil, err
63		}
64		var sessions []Session
65		for _, line := range strings.Split(out, "\n") {
66			if line == "" {
67				continue
68			}
69			f := strings.Split(line, "\t")
70			if len(f) < 2 {
71				continue
72			}
73			s := Session{Handle: f[0], Label: f[0], Dirs: []string{f[1]}}
74			if len(f) > 2 {
75				s.Focused = f[2] == "1"
76			}
77			sessions = append(sessions, s)
78		}
79		return sessions, nil
80	}

23	// harness runs dev commands against an isolated HOME, config and scan root.
24	type harness struct {
25		t          *testing.T
26		home       string
27		configPath string
28		scanRoot   string
29		wtRoot     string
30		repo       *gittest.Repo
31	}
32	
33	func newHarness(t *testing.T) *harness {
34		t.Helper()
35		home := t.TempDir()
36		scanRoot := filepath.Join(home, "Program")
37		wtRoot := filepath.Join(home, "Worktrees")
38		if err := os.MkdirAll(scanRoot, 0o755); err != nil {
39			t.Fatal(err)
40		}
41	
42		// A repo inside the scan root, so `dev` discovers it the way it would in
43		// real use rather than via an absolute path.
44		r := gittest.New(t)
45		dest := filepath.Join(scanRoot, "demo")
46		if err := os.Rename(r.Root, dest); err != nil {
47			t.Fatal(err)
48		}
49		r.Root = dest
50	
51		// Isolate every path dev touches from the developer's real machine.
52		t.Setenv("HOME", home)
53		t.Setenv("XDG_DATA_HOME", filepath.Join(home, ".local", "share"))
54		t.Setenv("XDG_CONFIG_HOME", filepath.Join(home, ".config"))
55		t.Setenv("XDG_CACHE_HOME", filepath.Join(home, ".cache"))
56	
57		configPath := filepath.Join(home, "config.toml")
58		cfg := "" +
59			"[paths]\n" +
60			"scan_roots = [\"" + scanRoot + "\"]\n" +
61			"project_root = \"" + scanRoot + "\"\n" +
62			"tries_root = \"" + filepath.Join(home, "tries") + "\"\n" +
63			"worktree_root = \"" + wtRoot + "\"\n" +
64			"state_dir = \"" + filepath.Join(home, "state") + "\"\n" +
65			"\n[runtime]\nbackend = \"none\"\n" +
66			"\n[worktree]\ninclude = [\".env\"]\npost_create = []\n"
67		if err := os.WriteFile(configPath, []byte(cfg), 0o644); err != nil {
68			t.Fatal(err)
69		}
70		return &harness{t: t, home: home, configPath: configPath, scanRoot: scanRoot, wtRoot: wtRoot, repo: r}
71	}

73	// run executes one dev invocation, capturing its output. Commands write
74	// through App, so the writers passed to NewRootCommandWithIO are all that is
75	// needed — no file-descriptor juggling.
76	func (h *harness) run(args ...string) (string, string, error) {
77		h.t.Helper()
78		var out, errBuf bytes.Buffer
79		root := cli.NewRootCommandWithIO(&out, &errBuf)
80		root.SetArgs(append([]string{"--config", h.configPath}, args...))
81		err := root.Execute()
82		return out.String(), errBuf.String(), err
83	}

88		if err != nil {
89			h.t.Fatalf("dev %s: %v\nstderr: %s", strings.Join(args, " "), err, errOut)
90		}
91		return out
92	}

94	func TestLifecycleEndToEnd(t *testing.T) {
95		h := newHarness(t)
96	
97		// An empty inventory should tell the user how to start, not print nothing.
98		out := h.mustRun("ls")
99		if !strings.Contains(out, "No tasks yet") {
100			t.Errorf("empty ls output: %q", out)
101		}
102	
103		// start: branch + worktree + task entry.

105		if !strings.Contains(out, "feat/auth") {
106			t.Fatalf("start output: %q", out)

111		}

113		// The task appears in the inventory as hot.
114		out = h.mustRun("ls")
115		if !strings.Contains(out, "auth") || !strings.Contains(out, "HOT") {
116			t.Errorf("ls after start: %q", out)
117		}
118	
119		// JSON is a stable contract for other tools.

121		var rows []map[string]any
122		if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(out), &rows); err != nil {
123			t.Fatalf("ls --json is not valid JSON: %v\n%s", err, out)

28	      [ -n "$__dev_before" ] && printf '%%s\n' "$__dev_before"

106	// no remote, or one on a self-hosted host neither CLI knows, resolves to

121			return GitLab
122		}
123		return Unknown
124	}

135	}

22		}

12	// Tmux is the fallback backend for machines without herdr. It models a task as
13	// a named tmux session rooted at the checkout.
14	type Tmux struct{ bin string }
15	
16	// NewTmux returns the tmux adapter.
17	func NewTmux() *Tmux { return &Tmux{bin: "tmux"} }
18	
19	// Name implements Runtime.
20	func (t *Tmux) Name() string { return "tmux" }
21	
22	// Available reports whether tmux is installed. Unlike herdr, tmux needs no
23	// running server for `new-session -d` to work, so presence is enough.
24	func (t *Tmux) Available() bool { return haveBinary(t.bin) }
25	
26	func (t *Tmux) run(ctx context.Context, args ...string) (string, error) {
27		cmd := exec.CommandContext(ctx, t.bin, args...)
28		var stdout, stderr bytes.Buffer
29		cmd.Stdout, cmd.Stderr = &stdout, &stderr
30		if err := cmd.Run(); err != nil {
31			msg := strings.TrimSpace(stderr.String())
32			if msg == "" {
33				msg = err.Error()
34			}
35			return "", fmt.Errorf("tmux %s: %s", strings.Join(args, " "), msg)
36		}
37		return strings.TrimRight(stdout.String(), "\n"), nil
38	}
39	
40	// tmuxUnsafe covers the characters tmux treats specially in session names:
41	// a "." or ":" would make the name ambiguous with window/pane addressing.
42	var tmuxUnsafe = regexp.MustCompile(`[.:\s]+`)
43	
44	// SessionName converts a task label into a legal tmux session name.
45	func SessionName(label string) string {
46		s := tmuxUnsafe.ReplaceAllString(label, "-")
47		s = strings.Trim(s, "-")
48		if s == "" {
49			return "dev"
50		}
51		return s
52	}
53	
54	// List implements Runtime. An absent server means "no sessions", not an error.
55	func (t *Tmux) List(ctx context.Context) ([]Session, error) {
56		out, err := t.run(ctx, "list-sessions", "-F", "#{session_name}\t#{session_path}\t#{?session_attached,1,0}")
57		if err != nil {
58			// "no server running on ..." is the normal idle case.
59			if strings.Contains(err.Error(), "no server running") || strings.Contains(err.Error(), "error connecting") {
60				return nil, nil
61			}
62			return nil, err
63		}
64		var sessions []Session
65		for _, line := range strings.Split(out, "\n") {
66			if line == "" {
67				continue
68			}
69			f := strings.Split(line, "\t")
70			if len(f) < 2 {
71				continue
72			}
73			s := Session{Handle: f[0], Label: f[0], Dirs: []string{f[1]}}
74			if len(f) > 2 {
75				s.Focused = f[2] == "1"
76			}
77			sessions = append(sessions, s)
78		}
79		return sessions, nil
80	}
81	
82	// Open implements Runtime, reusing a session that already exists under that
83	// name rather than creating a duplicate.
84	func (t *Tmux) Open(ctx context.Context, dir, label string) (string, error) {
85		name := SessionName(label)
86		if _, err := t.run(ctx, "has-session", "-t", "="+name); err == nil {
87			return name, nil
88		}
89		if _, err := t.run(ctx, "new-session", "-d", "-s", name, "-c", dir); err != nil {
90			return "", err
91		}
92		return name, nil
93	}
94	
95	// Close implements Runtime: it kills the session only. The checkout is
96	// untouched.
97	func (t *Tmux) Close(ctx context.Context, handle string) error {
98		if handle == "" {
99			return nil
100		}
101		if _, err := t.run(ctx, "has-session", "-t", "="+handle); err != nil {
102			return nil // already gone
103		}
104		_, err := t.run(ctx, "kill-session", "-t", "="+handle)
105		return err
106	}
107	
108	// Annotate implements Runtime. tmux has no metadata channel, so dev writes the
109	// task state into the session's user option, where a status-line format can
110	// pick it up with #{@dev_stage} if the user wants it.
111	func (t *Tmux) Annotate(ctx context.Context, handle string, kv map[string]string) error {
112		if handle == "" {
113			return nil
114		}
115		for k, v := range kv {
116			if _, err := t.run(ctx, "set-option", "-t", "="+handle, "-q", "@dev_"+k, v); err != nil {
117				return err
118			}
119		}
120		return nil
121	}

41	// "~/Worktrees" and "$WORK/trees" have to work.
42	func Expand(p string) string {
43		if p == "" {
44			return ""
45		}
46		p = os.ExpandEnv(p)
47		switch {
48		case p == "~":
49			p = home()
50		case strings.HasPrefix(p, "~/"):
51			p = filepath.Join(home(), p[2:])
52		}
53		if abs, err := filepath.Abs(p); err == nil {
54			return abs
55		}
56		return filepath.Clean(p)
57	}

64		}
65		if h != "" && strings.HasPrefix(p, h+string(filepath.Separator)) {

13		ai, err := os.Stat(a)

16		}

39	// Expand resolves a leading ~ and any environment variables in p, then makes
40	// the result absolute. Paths in config.toml are written by humans, so both
41	// "~/Worktrees" and "$WORK/trees" have to work.
42	func Expand(p string) string {
43		if p == "" {
44			return ""
45		}
46		p = os.ExpandEnv(p)
47		switch {
48		case p == "~":
49			p = home()
50		case strings.HasPrefix(p, "~/"):
51			p = filepath.Join(home(), p[2:])
52		}
53		if abs, err := filepath.Abs(p); err == nil {
54			return abs
55		}
56		return filepath.Clean(p)
57	}
58	
59	// Contract renders p with $HOME collapsed back to ~, for display only.
60	func Contract(p string) string {
61		h := home()
62		if h != "" && p == h {
63			return "~"
64		}
65		if h != "" && strings.HasPrefix(p, h+string(filepath.Separator)) {
66			return "~" + p[len(h):]
67		}
68		return p
69	}

464			}
465			value = value.Elem()

469		}
470		device := value.FieldByName("Dev")
471		if !device.IsValid() {
472			return 0, false
473		}
474		switch device.Kind() {
475		case reflect.Uint, reflect.Uint8, reflect.Uint16, reflect.Uint32, reflect.Uint64, reflect.Uintptr:
476			return device.Uint(), true
477		case reflect.Int, reflect.Int8, reflect.Int16, reflect.Int32, reflect.Int64:

package experiment

func sameFilesystem(source, destination string) (bool, error) {
	sourceAncestor, err := nearestExisting(source)
	if err != nil {
		return false, err
	}
	destinationAncestor, err := nearestExisting(destination)
	if err != nil {
		return false, err

	if err != nil {

	}

//go:build windows

package experiment

import (
	"fmt"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"

	"golang.org/x/sys/windows"
)

func sameFilesystem(source, destination string) (bool, error) {
	sourceAncestor, err := nearestExisting(source)
	if err != nil {
		return false, err
	}
	destinationAncestor, err := nearestExisting(destination)
	if err != nil {
		return false, err
	}
	sourceVolume, err := windowsVolumePath(sourceAncestor)
	if err != nil {
		return false, fmt.Errorf("identify source volume: %w", err)
	}
	destinationVolume, err := windowsVolumePath(destinationAncestor)
	if err != nil {
		return false, fmt.Errorf("identify destination volume: %w", err)
	}
	return sameWindowsVolumePath(sourceVolume, destinationVolume), nil
}

func windowsVolumePath(path string) (string, error) {
	pathPointer, err := windows.UTF16PtrFromString(path)
	if err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	buffer := make([]uint16, windows.MAX_PATH+1)
	if err := windows.GetVolumePathName(pathPointer, &buffer[0], uint32(len(buffer))); err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	return windows.UTF16ToString(buffer), nil
}

func sameWindowsVolumePath(left, right string) bool {
	return strings.EqualFold(filepath.Clean(left), filepath.Clean(right))
}

413	func nearestExisting(path string) (string, error) {
414		path = filepath.Clean(path)
415		for {
416			if _, err := os.Stat(path); err == nil {
417				return path, nil
418			} else if !errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
419				return "", err
420			}
421			parent := filepath.Dir(path)
422			if parent == path {
423				return "", fmt.Errorf("no existing ancestor for %s", path)
424			}
425			path = parent
426		}
427	}

13	func sameFilesystem(source, destination string) (bool, error) {
14		sourceAncestor, err := nearestExisting(source)
15		if err != nil {
16			return false, err
17		}
18		destinationAncestor, err := nearestExisting(destination)
19		if err != nil {
20			return false, err
21		}
22		sourceVolume, err := windowsVolumePath(sourceAncestor)
23		if err != nil {
24			return false, fmt.Errorf("identify source volume: %w", err)
25		}
26		destinationVolume, err := windowsVolumePath(destinationAncestor)
27		if err != nil {
28			return false, fmt.Errorf("identify destination volume: %w", err)
29		}
30		return sameWindowsVolumePath(sourceVolume, destinationVolume), nil
31	}
32	
33	func windowsVolumePath(path string) (string, error) {
34		pathPointer, err := windows.UTF16PtrFromString(path)
35		if err != nil {
36			return "", err
37		}
38		buffer := make([]uint16, windows.MAX_PATH+1)
39		if err := windows.GetVolumePathName(pathPointer, &buffer[0], uint32(len(buffer))); err != nil {
40			return "", err
41		}
42		return windows.UTF16ToString(buffer), nil
43	}
44	
45	func sameWindowsVolumePath(left, right string) bool {
46		return strings.EqualFold(filepath.Clean(left), filepath.Clean(right))
47	}

10	func sameFilesystem(source, destination string) (bool, error) {

12		if err != nil {
13			return false, err
14		}
15		destinationAncestor, err := nearestExisting(destination)
16		if err != nil {

18		}
19		sourceInfo, err := os.Stat(sourceAncestor)
20		if err != nil {
21			return false, err
22		}
23		destinationInfo, err := os.Stat(destinationAncestor)
24		if err != nil {
25			return false, err
26		}
27		sourceStat, sourceOK := sourceInfo.Sys().(*syscall.Stat_t)
28		destinationStat, destinationOK := destinationInfo.Sys().(*syscall.Stat_t)
29		if !sourceOK || !destinationOK {
30			// os.Rename remains the final authority on platforms whose FileInfo does
31			// not expose a Unix-style device number.
32			return true, nil
33		}
34		return sourceStat.Dev == destinationStat.Dev, nil
35	}

13	func sameFilesystem(source, destination string) (bool, error) {
14		sourceAncestor, err := nearestExisting(source)
15		if err != nil {
16			return false, err
17		}
18		destinationAncestor, err := nearestExisting(destination)
19		if err != nil {
20			return false, err
21		}
22		sourceVolume, err := windowsVolumePath(sourceAncestor)
23		if err != nil {
24			return false, fmt.Errorf("identify source volume: %w", err)
25		}
26		destinationVolume, err := windowsVolumePath(destinationAncestor)
27		if err != nil {
28			return false, fmt.Errorf("identify destination volume: %w", err)
29		}
30		return sameWindowsVolumePath(sourceVolume, destinationVolume), nil
31	}
32	
33	func windowsVolumePath(path string) (string, error) {
34		pathPointer, err := windows.UTF16PtrFromString(path)
35		if err != nil {
36			return "", err
37		}
38		buffer := make([]uint16, windows.MAX_PATH+1)
39		if err := windows.GetVolumePathName(pathPointer, &buffer[0], uint32(len(buffer))); err != nil {
40			return "", err
41		}
42		return windows.UTF16ToString(buffer), nil
43	}
44	
45	func sameWindowsVolumePath(left, right string) bool {
46		return strings.EqualFold(filepath.Clean(left), filepath.Clean(right))
47	}

142	// same-filesystem rename, and atomically transitions the same catalog ID.
143	func (s *Service) Graduate(ctx context.Context, request GraduateRequest) (GraduateResult, error) {
144		plan, err := s.PlanGraduate(ctx, request)

256	func (s *Service) validateCatalogSource(id, source string) error {
257		entry, err := s.registry.Get(id)
258		if err != nil {
259			return fmt.Errorf("reload catalog source %s: %w", id, err)
260		}
261		if entry.Kind != catalog.KindTry || entry.Experiment == nil || entry.Experiment.Phase == catalog.PhaseGraduated {
262			return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s is no longer an active Try", id)
263		}
264		location, ok := entry.LocationFor(s.host)
265		if !ok || location.State != catalog.LocationPresent || !storedLocationMatches(location, source) {
266			return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s moved or was reassigned after graduation planning", id)
267		}
268		return nil
269	}

253	func (s *Service) validateCatalogSource(id, source string) error {
254		entry, err := s.registry.Get(id)
255		if err != nil {
256			return fmt.Errorf("reload catalog source %s: %w", id, err)
257		}
258		if entry.Kind != catalog.KindTry || entry.Experiment == nil || entry.Experiment.Phase == catalog.PhaseGraduated {
259			return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s is no longer an active Try", id)
260		}
261		location, ok := entry.LocationFor(s.host)
262		if !ok || location.State != catalog.LocationPresent || !storedLocationMatches(location, source) {
263			return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s moved or was reassigned after graduation planning", id)
264		}
265		return nil
266	}
267	
268	func (s *Service) validateGraduatePaths(plan GraduatePlan) error {
269		source, err := pathx.CanonicalChild(s.triesRoot, plan.Source)
270		if err != nil {
271			return fmt.Errorf("revalidate graduation source: %w", err)
272		}
273		if source != plan.Source {
274			return fmt.Errorf("graduation source changed after planning: %s became %s", plan.Source, source)
275		}
276		components := []string{plan.Name}
277		if plan.Category != "" {
278			components = []string{plan.Category, plan.Name}
279		}
280		destination, err := s.availableGraduationDestination(components)
281		if err != nil {
282			return fmt.Errorf("revalidate graduation destination: %w", err)
283		}
284		if destination != plan.Destination {
285			return fmt.Errorf("graduation destination changed after planning: %s became %s", plan.Destination, destination)
286		}
287		if nested, nestedErr := pathx.IsChild(source, destination); nestedErr != nil {
288			return fmt.Errorf("revalidate graduation destination: %w", nestedErr)
289		} else if nested {
290			return fmt.Errorf("graduation destination %s is inside its source %s", destination, source)
291		}
292		return nil
293	}
294	
295	func storedLocationMatches(location catalog.Location, source string) bool {
296		return filepath.Clean(location.CurrentPath) == source || filepath.Clean(location.RealPath) == source
297	}
298	
299	func (s *Service) resolveGraduateItem(ctx context.Context, request GraduateRequest) (Item, []Diagnostic, error) {
300		if strings.TrimSpace(request.Ref) != "" {
301			return s.Resolve(ctx, request.Ref)
302		}
303		current := request.CurrentDir
304		if current == "" {
305			var err error
306			current, err = s.getwd()
307			if err != nil {
308				return Item{}, nil, fmt.Errorf("get current directory: %w", err)
309			}
310		}
311		canonicalCurrent, err := pathx.CanonicalChild(s.triesRoot, current)
312		if err != nil {
313			return Item{}, nil, fmt.Errorf("%s is not inside %s — name the try to graduate", current, s.triesRoot)
314		}
315		canonicalRoot, err := pathx.Canonical(s.triesRoot)
316		if err != nil {
317			return Item{}, nil, err
318		}
319		relative, err := filepath.Rel(canonicalRoot, canonicalCurrent)
320		if err != nil {
321			return Item{}, nil, err
322		}
323		first, _, _ := strings.Cut(relative, string(filepath.Separator))
324		if first == "" || first == "." || strings.HasPrefix(first, ".") {
325			return Item{}, nil, fmt.Errorf("%s is not inside a visible try under %s", current, s.triesRoot)
326		}
327		return s.Resolve(ctx, filepath.Join(s.triesRoot, first))
328	}

330	func (s *Service) hasCommit(ctx context.Context, directory string) bool {
331		if unix, _, err := s.gitLastCommit(ctx, directory); err == nil && unix > 0 {
332			return true
333		}
334		_, err := s.gitRun(ctx, directory, "rev-parse", "--verify", "HEAD")
335		return err == nil
336	}
337	
338	func (s *Service) ensureInitialCommit(ctx context.Context, directory, name string) (bool, error) {
339		if s.hasCommit(ctx, directory) {
340			return false, nil
341		}
342		empty, err := isEmptyWorkTree(directory)
343		if err != nil {
344			return false, err
345		}
346		if empty {
347			readme := filepath.Join(directory, "README.md")
348			file, err := os.OpenFile(readme, os.O_WRONLY|os.O_CREATE|os.O_EXCL, 0o644)
349			if err != nil {
350				return false, err
351			}
352			if _, err := fmt.Fprintf(file, "# %s\n", name); err != nil {
353				_ = file.Close()
354				return false, err
355			}
356			if err := file.Close(); err != nil {
357				return false, err
358			}
359		}
360		if _, err := s.gitRun(ctx, directory, "add", "--all"); err != nil {
361			return false, err
362		}
363		tracked, err := s.gitRun(ctx, directory, "ls-files", "--cached")
364		if err != nil {
365			return false, err
366		}
367		commitArgs := []string{"commit"}
368		if tracked == "" {
369			// A Try containing only globally ignored files still needs a HEAD, but dev
370			// must not force-add or overwrite those user files merely to manufacture it.
371			commitArgs = append(commitArgs, "--allow-empty")
372		}
373		commitArgs = append(commitArgs, "-m", "chore: graduate experiment into a project")
374		if _, err := s.gitRun(ctx, directory, commitArgs...); err != nil {
375			return false, err
376		}
377		return true, nil
378	}
379	
380	func (s *Service) rollbackGraduation(result GraduateResult, cause error) (GraduateResult, error) {
381		rollbackErr := rejectExisting(result.Plan.Source)
382		if rollbackErr == nil {
383			rollbackErr = s.rename(result.Plan.Destination, result.Plan.Source)
384		}
385		result.RollbackError = rollbackErr
386		result.RolledBack = rollbackErr == nil
387		if rollbackErr == nil {
388			result.Moved = false
389		}
390		return result, &FinalizeError{
391			Source: result.Plan.Source, Destination: result.Plan.Destination,
392			Cause: cause, RollbackErr: rollbackErr,
393		}
394	}
395	
396	func rejectExisting(path string) error {
397		if _, err := os.Lstat(path); err == nil {
398			return fmt.Errorf("%s already exists", path)
399		} else if !errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
400			return fmt.Errorf("inspect graduation destination %s: %w", path, err)
401		}
402		return nil
403	}
404	
405	func isEmptyWorkTree(directory string) (bool, error) {
406		entries, err := os.ReadDir(directory)
407		if err != nil {
408			return false, err
409		}
410		for _, entry := range entries {
411			if entry.Name() != ".git" {
412				return false, nil
413			}
414		}
415		return true, nil
416	}
417	
418	func nearestExisting(path string) (string, error) {
419		path = filepath.Clean(path)
420		for {
421			if _, err := os.Stat(path); err == nil {
422				return path, nil
423			} else if !errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
424				return "", err
425			}
426			parent := filepath.Dir(path)
427			if parent == path {
428				return "", fmt.Errorf("no existing ancestor for %s", path)
429			}
430			path = parent
431		}
432	}
433
```

13	func sameFilesystem(source, destination string) (bool, error) {
14		sourceAncestor, err := nearestExisting(source)
15		if err != nil {
16			return false, err
17		}
18		destinationAncestor, err := nearestExisting(destination)
19		if err != nil {
20			return false, err
21		}
22		sourceVolume, err := windowsVolumePath(sourceAncestor)
23		if err != nil {
24			return false, fmt.Errorf("identify source volume: %w", err)
25		}
26		destinationVolume, err := windowsVolumePath(destinationAncestor)
27		if err != nil {
28			return false, fmt.Errorf("identify destination volume: %w", err)
29		}
30		return sameWindowsVolumePath(sourceVolume, destinationVolume), nil
31	}
32	
33	func windowsVolumePath(path string) (string, error) {
34		pathPointer, err := windows.UTF16PtrFromString(path)
35		if err != nil {
36			return "", err
37		}
38		buffer := make([]uint16, windows.MAX_PATH+1)
39		if err := windows.GetVolumePathName(pathPointer, &buffer[0], uint32(len(buffer))); err != nil {
40			return "", err
41		}
42		return windows.UTF16ToString(buffer), nil
43	}
44	
45	func sameWindowsVolumePath(left, right string) bool {
46		return strings.EqualFold(filepath.Clean(left), filepath.Clean(right))
47	}

88					Path: probe.live.CurrentPath, Operation: "validate try location", Err: visibilityErr,
89				})
90				continue
91			}
92	
93			matches := matchingEntries(entries, s.host, probe)
94			if len(matches) == 0 && len(catalogProblems) == 0 && probe.originURL != "" {
95				matched, matchErr := s.registry.Match(observationFromProbe(s.host, probe))
96				switch {
97				case matchErr == nil && eligibleTryRecord(matched):
98					matches = []*catalog.Entry{matched}
99				case matchErr == nil:
100					// A graduated experiment at the same identity is history, not an
101					// active Try to revive implicitly.
102				case errors.Is(matchErr, catalog.ErrNotFound), errors.Is(matchErr, catalog.ErrAmbiguous):
103					// A live clone must get its own identity when the remote hint is
104					// absent or ambiguous.
105				default:
106					item := s.transientItem(probe, matchErr)
107					items = append(items, item)
108					diagnostics = append(diagnostics, Diagnostic{
109						Path: probe.live.CurrentPath, Operation: "match catalog try", Err: matchErr,
110					})
111					continue
112				}
113			}
114			switch len(matches) {
115			case 0:
116				if len(catalogProblems) > 0 {
117					// The catalog diagnostic is reported once, while each live item carries
118					// the same typed tracking error for callers that try to mutate it.
119					items = append(items, s.transientItem(probe, incompleteCatalogError(catalogProblems)))
120					continue
121				}
122				entry := s.newEntry(probe)
123				if err := s.catalogCreate(entry); err != nil {
124					item := s.transientItem(probe, err)
125					items = append(items, item)
126					diagnostics = append(diagnostics, Diagnostic{
127						Path: probe.live.CurrentPath, Operation: "catalog try", Err: err,
128					})
129					continue
130				}
131				entries = append(entries, entry)
132				items = append(items, itemFromEntry(entry, probe.live))
133			case 1:
134				entry := matches[0]
135				updated, updateErr := s.refreshEntry(entry, probe)
136				if updateErr != nil {
137					item := itemFromEntry(entry, probe.live)
138					item.CatalogError = updateErr
139					items = append(items, item)
140					diagnostics = append(diagnostics, Diagnostic{
141						Path: probe.live.CurrentPath, Operation: "refresh catalog try", Err: updateErr,
142					})
143					continue
144				}
145				replaceEntry(entries, updated)
146				items = append(items, itemFromEntry(updated, probe.live))
147			default:
148				matchedItems := make([]Item, len(matches))
149				for index, entry := range matches {
150					matchedItems[index] = itemFromEntry(entry, probe.live)
151				}
152				ambiguous := &AmbiguousError{Ref: probe.live.CurrentPath, Candidates: candidatesOf(matchedItems)}
153				item := s.transientItem(probe, ambiguous)
154				items = append(items, item)
155				diagnostics = append(diagnostics, Diagnostic{
156					Path: probe.live.CurrentPath, Operation: "match catalog try", Err: ambiguous,
157				})
158			}
159		}
160	
161		items = deduplicateItems(items)
162		sortItemsByName(items)
163		sortDiagnostics(diagnostics)
164		return items, diagnostics, nil
165	}
166	
167	// List reconciles visible directories, joins requested catalog history, and
168	// enriches Git repositories with bounded status/last-commit probes.
169	func (s *Service) List(ctx context.Context, options ListOptions) ([]Item, []Diagnostic, error) {
170		visible, diagnostics, err := s.Reconcile(ctx)
171		if err != nil {
172			return visible, diagnostics, err
173		}
174	
175		entries, catalogProblems, err := s.store.ListWithDiagnostics()
176		if err != nil {
177			return visible, diagnostics, err
178		}
179		diagnostics = append(diagnostics, catalogDiagnostics(catalogProblems)...)
180	
181		items := make([]Item, 0, len(entries)+len(visible))
182		seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(visible))
183		seenPaths := make(map[string]struct{}, len(visible))
184		for _, item := range visible {
185			if item.ID != "" {
186				seen[item.ID] = struct{}{}
187			}
188			if item.Live.CurrentPath != "" {
189				seenPaths[item.Live.CurrentPath] = struct{}{}
190			}
191			items = append(items, item)
192		}
193	
194		for _, entry := range entries {
195			if _, ok := seen[entry.ID]; ok {
196				continue
197			}
198			if location, ok := entry.LocationFor(s.host); ok {
199				if _, pathSeen := seenPaths[location.CurrentPath]; pathSeen {
200					continue
201				}
202			}
203			graduated := entry.Kind == catalog.KindRepository && entry.Experiment != nil &&
204				entry.Experiment.Phase == catalog.PhaseGraduated
205			if graduated {
206				if !options.IncludeGraduated {
207					continue
208				}
209			} else if entry.Kind != catalog.KindTry || entry.Experiment == nil {
210				continue
211			}
212	
213			location, located := entry.LocationFor(s.host)
214			present := located && location.State == catalog.LocationPresent && !s.hiddenStorage(location.CurrentPath)
215			if present && !graduated && s.validateVisibleTryPath(location.CurrentPath) != nil {
216				present = false
217			}
218			if present {
219				isDirectory, statErr := directoryExists(location.CurrentPath)
220				if statErr != nil {
221					diagnostics = append(diagnostics, Diagnostic{
222						Path: location.CurrentPath, Operation: "stat catalog try", Err: statErr,
223					})
224					present = false
225				} else {
226					present = isDirectory
227				}
228			}
229			if !present && !options.IncludeNonPresent {
230				continue
231			}
232	
233			live := LiveFacts{Present: present}
234			if located {
235				live.CurrentPath = location.CurrentPath
236				live.RealPath = location.RealPath
237			}
238			if present {
239				probe := s.probeDirectory(ctx, location.CurrentPath)
240				if probe.diagnostic != nil {
241					diagnostics = append(diagnostics, *probe.diagnostic)
242				}
243				if probe.valid {
244					live = probe.live
245				}
246			}
247			items = append(items, itemFromEntry(entry, live))
248		}
249	
250		if query := strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(options.Query)); query != "" {
251			filtered := items[:0]
252			for _, item := range items {
253				if strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(item.SearchText()), query) {
254					filtered = append(filtered, item)
255				}
256			}
257			items = filtered
258		}
259		if !options.SkipEnrichment {
260			items = s.enrich(ctx, items)
261		}
262		sortItemsByActivity(items)
263		diagnostics = deduplicateDiagnostics(diagnostics)
264		sortDiagnostics(diagnostics)
265		return items, diagnostics, nil
266	}
267	
268	// Resolve applies stable, deterministic matching: exact ID, exact basename,
269	// exact date-stripped name/slug, then one unique case-insensitive substring.
270	func (s *Service) Resolve(ctx context.Context, ref string) (Item, []Diagnostic, error) {
271		items, diagnostics, err := s.List(ctx, ListOptions{SkipEnrichment: true})
272		if err != nil {
273			return Item{}, diagnostics, err
274		}
275		ref = strings.TrimSpace(ref)
276		if ref == "" {
277			return Item{}, diagnostics, &NotFoundError{Ref: ref, Root: s.triesRoot}
278		}
279	
280		if looksLikePath(ref) {
281			pathRef := config.Expand(ref)
282			if canonical, canonicalErr := pathx.Canonical(pathRef); canonicalErr == nil {
283				var matches []Item
284				for _, item := range items {
285					if samePath(canonical, item.Live.CurrentPath) {
286						matches = append(matches, item)
287					}
288				}
289				if len(matches) > 0 {
290					return s.selectResolved(ctx, ref, matches, diagnostics)
291				}
292			}
293		}
294	
295		for _, match := range []func(Item) bool{
296			func(item Item) bool { return item.ID != "" && item.ID == ref },
297			func(item Item) bool { return item.Basename == ref },
298			func(item Item) bool {
299				stripped, _, _ := splitDatedBasename(item.Basename)
300				return stripped == ref || item.Name == ref || item.Slug == ref
301			},
302		} {
303			var matches []Item
304			for _, item := range items {
305				if match(item) {
306					matches = append(matches, item)
307				}
308			}
309			if len(matches) > 0 {
310				return s.selectResolved(ctx, ref, matches, diagnostics)
311			}
312		}
313	
314		needle := strings.ToLower(ref)
315		var matches []Item
316		for _, item := range items {
317			stripped, _, _ := splitDatedBasename(item.Basename)
318			for _, value := range []string{item.Basename, stripped, item.Name, item.Slug} {
319				if value != "" && strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(value), needle) {
320					matches = append(matches, item)
321					break
322				}
323			}
324		}
325		if len(matches) == 0 {
326			return Item{}, diagnostics, &NotFoundError{Ref: ref, Root: s.triesRoot}
327		}
328		return s.selectResolved(ctx, ref, matches, diagnostics)
329	}
330	
331	func (s *Service) selectResolved(ctx context.Context, ref string, matches []Item, diagnostics []Diagnostic) (Item, []Diagnostic, error) {
332		if len(matches) == 1 {
333			enriched := s.enrich(ctx, matches)
334			return enriched[0], diagnostics, nil
335		}
336		return Item{}, diagnostics, &AmbiguousError{Ref: ref, Candidates: candidatesOf(matches)}
337	}
338	
339	// ResolveOrCreate preserves the low-friction dev try behavior: an existing
340	// non-clone match wins; clone requests always get a collision-safe new path.
341	func (s *Service) ResolveOrCreate(ctx context.Context, request CreateRequest) (CreateResult, error) {
342		if request.Clone == "" {
343			name := config.Slug(strings.ReplaceAll(request.Name, " ", "-"))
344			item, diagnostics, err := s.Resolve(ctx, name)
345			if err == nil {
346				result := CreateResult{
347					Item: item, Path: item.Live.CurrentPath, Existing: true,
348					Tracked: item.ID != "" && item.CatalogError == nil, Diagnostics: diagnostics,
349				}
350				if !result.Tracked {
351					trackingErr := item.CatalogError
352					if trackingErr == nil {
353						trackingErr = errors.New("matching directory has no catalog ID")
354					}
355					return result, fmt.Errorf("existing try at %s is not tracked in the catalog: %w", result.Path, trackingErr)
356				}
357				return result, nil
358			}
359			if !errors.Is(err, ErrNotFound) {
360				return CreateResult{Diagnostics: diagnostics}, err
361			}
362		}
363		return s.Create(ctx, request)
364	}
365	
366	// Create makes a new collision-safe dated directory or clone and catalogs it
367	// only after the filesystem operation succeeds.
368	func (s *Service) Create(ctx context.Context, request CreateRequest) (CreateResult, error) {
369		var result CreateResult
370		if err := s.ensureTriesRoot(); err != nil {
371			return result, err
372		}
373		name := request.Name
374		if request.Clone != "" && strings.TrimSpace(name) == "" {
375			name = cloneDefaultName(request.Clone)
376		}
377		slug := config.Slug(strings.ReplaceAll(name, " ", "-"))
378		if err := pathx.ValidateComponent(slug); err != nil {
379			return result, fmt.Errorf("try name %q: %w", name, err)
380		}
381	
382		path, err := s.availableDatedPath(slug)
383		if err != nil {
384			return result, err
385		}
386		result.Path = path
387		if request.Clone != "" {
388			cloneRef, normalizeErr := s.normalizeCloneRef(request.Clone)
389			if normalizeErr != nil {
390				return result, normalizeErr
391			}
392			if _, err := s.gitRun(ctx, s.triesRoot, "clone", cloneRef, path); err != nil {
393				return result, fmt.Errorf("clone try into %s: %w", path, err)
394			}
395			result.Created = true
396			result.Cloned = true
397		} else {
398			if err := os.Mkdir(path, 0o755); err != nil {
399				return result, fmt.Errorf("create try %s: %w", path, err)
400			}
401			result.Created = true
402			if !request.NoGit {
403				if _, err := s.gitRun(ctx, path, "init", "-b", "main"); err != nil {
404					result.InitWarning = err
405				}
406			}
407		}
408	
409		canonical, canonicalErr := pathx.Canonical(path)
410		if canonicalErr != nil {
411			return result, fmt.Errorf("try exists at %s but its canonical path could not be determined: %w", path, canonicalErr)
412		}
413		result.Path = canonical
414		items, diagnostics, reconcileErr := s.Reconcile(ctx)
415		result.Diagnostics = diagnostics
416		if reconcileErr != nil {
417			return result, fmt.Errorf("try exists at %s but catalog reconciliation failed: %w", canonical, reconcileErr)
418		}
419		for _, item := range items {
420			if samePath(item.Live.CurrentPath, canonical) {
421				result.Item = item
422				result.Tracked = item.ID != "" && item.CatalogError == nil
423				break
424			}
425		}
426		if !result.Tracked {
427			trackingErr := result.Item.CatalogError
428			if trackingErr == nil {
429				trackingErr = errors.New("reconciliation did not produce a catalog record")
430			}
431			return result, fmt.Errorf("try exists at %s but could not be added to the catalog: %w", canonical, trackingErr)
432		}
433		enriched := s.enrich(ctx, []Item{result.Item})
434		if len(enriched) == 1 {
435			result.Item = enriched[0]
436		}
437		return result, nil
438	}
439	
440	// RefreshOrigin re-probes origin after an explicit external remote-creation
441	// step and persists its raw URL and normalized identity on the same catalog ID.
442	func (s *Service) RefreshOrigin(ctx context.Context, id string) (Item, error) {
443		entry, err := s.registry.Get(id)
444		if err != nil {
445			return Item{}, fmt.Errorf("load experiment %s for origin refresh: %w", id, err)
446		}
447		if entry.Experiment == nil ||
448			(entry.Kind != catalog.KindTry && !(entry.Kind == catalog.KindRepository && entry.Experiment.Phase == catalog.PhaseGraduated)) {
449			return Item{}, &NotFoundError{Ref: id, Root: s.triesRoot}
450		}
451		location, ok := entry.LocationFor(s.host)
452		if !ok || location.State != catalog.LocationPresent || location.CurrentPath == "" {
453			return Item{}, &NotFoundError{Ref: id, Root: s.triesRoot}
454		}
455		probe := s.probeDirectory(ctx, location.CurrentPath)
456		if !probe.valid || probe.live.Repo == nil || probe.live.DiscoverError != nil {
457			if probe.diagnostic != nil {
458				return Item{}, fmt.Errorf("refresh experiment origin: %w", probe.diagnostic.Err)
459			}
460			return Item{}, errors.New("refresh experiment origin: path is not a discoverable Git repository")
461		}
462		if probe.originURL == "" {
463			return Item{}, errors.New("refresh experiment origin: Git origin is not configured")
464		}
465		updated, err := s.catalogUpdate(id, func(current *catalog.Entry) error {
466			currentLocation, found := current.LocationFor(s.host)
467			if !found || currentLocation.State != catalog.LocationPresent ||
468				!samePath(currentLocation.CurrentPath, probe.live.CurrentPath) {
469				return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s moved or was reassigned before origin refresh", id)
470			}
471			if current.Experiment == nil {
472				return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s no longer has experiment provenance", id)
473			}
474			current.Experiment.OriginURL = probe.originURL
475			current.RemoteIdentity = remoteIdentityFromOrigin(probe.originURL)
476			return current.SetLocation(s.host, locationFromProbe(probe, currentLocation))
477		})
478		if err != nil {
479			return Item{}, fmt.Errorf("refresh experiment origin: %w", err)
480		}
481		item := itemFromEntry(updated, probe.live)
482		enriched := s.enrich(ctx, []Item{item})
483		if len(enriched) == 1 {
484			item = enriched[0]
485		}
486		return item, nil
487	}
488	
489	// Touch updates LastOpened only after a caller has successfully handed off the
490	// selected OpenTarget.
491	func (s *Service) Touch(_ context.Context, id string) (TouchResult, error) {
492		if id == "" {
493			return TouchResult{}, &NotFoundError{Ref: id, Root: s.triesRoot}
494		}
495		now := s.now()
496		updated, err := s.catalogUpdate(id, func(entry *catalog.Entry) error {
497			if entry.Experiment == nil ||
498				(entry.Kind != catalog.KindTry && !(entry.Kind == catalog.KindRepository && entry.Experiment.Phase == catalog.PhaseGraduated)) {
499				return &NotFoundError{Ref: id, Root: s.triesRoot}
500			}
501			location, ok := entry.LocationFor(s.host)
502			if !ok || location.State != catalog.LocationPresent {
503				return &NotFoundError{Ref: id, Root: s.triesRoot}
504			}
505			entry.LastOpened = now
506			return nil
507		})
508		if err != nil {
509			if errors.Is(err, catalog.ErrNotFound) {
510				return TouchResult{}, &NotFoundError{Ref: id, Root: s.triesRoot}
511			}
512			return TouchResult{}, fmt.Errorf("touch try %s: %w", id, err)
513		}
514		location, _ := updated.LocationFor(s.host)
515		item := itemFromEntry(updated, LiveFacts{
516			Present:     location.State == catalog.LocationPresent,
517			CurrentPath: location.CurrentPath, RealPath: location.RealPath,
518		})
519		return TouchResult{Item: item, TouchedAt: now}, nil
520	}
521	
522	func (s *Service) probeDirectory(ctx context.Context, path string) directoryProbe {
523		probe := directoryProbe{}
524		if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
525			probe.diagnostic = &Diagnostic{Path: path, Operation: "inspect try", Err: err}
526			return probe
527		}
528		info, err := os.Stat(path)
529		if err != nil {
530			probe.diagnostic = &Diagnostic{Path: path, Operation: "stat try", Err: err}
531			return probe
532		}
533		if !info.IsDir() {
534			return probe
535		}
536		canonical, err := pathx.Canonical(path)
537		if err != nil {
538			probe.diagnostic = &Diagnostic{Path: path, Operation: "canonicalize try", Err: err}
539			return probe
540		}
541		probe.valid = true
542		probe.live = LiveFacts{Present: true, CurrentPath: canonical, RealPath: canonical}
543		_, markerErr := os.Lstat(filepath.Join(canonical, ".git"))
544		probe.gitMarker = markerErr == nil || !errors.Is(markerErr, fs.ErrNotExist)
545	
546		repository, discoverErr := s.gitDiscover(ctx, canonical)
547		if discoverErr != nil {
548			if probe.gitMarker {
549				probe.live.DiscoverError = discoverErr
550				probe.diagnostic = &Diagnostic{Path: canonical, Operation: "discover Git try", Err: discoverErr}
551			}
552			return probe
553		}
554		repositoryRoot := repository.Root
555		if repository.Bare {
556			repositoryRoot = repository.MainRoot
557		}
558		canonicalRoot, rootErr := pathx.Canonical(repositoryRoot)
559		if rootErr != nil || !samePath(canonicalRoot, canonical) {
560			// A TriesRoot may itself be inside a repository. Its child directories are
561			// not independent Git Tries merely because rev-parse walks to that parent.
562			return probe
563		}
564		repository.Root = canonicalRoot
565		if repository.MainRoot != "" {
566			if canonicalMain, mainErr := pathx.Canonical(repository.MainRoot); mainErr == nil {
567				repository.MainRoot = canonicalMain
568			}
569		}
570		if repository.GitCommonDir != "" {
571			commonDir, commonErr := pathx.Canonical(repository.GitCommonDir)
572			if commonErr != nil {
573				probe.live.DiscoverError = commonErr
574				probe.diagnostic = &Diagnostic{Path: canonical, Operation: "canonicalize Git common directory", Err: commonErr}
575				repository.GitCommonDir = ""
576			} else {
577				repository.GitCommonDir = commonDir
578			}
579		}
580		probe.live.Repo = &repository
581		probe.originURL = gitx.RemoteFromConfig(repository.GitCommonDir, "origin")
582		return probe
583	}
584	
585	func (s *Service) enrich(ctx context.Context, items []Item) []Item {
586		return boundedMap(ctx, s.workers, items, func(ctx context.Context, item Item) Item {
587			if item.Live.Repo == nil || item.Live.CurrentPath == "" {
588				return item
589			}
590			status, statusErr := s.gitStatus(ctx, item.Live.CurrentPath)
591			if statusErr != nil {
592				item.Live.StatusError = statusErr
593			} else {
594				item.Live.Status = &status
595			}
596			unix, subject, commitErr := s.gitLastCommit(ctx, item.Live.CurrentPath)
597			if commitErr != nil {
598				item.Live.LastCommitError = commitErr
599			} else if unix > 0 {
600				item.Live.LastCommit = time.Unix(unix, 0).UTC()
601				item.Live.LastCommitSubject = subject
602			}
603			return item
604		})
605	}
606	
607	func (s *Service) experimentFromProbe(probe directoryProbe) *catalog.Experiment {
608		name, started, dated := splitDatedBasename(filepath.Base(probe.live.CurrentPath))
609		if strings.TrimSpace(name) == "" {
610			name = "unnamed"
611		} else {
612			name = strings.TrimSpace(name)
613		}
614		if !dated {
615			started = s.now()
616		}
617		return &catalog.Experiment{
618			Phase: catalog.PhaseActive, Slug: config.Slug(name),
619			OriginURL: probe.originURL, Started: started,
620			OriginalPath: probe.live.CurrentPath,
621		}
622	}
623	
624	func (s *Service) newEntry(probe directoryProbe) *catalog.Entry {
625		name, started, dated := splitDatedBasename(filepath.Base(probe.live.CurrentPath))
626		if strings.TrimSpace(name) == "" {
627			name = "unnamed"
628		} else {
629			name = strings.TrimSpace(name)
630		}
631		if !dated {
632			started = s.now()
633		}
634		entry := &catalog.Entry{
635			Kind:           catalog.KindTry,
636			Name:           name,
637			RemoteIdentity: remoteIdentityFromOrigin(probe.originURL),
638			Experiment: &catalog.Experiment{
639				Phase: catalog.PhaseActive, Slug: config.Slug(name),
640				OriginURL: probe.originURL, Started: started,
641				OriginalPath: probe.live.CurrentPath,
642			},
643			Locations: map[string]catalog.Location{
644				s.host: locationFromProbe(probe, catalog.Location{}),
645			},
646		}
647		entry.Created = started
648		return entry
649	}
650	
651	func (s *Service) transientItem(probe directoryProbe, catalogErr error) Item {
652		name, started, dated := splitDatedBasename(filepath.Base(probe.live.CurrentPath))
653		if strings.TrimSpace(name) == "" {
654			name = "unnamed"
655		} else {
656			name = strings.TrimSpace(name)
657		}
658		if !dated {
659			started = s.now()
660		}
661		return Item{
662			Kind: catalog.KindTry, Name: name,
663			Basename: filepath.Base(probe.live.CurrentPath), Slug: config.Slug(name),
664			Phase: catalog.PhaseActive, Created: started, Started: started,
665			OriginURL: probe.originURL, RemoteIdentity: remoteIdentityFromOrigin(probe.originURL),
666			Live: probe.live, CatalogError: catalogErr,
667		}
668	}
669	
670	func (s *Service) refreshEntry(entry *catalog.Entry, probe directoryProbe) (*catalog.Entry, error) {
671		location, _ := entry.LocationFor(s.host)
672		wantedLocation := locationFromProbe(probe, location)
673		if entry.Kind == catalog.KindRepository && entry.Experiment == nil {
674			metadata := s.experimentFromProbe(probe)
675			return s.catalogUpdate(entry.ID, func(updated *catalog.Entry) error {
676				if updated.Kind != catalog.KindRepository || updated.Experiment != nil {
677					return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s changed before it could become a Try", updated.ID)
678				}
679				updated.Kind = catalog.KindTry
680				updated.Experiment = metadata
681				if probe.originURL != "" {
682					updated.RemoteIdentity = remoteIdentityFromOrigin(probe.originURL)
683				}
684				return updated.SetLocation(s.host, wantedLocation)

811	func splitDatedBasename(basename string) (string, time.Time, bool) {
812		if len(basename) <= len("2006-01-02-") || basename[10] != '-' {
813			return basename, time.Time{}, false
814		}
815		parsed, err := time.Parse("2006-01-02", basename[:10])
816		if err != nil || parsed.Format("2006-01-02") != basename[:10] {
817			return basename, time.Time{}, false
818		}
819		name := basename[11:]
820		if name == "" {
821			return basename, time.Time{}, false
822		}
823		return name, parsed, true
824	}

826	func (s *Service) availableDatedPath(slug string) (string, error) {
827		prefix := s.clock().Format("2006-01-02") + "-" + slug
828		for version := 1; version < 10_000; version++ {
829			basename := prefix
830			if version > 1 {
831				basename = fmt.Sprintf("%s-%d", prefix, version)

833			intended := filepath.Join(s.triesRoot, basename)

835				continue
836			} else if !errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
837				return "", fmt.Errorf("inspect try destination %s: %w", intended, err)
838			}
839			candidate, err := pathx.JoinChild(s.triesRoot, basename)
840			if err != nil {
