```text
842			}
843			if _, err := os.Lstat(candidate); errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
844				return candidate, nil
845			} else if err != nil {
846				return "", fmt.Errorf("inspect try destination %s: %w", candidate, err)
847			}
848		}

871	func (s *Service) normalizeCloneRef(ref string) (string, error) {
872		ref = strings.TrimSpace(ref)
873		if ref == "" {
874			return "", errors.New("clone reference is required")
875		}
876		if local, ok, err := s.resolveLocalCloneRef(ref); ok || err != nil {
877			return local, err
878		}
879		// SCP-style remotes are already complete clone references. In particular,
880		// nonstandard SSH usernames must not be rewritten as preferred-forge shorthand.
881		if !strings.Contains(ref, "://") && strings.ContainsAny(ref, "@:") {
882			return ref, nil
883		}
884		kind := forge.FromURL(ref)
885		if kind != forge.Unknown {
886			adapter, err := forge.For(kind)
887			if err == nil {
888				return adapter.CloneURL(ref), nil
889			}
890			return ref, nil
891		}
892		if !strings.Contains(ref, "://") && strings.Contains(ref, "/") {
893			if adapter, err := forge.Preferred(); err == nil {
894				return adapter.CloneURL(ref), nil
895			}
896		}
897		return ref, nil
898	}

900	func (s *Service) resolveLocalCloneRef(ref string) (string, bool, error) {
901		if strings.HasPrefix(ref, "file://") {
902			return ref, true, nil
903		}
904		if filepath.IsAbs(ref) {
905			return filepath.Clean(ref), true, nil
906		}
907		if ref == "~" || strings.HasPrefix(ref, "~/") {
908			return config.Expand(ref), true, nil
909		}
910	
911		explicit := strings.HasPrefix(ref, "./") || strings.HasPrefix(ref, "../")
912		cwd, err := s.getwd()
913		if err != nil {
914			if explicit {
915				return "", true, fmt.Errorf("resolve local clone reference %q: %w", ref, err)
916			}
917			return "", false, nil
918		}
919		candidate := filepath.Clean(filepath.Join(cwd, ref))
920		if explicit {
921			return candidate, true, nil
922		}
923		if strings.ContainsAny(ref, "@:") {
924			return "", false, nil
925		}
926		if _, err := os.Stat(candidate); err == nil {
927			return candidate, true, nil
928		}
929		return "", false, nil
930	}

932	func localClonePath(ref string) bool {
933		if filepath.IsAbs(ref) || strings.HasPrefix(ref, "file://") || strings.HasPrefix(ref, "./") ||
934			strings.HasPrefix(ref, "../") || strings.HasPrefix(ref, "~/") {
935			return true
936		}
937		_, err := os.Stat(ref)
938		return err == nil
939	}

941	func clonePathIdentity(ref string) string {
942		if parsed, err := url.Parse(ref); err == nil && parsed.Host != "" {
943			return strings.Trim(strings.TrimSuffix(parsed.Path, ".git"), "/")
944		}
945		if at := strings.LastIndexByte(ref, '@'); at >= 0 {
946			ref = ref[at+1:]
947		}
948		if colon := strings.IndexByte(ref, ':'); colon >= 0 {
949			ref = ref[colon+1:]
950		}
951		ref = strings.Trim(strings.TrimSuffix(ref, ".git"), "/")
952		if strings.Contains(ref, "/") {
953			return ref
954		}
955		return ""
956	}

958	func (s *Service) validateVisibleTryPath(path string) error {
959		canonicalRoot, err := pathx.Canonical(s.triesRoot)
960		if err != nil {
961			return fmt.Errorf("canonicalize tries root: %w", err)
962		}
963		canonicalPath, err := pathx.CanonicalChild(canonicalRoot, path)
964		if err != nil {
965			return err
966		}
967		relative, err := filepath.Rel(canonicalRoot, canonicalPath)
968		if err != nil {
969			return fmt.Errorf("locate try under root: %w", err)
970		}
971		if strings.Contains(relative, string(filepath.Separator)) || strings.HasPrefix(relative, ".") {
972			return fmt.Errorf("%s is not an immediate visible child of %s", canonicalPath, canonicalRoot)
973		}
974		return nil
975	}

977	func (s *Service) hiddenStorage(path string) bool {
978		if path == "" {
979			return false
980		}
981		if hiddenImmediateChild(s.triesRoot, path) {
982			return true
983		}
984		canonicalRoot, rootErr := pathx.Canonical(s.triesRoot)
985		canonicalPath, pathErr := pathx.Canonical(path)
986		if rootErr != nil || pathErr != nil {

992	func hiddenImmediateChild(root, path string) bool {
993		absoluteRoot, rootErr := filepath.Abs(root)
994		absolutePath, pathErr := filepath.Abs(path)
995		if rootErr != nil || pathErr != nil {
996			return false
997		}
998		relative, err := filepath.Rel(filepath.Clean(absoluteRoot), filepath.Clean(absolutePath))
999		if err != nil || relative == "." || relative == ".." ||
1000			strings.HasPrefix(relative, ".."+string(filepath.Separator)) {
1001			return false
1002		}
1003		first, _, _ := strings.Cut(relative, string(filepath.Separator))
1004		return strings.HasPrefix(first, ".")
1005	}

1012	func samePath(left, right string) bool {
1013		if left == "" || right == "" {
1014			return false
1015		}
1016		leftCanonical, leftErr := pathx.Canonical(left)
1017		rightCanonical, rightErr := pathx.Canonical(right)
1018		if leftErr == nil && rightErr == nil {
1019			return leftCanonical == rightCanonical
1020		}
1021		leftAbsolute, leftAbsErr := filepath.Abs(left)
1022		rightAbsolute, rightAbsErr := filepath.Abs(right)
1023		return leftAbsErr == nil && rightAbsErr == nil && filepath.Clean(leftAbsolute) == filepath.Clean(rightAbsolute)
1024	}

1026	func sortItemsByName(items []Item) {
1027		sort.SliceStable(items, func(i, j int) bool {
1028			left, right := strings.ToLower(items[i].DisplayName()), strings.ToLower(items[j].DisplayName())
1029			if left != right {
1030				return left < right
1031			}
1032			if items[i].DisplayName() != items[j].DisplayName() {
1033				return items[i].DisplayName() < items[j].DisplayName()
1034			}
1035			return items[i].ID < items[j].ID
1036		})
1037	}
1038	
1039	func sortItemsByActivity(items []Item) {
1040		sort.SliceStable(items, func(i, j int) bool {
1041			left, right := items[i].Activity(), items[j].Activity()
1042			if !left.Equal(right) {
1043				if left.IsZero() {
1044					return false
1045				}
1046				if right.IsZero() {
1047					return true
1048				}
1049				return left.After(right)
1050			}
1051			leftName, rightName := strings.ToLower(items[i].DisplayName()), strings.ToLower(items[j].DisplayName())
1052			if leftName != rightName {
1053				return leftName < rightName
1054			}
1055			return items[i].ID < items[j].ID
1056		})
1057	}

1059	func sortDiagnostics(diagnostics []Diagnostic) {

1062				return diagnostics[i].Path < diagnostics[j].Path
1063			}
1064			return diagnostics[i].Operation < diagnostics[j].Operation
1065		})
1066	}

1068	func deduplicateItems(items []Item) []Item {
1069		seenIDs := make(map[string]struct{}, len(items))
1070		seenPaths := make(map[string]struct{}, len(items))
1071		out := items[:0]
1072		for _, item := range items {
1073			if item.ID != "" {
1074				if _, ok := seenIDs[item.ID]; ok {
1075					continue
1076				}
1077				seenIDs[item.ID] = struct{}{}
1078			} else if item.Live.CurrentPath != "" {
1079				if _, ok := seenPaths[item.Live.CurrentPath]; ok {
1080					continue
1081				}
1082				seenPaths[item.Live.CurrentPath] = struct{}{}
1083			}
1084			out = append(out, item)
1085		}
1086		return out
1087	}
1088	
1089	func deduplicateDiagnostics(diagnostics []Diagnostic) []Diagnostic {
1090		seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(diagnostics))
1091		out := diagnostics[:0]
1092		for _, diagnostic := range diagnostics {
1093			key := diagnostic.Path + "\x00" + diagnostic.Operation + "\x00" + fmt.Sprint(diagnostic.Err)
1094			if _, ok := seen[key]; ok {
1095				continue
1096			}
1097			seen[key] = struct{}{}
1098			out = append(out, diagnostic)
1099		}
1100		return out
1101	}

1103	func boundedMap[Input, Output any](ctx context.Context, limit int, input []Input, work func(context.Context, Input) Output) []Output {
1104		if len(input) == 0 {
1105			return nil
1106		}
1107		if limit <= 0 || limit > len(input) {
1108			limit = len(input)
1109		}
1110		type job struct {
1111			index int
1112			value Input
1113		}
1114		type result struct {
1115			index int
1116			value Output
1117		}
1118		jobs := make(chan job, len(input))
1119		results := make(chan result, len(input))
1120		for index, value := range input {
1121			jobs <- job{index: index, value: value}
1122		}
1123		close(jobs)
1124	
1125		var workers sync.WaitGroup
1126		workers.Add(limit)
1127		for range limit {
1128			go func() {
1129				defer workers.Done()
1130				for next := range jobs {
1131					results <- result{index: next.index, value: work(ctx, next.value)}
1132				}
1133			}()
1134		}
1135		workers.Wait()
1136		close(results)
1137	
1138		out := make([]Output, len(input))
1139		for result := range results {
1140			out[result.index] = result.value
1141		}
1142		return out
1143	}
```

```text
131		plan.Category = request.Category
132		plan.Name = name
133		plan.NeedsGitInit = item.Live.Repo == nil
134		plan.NeedsInitialCommit = plan.NeedsGitInit || !s.hasCommit(ctx, source)
135		return plan, nil
136	}
137	
138	// Graduate prepares Git while the Try is still at its source, performs one
139	// same-filesystem rename, and atomically transitions the same catalog ID.
140	func (s *Service) Graduate(ctx context.Context, request GraduateRequest) (GraduateResult, error) {
141		plan, err := s.PlanGraduate(ctx, request)
142		result := GraduateResult{Plan: plan, Item: plan.Item, Diagnostics: plan.Diagnostics}
143		if err != nil {
144			return result, err
145		}
146		if request.DryRun {
147			return result, nil
148		}
149		if err := s.validateCatalogSource(plan.Item.ID, plan.Source); err != nil {
150			return result, err
151		}
152		if err := s.validateGraduatePaths(plan); err != nil {
153			return result, err
154		}
155	
156		if plan.NeedsGitInit {
157			if _, err := s.gitRun(ctx, plan.Source, "init", "-b", "main"); err != nil {
158				return result, fmt.Errorf("initialize Git before graduating %s: %w", plan.Source, err)
159			}
160			result.GitInitialized = true
161		}
162		made, err := s.ensureInitialCommit(ctx, plan.Source, plan.Name)
163		if err != nil {
164			return result, fmt.Errorf("ensure initial commit before graduating %s: %w", plan.Source, err)
165		}
166		result.InitialCommitMade = made
167	
168		// Revalidate containment, catalog ownership, collision, and device after Git
169		// preparation. Each check precedes the only move, so a stale plan fails with
170		// the source still in place.
171		if err := s.validateCatalogSource(plan.Item.ID, plan.Source); err != nil {
172			return result, err
173		}
174		if err := s.validateGraduatePaths(plan); err != nil {
175			return result, err
176		}
177		if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(plan.Destination), 0o755); err != nil {
178			return result, fmt.Errorf("create graduation category: %w", err)
179		}
180		if err := s.validateGraduatePaths(plan); err != nil {
181			return result, err
182		}
183		sameDevice, err := s.sameFilesystem(plan.Source, plan.Destination)
184		if err != nil {
185			return result, fmt.Errorf("compare graduation filesystems: %w", err)
186		}
187		if !sameDevice {
188			return result, fmt.Errorf("move %s to %s: %w", plan.Source, plan.Destination, ErrCrossFilesystem)
189		}
190		if err := s.validateGraduatePaths(plan); err != nil {
191			return result, err
192		}
193		if err := s.validateCatalogSource(plan.Item.ID, plan.Source); err != nil {
194			return result, err
195		}
196		if err := s.rename(plan.Source, plan.Destination); err != nil {
197			if errors.Is(err, syscall.EXDEV) {
198				return result, fmt.Errorf("move %s to %s: %w", plan.Source, plan.Destination, ErrCrossFilesystem)
199			}
200			return result, fmt.Errorf("move %s to %s: %w", plan.Source, plan.Destination, err)
201		}
202		result.Moved = true
203	
204		probe := s.probeDirectory(ctx, plan.Destination)
205		if !probe.valid || probe.live.Repo == nil || probe.live.DiscoverError != nil {
206			cause := probe.live.DiscoverError
207			if cause == nil && probe.diagnostic != nil {
208				cause = probe.diagnostic.Err
209			}
210			if cause == nil {
211				cause = errors.New("moved project is not a discoverable Git repository")
212			}
213			return s.rollbackGraduation(result, cause)
214		}
215	
216		now := s.now()
217		updated, updateErr := s.catalogUpdate(plan.Item.ID, func(entry *catalog.Entry) error {
218			if entry.Kind != catalog.KindTry || entry.Experiment == nil || entry.Experiment.Phase == catalog.PhaseGraduated {
219				return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s is no longer an active Try", entry.ID)
220			}
221			location, ok := entry.LocationFor(s.host)
222			if !ok || location.State != catalog.LocationPresent || !storedLocationMatches(location, plan.Source) {
223				return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s moved or was reassigned after graduation planning", entry.ID)
224			}
225			entry.Kind = catalog.KindRepository
226			entry.Name = plan.Name
227			entry.Experiment.Phase = catalog.PhaseGraduated
228			entry.Experiment.GraduatedAt = now
229			entry.Experiment.GraduatedPath = probe.live.CurrentPath
230			if probe.originURL != "" {
231				entry.Experiment.OriginURL = probe.originURL
232				entry.RemoteIdentity = remoteIdentityFromOrigin(probe.originURL)
233			}
234			previous, _ := entry.LocationFor(s.host)
235			return entry.SetLocation(s.host, locationFromProbe(probe, previous))
236		})
237		if updateErr != nil {
238			return s.rollbackGraduation(result, updateErr)
239		}
240		if updated == nil {
241			return s.rollbackGraduation(result, errors.New("catalog update returned no graduated entry"))
242		}
243	
244		item := itemFromEntry(updated, probe.live)
245		enriched := s.enrich(ctx, []Item{item})
246		if len(enriched) == 1 {
247			item = enriched[0]
248		}
249		result.Item = item
250		return result, nil
251	}
252	
253	func (s *Service) validateCatalogSource(id, source string) error {
254		entry, err := s.registry.Get(id)
255		if err != nil {
256			return fmt.Errorf("reload catalog source %s: %w", id, err)
257		}
258		if entry.Kind != catalog.KindTry || entry.Experiment == nil || entry.Experiment.Phase == catalog.PhaseGraduated {
259			return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s is no longer an active Try", id)
260		}
261		location, ok := entry.LocationFor(s.host)
262		if !ok || location.State != catalog.LocationPresent || !storedLocationMatches(location, source) {
263			return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s moved or was reassigned after graduation planning", id)
264		}
265		return nil
266	}
267	
268	func (s *Service) validateGraduatePaths(plan GraduatePlan) error {
269		source, err := pathx.CanonicalChild(s.triesRoot, plan.Source)
270		if err != nil {
271			return fmt.Errorf("revalidate graduation source: %w", err)
272		}
273		if source != plan.Source {
274			return fmt.Errorf("graduation source changed after planning: %s became %s", plan.Source, source)
275		}
276		components := []string{plan.Name}
277		if plan.Category != "" {
278			components = []string{plan.Category, plan.Name}
279		}
280		destination, err := s.availableGraduationDestination(components)
281		if err != nil {
282			return fmt.Errorf("revalidate graduation destination: %w", err)
283		}
284		if destination != plan.Destination {
285			return fmt.Errorf("graduation destination changed after planning: %s became %s", plan.Destination, destination)
286		}
287		if nested, nestedErr := pathx.IsChild(source, destination); nestedErr != nil {
288			return fmt.Errorf("revalidate graduation destination: %w", nestedErr)
289		} else if nested {
290			return fmt.Errorf("graduation destination %s is inside its source %s", destination, source)
291		}
292		return nil
293	}
294	
295	func (s *Service) availableGraduationDestination(components []string) (string, error) {
296		intended := filepath.Join(append([]string{s.projectRoot}, components...)...)
297		if err := rejectExisting(intended); err != nil {
298			return "", err
299		}
300		destination, err := pathx.JoinChild(s.projectRoot, components...)
301		if err != nil {
302			return "", err
303		}
304		if err := rejectExisting(destination); err != nil {
305			return "", err
306		}
307		return destination, nil
308	}
309	
310	func storedLocationMatches(location catalog.Location, source string) bool {
311		return filepath.Clean(location.CurrentPath) == source || filepath.Clean(location.RealPath) == source
312	}
313	
314	func (s *Service) resolveGraduateItem(ctx context.Context, request GraduateRequest) (Item, []Diagnostic, error) {
315		if strings.TrimSpace(request.Ref) != "" {
316			return s.Resolve(ctx, request.Ref)
317		}
318		current := request.CurrentDir
319		if current == "" {
320			var err error
321			current, err = s.getwd()
322			if err != nil {
323				return Item{}, nil, fmt.Errorf("get current directory: %w", err)
324			}
325		}
326		canonicalCurrent, err := pathx.CanonicalChild(s.triesRoot, current)
327		if err != nil {
328			return Item{}, nil, fmt.Errorf("%s is not inside %s — name the try to graduate", current, s.triesRoot)
329		}
330		canonicalRoot, err := pathx.Canonical(s.triesRoot)
331		if err != nil {
332			return Item{}, nil, err
333		}
334		relative, err := filepath.Rel(canonicalRoot, canonicalCurrent)
335		if err != nil {
336			return Item{}, nil, err
337		}
338		first, _, _ := strings.Cut(relative, string(filepath.Separator))
339		if first == "" || first == "." || strings.HasPrefix(first, ".") {
340			return Item{}, nil, fmt.Errorf("%s is not inside a visible try under %s", current, s.triesRoot)
341		}
342		return s.Resolve(ctx, filepath.Join(s.triesRoot, first))
343	}
344	
345	func (s *Service) hasCommit(ctx context.Context, directory string) bool {
346		if unix, _, err := s.gitLastCommit(ctx, directory); err == nil && unix > 0 {
347			return true
348		}
349		_, err := s.gitRun(ctx, directory, "rev-parse", "--verify", "HEAD")
350		return err == nil
351	}
352	
353	func (s *Service) ensureInitialCommit(ctx context.Context, directory, name string) (bool, error) {
354		if s.hasCommit(ctx, directory) {
355			return false, nil
356		}
357		empty, err := isEmptyWorkTree(directory)
358		if err != nil {
359			return false, err
360		}
361		if empty {
362			readme := filepath.Join(directory, "README.md")
363			file, err := os.OpenFile(readme, os.O_WRONLY|os.O_CREATE|os.O_EXCL, 0o644)
364			if err != nil {
365				return false, err
366			}
367			if _, err := fmt.Fprintf(file, "# %s\n", name); err != nil {
368				_ = file.Close()
369				return false, err
370			}
371			if err := file.Close(); err != nil {
372				return false, err
373			}
374		}
375		if _, err := s.gitRun(ctx, directory, "add", "--all"); err != nil {
376			return false, err
377		}
378		tracked, err := s.gitRun(ctx, directory, "ls-files", "--cached")
379		if err != nil {
380			return false, err
381		}
382		commitArgs := []string{"commit"}
383		if tracked == "" {
384			// A Try containing only globally ignored files still needs a HEAD, but dev
385			// must not force-add or overwrite those user files merely to manufacture it.
386			commitArgs = append(commitArgs, "--allow-empty")
387		}
388		commitArgs = append(commitArgs, "-m", "chore: graduate experiment into a project")
389		if _, err := s.gitRun(ctx, directory, commitArgs...); err != nil {
390			return false, err
391		}
392		return true, nil
393	}
394	
395	func (s *Service) rollbackGraduation(result GraduateResult, cause error) (GraduateResult, error) {
396		rollbackErr := rejectExisting(result.Plan.Source)
397		if rollbackErr == nil {
398			rollbackErr = s.rename(result.Plan.Destination, result.Plan.Source)
399		}
400		result.RollbackError = rollbackErr
401		result.RolledBack = rollbackErr == nil
402		if rollbackErr == nil {
403			result.Moved = false
404		}
405		return result, &FinalizeError{
406			Source: result.Plan.Source, Destination: result.Plan.Destination,
407			Cause: cause, RollbackErr: rollbackErr,
408		}
409	}
410	
411	func rejectExisting(path string) error {
412		if _, err := os.Lstat(path); err == nil {
413			return fmt.Errorf("%s already exists", path)
414		} else if !errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
415			return fmt.Errorf("inspect graduation destination %s: %w", path, err)
416		}
417		return nil
418	}
419	
420	func isEmptyWorkTree(directory string) (bool, error) {
421		entries, err := os.ReadDir(directory)
422		if err != nil {
423			return false, err
424		}
425		for _, entry := range entries {
426			if entry.Name() != ".git" {
427				return false, nil
428			}
429		}
430		return true, nil
431	}
432	
433	func nearestExisting(path string) (string, error) {
434		path = filepath.Clean(path)
435		for {
436			if _, err := os.Stat(path); err == nil {
437				return path, nil
438			} else if !errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
439				return "", err
440			}
441			parent := filepath.Dir(path)
442			if parent == path {
443				return "", fmt.Errorf("no existing ancestor for %s", path)
444			}
445			path = parent
446		}
447	}
```

```text
10	func lockCatalogFile(path string) (func(), error) {
11		file, err := os.OpenFile(path, os.O_CREATE|os.O_RDWR, 0o600)
12		if err != nil {
13			return nil, err
14		}
15		if err := syscall.Flock(int(file.Fd()), syscall.LOCK_EX); err != nil {
16			_ = file.Close()
17			return nil, err
18		}
19		return func() {
20			_ = syscall.Flock(int(file.Fd()), syscall.LOCK_UN)
21			_ = file.Close()
22		}, nil
23	}
24	
25	func sameFilesystem(source, destination string) (bool, error) {
26		sourceAncestor, err := nearestExisting(source)
27		if err != nil {
28			return false, err
29		}
30		destinationAncestor, err := nearestExisting(destination)
31		if err != nil {
32			return false, err
33		}
34		sourceInfo, err := os.Stat(sourceAncestor)
35		if err != nil {
36			return false, err
37		}
38		destinationInfo, err := os.Stat(destinationAncestor)
39		if err != nil {
40			return false, err
41		}
42		sourceStat, sourceOK := sourceInfo.Sys().(*syscall.Stat_t)
43		destinationStat, destinationOK := destinationInfo.Sys().(*syscall.Stat_t)
44		if !sourceOK || !destinationOK {
45			// os.Rename remains the final authority on platforms whose FileInfo does
46			// not expose a Unix-style device number.
47			return true, nil
48		}
49		return sourceStat.Dev == destinationStat.Dev, nil
50	}
```

```text
14	func lockCatalogFile(path string) (func(), error) {
15		file, err := os.OpenFile(path, os.O_CREATE|os.O_RDWR, 0o600)
16		if err != nil {
17			return nil, err
18		}
19		overlapped := &windows.Overlapped{}
20		if err := windows.LockFileEx(windows.Handle(file.Fd()), windows.LOCKFILE_EXCLUSIVE_LOCK, 0, 1, 0, overlapped); err != nil {
21			_ = file.Close()
22			return nil, err
23		}
24		return func() {
25			_ = windows.UnlockFileEx(windows.Handle(file.Fd()), 0, 1, 0, overlapped)
26			_ = file.Close()
27		}, nil
28	}
29	
30	func sameFilesystem(source, destination string) (bool, error) {
31		sourceAncestor, err := nearestExisting(source)
32		if err != nil {
33			return false, err
34		}
35		destinationAncestor, err := nearestExisting(destination)
36		if err != nil {
37			return false, err
38		}
39		sourceVolume, err := windowsVolumePath(sourceAncestor)
40		if err != nil {
41			return false, fmt.Errorf("identify source volume: %w", err)
42		}
43		destinationVolume, err := windowsVolumePath(destinationAncestor)
44		if err != nil {
45			return false, fmt.Errorf("identify destination volume: %w", err)
46		}
47		return sameWindowsVolumePath(sourceVolume, destinationVolume), nil
48	}
49	
50	func windowsVolumePath(path string) (string, error) {
51		pathPointer, err := windows.UTF16PtrFromString(path)
52		if err != nil {
53			return "", err
54		}
55		buffer := make([]uint16, windows.MAX_PATH+1)
56		if err := windows.GetVolumePathName(pathPointer, &buffer[0], uint32(len(buffer))); err != nil {
57			return "", err
58		}
59		return windows.UTF16ToString(buffer), nil
60	}
61	
62	func sameWindowsVolumePath(left, right string) bool {
63		return strings.EqualFold(filepath.Clean(left), filepath.Clean(right))
64	}
```

```go
//go:build unix

package catalog

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"os"
	"time"

	"golang.org/x/sys/unix"
)

type catalogFileLock struct {
	file *os.File
}

func acquireCatalogFileLock(ctx context.Context, path string) (*catalogFileLock, error) {
	if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	file, err := os.OpenFile(path, os.O_CREATE|os.O_RDWR, 0o600)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	lock := &catalogFileLock{file: file}
	ticker := time.NewTicker(10 * time.Millisecond)
	defer ticker.Stop()
	for {
		err = unix.Flock(int(file.Fd()), unix.LOCK_EX|unix.LOCK_NB)
		if err == nil {
			return lock, nil
		}
		if !errors.Is(err, unix.EWOULDBLOCK) && !errors.Is(err, unix.EAGAIN) && !errors.Is(err, unix.EINTR) {
			_ = file.Close()
			return nil, err
		}
		select {
		case <-ctx.Done():
			_ = file.Close()
			return nil, ctx.Err()
		case <-ticker.C:
		}
	}
}

func (l *catalogFileLock) Close() error {
	unlockErr := unix.Flock(int(l.file.Fd()), unix.LOCK_UN)
	return errors.Join(unlockErr, l.file.Close())
}
```

```go
//go:build windows

package catalog

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"os"
	"time"

	"golang.org/x/sys/windows"
)

type catalogFileLock struct {
	file       *os.File
	overlapped windows.Overlapped
}

func acquireCatalogFileLock(ctx context.Context, path string) (*catalogFileLock, error) {
	if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	file, err := os.OpenFile(path, os.O_CREATE|os.O_RDWR, 0o600)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	lock := &catalogFileLock{file: file}
	ticker := time.NewTicker(10 * time.Millisecond)
	defer ticker.Stop()
	for {
		err = windows.LockFileEx(windows.Handle(file.Fd()),
			windows.LOCKFILE_EXCLUSIVE_LOCK|windows.LOCKFILE_FAIL_IMMEDIATELY,
			0, 1, 0, &lock.overlapped)
		if err == nil {
			return lock, nil
		}
		if !errors.Is(err, windows.ERROR_LOCK_VIOLATION) && !errors.Is(err, windows.ERROR_IO_PENDING) {
			_ = file.Close()
			return nil, err
		}
		select {
		case <-ctx.Done():
			_ = file.Close()
			return nil, ctx.Err()
		case <-ticker.C:
		}
	}
}

func (l *catalogFileLock) Close() error {
	unlockErr := windows.UnlockFileEx(windows.Handle(l.file.Fd()), 0, 1, 0, &l.overlapped)
	return errors.Join(unlockErr, l.file.Close())
}
```

```text
14	type catalogFileLock struct {
```
```text
15		file       *os.File
16		overlapped windows.Overlapped
17	}
18	
19	func acquireCatalogFileLock(ctx context.Context, path string) (*catalogFileLock, error) {
20		if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
21			return nil, err
22		}
23		file, err := os.OpenFile(path, os.O_CREATE|os.O_RDWR, 0o600)
24		if err != nil {
25			return nil, err
26		}
27		lock := &catalogFileLock{file: file}
28		ticker := time.NewTicker(10 * time.Millisecond)
29		defer ticker.Stop()
30		for {
31			err = windows.LockFileEx(windows.Handle(file.Fd()),
32				windows.LOCKFILE_EXCLUSIVE_LOCK|windows.LOCKFILE_FAIL_IMMEDIATELY,
33				0, 1, 0, &lock.overlapped)
34			if err == nil {
35				return lock, nil
36			}
37			if !errors.Is(err, windows.ERROR_LOCK_VIOLATION) && !errors.Is(err, windows.ERROR_IO_PENDING) {
38				_ = file.Close()
39				return nil, err
40			}
41			select {
42			case <-ctx.Done():
43				_ = file.Close()
44				return nil, ctx.Err()
45			case <-ticker.C:
46			}
47		}
48	}
49	
50	func (l *catalogFileLock) Close() error {
51		unlockErr := windows.UnlockFileEx(windows.Handle(l.file.Fd()), 0, 1, 0, &l.overlapped)
52		return errors.Join(unlockErr, l.file.Close())
53	}
```

```text
20			_ = syscall.Flock(int(file.Fd()), syscall.LOCK_UN)
21			_ = file.Close()
22		}, nil
23	}
24	
25	func sameFilesystem(source, destination string) (bool, error) {
26		sourceAncestor, err := nearestExisting(source)
27		if err != nil {
28			return false, err
29		}
30		destinationAncestor, err := nearestExisting(destination)
31		if err != nil {
32			return false, err
33		}
34		sourceInfo, err := os.Stat(sourceAncestor)
35		if err != nil {
36			return false, err
37		}
38		destinationInfo, err := os.Stat(destinationAncestor)
39		if err != nil {
40			return false, err
41		}
42		sourceStat, sourceOK := sourceInfo.Sys().(*syscall.Stat_t)
43		destinationStat, destinationOK := destinationInfo.Sys().(*syscall.Stat_t)
44		if !sourceOK || !destinationOK {
45			// os.Rename remains the final authority on platforms whose FileInfo does
46			// not expose a Unix-style device number.
47			return true, nil
48		}
49		return sourceStat.Dev == destinationStat.Dev, nil
50	}
51
```

```text
14	func lockCatalogFile(path string) (func(), error) {
15		file, err := os.OpenFile(path, os.O_CREATE|os.O_RDWR, 0o600)
16		if err != nil {
17			return nil, err
18		}
19		overlapped := &windows.Overlapped{}
20		if err := windows.LockFileEx(windows.Handle(file.Fd()), windows.LOCKFILE_EXCLUSIVE_LOCK, 0, 1, 0, overlapped); err != nil {
21			_ = file.Close()
22			return nil, err
23		}
24		return func() {
25			_ = windows.UnlockFileEx(windows.Handle(file.Fd()), 0, 1, 0, overlapped)
26			_ = file.Close()
27		}, nil
28	}
29	
30	func sameFilesystem(source, destination string) (bool, error) {
31		sourceAncestor, err := nearestExisting(source)
32		if err != nil {
33			return false, err
34		}
35		destinationAncestor, err := nearestExisting(destination)
36		if err != nil {
37			return false, err
38		}
39		sourceVolume, err := windowsVolumePath(sourceAncestor)
40		if err != nil {
41			return false, fmt.Errorf("identify source volume: %w", err)
42		}
43		destinationVolume, err := windowsVolumePath(destinationAncestor)
44		if err != nil {
45			return false, fmt.Errorf("identify destination volume: %w", err)
46		}
47		return sameWindowsVolumePath(sourceVolume, destinationVolume), nil
48	}
49	
50	func windowsVolumePath(path string) (string, error) {
51		pathPointer, err := windows.UTF16PtrFromString(path)
52		if err != nil {
53			return "", err
54		}
55		buffer := make([]uint16, windows.MAX_PATH+1)
56		if err := windows.GetVolumePathName(pathPointer, &buffer[0], uint32(len(buffer))); err != nil {
57			return "", err
58		}
59		return windows.UTF16ToString(buffer), nil
60	}
61	
62	func sameWindowsVolumePath(left, right string) bool {
63		return strings.EqualFold(filepath.Clean(left), filepath.Clean(right))
64	}
```

```text
117						})
118						continue
119					}
120					entries = append(entries, entry)
121					items = append(items, itemFromEntry(entry, probe.live))
122				case 1:

131						})
132						continue
133					}
134					replaceEntry(entries, updated)
135					items = append(items, itemFromEntry(updated, probe.live))
136				default:

138					for index, entry := range matches {

140					}
141					ambiguous := &AmbiguousError{Ref: probe.live.CurrentPath, Candidates: candidatesOf(matchedItems)}
142					items = append(items, s.transientItem(probe, ambiguous))
143					diagnostics = append(diagnostics, Diagnostic{

145					})
146				}

152		sortItemsByName(items)
153		sortDiagnostics(diagnostics)

155	}

157	// List reconciles visible directories, joins requested catalog history, and
158	// enriches Git repositories with bounded status/last-commit probes.
159	func (s *Service) List(ctx context.Context, options ListOptions) ([]Item, []Diagnostic, error) {
160		visible, diagnostics, err := s.Reconcile(ctx)

172		seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(visible))
173		seenPaths := make(map[string]struct{}, len(visible))
```

```text
13			return false, err
14		}

16		if err != nil {

24		if err != nil {

26		}
27		sourceStat, sourceOK := sourceInfo.Sys().(*syscall.Stat_t)
28		destinationStat, destinationOK := destinationInfo.Sys().(*syscall.Stat_t)
29		if !sourceOK || !destinationOK {
30			// os.Rename remains the final authority on platforms whose FileInfo does

33		}
34		return sourceStat.Dev == destinationStat.Dev, nil
35	}
```

```text
14	type catalogFileLock struct {
15		file *os.File
16	}
17	
18	func acquireCatalogFileLock(ctx context.Context, path string) (*catalogFileLock, error) {
19		if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
20			return nil, err
21		}
22		file, err := os.OpenFile(path, os.O_CREATE|os.O_RDWR, 0o600)
23		if err != nil {
24			return nil, err
25		}
26		lock := &catalogFileLock{file: file}
27		ticker := time.NewTicker(10 * time.Millisecond)
28		defer ticker.Stop()
29		for {
30			err = unix.Flock(int(file.Fd()), unix.LOCK_EX|unix.LOCK_NB)
31			if err == nil {
32				return lock, nil
33			}
34			if !errors.Is(err, unix.EWOULDBLOCK) && !errors.Is(err, unix.EAGAIN) && !errors.Is(err, unix.EINTR) {
35				_ = file.Close()
36				return nil, err
37			}
38			select {
39			case <-ctx.Done():
40				_ = file.Close()
41				return nil, ctx.Err()
42			case <-ticker.C:
43			}
44		}
45	}
46	
47	func (l *catalogFileLock) Close() error {
48		unlockErr := unix.Flock(int(l.file.Fd()), unix.LOCK_UN)
49		return errors.Join(unlockErr, l.file.Close())
50	}
```

```text
14	type catalogFileLock struct {

19	func acquireCatalogFileLock(ctx context.Context, path string) (*catalogFileLock, error) {
20		if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
21			return nil, err
22		}
23		file, err := os.OpenFile(path, os.O_CREATE|os.O_RDWR, 0o600)
24		if err != nil {
25			return nil, err
26		}
27		lock := &catalogFileLock{file: file}
28		ticker := time.NewTicker(10 * time.Millisecond)
29		defer ticker.Stop()
30		for {
31			err = windows.LockFileEx(windows.Handle(file.Fd()),
32				windows.LOCKFILE_EXCLUSIVE_LOCK|windows.LOCKFILE_FAIL_IMMEDIATELY,
33				0, 1, 0, &lock.overlapped)
34			if err == nil {
35				return lock, nil
36			}
37			if !errors.Is(err, windows.ERROR_LOCK_VIOLATION) && !errors.Is(err, windows.ERROR_IO_PENDING) {
38				_ = file.Close()
39				return nil, err
40			}
41			select {
42			case <-ctx.Done():
43				_ = file.Close()
44				return nil, ctx.Err()
45			case <-ticker.C:
46			}
47		}
48	}
49	
50	func (l *catalogFileLock) Close() error {
51		unlockErr := windows.UnlockFileEx(windows.Handle(l.file.Fd()), 0, 1, 0, &l.overlapped)
52		return errors.Join(unlockErr, l.file.Close())
53	}
```

```text
103	// lock. It is intended for short read-match-write transactions; expensive
104	// discovery belongs before the lock. The operating system releases the lock if
105	// the process exits unexpectedly.
106	func (s *Store) WithLock(ctx context.Context, operation func() error) (err error) {
107		if s == nil {
108			return errors.New("lock nil catalog store")
109		}
```

```text
345	// NewService validates and normalizes the injected service dependencies.
346	func NewService(config ServiceConfig) (*Service, error) {
347		store := config.Store
348		registry := config.Registry
349		if store == nil && registry != nil {
350			store = registry.Store()
351		}
352		if registry == nil && store != nil {
353			registry = catalog.NewRegistry(store)
354		}
355		if store == nil || registry == nil {
356			return nil, errors.New("experiment service requires a catalog registry and store")
357		}
358		if registry.Store() != store {
359			return nil, errors.New("experiment service registry and store do not share a catalog")
360		}
361	
362		triesRoot, err := absoluteRoot(config.TriesRoot, "tries root")
363		if err != nil {
364			return nil, err
365		}
366		projectRoot, err := absoluteRoot(config.ProjectRoot, "project root")
367		if err != nil {
368			return nil, err
369		}
370		host := strings.TrimSpace(config.Host)
371		if host == "" || host != config.Host || strings.ContainsRune(host, '\x00') {
372			return nil, errors.New("experiment service host is required and must be normalized")
373		}
374		clock := config.Clock
375		if clock == nil {
376			clock = time.Now
377		}
378		workers := config.MaxEnrichment
379		if workers <= 0 {
380			workers = 4
381		}
382	
383		s := &Service{
384			registry: registry, store: store,
385			triesRoot: triesRoot, projectRoot: projectRoot, host: host,
386			clock: clock, workers: workers,
387			gitRun: gitx.Run, gitDiscover: gitx.Discover,
388			gitStatus: gitx.StatusOf, gitLastCommit: gitx.LastCommit,
389			rename: os.Rename, sameFilesystem: sameFilesystem,
390			getwd: os.Getwd,
391		}
392		s.catalogCreate = store.Create
393		s.catalogUpdate = registry.Update
394		applyHooks(s, config.Hooks)
395		return s, nil
396	}

428	func absoluteRoot(root, label string) (string, error) {
429		if strings.TrimSpace(root) == "" {
430			return "", fmt.Errorf("experiment service %s is required", label)
431		}
432		absolute, err := filepath.Abs(root)
433		if err != nil {
434			return "", fmt.Errorf("make %s absolute: %w", label, err)
435		}
436		return filepath.Clean(absolute), nil
437	}

443			return fmt.Errorf("create tries root %s: %w", s.triesRoot, err)
444		}

448	func candidatesOf(items []Item) []Candidate {
449		candidates := make([]Candidate, len(items))
450		for index, item := range items {
451			candidates[index] = Candidate{
452				ID: item.ID, Name: item.Name, Basename: item.Basename, Path: item.Live.CurrentPath,
453			}
454		}
455		sort.Slice(candidates, func(i, j int) bool {
456			left, right := strings.ToLower(candidates[i].Basename), strings.ToLower(candidates[j].Basename)
457			if left != right {
458				return left < right
459			}
460			if candidates[i].Basename != candidates[j].Basename {
461				return candidates[i].Basename < candidates[j].Basename
462			}
463			return candidates[i].ID < candidates[j].ID
464		})
465		return candidates
466	}
467	
468	func itemFromEntry(entry *catalog.Entry, live LiveFacts) Item {
469		if entry == nil {
470			return Item{Live: live}
471		}
472		copy := entry.Clone()
473		item := Item{
474			Entry: copy,
475			ID:    copy.ID, Kind: copy.Kind, Name: copy.Name,
476			Note: copy.Note, Tags: append([]string(nil), copy.Tags...),
477			Created: copy.Created, LastOpened: copy.LastOpened,
478			RemoteIdentity: copy.RemoteIdentity,
479			Live:           live,
480		}
481		if copy.Experiment != nil {
482			item.Slug = copy.Experiment.Slug
483			item.Phase = copy.Experiment.Phase
484			item.Started = copy.Experiment.Started
485			item.OriginURL = copy.Experiment.OriginURL
486		}
487		if item.Live.CurrentPath != "" {
488			item.Basename = filepath.Base(item.Live.CurrentPath)
489		} else if copy.Experiment != nil && copy.Experiment.OriginalPath != "" {
490			item.Basename = filepath.Base(copy.Experiment.OriginalPath)
491		}
492		return item
493	}
494	
495	func catalogDiagnostics(diagnostics []catalog.Diagnostic) []Diagnostic {
496		out := make([]Diagnostic, len(diagnostics))
497		for index, diagnostic := range diagnostics {

499		}
500		return out
501	}

503	func directoryExists(path string) (bool, error) {
504		info, err := os.Stat(path)
505		if err == nil {
506			return info.IsDir(), nil
507		}
508		if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
509			return false, nil
510		}
511		return false, err
512	}
```

```text
32	// It never moves, renames, or writes into a discovered directory. Filesystem
33	// and Git probes happen before the short cross-process catalog transaction.
34	func (s *Service) Reconcile(ctx context.Context) ([]Item, []Diagnostic, error) {
35		s.reconcileMu.Lock()
36		defer s.reconcileMu.Unlock()
37	
38		if err := s.ensureTriesRoot(); err != nil {
39			return nil, nil, err
40		}
41		directoryEntries, err := os.ReadDir(s.triesRoot)
42		if err != nil {
43			return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("read tries root %s: %w", s.triesRoot, err)
44		}
45		paths := make([]string, 0, len(directoryEntries))
46		for _, entry := range directoryEntries {
47			if strings.HasPrefix(entry.Name(), ".") {
48				continue
49			}
50			paths = append(paths, filepath.Join(s.triesRoot, entry.Name()))
51		}
52		probes := boundedMap(ctx, s.workers, paths, func(ctx context.Context, path string) directoryProbe {
53			return s.probeDirectory(ctx, path)
54		})
55	
56		validProbes := make([]directoryProbe, 0, len(probes))
57		var diagnostics []Diagnostic
58		for _, probe := range probes {
59			if probe.diagnostic != nil {
60				diagnostics = append(diagnostics, *probe.diagnostic)
61			}
62			if !probe.valid {
63				continue
64			}
65			if visibilityErr := s.validateVisibleTryPath(probe.live.CurrentPath); visibilityErr != nil {
66				diagnostics = append(diagnostics, Diagnostic{
67					Path: probe.live.CurrentPath, Operation: "validate try location", Err: visibilityErr,
68				})
69				continue
70			}
71			validProbes = append(validProbes, probe)
72		}
73	
74		items := make([]Item, 0, len(validProbes))
75		lockErr := s.store.WithLock(ctx, func() error {
76			entries, catalogProblems, listErr := s.store.ListWithDiagnostics()
77			if listErr != nil {
78				return listErr
79			}
80			diagnostics = append(diagnostics, catalogDiagnostics(catalogProblems)...)
81	
82			for _, probe := range validProbes {
83				matches := matchingEntries(entries, s.host, probe)
84				if len(matches) == 0 && len(catalogProblems) == 0 && remoteIdentityFromOrigin(probe.originURL) != "" {
85					matched, matchErr := s.registry.Match(observationFromProbe(s.host, probe))
86					switch {
87					case matchErr == nil && eligibleTryRecord(matched):
88						matches = []*catalog.Entry{matched}
89					case matchErr == nil:
90						// A graduated experiment at the same identity is history, not an
91						// active Try to revive implicitly.
92					case errors.Is(matchErr, catalog.ErrNotFound), errors.Is(matchErr, catalog.ErrAmbiguous):
93						// A live clone must get its own identity when the remote hint is
94						// absent or ambiguous.
95					default:
96						item := s.transientItem(probe, matchErr)
97						items = append(items, item)
98						diagnostics = append(diagnostics, Diagnostic{
99							Path: probe.live.CurrentPath, Operation: "match catalog try", Err: matchErr,
100						})
101						continue
102					}
103				}
104				switch len(matches) {
105				case 0:
106					if len(catalogProblems) > 0 {
107						// The catalog diagnostic is reported once, while each live item carries
108						// the same typed tracking error for callers that try to mutate it.
109						items = append(items, s.transientItem(probe, incompleteCatalogError(catalogProblems)))
110						continue
111					}
112					entry := s.newEntry(probe)
113					if createErr := s.catalogCreate(entry); createErr != nil {
114						item := s.transientItem(probe, createErr)
115						items = append(items, item)
116						diagnostics = append(diagnostics, Diagnostic{
117							Path: probe.live.CurrentPath, Operation: "catalog try", Err: createErr,
118						})
119						continue
120					}
121					entries = append(entries, entry)
122					items = append(items, itemFromEntry(entry, probe.live))
123				case 1:
124					entry := matches[0]
125					updated, updateErr := s.refreshEntry(entry, probe)
126					if updateErr != nil {
127						item := itemFromEntry(entry, probe.live)
128						item.CatalogError = updateErr
129						items = append(items, item)
130						diagnostics = append(diagnostics, Diagnostic{
131							Path: probe.live.CurrentPath, Operation: "refresh catalog try", Err: updateErr,
132						})
133						continue
134					}
135					replaceEntry(entries, updated)
136					items = append(items, itemFromEntry(updated, probe.live))
137				default:
138					matchedItems := make([]Item, len(matches))
139					for index, entry := range matches {
140						matchedItems[index] = itemFromEntry(entry, probe.live)
141					}
142					ambiguous := &AmbiguousError{Ref: probe.live.CurrentPath, Candidates: candidatesOf(matchedItems)}
143					items = append(items, s.transientItem(probe, ambiguous))
144					diagnostics = append(diagnostics, Diagnostic{
145						Path: probe.live.CurrentPath, Operation: "match catalog try", Err: ambiguous,
146					})
147				}
148			}
149			return nil
150		})
151	
152		items = deduplicateItems(items)
153		sortItemsByName(items)
154		sortDiagnostics(diagnostics)
155		return items, diagnostics, lockErr
156	}
157	
158	// List reconciles visible directories, joins requested catalog history, and
159	// enriches Git repositories with bounded status/last-commit probes.
160	func (s *Service) List(ctx context.Context, options ListOptions) ([]Item, []Diagnostic, error) {
161		visible, diagnostics, err := s.Reconcile(ctx)
162		if err != nil {
163			return visible, diagnostics, err
164		}
165	
166		entries, catalogProblems, err := s.store.ListWithDiagnostics()
167		if err != nil {
168			return visible, diagnostics, err
169		}
170		diagnostics = append(diagnostics, catalogDiagnostics(catalogProblems)...)
171	
172		items := make([]Item, 0, len(entries)+len(visible))
173		seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(visible))
174		seenPaths := make(map[string]struct{}, len(visible))
175		for _, item := range visible {
176			if item.ID != "" {
177				seen[item.ID] = struct{}{}
178			}
179			if key := pathKey(item.Live.CurrentPath); key != "" {
180				seenPaths[key] = struct{}{}
181			}
182			items = append(items, item)
183		}
184	
185		for _, entry := range entries {
186			if _, ok := seen[entry.ID]; ok {
187				continue
188			}
189			if location, ok := entry.LocationFor(s.host); ok {
190				if _, pathSeen := seenPaths[pathKey(location.CurrentPath)]; pathSeen {
191					continue
192				}
193			}
194			graduated := entry.Kind == catalog.KindRepository && entry.Experiment != nil &&
195				entry.Experiment.Phase == catalog.PhaseGraduated
196			if graduated {
197				if !options.IncludeGraduated {
198					continue
199				}
200			} else if entry.Kind != catalog.KindTry || entry.Experiment == nil {
201				continue
202			}
203	
204			location, located := entry.LocationFor(s.host)
205			present := located && location.State == catalog.LocationPresent && !s.hiddenStorage(location.CurrentPath)
206			if present && !graduated && s.validateVisibleTryPath(location.CurrentPath) != nil {
207				present = false
208			}
209			if present {
210				isDirectory, statErr := directoryExists(location.CurrentPath)
211				if statErr != nil {
212					diagnostics = append(diagnostics, Diagnostic{
213						Path: location.CurrentPath, Operation: "stat catalog try", Err: statErr,
214					})
215					present = false
216				} else {
217					present = isDirectory
218				}
219			}
220			if !present && !options.IncludeNonPresent {
221				continue
222			}
223	
224			live := LiveFacts{Present: present}
225			if located {
226				live.CurrentPath = location.CurrentPath
227				live.RealPath = location.RealPath
228			}
229			if present {
230				probe := s.probeDirectory(ctx, location.CurrentPath)
231				if probe.diagnostic != nil {
232					diagnostics = append(diagnostics, *probe.diagnostic)
233				}
234				if probe.valid {
235					live = probe.live
236				}
237			}
238			items = append(items, itemFromEntry(entry, live))
239		}
240	
241		if query := strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(options.Query)); query != "" {
242			filtered := items[:0]
243			for _, item := range items {
244				if strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(item.SearchText()), query) {
245					filtered = append(filtered, item)
246				}
247			}
248			items = filtered
249		}
250		if !options.SkipEnrichment {
251			items = s.enrich(ctx, items)
252		}
253		sortItemsByActivity(items)
254		diagnostics = deduplicateDiagnostics(diagnostics)
255		sortDiagnostics(diagnostics)
256		return items, diagnostics, nil
257	}
258	
259	// Resolve applies stable, deterministic matching: exact ID, exact basename,
260	// exact date-stripped name/slug, then one unique case-insensitive substring.
261	func (s *Service) Resolve(ctx context.Context, ref string) (Item, []Diagnostic, error) {
262		items, diagnostics, err := s.List(ctx, ListOptions{SkipEnrichment: true})
263		if err != nil {
264			return Item{}, diagnostics, err
265		}
266		ref = strings.TrimSpace(ref)
267		if ref == "" {
268			return Item{}, diagnostics, &NotFoundError{Ref: ref, Root: s.triesRoot}
269		}
270	
271		if looksLikePath(ref) {
272			pathRef := config.Expand(ref)
273			if canonical, canonicalErr := pathx.Canonical(pathRef); canonicalErr == nil {
274				var matches []Item
275				for _, item := range items {
276					if samePath(canonical, item.Live.CurrentPath) {
277						matches = append(matches, item)
278					}
279				}
280				if len(matches) > 0 {
281					return s.selectResolved(ctx, ref, matches, diagnostics)
282				}
283			}
284		}
285	
286		for _, match := range []func(Item) bool{
287			func(item Item) bool { return item.ID != "" && item.ID == ref },
288			func(item Item) bool { return item.Basename == ref },
289			func(item Item) bool {
290				stripped, _, _ := splitDatedBasename(item.Basename)
291				return stripped == ref || item.Name == ref || item.Slug == ref
292			},
293		} {
294			var matches []Item
295			for _, item := range items {
296				if match(item) {
297					matches = append(matches, item)
298				}
299			}
300			if len(matches) > 0 {
301				return s.selectResolved(ctx, ref, matches, diagnostics)
302			}
303		}
304	
305		needle := strings.ToLower(ref)
306		var matches []Item
307		for _, item := range items {
308			stripped, _, _ := splitDatedBasename(item.Basename)
309			for _, value := range []string{item.Basename, stripped, item.Name, item.Slug} {
310				if value != "" && strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(value), needle) {
311					matches = append(matches, item)
312					break
313				}
314			}
315		}
316		if len(matches) == 0 {
317			return Item{}, diagnostics, &NotFoundError{Ref: ref, Root: s.triesRoot}
318		}
319		return s.selectResolved(ctx, ref, matches, diagnostics)
320	}
321	
322	func (s *Service) selectResolved(ctx context.Context, ref string, matches []Item, diagnostics []Diagnostic) (Item, []Diagnostic, error) {
323		if len(matches) == 1 {
324			if errors.Is(matches[0].CatalogError, ErrAmbiguous) {
325				return Item{}, diagnostics, matches[0].CatalogError
326			}
327			enriched := s.enrich(ctx, matches)
328			return enriched[0], diagnostics, nil
329		}
330		return Item{}, diagnostics, &AmbiguousError{Ref: ref, Candidates: candidatesOf(matches)}
331	}
332	
333	// ResolveOrCreate preserves the low-friction dev try behavior: an existing
334	// non-clone match wins; clone requests always get a collision-safe new path.
335	func (s *Service) ResolveOrCreate(ctx context.Context, request CreateRequest) (CreateResult, error) {
336		if request.Clone == "" {
337			name := config.Slug(strings.ReplaceAll(request.Name, " ", "-"))
338			item, diagnostics, err := s.Resolve(ctx, name)
339			if err == nil {
340				result := CreateResult{
341					Item: item, Path: item.Live.CurrentPath, Existing: true,
342					Tracked: item.ID != "" && item.CatalogError == nil, Diagnostics: diagnostics,
343				}
344				if !result.Tracked {
345					trackingErr := item.CatalogError
346					if trackingErr == nil {
347						trackingErr = errors.New("matching directory has no catalog ID")
348					}
349					return result, fmt.Errorf("existing try at %s is not tracked in the catalog: %w", result.Path, trackingErr)
350				}
351				return result, nil
352			}
353			if !errors.Is(err, ErrNotFound) {
354				return CreateResult{Diagnostics: diagnostics}, err
355			}
356		}
357		return s.Create(ctx, request)
358	}
359	
360	// Create makes a new collision-safe dated directory or clone and catalogs it
361	// only after the filesystem operation succeeds.
362	func (s *Service) Create(ctx context.Context, request CreateRequest) (CreateResult, error) {
363		var result CreateResult
364		if err := s.ensureTriesRoot(); err != nil {
365			return result, err
366		}
367		name := request.Name
368		if request.Clone != "" && strings.TrimSpace(name) == "" {
369			name = cloneDefaultName(request.Clone)
370		}
371		slug := config.Slug(strings.ReplaceAll(name, " ", "-"))
372		if err := pathx.ValidateComponent(slug); err != nil {
373			return result, fmt.Errorf("try name %q: %w", name, err)
374		}
375	
376		path, err := s.availableDatedPath(slug)
377		if err != nil {
378			return result, err
379		}
380		result.Path = path
381		if request.Clone != "" {
382			cloneRef, normalizeErr := s.normalizeCloneRef(request.Clone)
383			if normalizeErr != nil {
384				return result, normalizeErr
385			}
386			if _, err := s.gitRun(ctx, s.triesRoot, "clone", cloneRef, path); err != nil {
387				return result, fmt.Errorf("clone try into %s: %w", path, err)
388			}
389			result.Created = true
390			result.Cloned = true
391		} else {
392			if err := os.Mkdir(path, 0o755); err != nil {
393				return result, fmt.Errorf("create try %s: %w", path, err)
394			}
395			result.Created = true
396			if !request.NoGit {
397				if _, err := s.gitRun(ctx, path, "init", "-b", "main"); err != nil {
398					result.InitWarning = err
399				}
400			}
401		}
402	
403		canonical, canonicalErr := pathx.Canonical(path)
404		if canonicalErr != nil {
405			return result, fmt.Errorf("try exists at %s but its canonical path could not be determined: %w", path, canonicalErr)
406		}
407		result.Path = canonical
408		items, diagnostics, reconcileErr := s.Reconcile(ctx)
409		result.Diagnostics = diagnostics
410		if reconcileErr != nil {
411			return result, fmt.Errorf("try exists at %s but catalog reconciliation failed: %w", canonical, reconcileErr)
412		}
413		for _, item := range items {
414			if samePath(item.Live.CurrentPath, canonical) {
415				result.Item = item
416				result.Tracked = item.ID != "" && item.CatalogError == nil
417				break
418			}
419		}
420		if !result.Tracked {
421			trackingErr := result.Item.CatalogError
422			if trackingErr == nil {
423				trackingErr = errors.New("reconciliation did not produce a catalog record")
424			}
425			return result, fmt.Errorf("try exists at %s but could not be added to the catalog: %w", canonical, trackingErr)
426		}
427		enriched := s.enrich(ctx, []Item{result.Item})
428		if len(enriched) == 1 {
429			result.Item = enriched[0]
430		}
431		return result, nil
432	}
433	
434	// RefreshOrigin re-probes origin after an explicit external remote-creation
435	// step and persists its raw URL and normalized identity on the same catalog ID.
436	func (s *Service) RefreshOrigin(ctx context.Context, id string) (Item, error) {
437		entry, err := s.registry.Get(id)
438		if err != nil {
439			return Item{}, fmt.Errorf("load experiment %s for origin refresh: %w", id, err)
440		}
441		if entry.Experiment == nil ||
442			(entry.Kind != catalog.KindTry && !(entry.Kind == catalog.KindRepository && entry.Experiment.Phase == catalog.PhaseGraduated)) {
443			return Item{}, &NotFoundError{Ref: id, Root: s.triesRoot}
444		}
445		location, ok := entry.LocationFor(s.host)
446		if !ok || location.State != catalog.LocationPresent || location.CurrentPath == "" {
447			return Item{}, &NotFoundError{Ref: id, Root: s.triesRoot}
448		}
449		probe := s.probeDirectory(ctx, location.CurrentPath)
450		if !probe.valid || probe.live.Repo == nil || probe.live.DiscoverError != nil {
451			if probe.diagnostic != nil {
452				return Item{}, fmt.Errorf("refresh experiment origin: %w", probe.diagnostic.Err)
453			}
454			return Item{}, errors.New("refresh experiment origin: path is not a discoverable Git repository")
455		}
456		if probe.originURL == "" {
457			return Item{}, errors.New("refresh experiment origin: Git origin is not configured")
458		}
459		updated, err := s.catalogUpdate(id, func(current *catalog.Entry) error {
460			currentLocation, found := current.LocationFor(s.host)
461			if !found || currentLocation.State != catalog.LocationPresent ||
462				!samePath(currentLocation.CurrentPath, probe.live.CurrentPath) {
463				return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s moved or was reassigned before origin refresh", id)
464			}
465			if current.Experiment == nil {
466				return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s no longer has experiment provenance", id)
467			}
468			current.Experiment.OriginURL = probe.originURL
469			current.RemoteIdentity = remoteIdentityFromOrigin(probe.originURL)
470			return current.SetLocation(s.host, locationFromProbe(probe, currentLocation))
471		})
472		if err != nil {
473			return Item{}, fmt.Errorf("refresh experiment origin: %w", err)
474		}
475		item := itemFromEntry(updated, probe.live)
476		enriched := s.enrich(ctx, []Item{item})
477		if len(enriched) == 1 {
478			item = enriched[0]
479		}
480		return item, nil
481	}
482	
483	// Touch updates LastOpened only after a caller has successfully handed off the
484	// selected OpenTarget.
485	func (s *Service) Touch(_ context.Context, id string) (TouchResult, error) {
486		if id == "" {
487			return TouchResult{}, &NotFoundError{Ref: id, Root: s.triesRoot}
488		}
489		now := s.now()
490		updated, err := s.catalogUpdate(id, func(entry *catalog.Entry) error {
491			if entry.Experiment == nil ||
492				(entry.Kind != catalog.KindTry && !(entry.Kind == catalog.KindRepository && entry.Experiment.Phase == catalog.PhaseGraduated)) {
493				return &NotFoundError{Ref: id, Root: s.triesRoot}
494			}
495			location, ok := entry.LocationFor(s.host)
496			if !ok || location.State != catalog.LocationPresent {
497				return &NotFoundError{Ref: id, Root: s.triesRoot}
498			}
499			entry.LastOpened = now
500			return nil
501		})
502		if err != nil {
503			if errors.Is(err, catalog.ErrNotFound) {
504				return TouchResult{}, &NotFoundError{Ref: id, Root: s.triesRoot}
505			}
506			return TouchResult{}, fmt.Errorf("touch try %s: %w", id, err)
507		}
508		location, _ := updated.LocationFor(s.host)
509		item := itemFromEntry(updated, LiveFacts{
510			Present:     location.State == catalog.LocationPresent,
511			CurrentPath: location.CurrentPath, RealPath: location.RealPath,
512		})
513		return TouchResult{Item: item, TouchedAt: now}, nil
514	}
515	
516	func (s *Service) probeDirectory(ctx context.Context, path string) directoryProbe {
517		probe := directoryProbe{}
518		if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
519			probe.diagnostic = &Diagnostic{Path: path, Operation: "inspect try", Err: err}
520			return probe
521		}
522		info, err := os.Stat(path)
523		if err != nil {
524			probe.diagnostic = &Diagnostic{Path: path, Operation: "stat try", Err: err}
525			return probe
526		}
527		if !info.IsDir() {
528			return probe
529		}
530		canonical, err := pathx.Canonical(path)
531		if err != nil {
532			probe.diagnostic = &Diagnostic{Path: path, Operation: "canonicalize try", Err: err}
533			return probe
534		}
535		probe.valid = true
536		probe.live = LiveFacts{Present: true, CurrentPath: canonical, RealPath: canonical}
537		_, markerErr := os.Lstat(filepath.Join(canonical, ".git"))
538		probe.gitMarker = markerErr == nil || !errors.Is(markerErr, fs.ErrNotExist)
539	
540		repository, discoverErr := s.gitDiscover(ctx, canonical)
541		if discoverErr != nil {
542			if probe.gitMarker || !errors.Is(discoverErr, gitx.ErrNotARepo) {
543				probe.live.DiscoverError = discoverErr
544				probe.diagnostic = &Diagnostic{Path: canonical, Operation: "discover Git try", Err: discoverErr}
545			}
546			return probe
547		}
548		repositoryRoot := repository.Root
549		if repository.Bare {
550			repositoryRoot = repository.MainRoot
551		}
552		canonicalRoot, rootErr := pathx.Canonical(repositoryRoot)
553		if rootErr != nil || !samePath(canonicalRoot, canonical) {
554			// A TriesRoot may itself be inside a repository. Its child directories are
555			// not independent Git Tries merely because rev-parse walks to that parent.
556			return probe
557		}
558		repository.Root = canonicalRoot
559		if repository.MainRoot != "" {
560			if canonicalMain, mainErr := pathx.Canonical(repository.MainRoot); mainErr == nil {
561				repository.MainRoot = canonicalMain
562			}
563		}
564		if repository.GitCommonDir != "" {
565			commonDir, commonErr := pathx.Canonical(repository.GitCommonDir)
566			if commonErr != nil {
567				probe.live.DiscoverError = commonErr
568				probe.diagnostic = &Diagnostic{Path: canonical, Operation: "canonicalize Git common directory", Err: commonErr}
569				repository.GitCommonDir = ""
570			} else {
571				repository.GitCommonDir = commonDir
572			}
573		}
574		probe.live.Repo = &repository
575		probe.originURL = gitx.RemoteFromConfig(repository.GitCommonDir, "origin")
576		return probe
577	}
578	
579	func (s *Service) enrich(ctx context.Context, items []Item) []Item {
580		return boundedMap(ctx, s.workers, items, func(ctx context.Context, item Item) Item {
581			if item.Live.Repo == nil || item.Live.CurrentPath == "" {
582				return item
583			}
584			status, statusErr := s.gitStatus(ctx, item.Live.CurrentPath)
585			if statusErr != nil {
586				item.Live.StatusError = statusErr
587			} else {
588				item.Live.Status = &status
589			}
590			unix, subject, commitErr := s.gitLastCommit(ctx, item.Live.CurrentPath)
591			if commitErr != nil {
592				item.Live.LastCommitError = commitErr
593			} else if unix > 0 {
594				item.Live.LastCommit = time.Unix(unix, 0).UTC()
595				item.Live.LastCommitSubject = subject
596			}
597			return item
598		})
599	}
600	
601	func (s *Service) experimentFromProbe(probe directoryProbe) *catalog.Experiment {
602		name, started, dated := splitDatedBasename(filepath.Base(probe.live.CurrentPath))
603		if strings.TrimSpace(name) == "" {
604			name = "unnamed"
605		} else {
606			name = strings.TrimSpace(name)
607		}
608		if !dated {
609			started = s.now()
610		}
611		return &catalog.Experiment{
612			Phase: catalog.PhaseActive, Slug: config.Slug(name),
613			OriginURL: probe.originURL, Started: started,
614			OriginalPath: probe.live.CurrentPath,
615		}
616	}
617	
618	func (s *Service) newEntry(probe directoryProbe) *catalog.Entry {
619		name, started, dated := splitDatedBasename(filepath.Base(probe.live.CurrentPath))
620		if strings.TrimSpace(name) == "" {
621			name = "unnamed"
622		} else {
623			name = strings.TrimSpace(name)
624		}
625		if !dated {
626			started = s.now()

628		entry := &catalog.Entry{

664	func (s *Service) refreshEntry(entry *catalog.Entry, probe directoryProbe) (*catalog.Entry, error) {
665		location, _ := entry.LocationFor(s.host)
666		wantedLocation := locationFromProbe(probe, location)
667		if entry.Kind == catalog.KindRepository && entry.Experiment == nil {
668			metadata := s.experimentFromProbe(probe)
669			return s.catalogUpdate(entry.ID, func(updated *catalog.Entry) error {
670				if updated.Kind != catalog.KindRepository || updated.Experiment != nil {
671					return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s changed before it could become a Try", updated.ID)
672				}
673				updated.Kind = catalog.KindTry
674				updated.Experiment = metadata
675				if probe.originURL != "" {
676					updated.RemoteIdentity = remoteIdentityFromOrigin(probe.originURL)
677				}
678				return updated.SetLocation(s.host, wantedLocation)
679			})
680		}
681	
682		wantedOrigin := entry.Experiment.OriginURL
683		wantedIdentity := entry.RemoteIdentity
684		if probe.originURL != "" {
685			wantedOrigin = probe.originURL
686			wantedIdentity = remoteIdentityFromOrigin(probe.originURL)
687		}
688		if locationEqual(location, wantedLocation) && entry.Experiment.OriginURL == wantedOrigin &&
689			entry.RemoteIdentity == wantedIdentity {
690			return entry, nil
691		}
692		return s.catalogUpdate(entry.ID, func(updated *catalog.Entry) error {
693			if updated.Kind != catalog.KindTry || updated.Experiment == nil || updated.Experiment.Phase == catalog.PhaseGraduated {
694				return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s is not an active Try", updated.ID)
695			}
696			if probe.originURL != "" {
697				updated.Experiment.OriginURL = probe.originURL
698				updated.RemoteIdentity = remoteIdentityFromOrigin(probe.originURL)
699			}
700			return updated.SetLocation(s.host, wantedLocation)
701		})
702	}

759	func matchingEntries(entries []*catalog.Entry, host string, probe directoryProbe) []*catalog.Entry {
760		matched := make(map[string]*catalog.Entry)
761		for _, entry := range entries {

764			}

766			if located {

768					samePath(probe.live.CurrentPath, location.RealPath) ||
769					samePath(probe.live.CurrentPath, location.RestorePath)
770				commonMatch := probe.live.Repo != nil && probe.live.Repo.GitCommonDir != "" &&
771					samePath(probe.live.Repo.GitCommonDir, location.GitCommonDir)
772				if pathMatch || commonMatch {
773					matched[entry.ID] = entry
774				}
775			} else if entry.Experiment != nil && samePath(probe.live.CurrentPath, entry.Experiment.OriginalPath) {
776				matched[entry.ID] = entry
777			}
778		}
779		out := make([]*catalog.Entry, 0, len(matched))
780		for _, entry := range matched {
781			out = append(out, entry)
782		}
783		catalog.Sort(out)
784		return out
785	}

805	func splitDatedBasename(basename string) (string, time.Time, bool) {
806		if len(basename) <= len("2006-01-02-") || basename[10] != '-' {
807			return basename, time.Time{}, false
808		}
809		parsed, err := time.Parse("2006-01-02", basename[:10])
810		if err != nil || parsed.Format("2006-01-02") != basename[:10] {
811			return basename, time.Time{}, false
812		}
813		name := basename[11:]
814		if name == "" {
815			return basename, time.Time{}, false
816		}
817		return name, parsed, true
818	}

837			if _, err := os.Lstat(candidate); errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {

865	func (s *Service) normalizeCloneRef(ref string) (string, error) {
866		ref = strings.TrimSpace(ref)
867		if ref == "" {
868			return "", errors.New("clone reference is required")
869		}
870		if local, ok, err := s.resolveLocalCloneRef(ref); ok || err != nil {
871			return local, err
872		}
873		// SCP-style remotes are already complete clone references. In particular,
874		// nonstandard SSH usernames must not be rewritten as preferred-forge shorthand.
875		if !strings.Contains(ref, "://") && strings.ContainsAny(ref, "@:") {
876			return ref, nil
877		}
878		kind := forge.FromURL(ref)
879		if kind != forge.Unknown {
880			adapter, err := forge.For(kind)
881			if err == nil {
882				return adapter.CloneURL(ref), nil
883			}
884			return ref, nil
885		}
886		if !strings.Contains(ref, "://") && strings.Contains(ref, "/") {
887			if adapter, err := forge.Preferred(); err == nil {
888				return adapter.CloneURL(ref), nil
889			}
890		}
891		return ref, nil
892	}

894	func (s *Service) resolveLocalCloneRef(ref string) (string, bool, error) {
895		if strings.HasPrefix(ref, "file://") {
896			return ref, true, nil
897		}
898		if filepath.IsAbs(ref) {
899			return filepath.Clean(ref), true, nil
900		}
901		if ref == "~" || strings.HasPrefix(ref, "~/") {
902			return config.Expand(ref), true, nil
903		}
904	
905		explicit := strings.HasPrefix(ref, "./") || strings.HasPrefix(ref, "../")
906		cwd, err := s.getwd()
907		if err != nil {
908			if explicit {
909				return "", true, fmt.Errorf("resolve local clone reference %q: %w", ref, err)
910			}
911			return "", false, nil
912		}
913		candidate := filepath.Clean(filepath.Join(cwd, ref))
914		if explicit {
915			return candidate, true, nil
916		}
917		if strings.ContainsAny(ref, "@:") {
918			return "", false, nil
919		}
920		if _, err := os.Stat(candidate); err == nil {
921			return candidate, true, nil
922		}
923		return "", false, nil
924	}

926	func localClonePath(ref string) bool {

928			strings.HasPrefix(ref, "../") || strings.HasPrefix(ref, "~/") {
929			return true
930		}
931		_, err := os.Stat(ref)
932		return err == nil
933	}

935	func clonePathIdentity(ref string) string {
936		if parsed, err := url.Parse(ref); err == nil && parsed.Host != "" {
937			return strings.Trim(strings.TrimSuffix(parsed.Path, ".git"), "/")
938		}
939		if at := strings.LastIndexByte(ref, '@'); at >= 0 {
940			ref = ref[at+1:]
941		}
942		if colon := strings.IndexByte(ref, ':'); colon >= 0 {
943			ref = ref[colon+1:]
944		}
945		ref = strings.Trim(strings.TrimSuffix(ref, ".git"), "/")
946		if strings.Contains(ref, "/") {
947			return ref
948		}
949		return ""
950	}

952	func (s *Service) validateVisibleTryPath(path string) error {
953		canonicalRoot, err := pathx.Canonical(s.triesRoot)
954		if err != nil {
955			return fmt.Errorf("canonicalize tries root: %w", err)
956		}
957		canonicalPath, err := pathx.CanonicalChild(canonicalRoot, path)

964		}
965		if strings.Contains(relative, string(filepath.Separator)) || strings.HasPrefix(relative, ".") {
966			return fmt.Errorf("%s is not an immediate visible child of %s", canonicalPath, canonicalRoot)
967		}
968		return nil

971	func (s *Service) hiddenStorage(path string) bool {
972		if path == "" {
973			return false
974		}
975		if hiddenImmediateChild(s.triesRoot, path) {
976			return true
977		}
978		canonicalRoot, rootErr := pathx.Canonical(s.triesRoot)
979		canonicalPath, pathErr := pathx.Canonical(path)
980		if rootErr != nil || pathErr != nil {

982		}
983		return hiddenImmediateChild(canonicalRoot, canonicalPath)

986	func hiddenImmediateChild(root, path string) bool {
987		absoluteRoot, rootErr := filepath.Abs(root)
988		absolutePath, pathErr := filepath.Abs(path)
989		if rootErr != nil || pathErr != nil {
990			return false
991		}
992		relative, err := filepath.Rel(filepath.Clean(absoluteRoot), filepath.Clean(absolutePath))
993		if err != nil || relative == "." || relative == ".." ||
994			strings.HasPrefix(relative, ".."+string(filepath.Separator)) {
995			return false
996		}
997		first, _, _ := strings.Cut(relative, string(filepath.Separator))
998		return strings.HasPrefix(first, ".")
999	}

1010		if canonical, err := pathx.Canonical(path); err == nil {
1011			return canonical
1012		}

1019	func samePath(left, right string) bool {
1020		if left == "" || right == "" {
1021			return false
1022		}
1023		leftCanonical, leftErr := pathx.Canonical(left)
1024		rightCanonical, rightErr := pathx.Canonical(right)
1025		if leftErr == nil && rightErr == nil {
1026			return leftCanonical == rightCanonical
1027		}
1028		leftAbsolute, leftAbsErr := filepath.Abs(left)
1029		rightAbsolute, rightAbsErr := filepath.Abs(right)
1030		return leftAbsErr == nil && rightAbsErr == nil && filepath.Clean(leftAbsolute) == filepath.Clean(rightAbsolute)
1031	}

1033	func sortItemsByName(items []Item) {
1034		sort.SliceStable(items, func(i, j int) bool {
1035			left, right := strings.ToLower(items[i].DisplayName()), strings.ToLower(items[j].DisplayName())
1036			if left != right {
1037				return left < right
1038			}
1039			if items[i].DisplayName() != items[j].DisplayName() {
1040				return items[i].DisplayName() < items[j].DisplayName()
1041			}
1042			return items[i].ID < items[j].ID
1043		})
1044	}
1045	
1046	func sortItemsByActivity(items []Item) {
1047		sort.SliceStable(items, func(i, j int) bool {
1048			left, right := items[i].Activity(), items[j].Activity()
1049			if !left.Equal(right) {
1050				if left.IsZero() {
1051					return false
1052				}
1053				if right.IsZero() {
1054					return true
1055				}
1056				return left.After(right)
1057			}
1058			leftName, rightName := strings.ToLower(items[i].DisplayName()), strings.ToLower(items[j].DisplayName())
1059			if leftName != rightName {
1060				return leftName < rightName
1061			}
1062			return items[i].ID < items[j].ID
1063		})
1064	}

1066	func sortDiagnostics(diagnostics []Diagnostic) {

1071			return diagnostics[i].Operation < diagnostics[j].Operation

1075	func deduplicateItems(items []Item) []Item {
1076		seenIDs := make(map[string]struct{}, len(items))
1077		seenPaths := make(map[string]struct{}, len(items))
1078		out := items[:0]
1079		for _, item := range items {
1080			if item.ID != "" {
1081				if _, ok := seenIDs[item.ID]; ok {
1082					continue
1083				}
1084				seenIDs[item.ID] = struct{}{}
1085			} else if item.Live.CurrentPath != "" {
1086				if _, ok := seenPaths[item.Live.CurrentPath]; ok {
1087					continue
1088				}
1089				seenPaths[item.Live.CurrentPath] = struct{}{}
1090			}
1091			out = append(out, item)
1092		}
1093		return out
1094	}

1096	func deduplicateDiagnostics(diagnostics []Diagnostic) []Diagnostic {
1097		seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(diagnostics))
1098		out := diagnostics[:0]
1099		for _, diagnostic := range diagnostics {
1100			key := diagnostic.Path + "\x00" + diagnostic.Operation + "\x00" + fmt.Sprint(diagnostic.Err)
1101			if _, ok := seen[key]; ok {
1102				continue
1103			}
1104			seen[key] = struct{}{}
1105			out = append(out, diagnostic)
1106		}

1110	func boundedMap[Input, Output any](ctx context.Context, limit int, input []Input, work func(context.Context, Input) Output) []Output {
1111		if len(input) == 0 {
1112			return nil
1113		}
1114		if limit <= 0 || limit > len(input) {
1115			limit = len(input)
1116		}
1117		type job struct {
1118			index int
1119			value Input
1120		}
1121		type result struct {
1122			index int
1123			value Output
1124		}
1125		jobs := make(chan job, len(input))
1126		results := make(chan result, len(input))
1127		for index, value := range input {
1128			jobs <- job{index: index, value: value}
1129		}
1130		close(jobs)
1131	
1132		var workers sync.WaitGroup
1133		workers.Add(limit)
1134		for range limit {
1135			go func() {
1136				defer workers.Done()
1137				for next := range jobs {
1138					results <- result{index: next.index, value: work(ctx, next.value)}
1139				}
1140			}()
1141		}
1142		workers.Wait()
1143		close(results)
1144	
1145		out := make([]Output, len(input))
1146		for result := range results {
1147			out[result.index] = result.value
1148		}
1149		return out
1150	}
```

```text
74			return plan, fmt.Errorf("locate try under root: %w", err)
75		}
76		if relative == "." || strings.Contains(relative, string(filepath.Separator)) || strings.HasPrefix(relative, ".") {
77			return plan, fmt.Errorf("graduate source %s is not an immediate visible child of %s", source, canonicalRoot)
78		}

80		name := request.Name
81		if name == "" {
82			name, _, _ = splitDatedBasename(filepath.Base(source))
83		}
84		if name == "" {
85			return plan, fmt.Errorf("could not derive a project name from %s — pass --name", source)
86		}
87		if err := pathx.ValidateComponent(name); err != nil {
88			return plan, fmt.Errorf("project name %q: %w", name, err)
89		}
90		if name != strings.TrimSpace(name) {
91			return plan, fmt.Errorf("project name %q is not normalized: %w", name, pathx.ErrInvalidComponent)
92		}

95				return plan, fmt.Errorf("project category %q: %w", request.Category, err)

97			if request.Category != strings.TrimSpace(request.Category) {

121		}

130		plan.Destination = destination
131		plan.Category = request.Category
132		plan.Name = name
133		plan.NeedsGitInit = item.Live.Repo == nil
134		plan.NeedsInitialCommit = plan.NeedsGitInit || !s.hasCommit(ctx, source)
135		return plan, nil
```
