138	// Graduate prepares Git while the Try is still at its source, performs one
139	// same-filesystem rename, and atomically transitions the same catalog ID.
140	func (s *Service) Graduate(ctx context.Context, request GraduateRequest) (GraduateResult, error) {
141		plan, err := s.PlanGraduate(ctx, request)
142		result := GraduateResult{Plan: plan, Item: plan.Item, Diagnostics: plan.Diagnostics}
143		if err != nil {
144			return result, err
145		}
146		if request.DryRun {
147			return result, nil
148		}
149		if err := s.validateCatalogSource(plan.Item.ID, plan.Source); err != nil {
150			return result, err
151		}
152		if err := s.validateGraduatePaths(plan); err != nil {
153			return result, err
154		}
155	
156		if plan.NeedsGitInit {
157			if _, err := s.gitRun(ctx, plan.Source, "init", "-b", "main"); err != nil {
158				return result, fmt.Errorf("initialize Git before graduating %s: %w", plan.Source, err)
159			}
160			result.GitInitialized = true
161		}
162		made, err := s.ensureInitialCommit(ctx, plan.Source, plan.Name)
163		if err != nil {
164			return result, fmt.Errorf("ensure initial commit before graduating %s: %w", plan.Source, err)
165		}
166		result.InitialCommitMade = made
167	
168		// Revalidate containment, catalog ownership, collision, and device after Git
169		// preparation. Each check precedes the only move, so a stale plan fails with
170		// the source still in place.
171		if err := s.validateCatalogSource(plan.Item.ID, plan.Source); err != nil {
172			return result, err
173		}
174		if err := s.validateGraduatePaths(plan); err != nil {
175			return result, err
176		}
177		if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(plan.Destination), 0o755); err != nil {
178			return result, fmt.Errorf("create graduation category: %w", err)
179		}
180		if err := s.validateGraduatePaths(plan); err != nil {
181			return result, err
182		}
183		sameDevice, err := s.sameFilesystem(plan.Source, plan.Destination)
184		if err != nil {
185			return result, fmt.Errorf("compare graduation filesystems: %w", err)
186		}
187		if !sameDevice {
188			return result, fmt.Errorf("move %s to %s: %w", plan.Source, plan.Destination, ErrCrossFilesystem)
189		}
190		if err := s.validateGraduatePaths(plan); err != nil {
191			return result, err
192		}
193		if err := s.validateCatalogSource(plan.Item.ID, plan.Source); err != nil {
194			return result, err
195		}
196		if err := s.rename(plan.Source, plan.Destination); err != nil {
197			if errors.Is(err, syscall.EXDEV) {
198				return result, fmt.Errorf("move %s to %s: %w", plan.Source, plan.Destination, ErrCrossFilesystem)
199			}
200			return result, fmt.Errorf("move %s to %s: %w", plan.Source, plan.Destination, err)
201		}
202		result.Moved = true
203	
204		probe := s.probeDirectory(ctx, plan.Destination)
205		if !probe.valid || probe.live.Repo == nil || probe.live.DiscoverError != nil {
206			cause := probe.live.DiscoverError
207			if cause == nil && probe.diagnostic != nil {
208				cause = probe.diagnostic.Err
209			}
210			if cause == nil {
211				cause = errors.New("moved project is not a discoverable Git repository")
212			}
213			return s.rollbackGraduation(result, cause)
214		}
215	
216		now := s.now()
217		updated, updateErr := s.catalogUpdate(plan.Item.ID, func(entry *catalog.Entry) error {
218			if entry.Kind != catalog.KindTry || entry.Experiment == nil || entry.Experiment.Phase == catalog.PhaseGraduated {
219				return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s is no longer an active Try", entry.ID)
220			}
221			location, ok := entry.LocationFor(s.host)
222			if !ok || location.State != catalog.LocationPresent || !storedLocationMatches(location, plan.Source) {
223				return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s moved or was reassigned after graduation planning", entry.ID)
224			}
225			entry.Kind = catalog.KindRepository
226			entry.Name = plan.Name
227			entry.Experiment.Phase = catalog.PhaseGraduated
228			entry.Experiment.GraduatedAt = now
229			entry.Experiment.GraduatedPath = probe.live.CurrentPath
230			if probe.originURL != "" {
231				entry.Experiment.OriginURL = probe.originURL
232				entry.RemoteIdentity = remoteIdentityFromOrigin(probe.originURL)
233			}
234			previous, _ := entry.LocationFor(s.host)
235			return entry.SetLocation(s.host, locationFromProbe(probe, previous))
236		})
237		if updateErr != nil {
238			return s.rollbackGraduation(result, updateErr)
239		}
240		if updated == nil {
241			return s.rollbackGraduation(result, errors.New("catalog update returned no graduated entry"))
242		}
243	
244		item := itemFromEntry(updated, probe.live)
245		enriched := s.enrich(ctx, []Item{item})
246		if len(enriched) == 1 {
247			item = enriched[0]
248		}
249		result.Item = item
250		return result, nil
251	}
252	
253	func (s *Service) validateCatalogSource(id, source string) error {
254		entry, err := s.registry.Get(id)
255		if err != nil {
256			return fmt.Errorf("reload catalog source %s: %w", id, err)
257		}
258		if entry.Kind != catalog.KindTry || entry.Experiment == nil || entry.Experiment.Phase == catalog.PhaseGraduated {
259			return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s is no longer an active Try", id)
260		}
261		location, ok := entry.LocationFor(s.host)
262		if !ok || location.State != catalog.LocationPresent || !storedLocationMatches(location, source) {
263			return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s moved or was reassigned after graduation planning", id)
264		}
265		return nil
266	}
267	
268	func (s *Service) validateGraduatePaths(plan GraduatePlan) error {
269		source, err := pathx.CanonicalChild(s.triesRoot, plan.Source)
270		if err != nil {
271			return fmt.Errorf("revalidate graduation source: %w", err)
272		}
273		if source != plan.Source {
274			return fmt.Errorf("graduation source changed after planning: %s became %s", plan.Source, source)
275		}
276		components := []string{plan.Name}
277		if plan.Category != "" {
278			components = []string{plan.Category, plan.Name}
279		}
280		destination, err := s.availableGraduationDestination(components)
281		if err != nil {
282			return fmt.Errorf("revalidate graduation destination: %w", err)
283		}
284		if destination != plan.Destination {
285			return fmt.Errorf("graduation destination changed after planning: %s became %s", plan.Destination, destination)
286		}
287		if nested, nestedErr := pathx.IsChild(source, destination); nestedErr != nil {
288			return fmt.Errorf("revalidate graduation destination: %w", nestedErr)
289		} else if nested {
290			return fmt.Errorf("graduation destination %s is inside its source %s", destination, source)
291		}
292		return nil
293	}
294	
295	func (s *Service) availableGraduationDestination(components []string) (string, error) {
296		intended := filepath.Join(append([]string{s.projectRoot}, components...)...)
297		if err := rejectExisting(intended); err != nil {
298			return "", err
299		}
300		destination, err := pathx.JoinChild(s.projectRoot, components...)
301		if err != nil {
302			return "", err
303		}
304		if err := rejectExisting(destination); err != nil {
305			return "", err
306		}
307		return destination, nil
308	}
309	
310	func storedLocationMatches(location catalog.Location, source string) bool {
311		return filepath.Clean(location.CurrentPath) == source || filepath.Clean(location.RealPath) == source
312	}
313	
314	func (s *Service) resolveGraduateItem(ctx context.Context, request GraduateRequest) (Item, []Diagnostic, error) {
315		if strings.TrimSpace(request.Ref) != "" {
316			return s.Resolve(ctx, request.Ref)
317		}
318		current := request.CurrentDir
319		if current == "" {
320			var err error
321			current, err = s.getwd()
322			if err != nil {
323				return Item{}, nil, fmt.Errorf("get current directory: %w", err)
324			}
325		}
326		canonicalCurrent, err := pathx.CanonicalChild(s.triesRoot, current)
327		if err != nil {
328			return Item{}, nil, fmt.Errorf("%s is not inside %s — name the try to graduate", current, s.triesRoot)
329		}
330		canonicalRoot, err := pathx.Canonical(s.triesRoot)
331		if err != nil {
332			return Item{}, nil, err
333		}
334		relative, err := filepath.Rel(canonicalRoot, canonicalCurrent)
335		if err != nil {
336			return Item{}, nil, err
337		}
338		first, _, _ := strings.Cut(relative, string(filepath.Separator))
339		if first == "" || first == "." || strings.HasPrefix(first, ".") {
340			return Item{}, nil, fmt.Errorf("%s is not inside a visible try under %s", current, s.triesRoot)
341		}
342		return s.Resolve(ctx, filepath.Join(s.triesRoot, first))
343	}

345	func (s *Service) hasCommit(ctx context.Context, directory string) bool {
346		if unix, _, err := s.gitLastCommit(ctx, directory); err == nil && unix > 0 {
347			return true
348		}
349		_, err := s.gitRun(ctx, directory, "rev-parse", "--verify", "HEAD")
350		return err == nil
351	}
352	
353	func (s *Service) ensureInitialCommit(ctx context.Context, directory, name string) (bool, error) {
354		if s.hasCommit(ctx, directory) {
355			return false, nil
356		}
357		empty, err := isEmptyWorkTree(directory)
358		if err != nil {
359			return false, err
360		}
361		if empty {
362			readme := filepath.Join(directory, "README.md")
363			file, err := os.OpenFile(readme, os.O_WRONLY|os.O_CREATE|os.O_EXCL, 0o644)
364			if err != nil {
365				return false, err
366			}
367			if _, err := fmt.Fprintf(file, "# %s\n", name); err != nil {
368				_ = file.Close()
369				return false, err
370			}
371			if err := file.Close(); err != nil {
372				return false, err
373			}
374		}
375		if _, err := s.gitRun(ctx, directory, "add", "--all"); err != nil {
376			return false, err
377		}
378		tracked, err := s.gitRun(ctx, directory, "ls-files", "--cached")
379		if err != nil {
380			return false, err
381		}
382		commitArgs := []string{"commit"}
383		if tracked == "" {
384			// A Try containing only globally ignored files still needs a HEAD, but dev
385			// must not force-add or overwrite those user files merely to manufacture it.
386			commitArgs = append(commitArgs, "--allow-empty")
387		}
388		commitArgs = append(commitArgs, "-m", "chore: graduate experiment into a project")
389		if _, err := s.gitRun(ctx, directory, commitArgs...); err != nil {
390			return false, err
391		}
392		return true, nil
393	}
394	
395	func (s *Service) rollbackGraduation(result GraduateResult, cause error) (GraduateResult, error) {
396		rollbackErr := rejectExisting(result.Plan.Source)
397		if rollbackErr == nil {
398			rollbackErr = s.rename(result.Plan.Destination, result.Plan.Source)
399		}
400		result.RollbackError = rollbackErr
401		result.RolledBack = rollbackErr == nil
402		if rollbackErr == nil {
403			result.Moved = false
404		}
405		return result, &FinalizeError{
406			Source: result.Plan.Source, Destination: result.Plan.Destination,
407			Cause: cause, RollbackErr: rollbackErr,
408		}
409	}
410	
411	func rejectExisting(path string) error {
412		if _, err := os.Lstat(path); err == nil {
413			return fmt.Errorf("%s already exists", path)
414		} else if !errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
415			return fmt.Errorf("inspect graduation destination %s: %w", path, err)
416		}
417		return nil
418	}
419	
420	func isEmptyWorkTree(directory string) (bool, error) {
421		entries, err := os.ReadDir(directory)
422		if err != nil {
423			return false, err
424		}
425		for _, entry := range entries {
426			if entry.Name() != ".git" {
427				return false, nil
428			}
429		}
430		return true, nil
431	}
432	
433	func nearestExisting(path string) (string, error) {
434		path = filepath.Clean(path)
435		for {
436			if _, err := os.Stat(path); err == nil {
437				return path, nil
438			} else if !errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
439				return "", err
440			}
441			parent := filepath.Dir(path)
442			if parent == path {
443				return "", fmt.Errorf("no existing ancestor for %s", path)
444			}
445			path = parent
446		}
447	}

1	//go:build unix

5	import (
6		"context"

8		"os"

10	
11		"golang.org/x/sys/unix"
12	)
13	
14	type catalogFileLock struct {
15		file *os.File
16	}
17	
18	func acquireCatalogFileLock(ctx context.Context, path string) (*catalogFileLock, error) {
19		if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
20			return nil, err
21		}
22		file, err := os.OpenFile(path, os.O_CREATE|os.O_RDWR, 0o600)
23		if err != nil {
24			return nil, err
25		}
26		lock := &catalogFileLock{file: file}
27		ticker := time.NewTicker(10 * time.Millisecond)
28		defer ticker.Stop()
29		for {
30			if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
31				_ = file.Close()
32				return nil, err
33			}
34			err = unix.Flock(int(file.Fd()), unix.LOCK_EX|unix.LOCK_NB)
35			if err == nil {
36				return lock, nil
37			}
38			if !errors.Is(err, unix.EWOULDBLOCK) && !errors.Is(err, unix.EAGAIN) && !errors.Is(err, unix.EINTR) {
39				_ = file.Close()
40				return nil, err
41			}
42			select {
43			case <-ctx.Done():
44				_ = file.Close()
45				return nil, ctx.Err()
46			case <-ticker.C:
47			}
48		}
49	}
50	
51	func (l *catalogFileLock) Close() error {
52		unlockErr := unix.Flock(int(l.file.Fd()), unix.LOCK_UN)
53		return errors.Join(unlockErr, l.file.Close())
54	}

10	
11		"golang.org/x/sys/windows"
12	)
13	
14	type catalogFileLock struct {
15		file       *os.File
16		overlapped windows.Overlapped
17	}
18	
19	func acquireCatalogFileLock(ctx context.Context, path string) (*catalogFileLock, error) {
20		if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
21			return nil, err
22		}
23		file, err := os.OpenFile(path, os.O_CREATE|os.O_RDWR, 0o600)
24		if err != nil {
25			return nil, err
26		}
27		lock := &catalogFileLock{file: file}
28		ticker := time.NewTicker(10 * time.Millisecond)
29		defer ticker.Stop()
30		for {
31			if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
32				_ = file.Close()
33				return nil, err
34			}
35			err = windows.LockFileEx(windows.Handle(file.Fd()),
36				windows.LOCKFILE_EXCLUSIVE_LOCK|windows.LOCKFILE_FAIL_IMMEDIATELY,
37				0, 1, 0, &lock.overlapped)
38			if err == nil {
39				return lock, nil
40			}
41			if !errors.Is(err, windows.ERROR_LOCK_VIOLATION) && !errors.Is(err, windows.ERROR_IO_PENDING) {
42				_ = file.Close()
43				return nil, err
44			}
45			select {
46			case <-ctx.Done():
47				_ = file.Close()
48				return nil, ctx.Err()
49			case <-ticker.C:
50			}
51		}
52	}
53	
54	func (l *catalogFileLock) Close() error {
55		unlockErr := windows.UnlockFileEx(windows.Handle(l.file.Fd()), 0, 1, 0, &l.overlapped)
56		return errors.Join(unlockErr, l.file.Close())
57	}

+	}
+	if len(entries) != 2 {
+		t.Fatalf("clone entries = %d, want 2", len(entries))
+	}
+	var names []string
+	for _, entry := range entries {
+		names = append(names, entry.Name())
+	}
+	if !strings.HasSuffix(names[0], "-demo") || !strings.HasSuffix(names[1], "-demo-2") {
+		t.Errorf("clone collision names = %v", names)
+	}
+}
+
+func TestGraduateRemoteRefreshesCatalogOrigin(t *testing.T) {
+	h := newHarness(t)
+	h.mustRun("try", "remote-origin", "--no-git")
+
+	binDir := t.TempDir()
+	gh := filepath.Join(binDir, "gh")
+	script := `#!/bin/sh
+set -eu
+if [ "$1" != "repo" ] || [ "$2" != "create" ]; then
+  exit 2
+fi
+git remote add origin "git@github.com:owner/$3.git"
+printf 'https://github.com/owner/%s\n' "$3"
+`
+	if err := os.WriteFile(gh, []byte(script), 0o755); err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	t.Setenv("PATH", binDir+string(os.PathListSeparator)+os.Getenv("PATH"))
+	out := h.mustRun("graduate", "remote-origin", "--remote", "--push=false")
+	if !strings.Contains(out, "https://github.com/owner/remote-origin") {
+		t.Fatalf("graduate remote output: %q", out)
+	}
+
+	assets, err := filepath.Glob(filepath.Join(h.home, "state", "assets", "*.toml"))
+	if err != nil || len(assets) != 1 {
+		t.Fatalf("catalog assets = %d, %v", len(assets), err)
+	}
+	body, err := os.ReadFile(assets[0])
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	if !strings.Contains(string(body), "git@github.com:owner/remote-origin.git") ||
+		!strings.Contains(string(body), "github.com/owner/remote-origin") {
+		t.Errorf("graduated catalog did not retain remote origin:\n%s", body)
+	}
+}
+
+func TestGraduateRefreshesOriginAfterPartialRemoteFailure(t *testing.T) {
+	h := newHarness(t)
+	h.mustRun("try", "partial-remote", "--no-git")
+
+	binDir := t.TempDir()
+	gh := filepath.Join(binDir, "gh")
+	script := `#!/bin/sh
+set -eu
+if [ "$1" != "repo" ] || [ "$2" != "create" ]; then
+  exit 2
+fi
+git remote add origin "git@github.com:owner/$3.git"
+printf 'push failed\n' >&2
+exit 1
+`
+	if err := os.WriteFile(gh, []byte(script), 0o755); err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	t.Setenv("PATH", binDir+string(os.PathListSeparator)+os.Getenv("PATH"))
+	_, errOut, err := h.run("graduate", "partial-remote", "--remote")
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatalf("partial remote failure should remain nonfatal: %v\n%s", err, errOut)
+	}
+	if !strings.Contains(errOut, "could not create the remote") {
+		t.Errorf("partial remote warning = %q", errOut)
+	}
+
+	assets, err := filepath.Glob(filepath.Join(h.home, "state", "assets", "*.toml"))
+	if err != nil || len(assets) != 1 {
+		t.Fatalf("catalog assets = %d, %v", len(assets), err)
+	}
+	body, err := os.ReadFile(assets[0])
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	if !strings.Contains(string(body), "git@github.com:owner/partial-remote.git") ||
+		!strings.Contains(string(body), "github.com/owner/partial-remote") {
+		t.Errorf("partial remote origin was not retained:\n%s", body)
+	}
+}

102	// WithLock runs operation while holding the catalog's cross-process advisory
103	// lock. It is intended for short read-match-write transactions; expensive
104	// discovery belongs before the lock. The operating system releases the lock if
105	// the process exits unexpectedly.
106	func (s *Store) WithLock(ctx context.Context, operation func() error) (err error) {
107		if s == nil {
108			return errors.New("lock nil catalog store")
109		}
110		if operation == nil {
111			return errors.New("catalog lock requires an operation")
112		}
113		if ctx == nil {
114			ctx = context.Background()
115		}
116		if err := os.MkdirAll(s.Dir, 0o755); err != nil {
117			return fmt.Errorf("create catalog directory for lock: %w", err)
118		}
119		absoluteDir, err := filepath.Abs(s.Dir)
120		if err != nil {
121			return fmt.Errorf("make catalog directory absolute for lock: %w", err)
122		}
123		canonicalDir, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(absoluteDir)
124		if err != nil {
125			return fmt.Errorf("canonicalize catalog directory for lock: %w", err)
126		}
127		lockPath := filepath.Join(filepath.Dir(canonicalDir), "."+filepath.Base(canonicalDir)+".lock")
128		lock, err := acquireCatalogFileLock(ctx, lockPath)
129		if err != nil {
130			return fmt.Errorf("acquire catalog lock: %w", err)
131		}
132		defer func() {
133			if releaseErr := lock.Close(); releaseErr != nil {
134				err = errors.Join(err, fmt.Errorf("release catalog lock: %w", releaseErr))
135			}
136		}()
137		return operation()
138	}

201	func (s *Store) get(id string) (*Entry, error) {
202		data, err := os.ReadFile(s.path(id))
203		if err != nil {
204			if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
205				return nil, fmt.Errorf("%q: %w", id, ErrNotFound)
206			}

208		}
209		var header struct {
210			SchemaVersion int `toml:"schema_version"`
211		}
212		if _, err := toml.Decode(string(data), &header); err != nil {
213			return nil, fmt.Errorf("decode catalog asset %s schema: %w", id, err)
214		}
215		if header.SchemaVersion != 0 && header.SchemaVersion != CurrentSchemaVersion {
216			return nil, &UnsupportedSchemaError{ID: id, Version: header.SchemaVersion}
217		}
218	
219		var entry Entry
220		metadata, err := toml.Decode(string(data), &entry)
221		if err != nil {
222			return nil, fmt.Errorf("decode catalog asset %s: %w", id, err)
223		}
224		if undecoded := metadata.Undecoded(); len(undecoded) > 0 {
225			return nil, fmt.Errorf("decode catalog asset %s: unknown field(s): %v", id, undecoded)
226		}
227		entry.ID = id
228		// Version zero is the only implicit form: it means the schema marker was
229		// absent, not that an unknown future layout should be guessed.
230		if entry.SchemaVersion == 0 {
231			entry.SchemaVersion = CurrentSchemaVersion
232		}
233		entry.Normalize()
234		if err := entry.Validate(); err != nil {
235			return nil, fmt.Errorf("validate catalog asset %s: %w", id, err)
236		}
237		return &entry, nil
238	}

261	// ListWithDiagnostics is List's explicit diagnostic form. It is useful to
262	// services that want to aggregate notices rather than render them immediately.
263	func (s *Store) ListWithDiagnostics() ([]*Entry, []Diagnostic, error) {
264		directoryEntries, err := os.ReadDir(s.Dir)
265		if err != nil {
266			if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
267				return nil, nil, nil
268			}
269			return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("read catalog directory: %w", err)
270		}
271	
272		var entries []*Entry
273		var diagnostics []Diagnostic
274		for _, directoryEntry := range directoryEntries {
275			name := directoryEntry.Name()
276			if directoryEntry.IsDir() || strings.HasPrefix(name, ".") || !strings.HasSuffix(name, ".toml") {
277				continue
278			}
279			id := strings.TrimSuffix(name, ".toml")
280			entry, err := s.Get(id)
281			if err != nil {
282				diagnostics = append(diagnostics, Diagnostic{Path: filepath.Join(s.Dir, name), Err: err})
283				continue
284			}
285			entries = append(entries, entry)
286		}
287		Sort(entries)
288		sort.Slice(diagnostics, func(i, j int) bool { return diagnostics[i].Path < diagnostics[j].Path })
289		return entries, diagnostics, nil
290	}

292	// Update applies mutate to a deep copy and atomically replaces the record only
293	// if the mutation and validation both succeed. ID, Created, and Discovered are
294	// immutable.
295	func (s *Store) Update(id string, mutate func(*Entry) error) (*Entry, error) {
296		if err := ValidateID(id); err != nil {
297			return nil, err
298		}
299		if mutate == nil {
300			return nil, errors.New("catalog update requires a mutation")
301		}
302	
303		s.mu.Lock()
304		defer s.mu.Unlock()
305	
306		current, err := s.get(id)
307		if err != nil {
308			return nil, err
309		}
310		updated := current.Clone()
311		if err := mutate(updated); err != nil {
312			return nil, err
313		}
314		if updated.ID != current.ID {
315			return nil, errors.New("catalog update cannot change ID")
316		}
317		if updated.SchemaVersion != current.SchemaVersion {
318			return nil, errors.New("catalog update cannot change schema version")
319		}
320		if !updated.Created.Equal(current.Created) {
321			return nil, errors.New("catalog update cannot change Created")
322		}
323		if !updated.Discovered.Equal(current.Discovered) {
324			return nil, errors.New("catalog update cannot change Discovered")
325		}
326	
327		now := s.now()
328		updated.Updated = now
329		prepareUpdatedNested(current, updated, now)
330		stampChangedLocations(current, updated, now)
331		updated.Normalize()
332		if err := updated.Validate(); err != nil {
333			return nil, err
334		}
335		if err := s.writeAtomic(updated); err != nil {
336			return nil, err
337		}
338		return updated.Clone(), nil
339	}

370	}

520		if err := os.Chtimes(plain, mtime, mtime); err != nil {
521			t.Fatal(err)
522		}

524		if err != nil {
525			t.Fatal(err)
526		}

529			t.Fatalf("activity before Touch = %s", item.Activity())
530		}
531		touched, err := f.service.Touch(context.Background(), item.ID)
532		if err != nil {
533			t.Fatal(err)

536			t.Errorf("Touch result = %+v", touched)

539		gitPath := f.mkdir("with-history")
540		initRepo(t, gitPath, true)
541		items, _, err = f.service.List(context.Background(), experiment.ListOptions{})
542		if err != nil {

547			t.Fatalf("Git activity missing: %+v", gitItem.Live)
548		}
549		earlierOpen := gitItem.Live.LastCommit.Add(-time.Hour)
550		if _, err := f.registry.Update(gitItem.ID, func(entry *catalog.Entry) error {
551			entry.LastOpened = earlierOpen
552			return nil
553		}); err != nil {
554			t.Fatal(err)
555		}
556		items, _, err = f.service.List(context.Background(), experiment.ListOptions{})
557		if err != nil {
558			t.Fatal(err)
559		}
560		gitItem = itemByBase(t, items, "with-history")
561		if !gitItem.Activity().Equal(gitItem.Live.LastCommit) {
562			t.Errorf("Activity = %s, want newer Git commit %s", gitItem.Activity(), gitItem.Live.LastCommit)
563		}
564		*f.now = gitItem.Live.LastCommit.Add(time.Hour)
565		touchedGit, err := f.service.Touch(context.Background(), gitItem.ID)
566		if err != nil {
567			t.Fatal(err)
568		}
569		if !touchedGit.Item.Activity().Equal(*f.now) {
570			t.Errorf("Activity = %s, want newer explicit open %s", touchedGit.Item.Activity(), *f.now)
571		}
572	}

13	func sameFilesystem(source, destination string) (bool, error) {
14		sourceAncestor, err := nearestExisting(source)
15		if err != nil {
16			return false, err
17		}

19		if err != nil {

26		destinationVolume, err := windowsVolumePath(destinationAncestor)
27		if err != nil {

29		}
30		return sameWindowsVolumePath(sourceVolume, destinationVolume), nil
31	}
32	
33	func windowsVolumePath(path string) (string, error) {
34		pathPointer, err := windows.UTF16PtrFromString(path)
35		if err != nil {
36			return "", err
37		}
38		buffer := make([]uint16, windows.MAX_PATH+1)
39		if err := windows.GetVolumePathName(pathPointer, &buffer[0], uint32(len(buffer))); err != nil {
40			return "", err
41		}
42		return windows.UTF16ToString(buffer), nil
43	}
44	
45	func sameWindowsVolumePath(left, right string) bool {
46		return strings.EqualFold(filepath.Clean(left), filepath.Clean(right))
47	}

23		// nonzero schema. Callers must surface it instead of interpreting newer data

30	// UnsupportedSchemaError describes a record whose schema this version cannot
31	// read. It supports errors.Is(err, ErrUnsupportedSchema).

37	func (e *UnsupportedSchemaError) Error() string {
38		if e.ID == "" {
39			return fmt.Sprintf("catalog schema version %d: %v", e.Version, ErrUnsupportedSchema)
40		}
41		return fmt.Sprintf("catalog asset %s has schema version %d: %v", e.ID, e.Version, ErrUnsupportedSchema)

169	var validID = regexp.MustCompile(`^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]*$`)
170	
171	// ValidateID checks that id can be used as exactly one visible filename stem.
172	func ValidateID(id string) error {
173		if !validID.MatchString(id) || filepath.Base(id) != id || id == "." || id == ".." {
174			return fmt.Errorf("%q: %w", id, ErrInvalidID)
175		}
176		return nil
177	}
178	
179	// NormalizeTags trims, lowercases, deduplicates and sorts tags. Sorting makes
180	// persisted output deterministic regardless of the order in which callers add
181	// labels.
182	func NormalizeTags(tags []string) []string {
183		seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(tags))
184		for _, tag := range tags {
185			tag = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(tag))
186			if tag != "" {
187				seen[tag] = struct{}{}
188			}
189		}
190		out := make([]string, 0, len(seen))
191		for tag := range seen {
192			out = append(out, tag)
193		}
194		sort.Strings(out)
195		return out
196	}
197	
198	// Normalize applies the lossless normalizations stores use before validation.
199	func (e *Entry) Normalize() {
200		if e == nil {
201			return
202		}
203		e.Name = strings.TrimSpace(e.Name)
204		e.Tags = NormalizeTags(e.Tags)
205		e.RemoteIdentity = NormalizeRemoteIdentity(e.RemoteIdentity)
206		if e.RecoveryReceipt != nil {
207			e.RecoveryReceipt.RemoteIdentity = NormalizeRemoteIdentity(e.RecoveryReceipt.RemoteIdentity)
208		}
209	}
210	
211	// Title is the human label, falling back to the stable ID for damaged display
212	// data. Persisted entries still require a name during validation.
213	func (e Entry) Title() string {
214		if e.Name != "" {
215			return e.Name
216		}
217		return e.ID
218	}
219	
220	// HasTag reports membership after applying the same normalization as storage.
221	func (e Entry) HasTag(tag string) bool {
222		tag = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(tag))
223		return tag != "" && slices.Contains(e.Tags, tag)
224	}

226	// LocationFor returns host's location without exposing the map for mutation.
227	func (e Entry) LocationFor(host string) (Location, bool) {
228		location, ok := e.Locations[host]
229		return location, ok
230	}

232	// SetLocation validates and records one host location.
233	func (e *Entry) SetLocation(host string, location Location) error {
234		if e == nil {
235			return errors.New("set location on nil catalog entry")
236		}
237		if err := validateLocationForSet(host, location); err != nil {
238			return err
239		}
240		if e.Locations == nil {
241			e.Locations = make(map[string]Location)
242		}
243		e.Locations[host] = location
244		return nil
245	}
246	
247	// Clone returns a deep copy suitable for mutation before an atomic update.
248	func (e Entry) Clone() *Entry {
249		clone := e
250		clone.Tags = append([]string(nil), e.Tags...)
251		if e.Experiment != nil {
252			value := *e.Experiment
253			clone.Experiment = &value
254		}
255		if e.RecoveryReceipt != nil {
256			value := *e.RecoveryReceipt
257			clone.RecoveryReceipt = &value
258		}
259		if e.MoveIntent != nil {
260			value := *e.MoveIntent
261			clone.MoveIntent = &value
262		}
263		if e.Locations != nil {
264			clone.Locations = make(map[string]Location, len(e.Locations))
265			for host, location := range e.Locations {
266				clone.Locations[host] = location
267			}
268		}
269		return &clone
270	}

272	// Validate rejects records that later lifecycle operations could not interpret
273	// safely. Store.Create fills identity and timestamps before calling it.
274	func (e Entry) Validate() error {
275		if e.SchemaVersion != CurrentSchemaVersion {
276			return &UnsupportedSchemaError{ID: e.ID, Version: e.SchemaVersion}
277		}
278		if err := ValidateID(e.ID); err != nil {
279			return err
280		}
281		switch e.Kind {
282		case KindTry:
283			if e.Experiment == nil {
284				return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s: try kind requires experiment metadata", e.ID)
285			}
286		case KindRepository:
287		default:
288			return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s: unknown kind %q", e.ID, e.Kind)
289		}
290		if strings.TrimSpace(e.Name) == "" {
291			return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s: name is required", e.ID)
292		}
293		if !slices.Equal(e.Tags, NormalizeTags(e.Tags)) {
294			return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s: tags must be normalized lowercase values", e.ID)
295		}
296		if e.Experiment != nil {
297			switch e.Experiment.Phase {
298			case PhaseActive, PhaseDeprecated, PhaseGraduated:
299			default:
300				return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s: unknown experiment phase %q", e.ID, e.Experiment.Phase)
301			}
302			switch {
303			case e.Kind == KindTry && e.Experiment.Phase == PhaseGraduated:
304				return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s: graduated experiment must be a repository", e.ID)
305			case e.Kind == KindRepository && e.Experiment.Phase != PhaseGraduated:
306				return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s: repository experiment history must be graduated", e.ID)
307			}
308			if e.Experiment.Started.IsZero() {
309				return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s: experiment started timestamp is required", e.ID)
310			}
311			if e.Experiment.Slug == "" {
312				return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s: experiment slug is required", e.ID)
313			}
314			if err := pathx.ValidateComponent(e.Experiment.Slug); err != nil {
315				return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s: experiment slug: %w", e.ID, err)
316			}
317			if e.Experiment.OriginalPath == "" {
318				return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s: experiment original path is required", e.ID)
319			}
320			switch e.Experiment.Phase {
321			case PhaseDeprecated:
322				if e.Experiment.DeprecatedAt.IsZero() || e.Experiment.DeprecatedPath == "" {
323					return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s: deprecated experiment requires timestamp and path", e.ID)
324				}
325			case PhaseGraduated:
326				if e.Experiment.GraduatedAt.IsZero() || e.Experiment.GraduatedPath == "" {
327					return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s: graduated experiment requires timestamp and path", e.ID)
328				}
329			}
330			if err := validateStringFields("experiment", []struct {
331				name  string
332				value string
333			}{
334				{"slug", e.Experiment.Slug},
335				{"origin_url", e.Experiment.OriginURL},
336				{"original_path", e.Experiment.OriginalPath},
337				{"deprecated_path", e.Experiment.DeprecatedPath},
338				{"graduated_path", e.Experiment.GraduatedPath},
339			}); err != nil {
340				return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s: %w", e.ID, err)
341			}
342		}
343		hosts := make([]string, 0, len(e.Locations))
344		for host := range e.Locations {
345			hosts = append(hosts, host)
346		}
347		sort.Strings(hosts)
348		for _, host := range hosts {
349			if err := validateLocation(host, e.Locations[host]); err != nil {
350				return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s: %w", e.ID, err)
351			}
352		}
353		if e.RecoveryReceipt != nil {
354			if err := validateRecoveryReceipt(*e.RecoveryReceipt); err != nil {
355				return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s: %w", e.ID, err)
356			}
357		}
358		if e.MoveIntent != nil {
359			if err := validateMoveIntent(*e.MoveIntent); err != nil {
360				return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s: %w", e.ID, err)
361			}
362		}
363		if e.Created.IsZero() || e.Discovered.IsZero() || e.Updated.IsZero() {
364			return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s: created, discovered and updated timestamps are required", e.ID)
365		}
366		return nil
367	}
368	
369	func validateLocation(host string, location Location) error {
370		return validateLocationValue(host, location, true)
371	}
372	
373	func validateLocationForSet(host string, location Location) error {
374		return validateLocationValue(host, location, false)
375	}
376	
377	func validateLocationValue(host string, location Location, requireUpdated bool) error {
378		if err := validateHostValue("location host", host); err != nil {
379			return err
380		}
381		fields := []struct {
382			name  string
383			value string
384		}{
385			{"current_path", location.CurrentPath},
386			{"restore_path", location.RestorePath},
387			{"real_path", location.RealPath},
388			{"git_common_dir", location.GitCommonDir},
389		}
390		for _, field := range fields {
391			if strings.ContainsRune(field.value, '\x00') {
392				return fmt.Errorf("location %s %s contains NUL", host, field.name)
393			}
394		}
395		if requireUpdated && location.Updated.IsZero() {
396			return fmt.Errorf("location %s: updated timestamp is required", host)
397		}
398		switch location.State {
399		case LocationPresent:
400			if location.CurrentPath == "" {
401				return fmt.Errorf("location %s: present state requires current_path", host)
402			}
403		case LocationArchived:
404			if location.CurrentPath == "" || location.RestorePath == "" {
405				return fmt.Errorf("location %s: archived state requires current_path and restore_path", host)
406			}
407		case LocationEvicted:
408			if location.RestorePath == "" {
409				return fmt.Errorf("location %s: evicted state requires restore_path", host)
410			}
411		default:
412			return fmt.Errorf("location %s: unknown state %q", host, location.State)
413		}
414		return nil
415	}
416	
417	func validateRecoveryReceipt(receipt RecoveryReceipt) error {
418		if err := validateHostValue("recovery receipt host", receipt.Host); err != nil {
419			return err
420		}
421		if receipt.Method == "" || receipt.Method != strings.TrimSpace(receipt.Method) {
422			return errors.New("recovery receipt method is required and must be normalized")
423		}
424		if receipt.Created.IsZero() || receipt.Verified.IsZero() {
425			return errors.New("recovery receipt requires created and verified timestamps")
426		}
427		fields := []struct {
428			name  string
429			value string
430		}{
431			{"method", receipt.Method},
432			{"source_path", receipt.SourcePath},
433			{"restore_path", receipt.RestorePath},
434			{"remote_identity", receipt.RemoteIdentity},
435			{"remote_name", receipt.RemoteName},
436			{"remote_url", receipt.RemoteURL},
437			{"revision", receipt.Revision},
438			{"refs_digest", receipt.RefsDigest},
439			{"archive_path", receipt.ArchivePath},
440			{"checksum", receipt.Checksum},
441		}
442		return validateStringFields("recovery receipt", fields)
443	}
444	
445	func validateMoveIntent(intent MoveIntent) error {
446		if err := validateHostValue("move intent host", intent.Host); err != nil {
447			return err
448		}
449		if intent.Operation == "" || intent.Operation != strings.TrimSpace(intent.Operation) {
450			return errors.New("move intent operation is required and must be normalized")
451		}
452		if intent.Started.IsZero() {
453			return errors.New("move intent started timestamp is required")
454		}
455		if intent.SourcePath == "" || intent.DestinationPath == "" {
456			return errors.New("move intent requires source and destination paths")
457		}
458		if err := validateStringFields("move intent", []struct {
459			name  string
460			value string
461		}{
462			{"operation", intent.Operation},
463			{"source_path", intent.SourcePath},
464			{"destination_path", intent.DestinationPath},
465		}); err != nil {
466			return err
467		}
468		if filepath.Clean(intent.SourcePath) == filepath.Clean(intent.DestinationPath) {
469			return errors.New("move intent source and destination are identical")
470		}
471		return nil
472	}
473	
474	func validateHostValue(name, host string) error {
475		if host == "" {
476			return fmt.Errorf("%s is required", name)
477		}
478		if host != strings.TrimSpace(host) || strings.ContainsRune(host, '\x00') {
479			return fmt.Errorf("%s %q is not normalized", name, host)
480		}
481		return nil
482	}
483	
484	func validateStringFields(scope string, fields []struct {
485		name  string
486		value string
487	}) error {
488		for _, field := range fields {
489			if strings.ContainsRune(field.value, '\x00') {
490				return fmt.Errorf("%s %s contains NUL", scope, field.name)
491			}
492		}
493		return nil
494	}

27	// Diagnostic describes one record skipped by a directory listing. The listing
28	// still returns every valid record; callers decide whether and where to render
29	// these notices.
30	type Diagnostic struct {
31		Path string
32		Err  error
33	}
34	
35	func (d Diagnostic) Error() string {
36		return fmt.Sprintf("skipping %s: %v", filepath.Base(d.Path), d.Err)
37	}
38	
39	func (d Diagnostic) Unwrap() error { return d.Err }

41	// IDGenerator supplies stable random filename stems. It is injectable so tests
42	// can assert exact filenames without weakening production randomness.
43	type IDGenerator func() string
44	
45	// DiagnosticSink receives non-fatal per-record listing failures.
46	type DiagnosticSink func(Diagnostic)
47	
48	// StoreOption configures a Store.
49	type StoreOption func(*Store)
50	
51	// WithIDGenerator replaces UUID generation.
52	func WithIDGenerator(generator IDGenerator) StoreOption {
53		return func(store *Store) { store.generateID = generator }
54	}
55	
56	// WithClock replaces timestamp generation.
57	func WithClock(clock func() time.Time) StoreOption {
58		return func(store *Store) { store.clock = clock }
59	}

61	// WithDiagnosticSink directs skipped-record notices to sink.
62	func WithDiagnosticSink(sink DiagnosticSink) StoreOption {
63		return func(store *Store) { store.diagnostics = sink }
64	}
65	
66	// WithDiagnosticWriter writes one line per skipped record to writer. It never
67	// defaults to a process-global stream.
68	func WithDiagnosticWriter(writer io.Writer) StoreOption {
69		if writer == nil {
70			return func(*Store) {}
71		}
72		return WithDiagnosticSink(func(diagnostic Diagnostic) {
73			fmt.Fprintln(writer, diagnostic.Error())
74		})

77	// Store is a directory of one TOML file per asset.
78	type Store struct {
79		Dir string
80	
81		mu          sync.Mutex
82		generateID  IDGenerator
83		clock       func() time.Time
84		diagnostics DiagnosticSink
85	}

87	// NewStore returns a catalog rooted at dir.
88	func NewStore(dir string, options ...StoreOption) *Store {
89		store := &Store{
90			Dir:        dir,
91			generateID: uuid.NewString,
92			clock:      time.Now,
93		}
94		for _, option := range options {
95			if option != nil {
96				option(store)
97			}
98		}
99		return store
100	}

102	// WithLock runs operation while holding the catalog's cross-process advisory
103	// lock. It is intended for short read-match-write transactions; expensive
104	// discovery belongs before the lock. The operating system releases the lock if
105	// the process exits unexpectedly.
106	func (s *Store) WithLock(ctx context.Context, operation func() error) (err error) {
107		if s == nil {
108			return errors.New("lock nil catalog store")
109		}
110		if operation == nil {
111			return errors.New("catalog lock requires an operation")
112		}
113		if ctx == nil {
114			ctx = context.Background()
115		}
116		if err := os.MkdirAll(s.Dir, 0o755); err != nil {
117			return fmt.Errorf("create catalog directory for lock: %w", err)
118		}
119		absoluteDir, err := filepath.Abs(s.Dir)
120		if err != nil {
121			return fmt.Errorf("make catalog directory absolute for lock: %w", err)
122		}
123		canonicalDir, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(absoluteDir)
124		if err != nil {
125			return fmt.Errorf("canonicalize catalog directory for lock: %w", err)
126		}
127		lockPath := filepath.Join(filepath.Dir(canonicalDir), "."+filepath.Base(canonicalDir)+".lock")
128		lock, err := acquireCatalogFileLock(ctx, lockPath)
129		if err != nil {
130			return fmt.Errorf("acquire catalog lock: %w", err)
131		}
132		defer func() {
133			if releaseErr := lock.Close(); releaseErr != nil {
134				err = errors.Join(err, fmt.Errorf("release catalog lock: %w", releaseErr))
135			}
136		}()
137		return operation()
138	}
139	
140	func (s *Store) path(id string) string { return filepath.Join(s.Dir, id+".toml") }

142	// Create assigns a random stable ID and atomically persists entry. The caller's
143	// value is updated only after the rename succeeds.
144	func (s *Store) Create(entry *Entry) error {
145		if entry == nil {
146			return errors.New("create nil catalog entry")
147		}
148		if entry.ID != "" {
149			return fmt.Errorf("create catalog asset: ID is assigned by the store")
150		}
151	
152		s.mu.Lock()
153		defer s.mu.Unlock()
154	
155		for range 32 {
156			candidate := entry.Clone()
157			candidate.ID = s.nextID()
158			if err := ValidateID(candidate.ID); err != nil {
159				return fmt.Errorf("generated catalog ID: %w", err)
160			}
161	
162			now := s.now()
163			candidate.SchemaVersion = CurrentSchemaVersion
164			if candidate.Created.IsZero() {
165				candidate.Created = now
166			}
167			if candidate.Discovered.IsZero() {
168				candidate.Discovered = now
169			}
170			candidate.Updated = now
171			prepareNewNested(candidate, now)
172			candidate.Normalize()
173			if err := candidate.Validate(); err != nil {
174				return err
175			}
176			if err := os.MkdirAll(s.Dir, 0o755); err != nil {
177				return fmt.Errorf("create catalog directory: %w", err)
178			}
179			if _, err := os.Lstat(s.path(candidate.ID)); err == nil {
180				continue
181			} else if !errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
182				return fmt.Errorf("check catalog ID %s: %w", candidate.ID, err)
183			}
184			if err := s.writeAtomic(candidate); err != nil {
185				return err
186			}
187			*entry = *candidate
188			return nil
189		}
190		return fmt.Errorf("generate unique catalog ID: %w", ErrAlreadyExists)
191	}
192	
193	// Get loads one asset by exact ID.
194	func (s *Store) Get(id string) (*Entry, error) {
195		if err := ValidateID(id); err != nil {
196			return nil, err
197		}
198		return s.get(id)
199	}
200	
201	func (s *Store) get(id string) (*Entry, error) {
202		data, err := os.ReadFile(s.path(id))
203		if err != nil {
204			if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
205				return nil, fmt.Errorf("%q: %w", id, ErrNotFound)
206			}
207			return nil, fmt.Errorf("read catalog asset %s: %w", id, err)
208		}
209		var header struct {
210			SchemaVersion int `toml:"schema_version"`
211		}
212		if _, err := toml.Decode(string(data), &header); err != nil {
213			return nil, fmt.Errorf("decode catalog asset %s schema: %w", id, err)
214		}
215		if header.SchemaVersion != 0 && header.SchemaVersion != CurrentSchemaVersion {
216			return nil, &UnsupportedSchemaError{ID: id, Version: header.SchemaVersion}
217		}
218	
219		var entry Entry
220		metadata, err := toml.Decode(string(data), &entry)
221		if err != nil {
222			return nil, fmt.Errorf("decode catalog asset %s: %w", id, err)
223		}
224		if undecoded := metadata.Undecoded(); len(undecoded) > 0 {
225			return nil, fmt.Errorf("decode catalog asset %s: unknown field(s): %v", id, undecoded)
226		}
227		entry.ID = id
228		// Version zero is the only implicit form: it means the schema marker was
229		// absent, not that an unknown future layout should be guessed.
230		if entry.SchemaVersion == 0 {
231			entry.SchemaVersion = CurrentSchemaVersion
232		}
233		entry.Normalize()
234		if err := entry.Validate(); err != nil {
235			return nil, fmt.Errorf("validate catalog asset %s: %w", id, err)
236		}
237		return &entry, nil
238	}
239	
240	// List loads every valid record in deterministic ID order. Per-record failures
241	// are skipped and sent to the configured diagnostic sink; directory-level
242	// failures are returned.
243	func (s *Store) List() ([]*Entry, error) {
244		entries, diagnostics, err := s.ListWithDiagnostics()
245		if err != nil {
246			return nil, err
247		}
248		s.reportDiagnostics(diagnostics)
249		return entries, nil
250	}
251	
252	func (s *Store) reportDiagnostics(diagnostics []Diagnostic) {
253		if s.diagnostics == nil {
254			return
255		}
256		for _, diagnostic := range diagnostics {
257			s.diagnostics(diagnostic)
258		}
259	}
260	
261	// ListWithDiagnostics is List's explicit diagnostic form. It is useful to
262	// services that want to aggregate notices rather than render them immediately.
263	func (s *Store) ListWithDiagnostics() ([]*Entry, []Diagnostic, error) {
264		directoryEntries, err := os.ReadDir(s.Dir)
265		if err != nil {
266			if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
267				return nil, nil, nil
268			}
269			return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("read catalog directory: %w", err)
270		}
271	
272		var entries []*Entry
273		var diagnostics []Diagnostic
274		for _, directoryEntry := range directoryEntries {
275			name := directoryEntry.Name()
276			if directoryEntry.IsDir() || strings.HasPrefix(name, ".") || !strings.HasSuffix(name, ".toml") {
277				continue
278			}
279			id := strings.TrimSuffix(name, ".toml")
280			entry, err := s.Get(id)
281			if err != nil {
282				diagnostics = append(diagnostics, Diagnostic{Path: filepath.Join(s.Dir, name), Err: err})
283				continue
284			}
285			entries = append(entries, entry)
286		}
287		Sort(entries)
288		sort.Slice(diagnostics, func(i, j int) bool { return diagnostics[i].Path < diagnostics[j].Path })
289		return entries, diagnostics, nil
290	}
291	
292	// Update applies mutate to a deep copy and atomically replaces the record only
293	// if the mutation and validation both succeed. ID, Created, and Discovered are
294	// immutable.
295	func (s *Store) Update(id string, mutate func(*Entry) error) (*Entry, error) {
296		if err := ValidateID(id); err != nil {
297			return nil, err
298		}
299		if mutate == nil {
300			return nil, errors.New("catalog update requires a mutation")
301		}
302	
303		s.mu.Lock()
304		defer s.mu.Unlock()
305	
306		current, err := s.get(id)
307		if err != nil {
308			return nil, err
309		}
310		updated := current.Clone()
311		if err := mutate(updated); err != nil {
312			return nil, err
313		}
314		if updated.ID != current.ID {
315			return nil, errors.New("catalog update cannot change ID")
316		}
317		if updated.SchemaVersion != current.SchemaVersion {
318			return nil, errors.New("catalog update cannot change schema version")
319		}
320		if !updated.Created.Equal(current.Created) {
321			return nil, errors.New("catalog update cannot change Created")
322		}
323		if !updated.Discovered.Equal(current.Discovered) {
324			return nil, errors.New("catalog update cannot change Discovered")
325		}
326	
327		now := s.now()
328		updated.Updated = now
329		prepareUpdatedNested(current, updated, now)
330		stampChangedLocations(current, updated, now)
331		updated.Normalize()
332		if err := updated.Validate(); err != nil {
333			return nil, err
334		}
335		if err := s.writeAtomic(updated); err != nil {
336			return nil, err
337		}
338		return updated.Clone(), nil
339	}
340	
341	// Sort orders entries by stable ID.
342	func Sort(entries []*Entry) {
343		sort.SliceStable(entries, func(i, j int) bool {
344			return entries[i].ID < entries[j].ID
345		})
346	}
347	
348	func (s *Store) writeAtomic(entry *Entry) error {
349		temporary, err := os.CreateTemp(s.Dir, "."+entry.ID+".*.tmp")
350		if err != nil {
351			return fmt.Errorf("create catalog temp file: %w", err)
352		}
353		name := temporary.Name()
354		defer os.Remove(name)
355	
356		if err := toml.NewEncoder(temporary).Encode(entry); err != nil {
357			_ = temporary.Close()
358			return fmt.Errorf("encode catalog asset %s: %w", entry.ID, err)
359		}
360		if err := temporary.Close(); err != nil {
361			return fmt.Errorf("close catalog temp file: %w", err)
362		}
363		if err := os.Chmod(name, 0o644); err != nil {
364			return fmt.Errorf("set catalog file mode: %w", err)
365		}
366		if err := os.Rename(name, s.path(entry.ID)); err != nil {
367			return fmt.Errorf("replace catalog asset %s: %w", entry.ID, err)
368		}
369		return nil
370	}
371	
372	func (s *Store) nextID() string {
373		if s.generateID == nil {
374			return uuid.NewString()
375		}
376		return s.generateID()
377	}
378	
379	func (s *Store) now() time.Time {
380		if s.clock == nil {
381			return time.Now().UTC()
382		}
383		return s.clock().UTC()
384	}
385	
386	func prepareNewNested(entry *Entry, now time.Time) {
387		if entry.Experiment != nil {
388			if entry.Experiment.Phase == "" {
389				entry.Experiment.Phase = PhaseActive
390			}
391			if entry.Experiment.Started.IsZero() {
392				entry.Experiment.Started = now
393			}
394		}
395		for host, location := range entry.Locations {
396			if location.Updated.IsZero() {
397				location.Updated = now
398				entry.Locations[host] = location
399			}
400		}
401		if entry.RecoveryReceipt != nil && entry.RecoveryReceipt.Created.IsZero() {
402			entry.RecoveryReceipt.Created = now
403		}
404		if entry.MoveIntent != nil && entry.MoveIntent.Started.IsZero() {
405			entry.MoveIntent.Started = now
406		}
407	}
408	
409	func prepareUpdatedNested(current, updated *Entry, now time.Time) {
410		if current.Experiment == nil && updated.Experiment != nil {
411			if updated.Experiment.Phase == "" {
412				updated.Experiment.Phase = PhaseActive
413			}
414			if updated.Experiment.Started.IsZero() {
415				updated.Experiment.Started = now
416			}
417		}
418		if updated.RecoveryReceipt != nil && updated.RecoveryReceipt.Created.IsZero() &&
419			(current.RecoveryReceipt == nil || recoveryPayloadChanged(*current.RecoveryReceipt, *updated.RecoveryReceipt)) {
420			updated.RecoveryReceipt.Created = now
421		}
422		if updated.MoveIntent != nil && updated.MoveIntent.Started.IsZero() &&
423			(current.MoveIntent == nil || moveIntentPayloadChanged(*current.MoveIntent, *updated.MoveIntent)) {
424			updated.MoveIntent.Started = now
425		}
426	}
427	
428	func recoveryPayloadChanged(left, right RecoveryReceipt) bool {
429		left.Created = time.Time{}
430		right.Created = time.Time{}
431		return left != right
432	}
433	
434	func moveIntentPayloadChanged(left, right MoveIntent) bool {
435		left.Started = time.Time{}
436		right.Started = time.Time{}
437		return left != right
438	}
439	
440	func stampChangedLocations(current, updated *Entry, now time.Time) {
441		for host, location := range updated.Locations {
442			previous, existed := current.Locations[host]
443			if !existed || locationPayloadChanged(previous, location) {
444				location.Updated = now
445			} else {
446				// Updated is store-owned metadata. A mutation that did not change this
447				// host's location must not make it look newly observed.
448				location.Updated = previous.Updated
449			}
450			updated.Locations[host] = location
451		}
452	}
453	
454	func locationPayloadChanged(left, right Location) bool {
455		left.Updated = time.Time{}
456		right.Updated = time.Time{}
457		return left != right
458	}
459

22	// AmbiguousMatchError reports records that cannot be safely distinguished. A
23	// remote-only ambiguity is never resolved by picking the first entry.
24	type AmbiguousMatchError struct {
25		Observation  Observation
26		CandidateIDs []string
27		Reason       string
28	}
29	
30	func (e *AmbiguousMatchError) Error() string {
31		reason := e.Reason
32		if reason == "" {
33			reason = "multiple records match"
34		}
35		return fmt.Sprintf("%s: %s (%s)", ErrAmbiguous, reason, strings.Join(e.CandidateIDs, ", "))
36	}
37	
38	func (e *AmbiguousMatchError) Unwrap() error { return ErrAmbiguous }

40	// Observation is live repository identity gathered from discovery. Path is the
41	// navigation path, RealPath its physical target, and either common-dir field may
42	// carry Git's shared administrative directory. CommonDir matches repo.Repo;
43	// GitCommonDir is accepted for callers using gitx.Repo terminology.
44	type Observation struct {
45		Host           string
46		Path           string
47		RealPath       string
48		CommonDir      string
49		GitCommonDir   string
50		Name           string
51		RemoteIdentity string
52	}

54	// Registry adds live matching and lazy repository persistence to a Store.
55	type Registry struct {
56		store *Store
57		mu    sync.Mutex
58	}
59	
60	// NewRegistry returns a registry backed by store.
61	func NewRegistry(store *Store) *Registry { return &Registry{store: store} }
62	
63	// Store exposes the durable store for callers that need lower-level APIs.
64	func (r *Registry) Store() *Store {
65		if r == nil {
66			return nil
67		}
68		return r.store
69	}
70	
71	// List returns every readable catalog entry and reports skipped records through
72	// the Store's configured diagnostic sink.

74		if r == nil || r.store == nil {
75			return nil, errors.New("catalog registry has no store")
76		}
77		return r.store.List()

88	// Update applies an atomic mutation to one entry.
89	func (r *Registry) Update(id string, mutate func(*Entry) error) (*Entry, error) {
90		if r == nil || r.store == nil {
91			return nil, errors.New("catalog registry has no store")
92		}
93		r.mu.Lock()
94		defer r.mu.Unlock()

98	// Match finds an observation without changing the catalog. Exact canonical path
99	// or common-directory identity on the same host always wins. A remote identity
100	// is considered only as a conservative relocation hint.
101	func (r *Registry) Match(observation Observation) (*Entry, error) {
102		normalized, err := normalizeObservation(observation, false)
103		if err != nil {
104			return nil, err
105		}
106		entry, _, err := r.match(normalized)
107		return entry, err
108	}

110	// EnsureRepository returns the matching repository, attaching the observed host
111	// location when safe. If nothing matches—or a remote is ambiguous because it
112	// may describe another live clone—it creates a distinct repository record.
113	func (r *Registry) EnsureRepository(observation Observation) (*Entry, error) {
114		normalized, err := normalizeObservation(observation, true)
115		if err != nil {
116			return nil, err
117		}
118		if r == nil || r.store == nil {
119			return nil, errors.New("catalog registry has no store")
120		}
121	
122		r.mu.Lock()
123		defer r.mu.Unlock()
124	
125		matched, method, matchErr := r.match(normalized)
126		if matchErr == nil {
127			return r.attach(matched.ID, normalized)
128		}
129		if !errors.Is(matchErr, ErrNotFound) && !(errors.Is(matchErr, ErrAmbiguous) && method == matchRemote) {
130			return nil, matchErr
131		}
132	
133		entry := &Entry{
134			Kind:           KindRepository,
135			Name:           normalized.Name,
136			RemoteIdentity: normalized.RemoteIdentity,
137			Locations: map[string]Location{
138				normalized.Host: locationFromObservation(normalized),
139			},
140		}
141		if err := r.store.Create(entry); err != nil {
142			return nil, err
143		}
144		return entry.Clone(), nil
145	}

147	// Patch applies an atomic catalog mutation.

152	// Attach explicitly records observation as id's present location. Explicit
153	// attachment may update a changed remote because the caller supplied the stable
154	// catalog identity rather than asking the remote hint to choose one.
155	func (r *Registry) Attach(id string, observation Observation) (*Entry, error) {
156		normalized, err := normalizeObservation(observation, true)
157		if err != nil {
158			return nil, err
159		}
160		if r == nil || r.store == nil {
161			return nil, errors.New("catalog registry has no store")
162		}
163		r.mu.Lock()
164		defer r.mu.Unlock()

168	func (r *Registry) attach(id string, observation Observation) (*Entry, error) {
169		return r.store.Update(id, func(entry *Entry) error {
170			if observation.RemoteIdentity != "" {
171				entry.RemoteIdentity = observation.RemoteIdentity
172			}
173			location := locationFromObservation(observation)
174			if previous, ok := entry.LocationFor(observation.Host); ok && location.GitCommonDir == "" &&
175				intersects(canonicalValues(observation.Path, observation.RealPath),
176					canonicalValues(previous.CurrentPath, previous.RestorePath, previous.RealPath)) {
177				location.GitCommonDir = previous.GitCommonDir
178			}
179			return entry.SetLocation(observation.Host, location)
180		})
181	}

183	// FindByPath performs only exact host+canonical-path matching; it never falls
184	// back to a remote identity.
185	func (r *Registry) FindByPath(host, path string) (*Entry, error) {
186		normalized, err := normalizeObservation(Observation{Host: host, Path: path}, false)
187		if err != nil {
188			return nil, err
189		}
190		entries, diagnostics, err := r.entriesWithDiagnostics()
191		if err != nil {
192			return nil, err
193		}
194		matches := exactMatches(entries, normalized)
195		if len(matches) == 0 && len(diagnostics) > 0 {
196			return nil, incompleteCatalogError(diagnostics)
197		}
198		if len(matches) > 0 {
199			r.store.reportDiagnostics(diagnostics)
200		}
201		return selectExact(normalized, matches)
202	}

206		normalized, err := normalizeObservation(Observation{Host: host, CommonDir: commonDir}, false)
207		if err != nil {
208			return nil, err
209		}
210		entries, diagnostics, err := r.entriesWithDiagnostics()
211		if err != nil {
212			return nil, err
213		}
214		matches := exactMatches(entries, normalized)
215		if len(matches) == 0 && len(diagnostics) > 0 {
216			return nil, incompleteCatalogError(diagnostics)

224	type matchMethod int
225	
226	const (
227		matchNone matchMethod = iota
228		matchExact
229		matchRemote
230	)
231	
232	func (r *Registry) match(observation Observation) (*Entry, matchMethod, error) {
233		entries, diagnostics, err := r.entriesWithDiagnostics()
234		if err != nil {
235			return nil, matchNone, err
236		}
237		if matches := exactMatches(entries, observation); len(matches) > 0 {
238			r.store.reportDiagnostics(diagnostics)
239			entry, err := selectExact(observation, matches)
240			return entry, matchExact, err
241		}
242		if len(diagnostics) > 0 {
243			return nil, matchNone, incompleteCatalogError(diagnostics)
244		}
245		if observation.RemoteIdentity == "" {
246			return nil, matchNone, fmt.Errorf("catalog observation %q: %w", observation.Path, ErrNotFound)
247		}
248	
249		var remoteMatches []*Entry
250		for _, entry := range entries {
251			if NormalizeRemoteIdentity(entry.RemoteIdentity) == observation.RemoteIdentity {
252				remoteMatches = append(remoteMatches, entry)
253			}
254		}
255		Sort(remoteMatches)
256		switch len(remoteMatches) {
257		case 0:
258			return nil, matchNone, fmt.Errorf("remote %q: %w", observation.RemoteIdentity, ErrNotFound)
259		case 1:
260			if remoteCanRelocate(remoteMatches[0], observation) {
261				return remoteMatches[0], matchRemote, nil
262			}
263			return nil, matchRemote, ambiguous(observation, remoteMatches,
264				"remote also belongs to a different live clone on this host")
265		default:
266			return nil, matchRemote, ambiguous(observation, remoteMatches,
267				"remote identity matches multiple catalog records")
268		}
269	}
270	
271	func (r *Registry) entriesWithDiagnostics() ([]*Entry, []Diagnostic, error) {
272		if r == nil || r.store == nil {
273			return nil, nil, errors.New("catalog registry has no store")
274		}
275		return r.store.ListWithDiagnostics()
276	}
277	
278	func incompleteCatalogError(diagnostics []Diagnostic) error {
279		errorsToJoin := make([]error, 1, len(diagnostics)+1)
280		errorsToJoin[0] = ErrIncompleteCatalog
281		for _, diagnostic := range diagnostics {
282			errorsToJoin = append(errorsToJoin, diagnostic)
283		}
284		return errors.Join(errorsToJoin...)
285	}
286	
287	func exactMatches(entries []*Entry, observation Observation) []*Entry {
288		matched := make(map[string]*Entry)
289		observationPaths := canonicalValues(observation.Path, observation.RealPath)
290		observationCommon := canonicalValue(observation.CommonDir)
291		for _, entry := range entries {
292			location, ok := entry.LocationFor(observation.Host)
293			if !ok {
294				continue
295			}
296			locationPaths := canonicalValues(location.CurrentPath, location.RestorePath, location.RealPath)
297			pathMatch := intersects(observationPaths, locationPaths)
298			commonMatch := observationCommon != "" && observationCommon == canonicalValue(location.GitCommonDir)
299			if pathMatch || commonMatch {
300				matched[entry.ID] = entry
301			}
302		}
303		out := make([]*Entry, 0, len(matched))
304		for _, entry := range matched {
305			out = append(out, entry)
306		}
307		Sort(out)
308		return out
309	}
310	
311	func selectExact(observation Observation, matches []*Entry) (*Entry, error) {
312		switch len(matches) {
313		case 0:
314			return nil, fmt.Errorf("catalog path %q on host %q: %w", observation.Path, observation.Host, ErrNotFound)
315		case 1:
316			return matches[0], nil
317		default:
318			return nil, ambiguous(observation, matches, "canonical path or Git common directory matches multiple records")
319		}
320	}
321	
322	func ambiguous(observation Observation, entries []*Entry, reason string) error {
323		ids := make([]string, len(entries))
324		for i, entry := range entries {
325			ids[i] = entry.ID
326		}
327		sort.Strings(ids)
328		return &AmbiguousMatchError{Observation: observation, CandidateIDs: ids, Reason: reason}
329	}
330	
331	func remoteCanRelocate(entry *Entry, observation Observation) bool {
332		location, ok := entry.LocationFor(observation.Host)
333		if !ok {
334			return true
335		}
336		// Exact aliases, restore paths, and common directories were already handled.
337		// A navigation symlink may disappear while its physical clone or Git common
338		// directory remains, so every stored identity path must be absent before the
339		// remote can be treated as relocation evidence. Archives also deliberately
340		// block relocation while their bytes remain.
341		for _, path := range []string{
342			location.CurrentPath,
343			location.RestorePath,
344			location.RealPath,
345			location.GitCommonDir,
346		} {
347			if path == "" {
348				continue
349			}
350			if pathMayStillExist(path) {
351				return false
352			}
353		}
354		return true
355	}
356	
357	func pathMayStillExist(path string) bool {
358		if _, err := os.Lstat(path); err == nil || !errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
359			// Lstat deliberately counts a dangling symlink as existing evidence.
360			return true
361		}
362		canonical, err := pathx.Canonical(path)
363		if err != nil {
364			return true
365		}
366		_, err = os.Stat(canonical)
367		return err == nil || !errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist)
368	}
369	
370	func locationFromObservation(observation Observation) Location {
371		currentPath := observation.Path
372		if currentPath == "" {
373			currentPath = observation.RealPath
374		}
375		return Location{
376			State:        LocationPresent,
377			CurrentPath:  currentPath,
378			RealPath:     observation.RealPath,
379			GitCommonDir: observation.CommonDir,
380		}
381	}
382	
383	func normalizeObservation(observation Observation, requireLocation bool) (Observation, error) {
384		observation.Host = strings.TrimSpace(observation.Host)
385		observation.Name = strings.TrimSpace(observation.Name)
386		if observation.Host == "" {
387			return Observation{}, errors.New("catalog observation host is required")
388		}
389	
390		commonDir := observation.CommonDir
391		if commonDir == "" {
392			commonDir = observation.GitCommonDir
393		} else if observation.GitCommonDir != "" {
394			left, leftErr := pathx.Canonical(commonDir)
395			right, rightErr := pathx.Canonical(observation.GitCommonDir)
396			if leftErr != nil || rightErr != nil || left != right {
397				return Observation{}, errors.New("catalog observation CommonDir and GitCommonDir disagree")
398			}
399		}
400	
401		var err error
402		canonicalPath := ""
403		if observation.Path != "" {
404			observation.Path, err = absoluteClean(observation.Path)
405			if err != nil {
406				return Observation{}, fmt.Errorf("catalog observation path: %w", err)
407			}
408			canonicalPath, err = pathx.Canonical(observation.Path)
409			if err != nil {
410				return Observation{}, fmt.Errorf("catalog observation path: %w", err)
411			}
412		}
413		if observation.RealPath != "" {
414			observation.RealPath, err = pathx.Canonical(observation.RealPath)
415			if err != nil {
416				return Observation{}, fmt.Errorf("catalog observation real path: %w", err)
417			}
418			if canonicalPath != "" && canonicalPath != observation.RealPath {
419				return Observation{}, fmt.Errorf("catalog observation Path and RealPath disagree: %q != %q",
420					canonicalPath, observation.RealPath)
421			}
422		} else {
423			observation.RealPath = canonicalPath
424		}
425		if commonDir != "" {
426			observation.CommonDir, err = pathx.Canonical(commonDir)
427			if err != nil {
428				return Observation{}, fmt.Errorf("catalog observation Git common directory: %w", err)
429			}
430		}
431		observation.GitCommonDir = observation.CommonDir
432		observation.RemoteIdentity = NormalizeRemoteIdentity(observation.RemoteIdentity)
433	
434		if requireLocation && observation.Path == "" && observation.RealPath == "" {
435			return Observation{}, errors.New("catalog repository observation requires a path")
436		}
437		if requireLocation {
438			path := observation.Path
439			if path == "" {
440				path = observation.RealPath
441			}
442			info, statErr := os.Stat(path)
443			if statErr != nil {
444				return Observation{}, fmt.Errorf("catalog repository observation path %q: %w", path, statErr)
445			}
446			if !info.IsDir() {
447				return Observation{}, fmt.Errorf("catalog repository observation path %q is not a directory", path)
448			}
449			if observation.CommonDir != "" {
450				commonInfo, commonErr := os.Stat(observation.CommonDir)
451				if commonErr != nil {
452					return Observation{}, fmt.Errorf("catalog repository observation Git common directory %q: %w",
453						observation.CommonDir, commonErr)
454				}
455				if !commonInfo.IsDir() {
456					return Observation{}, fmt.Errorf("catalog repository observation Git common directory %q is not a directory",
457						observation.CommonDir)
458				}
459			}
460		}
461		if observation.Name == "" {
462			path := observation.Path
463			if path == "" {
464				path = observation.RealPath
465			}
466			if path != "" {
467				observation.Name = filepath.Base(path)
468			}
469		}
470		if requireLocation && (observation.Name == "" || observation.Name == ".") {
471			return Observation{}, errors.New("catalog repository observation requires a name")
472		}
473		return observation, nil
474	}
475	
476	func absoluteClean(path string) (string, error) {
477		absolute, err := filepath.Abs(path)
478		if err != nil {
479			return "", err
480		}
481		return filepath.Clean(absolute), nil
482	}
483	
484	func canonicalValues(values ...string) map[string]struct{} {
485		out := make(map[string]struct{}, len(values))
486		for _, value := range values {
487			if canonical := canonicalValue(value); canonical != "" {
488				out[canonical] = struct{}{}
489			}
490		}
491		return out
492	}
493	
494	func canonicalValue(value string) string {
495		if value == "" {
496			return ""
497		}
498		canonical, err := pathx.Canonical(value)
499		if err != nil {
500			return ""
501		}
502		return canonical
503	}
504	
505	func intersects(left, right map[string]struct{}) bool {
506		for value := range left {
507			if _, ok := right[value]; ok {
508				return true
509			}
510		}
511		return false
512	}
513	
514	// NormalizeRemoteIdentity converts common HTTPS and SCP-style Git URLs into a
515	// stable host/path key. Hosts are case-insensitive, but paths are preserved
516	// because arbitrary Git servers may use a case-sensitive repository namespace.
517	// The result remains only a hint for matching.
518	func NormalizeRemoteIdentity(identity string) string {
519		identity = strings.TrimSpace(identity)
520		if identity == "" {
521			return ""
522		}
523		if parsed, err := url.Parse(identity); err == nil && parsed.Scheme != "" {
524			if strings.EqualFold(parsed.Scheme, "file") {
525				return ""
526			}
527			if parsed.Host != "" {
528				return remoteIdentityKey(parsed.Host, parsed.EscapedPath())
529			}
530		}
531		if looksLikeLocalRemote(identity) {
532			return ""
533		}
534	
535		afterUser := identity
536		user := ""
537		if at := strings.LastIndexByte(afterUser, '@'); at >= 0 {
538			user, afterUser = afterUser[:at], afterUser[at+1:]
539		}
540		if host, remotePath, ok := splitSCPLike(afterUser); ok {
541			if user != "" && !strings.EqualFold(user, "git") && !strings.HasPrefix(remotePath, "/") {
542				remotePath = "~" + user + "/" + remotePath
543			}
544			return remoteIdentityKey(host, remotePath)
545		}
546	
547		identity = strings.Trim(identity, "/")
548		if host, remotePath, ok := strings.Cut(identity, "/"); ok {
549			return remoteIdentityKey(host, remotePath)
550		}
551		return ""
552	}
553	
554	func looksLikeLocalRemote(identity string) bool {
555		if filepath.IsAbs(identity) || strings.HasPrefix(identity, `\\`) {
556			return true
557		}
558		for _, prefix := range []string{"./", "../", "~/", `.\`, `..\`, `~\`} {
559			if strings.HasPrefix(identity, prefix) {
560				return true
561			}
562		}
563		if len(identity) >= 2 && identity[1] == ':' {
564			letter := identity[0]
565			if letter >= 'a' && letter <= 'z' || letter >= 'A' && letter <= 'Z' {
566				return true
567			}
568		}
569		return !strings.ContainsAny(identity, `/\:@`)
570	}
571	
572	func splitSCPLike(identity string) (string, string, bool) {
573		if strings.HasPrefix(identity, "[") {
574			if end := strings.Index(identity, "]:"); end >= 0 {
575				return identity[:end+1], identity[end+2:], true
576			}
577		}
578		colon := strings.IndexByte(identity, ':')
579		if colon <= 0 || strings.ContainsAny(identity[:colon], `/\\`) {
580			return "", "", false
581		}
582		return identity[:colon], identity[colon+1:], true
583	}
584	
585	func remoteIdentityKey(host, remotePath string) string {
586		host = strings.ToLower(strings.Trim(host, "/"))
587		remotePath = trimGitSuffix(strings.Trim(remotePath, "/"))
588		if host == "" || remotePath == "" {
589			return ""
590		}
591		return host + "/" + remotePath
592	}
593	
594	func trimGitSuffix(value string) string {
595		return strings.TrimSuffix(value, ".git")
596	}
597

345	// NewService validates and normalizes the injected service dependencies.
346	func NewService(config ServiceConfig) (*Service, error) {
347		store := config.Store
348		registry := config.Registry
349		if store == nil && registry != nil {
350			store = registry.Store()
351		}
352		if registry == nil && store != nil {
353			registry = catalog.NewRegistry(store)
354		}
355		if store == nil || registry == nil {
356			return nil, errors.New("experiment service requires a catalog registry and store")
357		}
358		if registry.Store() != store {
359			return nil, errors.New("experiment service registry and store do not share a catalog")
360		}
361	
362		triesRoot, err := absoluteRoot(config.TriesRoot, "tries root")
363		if err != nil {
364			return nil, err
365		}
366		projectRoot, err := absoluteRoot(config.ProjectRoot, "project root")
367		if err != nil {
368			return nil, err
369		}
370		host := strings.TrimSpace(config.Host)
371		if host == "" || host != config.Host || strings.ContainsRune(host, '\x00') {
372			return nil, errors.New("experiment service host is required and must be normalized")
373		}
374		clock := config.Clock
375		if clock == nil {
376			clock = time.Now
377		}
378		workers := config.MaxEnrichment
379		if workers <= 0 {
380			workers = 4
381		}
382	
383		s := &Service{
384			registry: registry, store: store,
385			triesRoot: triesRoot, projectRoot: projectRoot, host: host,
386			clock: clock, workers: workers,
387			gitRun: gitx.Run, gitDiscover: gitx.Discover,
388			gitStatus: gitx.StatusOf, gitLastCommit: gitx.LastCommit,
389			rename: os.Rename, sameFilesystem: sameFilesystem,
390			getwd: os.Getwd,
391		}

393		s.catalogUpdate = registry.Update
394		applyHooks(s, config.Hooks)
395		return s, nil

434			return "", fmt.Errorf("make %s absolute: %w", label, err)
435		}
436		return filepath.Clean(absolute), nil
437	}
438	
439	func (s *Service) now() time.Time { return s.clock().UTC() }
440	
441	func (s *Service) ensureTriesRoot() error {
442		if err := os.MkdirAll(s.triesRoot, 0o755); err != nil {
443			return fmt.Errorf("create tries root %s: %w", s.triesRoot, err)
444		}
445		return nil
446	}
447	
448	func candidatesOf(items []Item) []Candidate {
449		candidates := make([]Candidate, len(items))
450		for index, item := range items {
451			candidates[index] = Candidate{
452				ID: item.ID, Name: item.Name, Basename: item.Basename, Path: item.Live.CurrentPath,
453			}
454		}
455		sort.Slice(candidates, func(i, j int) bool {
456			left, right := strings.ToLower(candidates[i].Basename), strings.ToLower(candidates[j].Basename)
457			if left != right {
458				return left < right
459			}
460			if candidates[i].Basename != candidates[j].Basename {
461				return candidates[i].Basename < candidates[j].Basename
462			}
463			return candidates[i].ID < candidates[j].ID
464		})
465		return candidates
466	}
467	
468	func itemFromEntry(entry *catalog.Entry, live LiveFacts) Item {
469		if entry == nil {
470			return Item{Live: live}
471		}
472		copy := entry.Clone()
473		item := Item{
474			Entry: copy,
475			ID:    copy.ID, Kind: copy.Kind, Name: copy.Name,
476			Note: copy.Note, Tags: append([]string(nil), copy.Tags...),
477			Created: copy.Created, LastOpened: copy.LastOpened,
478			RemoteIdentity: copy.RemoteIdentity,
479			Live:           live,
480		}
481		if copy.Experiment != nil {
482			item.Slug = copy.Experiment.Slug
483			item.Phase = copy.Experiment.Phase
484			item.Started = copy.Experiment.Started
485			item.OriginURL = copy.Experiment.OriginURL
486		}
487		if item.Live.CurrentPath != "" {
488			item.Basename = filepath.Base(item.Live.CurrentPath)
489		} else if copy.Experiment != nil && copy.Experiment.OriginalPath != "" {
490			item.Basename = filepath.Base(copy.Experiment.OriginalPath)
491		}
492		return item
493	}
494	
495	func catalogDiagnostics(diagnostics []catalog.Diagnostic) []Diagnostic {
496		out := make([]Diagnostic, len(diagnostics))
497		for index, diagnostic := range diagnostics {
498			out[index] = Diagnostic{Path: diagnostic.Path, Operation: "read catalog record", Err: diagnostic.Err}
499		}
500		return out
501	}
502	
503	func directoryExists(path string) (bool, error) {
504		info, err := os.Stat(path)
505		if err == nil {
506			return info.IsDir(), nil
507		}
508		if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
509			return false, nil
510		}
511		return false, err
512	}
