31	// Reconcile backfills every immediate, non-hidden directory under TriesRoot.
32	// It never moves, renames, or writes into a discovered directory. Filesystem
33	// and Git probes happen before the short cross-process catalog transaction.
34	func (s *Service) Reconcile(ctx context.Context) ([]Item, []Diagnostic, error) {
35		s.reconcileMu.Lock()
36		defer s.reconcileMu.Unlock()
37	
38		if err := s.ensureTriesRoot(); err != nil {
39			return nil, nil, err
40		}
41		directoryEntries, err := os.ReadDir(s.triesRoot)
42		if err != nil {
43			return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("read tries root %s: %w", s.triesRoot, err)
44		}
45		paths := make([]string, 0, len(directoryEntries))
46		for _, entry := range directoryEntries {
47			if strings.HasPrefix(entry.Name(), ".") {
48				continue
49			}
50			paths = append(paths, filepath.Join(s.triesRoot, entry.Name()))
51		}
52		probes := boundedMap(ctx, s.workers, paths, func(ctx context.Context, path string) directoryProbe {
53			return s.probeDirectory(ctx, path)
54		})
55	
56		validProbes := make([]directoryProbe, 0, len(probes))
57		var diagnostics []Diagnostic
58		for _, probe := range probes {
59			if probe.diagnostic != nil {
60				diagnostics = append(diagnostics, *probe.diagnostic)
61			}
62			if !probe.valid {
63				continue
64			}
65			if visibilityErr := s.validateVisibleTryPath(probe.live.CurrentPath); visibilityErr != nil {
66				diagnostics = append(diagnostics, Diagnostic{
67					Path: probe.live.CurrentPath, Operation: "validate try location", Err: visibilityErr,
68				})
69				continue
70			}
71			validProbes = append(validProbes, probe)
72		}
73	
74		items := make([]Item, 0, len(validProbes))
75		lockErr := s.store.WithLock(ctx, func() error {
76			entries, catalogProblems, listErr := s.store.ListWithDiagnostics()
77			if listErr != nil {
78				return listErr
79			}
80			diagnostics = append(diagnostics, catalogDiagnostics(catalogProblems)...)
81	
82			for _, probe := range validProbes {
83				matches := matchingEntries(entries, s.host, probe)
84				if len(matches) == 0 && len(catalogProblems) == 0 && remoteIdentityFromOrigin(probe.originURL) != "" {
85					matched, matchErr := s.registry.Match(observationFromProbe(s.host, probe))
86					switch {
87					case matchErr == nil && eligibleTryRecord(matched):
88						matches = []*catalog.Entry{matched}
89					case matchErr == nil:
90						// A graduated experiment at the same identity is history, not an
91						// active Try to revive implicitly.
92					case errors.Is(matchErr, catalog.ErrNotFound), errors.Is(matchErr, catalog.ErrAmbiguous):
93						// A live clone must get its own identity when the remote hint is
94						// absent or ambiguous.
95					default:
96						item := s.transientItem(probe, matchErr)
97						items = append(items, item)
98						diagnostics = append(diagnostics, Diagnostic{
99							Path: probe.live.CurrentPath, Operation: "match catalog try", Err: matchErr,
100						})
101						continue
102					}
103				}
104				switch len(matches) {
105				case 0:
106					if len(catalogProblems) > 0 {
107						// The catalog diagnostic is reported once, while each live item carries
108						// the same typed tracking error for callers that try to mutate it.
109						items = append(items, s.transientItem(probe, incompleteCatalogError(catalogProblems)))
110						continue
111					}
112					entry := s.newEntry(probe)
113					if createErr := s.catalogCreate(entry); createErr != nil {
114						item := s.transientItem(probe, createErr)
115						items = append(items, item)
116						diagnostics = append(diagnostics, Diagnostic{
117							Path: probe.live.CurrentPath, Operation: "catalog try", Err: createErr,
118						})
119						continue
120					}
121					entries = append(entries, entry)
122					items = append(items, itemFromEntry(entry, probe.live))
123				case 1:
124					entry := matches[0]
125					updated, updateErr := s.refreshEntry(entry, probe)
126					if updateErr != nil {
127						item := itemFromEntry(entry, probe.live)
128						item.CatalogError = updateErr
129						items = append(items, item)
130						diagnostics = append(diagnostics, Diagnostic{
131							Path: probe.live.CurrentPath, Operation: "refresh catalog try", Err: updateErr,
132						})
133						continue
134					}
135					replaceEntry(entries, updated)
136					items = append(items, itemFromEntry(updated, probe.live))
137				default:
138					matchedItems := make([]Item, len(matches))
139					for index, entry := range matches {
140						matchedItems[index] = itemFromEntry(entry, probe.live)
141					}
142					ambiguous := &AmbiguousError{Ref: probe.live.CurrentPath, Candidates: candidatesOf(matchedItems)}
143					items = append(items, s.transientItem(probe, ambiguous))
144					diagnostics = append(diagnostics, Diagnostic{
145						Path: probe.live.CurrentPath, Operation: "match catalog try", Err: ambiguous,
146					})
147				}
148			}
149			return nil
150		})
151	
152		items = deduplicateItems(items)
153		sortItemsByName(items)
154		sortDiagnostics(diagnostics)
155		return items, diagnostics, lockErr
156	}

158	// List reconciles visible directories, joins requested catalog history, and
159	// enriches Git repositories with bounded status/last-commit probes.
160	func (s *Service) List(ctx context.Context, options ListOptions) ([]Item, []Diagnostic, error) {
161		visible, diagnostics, err := s.Reconcile(ctx)
162		if err != nil {
163			return visible, diagnostics, err
164		}
165	
166		entries, catalogProblems, err := s.store.ListWithDiagnostics()
167		if err != nil {
168			return visible, diagnostics, err
169		}
170		diagnostics = append(diagnostics, catalogDiagnostics(catalogProblems)...)
171	
172		items := make([]Item, 0, len(entries)+len(visible))
173		seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(visible))
174		seenPaths := make(map[string]struct{}, len(visible))
175		for _, item := range visible {
176			if item.ID != "" {
177				seen[item.ID] = struct{}{}
178			}
179			if key := pathKey(item.Live.CurrentPath); key != "" {
180				seenPaths[key] = struct{}{}
181			}
182			items = append(items, item)
183		}
184	
185		for _, entry := range entries {
186			if _, ok := seen[entry.ID]; ok {
187				continue
188			}
189			if location, ok := entry.LocationFor(s.host); ok {
190				if _, pathSeen := seenPaths[pathKey(location.CurrentPath)]; pathSeen {
191					continue
192				}
193			}
194			graduated := entry.Kind == catalog.KindRepository && entry.Experiment != nil &&
195				entry.Experiment.Phase == catalog.PhaseGraduated
196			if graduated {
197				if !options.IncludeGraduated {
198					continue
199				}
200			} else if entry.Kind != catalog.KindTry || entry.Experiment == nil {
201				continue
202			}
203	
204			location, located := entry.LocationFor(s.host)
205			present := located && location.State == catalog.LocationPresent && !s.hiddenStorage(location.CurrentPath)
206			if present && !graduated && s.validateVisibleTryPath(location.CurrentPath) != nil {
207				present = false
208			}
209			if present {
210				isDirectory, statErr := directoryExists(location.CurrentPath)
211				if statErr != nil {
212					diagnostics = append(diagnostics, Diagnostic{
213						Path: location.CurrentPath, Operation: "stat catalog try", Err: statErr,
214					})
215					present = false
216				} else {
217					present = isDirectory
218				}
219			}
220			if !present && !options.IncludeNonPresent {
221				continue
222			}
223	
224			live := LiveFacts{Present: present}
225			if located {
226				live.CurrentPath = location.CurrentPath
227				live.RealPath = location.RealPath
228			}
229			if present {
230				probe := s.probeDirectory(ctx, location.CurrentPath)
231				if probe.diagnostic != nil {
232					diagnostics = append(diagnostics, *probe.diagnostic)
233				}
234				if probe.valid {
235					live = probe.live
236				}
237			}
238			items = append(items, itemFromEntry(entry, live))
239		}
240	
241		if query := strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(options.Query)); query != "" {
242			filtered := items[:0]
243			for _, item := range items {
244				if strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(item.SearchText()), query) {
245					filtered = append(filtered, item)
246				}
247			}
248			items = filtered
249		}
250		if !options.SkipEnrichment {
251			items = s.enrich(ctx, items)
252		}
253		sortItemsByActivity(items)
254		diagnostics = deduplicateDiagnostics(diagnostics)
255		sortDiagnostics(diagnostics)
256		return items, diagnostics, nil
257	}

259	// Resolve applies stable, deterministic matching: exact ID, exact basename,
260	// exact date-stripped name/slug, then one unique case-insensitive substring.
261	func (s *Service) Resolve(ctx context.Context, ref string) (Item, []Diagnostic, error) {
262		items, diagnostics, err := s.List(ctx, ListOptions{SkipEnrichment: true})
263		if err != nil {
264			return Item{}, diagnostics, err
265		}
266		ref = strings.TrimSpace(ref)
267		if ref == "" {
268			return Item{}, diagnostics, &NotFoundError{Ref: ref, Root: s.triesRoot}
269		}
270	
271		if looksLikePath(ref) {
272			pathRef := config.Expand(ref)
273			if canonical, canonicalErr := pathx.Canonical(pathRef); canonicalErr == nil {
274				var matches []Item
275				for _, item := range items {
276					if samePath(canonical, item.Live.CurrentPath) {
277						matches = append(matches, item)
278					}
279				}
280				if len(matches) > 0 {
281					return s.selectResolved(ctx, ref, matches, diagnostics)
282				}
283			}
284		}
285	
286		for _, match := range []func(Item) bool{
287			func(item Item) bool { return item.ID != "" && item.ID == ref },
288			func(item Item) bool { return item.Basename == ref },
289			func(item Item) bool {
290				stripped, _, _ := splitDatedBasename(item.Basename)
291				return stripped == ref || item.Name == ref || item.Slug == ref
292			},
293		} {
294			var matches []Item
295			for _, item := range items {
296				if match(item) {
297					matches = append(matches, item)
298				}
299			}
300			if len(matches) > 0 {
301				return s.selectResolved(ctx, ref, matches, diagnostics)
302			}
303		}
304	
305		needle := strings.ToLower(ref)
306		var matches []Item
307		for _, item := range items {
308			stripped, _, _ := splitDatedBasename(item.Basename)
309			for _, value := range []string{item.Basename, stripped, item.Name, item.Slug} {
310				if value != "" && strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(value), needle) {
311					matches = append(matches, item)
312					break
313				}
314			}
315		}
316		if len(matches) == 0 {
317			return Item{}, diagnostics, &NotFoundError{Ref: ref, Root: s.triesRoot}
318		}
319		return s.selectResolved(ctx, ref, matches, diagnostics)
320	}
321	
322	func (s *Service) selectResolved(ctx context.Context, ref string, matches []Item, diagnostics []Diagnostic) (Item, []Diagnostic, error) {
323		if len(matches) == 1 {
324			if errors.Is(matches[0].CatalogError, ErrAmbiguous) {
325				return Item{}, diagnostics, matches[0].CatalogError
326			}
327			enriched := s.enrich(ctx, matches)
328			return enriched[0], diagnostics, nil
329		}
330		return Item{}, diagnostics, &AmbiguousError{Ref: ref, Candidates: candidatesOf(matches)}
331	}

333	// ResolveOrCreate preserves the low-friction dev try behavior: an existing
334	// non-clone match wins; clone requests always get a collision-safe new path.
335	func (s *Service) ResolveOrCreate(ctx context.Context, request CreateRequest) (CreateResult, error) {
336		if request.Clone == "" {
337			name := config.Slug(strings.ReplaceAll(request.Name, " ", "-"))
338			item, diagnostics, err := s.Resolve(ctx, name)
339			if err == nil {
340				result := CreateResult{
341					Item: item, Path: item.Live.CurrentPath, Existing: true,
342					Tracked: item.ID != "" && item.CatalogError == nil, Diagnostics: diagnostics,
343				}
344				if !result.Tracked {
345					trackingErr := item.CatalogError
346					if trackingErr == nil {
347						trackingErr = errors.New("matching directory has no catalog ID")
348					}
349					return result, fmt.Errorf("existing try at %s is not tracked in the catalog: %w", result.Path, trackingErr)
350				}
351				return result, nil
352			}
353			if !errors.Is(err, ErrNotFound) {
354				return CreateResult{Diagnostics: diagnostics}, err
355			}
356		}
357		return s.Create(ctx, request)
358	}
359	
360	// Create makes a new collision-safe dated directory or clone and catalogs it
361	// only after the filesystem operation succeeds.
362	func (s *Service) Create(ctx context.Context, request CreateRequest) (CreateResult, error) {
363		var result CreateResult
364		if err := s.ensureTriesRoot(); err != nil {
365			return result, err
366		}
367		name := request.Name
368		if request.Clone != "" && strings.TrimSpace(name) == "" {
369			name = cloneDefaultName(request.Clone)
370		}
371		slug := config.Slug(strings.ReplaceAll(name, " ", "-"))
372		if err := pathx.ValidateComponent(slug); err != nil {
373			return result, fmt.Errorf("try name %q: %w", name, err)
374		}
375	
376		path, err := s.availableDatedPath(slug)
377		if err != nil {
378			return result, err
379		}
380		result.Path = path
381		if request.Clone != "" {
382			cloneRef, normalizeErr := s.normalizeCloneRef(request.Clone)
383			if normalizeErr != nil {
384				return result, normalizeErr
385			}
386			if _, err := s.gitRun(ctx, s.triesRoot, "clone", cloneRef, path); err != nil {
387				return result, fmt.Errorf("clone try into %s: %w", path, err)
388			}
389			result.Created = true
390			result.Cloned = true
391		} else {
392			if err := os.Mkdir(path, 0o755); err != nil {
393				return result, fmt.Errorf("create try %s: %w", path, err)
394			}
395			result.Created = true
396			if !request.NoGit {
397				if _, err := s.gitRun(ctx, path, "init", "-b", "main"); err != nil {
398					result.InitWarning = err
399				}
400			}
401		}
402	
403		canonical, canonicalErr := pathx.Canonical(path)
404		if canonicalErr != nil {
405			return result, fmt.Errorf("try exists at %s but its canonical path could not be determined: %w", path, canonicalErr)
406		}
407		result.Path = canonical
408		items, diagnostics, reconcileErr := s.Reconcile(ctx)
409		result.Diagnostics = diagnostics
410		if reconcileErr != nil {
411			return result, fmt.Errorf("try exists at %s but catalog reconciliation failed: %w", canonical, reconcileErr)
412		}
413		for _, item := range items {
414			if samePath(item.Live.CurrentPath, canonical) {
415				result.Item = item
416				result.Tracked = item.ID != "" && item.CatalogError == nil
417				break
418			}
419		}
420		if !result.Tracked {
421			trackingErr := result.Item.CatalogError
422			if trackingErr == nil {
423				trackingErr = errors.New("reconciliation did not produce a catalog record")
424			}
425			return result, fmt.Errorf("try exists at %s but could not be added to the catalog: %w", canonical, trackingErr)
426		}
427		enriched := s.enrich(ctx, []Item{result.Item})
428		if len(enriched) == 1 {
429			result.Item = enriched[0]
430		}
431		return result, nil
432	}

434	// RefreshOrigin re-probes origin after an explicit external remote-creation
435	// step and persists its raw URL and normalized identity on the same catalog ID.
436	func (s *Service) RefreshOrigin(ctx context.Context, id string) (Item, error) {
437		entry, err := s.registry.Get(id)
438		if err != nil {
439			return Item{}, fmt.Errorf("load experiment %s for origin refresh: %w", id, err)
440		}
441		if entry.Experiment == nil ||
442			(entry.Kind != catalog.KindTry && !(entry.Kind == catalog.KindRepository && entry.Experiment.Phase == catalog.PhaseGraduated)) {
443			return Item{}, &NotFoundError{Ref: id, Root: s.triesRoot}
444		}
445		location, ok := entry.LocationFor(s.host)
446		if !ok || location.State != catalog.LocationPresent || location.CurrentPath == "" {
447			return Item{}, &NotFoundError{Ref: id, Root: s.triesRoot}
448		}
449		probe := s.probeDirectory(ctx, location.CurrentPath)
450		if !probe.valid || probe.live.Repo == nil || probe.live.DiscoverError != nil {
451			if probe.diagnostic != nil {
452				return Item{}, fmt.Errorf("refresh experiment origin: %w", probe.diagnostic.Err)
453			}
454			return Item{}, errors.New("refresh experiment origin: path is not a discoverable Git repository")
455		}
456		if probe.originURL == "" {
457			return Item{}, errors.New("refresh experiment origin: Git origin is not configured")
458		}
459		updated, err := s.catalogUpdate(id, func(current *catalog.Entry) error {
460			currentLocation, found := current.LocationFor(s.host)
461			if !found || currentLocation.State != catalog.LocationPresent ||
462				!samePath(currentLocation.CurrentPath, probe.live.CurrentPath) {
463				return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s moved or was reassigned before origin refresh", id)
464			}
465			if current.Experiment == nil {
466				return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s no longer has experiment provenance", id)
467			}
468			current.Experiment.OriginURL = probe.originURL
469			current.RemoteIdentity = remoteIdentityFromOrigin(probe.originURL)
470			return current.SetLocation(s.host, locationFromProbe(probe, currentLocation))
471		})
472		if err != nil {
473			return Item{}, fmt.Errorf("refresh experiment origin: %w", err)
474		}
475		item := itemFromEntry(updated, probe.live)
476		enriched := s.enrich(ctx, []Item{item})
477		if len(enriched) == 1 {
478			item = enriched[0]
479		}
480		return item, nil
481	}
482	
483	// Touch updates LastOpened only after a caller has successfully handed off the
484	// selected OpenTarget.
485	func (s *Service) Touch(_ context.Context, id string) (TouchResult, error) {
486		if id == "" {
487			return TouchResult{}, &NotFoundError{Ref: id, Root: s.triesRoot}
488		}
489		now := s.now()
490		updated, err := s.catalogUpdate(id, func(entry *catalog.Entry) error {
491			if entry.Experiment == nil ||
492				(entry.Kind != catalog.KindTry && !(entry.Kind == catalog.KindRepository && entry.Experiment.Phase == catalog.PhaseGraduated)) {
493				return &NotFoundError{Ref: id, Root: s.triesRoot}
494			}
495			location, ok := entry.LocationFor(s.host)
496			if !ok || location.State != catalog.LocationPresent {
497				return &NotFoundError{Ref: id, Root: s.triesRoot}
498			}
499			entry.LastOpened = now
500			return nil
501		})
502		if err != nil {
503			if errors.Is(err, catalog.ErrNotFound) {
504				return TouchResult{}, &NotFoundError{Ref: id, Root: s.triesRoot}
505			}
506			return TouchResult{}, fmt.Errorf("touch try %s: %w", id, err)
507		}
508		location, _ := updated.LocationFor(s.host)
509		item := itemFromEntry(updated, LiveFacts{
510			Present:     location.State == catalog.LocationPresent,
511			CurrentPath: location.CurrentPath, RealPath: location.RealPath,
512		})
513		return TouchResult{Item: item, TouchedAt: now}, nil
514	}
515	
516	func (s *Service) probeDirectory(ctx context.Context, path string) directoryProbe {
517		probe := directoryProbe{}
518		if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
519			probe.diagnostic = &Diagnostic{Path: path, Operation: "inspect try", Err: err}
520			return probe
521		}
522		info, err := os.Stat(path)
523		if err != nil {
524			probe.diagnostic = &Diagnostic{Path: path, Operation: "stat try", Err: err}
525			return probe
526		}
527		if !info.IsDir() {
528			return probe
529		}
530		canonical, err := pathx.Canonical(path)
531		if err != nil {
532			probe.diagnostic = &Diagnostic{Path: path, Operation: "canonicalize try", Err: err}
533			return probe
534		}
535		probe.valid = true
536		probe.live = LiveFacts{Present: true, CurrentPath: canonical, RealPath: canonical}
537		_, markerErr := os.Lstat(filepath.Join(canonical, ".git"))
538		probe.gitMarker = markerErr == nil || !errors.Is(markerErr, fs.ErrNotExist)
539	
540		repository, discoverErr := s.gitDiscover(ctx, canonical)
541		if discoverErr != nil {
542			if probe.gitMarker || !errors.Is(discoverErr, gitx.ErrNotARepo) {
543				probe.live.DiscoverError = discoverErr
544				probe.diagnostic = &Diagnostic{Path: canonical, Operation: "discover Git try", Err: discoverErr}
545			}
546			return probe
547		}
548		repositoryRoot := repository.Root
549		if repository.Bare {
550			repositoryRoot = repository.MainRoot
551		}
552		canonicalRoot, rootErr := pathx.Canonical(repositoryRoot)
553		if rootErr != nil || !samePath(canonicalRoot, canonical) {
554			// A TriesRoot may itself be inside a repository. Its child directories are
555			// not independent Git Tries merely because rev-parse walks to that parent.
556			return probe
557		}
558		repository.Root = canonicalRoot
559		if repository.MainRoot != "" {
560			if canonicalMain, mainErr := pathx.Canonical(repository.MainRoot); mainErr == nil {
561				repository.MainRoot = canonicalMain
562			}
563		}
564		if repository.GitCommonDir != "" {
565			commonDir, commonErr := pathx.Canonical(repository.GitCommonDir)
566			if commonErr != nil {
567				probe.live.DiscoverError = commonErr
568				probe.diagnostic = &Diagnostic{Path: canonical, Operation: "canonicalize Git common directory", Err: commonErr}
569				repository.GitCommonDir = ""
570			} else {
571				repository.GitCommonDir = commonDir
572			}
573		}
574		probe.live.Repo = &repository
575		probe.originURL = gitx.RemoteFromConfig(repository.GitCommonDir, "origin")
576		return probe
577	}
578	
579	func (s *Service) enrich(ctx context.Context, items []Item) []Item {
580		return boundedMap(ctx, s.workers, items, func(ctx context.Context, item Item) Item {
581			if item.Live.Repo == nil || item.Live.CurrentPath == "" {
582				return item
583			}
584			status, statusErr := s.gitStatus(ctx, item.Live.CurrentPath)
585			if statusErr != nil {
586				item.Live.StatusError = statusErr
587			} else {
588				item.Live.Status = &status
589			}
590			unix, subject, commitErr := s.gitLastCommit(ctx, item.Live.CurrentPath)
591			if commitErr != nil {
592				item.Live.LastCommitError = commitErr
593			} else if unix > 0 {
594				item.Live.LastCommit = time.Unix(unix, 0).UTC()
595				item.Live.LastCommitSubject = subject
596			}
597			return item
598		})
599	}

601	func (s *Service) experimentFromProbe(probe directoryProbe) *catalog.Experiment {
602		name, started, dated := splitDatedBasename(filepath.Base(probe.live.CurrentPath))
603		if strings.TrimSpace(name) == "" {
604			name = "unnamed"
605		} else {
606			name = strings.TrimSpace(name)
607		}
608		if !dated {
609			started = s.now()
610		}
611		return &catalog.Experiment{
612			Phase: catalog.PhaseActive, Slug: config.Slug(name),
613			OriginURL: probe.originURL, Started: started,
614			OriginalPath: probe.live.CurrentPath,
615		}
616	}

618	func (s *Service) newEntry(probe directoryProbe) *catalog.Entry {
619		name, started, dated := splitDatedBasename(filepath.Base(probe.live.CurrentPath))
620		if strings.TrimSpace(name) == "" {
621			name = "unnamed"
622		} else {
623			name = strings.TrimSpace(name)
624		}
625		if !dated {
626			started = s.now()
627		}
628		entry := &catalog.Entry{
629			Kind:           catalog.KindTry,
630			Name:           name,
631			RemoteIdentity: remoteIdentityFromOrigin(probe.originURL),
632			Experiment: &catalog.Experiment{
633				Phase: catalog.PhaseActive, Slug: config.Slug(name),
634				OriginURL: probe.originURL, Started: started,
635				OriginalPath: probe.live.CurrentPath,
636			},
637			Locations: map[string]catalog.Location{
638				s.host: locationFromProbe(probe, catalog.Location{}),
639			},
640		}
641		entry.Created = started
642		return entry

645	func (s *Service) transientItem(probe directoryProbe, catalogErr error) Item {
646		name, started, dated := splitDatedBasename(filepath.Base(probe.live.CurrentPath))
647		if strings.TrimSpace(name) == "" {
648			name = "unnamed"
649		} else {

655		return Item{

657			Basename: filepath.Base(probe.live.CurrentPath), Slug: config.Slug(name),

664	func (s *Service) refreshEntry(entry *catalog.Entry, probe directoryProbe) (*catalog.Entry, error) {
665		location, _ := entry.LocationFor(s.host)
666		wantedLocation := locationFromProbe(probe, location)
667		if entry.Kind == catalog.KindRepository && entry.Experiment == nil {
668			metadata := s.experimentFromProbe(probe)
669			return s.catalogUpdate(entry.ID, func(updated *catalog.Entry) error {
670				if updated.Kind != catalog.KindRepository || updated.Experiment != nil {
671					return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s changed before it could become a Try", updated.ID)
672				}
673				updated.Kind = catalog.KindTry
674				updated.Experiment = metadata
675				if probe.originURL != "" {
676					updated.RemoteIdentity = remoteIdentityFromOrigin(probe.originURL)
677				}
678				return updated.SetLocation(s.host, wantedLocation)
679			})
680		}
681	
682		wantedOrigin := entry.Experiment.OriginURL
683		wantedIdentity := entry.RemoteIdentity
684		if probe.originURL != "" {
685			wantedOrigin = probe.originURL
686			wantedIdentity = remoteIdentityFromOrigin(probe.originURL)
687		}
688		if locationEqual(location, wantedLocation) && entry.Experiment.OriginURL == wantedOrigin &&
689			entry.RemoteIdentity == wantedIdentity {
690			return entry, nil
691		}
692		return s.catalogUpdate(entry.ID, func(updated *catalog.Entry) error {
693			if updated.Kind != catalog.KindTry || updated.Experiment == nil || updated.Experiment.Phase == catalog.PhaseGraduated {
694				return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s is not an active Try", updated.ID)
695			}
696			if probe.originURL != "" {
697				updated.Experiment.OriginURL = probe.originURL
698				updated.RemoteIdentity = remoteIdentityFromOrigin(probe.originURL)
699			}
700			return updated.SetLocation(s.host, wantedLocation)
701		})
702	}
703	
704	func locationFromProbe(probe directoryProbe, previous catalog.Location) catalog.Location {
705		commonDir := ""
706		if probe.live.Repo != nil && probe.live.DiscoverError == nil {
707			commonDir = probe.live.Repo.GitCommonDir
708		} else if probe.gitMarker && probe.live.DiscoverError != nil {
709			// A transient Git failure must not erase identity gathered earlier.
710			commonDir = previous.GitCommonDir
711		}
712		return catalog.Location{
713			State:        catalog.LocationPresent,
714			CurrentPath:  probe.live.CurrentPath,
715			RealPath:     probe.live.RealPath,
716			GitCommonDir: commonDir,
717		}
718	}
719	
720	func locationEqual(left, right catalog.Location) bool {
721		left.Updated = time.Time{}
722		right.Updated = time.Time{}
723		return left == right
724	}
725	
726	func eligibleTryRecord(entry *catalog.Entry) bool {
727		return entry != nil && entry.Kind == catalog.KindTry && entry.Experiment != nil &&
728			entry.Experiment.Phase != catalog.PhaseGraduated
729	}
730	
731	func eligibleLocalRecord(entry *catalog.Entry) bool {
732		return eligibleTryRecord(entry) ||
733			(entry != nil && entry.Kind == catalog.KindRepository && entry.Experiment == nil)
734	}
735	
736	func remoteIdentityFromOrigin(origin string) string {
737		origin = strings.TrimSpace(origin)
738		if strings.Contains(origin, "://") {
739			return catalog.NormalizeRemoteIdentity(origin)
740		}
741		colon := strings.IndexByte(origin, ':')
742		if colon > 0 && !strings.ContainsAny(origin[:colon], `/\\`) {
743			return catalog.NormalizeRemoteIdentity(origin)
744		}
745		return ""
746	}
747	
748	func observationFromProbe(host string, probe directoryProbe) catalog.Observation {
749		observation := catalog.Observation{
750			Host: host, Path: probe.live.CurrentPath, RealPath: probe.live.RealPath,
751			Name: filepath.Base(probe.live.CurrentPath), RemoteIdentity: remoteIdentityFromOrigin(probe.originURL),
752		}
753		if probe.live.Repo != nil {
754			observation.CommonDir = probe.live.Repo.GitCommonDir
755		}
756		return observation
757	}
758	
759	func matchingEntries(entries []*catalog.Entry, host string, probe directoryProbe) []*catalog.Entry {
760		matched := make(map[string]*catalog.Entry)
761		for _, entry := range entries {
762			if !eligibleLocalRecord(entry) {
763				continue
764			}
765			location, located := entry.LocationFor(host)
766			if located {
767				pathMatch := samePath(probe.live.CurrentPath, location.CurrentPath) ||
768					samePath(probe.live.CurrentPath, location.RealPath) ||
769					samePath(probe.live.CurrentPath, location.RestorePath)
770				commonMatch := probe.live.Repo != nil && probe.live.Repo.GitCommonDir != "" &&
771					samePath(probe.live.Repo.GitCommonDir, location.GitCommonDir)
772				if pathMatch || commonMatch {
773					matched[entry.ID] = entry
774				}
775			} else if entry.Experiment != nil && samePath(probe.live.CurrentPath, entry.Experiment.OriginalPath) {
776				matched[entry.ID] = entry
777			}
778		}
779		out := make([]*catalog.Entry, 0, len(matched))
780		for _, entry := range matched {
781			out = append(out, entry)
782		}
783		catalog.Sort(out)
784		return out
785	}
786	
787	func incompleteCatalogError(diagnostics []catalog.Diagnostic) error {
788		joined := make([]error, 1, len(diagnostics)+1)
789		joined[0] = catalog.ErrIncompleteCatalog
790		for _, diagnostic := range diagnostics {
791			joined = append(joined, diagnostic)
792		}
793		return errors.Join(joined...)
794	}

796	func replaceEntry(entries []*catalog.Entry, replacement *catalog.Entry) {
797		for index, entry := range entries {
798			if entry.ID == replacement.ID {
799				entries[index] = replacement
800				return
801			}
802		}
803	}
804	
805	func splitDatedBasename(basename string) (string, time.Time, bool) {
806		if len(basename) <= len("2006-01-02-") || basename[10] != '-' {
807			return basename, time.Time{}, false
808		}
809		parsed, err := time.Parse("2006-01-02", basename[:10])
810		if err != nil || parsed.Format("2006-01-02") != basename[:10] {
811			return basename, time.Time{}, false
812		}
813		name := basename[11:]
814		if name == "" {
815			return basename, time.Time{}, false
816		}
817		return name, parsed, true
818	}
819	
820	func (s *Service) availableDatedPath(slug string) (string, error) {
821		prefix := s.clock().Format("2006-01-02") + "-" + slug
822		for version := 1; version < 10_000; version++ {
823			basename := prefix
824			if version > 1 {
825				basename = fmt.Sprintf("%s-%d", prefix, version)
826			}
827			intended := filepath.Join(s.triesRoot, basename)
828			if _, err := os.Lstat(intended); err == nil {
829				continue
830			} else if !errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
831				return "", fmt.Errorf("inspect try destination %s: %w", intended, err)
832			}
833			candidate, err := pathx.JoinChild(s.triesRoot, basename)
834			if err != nil {
835				return "", fmt.Errorf("choose try destination: %w", err)
836			}
837			if _, err := os.Lstat(candidate); errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
838				return candidate, nil
839			} else if err != nil {
840				return "", fmt.Errorf("inspect try destination %s: %w", candidate, err)
841			}
842		}
843		return "", fmt.Errorf("choose a unique destination for %q", slug)
844	}
845	
846	func cloneDefaultName(ref string) string {
847		if localClonePath(ref) {
848			trimmed := strings.TrimSuffix(strings.TrimSuffix(ref, string(filepath.Separator)), ".git")
849			return config.Slug(filepath.Base(trimmed))
850		}
851		if _, identity := forge.IdentityFromURL(ref); identity != "" {
852			return config.Slug(strings.ReplaceAll(identity, "/", "-"))
853		}
854		identity := clonePathIdentity(ref)
855		if identity != "" {
856			return config.Slug(strings.ReplaceAll(identity, "/", "-"))
857		}
858		trimmed := strings.TrimSuffix(strings.TrimSuffix(ref, "/"), ".git")
859		if index := strings.LastIndexAny(trimmed, "/:"); index >= 0 {
860			trimmed = trimmed[index+1:]
861		}
862		return config.Slug(trimmed)
863	}
864	
865	func (s *Service) normalizeCloneRef(ref string) (string, error) {
866		ref = strings.TrimSpace(ref)
867		if ref == "" {
868			return "", errors.New("clone reference is required")
869		}
870		if local, ok, err := s.resolveLocalCloneRef(ref); ok || err != nil {
871			return local, err
872		}
873		// SCP-style remotes are already complete clone references. In particular,
874		// nonstandard SSH usernames must not be rewritten as preferred-forge shorthand.
875		if !strings.Contains(ref, "://") && strings.ContainsAny(ref, "@:") {
876			return ref, nil
877		}
878		kind := forge.FromURL(ref)
879		if kind != forge.Unknown {
880			adapter, err := forge.For(kind)
881			if err == nil {
882				return adapter.CloneURL(ref), nil
883			}
884			return ref, nil
885		}
886		if !strings.Contains(ref, "://") && strings.Contains(ref, "/") {
887			if adapter, err := forge.Preferred(); err == nil {
888				return adapter.CloneURL(ref), nil
889			}
890		}
891		return ref, nil
892	}
893	
894	func (s *Service) resolveLocalCloneRef(ref string) (string, bool, error) {
895		if strings.HasPrefix(ref, "file://") {
896			return ref, true, nil
897		}
898		if filepath.IsAbs(ref) {
899			return filepath.Clean(ref), true, nil
900		}
901		if ref == "~" || strings.HasPrefix(ref, "~/") {
902			return config.Expand(ref), true, nil
903		}
904	
905		explicit := strings.HasPrefix(ref, "./") || strings.HasPrefix(ref, "../")
906		cwd, err := s.getwd()
907		if err != nil {
908			if explicit {
909				return "", true, fmt.Errorf("resolve local clone reference %q: %w", ref, err)
910			}
911			return "", false, nil
912		}
913		candidate := filepath.Clean(filepath.Join(cwd, ref))
914		if explicit {
915			return candidate, true, nil
916		}
917		if strings.ContainsAny(ref, "@:") {
918			return "", false, nil
919		}
920		if _, err := os.Stat(candidate); err == nil {
921			return candidate, true, nil
922		}
923		return "", false, nil
924	}
925	
926	func localClonePath(ref string) bool {
927		if filepath.IsAbs(ref) || strings.HasPrefix(ref, "file://") || strings.HasPrefix(ref, "./") ||
928			strings.HasPrefix(ref, "../") || strings.HasPrefix(ref, "~/") {
929			return true
930		}
931		_, err := os.Stat(ref)
932		return err == nil
933	}
934	
935	func clonePathIdentity(ref string) string {
936		if parsed, err := url.Parse(ref); err == nil && parsed.Host != "" {
937			return strings.Trim(strings.TrimSuffix(parsed.Path, ".git"), "/")
938		}
939		if at := strings.LastIndexByte(ref, '@'); at >= 0 {
940			ref = ref[at+1:]
941		}
942		if colon := strings.IndexByte(ref, ':'); colon >= 0 {
943			ref = ref[colon+1:]
944		}
945		ref = strings.Trim(strings.TrimSuffix(ref, ".git"), "/")
946		if strings.Contains(ref, "/") {
947			return ref
948		}
949		return ""
950	}
951	
952	func (s *Service) validateVisibleTryPath(path string) error {
953		canonicalRoot, err := pathx.Canonical(s.triesRoot)
954		if err != nil {
955			return fmt.Errorf("canonicalize tries root: %w", err)
956		}
957		canonicalPath, err := pathx.CanonicalChild(canonicalRoot, path)
958		if err != nil {
959			return err
960		}
961		relative, err := filepath.Rel(canonicalRoot, canonicalPath)
962		if err != nil {
963			return fmt.Errorf("locate try under root: %w", err)
964		}
965		if strings.Contains(relative, string(filepath.Separator)) || strings.HasPrefix(relative, ".") {
966			return fmt.Errorf("%s is not an immediate visible child of %s", canonicalPath, canonicalRoot)
967		}
968		return nil
969	}
970	
971	func (s *Service) hiddenStorage(path string) bool {
972		if path == "" {
973			return false
974		}
975		if hiddenImmediateChild(s.triesRoot, path) {
976			return true
977		}
978		canonicalRoot, rootErr := pathx.Canonical(s.triesRoot)
979		canonicalPath, pathErr := pathx.Canonical(path)
980		if rootErr != nil || pathErr != nil {
981			return false
982		}
983		return hiddenImmediateChild(canonicalRoot, canonicalPath)
984	}
985	
986	func hiddenImmediateChild(root, path string) bool {
987		absoluteRoot, rootErr := filepath.Abs(root)
988		absolutePath, pathErr := filepath.Abs(path)
989		if rootErr != nil || pathErr != nil {
990			return false
991		}
992		relative, err := filepath.Rel(filepath.Clean(absoluteRoot), filepath.Clean(absolutePath))
993		if err != nil || relative == "." || relative == ".." ||
994			strings.HasPrefix(relative, ".."+string(filepath.Separator)) {
995			return false
996		}
997		first, _, _ := strings.Cut(relative, string(filepath.Separator))
998		return strings.HasPrefix(first, ".")
999	}
1000	
1001	func looksLikePath(ref string) bool {
1002		return filepath.IsAbs(ref) || strings.HasPrefix(ref, ".") || strings.HasPrefix(ref, "~") ||
1003			strings.ContainsAny(ref, `/\\`)
1004	}
1005	
1006	func pathKey(path string) string {
1007		if path == "" {
1008			return ""
1009		}
1010		if canonical, err := pathx.Canonical(path); err == nil {
1011			return canonical
1012		}
1013		if absolute, err := filepath.Abs(path); err == nil {
1014			return filepath.Clean(absolute)
1015		}
1016		return filepath.Clean(path)
1017	}
1018	
1019	func samePath(left, right string) bool {
1020		if left == "" || right == "" {
1021			return false
1022		}
1023		leftCanonical, leftErr := pathx.Canonical(left)
1024		rightCanonical, rightErr := pathx.Canonical(right)
1025		if leftErr == nil && rightErr == nil {
1026			return leftCanonical == rightCanonical
1027		}
1028		leftAbsolute, leftAbsErr := filepath.Abs(left)
1029		rightAbsolute, rightAbsErr := filepath.Abs(right)
1030		return leftAbsErr == nil && rightAbsErr == nil && filepath.Clean(leftAbsolute) == filepath.Clean(rightAbsolute)
1031	}
1032	
1033	func sortItemsByName(items []Item) {
1034		sort.SliceStable(items, func(i, j int) bool {
1035			left, right := strings.ToLower(items[i].DisplayName()), strings.ToLower(items[j].DisplayName())
1036			if left != right {
1037				return left < right
1038			}
1039			if items[i].DisplayName() != items[j].DisplayName() {
1040				return items[i].DisplayName() < items[j].DisplayName()
1041			}
1042			return items[i].ID < items[j].ID
1043		})
1044	}
1045	
1046	func sortItemsByActivity(items []Item) {
1047		sort.SliceStable(items, func(i, j int) bool {
1048			left, right := items[i].Activity(), items[j].Activity()
1049			if !left.Equal(right) {
1050				if left.IsZero() {
1051					return false
1052				}
1053				if right.IsZero() {
1054					return true
1055				}
1056				return left.After(right)
1057			}
1058			leftName, rightName := strings.ToLower(items[i].DisplayName()), strings.ToLower(items[j].DisplayName())
1059			if leftName != rightName {
1060				return leftName < rightName
1061			}
1062			return items[i].ID < items[j].ID
1063		})
1064	}
1065	
1066	func sortDiagnostics(diagnostics []Diagnostic) {
1067		sort.SliceStable(diagnostics, func(i, j int) bool {
1068			if diagnostics[i].Path != diagnostics[j].Path {
1069				return diagnostics[i].Path < diagnostics[j].Path
1070			}
1071			return diagnostics[i].Operation < diagnostics[j].Operation
1072		})
1073	}
1074	
1075	func deduplicateItems(items []Item) []Item {
1076		seenIDs := make(map[string]struct{}, len(items))
1077		seenPaths := make(map[string]struct{}, len(items))
1078		out := items[:0]
1079		for _, item := range items {
1080			if item.ID != "" {
1081				if _, ok := seenIDs[item.ID]; ok {
1082					continue
1083				}
1084				seenIDs[item.ID] = struct{}{}
1085			} else if item.Live.CurrentPath != "" {
1086				if _, ok := seenPaths[item.Live.CurrentPath]; ok {
1087					continue
1088				}
1089				seenPaths[item.Live.CurrentPath] = struct{}{}
1090			}
1091			out = append(out, item)
1092		}
1093		return out
1094	}
1095	
1096	func deduplicateDiagnostics(diagnostics []Diagnostic) []Diagnostic {
1097		seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(diagnostics))
1098		out := diagnostics[:0]
1099		for _, diagnostic := range diagnostics {
1100			key := diagnostic.Path + "\x00" + diagnostic.Operation + "\x00" + fmt.Sprint(diagnostic.Err)
1101			if _, ok := seen[key]; ok {
1102				continue
1103			}
1104			seen[key] = struct{}{}
1105			out = append(out, diagnostic)
1106		}
1107		return out
1108	}
1109	
1110	func boundedMap[Input, Output any](ctx context.Context, limit int, input []Input, work func(context.Context, Input) Output) []Output {
1111		if len(input) == 0 {
1112			return nil
1113		}
1114		if limit <= 0 || limit > len(input) {
1115			limit = len(input)
1116		}
1117		type job struct {
1118			index int
1119			value Input
1120		}
1121		type result struct {
1122			index int
1123			value Output
1124		}
1125		jobs := make(chan job, len(input))
1126		results := make(chan result, len(input))
1127		for index, value := range input {
1128			jobs <- job{index: index, value: value}
1129		}
1130		close(jobs)
1131	
1132		var workers sync.WaitGroup
1133		workers.Add(limit)
1134		for range limit {
1135			go func() {
1136				defer workers.Done()
1137				for next := range jobs {
1138					results <- result{index: next.index, value: work(ctx, next.value)}
1139				}
1140			}()
1141		}
1142		workers.Wait()
1143		close(results)
1144	
1145		out := make([]Output, len(input))
1146		for result := range results {
1147			out[result.index] = result.value
1148		}
1149		return out
1150	}
1151

314	func (s *Service) resolveGraduateItem(ctx context.Context, request GraduateRequest) (Item, []Diagnostic, error) {
315		if strings.TrimSpace(request.Ref) != "" {
316			return s.Resolve(ctx, request.Ref)
317		}
318		current := request.CurrentDir
319		if current == "" {
320			var err error
321			current, err = s.getwd()
322			if err != nil {
323				return Item{}, nil, fmt.Errorf("get current directory: %w", err)
324			}
325		}
326		canonicalCurrent, err := pathx.CanonicalChild(s.triesRoot, current)
327		if err != nil {
328			return Item{}, nil, fmt.Errorf("%s is not inside %s — name the try to graduate", current, s.triesRoot)
329		}
330		canonicalRoot, err := pathx.Canonical(s.triesRoot)
331		if err != nil {
332			return Item{}, nil, err
333		}
334		relative, err := filepath.Rel(canonicalRoot, canonicalCurrent)
335		if err != nil {
336			return Item{}, nil, err
337		}
338		first, _, _ := strings.Cut(relative, string(filepath.Separator))
339		if first == "" || first == "." || strings.HasPrefix(first, ".") {
340			return Item{}, nil, fmt.Errorf("%s is not inside a visible try under %s", current, s.triesRoot)
341		}
342		return s.Resolve(ctx, filepath.Join(s.triesRoot, first))
343	}

345	func (s *Service) hasCommit(ctx context.Context, directory string) bool {
346		if unix, _, err := s.gitLastCommit(ctx, directory); err == nil && unix > 0 {
347			return true
348		}
349		_, err := s.gitRun(ctx, directory, "rev-parse", "--verify", "HEAD")
350		return err == nil
351	}

353	func (s *Service) ensureInitialCommit(ctx context.Context, directory, name string) (bool, error) {
354		if s.hasCommit(ctx, directory) {
355			return false, nil
356		}
357		empty, err := isEmptyWorkTree(directory)
358		if err != nil {
359			return false, err
360		}
361		if empty {
362			readme := filepath.Join(directory, "README.md")
363			file, err := os.OpenFile(readme, os.O_WRONLY|os.O_CREATE|os.O_EXCL, 0o644)
364			if err != nil {
365				return false, err
366			}
367			if _, err := fmt.Fprintf(file, "# %s\n", name); err != nil {
368				_ = file.Close()
369				return false, err
370			}
371			if err := file.Close(); err != nil {
372				return false, err
373			}
374		}
375		if _, err := s.gitRun(ctx, directory, "add", "--all"); err != nil {
376			return false, err
377		}
378		tracked, err := s.gitRun(ctx, directory, "ls-files", "--cached")
379		if err != nil {
380			return false, err
381		}
382		commitArgs := []string{"commit"}
383		if tracked == "" {
384			// A Try containing only globally ignored files still needs a HEAD, but dev
385			// must not force-add or overwrite those user files merely to manufacture it.
386			commitArgs = append(commitArgs, "--allow-empty")
387		}
388		commitArgs = append(commitArgs, "-m", "chore: graduate experiment into a project")
389		if _, err := s.gitRun(ctx, directory, commitArgs...); err != nil {
390			return false, err
391		}
392		return true, nil
393	}

395	func (s *Service) rollbackGraduation(result GraduateResult, cause error) (GraduateResult, error) {
396		rollbackErr := rejectExisting(result.Plan.Source)
397		if rollbackErr == nil {
398			rollbackErr = s.rename(result.Plan.Destination, result.Plan.Source)
399		}
400		result.RollbackError = rollbackErr
401		result.RolledBack = rollbackErr == nil
402		if rollbackErr == nil {
403			result.Moved = false
404		}
405		return result, &FinalizeError{
406			Source: result.Plan.Source, Destination: result.Plan.Destination,
407			Cause: cause, RollbackErr: rollbackErr,
408		}
409	}
410	
411	func rejectExisting(path string) error {
412		if _, err := os.Lstat(path); err == nil {
413			return fmt.Errorf("%s already exists", path)
414		} else if !errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
415			return fmt.Errorf("inspect graduation destination %s: %w", path, err)
416		}
417		return nil
418	}
419	
420	func isEmptyWorkTree(directory string) (bool, error) {
421		entries, err := os.ReadDir(directory)
422		if err != nil {
423			return false, err
424		}
425		for _, entry := range entries {
426			if entry.Name() != ".git" {
427				return false, nil
428			}
429		}
430		return true, nil
431	}
432	
433	func nearestExisting(path string) (string, error) {
434		path = filepath.Clean(path)
435		for {
436			if _, err := os.Stat(path); err == nil {
437				return path, nil
438			} else if !errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
439				return "", err
440			}
441			parent := filepath.Dir(path)
442			if parent == path {
443				return "", fmt.Errorf("no existing ancestor for %s", path)
444			}
445			path = parent
446		}
447	}

95		}
96	
97		table := NewTable("TRY", "AGE", "GIT")
98		for _, item := range items {
99			gitColumn := "—"
100			switch {
101			case item.Live.Repo != nil && item.Live.Status != nil && item.Live.Status.Dirty():
102				gitColumn = "repo ●"
103			case item.Live.Repo != nil && item.Live.StatusError != nil:
104				gitColumn = "repo ?"
105			case item.Live.Repo != nil:
106				gitColumn = "repo"
107			case item.Live.DiscoverError != nil:
108				gitColumn = "error"
109			}
110			age := "unknown"
111			if activity := item.Activity(); !activity.IsZero() {
112				age = humanAge(time.Since(activity))
113			}
114			table.Add(truncate(item.DisplayName(), 44), age, gitColumn)
115		}
116		table.Render(app.Out)
117		fmt.Fprintf(app.Err, "\n%d tries under %s — promote one with `dev graduate <try>`\n",
118			len(items), config.Contract(root))
119		return nil
120	}
121	
122	func warnExperimentDiagnostics(app *App, diagnostics []experiment.Diagnostic) {
123		for _, diagnostic := range diagnostics {
124			app.warnf("%s", diagnostic.Error())
125		}
126	}
127	
128	func openOrCD(app *App, ctx context.Context, dir, label string) bool {
129		runtime := app.Runtime()
130		if runtime.Name() == "none" {
131			app.cdDirective(dir)
132			return true
133		}
134		if _, err := openCheckout(ctx, runtime, dir, label); err != nil {
135			app.warnf("could not open a session: %v", err)
136			return false
137		}
138		return true
139	}

12	func newGraduateCmd(app *App) *cobra.Command {

23			Short: "Promote an experiment into a real project",
24			Long: `Move a try out of the scratch directory and into your projects tree.
25	
26	An experiment that turns out to matter should stop being an experiment, and
27	that transition is where things usually get lost — the directory keeps its date
28	prefix forever, or it gets copied by hand and the history is left behind.
29	
30	graduate moves the directory to <project_root>/<category>/<name>, drops the
31	date prefix, makes sure it has a git repo and a first commit, and optionally
32	creates the remote with gh or glab.
33	
34	With no argument, the try containing the current directory is used.`,
35			Args: cobra.MaximumNArgs(1),
36			RunE: func(cmd *cobra.Command, args []string) error {
37				ctx := ctxOf()
38				service, err := newExperimentService(app)
39				if err != nil {
40					return err
41				}
42				ref := ""
43				if len(args) == 1 {
44					ref = args[0]
45				}
46				request := experiment.GraduateRequest{
47					Ref: ref, Category: category, Name: name, DryRun: dryRun,
48				}
49				plan, err := service.PlanGraduate(ctx, request)
50				warnExperimentDiagnostics(app, plan.Diagnostics)
51				if err != nil {
52					return err
53				}
54	
55				fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "graduate  %s\n", config.Contract(plan.Source))
56				fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "       →  %s\n", config.Contract(plan.Destination))
57				if dryRun {
58					fmt.Fprintln(app.Out, "\n(dry run — nothing moved)")
59					return nil
60				}
61	
62				result, err := service.Graduate(ctx, request)
63				if err != nil {
64					return err
65				}
66				if result.GitInitialized {
67					fmt.Fprintln(app.Out, "   git init")
68				}
69				if result.InitialCommitMade {
70					fmt.Fprintln(app.Out, "   committed the existing work")
71				}
72	
73				if remote {
74					adapter, err := forge.Preferred()
75					if err != nil {
76						app.warnf("%v — the project is in place; add a remote by hand", err)
77					} else {
78						remoteURL, createErr := adapter.CreateRepo(ctx, result.Plan.Destination, forge.RepoRequest{
79							Name: result.Plan.Name, Private: private, Push: push,
80						})
81						if createErr != nil {
82							app.warnf("could not create the remote: %v", createErr)
83						} else {
84							fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "   remote    %s\n", remoteURL)
85						}
86						// A forge command can add origin successfully and then fail while
87						// pushing. Refresh after every attempt so that partial success does not

89						// second warning about its expected missing origin.
90						if refreshed, refreshErr := service.RefreshOrigin(ctx, result.Item.ID); refreshErr == nil {

94						}
95					}

99					result.Plan.Name, result.Plan.Name)

102					return nil
103				}

336	// repoNameFromRef derives a directory name from a clone reference.
337	func repoNameFromRef(ref string) string {

340			return ref[i+1:]
341		}
342		return ref
343	}

1	// Package cli assembles dev's command tree. Commands stay thin: they parse
2	// flags, call into the domain packages, and render. All policy lives in
3	// config, catalog, gitx, wt, task and runtime so it can be tested without a terminal.
4	package cli
5	
6	import (
7		"context"
8		"fmt"
9		"io"
10		"os"
11	
12		"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/catalog"
13		"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/config"
14		"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/runtime"
15		"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/task"
16	)
17	
18	// App is the state shared by every command.
19	type App struct {
20		Cfg      config.Config
21		Tasks    *task.Store
22		Catalog  *catalog.Store
23		Registry *catalog.Registry
24	
25		Out io.Writer
26		Err io.Writer
27	
28		// configPath is the --config override; empty means the XDG default.
29		configPath string
30		// runtimeOverride is the --runtime flag; empty means use the config.
31		runtimeOverride string
32		// noRuntime disables all multiplexer interaction for one invocation.
33		noRuntime bool
34	}
35	
36	// Load reads configuration and prepares the shared stores.
37	func (a *App) Load() error {
38		cfg, err := config.Load(a.configPath)
39		if err != nil {
40			return err
41		}
42		a.Cfg = cfg
43		if a.Out == nil {
44			a.Out = os.Stdout
45		}
46		if a.Err == nil {
47			a.Err = os.Stderr
48		}
49		a.Tasks = task.NewStore(cfg.TasksDir())
50		a.Catalog = catalog.NewStore(cfg.AssetsDir(), catalog.WithDiagnosticSink(func(diagnostic catalog.Diagnostic) {
51			fmt.Fprintf(a.Err, "dev: warning: %s\n", diagnostic.Error())
52		}))
53		a.Registry = catalog.NewRegistry(a.Catalog)
54		return nil
55	}
56	
57	// Runtime resolves the multiplexer backend for this invocation, honouring
58	// --runtime and --no-runtime.
59	func (a *App) Runtime() runtime.Runtime {
60		if a.noRuntime {
61			return runtime.None{}
62		}
63		backend := a.Cfg.Runtime.Backend
64		if a.runtimeOverride != "" {
65			backend = a.runtimeOverride
66		}
67		rt := runtime.Select(backend)
68		if h, ok := rt.(*runtime.Herdr); ok {
69			return h.WithMetadataSource(a.Cfg.Runtime.MetadataSource)
70		}
71		return rt
72	}
73	
74	// printf writes to the command's stdout.
75	func (a *App) printf(format string, args ...any) {
76		fmt.Fprintf(a.Out, format, args...)
77	}
78	
79	// warnf writes a non-fatal notice to stderr, so it never pollutes piped output.
80	func (a *App) warnf(format string, args ...any) {
81		fmt.Fprintf(a.Err, "dev: "+format+"\n", args...)
82	}
83	
84	// cdDirective emits the marker the shell wrapper installed by
85	// `dev shell-init` looks for. A child process cannot change its parent's
86	// working directory, so the only way `dev resume` can leave the user *in* the
87	// checkout is to ask the shell to do it.
88	func (a *App) cdDirective(dir string) {
89		fmt.Fprintf(a.Out, "cd %s\n", shellQuote(dir))
90	}
91	
92	// ctx is the cancellable context commands run under.
93	func ctxOf() context.Context { return context.Background() }
94

1	package cli

3	import (

10		"github.com/spf13/cobra"
11	)
12	
13	// Version is set at build time via -ldflags.
14	var Version = "dev"
15	
16	const rootLong = `dev is a thin glue layer over git, worktrees, forges and agent runtimes.
17	
18	It exists to keep three things separate that otherwise collapse into one:
19	
20	  git remote      durable code state, the source of truth
21	  git worktree    a disposable local checkout
22	  herdr / tmux    a per-host live runtime
23	  dev             human intent: what am I working on, and what is next
24	
25	Everything derivable from git or the runtime is derived live. dev persists only
26	what git cannot answer — a task's state, its owner and its next action — so
27	closing a runtime session never means losing the thread.`
28	
29	// NewRootCommand builds the whole command tree writing to the process streams.
30	func NewRootCommand() *cobra.Command {
31		return NewRootCommandWithIO(os.Stdout, os.Stderr)
32	}
33	
34	// NewRootCommandWithIO builds the command tree writing to the given streams.
35	// Commands write through App rather than through cobra, so this is the seam
36	// tests use to capture output without redirecting the process's file
37	// descriptors.
38	func NewRootCommandWithIO(out, errOut io.Writer) *cobra.Command {
39		app := &App{Out: out, Err: errOut}
40	
41		root := &cobra.Command{
42			Use:           "dev",
43			Short:         "Manage repos, worktrees and work-in-progress across agent runtimes",
44			Long:          rootLong,
45			Version:       Version,
46			SilenceUsage:  true,
47			SilenceErrors: true,
48			// Bare `dev` shows the inventory, which is the question the tool
49			// exists to answer.
50			RunE: func(cmd *cobra.Command, args []string) error {
51				if printSkill, _ := cmd.Flags().GetBool("skill"); printSkill {
52					out, err := skill.Render()
53					if err != nil {
54						return err
55					}
56					fmt.Fprint(app.Out, out)
57					return nil
58				}
59				// A terminal gets the dashboard; a pipe gets the listing, so
60				// `dev | grep` and `dev > file` behave as expected.
61				if interactive() {
62					return runTUI(app)
63				}
64				return runList(app, listOptions{})
65			},
66			PersistentPreRunE: func(cmd *cobra.Command, args []string) error {
67				return app.Load()
68			},
69		}
70	
71		pf := root.PersistentFlags()
72		pf.StringVar(&app.configPath, "config", "", "path to config.toml (default: $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/dev/config.toml)")
73		pf.StringVar(&app.runtimeOverride, "runtime", "", "override runtime backend: herdr, tmux or none")
74		pf.BoolVar(&app.noRuntime, "no-runtime", false, "do not touch any terminal multiplexer")
75	
76		// Mirrors `herdr --skill`: the binary is the authority for its own agent
77		// skill, so a dotfiles installer can sync it without vendoring a copy.
78		root.Flags().Bool("skill", false, "print the bundled agent skill and exit")
79	
80		root.AddCommand(
81			newListCmd(app),
82			newTUICmd(app),
83			newStatusCmd(app),
84			newStartCmd(app),
85			newParkCmd(app),
86			newResumeCmd(app),
87			newDoneCmd(app),
88			newSweepCmd(app),
89			newAdoptCmd(app),
90			newBootstrapCmd(app),
91			newWorktreeCmd(app),
92			newRepoCmd(app),
93			newGitignoreCmd(app),
94			newTryCmd(app),
95			newGraduateCmd(app),
96			newStatsCmd(app),
97			newHelpTopicCmd(app),
98			newSkillCmd(app),
99			newDoctorCmd(app),
100			newShellInitCmd(app),
101			newConfigCmd(app),
102			newCacheCmd(app),
103			newEditCmd(app),
104		)
105		root.SetHelpCommand(&cobra.Command{Hidden: true, Use: "no-help"})
106		root.SetOut(out)
107		root.SetErr(errOut)
108		return root
109	}
110	
111	// Execute runs the CLI and maps errors to exit codes.
112	func Execute() int {
113		root := NewRootCommand()
114		if err := root.Execute(); err != nil {
115			msg := err.Error()
116			// cobra already printed usage errors in a readable form.
117			if !strings.HasPrefix(msg, "unknown command") {
118				fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "dev: "+msg)
119			}
120			return 1
121		}
122		return 0
123	}

34	Shows exactly what "dev ls" shows, from the same code path, plus the ability

37	Three lists, switched with tab:
38

40	  REPOS   every repository under the scan roots — what do I have here
41	  REMOTE  repositories visible through gh and glab — what can I clone/open
42	
43	Navigation is vim-style, with arrows alongside:
44	
45	  j k        move                 ctrl+d ctrl+u   half a page
46	  g G        top / bottom         h l / tab       previous / next view
47	  /          filter as you type   esc             clear, then quit

49	Actions depend on the list:

53	  REMOTE  enter open local · c clone after confirmation
54

340					return tui.StatsPanel{}, err
341				}
342				defer store.Close()
343				until := time.Now()
344				since := until.AddDate(-1, 0, 0)
345				totals, err := store.DayTotals(stats.Query{
346					Since: since, Until: until, Repo: repoName, ExactRepo: true,
347				})
348				if err != nil {
349					return tui.StatsPanel{}, err
350				}
351				seconds, days := 0, 0
352				for _, value := range totals {
353					seconds += value
354					if value > 0 {
355						days++
356					}
357				}
358				return tui.StatsPanel{
359					Repo: repoName, Seconds: seconds, ActiveDays: days,
360					Since: since, Until: until,
361					Heatmap: stats.Heatmap(totals, stats.HeatmapOptions{
362						Since: since, Until: until, Legend: true, WeekdayLabels: true,
363					}),
364				}, nil
365			},
366	
367			BackfillStats: func(ctx context.Context, repoName string) error {
368				r, _, err := repo.Resolve(ctx, app.Cfg.ScanRoots(), repoName)
369				if err != nil {
370					return err
371				}
372				store, err := stats.Open(stats.Path(app.Cfg.StateDir()))
373				if err != nil {
374					return err
375				}
376				defer store.Close()
377				_, err = stats.BackfillGit(ctx, store, []repo.Repo{r}, time.Now().AddDate(-1, 0, 0), "")
378				return err
379			},

381			EditConfig: func() (*exec.Cmd, error) {
382				proc, _, _, err := configEditorProcess(app, "")
383				return proc, err
384			},

386			ReloadConfig: func(ctx context.Context) (tui.ConfigUpdate, string, error) {
387				oldRuntime := rt.Name()
388				if err := app.Load(); err != nil {
389					return tui.ConfigUpdate{}, "", err
390				}
391				status := "config + data reloaded"
392				if nextRuntime := app.Runtime().Name(); nextRuntime != oldRuntime {
393					status += fmt.Sprintf("; restart TUI to switch runtime %s → %s", oldRuntime, nextRuntime)
394				}
395				return tui.ConfigUpdate{
396					Tools:       externalTools(app),
397					RepoColumns: app.Cfg.EffectiveRepoColumns(),
398					RepoSort:    app.Cfg.EffectiveRepoSort(),
399					RepoReverse: app.Cfg.TUI.Repos.Reverse,
400				}, status, nil

404		// Enter the alternate screen immediately. Local inventory is loaded by
405		// Init in the background rather than making the terminal appear frozen
406		// while dozens of repos are probed.
407		model := tui.New(actions, nil, nil).BeginLoading()
408		if cached, ok := cachedRemoteRows(app); ok {
409			model = model.WithRemotes(cached)
410		}
411		final, err := tea.NewProgram(model, tea.WithAltScreen()).Run()
412		if err != nil {

414		}
415		// A directory choice can only be honoured once the alternate screen is
416		// torn down, and only by the shell wrapper.
417		if m, ok := final.(tui.Model); ok {
418			if dir := m.Chosen(); dir != "" {
419				app.cdDirective(dir)
420			}
421		}
422		return nil

425	// collectRepos builds the repository view: what exists, plus how much of it is
426	// in flight.
427	func collectRepos(ctx context.Context, app *App, rt runtime.Runtime) ([]tui.RepoRow, error) {
428		repos, err := repo.Discover(ctx, app.Cfg.ScanRoots(), repo.DefaultOptions())
429		if err != nil {
430			return nil, err
431		}
432		tasks, err := app.Tasks.List()
433		if err != nil {
434			return nil, err
435		}
436		byRepo := map[string][]*task.Task{}
437		for _, t := range tasks {
438			byRepo[t.RepoPath] = append(byRepo[t.RepoPath], t)
439		}
440		sessions, _ := rt.List(ctx)
441	
442		out := make([]tui.RepoRow, len(repos))
443		// Each repo needs status, worktree and remote subprocesses. Serialising
444		// ~3*56 git processes was the measured 4.2s startup bottleneck; eight
445		// workers brings that down without forking hundreds at once.
446		sem := make(chan struct{}, 8)
447		var wg sync.WaitGroup
448		for i, r := range repos {
449			wg.Add(1)
450			go func(i int, r repo.Repo) {
451				defer wg.Done()
452				sem <- struct{}{}
453				defer func() { <-sem }()
454	
455				row := tui.RepoRow{Repo: r}
456				row.Tasks = append(row.Tasks, byRepo[r.Path]...)
457				if r.RealPath != "" && r.RealPath != r.Path {
458					row.Tasks = append(row.Tasks, byRepo[r.RealPath]...)
459				}
460				if !r.Bare {
461					row.Status, _ = gitx.StatusOf(ctx, r.Path)
462					if row.Status.LatestChange.After(row.LastActivity) {
463						row.LastActivity = row.Status.LatestChange
464					}
465					// A normal clone stores one administrative directory per
466					// linked worktree. Reading it avoids spawning another git
467					// process for almost every repo in the main inventory.
468					if entries, err := os.ReadDir(filepath.Join(r.CommonDir, "worktrees")); err == nil {
469						for _, entry := range entries {
470							if entry.IsDir() {
471								row.Worktrees++
472							}
473						}
474					}
475					row.RemoteForge, row.RemoteName = forge.IdentityFromURL(gitx.RemoteFromConfig(r.CommonDir, "origin"))
476					if unix, _, err := gitx.LastCommit(ctx, r.Path); err == nil && unix > 0 {
477						commitTime := time.Unix(unix, 0)
478						if commitTime.After(row.LastActivity) {
479							row.LastActivity = commitTime
480						}
481					}
482				}
483				for _, tracked := range row.Tasks {
484					if tracked.Updated.After(row.LastActivity) {
485						row.LastActivity = tracked.Updated
486					}
487				}
488				for _, session := range sessions {
489					if session.Covers(r.Path) || (r.RealPath != "" && session.Covers(r.RealPath)) {
490						row.Live = true
491						row.Runtime, row.RuntimeHandle, row.RuntimeStatus =
492							rt.Name(), session.Handle, session.AgentStatus
493						break
494					}
495				}
496				out[i] = row
497			}(i, r)
498		}
499		wg.Wait()
500		return out, ctx.Err()
501	}
502	
503	// externalTools resolves the configured tool bindings.
504	//
505	// Configurable rather than fixed because which program you reach for is
506	// personal, and because the useful ones are often your own scripts and
507	// aliases, not just the well-known tools.
508	func externalTools(app *App) []tui.Tool {
509		var out []tui.Tool
510		for _, t := range app.Cfg.EffectiveTools() {
511			run := t.Run
512			name := t.Name
513			if name == "" {
514				name = firstWord(run)
515			}
516			command := []string{shellPath(), "-c", run}
517			if t.Interactive {
518				// The command string passed to shell -lic is parsed before some
519				// shells finish loading aliases. Parse only eval "$1" up front,
520				// then evaluate the configured command after rc loading, so both
521				// aliases (vibe) and functions (claude-plans-here) work.
522				command = []string{shellPath(), "-lic", `eval "$1"`, "dev-tui-tool", run}
523			}
524			out = append(out, tui.Tool{
525				Key: t.Key, Name: name, Command: command,
526				Available: commandRunnable(run, t.Interactive),
527			})
528		}
529		return out
530	}
531	
532	// commandRunnable resolves the command's first word on PATH, expanding a
533	// leading environment variable so "$EDITOR ." checks the editor itself.
534	func commandRunnable(run string, interactive bool) func() bool {
535		// Availability is stable for the lifetime of one dashboard. In particular,
536		// probing an interactive alias starts a login shell; doing that on every
537		// render would turn a 60fps UI into a shell-launch benchmark.
538		var once sync.Once
539		available := false
540		return func() bool {
541			once.Do(func() { available = checkCommandRunnable(run, interactive) })
542			return available
543		}
544	}
545	
546	func checkCommandRunnable(run string, interactive bool) bool {
547		word := firstWord(run)
548		if strings.HasPrefix(word, "$") {
549			word = os.Getenv(strings.TrimPrefix(word, "$"))
550			if word == "" {
551				return false
552			}
553			word = firstWord(word)
554		}
555		if word == "" {
556			return false
557		}
558		if interactive {
559			// Ask the configured shell after it loads its rc files; LookPath
560			// cannot see aliases or functions.
561			ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 3*time.Second)
562			defer cancel()
563			probe := exec.CommandContext(ctx, shellPath(), "-lic",
564				`command -v "$1" >/dev/null 2>&1`, "dev-tool-probe", word)
565			return probe.Run() == nil
566		}
567		if filepath.IsAbs(word) {
568			_, err := os.Stat(word)
569			return err == nil
570		}
571		_, err := exec.LookPath(word)
572		return err == nil
573	}
574	
575	func firstWord(s string) string {
576		f := strings.Fields(s)
577		if len(f) == 0 {
578			return ""
579		}
580		return f[0]
581	}
582	
583	func shellPath() string {
584		if s := os.Getenv("SHELL"); s != "" {
585			return s
586		}
587		return "/bin/sh"
588	}
589	
590	// remoteCachePath is private because the inventory can contain names and URLs
591	// of private repositories.
592	func remoteCachePath() string {
593		return filepath.Join(config.CacheHome(), "dev", "remotes.json")
594	}
595	
596	// cachedRemoteRows reads only the private JSON cache — no repository scan or
597	// subprocess — so it is safe on the startup path. Local clone markers are
598	// filled when the background local inventory arrives.
599	func cachedRemoteRows(app *App) ([]tui.RemoteRow, bool) {
600		cache, ok := forge.LoadCache(remoteCachePath(), app.Cfg.Forge.CacheTTL.Duration)
601		if !ok {
602			return nil, false
603		}
604		out := make([]tui.RemoteRow, 0, len(cache.Repos))
605		for _, rr := range cache.Repos {
606			out = append(out, tui.RemoteRow{Repo: rr})
607		}
608		return out, true
609	}
610	
611	// cachedRemotesForRepoRows uses the local repo data the dashboard already
612	// collected, avoiding another process-spawning scan on startup.
613	func cachedRemotesForRepoRows(app *App, locals []tui.RepoRow) ([]tui.RemoteRow, bool) {
614		cache, ok := forge.LoadCache(remoteCachePath(), app.Cfg.Forge.CacheTTL.Duration)
615		if !ok {
616			return nil, false
617		}
618		byRemote := map[string]tui.RepoRow{}
619		for _, r := range locals {
620			if r.RemoteForge != forge.Unknown && r.RemoteName != "" {
621				byRemote[string(r.RemoteForge)+"/"+strings.ToLower(r.RemoteName)] = r
622			}
623		}
624		out := make([]tui.RemoteRow, 0, len(cache.Repos))
625		for _, rr := range cache.Repos {
626			row := tui.RemoteRow{Repo: rr}
627			if local, ok := byRemote[string(rr.Forge)+"/"+strings.ToLower(rr.FullName)]; ok {
628				row.LocalPath, row.LocalName = local.Repo.Path, local.Repo.Display()
629			}
630			out = append(out, row)
631		}
632		return out, true
633	}
634	
635	// cachedRemotes returns a fresh, already-local-matched cache for instant TUI
636	// navigation. Local paths are recomputed rather than cached because clones can
637	// move independently of the forge inventory.
638	func cachedRemotes(ctx context.Context, app *App) ([]tui.RemoteRow, bool) {
639		cache, ok := forge.LoadCache(remoteCachePath(), app.Cfg.Forge.CacheTTL.Duration)
640		if !ok {
641			return nil, false
642		}
643		return matchRemoteLocals(ctx, app, cache.Repos), true
644	}
645	
646	// collectRemotes aggregates gh and glab, caches the normalised response, then
647	// marks remotes that already have a checkout under the configured scan roots.
648	// Calls run concurrently so one slow forge does not serialise the other.
649	func collectRemotes(ctx context.Context, app *App, limit int) ([]tui.RemoteRow, error) {
650		if limit <= 0 {
651			limit = app.Cfg.Forge.RemoteLimit
652		}
653		type result struct {
654			repos []forge.RemoteRepo
655			err   error
656		}
657		ch := make(chan result, len(forge.All()))
658		var wg sync.WaitGroup
659		available := 0
660		for _, f := range forge.All() {
661			if !f.Available() {
662				continue
663			}
664			available++
665			wg.Add(1)
666			go func(f forge.Forge) {
667				defer wg.Done()
668				r, err := f.ListRepos(ctx, limit)
669				ch <- result{repos: r, err: err}
670			}(f)
671		}
672		wg.Wait()
673		close(ch)
674		if available == 0 {
675			return nil, fmt.Errorf("neither gh nor glab is installed")
676		}
677	
678		var (
679			remoteRepos []forge.RemoteRepo
680			errs        []error
681		)
682		for res := range ch {
683			if res.err != nil {
684				errs = append(errs, res.err)
685			}
686			remoteRepos = append(remoteRepos, res.repos...)
687		}
688		// Cache partial results too. They are exactly what was observed, and a
689		// partial list is more useful on the next switch than another six-second
690		// wait merely to rediscover the same provider failure.
691		if len(remoteRepos) > 0 && limit >= app.Cfg.Forge.RemoteLimit {
692			_ = forge.SaveCache(remoteCachePath(), remoteRepos)
693		}
694		return matchRemoteLocals(ctx, app, remoteRepos), errors.Join(errs...)
695	}
696	
697	func matchRemoteLocals(ctx context.Context, app *App, remoteRepos []forge.RemoteRepo) []tui.RemoteRow {
698		locals, _ := repo.Discover(ctx, app.Cfg.ScanRoots(), repo.DefaultOptions())
699		localByRemote := map[string]repo.Repo{}
700		for _, r := range locals {
701			if r.Bare {
702				continue
703			}
704			kind, name := forge.IdentityFromURL(gitx.RemoteFromConfig(r.CommonDir, "origin"))
705			if kind != forge.Unknown && name != "" {
706				localByRemote[string(kind)+"/"+strings.ToLower(name)] = r
707			}
708		}
709		out := make([]tui.RemoteRow, 0, len(remoteRepos))
710		for _, rr := range remoteRepos {
711			row := tui.RemoteRow{Repo: rr}
712			if local, ok := localByRemote[string(rr.Forge)+"/"+strings.ToLower(rr.FullName)]; ok {
713				row.LocalPath, row.LocalName = local.Path, local.Display()
714			}
715			out = append(out, row)
716		}
717		return out
718	}

1	package gitx
2	
3	import (
4		"context"
5		"strings"
6	)
7	
8	// Worktree is one entry of `git worktree list --porcelain`.
9	type Worktree struct {
10		Path string
11		// Head is the commit the worktree is checked out at.
12		Head string
13		// Branch is the short branch name, empty when detached.
14		Branch   string
15		Detached bool
16		Bare     bool
17		// Locked reports a `git worktree lock`; Prunable reports a checkout whose
18		// directory has gone missing. Both block a plain remove.
19		Locked         bool
20		LockedReason   string
21		Prunable       bool
22		PrunableReason string
23		// Main reports the primary (non-linked) checkout.
24		Main bool
25	}
26	
27	// Worktrees lists every worktree of the repository containing dir, in git's
28	// own order: the main checkout first, then linked worktrees.
29	func Worktrees(ctx context.Context, dir string) ([]Worktree, error) {
30		out, err := run(ctx, dir, "worktree", "list", "--porcelain")
31		if err != nil {
32			return nil, err
33		}
34		var (
35			list []Worktree
36			cur  *Worktree
37		)
38		flush := func() {
39			if cur != nil {
40				list = append(list, *cur)
41				cur = nil
42			}
43		}
44		for _, line := range strings.Split(out, "\n") {
45			if line == "" { // records are blank-line separated
46				flush()
47				continue
48			}
49			key, val, _ := strings.Cut(line, " ")
50			switch key {
51			case "worktree":
52				flush()
53				cur = &Worktree{Path: val, Main: len(list) == 0}
54			case "HEAD":
55				if cur != nil {
56					cur.Head = val
57				}
58			case "branch":
59				if cur != nil {
60					cur.Branch = strings.TrimPrefix(val, "refs/heads/")
61				}
62			case "detached":
63				if cur != nil {
64					cur.Detached = true
65				}
66			case "bare":
67				if cur != nil {
68					cur.Bare = true
69				}
70			case "locked":
71				if cur != nil {
72					cur.Locked, cur.LockedReason = true, val
73				}
74			case "prunable":
75				if cur != nil {
76					cur.Prunable, cur.PrunableReason = true, val
77				}
78			}
79		}
80		flush()
81		return list, nil
82	}
83	
84	// WorktreeFor finds the worktree checked out on branch, if any. Git refuses to
85	// check the same branch out twice, so at most one can match.
86	func WorktreeFor(ctx context.Context, dir, branch string) (Worktree, bool, error) {
87		list, err := Worktrees(ctx, dir)
88		if err != nil {
89			return Worktree{}, false, err
90		}
91		for _, w := range list {
92			if w.Branch == branch {
93				return w, true, nil
94			}
95		}
96		return Worktree{}, false, nil
97	}
98	
99	// AddWorktree creates a linked worktree at path.
100	//
101	// When branch already exists it is checked out; otherwise it is created from
102	// base. Passing an explicit base matters: without one git branches from the
103	// *current* HEAD, so a worktree created while standing on feature/A would
104	// silently inherit feature/A's commits.
105	func AddWorktree(ctx context.Context, dir, path, branch, base string) error {
106		exists := BranchExists(ctx, dir, branch)
107		args := []string{"worktree", "add"}
108		if exists {
109			args = append(args, path, branch)
110		} else {
111			args = append(args, "-b", branch, path)
112			if base != "" {
113				args = append(args, base)
114			}
115		}
116		_, err := run(ctx, dir, args...)
117		return err
118	}
119	
120	// RemoveWorktree removes a linked worktree checkout. It never deletes the
121	// branch — that is a separate, explicit decision.
122	func RemoveWorktree(ctx context.Context, dir, path string, force bool) error {
123		args := []string{"worktree", "remove"}
124		if force {
125			args = append(args, "--force")
126		}
127		args = append(args, path)
128		_, err := run(ctx, dir, args...)
129		return err
130	}
131	
132	// PruneWorktrees clears administrative entries for checkouts whose directories
133	// were deleted behind git's back.
134	func PruneWorktrees(ctx context.Context, dir string) error {
135		_, err := run(ctx, dir, "worktree", "prune")
136		return err
137	}
138	
139	// BranchExists reports whether a local branch of that name exists.
140	func BranchExists(ctx context.Context, dir, branch string) bool {
141		if branch == "" {
142			return false
143		}
144		_, err := run(ctx, dir, "show-ref", "--verify", "--quiet", "refs/heads/"+branch)
145		return err == nil
146	}
147	
148	// RefExists reports whether any ref or commit-ish resolves.
149	func RefExists(ctx context.Context, dir, ref string) bool {
150		if ref == "" {
151			return false
152		}
153		_, err := run(ctx, dir, "rev-parse", "--verify", "--quiet", ref+"^{commit}")
154		return err == nil
155	}

1	package gitx
