```text
3	import (
4		"context"
5		"os"
6		"path/filepath"
7		"strings"
8	)
9	
10	// Repo identifies one repository, independent of which worktree you are
11	// standing in. Two linked worktrees of the same clone share a Key.
12	type Repo struct {
13		// Root is the working-tree root of the checkout that was probed.
14		Root string
15		// GitCommonDir is the shared .git directory — the same value for every
16		// worktree of a clone, which makes it the natural identity.
17		GitCommonDir string
18		// Name is the basename users recognise the repo by.
19		Name string
20		// IsLinkedWorktree reports whether Root is a linked worktree rather than
21		// the main checkout.
22		IsLinkedWorktree bool
23		// MainRoot is the main (non-linked) checkout of this clone.
24		MainRoot string
25		// Bare reports whether the main checkout is a bare repository.
26		Bare bool
27	}
28	
29	// Key is the stable identity of the clone, shared by all its worktrees.
30	func (r Repo) Key() string { return r.GitCommonDir }
31	
32	// Discover probes dir and reports the repository containing it.
33	func Discover(ctx context.Context, dir string) (Repo, error) {
34		// A single rev-parse call answers everything: batching avoids four
35		// process spawns per repo, which matters when scanning 39 of them.
36		out, err := run(ctx, dir,
37			"rev-parse",
38			"--path-format=absolute",
39			"--show-toplevel",
40			"--git-common-dir",
41			"--is-bare-repository",
42		)
43		if err != nil {
44			return Repo{}, err
45		}
46		f := lines(out)
47		r := Repo{}
48		// A bare repo has no toplevel, so git prints one fewer line.
49		switch len(f) {
50		case 3:
51			r.Root = f[0]
52			r.GitCommonDir = f[1]
53			r.Bare = f[2] == "true"
54		case 2:
55			r.GitCommonDir = f[0]
56			r.Bare = f[1] == "true"
57		default:
58			return Repo{}, ErrNotARepo
59		}
60	
61		// The main checkout is the parent of the common .git dir, except for a
62		// bare repo (where the common dir *is* the repo).
63		if r.Bare {
64			r.MainRoot = strings.TrimSuffix(r.GitCommonDir, string(filepath.Separator))
65		} else {
66			r.MainRoot = filepath.Dir(r.GitCommonDir)
67		}
68		r.IsLinkedWorktree = r.Root != "" && r.Root != r.MainRoot
69		r.Name = filepath.Base(r.MainRoot)
70		if r.Bare {
71			// ".../foo/.bare" or ".../foo.git" should both read as "foo".
72			r.Name = strings.TrimSuffix(filepath.Base(r.MainRoot), ".git")
73			if strings.HasPrefix(r.Name, ".") {
74				r.Name = filepath.Base(filepath.Dir(r.MainRoot))
75			}
76		}
77		return r, nil
78	}
79	
80	// IsRepo reports whether dir is inside a git working tree, without the cost of
81	// a full Discover.
82	func IsRepo(ctx context.Context, dir string) bool {
83		_, err := run(ctx, dir, "rev-parse", "--git-dir")
84		return err == nil
85	}
86	
87	// DefaultBranch resolves the repository's default branch — origin/HEAD when the
88	// remote advertises it, else the first of main/master that exists locally.
89	// Returns "" when nothing can be determined, which callers must treat as
90	// "ask the user" rather than guessing.
91	func DefaultBranch(ctx context.Context, dir string) string {
92		if out, err := run(ctx, dir, "symbolic-ref", "--short", "refs/remotes/origin/HEAD"); err == nil {
93			if _, b, ok := strings.Cut(out, "/"); ok {
94				return b
95			}
96		}
97		for _, cand := range []string{"main", "master", "trunk", "develop"} {
98			if _, err := run(ctx, dir, "show-ref", "--verify", "--quiet", "refs/heads/"+cand); err == nil {
99				return cand
100			}
101		}
102		return ""
103	}
104	
105	// Remote returns the push URL of the named remote ("origin" when empty).
106	func Remote(ctx context.Context, dir, name string) string {
107		if name == "" {
108			name = "origin"
109		}
110		out, err := run(ctx, dir, "remote", "get-url", name)
111		if err != nil {
112			return ""
113		}
114		return out
115	}
116	
117	// RemoteFromConfig reads one remote URL directly from a Git common directory.
118	// It is the zero-process path used by whole-machine inventory, where spawning
119	// `git remote get-url` once per repo dominated startup. Includes and URL
120	// rewriting are deliberately not evaluated; callers that need Git's complete
121	// semantics should use Remote instead.
122	func RemoteFromConfig(commonDir, name string) string {
123		if commonDir == "" {
124			return ""
125		}
126		if name == "" {
127			name = "origin"
128		}
129		b, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(commonDir, "config"))
130		if err != nil {
131			return ""
132		}
133		want := `remote "` + name + `"`
134		section := ""
135		for _, raw := range strings.Split(string(b), "\n") {
136			line := strings.TrimSpace(raw)
137			if line == "" || strings.HasPrefix(line, "#") || strings.HasPrefix(line, ";") {
138				continue
139			}
140			if strings.HasPrefix(line, "[") && strings.HasSuffix(line, "]") {
141				section = strings.TrimSpace(line[1 : len(line)-1])
142				continue
143			}
144			if section != want {
145				continue
146			}
147			key, value, ok := strings.Cut(line, "=")
148			if ok && strings.TrimSpace(key) == "url" {
149				return strings.Trim(strings.TrimSpace(value), `"`)
150			}
151		}
152		return ""
153	}
```

```text
15	// RepoRow is one repository as the dashboard shows it: what it is, plus how
16	// much of it is currently in flight.
17	//
18	// The repository view exists because the task list alone answers only half the
19	// question. On a machine with forty repositories and no tasks recorded yet,
20	// a task-only dashboard is empty — and the honest answer to "what do I have
21	// here?" has to come before "what am I working on?"
22	type RepoRow struct {
23		Repo   repo.Repo
24		Status gitx.Status
25		// LastActivity is the newest commit time in this checkout. It is a durable,
26		// cheap approximation of "when was this repo last touched" and is sortable.
27		LastActivity time.Time
28		// Worktrees is the number of linked worktrees, excluding the main checkout.
29		Worktrees int
30		// Tasks are the recorded tasks belonging to this repository.
31		Tasks []*task.Task
32		// Live reports a runtime session sitting in this repository.
33		Live          bool
34		Runtime       string
35		RuntimeHandle string
36		RuntimeStatus string
37		// RemoteForge / RemoteName identify origin for matching the REMOTE view to
38		// this local checkout without rescanning every repo when a cache opens.
39		RemoteForge forge.Kind
40		RemoteName  string
41	}
42	
43	// HotTasks counts the repository's tasks that are currently hot.
44	func (r RepoRow) HotTasks() int {
45		n := 0
46		for _, t := range r.Tasks {
47			if t.State == task.Hot {
48				n++
49			}
50		}
51		return n
52	}
53	
54	// StateSummary renders the repository's tasks as a compact per-state tally,
55	// which is what makes the list scannable at forty repositories.
56	func (r RepoRow) StateSummary() string {
57		if len(r.Tasks) == 0 {
58			return ""
59		}
60		counts := map[task.State]int{}
61		for _, t := range r.Tasks {
62			counts[t.State]++
63		}
64		var parts []string
65		for _, s := range task.States {
66			if counts[s] > 0 {
67				parts = append(parts, s.Icon()+strconv.Itoa(counts[s]))
68			}
69		}
70		return strings.Join(parts, " ")
71	}
72	
73	// searchText is what a filter query matches against.
74	func (r RepoRow) searchText() string {
75		var b strings.Builder
76		b.WriteString(r.Repo.Display())
77		b.WriteString(" ")
78		b.WriteString(r.Status.Branch)
79		for _, t := range r.Tasks {
80			b.WriteString(" ")
81			b.WriteString(t.Title())
82			b.WriteString(" ")
83			b.WriteString(t.Branch)
84		}
85		return strings.ToLower(b.String())
86	}
87	
88	// taskSearchText is what a filter query matches a task row against.
89	func taskSearchText(r inventory.Row) string {
90		t := r.Task
91		return strings.ToLower(strings.Join([]string{
92			t.Title(), t.Repo, t.Branch, t.Next, t.Note, string(t.State),
93		}, " "))
94	}
95	
96	// matches reports whether every whitespace-separated term of the query appears
97	// in the haystack.
98	//
99	// Term-wise rather than substring so "auth api" finds a task named "api token
100	// auth" — the order words come to mind in is rarely the order they appear in.
101	func matches(haystack, query string) bool {
102		query = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(query))
103		if query == "" {
104			return true
105		}
106		for _, term := range strings.Fields(query) {
107			if !strings.Contains(haystack, term) {
108				return false
109			}
110		}
111		return true
112	}

123		LocalName string `json:"local_name,omitempty"`
```

```text
286	
287	func (m Model) reloadConfig(refreshRemote bool) tea.Cmd {
288		return func() tea.Msg {
289			if m.actions.ReloadConfig == nil {
290				return configMsg{refreshRemote: refreshRemote}
291			}
292			update, status, err := m.actions.ReloadConfig(context.Background())
293			return configMsg{update: update, status: status, refreshRemote: refreshRemote, err: err}
294		}
295	}
296	
297	func (m Model) reloadAfterConfig(refreshRemote bool) tea.Cmd {
298		return func() tea.Msg {
299			ctx := context.Background()
300			out := reloadMsg{}
301			if m.actions.Reload != nil {
302				out.rows, out.err = m.actions.Reload(ctx)
303			}
304			if m.actions.ReloadRepos != nil {
305				var err error
306				out.repos, err = m.actions.ReloadRepos(ctx)
307				if out.err == nil {
308					out.err = err
309				}
310			}
311			if refreshRemote && m.actions.ReloadRemote != nil {
312				var err error
313				out.remotes, err = m.actions.ReloadRemote(ctx)
314				out.remoteSet = true
315				if out.err == nil {
316					out.err = err
317				}
318			}
319			return out
320		}
321	}
322	
323	// visibleTasks applies the state filter and the text query.
324	func (m Model) visibleTasks() []inventory.Row {
325		var out []inventory.Row
326		for _, r := range m.rows {
327			if len(m.states) > 0 {
328				if !containsState(m.states, r.Task.State) {
329					continue
330				}
331			} else if r.Task.State == task.Done && !m.showDone {
332				continue
333			}
334			if !matches(taskSearchText(r), m.filter) {
335				continue
336			}
337			out = append(out, r)
338		}
339		return out
340	}
341	
342	// visibleRepos applies the text query, and sorts repositories with work in
343	// flight to the top — that is what someone opening the dashboard is looking
344	// for, not alphabetical order.
345	func (m Model) visibleRepos() []RepoRow {
346		var out []RepoRow
347		for _, r := range m.repos {
348			if !matches(r.searchText(), m.filter) {
349				continue
350			}
351			out = append(out, r)
352		}
353		sortBy := m.actions.RepoSort
354		if sortBy == "" {
355			sortBy = "activity"
356		}
357		sort.SliceStable(out, func(i, j int) bool {
358			cmp := compareRepos(out[i], out[j], sortBy)
359			if m.actions.RepoReverse {
360				return cmp > 0
361			}
362			return cmp < 0
363		})
364		return out
365	}
366	
367	// visibleRemotes filters the combined gh/glab inventory. Local clones sort
368	// first, then recently updated repositories.
369	func (m Model) visibleRemotes() []RemoteRow {
370		var out []RemoteRow
371		for _, r := range m.remotes {
372			if matches(r.searchText(), m.filter) {
373				out = append(out, r)
374			}
375		}
376		sort.SliceStable(out, func(i, j int) bool {
377			if out[i].Cloned() != out[j].Cloned() {
378				return out[i].Cloned()
379			}
380			if !out[i].Repo.UpdatedAt.Equal(out[j].Repo.UpdatedAt) {
381				return out[i].Repo.UpdatedAt.After(out[j].Repo.UpdatedAt)
382			}
383			return out[i].Repo.Label() < out[j].Repo.Label()
384		})
385		return out
386	}
387	
388	// compareRepos returns negative when a belongs before b.
389	func compareRepos(a, b RepoRow, sortBy string) int {
390		nameCmp := strings.Compare(strings.ToLower(a.Repo.Display()), strings.ToLower(b.Repo.Display()))
391		descInt := func(x, y int) int {
392			switch {
393			case x > y:
394				return -1
395			case x < y:
396				return 1
397			default:
398				return 0
399			}
400		}
401		descBool := func(x, y bool) int {
402			if x == y {
403				return 0
404			}
405			if x {
406				return -1
407			}
408			return 1
409		}
410		latest := func() int {
411			if a.LastActivity.Equal(b.LastActivity) {
412				return 0
413			}
414			if a.LastActivity.After(b.LastActivity) {
415				return -1
416			}
417			return 1
418		}
419	
420		switch sortBy {
421		case "name":
422			return nameCmp
423		case "latest":
424			if c := latest(); c != 0 {
425				return c
426			}
427		case "git":
428			if c := descBool(a.Status.Dirty(), b.Status.Dirty()); c != 0 {
429				return c
430			}
431			if c := descInt(a.Status.Changed, b.Status.Changed); c != 0 {
432				return c
433			}
434		case "tasks":
435			if c := descInt(a.HotTasks(), b.HotTasks()); c != 0 {
436				return c
437			}
438			if c := descInt(len(a.Tasks), len(b.Tasks)); c != 0 {
439				return c
440			}
441		default: // activity
442			if c := descInt(a.HotTasks(), b.HotTasks()); c != 0 {
443				return c
444			}
445			if c := descBool(a.Live, b.Live); c != 0 {
446				return c
447			}
448			if c := descBool(a.Status.Dirty(), b.Status.Dirty()); c != 0 {
449				return c
450			}
451			if c := descInt(len(a.Tasks), len(b.Tasks)); c != 0 {
452				return c
453			}
454			if c := latest(); c != 0 {
455				return c
456			}
457		}
458		return nameCmp
459	}
460	
461	func containsState(list []task.State, s task.State) bool {
462		for _, v := range list {
463			if v == s {
464				return true
465			}
466		}
467		return false
468	}
469	
470	// count is how many rows the current view has.
471	func (m Model) count() int {
472		switch m.view {
473		case ViewRepos:
474			return len(m.visibleRepos())
475		case ViewRemote:
476			return len(m.visibleRemotes())
477		default:
478			return len(m.visibleTasks())
479		}
480	}
481	
482	// at is the cursor position in the current view.
483	func (m Model) at() int {
484		switch m.view {
485		case ViewRepos:
486			return m.repoCursor
487		case ViewRemote:
488			return m.remoteCursor
489		default:
490			return m.taskCursor
491		}
492	}
493	
494	// setAt moves the cursor, clamped to the current view's length.
495	func (m *Model) setAt(i int) {
496		n := m.count()
497		switch {
498		case n == 0:
499			i = 0
500		case i >= n:
501			i = n - 1
502		case i < 0:
503			i = 0
504		}
505		switch m.view {
506		case ViewRepos:
507			m.repoCursor = i
508		case ViewRemote:
509			m.remoteCursor = i
510		default:
511			m.taskCursor = i
512		}
513	}
514	
515	// currentTask returns the selected task, if the task view is showing one.
516	func (m Model) currentTask() (inventory.Row, bool) {
517		if m.view != ViewTasks {
518			return inventory.Row{}, false
519		}
520		rows := m.visibleTasks()
521		if m.at() >= len(rows) {
522			return inventory.Row{}, false
523		}
524		return rows[m.at()], true
525	}
526	
527	// currentRepo returns the selected repository, if the repo view is showing one.
528	func (m Model) currentRepo() (RepoRow, bool) {
529		if m.view != ViewRepos {
530			return RepoRow{}, false
531		}
532		repos := m.visibleRepos()
533		if m.at() >= len(repos) {
534			return RepoRow{}, false
535		}
536		return repos[m.at()], true
537	}
538	
539	// currentRemote returns the selected forge repository.
540	func (m Model) currentRemote() (RemoteRow, bool) {
541		if m.view != ViewRemote {
542			return RemoteRow{}, false
543		}
544		rows := m.visibleRemotes()
545		if m.at() >= len(rows) {
546			return RemoteRow{}, false
547		}
548		return rows[m.at()], true
549	}
550	
551	// matchRemoteLocals fills cached remote rows from the freshly loaded local
552	// inventory without another scan.
553	func (m *Model) matchRemoteLocals() {
554		byRemote := map[string]RepoRow{}
555		for _, r := range m.repos {
556			if r.RemoteName != "" {
557				byRemote[string(r.RemoteForge)+"/"+strings.ToLower(r.RemoteName)] = r
558			}
559		}
560		for i := range m.remotes {
561			key := string(m.remotes[i].Repo.Forge) + "/" + strings.ToLower(m.remotes[i].Repo.FullName)
562			if local, ok := byRemote[key]; ok {
563				m.remotes[i].LocalPath = local.Repo.Path
564				m.remotes[i].LocalName = local.Repo.Display()
565			} else {
566				m.remotes[i].LocalPath, m.remotes[i].LocalName = "", ""
567			}
568		}
569	}
570	
571	// currentDir is the checkout the selected row points at, for the external
572	// tools and for the cd directive.
573	func (m Model) currentDir() string {
574		if r, ok := m.currentTask(); ok {
575			if r.CheckoutExists {
576				return r.Checkout
577			}
578			return ""
579		}
580		if r, ok := m.currentRepo(); ok {
581			return r.Repo.Path
582		}
583		if r, ok := m.currentRemote(); ok {
584			return r.LocalPath
585		}
586		return ""
587	}
588	
589	// Update implements tea.Model.
590	func (m Model) Update(msg tea.Msg) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
591		switch msg := msg.(type) {
592		case tea.WindowSizeMsg:
593			m.width, m.height = msg.Width, msg.Height
594			return m, nil
595	
596		case reloadMsg:
597			m.loadingLocal = false
598			if msg.err != nil {
599				m.err = msg.err
600				return m, nil
601			}
602			m.err = nil
603			if msg.rows != nil {
604				m.rows = msg.rows
605			}
606			if msg.repos != nil {
607				m.repos = msg.repos
608				m.matchRemoteLocals()
609			}
610			if msg.remoteSet {
611				m.remotes, m.remotesLoaded, m.remotesLoading = msg.remotes, true, false
612			}
613			m.setAt(m.at())
614			return m, nil
615	
616		case remoteMsg:
617			m.remotes, m.remotesLoaded, m.remotesLoading = msg.rows, true, false
618			m.err = msg.err
619			m.status = ""
620			m.setAt(m.at())
621			return m, nil
622	
623		case statsBackfilledMsg:
624			if msg.err != nil {
625				m.err, m.status = msg.err, ""
626				return m, nil
627			}
628			m.status = "backfill complete; loading heatmap…"
629			return m, m.loadStats(msg.repo)
630	
631		case configEditedMsg:
632			if msg.err != nil {
633				m.err, m.status = msg.err, ""
634				return m, nil
635			}
636			m.status = "reloading config…"
637			return m, m.reloadConfig(m.view == ViewRemote)
638	
639		case configMsg:
640			if msg.err != nil {
641				m.err, m.status = msg.err, ""
642				return m, nil
643			}
644			m.actions.Tools = msg.update.Tools
645			m.actions.RepoColumns = msg.update.RepoColumns
646			m.actions.RepoSort = msg.update.RepoSort
647			m.actions.RepoReverse = msg.update.RepoReverse
648			m.err, m.status = nil, msg.status
649			return m, m.reloadAfterConfig(msg.refreshRemote)
650	
651		case statsMsg:
652			if msg.err != nil {
653				m.err = msg.err
654				m.stats = nil
655			} else {
656				m.err = nil
657				m.stats = &msg.panel
658			}
659			m.status = ""
660			return m, nil
661	
662		case actionMsg:
663			if msg.err != nil {
664				m.err = msg.err
665				return m, nil
666			}
667			m.err, m.status = nil, msg.status
668			if msg.remoteName != "" && msg.localPath != "" {
669				for i := range m.remotes {
670					if m.remotes[i].Repo.FullName == msg.remoteName {
671						m.remotes[i].LocalPath = msg.localPath
672						break
673					}
674				}
675			}
676			if msg.cd != "" {
677				// Under a runtime with no sessions the only useful outcome is
678				// putting the user in the directory, which needs the alternate
679				// screen torn down first.
680				m.chosen, m.quitting = msg.cd, true
681				return m, tea.Quit
682			}
683			if m.view == ViewRemote {
684				// Clone already updated the selected row; only local repo/task
685				// state needs a refresh. A network round-trip here would make a
686				// successful clone feel hung for several seconds.
687				return m, m.reload()
688			}
689			return m, m.reload()
690	
691		case tea.KeyMsg:
692			if m.mode == modeStats {
693				return m.updateStats(msg)
694			}
695			switch m.mode {
696			case modeFilter:
697				return m.updateFilter(msg)
698			case modeEditNext, modeConfirmPark, modeStartTask, modeStartDirect, modeConfirmClone:
699				return m.updatePrompt(msg)
700			}
701			return m.updateList(msg)
702		}
703		return m, nil
704	}
705	
706	func (m Model) updateList(msg tea.KeyMsg) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
707		n := m.count()
708		page := m.listHeight() / 2
709		if page < 1 {
710			page = 1
711		}
712	
713		switch msg.String() {
714		case "q", "ctrl+c":
715			m.quitting = true
716			return m, tea.Quit
717		case "esc":
718			// One escape clears whatever narrowing is in effect before quitting
719			// becomes the meaning of the key.
720			if m.filter != "" || len(m.states) > 0 {
721				m.filter, m.states = "", nil
722				m.setAt(0)
723				return m, nil
724			}
725			m.quitting = true
726			return m, tea.Quit
727	
728		// Vim-style movement, with the arrow equivalents alongside.
729		case "j", "down", "ctrl+n":
730			m.setAt(m.at() + 1)
731		case "k", "up", "ctrl+p":
732			m.setAt(m.at() - 1)
733		case "ctrl+d", "pgdown":
734			m.setAt(m.at() + page)
735		case "ctrl+u", "pgup":
736			m.setAt(m.at() - page)
737		case "g", "home":
738			m.setAt(0)
739		case "G", "end":
740			m.setAt(n - 1)
741	
742		// View switching. h/l double as left/right between views, since a list has
743		// no horizontal axis of its own.
744		case "tab", "l", "right":
745			m.view = Views[(int(m.view)+1)%len(Views)]
746			return m.afterViewSwitch()
747		case "shift+tab", "h", "left":
748			m.view = Views[(int(m.view)+len(Views)-1)%len(Views)]
749			return m.afterViewSwitch()
750	
751		case "/":
752			m.mode = modeFilter
753			m.input.SetValue(m.filter)
754			m.input.Placeholder = "filter"
755			m.input.CursorEnd()
756			m.input.Focus()
757			return m, textinput.Blink
758	
759		case "r":
760			m.status = "reloading config + data…"
761			if m.view == ViewRemote {
762				m.remotesLoading = true
763			}
764			return m, m.reloadConfig(m.view == ViewRemote)
765	
766		case "1":
767			m.states, m.showDone = []task.State{task.Hot}, false
768			m.view = ViewTasks
769			m.setAt(0)
770		case "2":
771			m.states, m.showDone = []task.State{task.Warm}, false
772			m.view = ViewTasks
773			m.setAt(0)
774		case "3":
775			m.states, m.showDone = []task.State{task.Cold}, false
776			m.view = ViewTasks
777			m.setAt(0)
778		case "0":
779			m.states, m.filter = nil, ""
780			m.setAt(0)
781		case "a":
782			m.showDone, m.states = !m.showDone, nil
783			m.setAt(0)
784	
785		case "enter", "o":
786			return m, m.openSelected()
787	
788		case "p":
789			if _, ok := m.currentTask(); !ok {
790				return m, nil
791			}
792			return m.prompt(modeConfirmPark, "", "what to do when you come back")
793	
794		case "c":
795			if row, ok := m.currentTask(); ok {
796				return m.prompt(modeEditNext, row.Task.Next, "next action")
797			}
798			if row, ok := m.currentRemote(); ok && !row.Cloned() {
799				return m.prompt(modeConfirmClone, row.Repo.FullName,
800					"enter to clone; esc to cancel")
801			}
802			return m, nil
803	
804		case "s":
805			if _, ok := m.currentRepo(); !ok {
806				return m, nil
807			}
808			return m.prompt(modeStartTask, "", "name for the new worktree task")
809	
810		case "d":
811			if _, ok := m.currentRepo(); !ok {
812				return m, nil
813			}
814			return m.prompt(modeStartDirect, "", "name for direct work on current branch")
815	
816		case "e":
817			if m.actions.EditConfig == nil {
818				return m, nil
819			}
820			proc, err := m.actions.EditConfig()
821			if err != nil {
822				m.err = err
823				return m, nil
824			}
825			m.status = "editing config…"
826			return m, tea.ExecProcess(proc, func(err error) tea.Msg {
827				return configEditedMsg{err: err}
828			})
829	
830		case "O":
831			if m.view != ViewRepos {
832				return m, nil
833			}
834			orders := []string{"activity", "latest", "name", "git", "tasks"}
835			current := 0
836			for i, order := range orders {
837				if order == m.actions.RepoSort {
838					current = i
839					break
840				}
841			}
842			m.actions.RepoSort = orders[(current+1)%len(orders)]
843			m.status = "repo sort: " + m.actions.RepoSort
844			m.setAt(0)
845			return m, nil
846	
847		case "R":
848			if m.view != ViewRepos {
849				return m, nil
850			}
851			m.actions.RepoReverse = !m.actions.RepoReverse
852			m.status = fmt.Sprintf("repo sort reversed: %v", m.actions.RepoReverse)
853			m.setAt(0)
854			return m, nil
855	
856		case "H":
857			repo := m.selectedRepoName()
858			if repo == "" || m.actions.LoadStats == nil {
859				return m, nil
860			}
861			m.mode, m.stats, m.status = modeStats, nil, "loading activity…"
862			return m, m.loadStats(repo)
863	
864		default:
865			if cmd := m.launchTool(msg.String()); cmd != nil {
866				return m, cmd
867			}
868		}
869		m.setAt(m.at())
870		return m, nil
871	}
872	
873	func (m Model) selectedRepoName() string {
874		if r, ok := m.currentTask(); ok {
875			return r.Task.Repo
876		}
877		if r, ok := m.currentRepo(); ok {
878			return r.Repo.Name
879		}
880		if r, ok := m.currentRemote(); ok && r.Cloned() {
881			if r.LocalName != "" {
882				return filepath.Base(r.LocalName)
883			}
884			return r.Repo.Name
885		}
886		return ""
887	}
888	
889	func (m Model) loadStats(repo string) tea.Cmd {
890		return func() tea.Msg {
891			panel, err := m.actions.LoadStats(context.Background(), repo)
892			return statsMsg{panel: panel, err: err}
893		}
894	}
895	
896	func (m Model) updateStats(msg tea.KeyMsg) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
897		switch msg.String() {
898		case "q", "ctrl+c":
899			m.quitting = true
900			return m, tea.Quit
901		case "esc", "H":
902			m.mode, m.stats, m.err, m.status = modeList, nil, nil, ""
903			return m, nil
904		case "r":
905			repo := ""
906			if m.stats != nil {
907				repo = m.stats.Repo
908			}
909			if repo == "" {
910				repo = m.selectedRepoName()
911			}
912			m.stats, m.status = nil, "loading activity…"
913			return m, m.loadStats(repo)
914		case "b":
915			repo := ""
916			if m.stats != nil {
917				repo = m.stats.Repo
918			}
919			if repo == "" {
920				repo = m.selectedRepoName()
921			}
922			if repo == "" || m.actions.BackfillStats == nil {
923				return m, nil
924			}
925			m.status = "backfilling this repository from Git history…"
926			return m, func() tea.Msg {
927				err := m.actions.BackfillStats(context.Background(), repo)
928				return statsBackfilledMsg{repo: repo, err: err}
929			}
930		}
931		return m, nil
932	}
933	
934	// afterViewSwitch lazily loads forge data only when REMOTE is first opened,
935	// so starting the dashboard never waits on a network request.
936	func (m Model) afterViewSwitch() (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
937		m.setAt(m.at())
938		if m.view == ViewRemote && !m.remotesLoaded && !m.remotesLoading {
939			m.remotesLoading = true
940			m.status = "loading GitHub and GitLab repositories…"
941			return m, m.reloadRemote()
942		}
943		return m, nil
944	}
945	
946	func (m Model) prompt(md mode, value, placeholder string) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
947		m.mode = md
948		m.input.SetValue(value)
949		m.input.Placeholder = placeholder
950		m.input.CursorEnd()
951		m.input.Focus()
952		return m, textinput.Blink
953	}
954	
955	func (m Model) updateFilter(msg tea.KeyMsg) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
956		switch msg.String() {
957		case "esc":
958			m.mode = modeList
959			m.input.Blur()
960			m.filter = ""
961			m.setAt(0)
962			return m, nil
963		case "enter":
964			m.mode = modeList
965			m.input.Blur()
966			return m, nil
967		}
968		var cmd tea.Cmd
969		m.input, cmd = m.input.Update(msg)
970		// Filtering live is the point: seeing the list narrow as you type is what
971		// makes it faster than remembering an exact name.
972		m.filter = m.input.Value()
973		m.setAt(0)
974		return m, cmd
975	}
976	
977	func (m Model) updatePrompt(msg tea.KeyMsg) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
978		switch msg.String() {
979		case "esc":
980			m.mode = modeList
981			m.input.Blur()
982			return m, nil
983		case "enter":
984			md := m.mode
985			value := strings.TrimSpace(m.input.Value())
986			m.mode = modeList
987			m.input.Blur()
988			return m, m.submit(md, value)
989		}
990		var cmd tea.Cmd
991		m.input, cmd = m.input.Update(msg)
992		return m, cmd
993	}
994	
995	func (m Model) submit(md mode, value string) tea.Cmd {
996		switch md {
997		case modeEditNext:
998			row, ok := m.currentTask()
999			if !ok {
1000				return nil
1001			}
1002			t := row.Task
1003			return func() tea.Msg {
1004				if err := m.actions.SetNext(context.Background(), t, value); err != nil {
1005					return actionMsg{err: err}
1006				}
1007				return actionMsg{status: "next action recorded for " + t.Title()}
1008			}
1009	
1010		case modeConfirmPark:
1011			row, ok := m.currentTask()
1012			if !ok {
1013				return nil
1014			}
1015			t := row.Task
1016			return func() tea.Msg {
1017				status, err := m.actions.Park(context.Background(), t, value)
1018				return actionMsg{status: status, err: err}
1019			}
1020	
1021		case modeStartTask:
1022			r, ok := m.currentRepo()
1023			if !ok {
1024				return nil
1025			}
1026			if value == "" {
1027				return func() tea.Msg { return actionMsg{err: fmt.Errorf("a task needs a name")} }
1028			}
1029			return func() tea.Msg {
1030				status, err := m.actions.Start(context.Background(), r, value)
1031				return actionMsg{status: status, err: err}
1032			}
1033	
1034		case modeStartDirect:
1035			r, ok := m.currentRepo()
1036			if !ok {
1037				return nil
1038			}
1039			if value == "" {
1040				return func() tea.Msg { return actionMsg{err: fmt.Errorf("a task needs a name")} }
1041			}
1042			return func() tea.Msg {
1043				status, err := m.actions.StartDirect(context.Background(), r, value)
1044				return actionMsg{status: status, err: err}
1045			}
1046	
1047		case modeConfirmClone:
1048			r, ok := m.currentRemote()
1049			if !ok {
1050				return nil
1051			}
1052			return func() tea.Msg {
1053				status, path, err := m.actions.CloneRemote(context.Background(), r)
1054				return actionMsg{
1055					status: status, remoteName: r.Repo.FullName, localPath: path, err: err,
1056				}
1057			}
1058		}
1059		return nil
1060	}
1061	
1062	func (m Model) openSelected() tea.Cmd {
1063		cdWanted := m.actions.Runtime != nil && m.actions.Runtime.Name() == "none"
1064	
1065		if row, ok := m.currentTask(); ok {
1066			t := row.Task
1067			dir := row.Checkout
1068			return func() tea.Msg {
1069				status, err := m.actions.Open(context.Background(), t)
1070				cd := ""
1071				if err == nil && cdWanted {
1072					cd = dir
1073				}
1074				return actionMsg{status: status, cd: cd, err: err}
1075			}
1076		}
1077		if r, ok := m.currentRepo(); ok {
1078			dir := r.Repo.Path
1079			return func() tea.Msg {
1080				status, err := m.actions.OpenRepo(context.Background(), r)
1081				cd := ""
1082				if err == nil && cdWanted {
1083					cd = dir
1084				}
1085				return actionMsg{status: status, cd: cd, err: err}
1086			}
1087		}
1088		if r, ok := m.currentRemote(); ok {
1089			if !r.Cloned() {
1090				return nil // c is the explicit clone action
1091			}
1092			dir := r.LocalPath
1093			return func() tea.Msg {
1094				status, err := m.actions.OpenRemote(context.Background(), r)
1095				cd := ""
1096				if err == nil && cdWanted {
1097					cd = dir
1098				}
1099				return actionMsg{status: status, cd: cd, err: err}
1100			}
1101		}
1102		return nil
1103	}
1104	
1105	// launchTool hands the terminal to an external program running in the selected
1106	// row's checkout, then reloads — the tool may well have changed the git state
1107	// the dashboard is displaying.
1108	func (m Model) launchTool(key string) tea.Cmd {
1109		for _, t := range m.actions.Tools {
1110			if t.Key != key {
1111				continue
1112			}
1113			if t.Available != nil && !t.Available() {
1114				return func() tea.Msg {
1115					return actionMsg{err: fmt.Errorf("%s is not installed", t.Command[0])}
1116				}
1117			}
1118			dir := m.currentDir()
1119			if dir == "" {
1120				return func() tea.Msg {
1121					return actionMsg{err: fmt.Errorf("nothing selected with a checkout on disk")}
1122				}
1123			}
1124			c := exec.Command(t.Command[0], t.Command[1:]...)
1125			c.Dir = dir
1126			return tea.ExecProcess(c, func(err error) tea.Msg {
1127				if err != nil {
1128					return actionMsg{err: fmt.Errorf("%s: %w", t.Name, err)}
1129				}
1130				return actionMsg{status: "back from " + t.Name}
1131			})
1132		}
1133		return nil
1134	}
1135	
1136	// Tools lists the external programs available on this machine, so the footer
1137	// only advertises bindings that will actually work.
1138	func (m Model) Tools() []Tool {
1139		var out []Tool
1140		for _, t := range m.actions.Tools {
1141			if t.Available == nil || t.Available() {
1142				out = append(out, t)
1143			}
1144		}
1145		return out
1146	}
1147	
1148	// Summary counts the task states, for the header line.
1149	func (m Model) Summary() string {
1150		counts := map[task.State]int{}
1151		for _, r := range m.rows {
1152			counts[r.Task.State]++
1153		}
1154		var parts []string
1155		for _, s := range task.States {
1156			if counts[s] > 0 {
1157				parts = append(parts, fmt.Sprintf("%s %d %s", s.Icon(), counts[s], s))
1158			}
1159		}
1160		if len(m.repos) > 0 {
1161			parts = append(parts, fmt.Sprintf("%d repos", len(m.repos)))
1162		}
1163		if m.remotesLoaded {
1164			parts = append(parts, fmt.Sprintf("%d remote", len(m.remotes)))
1165		}
1166		if len(parts) == 0 {
1167			return "no tasks"
1168		}
1169		return strings.Join(parts, "   ")
1170	}
1171	
1172	func contract(p string) string { return config.Contract(p) }
```

```text
33	func newHarness(t *testing.T) *harness {
34		t.Helper()
35		home := t.TempDir()
36		scanRoot := filepath.Join(home, "Program")
37		wtRoot := filepath.Join(home, "Worktrees")
38		if err := os.MkdirAll(scanRoot, 0o755); err != nil {
39			t.Fatal(err)
40		}
41	
42		// A repo inside the scan root, so `dev` discovers it the way it would in
43		// real use rather than via an absolute path.
44		r := gittest.New(t)
45		dest := filepath.Join(scanRoot, "demo")
46		if err := os.Rename(r.Root, dest); err != nil {
47			t.Fatal(err)
48		}
49		r.Root = dest
50	
51		// Isolate every path dev touches from the developer's real machine.
52		t.Setenv("HOME", home)
53		t.Setenv("XDG_DATA_HOME", filepath.Join(home, ".local", "share"))
54		t.Setenv("XDG_CONFIG_HOME", filepath.Join(home, ".config"))
55		t.Setenv("XDG_CACHE_HOME", filepath.Join(home, ".cache"))

60			"scan_roots = [\"" + scanRoot + "\"]\n" +
61			"project_root = \"" + scanRoot + "\"\n" +
62			"tries_root = \"" + filepath.Join(home, "tries") + "\"\n" +

64			"state_dir = \"" + filepath.Join(home, "state") + "\"\n" +

255		if !strings.Contains(out, "redis-streams") {
256			t.Fatalf("try output: %q", out)
257		}
258		triesRoot := filepath.Join(h.home, "tries")
259		entries, _ := os.ReadDir(triesRoot)
260		if len(entries) != 1 {
261			t.Fatalf("want one try directory, got %d", len(entries))
262		}
263		tryName := entries[0].Name()
264		if !strings.HasSuffix(tryName, "-redis-streams") || len(tryName) < 21 {
265			t.Errorf("a try should be date-prefixed, got %q", tryName)
266		}
267	
268		// A second `try` with the same name reuses the existing directory rather
269		// than creating a near-duplicate.
270		h.mustRun("try", "redis-streams")
271		entries, _ = os.ReadDir(triesRoot)
272		if len(entries) != 1 {
273			t.Errorf("try should reuse an existing match, got %d directories", len(entries))
274		}
275	
276		out = h.mustRun("graduate", "redis-streams", "--category", "Infra")
277		if !strings.Contains(out, "is now a project") {
278			t.Fatalf("graduate output: %q", out)
279		}
280		dest := filepath.Join(h.scanRoot, "Infra", "redis-streams")
281		if _, err := os.Stat(dest); err != nil {
282			t.Fatalf("graduated project should exist at %s: %v", dest, err)
283		}
284		if _, err := os.Stat(filepath.Join(triesRoot, tryName)); !os.IsNotExist(err) {
285			t.Error("the try directory should have been moved, not copied")
286		}
287		// The date prefix is dropped, and it is a repo with history.
288		if _, _, err := gitx.LastCommit(gittest.Ctx(), dest); err != nil {
289			t.Errorf("a graduated project should have a commit: %v", err)
290		}
291	}

380		binDir := t.TempDir()

382		script := `#!/bin/sh
383	set -eu
384	if [ "$1" != "repo" ] || [ "$2" != "create" ]; then
385	  exit 2
386	fi
387	git remote add origin "git@github.com:owner/$3.git"
388	printf 'https://github.com/owner/%s\n' "$3"
389	`
390		if err := os.WriteFile(gh, []byte(script), 0o755); err != nil {
391			t.Fatal(err)

402		}

404		if err != nil {
405			t.Fatal(err)
406		}

408			!strings.Contains(string(body), "github.com/owner/remote-origin") {
409			t.Errorf("graduated catalog did not retain remote origin:\n%s", body)

559	func TestAdoptReportsThenApplies(t *testing.T) {
560		h := newHarness(t)
561	
562		// A branch ahead of main, which is exactly the unfinished work adopt is for.
563		h.repo.Branch("feat/in-flight")
564		h.repo.Commit("wip.txt", "half done\n", "feat: in flight")
565		h.repo.Git("switch", "main")
566	
567		out := h.mustRun("adopt")
568		if !strings.Contains(out, "feat/in-flight") {
569			t.Fatalf("adopt should find the unmerged branch:\n%s", out)
570		}
571		if !strings.Contains(out, "--apply") {
572			t.Error("reporting run should say how to act on it")
573		}
574		// Reporting must not have created anything.
575		if ls := h.mustRun("ls"); !strings.Contains(ls, "No tasks yet") {
576			t.Errorf("adopt without --apply must create nothing, got:\n%s", ls)
577		}
578	
579		h.mustRun("adopt", "--apply", "--yes")
580		ls := h.mustRun("ls")
581		if !strings.Contains(ls, "feat/in-flight") {
582			t.Errorf("adopted task should appear in the inventory:\n%s", ls)
583		}
584	
585		// Adopting twice must not duplicate.
586		out = h.mustRun("adopt")
587		if strings.Contains(out, "feat/in-flight") {
588			t.Errorf("an already-tracked branch should not be offered again:\n%s", out)
589		}
590	}

657	func TestBootstrapSymlinkIndexAndGeneratedConfig(t *testing.T) {
658		h := newHarness(t)

661	
662		out := h.mustRun("bootstrap", h.scanRoot,
663			"--index", index, "--layout", "flat", "--apply",
664			"--config-out", generated)
665		if !strings.Contains(out, "created 1 symlink") {
666			t.Fatalf("bootstrap output:\n%s", out)
667		}
668		link := filepath.Join(index, "demo")
669		info, err := os.Lstat(link)
670		if err != nil || info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink == 0 {
671			t.Fatalf("want a symlink at %s: %+v %v", link, info, err)
672		}
673		if _, err := os.Stat(h.repo.Root); err != nil {
674			t.Error("indexing must leave the physical repository untouched")
675		}
676		body, err := os.ReadFile(generated)
677		if err != nil {
678			t.Fatal(err)
679		}
680		if !strings.Contains(string(body), config.Contract(index)) {
681			t.Errorf("generated config should scan the index:\n%s", body)
682		}
683		if !strings.Contains(string(body), `project_root = "`+config.Contract(h.scanRoot)+`"`) {
684			t.Errorf("the index is navigation, not where physical new repos should land:\n%s", body)
685		}
686	
687		// The normal repo inventory follows direct repo symlinks, so the catalog is
688		// a real navigation layer rather than a set of links dev itself ignores.
689		var listed bytes.Buffer
690		root := cli.NewRootCommandWithIO(&listed, io.Discard)
691		root.SetArgs([]string{"--config", generated, "repo", "list", "--long"})
692		if err := root.Execute(); err != nil {
693			t.Fatal(err)
694		}
695		if !strings.Contains(listed.String(), config.Contract(filepath.Join(index, "demo"))) {
696			t.Errorf("repo list should retain the index path:\n%s", listed.String())
697		}
698	}
```

```text
32	func newFixture(t *testing.T, hooks experiment.Hooks, maxWorkers int) *fixture {
33		t.Helper()
34		t.Setenv("GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL", os.DevNull)
35		t.Setenv("GIT_CONFIG_SYSTEM", os.DevNull)
36		t.Setenv("GIT_AUTHOR_NAME", "dev test")
37		t.Setenv("GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL", "dev@example.test")
38		t.Setenv("GIT_COMMITTER_NAME", "dev test")
39		t.Setenv("GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL", "dev@example.test")
40		root := t.TempDir()
41		tries := filepath.Join(root, "tries")
42		projects := filepath.Join(root, "projects")
43		for _, directory := range []string{tries, projects} {
44			if err := os.MkdirAll(directory, 0o755); err != nil {
45				t.Fatal(err)
46			}
47		}
48		now := time.Date(2026, time.August, 27, 15, 30, 0, 0, time.UTC)
49		sequence := 0
50		store := catalog.NewStore(filepath.Join(root, "assets"),
51			catalog.WithClock(func() time.Time { return now }),
52			catalog.WithIDGenerator(func() string {
53				sequence++
54				return fmt.Sprintf("try-%03d", sequence)
55			}))
56		registry := catalog.NewRegistry(store)
57		service, err := experiment.NewService(experiment.ServiceConfig{
58			Registry: registry, Store: store,
59			TriesRoot: tries, ProjectRoot: projects, Host: "test-host",
60			Clock: func() time.Time { return now }, MaxEnrichment: maxWorkers,
61			Hooks: hooks,
62		})
63		if err != nil {
64			t.Fatal(err)
65		}
66		return &fixture{
67			t: t, root: root, tries: tries, projects: projects,
68			store: store, registry: registry, service: service, now: &now,
69		}
70	}

72	func (f *fixture) mkdir(name string) string {
73		f.t.Helper()
74		path := filepath.Join(f.tries, name)
75		if err := os.MkdirAll(path, 0o755); err != nil {
76			f.t.Fatal(err)
77		}
78		return path
79	}

81	func runGit(t *testing.T, directory string, args ...string) string {
82		t.Helper()
83		command := exec.Command("git", args...)
84		command.Dir = directory
85		command.Env = append(os.Environ(),
86			"GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null",
87			"GIT_CONFIG_SYSTEM=/dev/null",
88			"GIT_AUTHOR_NAME=dev test",
89			"GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL=dev@example.test",
90			"GIT_COMMITTER_NAME=dev test",
91			"GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL=dev@example.test",
92			"GIT_AUTHOR_DATE=2026-08-22T10:00:00Z",
93			"GIT_COMMITTER_DATE=2026-08-22T10:00:00Z",
94		)
95		output, err := command.CombinedOutput()
96		if err != nil {
97			t.Fatalf("git %s in %s: %v\n%s", strings.Join(args, " "), directory, err, output)
98		}
99		return strings.TrimSpace(string(output))
100	}

102	func initRepo(t *testing.T, directory string, commit bool) {
103		t.Helper()
104		if err := os.MkdirAll(directory, 0o755); err != nil {
105			t.Fatal(err)
106		}
107		runGit(t, directory, "init", "--initial-branch=main")
108		if !commit {
109			return
110		}
111		if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(directory, "README.md"), []byte("# experiment\n"), 0o644); err != nil {
112			t.Fatal(err)
113		}
114		runGit(t, directory, "add", "README.md")
115		runGit(t, directory, "commit", "-m", "initial experiment")
116	}

118	func itemByBase(t *testing.T, items []experiment.Item, basename string) experiment.Item {
119		t.Helper()
120		for _, item := range items {
121			if item.Basename == basename {
122				return item
123			}
124		}
125		t.Fatalf("no item %q in %+v", basename, items)
126		return experiment.Item{}
127	}

129	func TestReconcileBackfillsGitAndNonGitDirectoriesIdempotently(t *testing.T) {
130		f := newFixture(t, experiment.Hooks{}, 2)
131		gitPath := f.mkdir("2026-08-20-owner-repo")
132		initRepo(t, gitPath, true)
133		runGit(t, gitPath, "remote", "add", "origin", "git@github.com:owner/repo.git")
134		plainPath := f.mkdir("plain-notes")
135		hiddenPath := filepath.Join(f.tries, ".dev", "archive", "hidden")
136		if err := os.MkdirAll(hiddenPath, 0o755); err != nil {
137			t.Fatal(err)
138		}
139		mtime := time.Date(2030, time.January, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
140		if err := os.Chtimes(plainPath, mtime, mtime); err != nil {
141			t.Fatal(err)
142		}
143	
144		first, diagnostics, err := f.service.List(context.Background(), experiment.ListOptions{})
145		if err != nil {
146			t.Fatal(err)
147		}
148		if len(diagnostics) != 0 {
149			t.Fatalf("unexpected diagnostics: %+v", diagnostics)
150		}
151		if len(first) != 2 {
152			t.Fatalf("List returned %d items, want 2", len(first))
153		}
154	
155		gitItem := itemByBase(t, first, "2026-08-20-owner-repo")
156		if gitItem.ID == "" || gitItem.Live.Repo == nil || gitItem.Live.Status == nil {
157			t.Fatalf("Git item lacks durable/live facts: %+v", gitItem)
158		}
159		if got, want := gitItem.Name, "owner-repo"; got != want {
160			t.Errorf("Name = %q, want %q", got, want)
161		}
162		if got, want := gitItem.OriginURL, "git@github.com:owner/repo.git"; got != want {
163			t.Errorf("OriginURL = %q, want %q", got, want)
164		}
165		if got, want := gitItem.RemoteIdentity, "github.com/owner/repo"; got != want {
166			t.Errorf("RemoteIdentity = %q, want %q", got, want)
167		}
168		wantStarted := time.Date(2026, time.August, 20, 0, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
169		if !gitItem.Created.Equal(wantStarted) || !gitItem.Started.Equal(wantStarted) {
170			t.Errorf("dated timestamps = %s / %s, want %s", gitItem.Created, gitItem.Started, wantStarted)
171		}
172		canonicalGitPath, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(gitPath)
173		if err != nil {
174			t.Fatal(err)
175		}
176		location, ok := gitItem.Entry.LocationFor("test-host")
177		if !ok || location.CurrentPath != canonicalGitPath || location.RealPath != canonicalGitPath || location.GitCommonDir == "" {
178			t.Errorf("catalog location = %+v, %v", location, ok)
179		}
180	
181		plainItem := itemByBase(t, first, "plain-notes")
182		if plainItem.Live.Repo != nil || plainItem.Live.Status != nil {
183			t.Errorf("plain directory was presented as Git: %+v", plainItem.Live)
184		}
185		if activity := plainItem.Activity(); !activity.IsZero() {
186			t.Errorf("directory mtime leaked into activity: %s", activity)
187		}
188		if _, err := os.Stat(filepath.Join(plainPath, ".git")); !errors.Is(err, os.ErrNotExist) {
189			t.Errorf("backfill wrote inside non-Git Try: %v", err)
190		}
191	
192		second, diagnostics, err := f.service.List(context.Background(), experiment.ListOptions{})
193		if err != nil || len(diagnostics) != 0 {
194			t.Fatalf("second List: %v, %+v", err, diagnostics)
195		}
196		if itemByBase(t, second, gitItem.Basename).ID != gitItem.ID ||
197			itemByBase(t, second, plainItem.Basename).ID != plainItem.ID {
198			t.Error("reconciliation changed stable IDs")
199		}
200		entries, err := f.store.List()
201		if err != nil || len(entries) != 2 {
202			t.Fatalf("catalog entries = %d, %v", len(entries), err)
203		}
204	}

427	func TestResolveUsesExactPrecedenceAndReportsDeterministicAmbiguity(t *testing.T) {
428		f := newFixture(t, experiment.Hooks{}, 2)
429		for _, name := range []string{
430			"2026-08-01-cache-alpha",
431			"2026-08-02-cache-beta",
432			"scratch",
433		} {
434			f.mkdir(name)
435		}
436		items, _, err := f.service.List(context.Background(), experiment.ListOptions{})
437		if err != nil {
438			t.Fatal(err)
439		}
440		alpha := itemByBase(t, items, "2026-08-01-cache-alpha")
441	
442		for label, ref := range map[string]string{
443			"stable ID": alpha.ID,
444			"basename":  alpha.Basename,
445			"stripped":  "cache-alpha",
446		} {
447			resolved, _, err := f.service.Resolve(context.Background(), ref)
448			if err != nil || resolved.ID != alpha.ID {
449				t.Errorf("Resolve by %s = %+v, %v", label, resolved, err)
450			}
451		}
452	
453		_, _, err = f.service.Resolve(context.Background(), "CACHE")
454		var ambiguous *experiment.AmbiguousError
455		if !errors.Is(err, experiment.ErrAmbiguous) || !errors.As(err, &ambiguous) {
456			t.Fatalf("ambiguous Resolve = %v", err)
457		}
458		if len(ambiguous.Candidates) != 2 ||
459			ambiguous.Candidates[0].Basename != "2026-08-01-cache-alpha" ||
460			ambiguous.Candidates[1].Basename != "2026-08-02-cache-beta" {
461			t.Errorf("ambiguous candidates = %+v", ambiguous.Candidates)
462		}
463	
464		_, _, err = f.service.Resolve(context.Background(), "missing")
465		var notFound *experiment.NotFoundError
466		if !errors.Is(err, experiment.ErrNotFound) || !errors.As(err, &notFound) {
467			t.Errorf("missing Resolve = %v", err)
468		}
469	
470		created, err := f.service.ResolveOrCreate(context.Background(), experiment.CreateRequest{Name: "001", NoGit: true})
471		if err != nil {
472			t.Fatal(err)
473		}
474		if created.Existing || !strings.HasSuffix(created.Path, "-001") {
475			t.Errorf("name matched an unrelated ID substring: %+v", created)
476		}
477	
478		scratch := itemByBase(t, items, "scratch")
479		if err := os.RemoveAll(scratch.Live.CurrentPath); err != nil {
480			t.Fatal(err)
481		}
482		if _, _, err := f.service.Resolve(context.Background(), "scratch"); !errors.Is(err, experiment.ErrNotFound) {
483			t.Errorf("host-nonpresent Try should be excluded, got %v", err)
484		}
485	}
```

```text
10	func sameFilesystem(source, destination string) (bool, error) {
11		sourceAncestor, err := nearestExisting(source)
12		if err != nil {
13			return false, err
14		}
15		destinationAncestor, err := nearestExisting(destination)
16		if err != nil {
17			return false, err
18		}
19		sourceInfo, err := os.Stat(sourceAncestor)
20		if err != nil {
21			return false, err
22		}
23		destinationInfo, err := os.Stat(destinationAncestor)
24		if err != nil {
25			return false, err
26		}
27		sourceStat, sourceOK := sourceInfo.Sys().(*syscall.Stat_t)
28		destinationStat, destinationOK := destinationInfo.Sys().(*syscall.Stat_t)
29		if !sourceOK || !destinationOK {
30			// os.Rename remains the final authority on platforms whose FileInfo does
31			// not expose a Unix-style device number.
32			return true, nil
33		}
34		return sourceStat.Dev == destinationStat.Dev, nil
35	}
```

```text
40			return "", err
41		}
42		return windows.UTF16ToString(buffer), nil
43	}
```

```text
1	// Package pathx provides the path-safety checks shared by filesystem lifecycle
2	// operations. The checks are strict: a destination must be below its root, not
3	// merely share a string prefix with it, and symlinks are resolved before that
4	// decision is made.
5	package pathx
6	
7	import (
8		"errors"
9		"fmt"
10		"io/fs"
11		"os"
12		"path/filepath"
13		"slices"
14		"strings"
15	)
16	
17	var (
18		// ErrOutsideRoot reports a path that does not resolve below the requested root.
19		ErrOutsideRoot = errors.New("path is outside root")
20		// ErrRoot reports an operation that named the root itself rather than a child.
21		ErrRoot = errors.New("path is the root itself")
22		// ErrTraversal reports an explicit .. component in an unclean input path.
23		ErrTraversal = errors.New("path contains parent traversal")
24		// ErrInvalidComponent reports a value that is not one filesystem component.
25		ErrInvalidComponent = errors.New("invalid path component")
26	)
27	
28	// Canonical returns an absolute, clean path with symlinks resolved. If the final
29	// path does not exist yet, it resolves the nearest existing ancestor and then
30	// appends the missing suffix. This is the form needed to validate a destination
31	// before creating or moving anything into it.
32	func Canonical(path string) (string, error) {
33		if path == "" {
34			return "", fmt.Errorf("canonical path: empty path")
35		}
36		absolute, err := filepath.Abs(path)
37		if err != nil {
38			return "", fmt.Errorf("make %q absolute: %w", path, err)
39		}
40		absolute = filepath.Clean(absolute)
41	
42		probe := absolute
43		var missing []string
44		for {
45			resolved, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(probe)
46			if err == nil {
47				slices.Reverse(missing)
48				parts := append([]string{resolved}, missing...)
49				return filepath.Clean(filepath.Join(parts...)), nil
50			}
51			if !errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
52				return "", fmt.Errorf("resolve %q: %w", path, err)
53			}
54			// EvalSymlinks reports ErrNotExist both for a genuinely missing component
55			// and for a symlink whose target is missing. Treating the latter as an
56			// ordinary lexical suffix would make an escape look as though it remained
57			// below its root. Resolve the link target explicitly before appending the
58			// still-missing suffix.
59			if info, lstatErr := os.Lstat(probe); lstatErr == nil && info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 {
60				target, readErr := os.Readlink(probe)
61				if readErr != nil {
62					return "", fmt.Errorf("read unresolved symlink %q: %w", probe, readErr)
63				}
64				if hasParentTraversal(target) {
65					return "", fmt.Errorf("unresolved symlink %q target %q: %w", probe, target, ErrTraversal)
66				}
67				if !filepath.IsAbs(target) {
68					target = filepath.Join(filepath.Dir(probe), target)
69				}
70				resolved, resolveErr := Canonical(target)
71				if resolveErr != nil {
72					return "", fmt.Errorf("resolve target of %q: %w", probe, resolveErr)
73				}
74				slices.Reverse(missing)
75				parts := append([]string{resolved}, missing...)
76				return filepath.Clean(filepath.Join(parts...)), nil
77			} else if lstatErr != nil && !errors.Is(lstatErr, fs.ErrNotExist) {
78				return "", fmt.Errorf("inspect unresolved path %q: %w", probe, lstatErr)
79			}
80			parent := filepath.Dir(probe)
81			if parent == probe {
82				return "", fmt.Errorf("resolve %q: no existing ancestor: %w", path, err)
83			}
84			missing = append(missing, filepath.Base(probe))
85			probe = parent
86		}
87	}
88	
89	// CanonicalChild returns candidate in canonical form when it resolves strictly
90	// below root. It rejects root itself, lexical .. traversal, sibling-prefix
91	// confusion, and paths that escape through a symlink.
92	func CanonicalChild(root, candidate string) (string, error) {
93		if hasParentTraversal(candidate) {
94			return "", fmt.Errorf("%q: %w", candidate, ErrTraversal)
95		}
96		canonicalRoot, err := Canonical(root)
97		if err != nil {
98			return "", fmt.Errorf("canonicalize root: %w", err)
99		}
100		canonicalCandidate, err := Canonical(candidate)
101		if err != nil {
102			return "", fmt.Errorf("canonicalize candidate: %w", err)
103		}
104	
105		rel, err := filepath.Rel(canonicalRoot, canonicalCandidate)
106		if err != nil {
107			return "", fmt.Errorf("compare %q with root %q: %w", candidate, root, err)
108		}
109		switch {
110		case rel == ".":
111			return "", fmt.Errorf("%q: %w", candidate, ErrRoot)
112		case filepath.IsAbs(rel), rel == "..", strings.HasPrefix(rel, ".."+string(filepath.Separator)):
113			return "", fmt.Errorf("%q is not below %q: %w", candidate, root, ErrOutsideRoot)
114		default:
115			return canonicalCandidate, nil
116		}
117	}
118	
119	// IsChild reports whether candidate resolves strictly below root. Policy
120	// rejections are returned as false without hiding filesystem errors.
121	func IsChild(root, candidate string) (bool, error) {
122		_, err := CanonicalChild(root, candidate)
123		if err == nil {
124			return true, nil
125		}
126		if errors.Is(err, ErrOutsideRoot) || errors.Is(err, ErrRoot) || errors.Is(err, ErrTraversal) {
127			return false, nil
128		}
129		return false, err
130	}
131	
132	// ValidateComponent requires a non-empty relative value containing exactly one
133	// path component. Both slash styles are rejected so state synced between Unix
134	// and Windows cannot acquire a different meaning on another host.
135	func ValidateComponent(component string) error {
136		switch {
137		case strings.TrimSpace(component) == "":
138			return fmt.Errorf("empty component: %w", ErrInvalidComponent)
139		case strings.ContainsRune(component, '\x00'):
140			return fmt.Errorf("component contains NUL: %w", ErrInvalidComponent)
141		case component == "." || component == "..":
142			return fmt.Errorf("component %q is reserved: %w", component, ErrInvalidComponent)
143		case filepath.IsAbs(component) || filepath.VolumeName(component) != "" || driveQualified(component):
144			return fmt.Errorf("component %q is absolute or drive-qualified: %w", component, ErrInvalidComponent)
145		case strings.ContainsAny(component, `/\\`):
146			return fmt.Errorf("component %q contains a path separator: %w", component, ErrInvalidComponent)
147		case filepath.Clean(component) != component || filepath.Base(component) != component:
148			return fmt.Errorf("component %q is not a single clean name: %w", component, ErrInvalidComponent)
149		default:
150			return nil
151		}
152	}
153	
154	// JoinChild validates every component, joins it below root, and returns the
155	// canonical destination. It is suitable for paths such as
156	// <project-root>/<category>/<name>, where each user-supplied value must remain a
157	// single component.
158	func JoinChild(root string, components ...string) (string, error) {
159		if len(components) == 0 {
160			return "", fmt.Errorf("join child: no components: %w", ErrRoot)
161		}
162		for i, component := range components {
163			if err := ValidateComponent(component); err != nil {
164				return "", fmt.Errorf("component %d: %w", i, err)
165			}
166		}
167		canonicalRoot, err := Canonical(root)
168		if err != nil {
169			return "", fmt.Errorf("canonicalize root: %w", err)
170		}
171		return CanonicalChild(canonicalRoot, filepath.Join(append([]string{canonicalRoot}, components...)...))
172	}
173	
174	func driveQualified(component string) bool {
175		if len(component) < 2 || component[1] != ':' {
176			return false
177		}
178		letter := component[0]
179		return letter >= 'a' && letter <= 'z' || letter >= 'A' && letter <= 'Z'
180	}
181	
182	func hasParentTraversal(path string) bool {
183		for _, component := range strings.FieldsFunc(path, func(r rune) bool {
184			return r == '/' || r == '\\'
185		}) {
186			if component == ".." {
187				return true
188			}
189		}
190		return false
191	}
```

```text
1	// Package repo discovers the repositories a user actually owns by walking the
2	// configured scan roots. It answers "what projects do I have?", which is a
3	// different question from "what am I working on?" — that one belongs to
4	// package task.
5	package repo
6	
7	import (
8		"context"
9		"io/fs"
10		"os"
11		"path/filepath"
12		"sort"
13		"strings"
14	
15		"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/gitx"
16	)
17	
18	// Repo is one discovered repository.
19	type Repo struct {
20		// Name is the directory basename, which is how users refer to it.
21		Name string
22		// Path is the absolute path reached through the scan root. It may be a
23		// symlink from a bootstrap index; commands intentionally keep that human
24		// navigation path rather than replacing it with the physical one.
25		Path string
26		// RealPath is the physical checkout path.
27		RealPath string
28		// Symlink reports that Path is an alias to RealPath.
29		Symlink bool
30		// Root is the scan root it was found under.
31		Root string
32		// Category is the path between the scan root and the repo ("Quant",
33		// "Web/Frontend"), empty for a repo sitting directly in the root. It is
34		// human organisation metadata, preserved for `dev graduate` to place new
35		// projects consistently.
36		Category string
37		// CommonDir is Git's shared administrative directory. Its worktrees/
38		// children let inventory count linked checkouts without another git
39		// process per repository.
40		CommonDir string
41		// Bare reports a bare repository (a worktree hub).
42		Bare bool
43		// HasGit distinguishes a real repo from a plain directory that was found
44		// in a scan root; non-repos are reported so `dev repo list` can offer to
45		// initialise them.
46		HasGit bool
47	}
48	
49	// Display renders "Category/Name" or just "Name".
50	func (r Repo) Display() string {
51		if r.Category == "" {
52			return r.Name
53		}
54		return r.Category + "/" + r.Name
55	}
56	
57	// Options tunes discovery.
58	type Options struct {
59		// MaxDepth limits how deep below a scan root a repo may be found. The
60		// default layout is <root>/<Category>/<Repo>, so 2 suffices; 3 leaves room
61		// for a nested grouping without walking an entire home directory.
62		MaxDepth int
63		// IncludeNonRepos reports plain directories alongside repositories.
64		IncludeNonRepos bool
65	}
66	
67	// DefaultOptions is the discovery configuration used by dev's commands.
68	func DefaultOptions() Options { return Options{MaxDepth: 3} }
69	
70	// skipDirs are never descended into. These are large, never contain a project
71	// the user organises by hand, and walking them dominates scan time.
72	var skipDirs = map[string]bool{
73		"node_modules": true, ".venv": true, "venv": true, "target": true,
74		"vendor": true, "__pycache__": true, ".tox": true, "dist": true,
75		"build": true, ".next": true, ".cache": true, ".terraform": true,
76		"Library": true, ".Trash": true,
77	}
78	
79	// Discover walks every root and returns the repositories found, sorted by
80	// display name. Unreadable directories are skipped rather than fatal — a scan
81	// root that has been unmounted must not break `dev ls`.
82	func Discover(ctx context.Context, roots []string, opts Options) ([]Repo, error) {
83		if opts.MaxDepth <= 0 {
84			opts.MaxDepth = DefaultOptions().MaxDepth
85		}
86		seen := map[string]bool{}
87		// clone identities stop a physical path and a symlink index from showing
88		// the same repository twice. The first scan root wins, which lets users
89		// choose whether the curated index or the physical hierarchy is their UI
90		// simply by ordering scan_roots.
91		identities := map[string]bool{}
92		var out []Repo
93	
94		for _, root := range roots {
95			info, err := os.Stat(root)
96			if err != nil || !info.IsDir() {
97				continue // a missing scan root is normal on a fresh machine
98			}
99			rootClean := filepath.Clean(root)
100	
101			err = filepath.WalkDir(rootClean, func(path string, d fs.DirEntry, err error) error {
102				if err != nil {
103					return nil // unreadable entry: skip, keep walking
104				}
105				if ctx.Err() != nil {
106					return ctx.Err()
107				}
108				if path == rootClean {
109					return nil
110				}
111				name := d.Name()
112				isLink := d.Type()&os.ModeSymlink != 0
113				isDir := d.IsDir()
114				if isLink {
115					// WalkDir does not follow symlinks. Inspect a direct symlink to
116					// a repository, but do not recurse through arbitrary symlinked
117					// containers — bootstrap does that with cycle detection.
118					if info, err := os.Stat(path); err == nil {
119						isDir = info.IsDir()
120					}
121				}
122				if !isDir {
123					return nil
124				}
125				if skipDirs[name] || (strings.HasPrefix(name, ".") && name != ".bare") {
126					return filepath.SkipDir
127				}
128	
129				rel, _ := filepath.Rel(rootClean, path)
130				depth := len(strings.Split(rel, string(filepath.Separator)))
131	
132				if isRepoDir(path) {
133					real, _ := filepath.EvalSymlinks(path)
134					if real == "" {
135						real = path
136					}
137					bare := isBareDir(path)
138					identity, commonDir := real, real
139					if !bare {
140						if g, err := gitx.Discover(ctx, path); err == nil {
141							// A linked worktree is execution state, not another
142							// project in the repo inventory.
143							if g.IsLinkedWorktree {
144								return filepath.SkipDir
145							}
146							identity, commonDir = g.GitCommonDir, g.GitCommonDir
147							real = g.MainRoot
148						}
149					}
150					if !seen[path] && !identities[identity] {
151						seen[path], identities[identity] = true, true
152						out = append(out, Repo{
153							Name:      name,
154							Path:      path,
155							RealPath:  real,
156							Symlink:   isLink,
157							Root:      rootClean,
158							Category:  filepath.ToSlash(filepath.Dir(rel)),
159							CommonDir: commonDir,
160							Bare:      bare,
161							HasGit:    true,
162						})
163					}
164					// Never descend into a repo: its subdirectories are source
165					// code, and any nested .git is a submodule or a worktree that
166					// belongs to this repo, not a project of its own.
167					return filepath.SkipDir
168				}
169				if depth >= opts.MaxDepth {
170					return filepath.SkipDir
171				}
172				if opts.IncludeNonRepos && depth == 1 {
173					if !seen[path] {
174						seen[path] = true
175						out = append(out, Repo{Name: name, Path: path, Root: rootClean, Category: ""})
176					}
177				}
178				return nil
179			})
180			if err != nil && ctx.Err() != nil {
181				return out, ctx.Err()
182			}
183		}
184	
185		for i := range out {
186			if out[i].Category == "." {
187				out[i].Category = ""
188			}
189		}
190		sort.Slice(out, func(i, j int) bool {
191			if out[i].Name != out[j].Name {
192				return strings.ToLower(out[i].Name) < strings.ToLower(out[j].Name)
193			}
194			return out[i].Path < out[j].Path
195		})
196		return out, nil
197	}
198	
199	// isRepoDir reports whether path is a repository root: it holds a .git entry
200	// (directory for a normal clone, file for a linked worktree or submodule).
201	func isRepoDir(path string) bool {
202		if _, err := os.Lstat(filepath.Join(path, ".git")); err == nil {
203			return true
204		}
205		return isBareDir(path)
206	}
207	
208	// isBareDir recognises a bare repository by its skeleton, without shelling out.
209	func isBareDir(path string) bool {
210		for _, marker := range []string{"HEAD", "objects", "refs"} {
211			if _, err := os.Stat(filepath.Join(path, marker)); err != nil {
212				return false
213			}
214		}
215		return true
216	}
217	
218	// Resolve finds a repo by name, display name, or path.
219	//
220	// Matching is deliberately layered: an exact name or path wins outright, and
221	// only then does a substring search run — so a repo literally named "web"
222	// is never shadowed by "web-frontend".
223	func Resolve(ctx context.Context, roots []string, ref string) (Repo, []Repo, error) {
224		all, err := Discover(ctx, roots, DefaultOptions())
225		if err != nil {
226			return Repo{}, nil, err
227		}
228		if abs, err := filepath.Abs(ref); err == nil {
229			if g, err := gitx.Discover(ctx, abs); err == nil {
230				real, _ := filepath.EvalSymlinks(abs)
231				if real == "" {
232					real = g.MainRoot
233				}
234				// Preserve an explicit navigation alias. The caller named this
235				// path on purpose; resolving it to the physical checkout would
236				// defeat a bootstrap symlink catalog.
237				return Repo{
238					Name: filepath.Base(abs), Path: abs, RealPath: real,
239					Symlink: real != abs, CommonDir: g.GitCommonDir, HasGit: true, Bare: g.Bare,
240				}, nil, nil
241			}
242		}
243		for _, r := range all {
244			if r.Name == ref || r.Display() == ref || r.Path == ref {
245				return r, nil, nil
246			}
247		}
248		needle := strings.ToLower(ref)
249		var hits []Repo
250		for _, r := range all {
251			if strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(r.Display()), needle) {
252				hits = append(hits, r)
253			}
254		}
255		switch len(hits) {
256		case 1:
257			return hits[0], nil, nil
258		case 0:
259			return Repo{}, nil, &NotFoundError{Ref: ref}
260		default:
261			return Repo{}, hits, &AmbiguousError{Ref: ref, Candidates: hits}
262		}
263	}
264	
265	// NotFoundError reports a repo reference that matched nothing.
266	type NotFoundError struct{ Ref string }
267	
268	func (e *NotFoundError) Error() string { return "no repository matching " + e.Ref }
269	
270	// AmbiguousError reports a repo reference that matched several repos.
271	type AmbiguousError struct {
272		Ref        string
273		Candidates []Repo
274	}
275	
276	func (e *AmbiguousError) Error() string {
277		names := make([]string, len(e.Candidates))
278		for i, c := range e.Candidates {
279			names[i] = c.Display()
280		}
281		return e.Ref + " is ambiguous: " + strings.Join(names, ", ")
282	}
```

```text
1	// Package gitx wraps the git porcelain commands dev depends on. Every helper
2	// shells out to git rather than linking a Go implementation: git is already a
3	// hard dependency, its porcelain formats are stable and documented, and this
4	// keeps dev's behaviour identical to what the user sees when they run the same
5	// command by hand.
6	package gitx
7	
8	import (
9		"bytes"
10		"context"
11		"errors"
12		"fmt"
13		"os/exec"
14		"strings"
15	)
16	
17	// ErrNotARepo is returned when a directory is not inside a git working tree.
18	var ErrNotARepo = errors.New("not a git repository")
19	
20	// Error carries the failing command and git's own stderr, which is almost
21	// always more useful than the exit status alone.
22	type Error struct {
23		Args   []string
24		Dir    string
25		Stderr string
26		Err    error
27	}
28	
29	func (e *Error) Error() string {
30		msg := strings.TrimSpace(e.Stderr)
31		if msg == "" {
32			msg = e.Err.Error()
33		}
34		return fmt.Sprintf("git %s: %s", strings.Join(e.Args, " "), msg)
35	}
36	
37	func (e *Error) Unwrap() error { return e.Err }
38	
39	// run executes git in dir and returns trimmed stdout.
40	func run(ctx context.Context, dir string, args ...string) (string, error) {
41		// -c core.quotepath=false keeps non-ASCII paths readable rather than
42		// octal-escaped, which matters for the Chinese-named files in these repos.
43		full := append([]string{"-c", "core.quotepath=false"}, args...)
44		cmd := exec.CommandContext(ctx, "git", full...)
45		cmd.Dir = dir
46		var stdout, stderr bytes.Buffer
47		cmd.Stdout = &stdout
48		cmd.Stderr = &stderr
49		if err := cmd.Run(); err != nil {
50			gerr := &Error{Args: args, Dir: dir, Stderr: stderr.String(), Err: err}
51			if strings.Contains(gerr.Stderr, "not a git repository") {
52				return "", fmt.Errorf("%s: %w", dir, ErrNotARepo)
53			}
54			return "", gerr
55		}
56		return strings.TrimRight(stdout.String(), "\n"), nil
57	}
58	
59	// Run executes an arbitrary git command in dir. Exported for the few callers
60	// (park's wip commit, done's merge) that need a one-off command.
61	func Run(ctx context.Context, dir string, args ...string) (string, error) {
62		return run(ctx, dir, args...)
63	}
64	
65	// lines splits git output into non-empty lines.
66	func lines(s string) []string {
67		if s == "" {
68			return nil
69		}
70		out := strings.Split(s, "\n")
71		filtered := out[:0]
72		for _, l := range out {
73			if l != "" {
74				filtered = append(filtered, l)
75			}
76		}
77		return filtered
78	}
79	
80	// nulLines splits NUL-delimited git output (-z forms).
81	func nulLines(s string) []string {
82		s = strings.TrimRight(s, "\x00")
83		if s == "" {
84			return nil
85		}
86		return strings.Split(s, "\x00")
87	}
88
```

```text
13	func idSequence(ids ...string) catalog.IDGenerator {
14		index := 0
15		return func() string {
16			if index >= len(ids) {
17				return ids[len(ids)-1]
18			}
19			id := ids[index]
20			index++
21			return id
22		}
23	}
```

```text
508	func TestStoreWithLockSerializesAndStaysOutsideAssetDirectory(t *testing.T) {
509		dir := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "assets")
510		first := catalog.NewStore(dir)
511		second := catalog.NewStore(dir)
512		entered := make(chan struct{})
513		release := make(chan struct{})
514		firstDone := make(chan error, 1)
515		go func() {
516			firstDone <- first.WithLock(context.Background(), func() error {
517				close(entered)
518				<-release
519				return nil
520			})
521		}()
522		<-entered
523	
524		ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
525		secondDone := make(chan error, 1)
526		called := make(chan struct{}, 1)
527		go func() {
528			secondDone <- second.WithLock(ctx, func() error {
529				called <- struct{}{}
530				return nil
531			})
532		}()
533		select {
534		case err := <-secondDone:
535			t.Fatalf("second lock completed while first was held: %v", err)
536		case <-time.After(50 * time.Millisecond):
537			cancel()
538		}
539		if err := <-secondDone; !errors.Is(err, context.Canceled) {
540			t.Fatalf("canceled lock = %v, want context.Canceled", err)
541		}
542		select {
543		case <-called:
544			t.Fatal("canceled waiter ran its operation")
545		default:
546		}
547	
548		close(release)
549		if err := <-firstDone; err != nil {
550			t.Fatal(err)
551		}
552		sentinel := errors.New("operation failed")
553		if err := second.WithLock(context.Background(), func() error { return sentinel }); !errors.Is(err, sentinel) {
554			t.Fatalf("locked operation error = %v, want sentinel", err)
555		}
556		if err := first.WithLock(context.Background(), func() error { return nil }); err != nil {
557			t.Fatalf("lock after failed operation: %v", err)
558		}
559		entries, err := os.ReadDir(dir)
560		if err != nil {
561			t.Fatal(err)
562		}
563		if len(entries) != 0 {
564			t.Errorf("coordination files leaked into asset directory: %v", entries)
565		}
566	}

568	func TestStoreLockReleasedWhenHolderProcessExits(t *testing.T) {
569		if os.Getenv("DEV_CATALOG_LOCK_HELPER") == "1" {
570			store := catalog.NewStore(os.Getenv("DEV_CATALOG_LOCK_DIR"))
571			err := store.WithLock(context.Background(), func() error {
572				if err := os.WriteFile(os.Getenv("DEV_CATALOG_LOCK_READY"), []byte("ready"), 0o600); err != nil {
573					return err
574				}
575				for {
576					time.Sleep(time.Hour)
577				}
578			})
579			if err != nil {
580				os.Exit(2)
581			}
582			return
583		}
584	
585		root := t.TempDir()
586		dir := filepath.Join(root, "assets")
587		ready := filepath.Join(root, "ready")
588		command := exec.Command(os.Args[0], "-test.run=^TestStoreLockReleasedWhenHolderProcessExits$")
589		command.Env = append(os.Environ(),
590			"DEV_CATALOG_LOCK_HELPER=1",
591			"DEV_CATALOG_LOCK_DIR="+dir,
592			"DEV_CATALOG_LOCK_READY="+ready,
593		)
594		if err := command.Start(); err != nil {
595			t.Fatal(err)
596		}
597		defer func() {
598			if command.ProcessState == nil {
599				_ = command.Process.Kill()
600				_, _ = command.Process.Wait()
601			}
602		}()
603		deadline := time.Now().Add(5 * time.Second)
604		for {
605			if _, err := os.Stat(ready); err == nil {
606				break
607			}
608			if time.Now().After(deadline) {
609				t.Fatal("lock holder did not become ready")
610			}
611			time.Sleep(10 * time.Millisecond)
612		}
613	
614		waitCtx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 50*time.Millisecond)
615		defer cancel()
616		if err := catalog.NewStore(dir).WithLock(waitCtx, func() error { return nil }); !errors.Is(err, context.DeadlineExceeded) {
617			t.Fatalf("contended lock = %v, want context deadline", err)
618		}
619		if err := command.Process.Kill(); err != nil {
620			t.Fatal(err)
621		}
622		if err := command.Wait(); err == nil {
623			t.Fatal("killed lock helper exited successfully")
624		}
625		if err := catalog.NewStore(dir).WithLock(context.Background(), func() error { return nil }); err != nil {
626			t.Fatalf("lock was not released after holder process exited: %v", err)
627		}
628	}
```

```text
9	// XDG base directories, resolved the way the spec prescribes: honor the
10	// environment variable when it holds an absolute path, otherwise fall back to
11	// the documented default under $HOME.
12	
13	func xdgDir(envVar, fallback string) string {
14		if v := os.Getenv(envVar); filepath.IsAbs(v) {
15			return v
16		}
17		return filepath.Join(home(), fallback)
18	}

23		}
24		return os.Getenv("HOME")
25	}

27	// ConfigHome is $XDG_CONFIG_HOME (default ~/.config).

29	
30	// DataHome is $XDG_DATA_HOME (default ~/.local/share).
31	func DataHome() string { return xdgDir("XDG_DATA_HOME", ".local/share") }
32	
33	// CacheHome is $XDG_CACHE_HOME (default ~/.cache).
34	func CacheHome() string { return xdgDir("XDG_CACHE_HOME", ".cache") }
35	
36	// ConfigFile is the path dev loads its TOML configuration from.
37	func ConfigFile() string { return filepath.Join(ConfigHome(), "dev", "config.toml") }
38	
39	// Expand resolves a leading ~ and any environment variables in p, then makes
40	// the result absolute. Paths in config.toml are written by humans, so both
41	// "~/Worktrees" and "$WORK/trees" have to work.
42	func Expand(p string) string {
43		if p == "" {
44			return ""
45		}
46		p = os.ExpandEnv(p)
47		switch {
48		case p == "~":
49			p = home()
50		case strings.HasPrefix(p, "~/"):
51			p = filepath.Join(home(), p[2:])
52		}
53		if abs, err := filepath.Abs(p); err == nil {
54			return abs
55		}
56		return filepath.Clean(p)
57	}
58	
59	// Contract renders p with $HOME collapsed back to ~, for display only.
60	func Contract(p string) string {
61		h := home()
62		if h != "" && p == h {
63			return "~"
64		}
65		if h != "" && strings.HasPrefix(p, h+string(filepath.Separator)) {
66			return "~" + p[len(h):]
67		}
68		return p
69	}
70
```

```text
256	// Load reads config.toml over the defaults. A missing file is not an error —
257	// dev must be useful with zero setup. A malformed file is, because silently
258	// falling back to defaults would send worktrees to the wrong volume.
259	func Load(path string) (Config, error) {
260		cfg := Default()
261		if path == "" {

263		}
264		md, err := toml.DecodeFile(path, &cfg)
265		switch {
266		case errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist):

268		case err != nil:
269			return cfg, fmt.Errorf("read %s: %w", path, err)
270		}

272			// Unknown keys are usually typos ("worktree_dir" vs "worktree_root").
273			// Warn rather than fail so a newer config still works on an older dev.
274			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "dev: warning: unknown key(s) in %s: %v\n", path, undecoded)

282	func (c Config) Validate() error {
283		switch c.Runtime.Backend {
284		case "", "auto", "herdr", "tmux", "none":

292			return fmt.Errorf("paths.worktree_path: %w", err)
293		}
294		switch c.Bootstrap.Layout {
295		case "", "flat", "preserve":
296		default:
297			return fmt.Errorf("bootstrap.layout %q: want flat or preserve", c.Bootstrap.Layout)
298		}
299		if c.Bootstrap.MaxDepth < 0 {
300			return fmt.Errorf("bootstrap.max_depth must be zero (unlimited) or positive")
301		}
302		if c.Forge.RemoteLimit < 0 {
303			return fmt.Errorf("forge.remote_limit must be zero (use default) or positive")
304		}
305		validStrategy := func(v string) bool {
306			switch v {
307			case "", "reinstall", "copy", "link", "skip":
308				return true
309			}
310			return false
311		}
312		if !validStrategy(c.Worktree.Strategy) {
313			return fmt.Errorf("worktree.strategy %q: want reinstall, copy, link or skip", c.Worktree.Strategy)
314		}
315		for ecosystem, strategy := range c.Worktree.Strategies {
316			if !validStrategy(strategy) {
317				return fmt.Errorf("worktree.strategies.%s %q: want reinstall, copy, link or skip",
318					ecosystem, strategy)
319			}
320		}
321		validColumns := map[string]bool{
322			"repo": true, "branch": true, "git": true, "live": true,
323			"latest": true, "worktrees": true, "tasks": true,
324			"category": true, "path": true,
325		}
326		for i, column := range c.TUI.Repos.Columns {
327			if !validColumns[column] {
328				return fmt.Errorf("tui.repos.columns[%d] %q: unknown column", i, column)
329			}
330		}
331		switch c.EffectiveRepoSort() {
332		case "activity", "latest", "name", "git", "tasks":
333		default:
334			return fmt.Errorf("tui.repos.sort %q: want activity, latest, name, git or tasks", c.TUI.Repos.Sort)
335		}
336		seen := map[string]string{}
337		for i, t := range c.TUI.Tools {
338			switch {
339			case t.Key == "":
340				return fmt.Errorf("tui.tools[%d]: key is required", i)
341			case t.Run == "":
342				return fmt.Errorf("tui.tools[%d] (%s): run is required", i, t.Key)
343			}

346					i, t.Key, binding)

348			if prev, ok := seen[t.Key]; ok {
349				return fmt.Errorf("tui.tools[%d]: key %q is already bound to %q", i, t.Key, prev)
350			}
351			seen[t.Key] = t.Name
352		}
353		return nil
354	}
```
