```go
package cli_test

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"
	"testing"

	"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/forge"
)

type triesJSONFixture struct {
	Identity struct {
		ID   string `json:"id"`
		Kind string `json:"kind"`
		Name string `json:"name"`
	} `json:"identity"`
	Experiment struct {
		Phase string  `json:"phase"`
		Started *string `json:"started"`
	} `json:"experiment"`
	Location *struct {
		State       string `json:"state"`
		CurrentPath string `json:"current_path"`
		RestorePath string `json:"restore_path"`
	} `json:"location"`
	Live struct {
		Present bool `json:"present"`
	} `json:"live"`
	Metadata struct {
		Tags []string `json:"tags"`
		Note string   `json:"note"`
	} `json:"metadata"`
}

func decodeTriesJSON(t *testing.T, body string) []triesJSONFixture {
	t.Helper()
	var rows []triesJSONFixture
	if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(body), &rows); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("invalid tries JSON: %v\n%s", err, body)
	}
	return rows
}

func enableTryScanning(t *testing.T, h *harness) {
	t.Helper()
	body, err := os.ReadFile(h.configPath)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	old := `scan_roots = ["` + h.scanRoot + `"]`
	triesRoot := filepath.Join(h.home, "tries")
	replacement := `scan_roots = ["` + h.scanRoot + `", "` + triesRoot + `"]`
	updated := strings.Replace(string(body), old, replacement, 1)
	if updated == string(body) {
		t.Fatalf("scan_roots line not found in config:\n%s", body)
	}
	if err := os.WriteFile(h.configPath, []byte(updated), 0o644); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}

func TestTriesLifecycleCommandsAndStableJSON(t *testing.T) {
	h := newHarness(t)
	h.mustRun("try", "lifecycle", "--no-git")

	rows := decodeTriesJSON(t, h.mustRun("tries", "list", "--json"))
	if len(rows) != 1 || rows[0].Identity.ID == "" || rows[0].Identity.Kind != "try" ||
		rows[0].Experiment.Phase != "active" || rows[0].Experiment.Started == nil ||
		rows[0].Location == nil || rows[0].Location.State != "present" || !rows[0].Live.Present {
		t.Fatalf("initial tries JSON = %+v", rows)
	}
	id := rows[0].Identity.ID

	h.mustRun("tries", "mark", id, "--add", "API", "--add", "api", "--add", "Prototype", "--note", "keep this")
	rows = decodeTriesJSON(t, h.mustRun("tries", "list", "--json"))
	if got := strings.Join(rows[0].Metadata.Tags, ","); got != "api,prototype" || rows[0].Metadata.Note != "keep this" {
		t.Fatalf("marked metadata = %+v", rows[0].Metadata)
	}

	h.mustRun("tries", "abandon", id)
	if rows := decodeTriesJSON(t, h.mustRun("tries", "list", "--json")); len(rows) != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("deprecated Try leaked into default list: %+v", rows)
	}
	rows = decodeTriesJSON(t, h.mustRun("tries", "list", "--all", "--json"))
	if len(rows) != 1 || rows[0].Experiment.Phase != "deprecated" || rows[0].Location.State != "present" {
		t.Fatalf("deprecated history = %+v", rows)
	}

	h.mustRun("tries", "archive", id)
	rows = decodeTriesJSON(t, h.mustRun("tries", "list", "--all", "--json"))
	if len(rows) != 1 || rows[0].Location.State != "archived" || rows[0].Location.RestorePath == "" || rows[0].Live.Present {
		t.Fatalf("archived history = %+v", rows)
	}
	if _, _, err := h.run("tries", "open", id); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("archived Try opened")
	}

	h.mustRun("tries", "reactivate", id)
	h.mustRun("tries", "restore", id)
	rows = decodeTriesJSON(t, h.mustRun("tries", "list", "--json"))
	if len(rows) != 1 || rows[0].Experiment.Phase != "active" || rows[0].Location.State != "present" || !rows[0].Live.Present {
		t.Fatalf("restored active Try = %+v", rows)
	}

	h.mustRun("tries", "mark", id, "--remove", "API", "--note=")
	rows = decodeTriesJSON(t, h.mustRun("tries", "list", "--json"))
	if got := strings.Join(rows[0].Metadata.Tags, ","); got != "prototype" || rows[0].Metadata.Note != "" {
		t.Fatalf("cleared metadata = %+v", rows[0].Metadata)
	}
	if out := h.mustRun("tries", "--help"); !strings.Contains(out, "archive") || !strings.Contains(out, "graduate") {
		t.Fatalf("tries help does not register lifecycle commands:\n%s", out)
	}
}

func TestTriesGraduateUsesSharedBehaviorAndLegacyTryGrammar(t *testing.T) {
	h := newHarness(t)
	// The singular command must continue treating a management-looking word as a
	// positional experiment name.
	h.mustRun("try", "archive", "--no-git")
	if entries, err := os.ReadDir(filepath.Join(h.home, "tries")); err != nil || len(entries) != 1 || !strings.HasSuffix(entries[0].Name(), "-archive") {
		t.Fatalf("dev try archive grammar changed: %v, %v", entries, err)
	}

	out := h.mustRun("tries", "graduate", "archive", "--category", "Labs")
	if !strings.Contains(out, "is now a project") || !strings.Contains(out, "dev start archive") {
		t.Fatalf("nested graduate output differs from legacy behavior:\n%s", out)
	}
	if _, err := os.Stat(filepath.Join(h.scanRoot, "Labs", "archive")); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("nested graduate destination: %v", err)
	}
}

type repoJSONFixture struct {
	Name string `json:"name"`
	Kind string `json:"kind"`
	Path string `json:"path"`
	Asset *struct {
		ID    string   `json:"id"`
		Kind  string   `json:"kind"`
		Phase string   `json:"phase"`
		Tags  []string `json:"tags"`
		Note  string   `json:"note"`
	} `json:"asset"`
}

func decodeRepoJSON(t *testing.T, body string) []repoJSONFixture {
	t.Helper()
	var rows []repoJSONFixture
	if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(body), &rows); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("invalid repo JSON: %v\n%s", err, body)
	}
	return rows
}

func findRepoJSON(t *testing.T, rows []repoJSONFixture, name string) repoJSONFixture {
	t.Helper()
	for _, row := range rows {
		if row.Name == name {
			return row
		}
	}
	t.Fatalf("repository %q not found in %+v", name, rows)
	return repoJSONFixture{}
}

func TestRepoMarkAndTrySuppressionWithGraduatedReappearance(t *testing.T) {
	h := newHarness(t)
	enableTryScanning(t, h)

	h.mustRun("repo", "mark", "demo", "--add", "API", "--add", "api", "--add", "backend", "--note", "primary repo")
	rows := decodeRepoJSON(t, h.mustRun("repo", "list", "--json"))
	demo := findRepoJSON(t, rows, "demo")
	if demo.Kind != "repository" || demo.Asset == nil || strings.Join(demo.Asset.Tags, ",") != "api,backend" || demo.Asset.Note != "primary repo" {
		t.Fatalf("marked repository JSON = %+v", demo)
	}
	h.mustRun("repo", "mark", "demo", "--remove", "API", "--note=")
	demo = findRepoJSON(t, decodeRepoJSON(t, h.mustRun("repo", "list", "--json")), "demo")
	if demo.Asset == nil || strings.Join(demo.Asset.Tags, ",") != "backend" || demo.Asset.Note != "" {
		t.Fatalf("repository clear-note result = %+v", demo)
	}

	h.mustRun("try", "hidden-repo")
	tries := decodeTriesJSON(t, h.mustRun("tries", "list", "--json"))
	tryID := tries[0].Identity.ID
	defaultRows := decodeRepoJSON(t, h.mustRun("repo", "list", "--json"))
	for _, row := range defaultRows {
		if strings.Contains(row.Name, "hidden-repo") || row.Kind == "try" {
			t.Fatalf("active Try leaked into default repo list: %+v", defaultRows)
		}
	}
	included := decodeRepoJSON(t, h.mustRun("repo", "list", "--include-tries", "--json"))
	var sawTry bool
	for _, row := range included {
		if row.Asset != nil && row.Asset.ID == tryID {
			sawTry = row.Kind == "try" && row.Asset.Kind == "try"
		}
	}
	if !sawTry {
		t.Fatalf("--include-tries did not mark the Try: %+v", included)
	}

	h.mustRun("tries", "deprecate", tryID)
	for _, row := range decodeRepoJSON(t, h.mustRun("repo", "list", "--json")) {
		if row.Kind == "try" {
			t.Fatalf("deprecated Try leaked into default repo list: %+v", row)
		}
	}
	h.mustRun("tries", "graduate", tryID)
	graduated := findRepoJSON(t, decodeRepoJSON(t, h.mustRun("repo", "list", "--json")), "hidden-repo")
	if graduated.Kind != "repository" || graduated.Asset == nil || graduated.Asset.Phase != "graduated" {
		t.Fatalf("graduated repository did not reappear: %+v", graduated)
	}
}

func TestRemoteJSONIdentifiesCatalogedTryForCachedAndLiveMatching(t *testing.T) {
	h := newHarness(t)
	enableTryScanning(t, h)
	h.mustRun("try", "remote-try")
	tries := decodeTriesJSON(t, h.mustRun("tries", "list", "--json"))
	path := tries[0].Location.CurrentPath
	command := exec.Command("git", "remote", "add", "origin", "https://github.com/owner/remote-try.git")
	command.Dir = path
	if output, err := command.CombinedOutput(); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("add origin: %v\n%s", err, output)
	}
	// A reconcile refreshes both raw origin provenance and normalized identity.
	h.mustRun("tries", "list", "--all")
	cachePath := filepath.Join(config.CacheHome(), "dev", "remotes.json")
	if err := forge.SaveCache(cachePath, []forge.RemoteRepo{{
		Forge: forge.GitHub, Name: "remote-try", FullName: "owner/remote-try",
		URL: "https://github.com/owner/remote-try", CloneURL: "https://github.com/owner/remote-try.git",
	}}); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	out := h.mustRun("repo", "remote", "--cached", "--json")
	var rows []struct {
		LocalPath string `json:"local_path"`
		LocalKind string `json:"local_kind"`
	}
	if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(out), &rows); err != nil || len(rows) != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("remote JSON = %v, %s", err, out)
	}
	if rows[0].LocalPath == "" || rows[0].LocalKind != "try" {
		t.Fatalf("cached remote did not identify local Try: %+v", rows[0])
	}
}

func TestCorruptCatalogKeepsReadablePartialOutputAndAvoidsSuppression(t *testing.T) {
	h := newHarness(t)
	enableTryScanning(t, h)
	h.mustRun("try", "partial")
	assetsDir := filepath.Join(h.home, "state", "assets")
	if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(assetsDir, "broken.toml"), []byte("not = = toml"), 0o644); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}

	out, errOut, err := h.run("tries", "list", "--all", "--json")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("partial tries list: %v\n%s", err, errOut)
	}
	if rows := decodeTriesJSON(t, out); len(rows) == 0 {
		t.Fatal("valid Try was hidden by a corrupt record")
	}
	if !strings.Contains(errOut, "broken.toml") {
		t.Fatalf("corrupt catalog warning missing: %q", errOut)
	}

	out, errOut, err = h.run("repo", "list", "--json")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("partial repo list: %v\n%s", err, errOut)
	}
	rows := decodeRepoJSON(t, out)
	var visibleTry bool
	for _, row := range rows {
		if strings.Contains(row.Name, "partial") {
			visibleTry = true
		}
	}
	if !visibleTry {
		t.Fatalf("incomplete catalog silently suppressed ambiguous Try row: %+v", rows)
	}
	if !strings.Contains(errOut, "broken.toml") {
		t.Fatalf("repo catalog warning missing: %q", errOut)
	}
}
```

```go
func newRepoCatalogCollectorFixture(t *testing.T) (*App, *catalog.Entry, string) {
	t.Helper()
	physicalRoot := t.TempDir()
	repository := gittest.New(t)
	repository.Git("remote", "add", "origin", "https://github.com/owner/catalog-try.git")
	physical := filepath.Join(physicalRoot, "catalog-try")
	if err := os.Rename(repository.Root, physical); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	scanRoot := t.TempDir()
	alias := filepath.Join(scanRoot, "catalog-try")
	if err := os.Symlink(physical, alias); err != nil {
		t.Skipf("symlinks unavailable: %v", err)
	}
	discovered, err := gitx.Discover(context.Background(), physical)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	store := catalog.NewStore(filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "assets"),
		catalog.WithIDGenerator(func() string { return "collector-try" }))
	entry := &catalog.Entry{
		Kind: catalog.KindTry, Name: "catalog-try",
		RemoteIdentity: catalog.NormalizeRemoteIdentity("https://github.com/owner/catalog-try.git"),
		Experiment: &catalog.Experiment{
			Phase: catalog.PhaseActive, Slug: "catalog-try", Started: time.Now().UTC(),
			OriginURL: "https://github.com/owner/catalog-try.git", OriginalPath: physical,
		},
		Locations: map[string]catalog.Location{
			config.Hostname(): {
				State: catalog.LocationPresent, CurrentPath: physical, RealPath: physical,
				GitCommonDir: discovered.GitCommonDir,
			},
		},
	}
	if err := store.Create(entry); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	cfg := config.Default()
	cfg.Paths.ScanRoots = []string{scanRoot}
	app := &App{
		Cfg: cfg, Tasks: task.NewStore(filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "tasks")),
		Catalog: store, Registry: catalog.NewRegistry(store),
		Out: &bytes.Buffer{}, Err: &bytes.Buffer{},
	}
	return app, entry, alias
}

func TestCollectReposSuppressesCanonicalTryWithOptInAndCorruptFallback(t *testing.T) {
	app, entry, alias := newRepoCatalogCollectorFixture(t)
	rows, err := collectRepos(context.Background(), app, runtime.None{})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if len(rows) != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("default collector exposed active Try through symlink: %+v", rows)
	}
	rows, err = collectReposWithOptions(context.Background(), app, runtime.None{}, repoCollectOptions{IncludeTries: true})
	if err != nil || len(rows) != 1 || rows[0].Asset == nil || rows[0].Asset.ID != entry.ID || rows[0].Repo.Path != alias {
		t.Fatalf("opt-in collector = %+v, %v", rows, err)
	}

	if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(app.Catalog.Dir, "broken.toml"), []byte("not = = toml"), 0o644); err != nil {

	if err != nil || len(rows) != 1 {

	if warnings := app.Err.(*bytes.Buffer).String(); !strings.Contains(warnings, "broken.toml") {
		t.Fatalf("catalog warning missing: %q", warnings)
	}
}
```

```go
package experiment

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"io/fs"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"

	"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/catalog"
	"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/pathx"
)

// ErrCrossFilesystem identifies a transition that cannot use one atomic move.
var ErrCrossFilesystem = errors.New("cross-filesystem move is not supported")

// FinalizeError reports whether a failed post-move catalog transition was
// successfully rolled back. Cause remains available through errors.Is/As.
type FinalizeError struct {
	Operation   string
	Source      string
	Destination string
	Cause       error
	RollbackErr error
}

func (e *FinalizeError) Error() string {
	operation := e.Operation
	if operation == "" {
		operation = "graduation"
	}
	if e.RollbackErr == nil {
		return fmt.Sprintf("finalize %s catalog after moving %s to %s: %v; move rolled back",
			operation, e.Source, e.Destination, e.Cause)
	}
	return fmt.Sprintf("finalize %s catalog after moving %s to %s: %v; rollback to %s also failed: %v",
		operation, e.Source, e.Destination, e.Cause, e.Source, e.RollbackErr)
}

func (e *FinalizeError) Unwrap() []error {
	if e.RollbackErr == nil {
		return []error{e.Cause}
	}
	return []error{e.Cause, e.RollbackErr}
}

func (s *Service) availableGraduationDestination(components []string) (string, error) {
	intended := filepath.Join(append([]string{s.projectRoot}, components...)...)
	if err := rejectExisting(intended); err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	destination, err := pathx.JoinChild(s.projectRoot, components...)
	if err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	if err := rejectExisting(destination); err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	return destination, nil
}

func storedLocationMatches(location catalog.Location, source string) bool {
	return filepath.Clean(location.CurrentPath) == source || filepath.Clean(location.RealPath) == source
}

func (s *Service) resolveGraduateItem(ctx context.Context, request GraduateRequest) (Item, []Diagnostic, error) {
	if strings.TrimSpace(request.Ref) != "" {
		return s.ResolveWithOptions(ctx, request.Ref, ResolveOptions{
			IncludeDeprecated: true,
			IncludeArchived:   true,
		})
	}
	current := request.CurrentDir
	if current == "" {
		var err error
		current, err = s.getwd()
		if err != nil {
			return Item{}, nil, fmt.Errorf("get current directory: %w", err)
		}
	}
	canonicalCurrent, err := pathx.CanonicalChild(s.triesRoot, current)
	if err != nil {
		return Item{}, nil, fmt.Errorf("%s is not inside %s — name the try to graduate", current, s.triesRoot)
	}
	canonicalRoot, err := pathx.Canonical(s.triesRoot)
	if err != nil {
		return Item{}, nil, err
	}
	relative, err := filepath.Rel(canonicalRoot, canonicalCurrent)
	if err != nil {
		return Item{}, nil, err
	}
	first, _, _ := strings.Cut(relative, string(filepath.Separator))
	if first == "" || first == "." || strings.HasPrefix(first, ".") {
		return Item{}, nil, fmt.Errorf("%s is not inside a visible try under %s", current, s.triesRoot)
	}
	return s.ResolveWithOptions(ctx, filepath.Join(s.triesRoot, first), ResolveOptions{
		IncludeDeprecated: true,
		IncludeArchived:   true,
	})
}

func (s *Service) hasCommit(ctx context.Context, directory string) bool {
	if unix, _, err := s.gitLastCommit(ctx, directory); err == nil && unix > 0 {
		return true
	}
	_, err := s.gitRun(ctx, directory, "rev-parse", "--verify", "HEAD")
	return err == nil
}

func (s *Service) ensureInitialCommit(ctx context.Context, directory, name string) (bool, error) {
	if s.hasCommit(ctx, directory) {
		return false, nil
	}
	empty, err := isEmptyWorkTree(directory)
	if err != nil {
		return false, err
	}
	if empty {
		readme := filepath.Join(directory, "README.md")
		file, err := os.OpenFile(readme, os.O_WRONLY|os.O_CREATE|os.O_EXCL, 0o644)
		if err != nil {
			return false, err
		}
		if _, err := fmt.Fprintf(file, "# %s\n", name); err != nil {
			_ = file.Close()
			return false, err
		}
		if err := file.Close(); err != nil {
			return false, err
		}
	}
	if _, err := s.gitRun(ctx, directory, "add", "--all"); err != nil {
		return false, err
	}
	tracked, err := s.gitRun(ctx, directory, "ls-files", "--cached")
	if err != nil {
		return false, err
	}
	commitArgs := []string{"commit"}
	if tracked == "" {
		// A Try containing only globally ignored files still needs a HEAD, but dev
		// must not force-add or overwrite those user files merely to manufacture it.
		commitArgs = append(commitArgs, "--allow-empty")
	}
	commitArgs = append(commitArgs, "-m", "chore: graduate experiment into a project")
	if _, err := s.gitRun(ctx, directory, commitArgs...); err != nil {
		return false, err
	}
	return true, nil
}

func rejectExisting(path string) error {
	if _, err := os.Lstat(path); err == nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("%s already exists", path)
	} else if !errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
		return fmt.Errorf("inspect move destination %s: %w", path, err)
	}
	return nil
}

func isEmptyWorkTree(directory string) (bool, error) {
	entries, err := os.ReadDir(directory)
	if err != nil {
		return false, err
	}
	for _, entry := range entries {
		if entry.Name() != ".git" {
			return false, nil
		}
	}
	return true, nil
}

func nearestExisting(path string) (string, error) {
	path = filepath.Clean(path)
	for {
		if _, err := os.Stat(path); err == nil {
			return path, nil
		} else if !errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
			return "", err
		}
		parent := filepath.Dir(path)
		if parent == path {
			return "", fmt.Errorf("no existing ancestor for %s", path)
		}
		path = parent
	}
}
```

```go
//go:build linux

package experiment

import (
	"errors"
	"os"

	"golang.org/x/sys/unix"
)

func renameExclusive(source, destination string) error {
	err := unix.Renameat2(unix.AT_FDCWD, source, unix.AT_FDCWD, destination, unix.RENAME_NOREPLACE)
	if !errors.Is(err, unix.ENOSYS) && !errors.Is(err, unix.EINVAL) {
		return err
	}
	// Older kernels and filesystems may not implement renameat2. Retain the
	// collision check on that compatibility path; supported systems stay atomic.
	if err := rejectExisting(destination); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	return os.Rename(source, destination)
}

```

```text
18	// Deprecate changes only experiment metadata. The host location remains
19	// present, archived, or evicted exactly as it was.
20	func (s *Service) Deprecate(ctx context.Context, request TransitionRequest) (TransitionResult, error) {
21		item, diagnostics, err := s.ResolveWithOptions(ctx, request.Ref, ResolveOptions{
22			IncludeDeprecated: true,
23			IncludeArchived:   true,
24			IncludeEvicted:    true,
25		})
26		result := TransitionResult{Item: item, Diagnostics: diagnostics}
27		if err != nil {
28			return result, err
29		}
30		updated, err := s.updatePhase(ctx, item.ID, catalog.PhaseDeprecated)
31		if err != nil {
32			return result, err
33		}
34		result.Item = s.itemForEntry(ctx, updated)
35		return result, nil
36	}
37	
38	// Reactivate changes only experiment metadata. It never restores or recreates
39	// host-local bytes.
40	func (s *Service) Reactivate(ctx context.Context, request TransitionRequest) (TransitionResult, error) {
41		item, diagnostics, err := s.ResolveWithOptions(ctx, request.Ref, ResolveOptions{
42			IncludeDeprecated: true,
43			IncludeArchived:   true,
44			IncludeEvicted:    true,
45		})
46		result := TransitionResult{Item: item, Diagnostics: diagnostics}
47		if err != nil {
48			return result, err
49		}
50		updated, err := s.updatePhase(ctx, item.ID, catalog.PhaseActive)
51		if err != nil {
52			return result, err
53		}
54		result.Item = s.itemForEntry(ctx, updated)
55		return result, nil
56	}

58	func (s *Service) updatePhase(ctx context.Context, id string, phase catalog.ExperimentPhase) (*catalog.Entry, error) {
59		var updated *catalog.Entry
60		err := s.store.WithLock(ctx, func() error {
61			current, err := s.store.Get(id)
62			if err != nil {
63				return err
64			}
65			if !eligibleTryRecord(current) {
66				return &NotFoundError{Ref: id, Root: s.triesRoot}
67			}
68			if current.MoveIntent != nil {
69				return fmt.Errorf("try %s has a pending %s move", id, current.MoveIntent.Operation)
70			}
71			if current.Experiment.Phase == phase {
72				updated = current
73				return nil
74			}
75			now := s.now()
76			updated, err = s.catalogUpdate(id, func(entry *catalog.Entry) error {
77				if !eligibleTryRecord(entry) {
78					return &NotFoundError{Ref: id, Root: s.triesRoot}
79				}
80				if entry.MoveIntent != nil {
81					return fmt.Errorf("try %s has a pending %s move", id, entry.MoveIntent.Operation)
82				}
83				switch phase {
84				case catalog.PhaseDeprecated:
85					if entry.Experiment.Phase != catalog.PhaseActive {
86						return fmt.Errorf("try %s cannot transition from %s to deprecated", id, entry.Experiment.Phase)
87					}
88					entry.Experiment.Phase = catalog.PhaseDeprecated
89					entry.Experiment.DeprecatedAt = now
90					if location, ok := entry.LocationFor(s.host); ok {
91						entry.Experiment.DeprecatedPath = location.CurrentPath
92					}
93					if entry.Experiment.DeprecatedPath == "" {
94						entry.Experiment.DeprecatedPath = entry.Experiment.OriginalPath
95					}
96				case catalog.PhaseActive:
97					if entry.Experiment.Phase != catalog.PhaseDeprecated {
98						return fmt.Errorf("try %s cannot transition from %s to active", id, entry.Experiment.Phase)
99					}
100					entry.Experiment.Phase = catalog.PhaseActive
101				default:
102					return fmt.Errorf("unsupported experiment phase %q", phase)
103				}
104				return nil
105			})
106			return err
107		})
108		if err != nil {
109			return nil, fmt.Errorf("transition try %s to %s: %w", id, phase, err)
110		}
111		return updated, nil
112	}
113	
114	// Patch changes tags and note while preserving task tags as a separate model.
115	func (s *Service) Patch(ctx context.Context, request PatchRequest) (Item, []Diagnostic, error) {
116		item, diagnostics, err := s.ResolveWithOptions(ctx, request.Ref, ResolveOptions{
117			IncludeDeprecated: true,
118			IncludeArchived:   true,
119			IncludeEvicted:    true,
120			IncludeGraduated:  true,
121		})
122		if err != nil {
123			return Item{}, diagnostics, err
124		}
125		remove := catalog.NormalizeTags(request.RemoveTags)
126		add := catalog.NormalizeTags(request.AddTags)
127		var updated *catalog.Entry
128		err = s.store.WithLock(ctx, func() error {
129			var updateErr error
130			updated, updateErr = s.catalogUpdate(item.ID, func(entry *catalog.Entry) error {
131				if entry.Experiment == nil {
132					return &NotFoundError{Ref: request.Ref, Root: s.triesRoot}
133				}
134				if entry.MoveIntent != nil {
135					return fmt.Errorf("try %s has a pending %s move", entry.ID, entry.MoveIntent.Operation)
136				}
137				kept := make([]string, 0, len(entry.Tags)+len(add))
138				for _, tag := range entry.Tags {
139					if !slices.Contains(remove, strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(tag))) {
140						kept = append(kept, tag)
141					}
142				}
143				entry.Tags = append(kept, add...)
144				if request.Note != nil {
145					entry.Note = *request.Note
146				}
147				return nil
148			})
149			return updateErr
150		})
151		if err != nil {
152			return Item{}, diagnostics, fmt.Errorf("mark try %s: %w", request.Ref, err)
153		}
154		return s.itemForEntry(ctx, updated), diagnostics, nil
155	}
156	
157	// Attach explicitly associates an existing catalog ID with one visible Try
158	// directory. Corrupt catalog state blocks the attachment because an unreadable
159	// record may already own the path or Git common directory.
160	func (s *Service) Attach(ctx context.Context, id, path string) (Item, error) {
161		canonical, err := pathx.Canonical(path)
162		if err != nil {
163			return Item{}, fmt.Errorf("attach try path: %w", err)
164		}
165		if err := s.validateVisibleTryPath(canonical); err != nil {
166			return Item{}, fmt.Errorf("attach try path: %w", err)
167		}
168		probe := s.probeDirectory(ctx, canonical)
169		if !probe.valid {
170			if probe.diagnostic != nil {
171				return Item{}, probe.diagnostic
172			}
173			return Item{}, fmt.Errorf("attach try path %s: not a directory", canonical)
174		}
175	
176		var updated *catalog.Entry
177		err = s.store.WithLock(ctx, func() error {
178			entry, getErr := s.store.Get(id)
179			if getErr != nil {
180				return getErr
181			}
182			if !eligibleTryRecord(entry) {
183				return &NotFoundError{Ref: id, Root: s.triesRoot}
184			}
185			if entry.MoveIntent != nil {
186				return fmt.Errorf("try %s has a pending %s move", id, entry.MoveIntent.Operation)
187			}
188			if location, located := entry.LocationFor(s.host); located && !samePath(location.CurrentPath, canonical) {
189				switch location.State {
190				case catalog.LocationArchived:
191					return fmt.Errorf("try %s is archived on this host; use restore instead of attach", id)
192				case catalog.LocationEvicted:
193					return fmt.Errorf("try %s is evicted on this host and cannot be attached without recovery", id)
194				case catalog.LocationPresent:
195					if exists, statErr := pathExists(location.CurrentPath); statErr != nil {
196						return statErr
197					} else if exists {
198						return fmt.Errorf("try %s is still present at %s", id, location.CurrentPath)
199					}
200				}
201			}
202			entries, diagnostics, listErr := s.store.ListWithDiagnostics()
203			if listErr != nil {
204				return listErr
205			}
206			if len(diagnostics) > 0 {
207				return incompleteCatalogError(diagnostics)
208			}
209			for _, matched := range matchingEntries(entries, s.host, probe) {
210				if matched.ID != id {
211					return fmt.Errorf("attach %s: path or Git common directory already belongs to catalog asset %s", id, matched.ID)
212				}
213			}
214			updated, getErr = s.catalogUpdate(id, func(candidate *catalog.Entry) error {
215				if !eligibleTryRecord(candidate) {
216					return &NotFoundError{Ref: id, Root: s.triesRoot}
217				}
218				if candidate.MoveIntent != nil {
219					return fmt.Errorf("try %s has a pending %s move", id, candidate.MoveIntent.Operation)
220				}
221				previous, _ := candidate.LocationFor(s.host)
222				if probe.originURL != "" {
223					candidate.Experiment.OriginURL = probe.originURL
224					candidate.RemoteIdentity = remoteIdentityFromOrigin(probe.originURL)
225				}
226				return candidate.SetLocation(s.host, locationFromProbe(probe, previous))
227			})
228			return getErr
229		})
230		if err != nil {
231			return Item{}, fmt.Errorf("attach try %s: %w", id, err)
232		}
233		return s.itemForEntry(ctx, updated), nil
234	}
235	
236	// PlanGraduate resolves either a present or archived Try and validates its
237	// project destination without changing repository contents.
238	func (s *Service) PlanGraduate(ctx context.Context, request GraduateRequest) (GraduatePlan, error) {
239		item, diagnostics, err := s.resolveGraduateItem(ctx, request)
240		plan := GraduatePlan{Item: item, DryRun: request.DryRun, Diagnostics: diagnostics}
241		if err != nil {
242			return plan, err
243		}
244		if item.Entry == nil || item.ID == "" || item.CatalogError != nil {
245			if item.CatalogError != nil {
246				return plan, fmt.Errorf("try %s is not safely tracked: %w", item.DisplayName(), item.CatalogError)
247			}
248			return plan, fmt.Errorf("try %s is not safely tracked in the catalog", item.DisplayName())
249		}
250		location, ok := item.Entry.LocationFor(s.host)
251		if !ok || (location.State != catalog.LocationPresent && location.State != catalog.LocationArchived) {
252			return plan, &NotFoundError{Ref: request.Ref, Root: s.triesRoot}
253		}
254		source, err := pathx.Canonical(location.CurrentPath)
255		if err != nil {
256			return plan, fmt.Errorf("graduate source %s: %w", location.CurrentPath, err)
257		}
258	
259		name := request.Name
260		if name == "" {
261			name, _, _ = splitDatedBasename(filepath.Base(source))
262		}
263		if name == "" {
264			return plan, fmt.Errorf("could not derive a project name from %s — pass --name", source)
265		}
266		if err := pathx.ValidateComponent(name); err != nil {
267			return plan, fmt.Errorf("project name %q: %w", name, err)
268		}
269		if name != strings.TrimSpace(name) {
270			return plan, fmt.Errorf("project name %q is not normalized: %w", name, pathx.ErrInvalidComponent)
271		}
272		if request.Category != "" {
273			if err := pathx.ValidateComponent(request.Category); err != nil {
274				return plan, fmt.Errorf("project category %q: %w", request.Category, err)
275			}
276			if request.Category != strings.TrimSpace(request.Category) {
277				return plan, fmt.Errorf("project category %q is not normalized: %w", request.Category, pathx.ErrInvalidComponent)
278			}
279		}
280		components := []string{name}
281		if request.Category != "" {
282			components = []string{request.Category, name}
283		}
284		destination, err := s.availableGraduationDestination(components)
285		if err != nil {
286			return plan, fmt.Errorf("choose graduation destination: %w", err)
287		}
288		transition := TransitionPlan{
289			Operation: TransitionGraduate, Item: item,
290			Source: source, Destination: destination, Diagnostics: diagnostics,
291		}
292		if err := s.validatePlannedMove(item.Entry, transition); err != nil {
293			return plan, err
294		}
295		probe, err := s.inspectMovableSource(ctx, source)
296		if err != nil {
297			return plan, err
298		}
299		transition.LinkedWorktree = probe.live.Repo != nil && probe.live.Repo.IsLinkedWorktree
300	
301		plan.Source = source
302		plan.Destination = destination
303		plan.Category = request.Category
304		plan.Name = name
305		plan.NeedsGitInit = probe.live.Repo == nil
306		plan.NeedsInitialCommit = plan.NeedsGitInit || !s.hasCommit(ctx, source)
307		plan.LinkedWorktree = transition.LinkedWorktree
308		return plan, nil
309	}
310	
311	// Graduate prepares Git at the current location, then uses the same journaled
312	// move protocol as archive and restore.
313	func (s *Service) Graduate(ctx context.Context, request GraduateRequest) (GraduateResult, error) {
314		plan, err := s.PlanGraduate(ctx, request)
315		result := GraduateResult{Plan: plan, Item: plan.Item, Diagnostics: plan.Diagnostics}
316		if err != nil {
317			return result, err
318		}
319		if request.DryRun {
320			return result, nil
321		}
322		if plan.NeedsGitInit {
323			if _, err := s.gitRun(ctx, plan.Source, "init", "-b", "main"); err != nil {
324				return result, fmt.Errorf("initialize Git before graduating %s: %w", plan.Source, err)
325			}
326			result.GitInitialized = true
327		}
328		made, err := s.ensureInitialCommit(ctx, plan.Source, plan.Name)
329		if err != nil {
330			return result, fmt.Errorf("ensure initial commit before graduating %s: %w", plan.Source, err)
331		}
332		result.InitialCommitMade = made
333	
334		transitionResult, err := s.applyTransition(ctx, TransitionResult{
335			Plan: TransitionPlan{
336				Operation: TransitionGraduate, Item: plan.Item,
337				Source: plan.Source, Destination: plan.Destination,
338				Diagnostics: plan.Diagnostics, LinkedWorktree: plan.LinkedWorktree,
339			},
340			Item: plan.Item, Diagnostics: plan.Diagnostics,
341		})
342		result.Item = transitionResult.Item
343		result.Moved = transitionResult.Moved
344		result.RolledBack = transitionResult.RolledBack
345		result.RollbackError = transitionResult.RollbackError
346		return result, err
347	}
348	
349	// PlanArchive validates a present Try's collision-safe hidden destination.
350	func (s *Service) PlanArchive(ctx context.Context, request TransitionRequest) (TransitionPlan, error) {
351		item, diagnostics, err := s.ResolveWithOptions(ctx, request.Ref, ResolveOptions{IncludeDeprecated: true})
352		plan := TransitionPlan{Operation: TransitionArchive, Item: item, Diagnostics: diagnostics}
353		if err != nil {
354			return plan, err
355		}
356		entry := item.Entry
357		if entry == nil || item.ID == "" || item.CatalogError != nil {
358			return plan, fmt.Errorf("try %s is not safely tracked", item.DisplayName())
359		}
360		location, ok := entry.LocationFor(s.host)
361		if !ok || location.State != catalog.LocationPresent {
362			return plan, fmt.Errorf("try %s is not present on this host", item.DisplayName())
363		}
364		source, err := pathx.Canonical(location.CurrentPath)
365		if err != nil {
366			return plan, fmt.Errorf("archive source: %w", err)
367		}
368		destination, err := s.archiveDestination(entry.ID, filepath.Base(source))
369		if err != nil {
370			return plan, err
371		}
372		plan.Source, plan.Destination = source, destination
373		if err := s.validatePlannedMove(entry, plan); err != nil {
374			return plan, err
375		}
376		probe, err := s.inspectMovableSource(ctx, source)
377		if err != nil {
378			return plan, err
379		}
380		plan.LinkedWorktree = probe.live.Repo != nil && probe.live.Repo.IsLinkedWorktree
381		return plan, nil
382	}
383	
384	// Archive moves a present Try into <tries_root>/.dev/archive/<id>/<basename>.
385	func (s *Service) Archive(ctx context.Context, request TransitionRequest) (TransitionResult, error) {
386		plan, err := s.PlanArchive(ctx, request)
387		result := TransitionResult{Plan: plan, Item: plan.Item, Diagnostics: plan.Diagnostics}
388		if err != nil {
389			return result, err
390		}
391		return s.applyTransition(ctx, result)
392	}

394	// PlanRestore validates an archived Try's stored or explicit visible target.
395	func (s *Service) PlanRestore(ctx context.Context, request TransitionRequest) (TransitionPlan, error) {
396		item, diagnostics, err := s.ResolveWithOptions(ctx, request.Ref, ResolveOptions{
397			IncludeDeprecated: true,
398			IncludeArchived:   true,
399		})
400		plan := TransitionPlan{Operation: TransitionRestore, Item: item, Diagnostics: diagnostics}
401		if err != nil {
402			return plan, err
403		}
404		entry := item.Entry
405		if entry == nil || item.ID == "" || item.CatalogError != nil {
406			return plan, fmt.Errorf("try %s is not safely tracked", item.DisplayName())
407		}
408		location, ok := entry.LocationFor(s.host)
409		if !ok || location.State != catalog.LocationArchived {
410			return plan, fmt.Errorf("try %s is not archived on this host", item.DisplayName())
411		}
412		source, err := pathx.Canonical(location.CurrentPath)
413		if err != nil {
414			return plan, fmt.Errorf("restore source: %w", err)
415		}
416		destination := location.RestorePath
417		if request.To != "" {
418			destination, err = s.explicitRestoreDestination(request.To)
419			if err != nil {
420				return plan, err
421			}
422		}
423		if destination == "" {
424			return plan, fmt.Errorf("try %s has no stored restore path; pass --to", item.DisplayName())
425		}
426		destination, err = pathx.Canonical(destination)
427		if err != nil {
428			return plan, fmt.Errorf("restore destination: %w", err)
429		}
430		plan.Source, plan.Destination = source, destination
431		if err := s.validatePlannedMove(entry, plan); err != nil {
432			return plan, err
433		}
434		probe, err := s.inspectMovableSource(ctx, source)
435		if err != nil {
436			return plan, err
437		}
438		plan.LinkedWorktree = probe.live.Repo != nil && probe.live.Repo.IsLinkedWorktree
439		return plan, nil
440	}
441	
442	// Restore moves an archived Try back to its stored or explicit visible path.
443	func (s *Service) Restore(ctx context.Context, request TransitionRequest) (TransitionResult, error) {
444		plan, err := s.PlanRestore(ctx, request)
445		result := TransitionResult{Plan: plan, Item: plan.Item, Diagnostics: plan.Diagnostics}
446		if err != nil {
447			return result, err
448		}
449		return s.applyTransition(ctx, result)
450	}
451	
452	func (s *Service) validatePlannedMove(entry *catalog.Entry, plan TransitionPlan) error {
453		if err := s.validateTransitionEntry(entry, plan.Operation, plan.Source); err != nil {
454			return err
455		}
456		if err := s.validateTransitionPaths(entry, plan.Operation, plan.Source, plan.Destination); err != nil {
457			return err
458		}
459		sourceExists, err := pathExists(plan.Source)
460		if err != nil {
461			return fmt.Errorf("inspect move source %s: %w", plan.Source, err)
462		}
463		if !sourceExists {
464			return fmt.Errorf("move source %s does not exist", plan.Source)
465		}
466		if err := rejectExisting(plan.Destination); err != nil {
467			return err
468		}
469		same, err := s.sameFilesystem(plan.Source, plan.Destination)
470		if err != nil {
471			return fmt.Errorf("compare move filesystems: %w", err)
472		}
473		if !same {
474			return fmt.Errorf("move %s to %s: %w", plan.Source, plan.Destination, ErrCrossFilesystem)
475		}
476		return nil
477	}
478	
479	func (s *Service) applyTransition(ctx context.Context, result TransitionResult) (TransitionResult, error) {
480		plan := result.Plan
481		if err := s.beginMoveIntent(ctx, plan); err != nil {
482			return result, err
483		}
484	
485		failMove := func(cause error) (TransitionResult, error) {
486			repairErr := s.reconcileMoveIntentByID(ctx, plan.Item.ID)
487			if repairErr != nil {
488				return result, errors.Join(cause, fmt.Errorf("repair pending %s intent: %w", plan.Operation, repairErr))
489			}
490			return result, cause
491		}
492	
493		if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(plan.Destination), 0o755); err != nil {
494			return failMove(fmt.Errorf("create %s destination parent: %w", plan.Operation, err))
495		}
496		same, err := s.sameFilesystem(plan.Source, plan.Destination)
497		if err != nil {
498			return failMove(fmt.Errorf("compare move filesystems: %w", err))
499		}
500		if !same {
501			return failMove(fmt.Errorf("move %s to %s: %w", plan.Source, plan.Destination, ErrCrossFilesystem))
502		}
503		fresh, err := s.store.Get(plan.Item.ID)
504		if err != nil {
505			return failMove(fmt.Errorf("reload %s intent: %w", plan.Operation, err))
506		}
507		if err := s.validateTransitionEntry(fresh, plan.Operation, plan.Source); err != nil {
508			return failMove(fmt.Errorf("revalidate %s catalog source: %w", plan.Operation, err))
509		}
510		if err := s.validateTransitionPaths(fresh, plan.Operation, plan.Source, plan.Destination); err != nil {
511			return failMove(fmt.Errorf("revalidate %s paths: %w", plan.Operation, err))
512		}
513		if err := rejectExisting(plan.Destination); err != nil {
514			return failMove(err)
515		}
516		probe, err := s.inspectMovableSource(ctx, plan.Source)
517		if err != nil {
518			return failMove(err)
519		}
520		linked := probe.live.Repo != nil && probe.live.Repo.IsLinkedWorktree
521		if linked != plan.LinkedWorktree {
522			return failMove(fmt.Errorf("%s source Git worktree identity changed after planning", plan.Operation))
523		}
524		if err := s.movePath(ctx, linked, plan.Source, plan.Destination); err != nil {
525			if errors.Is(err, syscall.EXDEV) {
526				return failMove(fmt.Errorf("move %s to %s: %w", plan.Source, plan.Destination, ErrCrossFilesystem))
527			}
528			return failMove(fmt.Errorf("move %s to %s: %w", plan.Source, plan.Destination, err))
529		}
530		result.Moved = true
531	
532		destinationProbe := s.probeDirectory(ctx, plan.Destination)
533		if !destinationProbe.valid {
534			cause := errors.New("moved destination is not a directory")
535			if destinationProbe.diagnostic != nil {
536				cause = destinationProbe.diagnostic.Err
537			}
538			return s.rollbackTransition(ctx, result, cause)
539		}
540		updated, err := s.finalizeMoveIntent(ctx, plan.Item.ID, destinationProbe)
541		if err != nil {
542			return s.rollbackTransition(ctx, result, err)
543		}
544		result.Item = itemFromEntry(updated, destinationProbe.live)
545		enriched := s.enrich(ctx, []Item{result.Item})
546		if len(enriched) == 1 {
547			result.Item = enriched[0]
548		}
549		return result, nil
550	}
551	
552	func (s *Service) beginMoveIntent(ctx context.Context, plan TransitionPlan) error {
553		return s.store.WithLock(ctx, func() error {
554			entry, err := s.store.Get(plan.Item.ID)
555			if err != nil {
556				return err
557			}
558			if entry.MoveIntent != nil {
559				return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s already has a pending %s move", entry.ID, entry.MoveIntent.Operation)
560			}
561			if err := s.validateTransitionEntry(entry, plan.Operation, plan.Source); err != nil {
562				return err
563			}
564			if err := s.validateTransitionPaths(entry, plan.Operation, plan.Source, plan.Destination); err != nil {
565				return err
566			}
567			sourceExists, err := pathExists(plan.Source)
568			if err != nil {
569				return err
570			}
571			destinationExists, err := pathExists(plan.Destination)
572			if err != nil {
573				return err
574			}
575			if !sourceExists || destinationExists {
576				return fmt.Errorf("stale %s plan: source exists=%t destination exists=%t", plan.Operation, sourceExists, destinationExists)
577			}
578			_, err = s.catalogUpdate(entry.ID, func(current *catalog.Entry) error {
579				if current.MoveIntent != nil {
580					return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s already has a pending %s move", current.ID, current.MoveIntent.Operation)
581				}
582				if err := s.validateTransitionEntry(current, plan.Operation, plan.Source); err != nil {
583					return err
584				}
585				current.MoveIntent = &catalog.MoveIntent{
586					Host: s.host, Operation: string(plan.Operation),
587					SourcePath: plan.Source, DestinationPath: plan.Destination,
588					Started: s.now(),
589				}
590				return nil
591			})
592			return err
593		})
594	}
595	
596	func (s *Service) rollbackTransition(ctx context.Context, result TransitionResult, cause error) (TransitionResult, error) {
597		plan := result.Plan
598		rollbackErr := rejectExisting(plan.Source)
599		if rollbackErr == nil {
600			rollbackErr = s.movePath(ctx, plan.LinkedWorktree, plan.Destination, plan.Source)
601		}
602		if rollbackErr == nil {
603			if repairErr := s.reconcileMoveIntentByID(ctx, plan.Item.ID); repairErr != nil {
604				rollbackErr = fmt.Errorf("filesystem move rolled back but catalog intent repair failed: %w", repairErr)
605			}
606		}
607		result.RollbackError = rollbackErr
608		result.RolledBack = rollbackErr == nil
609		if rollbackErr == nil {
610			result.Moved = false
611		}
612		operation := string(plan.Operation)
613		if plan.Operation == TransitionGraduate {
614			operation = "graduation"
615		}
616		return result, &FinalizeError{
617			Operation: operation, Source: plan.Source, Destination: plan.Destination,
618			Cause: cause, RollbackErr: rollbackErr,
619		}
620	}
621	
622	func (s *Service) movePath(ctx context.Context, linked bool, source, destination string) error {
623		if linked {
624			return s.moveWorktree(ctx, source, source, destination)
625		}
626		return s.rename(source, destination)
627	}
628	
629	func (s *Service) inspectMovableSource(ctx context.Context, source string) (directoryProbe, error) {
630		probe := s.probeDirectory(ctx, source)
631		if !probe.valid {
632			if probe.diagnostic != nil {
633				return probe, probe.diagnostic
634			}
635			return probe, fmt.Errorf("move source %s is not a directory", source)
636		}
637		if probe.live.DiscoverError != nil {
638			return probe, fmt.Errorf("inspect Git metadata before move: %w", probe.live.DiscoverError)
639		}
640		if probe.live.Repo == nil {
641			return probe, nil
642		}
643		if probe.live.Repo.Bare {
644			return probe, errors.New("moving a bare repository through Try lifecycle is not supported")
645		}
646		if probe.live.Repo.IsLinkedWorktree {
647			return probe, nil
648		}
649		worktrees, err := s.worktrees(ctx, source)
650		if err != nil {
651			return probe, fmt.Errorf("inspect linked worktrees before move: %w", err)
652		}
653		if len(worktrees) > 1 {
654			return probe, errors.New("moving a main checkout with linked worktrees is not supported; move or remove its linked worktrees first")
655		}
656		return probe, nil
657	}
658	
659	func (s *Service) archiveDestination(id, basename string) (string, error) {
660		if err := catalog.ValidateID(id); err != nil {
661			return "", err
662		}
663		if err := pathx.ValidateComponent(basename); err != nil {
664			return "", fmt.Errorf("archive basename: %w", err)
665		}
666		root, err := s.canonicalArchiveRoot()
667		if err != nil {
668			return "", err
669		}
670		destination, err := pathx.JoinChild(root, id, basename)
671		if err != nil {
672			return "", fmt.Errorf("archive destination: %w", err)
673		}
674		return destination, nil
675	}
676	
677	func (s *Service) canonicalArchiveRoot() (string, error) {
678		triesRoot, err := pathx.Canonical(s.triesRoot)
679		if err != nil {
680			return "", fmt.Errorf("canonicalize tries root: %w", err)
681		}
682		root := filepath.Join(triesRoot, ".dev", "archive")
683		canonical, err := pathx.CanonicalChild(triesRoot, root)
684		if err != nil {
685			return "", fmt.Errorf("validate archive root: %w", err)
686		}
687		return canonical, nil
688	}
689	
690	func (s *Service) explicitRestoreDestination(to string) (string, error) {
691		if filepath.IsAbs(to) {
692			return pathx.Canonical(to)
693		}
694		if err := pathx.ValidateComponent(to); err != nil {
695			return "", fmt.Errorf("restore destination %q: %w", to, err)
696		}
697		return pathx.JoinChild(s.triesRoot, to)
698	}
699	
700	func (s *Service) validateTransitionEntry(entry *catalog.Entry, operation TransitionOperation, source string) error {
701		if !eligibleTryRecord(entry) {
702			return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s is not a mutable Try", entry.ID)
703		}
704		location, ok := entry.LocationFor(s.host)
705		if !ok || !storedLocationMatches(location, source) {
706			return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s moved or was reassigned after planning", entry.ID)
707		}
708		switch operation {
709		case TransitionArchive:
710			if location.State != catalog.LocationPresent {
711				return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s is not present", entry.ID)
712			}
713		case TransitionRestore:
714			if location.State != catalog.LocationArchived {
715				return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s is not archived", entry.ID)
716			}
717		case TransitionGraduate:
718			if location.State != catalog.LocationPresent && location.State != catalog.LocationArchived {
719				return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s is neither present nor archived", entry.ID)
720			}
721		default:
722			return fmt.Errorf("unknown move operation %q", operation)
723		}
724		return nil
725	}
726	
727	func (s *Service) validateTransitionPaths(entry *catalog.Entry, operation TransitionOperation, source, destination string) error {
728		if err := s.validateTransitionContainment(entry.ID, operation, source, destination); err != nil {
729			return err
730		}
731		location, ok := entry.LocationFor(s.host)
732		if !ok || !storedLocationMatches(location, source) {
733			return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s no longer owns %s", entry.ID, source)
734		}
735		return nil
736	}
737	
738	func (s *Service) validateTransitionContainment(id string, operation TransitionOperation, source, destination string) error {
739		canonicalSource, err := pathx.Canonical(source)
740		if err != nil {
741			return fmt.Errorf("canonicalize %s source: %w", operation, err)
742		}
743		canonicalDestination, err := pathx.Canonical(destination)
744		if err != nil {
745			return fmt.Errorf("canonicalize %s destination: %w", operation, err)
746		}
747		if canonicalSource != filepath.Clean(source) || canonicalDestination != filepath.Clean(destination) {
748			return fmt.Errorf("%s paths changed after canonicalization", operation)
749		}
750		if canonicalSource == canonicalDestination {
751			return fmt.Errorf("%s source and destination are identical", operation)
752		}
753	
754		switch operation {
755		case TransitionArchive:
756			if err := s.validateVisibleTryPath(canonicalSource); err != nil {
757				return fmt.Errorf("archive source: %w", err)
758			}
759			expected, err := s.archiveDestination(id, filepath.Base(canonicalSource))
760			if err != nil {
761				return err
762			}
763			if expected != canonicalDestination {
764				return fmt.Errorf("archive destination %s is not the reserved path %s", canonicalDestination, expected)
765			}
766		case TransitionRestore:
767			if err := s.validateArchivedPath(id, canonicalSource); err != nil {
768				return fmt.Errorf("restore source: %w", err)
769			}
770			if err := s.validateVisibleTryPath(canonicalDestination); err != nil {
771				return fmt.Errorf("restore destination: %w", err)
772			}
773		case TransitionGraduate:
774			visibleErr := s.validateVisibleTryPath(canonicalSource)
775			archivedErr := s.validateArchivedPath(id, canonicalSource)
776			if visibleErr != nil && archivedErr != nil {
777				return fmt.Errorf("graduate source is neither a visible nor reserved archived Try: %v; %v", visibleErr, archivedErr)
778			}
779			if err := s.validateProjectDestination(canonicalDestination); err != nil {
780				return fmt.Errorf("graduate destination: %w", err)
781			}
782		default:
783			return fmt.Errorf("unknown move operation %q", operation)
784		}
785		if nested, nestedErr := pathx.IsChild(canonicalSource, canonicalDestination); nestedErr != nil {
786			return fmt.Errorf("validate %s destination: %w", operation, nestedErr)
787		} else if nested {
788			return fmt.Errorf("%s destination %s is inside its source %s", operation, canonicalDestination, canonicalSource)
789		}
790		return nil
791	}

793	func (s *Service) validateArchivedPath(id, path string) error {
794		root, err := s.canonicalArchiveRoot()
795		if err != nil {
796			return err
797		}
798		canonical, err := pathx.CanonicalChild(root, path)
799		if err != nil {
800			return err
801		}
802		relative, err := filepath.Rel(root, canonical)
803		if err != nil {
804			return err
805		}
806		parts := strings.Split(relative, string(filepath.Separator))
807		if len(parts) != 2 || parts[0] != id || strings.HasPrefix(parts[1], ".") {
808			return fmt.Errorf("%s is not the reserved archive path for %s", canonical, id)
809		}
810		return nil
811	}
812	
813	func (s *Service) validateProjectDestination(path string) error {
814		root, err := pathx.Canonical(s.projectRoot)
815		if err != nil {
816			return err
817		}
818		canonical, err := pathx.CanonicalChild(root, path)
819		if err != nil {
820			return err
821		}
822		relative, err := filepath.Rel(root, canonical)
823		if err != nil {
824			return err
825		}
826		parts := strings.Split(relative, string(filepath.Separator))
827		if len(parts) < 1 || len(parts) > 2 {
828			return fmt.Errorf("%s must be a project or category/project below %s", canonical, root)
829		}
830		for _, part := range parts {
831			if strings.HasPrefix(part, ".") {
832				return fmt.Errorf("hidden project component %q is not allowed", part)
833			}
834			if err := pathx.ValidateComponent(part); err != nil {
835				return err
836			}
837		}
838		return nil
839	}

852	func moveIntentEqual(left, right *catalog.MoveIntent) bool {
853		if left == nil || right == nil {
854			return left == right
855		}
856		return *left == *right

859	// ReconcileMoveIntents repairs moves interrupted between intent creation and
860	// catalog finalization. Ambiguous both-present and neither-present states are
861	// retained for explicit recovery and returned as diagnostics.
862	func (s *Service) ReconcileMoveIntents(ctx context.Context) ([]Diagnostic, error) {
863		entries, catalogProblems, err := s.store.ListWithDiagnostics()
864		if err != nil {
865			return nil, err
866		}
867		diagnostics := catalogDiagnostics(catalogProblems)
868		for _, entry := range entries {
869			if entry.MoveIntent == nil || entry.MoveIntent.Host != s.host {
870				continue
871			}
872			if err := s.reconcileMoveIntent(ctx, entry); err != nil {
873				diagnostics = append(diagnostics, Diagnostic{
874					Path: entry.ID, Operation: "reconcile pending move", Err: err,
875				})
876			}
877		}
878		diagnostics = deduplicateDiagnostics(diagnostics)
879		sortDiagnostics(diagnostics)
880		return diagnostics, nil
881	}

894	func (s *Service) reconcileMoveIntent(ctx context.Context, snapshot *catalog.Entry) error {
895		intent := snapshot.MoveIntent
896		if intent == nil || intent.Host != s.host {
897			return nil
898		}
899		operation := TransitionOperation(intent.Operation)
900		if err := s.validateTransitionContainment(snapshot.ID, operation, intent.SourcePath, intent.DestinationPath); err != nil {
901			return err
902		}
903		sourceExists, err := pathExists(intent.SourcePath)
904		if err != nil {
905			return err
906		}
907		destinationExists, err := pathExists(intent.DestinationPath)
908		if err != nil {
909			return err
910		}
911		switch {
912		case sourceExists && !destinationExists:
913			return s.clearMoveIntent(ctx, snapshot.ID, intent)
914		case !sourceExists && destinationExists:
915			probe := s.probeDirectory(ctx, intent.DestinationPath)
916			if !probe.valid {
917				if probe.diagnostic != nil {
918					return probe.diagnostic
919				}
920				return fmt.Errorf("pending %s destination %s is not a directory", operation, intent.DestinationPath)
921			}
922			_, err := s.finalizeMoveIntent(ctx, snapshot.ID, probe)
923			return err
924		case sourceExists && destinationExists:
925			return fmt.Errorf("pending %s move for %s is ambiguous: both source and destination exist; intent retained", operation, snapshot.ID)
926		default:
927			return fmt.Errorf("pending %s move for %s is ambiguous: neither source nor destination exists; intent retained", operation, snapshot.ID)
928		}
929	}
930	
931	func (s *Service) clearMoveIntent(ctx context.Context, id string, expected *catalog.MoveIntent) error {
932		return s.store.WithLock(ctx, func() error {
933			current, err := s.store.Get(id)
934			if err != nil {
935				return err
936			}
937			if !moveIntentEqual(current.MoveIntent, expected) {
938				return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s move intent changed during reconciliation", id)
939			}
940			if err := s.validateTransitionContainment(id, TransitionOperation(expected.Operation), expected.SourcePath, expected.DestinationPath); err != nil {
941				return err
942			}
943			sourceExists, err := pathExists(expected.SourcePath)
944			if err != nil {
945				return err
946			}
947			destinationExists, err := pathExists(expected.DestinationPath)
948			if err != nil {
949				return err
950			}
951			if !sourceExists || destinationExists {
952				return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s move state changed during rollback reconciliation", id)
953			}
954			_, err = s.catalogUpdate(id, func(entry *catalog.Entry) error {
955				if !moveIntentEqual(entry.MoveIntent, expected) {
956					return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s move intent changed during reconciliation", id)
957				}
958				entry.MoveIntent = nil
959				return nil
960			})
961			return err
962		})
963	}
964	
965	func (s *Service) finalizeMoveIntent(ctx context.Context, id string, probe directoryProbe) (*catalog.Entry, error) {
966		var updated *catalog.Entry
967		err := s.store.WithLock(ctx, func() error {
968			current, err := s.store.Get(id)
969			if err != nil {
970				return err
971			}
972			intent := current.MoveIntent
973			if intent == nil || intent.Host != s.host {
974				return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s has no pending move for this host", id)
975			}
976			operation := TransitionOperation(intent.Operation)
977			if err := s.validateTransitionEntry(current, operation, intent.SourcePath); err != nil {
978				return err
979			}
980			if err := s.validateTransitionPaths(current, operation, intent.SourcePath, intent.DestinationPath); err != nil {
981				return err
982			}
983			sourceExists, err := pathExists(intent.SourcePath)
984			if err != nil {
985				return err
986			}
987			destinationExists, err := pathExists(intent.DestinationPath)
988			if err != nil {
989				return err
990			}
991			if sourceExists || !destinationExists {
992				return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s move is not ready to finalize", id)
993			}
994			if !samePath(probe.live.CurrentPath, intent.DestinationPath) {
995				return fmt.Errorf("moved destination probe no longer matches %s", intent.DestinationPath)
996			}
997			if probe.live.DiscoverError != nil {
998				return fmt.Errorf("re-probe moved destination Git metadata: %w", probe.live.DiscoverError)
999			}
1000			if operation == TransitionGraduate && probe.live.Repo == nil {
1001				return errors.New("moved project is not a discoverable Git repository")
1002			}
1003	
1004			expected := *intent
1005			updated, err = s.catalogUpdate(id, func(entry *catalog.Entry) error {
1006				if entry.MoveIntent == nil || *entry.MoveIntent != expected {
1007					return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s move intent changed before finalization", id)
1008				}
1009				previous, ok := entry.LocationFor(s.host)
1010				if !ok {
1011					return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s lost its host location", id)
1012				}
1013				switch operation {
1014				case TransitionArchive:
1015					location := locationFromProbe(probe, previous)
1016					location.State = catalog.LocationArchived
1017					location.RestorePath = intent.SourcePath
1018					if err := entry.SetLocation(s.host, location); err != nil {
1019						return err
1020					}
1021				case TransitionRestore:
1022					location := locationFromProbe(probe, previous)
1023					location.RestorePath = ""
1024					if err := entry.SetLocation(s.host, location); err != nil {
1025						return err
1026					}
1027				case TransitionGraduate:
1028					entry.Kind = catalog.KindRepository
1029					entry.Name = filepath.Base(intent.DestinationPath)
1030					entry.Experiment.Phase = catalog.PhaseGraduated
1031					entry.Experiment.GraduatedAt = intent.Started
1032					entry.Experiment.GraduatedPath = probe.live.CurrentPath
1033					if probe.originURL != "" {
1034						entry.Experiment.OriginURL = probe.originURL
1035						entry.RemoteIdentity = remoteIdentityFromOrigin(probe.originURL)
1036					}
1037					location := locationFromProbe(probe, previous)
1038					location.RestorePath = ""
1039					if err := entry.SetLocation(s.host, location); err != nil {
1040						return err
1041					}
1042				default:
1043					return fmt.Errorf("unknown move operation %q", operation)
1044				}
1045				entry.MoveIntent = nil
1046				return nil
1047			})
1048			return err
1049		})
1050		return updated, err
1051	}
1052	
1053	func (s *Service) itemForEntry(ctx context.Context, entry *catalog.Entry) Item {
1054		if entry == nil {
1055			return Item{}
1056		}
1057		location, located := entry.LocationFor(s.host)
1058		live := LiveFacts{}
1059		if located {
1060			live.CurrentPath = location.CurrentPath
1061			live.RealPath = location.RealPath
1062			live.Present = location.State == catalog.LocationPresent
1063		}
1064		if live.Present {
1065			probe := s.probeDirectory(ctx, live.CurrentPath)
1066			if probe.valid {
1067				live = probe.live
1068			}
1069		}
1070		item := itemFromEntry(entry, live)
1071		if live.Present {
1072			enriched := s.enrich(ctx, []Item{item})
1073			if len(enriched) == 1 {
1074				item = enriched[0]
1075			}
1076		}
1077		return item
1078	}
```

```text
383	func makeTryJSONRow(item experiment.Item, host string) tryJSONRow {
384		row := tryJSONRow{
385			Identity: tryJSONIdentity{
386				ID: item.ID, Kind: item.Kind, Name: item.Name, Slug: item.Slug, Basename: item.Basename,
387			},
388			Experiment: tryJSONExperiment{
389				Phase: item.Phase, OriginURL: item.OriginURL, Started: rfc3339Value(item.Started),
390			},
391			Live: tryJSONLive{
392				Present: item.Live.Present, Path: item.Live.CurrentPath, RealPath: item.Live.RealPath,
393				ActivityAt: rfc3339Value(item.Activity()),
394			},
395			Metadata: tryJSONMetadata{
396				Tags: append([]string{}, item.Tags...), Note: item.Note,
397				Created: rfc3339Value(item.Created), LastOpened: rfc3339Value(item.LastOpened),
398			},
399		}
400		if item.Entry != nil {
401			if experimentMetadata := item.Entry.Experiment; experimentMetadata != nil {
402				row.Experiment.OriginalPath = experimentMetadata.OriginalPath
403				row.Experiment.DeprecatedAt = rfc3339Value(experimentMetadata.DeprecatedAt)
404				row.Experiment.DeprecatedPath = experimentMetadata.DeprecatedPath
405				row.Experiment.GraduatedAt = rfc3339Value(experimentMetadata.GraduatedAt)
406				row.Experiment.GraduatedPath = experimentMetadata.GraduatedPath
407			}
408			if location, ok := item.Entry.LocationFor(host); ok {
409				row.Location = &tryJSONLocation{
410					Host: host, State: location.State, CurrentPath: location.CurrentPath,
411					RestorePath: location.RestorePath, RealPath: location.RealPath,
412					GitCommonDir: location.GitCommonDir, Updated: rfc3339Value(location.Updated),
413				}
414			}
415		}
416		if item.Live.Repo != nil {
417			git := &tryJSONGit{
418				LinkedWorktree: item.Live.Repo.IsLinkedWorktree,
419				LastCommitAt:   rfc3339Value(item.Live.LastCommit), LastSubject: item.Live.LastCommitSubject,
420			}
421			if item.Live.Status != nil {
422				dirty := item.Live.Status.Dirty()
423				git.Dirty = &dirty
424				git.Branch = item.Live.Status.Branch
425			}
426			row.Live.Git = git
427		}
428		for _, liveErr := range []error{item.CatalogError, item.Live.DiscoverError, item.Live.StatusError, item.Live.LastCommitError} {
429			if liveErr != nil {
430				row.Live.Errors = append(row.Live.Errors, liveErr.Error())
431			}
432		}
433		return row
434	}
435	
436	func rfc3339Value(value time.Time) *string {
437		if value.IsZero() {
438			return nil
439		}
440		formatted := value.UTC().Format(time.RFC3339)
441		return &formatted
442	}
```

```text
1	package cli
2	
3	import (
4		"sort"
5	
6		"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/catalog"
7		"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/config"
8		"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/pathx"
9		"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/repo"
10	)
11	
12	// joinRepoAssets matches a discovery snapshot without persisting every repo.
13	// complete is false when unreadable catalog records could make a negative or
14	// duplicate match unsafe to act on.
15	func joinRepoAssets(app *App, repos []repo.Repo) (assets []*catalog.Entry, complete bool, err error) {
16		assets = make([]*catalog.Entry, len(repos))
17		if app == nil || app.Catalog == nil {
18			return assets, true, nil
19		}
20		entries, diagnostics, err := app.Catalog.ListWithDiagnostics()
21		if err != nil {
22			app.warnf("could not read catalog metadata: %v; leaving repository rows unsuppressed", err)
23			return assets, false, nil
24		}
25		for _, diagnostic := range diagnostics {
26			app.warnf("%s", diagnostic.Error())
27		}
28		complete = len(diagnostics) == 0
29		host := configHostname()
30		for index, repository := range repos {
31			var matches []*catalog.Entry
32			for _, entry := range entries {
33				location, ok := entry.LocationFor(host)
34				if !ok || location.State != catalog.LocationPresent {
35					continue
36				}
37				if repoLocationMatches(repository, location) {
38					matches = append(matches, entry)
39				}
40			}
41			catalog.Sort(matches)
42			switch len(matches) {
43			case 1:
44				assets[index] = matches[0].Clone()
45			case 0:
46			default:
47				ids := make([]string, len(matches))
48				for i, entry := range matches {
49					ids[i] = entry.ID
50				}
51				sort.Strings(ids)
52				app.warnf("repository %s matches multiple catalog assets (%v); leaving it unsuppressed", repository.Path, ids)
53			}
54		}
55		return assets, complete, nil
56	}
57	
58	func repoLocationMatches(repository repo.Repo, location catalog.Location) bool {
59		repositoryPaths := canonicalRepoValues(repository.Path, repository.RealPath)
60		locationPaths := canonicalRepoValues(location.CurrentPath, location.RealPath)
61		for value := range repositoryPaths {
62			if _, ok := locationPaths[value]; ok {
63				return true
64			}
65		}
66		common := canonicalRepoValue(repository.CommonDir)
67		return common != "" && common == canonicalRepoValue(location.GitCommonDir)
68	}
69	
70	func canonicalRepoValues(values ...string) map[string]struct{} {
71		out := make(map[string]struct{}, len(values))
72		for _, value := range values {
73			if canonical := canonicalRepoValue(value); canonical != "" {
74				out[canonical] = struct{}{}
75			}
76		}
77		return out
78	}
79	
80	func canonicalRepoValue(value string) string {
81		if value == "" {
82			return ""
83		}
84		canonical, err := pathx.Canonical(value)
85		if err != nil {
86			return ""
87		}
88		return canonical
89	}
90	
91	func suppressTryRepo(entry *catalog.Entry, catalogComplete bool) bool {
92		if entry == nil || !catalogComplete || entry.Kind != catalog.KindTry || entry.Experiment == nil {
93			return false
94		}
95		return entry.Experiment.Phase == catalog.PhaseActive || entry.Experiment.Phase == catalog.PhaseDeprecated
96	}
97	
98	func configHostname() string {
99		// Kept behind a function to make every matching call visibly host-scoped.
100		return config.Hostname()
101	}
```

```text
+				CommonDir: commonDir, Name: repository.Name,
+				RemoteIdentity: gitx.RemoteFromConfig(commonDir, "origin"),
+			}
+			add = catalog.NormalizeTags(add)
+			remove = catalog.NormalizeTags(remove)
+			var marked *catalog.Entry
+			err = app.Catalog.WithLock(ctx, func() error {
+				entry, ensureErr := app.Registry.EnsureRepository(observation)
+				if ensureErr != nil {
+					return ensureErr
+				}
+				marked, ensureErr = app.Registry.Patch(entry.ID, func(candidate *catalog.Entry) error {
+					kept := make([]string, 0, len(candidate.Tags)+len(add))
+					for _, tag := range candidate.Tags {
+						if !slices.Contains(remove, tag) {
+							kept = append(kept, tag)
+						}
+					}
+					candidate.Tags = append(kept, add...)
+					if cmd.Flags().Changed("note") {
+						candidate.Note = note
+					}
+					return nil
+				})
+				return ensureErr
+			})
+			if err != nil {
+				return fmt.Errorf("mark repository %s: %w", repository.Display(), err)
+			}
+			fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "%s\n  path  %s\n  tags  %s\n  note  %s\n",
+				repository.Display(), config.Contract(repository.Path),
+				dash(strings.Join(marked.Tags, ", ")), dash(marked.Note))
+			return nil
+		},
+	}
+	flags := cmd.Flags()
+	flags.StringArrayVar(&add, "add", nil, "tag to add (repeatable)")
+	flags.StringArrayVar(&remove, "remove", nil, "tag to remove (repeatable)")
+	flags.StringVar(&note, "note", "", "replace the note; pass an empty value to clear it")
+	return cmd
+}
+
+type repoListJSONRow struct {
+	Name         string             `json:"name"`
+	Display      string             `json:"display"`
+	Kind         catalog.Kind       `json:"kind"`
+	Category     string             `json:"category,omitempty"`
+	Path         string             `json:"path"`
+	RealPath     string             `json:"real_path,omitempty"`
+	Symlink      bool               `json:"symlink"`
+	Bare         bool               `json:"bare"`
+	HasGit       bool               `json:"has_git"`
+	Branch       string             `json:"branch,omitempty"`
+	Git          repoListJSONGit    `json:"git"`
+	LastActivity *string            `json:"last_activity"`
+	Worktrees    int                `json:"worktrees"`
+	Asset        *repoListJSONAsset `json:"asset,omitempty"`
+}
+
+type repoListJSONGit struct {
+	Dirty     bool `json:"dirty"`
+	Changed   int  `json:"changed"`
+	Staged    int  `json:"staged"`
+	Unstaged  int  `json:"unstaged"`
+	Untracked int  `json:"untracked"`
+	Ahead     int  `json:"ahead"`
+	Behind    int  `json:"behind"`
+}
+
+type repoListJSONAsset struct {
+	ID    string                  `json:"id"`
+	Kind  catalog.Kind            `json:"kind"`
+	Phase catalog.ExperimentPhase `json:"phase,omitempty"`
+	Tags  []string                `json:"tags"`
+	Note  string                  `json:"note"`
+}
+
+func makeRepoListJSONRow(row tui.RepoRow) repoListJSONRow {
+	kind := catalog.KindRepository
+	if row.Asset != nil {
+		kind = row.Asset.Kind
+	}
+	result := repoListJSONRow{
+		Name: row.Repo.Name, Display: row.Repo.Display(), Kind: kind,
+		Category: row.Repo.Category, Path: row.Repo.Path, RealPath: row.Repo.RealPath,
+		Symlink: row.Repo.Symlink, Bare: row.Repo.Bare, HasGit: row.Repo.HasGit,
+		Branch: row.Status.Branch,
+		Git: repoListJSONGit{
+			Dirty: row.Status.Dirty(), Changed: row.Status.Changed,
+			Staged: row.Status.Staged, Unstaged: row.Status.Unstaged,
+			Untracked: row.Status.Untracked, Ahead: row.Status.Ahead, Behind: row.Status.Behind,
+		},
+		LastActivity: rfc3339Value(row.LastActivity), Worktrees: row.Worktrees,
+	}
+	if row.Asset != nil {
+		asset := &repoListJSONAsset{
+			ID: row.Asset.ID, Kind: row.Asset.Kind,
+			Tags: append([]string{}, row.Asset.Tags...), Note: row.Asset.Note,
+		}
+		if row.Asset.Experiment != nil {
+			asset.Phase = row.Asset.Experiment.Phase
+		}
+		result.Asset = asset
+	}
+	return result
+}

+
+func applyCatalogRemoteMatches(app *App, rows []tui.RemoteRow) {
+	if app == nil || app.Catalog == nil || len(rows) == 0 {
+		return
+	}
+	entries, diagnostics, err := app.Catalog.ListWithDiagnostics()
+	if err != nil {
+		app.warnf("could not read catalog for remote matching: %v", err)
+		return
+	}
+	for _, diagnostic := range diagnostics {
+		app.warnf("%s", diagnostic.Error())
+	}
+	if len(diagnostics) > 0 {
+		return
+	}
+	host := config.Hostname()
+	byIdentity := make(map[string][]*catalog.Entry)
+	for _, entry := range entries {
+		location, ok := entry.LocationFor(host)
+		if !ok || location.State != catalog.LocationPresent || entry.RemoteIdentity == "" ||
+			liveCatalogLocationPath(location) == "" {
+			continue
+		}
+		byIdentity[entry.RemoteIdentity] = append(byIdentity[entry.RemoteIdentity], entry)
+	}
+	for index := range rows {
+		identity := catalog.NormalizeRemoteIdentity(rows[index].Repo.CloneURL)
+		matches := byIdentity[identity]
+		if identity == "" || len(matches) != 1 {
+			continue
+		}
+		location, _ := matches[0].LocationFor(host)
+		rows[index].LocalPath = liveCatalogLocationPath(location)
+		rows[index].LocalName = matches[0].Name
+		rows[index].LocalKind = matches[0].Kind
+	}
+}
+
+func liveCatalogLocationPath(location catalog.Location) string {
+	for _, candidate := range []string{location.CurrentPath, location.RealPath} {
+		if candidate == "" {
+			continue
+		}
+		if info, err := os.Stat(candidate); err == nil && info.IsDir() {
+			return candidate
+		}
+	}
+	return ""
+}
```

```text
29	func (e *FinalizeError) Error() string {

33		}

37		}
38		return fmt.Sprintf("finalize %s catalog after moving %s to %s: %v; rollback to %s also failed: %v",

40	}

43		if e.RollbackErr == nil {

45		}

71				IncludeDeprecated: true,
72				IncludeArchived:   true,
73			})
74		}
75		current := request.CurrentDir
76		if current == "" {

78			current, err = s.getwd()
79			if err != nil {

90		}
91		relative, err := filepath.Rel(canonicalRoot, canonicalCurrent)
92		if err != nil {
93			return Item{}, nil, err
94		}
95		first, _, _ := strings.Cut(relative, string(filepath.Separator))

97			return Item{}, nil, fmt.Errorf("%s is not inside a visible try under %s", current, s.triesRoot)

102		})
103	}

116		}

124			if err != nil {
125				return false, err
126			}
127			if _, err := fmt.Fprintf(file, "# %s\n", name); err != nil {
128				_ = file.Close()

141		}

145			// must not force-add or overwrite those user files merely to manufacture it.
146			commitArgs = append(commitArgs, "--allow-empty")
147		}
148		commitArgs = append(commitArgs, "-m", "chore: graduate experiment into a project")
149		if _, err := s.gitRun(ctx, directory, commitArgs...); err != nil {
150			return false, err
151		}

155	func rejectExisting(path string) error {
156		if _, err := os.Lstat(path); err == nil {
157			return fmt.Errorf("%s already exists", path)
158		} else if !errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
159			return fmt.Errorf("inspect move destination %s: %w", path, err)
160		}
161		return nil
162	}
163	
164	func isEmptyWorkTree(directory string) (bool, error) {
165		entries, err := os.ReadDir(directory)
166		if err != nil {
167			return false, err
168		}
169		for _, entry := range entries {
170			if entry.Name() != ".git" {
171				return false, nil
172			}
173		}
174		return true, nil
175	}
176	
177	func nearestExisting(path string) (string, error) {
178		path = filepath.Clean(path)
179		for {
180			if _, err := os.Stat(path); err == nil {
181				return path, nil
182			} else if !errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
183				return "", err
184			}
185			parent := filepath.Dir(path)
186			if parent == path {
187				return "", fmt.Errorf("no existing ancestor for %s", path)
188			}
189			path = parent
190		}
191	}
```

```text
18	// Repo is one discovered repository.
19	type Repo struct {
20		// Name is the directory basename, which is how users refer to it.
21		Name string
22		// Path is the absolute path reached through the scan root. It may be a
23		// symlink from a bootstrap index; commands intentionally keep that human
24		// navigation path rather than replacing it with the physical one.
25		Path string
26		// RealPath is the physical checkout path.
27		RealPath string
28		// Symlink reports that Path is an alias to RealPath.
29		Symlink bool
30		// Root is the scan root it was found under.
31		Root string
32		// Category is the path between the scan root and the repo ("Quant",
33		// "Web/Frontend"), empty for a repo sitting directly in the root. It is
34		// human organisation metadata, preserved for `dev graduate` to place new
35		// projects consistently.
36		Category string
37		// CommonDir is Git's shared administrative directory. Its worktrees/
38		// children let inventory count linked checkouts without another git
39		// process per repository.
40		CommonDir string
41		// Bare reports a bare repository (a worktree hub).
42		Bare bool
43		// HasGit distinguishes a real repo from a plain directory that was found
44		// in a scan root; non-repos are reported so `dev repo list` can offer to
45		// initialise them.
46		HasGit bool
47	}
48	
49	// Display renders "Category/Name" or just "Name".
50	func (r Repo) Display() string {
51		if r.Category == "" {
52			return r.Name
53		}
54		return r.Category + "/" + r.Name
55	}
56	
57	// Options tunes discovery.
58	type Options struct {
59		// MaxDepth limits how deep below a scan root a repo may be found. The
60		// default layout is <root>/<Category>/<Repo>, so 2 suffices; 3 leaves room
61		// for a nested grouping without walking an entire home directory.
62		MaxDepth int
63		// IncludeNonRepos reports plain directories alongside repositories.
64		IncludeNonRepos bool
65	}
66	
67	// DefaultOptions is the discovery configuration used by dev's commands.
68	func DefaultOptions() Options { return Options{MaxDepth: 3} }
69	
70	// skipDirs are never descended into. These are large, never contain a project
71	// the user organises by hand, and walking them dominates scan time.
72	var skipDirs = map[string]bool{
73		"node_modules": true, ".venv": true, "venv": true, "target": true,
74		"vendor": true, "__pycache__": true, ".tox": true, "dist": true,
75		"build": true, ".next": true, ".cache": true, ".terraform": true,
76		"Library": true, ".Trash": true,
77	}
78	
79	// Discover walks every root and returns the repositories found, sorted by
80	// display name. Unreadable directories are skipped rather than fatal — a scan
81	// root that has been unmounted must not break `dev ls`.
82	func Discover(ctx context.Context, roots []string, opts Options) ([]Repo, error) {
83		if opts.MaxDepth <= 0 {
84			opts.MaxDepth = DefaultOptions().MaxDepth
85		}
86		seen := map[string]bool{}
87		// clone identities stop a physical path and a symlink index from showing
88		// the same repository twice. The first scan root wins, which lets users
89		// choose whether the curated index or the physical hierarchy is their UI
90		// simply by ordering scan_roots.
91		identities := map[string]bool{}
92		var out []Repo
93	
94		for _, root := range roots {
95			info, err := os.Stat(root)
96			if err != nil || !info.IsDir() {
97				continue // a missing scan root is normal on a fresh machine
98			}
99			rootClean := filepath.Clean(root)
100	
101			err = filepath.WalkDir(rootClean, func(path string, d fs.DirEntry, err error) error {
102				if err != nil {
103					return nil // unreadable entry: skip, keep walking
104				}
105				if ctx.Err() != nil {
106					return ctx.Err()
107				}
108				if path == rootClean {
109					return nil
110				}
111				name := d.Name()
112				isLink := d.Type()&os.ModeSymlink != 0
113				isDir := d.IsDir()
114				if isLink {
115					// WalkDir does not follow symlinks. Inspect a direct symlink to
116					// a repository, but do not recurse through arbitrary symlinked
117					// containers — bootstrap does that with cycle detection.
118					if info, err := os.Stat(path); err == nil {
119						isDir = info.IsDir()
120					}
121				}
122				if !isDir {
123					return nil
124				}
125				if skipDirs[name] || (strings.HasPrefix(name, ".") && name != ".bare") {
126					return filepath.SkipDir
127				}
128	
129				rel, _ := filepath.Rel(rootClean, path)
130				depth := len(strings.Split(rel, string(filepath.Separator)))
131	
132				if isRepoDir(path) {
133					real, _ := filepath.EvalSymlinks(path)
134					if real == "" {
135						real = path
136					}
137					bare := isBareDir(path)
138					identity, commonDir := real, real
139					if !bare {
140						if g, err := gitx.Discover(ctx, path); err == nil {
141							// A linked worktree is execution state, not another
142							// project in the repo inventory.
143							if g.IsLinkedWorktree {
144								return filepath.SkipDir
145							}
146							identity, commonDir = g.GitCommonDir, g.GitCommonDir
147							real = g.MainRoot
148						}
149					}
150					if !seen[path] && !identities[identity] {
151						seen[path], identities[identity] = true, true
152						out = append(out, Repo{
153							Name:      name,
154							Path:      path,
155							RealPath:  real,
156							Symlink:   isLink,
157							Root:      rootClean,
158							Category:  filepath.ToSlash(filepath.Dir(rel)),
159							CommonDir: commonDir,
160							Bare:      bare,
161							HasGit:    true,
162						})
163					}
164					// Never descend into a repo: its subdirectories are source
165					// code, and any nested .git is a submodule or a worktree that
166					// belongs to this repo, not a project of its own.
167					return filepath.SkipDir
168				}
169				if depth >= opts.MaxDepth {
170					return filepath.SkipDir
171				}
172				if opts.IncludeNonRepos && depth == 1 {
173					if !seen[path] {
174						seen[path] = true
175						out = append(out, Repo{Name: name, Path: path, Root: rootClean, Category: ""})
176					}
177				}
178				return nil
179			})
180			if err != nil && ctx.Err() != nil {
181				return out, ctx.Err()
182			}
183		}
184	
185		for i := range out {
186			if out[i].Category == "." {
187				out[i].Category = ""
188			}
189		}
190		sort.Slice(out, func(i, j int) bool {
191			if out[i].Name != out[j].Name {
192				return strings.ToLower(out[i].Name) < strings.ToLower(out[j].Name)
193			}
194			return out[i].Path < out[j].Path
195		})
196		return out, nil
197	}
198	
199	// isRepoDir reports whether path is a repository root: it holds a .git entry
200	// (directory for a normal clone, file for a linked worktree or submodule).
201	func isRepoDir(path string) bool {
202		if _, err := os.Lstat(filepath.Join(path, ".git")); err == nil {
203			return true
204		}
205		return isBareDir(path)
206	}
```
